job.title: Lead - Travel Services
job.description:
Responsibilities

Partner with Head-Ahmedabad in understanding the organization’s requirement for Hard services across all facilities (including MEP maintenance services, Inventory management for all supplies and tools, Infrastructure management and maintenance, and space management)

Develop the budget for Hard Services in consultation with Head-Ahmedabad;

Ensure adherence to pre-defined budgetary and cost optimization guidelines

Define a service delivery framework and service delivery plan for hard services basis the requirements for every facility/property under purview

Define and communicate operating procedure/ guidelines for hard services in accordance with the overall policy guidelines; Update the operating procedures from time to time keeping in consideration the changing business dynamics and requirements

Conduct Need assessment of MEP services from future operational perspective

Develop a Business Continuity plan from an Admin perspective to ensure smooth operations across locations

Develop & ensure implementation of SOPs, Engineering Guidelines for Electro- mechanical services, and operation control procedures for smooth operations

Prepare, analyse & improve SoWs for AMCs for maximum benefit realisation

Assess, identify, and plan the Life Cycle Completion, replacement of the Electro-mechanical equipment

Plan a calendar and ensure all MEP activities and structural upgradations are carried out for all facilities (heating/cooling systems, plumbing and water management, lightings, scientific tank cleaning, façade cleaning, painting etc.) with minimal/ zero downtime/ service disruption

Conduct service inspection and create a sustenance plan for pre-emptive and reactive maintenance to minimize downtime at Sites

Track and ensure timely renewal & submission of all mandatory compliances, licenses and health, safety, and statutory environmental requirements

Run and oversee complete snag management cycle for acquired property / infrastructure; Ensure closure of critical snags pertaining to MEP services.

Ensure monitoring of PPM calendar with adherence to all safety protocols

Management of readable Blue-prints, Schematics and diagrams of the equipment’s

Analyse and record all test results and prepare analysis documentation statement

Oversee all mechanical services including HVAC systems, elevators, escalators, Mechanized Systems- BMU, Façade Cradle systems, Dumb waiters, waste disposal systems, Lift well and Stairwell pressurization system, Basement Ventilation & Exhaust System, etc.

Oversee all electrical & instrumentation services including lighting, load Management & distribution systems, UPS, elevators, earthing and grounding systems

Oversee all plumbing services including domestic water system, Softener System, RO system, hot & cold-water system, flushing water system, sewage water system, storage tanks, rainwater harvesting system, Water bodies etc.

Design a plan for mechanical services basis the requirement for the property and work closely with engineering team for proper and timely support

Devise an annual maintenance calendar for inspection of all services and create a plan for preventive and reactive maintenance for mechanical services to minimize downtime

Develop a robust breakdown maintenance plan for all core mechanical services; Manage proper placement of signage pertaining to demarcation of safety lines around electromechanical area

Create a training calendar to ensure resources are updated with the technical know-how, market best practices and industry standards

Manage day to day operations (including routine maintenance operations, IBMS Rooms and related services and preventive controls) of all mechanical services at respective facility, site or guest house and address critical incidents if any while reporting any near misses

Review mechanical services’ performance at regular intervals; Conduct audits and root cause analysis of identified issues and ensure timely resolution of all problems with optimal utilization of all resources to increase site effectiveness.

Lead the conceptualization, design development and planning of new building and infrastructure.

Collaborate with Architect, Interior Design, MEP Consultants to finalize the design and execute strategy.

Review and validate design proposals, layout plans and construction drawings.

Execution and monitoring of Projects.

Monitor appropriate and timely resolution of hard services’ queries/ grievance redressal at the Helpdesk; Address escalations if any and provide guidance to teams to effectively resolve all queries

Analyse the service performance and employee satisfaction levels (through formal / informal feedback) and pilot strategic initiatives to drive process improvements to improve employee satisfaction

Maintain close coordination with other departmental services viz. Fire, Security, Telecom, IT and extend support as required

Manage communication pertaining to planned maintenance activities

Adhere to the Admin Governance framework and ensure all hard service processes are in compliance with the same

Analyse audit findings with regards to hard service operations and collaborate with the concerned stakeholders to develop effective action plans for mitigating risks/ gaps identified

Ensure timely submission & verification of service partner bills as well as timely pay-out as per agreed SLAs (for all facility services)

Conduct operational reviews from time to time and ensure smooth service delivery and adherence to defined SLAs for hard services

Identify and build partnerships and relationships with external vendors, government officials to ensure all necessary permits are in place

Successfully leverage these networks for value creation for Adani; Oversee partner offerings and lead negotiations with them for all hard services

Provide insights on service partner performance and address/ resolve any escalations

Identify areas within Hard services which could be automated/ integrated with technology and collaborate with the relevant stakeholders to plan and deploy these initiatives

Ensure smooth functioning of the tools for Hard services’ delivery; Track customer satisfaction levels

Assets’ database to be maintained basis tagging of assets and verified on a bi-annual basis

  • Coordinate with third party for timely availability of contractual manpower, manage them through shift planning and manage daily roster for all services; Ensure staff is working in line with the agreed SLA
  • Drive a performance driven culture – Set goals, review performance and provide feedback to ensure a motivated and committed team
  • Foster an environment of learning and excellence within the team.

4.

Internal External

  • Interact with Group Admin Head/Lead-Shantigram Cluster to formulate and continually validate the roadmap and plan for Hard Services’ delivery
  • Interact with a service partners and build strategic relationships with them with an objective of service excellence.
  • Collaborate with various stakeholders across businesses and understand their requirements, grievances about hard services
  • Interact with existing partners to reinforce working relationship, strengthen collaboration, track service deliveries and mitigate risks if any

5.

6.

Strategy

  • Business Plan formulation & Deployment
  • Improvement Initiatives’ Implementation

Financial

  • Budget Creation
  • Budget Compliance
  • Cost Optimization

Process

  • Hard Services Process Compliance
  • Hard Services Process Efficiency
  • Hard Services Process Enhancement
  • Drive Process Optimization and Standardization
  • Customer Satisfaction
  • Query Resolution /Grievance Redressal

People

  • Partner Relationship Management
  • People management & Skill Development

Qualifications

  • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering (Preferred: MBA (Operations/Facilities Management) / PGDM in Facilities Management)
  • 8-12 years of experience in Facility Management, Corporate Administration, Workplace Services, Hospitality, Real Estate Operations, or IFM.
  • Min 5+ years in Technical Services, Facility Engineering, Building Operations, or IFM.
  • Experience managing corporate campuses, commercial buildings, data centers, industrial facilities, or mixed-use developments.
  • Hands-on exposure to MEP operations and critical infrastructure management.
  • Exposure in facility digitization and CAFM implementation.

Experience handling senior leadership and executive workplace environments

job.title: Site HR Operations Partner
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Onboarding:

Support recruitment processes tailored to the site's requirements

  • Enabling the Day-1 onboarding based on document verification in coordination with security
  • Coordinate with Admin for Joining Kit distribution based on pre-shared joining lists
  • Ensure IT asset allocation on day of joining by coordinating with the IT team
  • Manage the onboarding process to ensure a seamless transition for new hires.
  • Administrative support for managing the induction process as designed
  • Welcome session with the new joiner and meet & greet with the Manager & team

Contractor Labor Management System:

  • Unique contractor ID creation & update in the CLMS (Kronos) for all contractors
  • Enable time and attendance tracking for all workmen at the sites
  • Manage the off-roll workforce management with focus on Legatrix platform and oversee the licenses and RC of labor laws
  • On ground coordination with the BU, contractor, security & other departments in case of offboarding

Performance and Development:

  • Administer performance management systems and work with leaders to ensure regular feedback and development planning.
  • Identify training needs and coordinate relevant learning and development initiatives to upskill employees.
  • Support GCC Towers in execution of the annual review cycles in order to achieve timely competition

Compliance and Policy Implementation:

  • Ensure adherence to all applicable labor laws and internal policies.
  • Review and update HR policies to reflect the dynamic needs of the capability center.
  • Managing Labor law related notices, filing of Monthly/ Quarterly/ Half yearly/ Annual returns (Non-Payroll) (including Apprentice Act)
  • Statutory documentation and recordkeeping team is responsible for the document management of all the sites

Health, Safety, and Wellbeing:

  • Coordinates the communication between the Site HR/Cluster HR Head and GCC LEA team whenever needed on employee health & safety issues
  • Support in incident management with coordination between employee/workmen, regional site manager, reporting manager and BU HR
  • Logging & escalating the required incidents to Group IR team over a call/e-mail in case of critical incidents

Stakeholder management:

  • Cultivate long standing relationships with local departments, regional labor office and other external stakeholders to maintain seamless operations.
  • Develop and implement effective communication strategies to engage stakeholders and keep them informed about site activities, changes, and developments.

Employee Engagement and Culture:

  • Organize events, workshops, and activities to foster a vibrant and inclusive workplace culture.
  • Support the employee engagement events by coordination with established vendors, procurement and administration teams
  • Calendarization of events and designing, communicating and coordinating for all engagement events at the sites

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree or MBA in HR is advantageous.
  • 3-10 years of HR experience, with at least 2 years in a management role within a manufacturing unit, plant or similar environment.

job.title: Duty Manager - Landside Security
job.description:
Responsibilities

Security Operations Management:

Oversee day-to-day landside security operations during shifts for landside, city side, airport village site, including patrolling, access control, and surveillance activities, to ensure adherence to established policies and procedures.

Act as the primary point of contact for on-site security teams, providing guidance and addressing any issues that arise promptly to maintain secure and seamless operations.

Conduct regular inspections of landside areas to identify potential risks or deviations from established standards.

Ensure operational readiness of all security equipment, including CCTV systems, access control devices, and communication tools. Coordinate with the Integrated Security Operations Center (ISOC) for seamless monitoring and response.

Incident Reporting and Response:

Coordinate initial response efforts during security incidents, gathering relevant information and ensuring immediate actions are taken to address the situation effectively.

Prepare detailed incident reports for the Lead - Landside Security, capturing all relevant information and contributing to follow-up investigations and preventive measures.

Supervision of Access Control and Traffic Management:

Oversee access control, Crowd control, Traffic management, loss prevention and asset protections measures for landside areas, including vehicle and personnel access, ensuring compliance with security protocols and addressing any exceptions or irregularities.

Manage traffic flow within landside zones, implementing measures to prevent congestion and maintain a secure environment for all employees, visitors, and vendors.

Ensure round the clock protection to both the tangible and intangible assets.

Risk Assessment and Mitigation:

Conduct routine risk assessments of landside operations and recommend mitigation measures.

Monitor local, national, and international developments that may impact landside security operations.

Report potential risks to the Lead - Landside Security and suggest proactive measures to address them.

Team Coordination and Scheduling:

Plan and manage shift schedules for landside security staff, coordinating coverage to ensure all critical areas are monitored and secured at all times.

Facilitate communication within the team, holding regular briefings to discuss daily objectives, key concerns, and any updates to security protocols that need to be followed.

Provide on-the-job training and guidance to security staff to improve performance and compliance.

Monitor the performance of outsourced security staff and escalate issues to the vendor management team if needed.

Compliance and Audit Support:

Conduct routine audits of landside security operations to identify areas for improvement and ensure full compliance with established standards.

Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation and ensuring compliance with findings.

Update staff on new regulations, SOP changes, and directives issued by regulatory agencies.

Stakeholder Liaison:

Act as the primary point of contact for landside security issues during the shift.

Collaborate with airport operations, law enforcement agencies, and other stakeholders to resolve operational challenges.

Address complaints or concerns from passengers, visitors, and employees regarding security matters.

Reporting and Documentation:

Review and submit shift reports detailing incidents, operational highlights, and staff performance.

Maintain accurate records of access control activities, visitor management, and incident investigations.

Ensure all documentation is updated and stored securely for audit and compliance purposes.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Lead - Landside Security

Operations Team

Facilities Management

Security Control Room Team

Airlines

HR and Training Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

Local Law Enforcement Agencies

Regulatory Bodies (e.g., BCAS)

Third-Party Security Service Providers

Contractors and Vendors

Community Representatives

Customs

Emergency Response Services (EMS, Fire Services)

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Public Safety, or a related discipline.

AVSEC certification or equivalent airport security certification.

Training in Crisis Management or Incident Response is preferred.

Work Experience:

5-10 (Depending on the site complexity/ requirement) years of experience in a security operations role, with at least 2 years in a supervisory capacity.

Experience in managing daily security operations, handling incidents, and ensuring compliance with security policies and protocols.

job.title: Duty Manager - Landside Security
job.description:
Responsibilities

Security Operations Management:

Oversee day-to-day landside security operations during shifts for landside, city side, airport village site, including patrolling, access control, and surveillance activities, to ensure adherence to established policies and procedures.

Act as the primary point of contact for on-site security teams, providing guidance and addressing any issues that arise promptly to maintain secure and seamless operations.

Conduct regular inspections of landside areas to identify potential risks or deviations from established standards.

Ensure operational readiness of all security equipment, including CCTV systems, access control devices, and communication tools. Coordinate with the Integrated Security Operations Center (ISOC) for seamless monitoring and response.

Incident Reporting and Response:

Coordinate initial response efforts during security incidents, gathering relevant information and ensuring immediate actions are taken to address the situation effectively.

Prepare detailed incident reports for the Lead - Landside Security, capturing all relevant information and contributing to follow-up investigations and preventive measures.

Supervision of Access Control and Traffic Management:

Oversee access control, Crowd control, Traffic management, loss prevention and asset protections measures for landside areas, including vehicle and personnel access, ensuring compliance with security protocols and addressing any exceptions or irregularities.

Manage traffic flow within landside zones, implementing measures to prevent congestion and maintain a secure environment for all employees, visitors, and vendors.

Ensure round the clock protection to both the tangible and intangible assets.

Risk Assessment and Mitigation:

Conduct routine risk assessments of landside operations and recommend mitigation measures.

Monitor local, national, and international developments that may impact landside security operations.

Report potential risks to the Lead - Landside Security and suggest proactive measures to address them.

Team Coordination and Scheduling:

Plan and manage shift schedules for landside security staff, coordinating coverage to ensure all critical areas are monitored and secured at all times.

Facilitate communication within the team, holding regular briefings to discuss daily objectives, key concerns, and any updates to security protocols that need to be followed.

Provide on-the-job training and guidance to security staff to improve performance and compliance.

Monitor the performance of outsourced security staff and escalate issues to the vendor management team if needed.

Compliance and Audit Support:

Conduct routine audits of landside security operations to identify areas for improvement and ensure full compliance with established standards.

Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation and ensuring compliance with findings.

Update staff on new regulations, SOP changes, and directives issued by regulatory agencies.

Stakeholder Liaison:

Act as the primary point of contact for landside security issues during the shift.

Collaborate with airport operations, law enforcement agencies, and other stakeholders to resolve operational challenges.

Address complaints or concerns from passengers, visitors, and employees regarding security matters.

Reporting and Documentation:

Review and submit shift reports detailing incidents, operational highlights, and staff performance.

Maintain accurate records of access control activities, visitor management, and incident investigations.

Ensure all documentation is updated and stored securely for audit and compliance purposes.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Lead - Landside Security

Operations Team

Facilities Management

Security Control Room Team

Airlines

HR and Training Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

Local Law Enforcement Agencies

Regulatory Bodies (e.g., BCAS)

Third-Party Security Service Providers

Contractors and Vendors

Community Representatives

Customs

Emergency Response Services (EMS, Fire Services)

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Public Safety, or a related discipline.

AVSEC certification or equivalent airport security certification.

Training in Crisis Management or Incident Response is preferred.

Work Experience:

5-10 (Depending on the site complexity/ requirement) years of experience in a security operations role, with at least 2 years in a supervisory capacity.

Experience in managing daily security operations, handling incidents, and ensuring compliance with security policies and protocols.

job.description:

job.title: Manager - Operations Research Scientist
job.description:
Responsibilities

Operations Research Scientist-AI Labs

Development & Implementation of Optimization Models:

Improve operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness by developing and implementing optimization models for logistics, supply chain, manufacturing, and other business processes.

Enhance business decision-making by applying mathematical optimization techniques such as linear programming, combinatorial optimization, integer programming, and network flow algorithms.

Ensure scalability and adaptability of models by leveraging advanced AI ML methodologies, hybrid optimization techniques, and data-driven simulation models.

Optimize business strategies by integrating optimization models into long-term strategic planning and short-term tactical decision-making.

Advanced Algorithm Development & Problem Solving:

Enhance model performance and accuracy by leveraging simulated annealing, genetic algorithms, tabu search, Markov decision processes, and ant colony optimization.

Drive process automation and optimization by designing data-driven decision support systems to optimize business workflows.

Optimize EV fleet operations by designing data-driven charging optimization models, ensuring cost-effective and efficient EV charging strategies.

Enhance cost reduction in logistics by applying combinatorial optimization, network flow algorithms, and machine learning-driven route planning.

Reduce complexity and improve computational efficiency by implementing decomposition algorithms and large-scale mathematical models.

Business Problem-Solving with Operations Research:

Enable predictive and prescriptive decision-making by analyzing historical and real-time data to develop optimal operational strategies.

Minimize operational disruptions and enhance resource utilization by applying discrete event simulation techniques.

Improve cost efficiency and risk mitigation by integrating optimization models with business forecasting and financial planning.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & AI Integration:

Ensure alignment of optimization models with business objectives by collaborating with business leaders, strategy teams, and data scientists.

Drive AI adoption in operations research by working with IT and engineering teams to deploy models on scalable cloud-based platforms.

Translate complex mathematical models into actionable insights by effectively communicating findings to C-level executives and decision-makers.

AI Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement:

Ensure regulatory compliance and ethical AI implementation by developing governance frameworks for AI-driven optimization models.

Improve model robustness and reliability by conducting regular model validation, risk assessment, and algorithm tuning.

Drive continuous innovation in operations research by staying updated with emerging AI trends, algorithmic advancements, and best practices in mathematical optimization.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Business Strategy & Operations Teams

Data Science & AI Teams

IT & Cloud Engineering Teams

Finance & Risk Management Teams

Key Stakeholders - External

Technology Vendors & AI Solution Providers

Research Institutions & Academia

Regulatory Authorities & Compliance Bodies

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related fields.

Certification:

Certified Optimization & OR Specialist (CPLEX Gurobi Certification)

Advanced AI & ML Certification (Google AWS Microsoft AI)

Data Science & Statistical Analysis Certification (Coursera IBM DataCamp)

Work Experience (Range of years):

5-10 years of experience in developing and deploying operations research models in engineering, logistics, manufacturing, or supply chain domains.

job.title: BU SPOC - Techno Commercial
job.description:

  • End-to-End Delivery: Coordinate service delivery across Procurement, Governance, GDGC and MDM; monitor demand, backlog, ageing, dependencies and closure against agreed SOW, SLA and TAT.
  • Governance & Escalation: Conduct periodic reviews with Business Units, SDLs, Tower Leads and Team Leads; maintain dashboards and action trackers; resolve bottlenecks and escalate critical risks promptly.
  • Procurement Coordination: Support sourcing, contracting, auctions, supplier onboarding, catalogue management, PO-related services and associated governance within the approved GCC scope.
  • Master Data & GDGC: Coordinate master data requests and governance across vendor, material, service, customer and finance domains; ensure required validation, approvals, data-quality controls and audit evidence.
  • Operational Excellence: Drive process compliance, audit readiness, root-cause resolution, standardization, automation and continuous improvement to enhance quality, productivity and customer experience.

Key Deliverables

| | | | --- | --- | | Service Delivery | At least 95% adherence to applicable SLA/TAT commitments | | Stakeholder Governance | Regular reviews with timely closure of agreed actions | | Escalation Control | Prompt resolution with zero critical avoidable escalations | | Data & Compliance | Improved data quality, process compliance and audit readiness | | Continuous Improvement | Measurable productivity, quality and automation improvements |

  • 8-12 years of relevant experience in Procurement, Shared Services/GCC Operations, Governance, Master Data Management or Business Operations.
  • Experience in cross-functional stakeholder management and service delivery in an SLA-driven environment.
  • Working exposure to platforms such as SAP, SAP Ariba, SAP MDG, ServiceNow or equivalent systems is preferred.

job.title: Enterprise Data Architect
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Analyze the business requirements and needs of the organization.
  • Architect and design robust, scalable, and secure enterprise data platform leveraging Databricks and various cloud services on Microsoft Azure.
  • Lead implementation of advanced data analytics solutions utilizing Databricks and Delta Lake architectures to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data.
  • Leverage Databricks to perform data engineering, artificial intelligence and machine learning tasks.
  • Collect, process, and analyze large datasets from various sources within the aviation domain (e.g., flight data, baggage information, weather data, operational logs etc.).
  • Perform data quality checks and ensure data accuracy and consistency.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in data to provide valuable insights and support business decision-making.
  • Contribute to the development of data models and database designs.
  • Document data sources, data flows, and analytical processes.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data analysis and the aviation industry.
  • Create insightful and interactive data visualizations and reports using tools like Power BI to communicate findings to non-technical audiences.
  • Define and govern enterprise-wide cloud architecture standards, security protocols, and operational best practices.
  • Developing and implementing strategies to connect different systems, ensuring they can share data and functionality
  • Defining and managing API that allow different software applications to communicate with each other
  • Defining and managing asynchronous data exchange between applications and as a part of data pipelines
  • Designing real-time streaming pipelines for IoT time-series data
  • Diving deep into the details to solve complex technical challenges
  • Ensure the platform is secure and adheres to best practices for data protection and privacy.
  • Ensuring high data quality and integrity to avoid operational failures and improve system accuracy
  • Perform regular audits and maintenance of the platform to ensure its continued performance and stability.
  • Support project management activities, resource monitoring, technical risk identification & mitigations
  • Mentor and provide technical leadership to platform engineering and data engineering teams.
  • Ensure continuous platform optimization, cost management, and high availability of critical analytics infrastructure.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate airport operational requirements into technical blueprints and scalable solutions.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent advanced architectural certification.
  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or similar advanced credential in big data ecosystems.
  • Proven track record of designing large-scale digital platforms in complex operational environments, preferably within aviation or large infrastructure.

Educational Background

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • Advanced certifications in Enterprise Architecture frameworks such as TOGAF are highly preferred.

Years & Type of Experience

  • 15 to 20 years of progressive experience in IT, with at least 5+ years in a senior architectural capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale data engineering and analytics transformation programs utilizing Microsoft Azure and Databricks.

Domain Expertise

  • Deep functional knowledge of cloud computing paradigms (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and distributed data systems.
  • Strong understanding of big data ecosystems, data warehousing, and modern data mesh architectures.
  • Familiarity with the aviation or large-scale infrastructure domain, including passenger processing, non-aero revenue analytics, and airport operations.

Digital & Operational Tools

  • Cloud Platforms: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Azure services (Azure Data Factory, Azure Event Hub, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure IoT Hub etc).
  • Data & Analytics: Expertise in Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and enterprise Business Intelligence platforms.
  • Proficiency in one programming languages such as JavaScript/Node.js, Java, Python, etc.
  • Expertise in databases like PostgreSQL, MS SQL, and MongoDB.
  • Expertise in APIs, ESB (Enterprise Service Bus), and Kafka.
  • Integration with IoT platforms (Azure IoT Hub), device protocols (MQTT, AMQP, HTTP)
  • Experience of data analytics, business intelligence, and AI/ML technologies
  • Use of AI tools for code generation, pipeline automation, testing
  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, and enterprise source control systems.
  • Understanding of machine learning fundamentals (supervised, unsupervised, feature engineering)
  • Experience supporting ML model lifecycle (training data, inference pipelines)
  • Exposure to LLMs, GenAI pipelines, and vector databases
  • Knowledge of feature engineering and model-ready datasets
  • Knowledge of MLOps tools (MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, etc.)
  • Building CI/CD pipelines for data + ML workflows
  • Experience of Agile methodologies, Jira, and Confluence.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and practices.

Leadership Capabilities

  • Ability to drive technical consensus and influence technology strategy across diverse stakeholder groups and executive leadership.
  • Strategic thinker with a demonstrated capability to align IT and platform roadmaps with long-term business objectives.
  • Proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Capable of managing complex, multi-million dollar technology initiatives and strategic vendor relationships.

job.title: Team Manager – Customer & Logistics
job.description:
Responsibilities

A. Customer Master Governance and Policy Control

  • Define, implement, and sustain enterprise-wide Customer Master data standards, policies, naming conventions, field-level controls, approval matrices, SOPs, and governance procedures.
  • Ensure standardization of customer creation, extension, modification, blocking, unblocking, and archival processes across legal entities and business units.
  • Govern Customer Master records for B2B customers, dealers, distributors, channel partners, institutional customers, government customers, export customers, intercompany customers, and group companies.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, GST/TDS/PAN/CIN/MSME validations, taxation rules, and applicable business policies.
  • Drive governance adherence through periodic reviews, compliance checks, issue logs, exception management, and preventive controls.

B. Customer Master Operations and SLA Delivery

  • Lead daily Customer Master Data operations and ensure timely processing of creation, change, extension, block, unblock, and mass maintenance requests in SAP MDG/SAP ERP.
  • Monitor volumes, ageing, backlog, workload distribution, escalations, and turnaround time across business units.
  • Ensure strict adherence to SLA, First Time Right, accuracy, productivity, and quality targets.
  • Review complex or high-impact Customer Master requests and provide guidance to the processing team on fit, form, mandatory checks, and compliance requirements.
  • Publish daily/weekly/monthly operational performance reports covering ticket volumes, CRUD activity, ageing, backlog, SLA adherence, accuracy, and business-wise request distribution.

C. Customer Onboarding and Business Partner Enablement

  • Lead the end-to-end customer onboarding governance process across multiple business entities and sales channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Commercial, Finance, Credit Management, Taxation, and IT teams to resolve customer onboarding issues and approval dependencies.
  • Ensure customer onboarding controls are standardized across cement, manufacturing, infrastructure, and conglomerate businesses.
  • Support customer onboarding for dealers, distributors, project customers, institutional customers, government customers, export customers, and strategic accounts.
  • Improve onboarding cycle time by identifying process bottlenecks, automating validations, and strengthening first-time-right data submission by business users.

D. Credit, Finance, and Compliance Integration

  • Partner with Credit Control and Finance teams to govern customer credit attributes, reconciliation-relevant fields, payment terms, risk categories, taxation fields, and business partner classifications.
  • Support customer block/unblock governance in alignment with credit, legal, commercial, and compliance requirements.
  • Ensure master data quality supports billing accuracy, collections, statutory reporting, credit exposure monitoring, and financial controls.
  • Provide first-level functional advisory to business users on Customer Master data dependencies across O2C processes.

E. SAP MDG, S/4HANA, and Transformation Leadership

  • Act as Customer Master SME for SAP MDG & SAP SD processes.
  • Participate in SAP rollout, acquisition integration, divestiture support, business restructuring, and data migration programs.
  • Define business requirements for MDG workflow optimization, role-based approvals, validations, derivations, duplicate checks, and governance controls.
  • Work with IT and implementation partners to test, validate, and deploy Customer Master process enhancements.
  • Support cutover, mock load validation, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, post-go-live stabilization, and hypercare for Customer Master workstreams.

F. Data Quality, Cleansing, and Harmonization

  • Define and execute Customer Master data quality roadmap covering completeness, uniqueness, consistency, validity, accuracy, and compliance dimensions.
  • Identify and remediate duplicate, obsolete, incomplete, inconsistent, invalid, and non-compliant customer records.
  • Lead periodic cleansing and enrichment programs in partnership with business users and data owners.
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring data-quality issues and implement preventive controls at source.
  • Maintain governance dashboards covering duplicate index, incomplete records, quality score, exception ageing, cleansing progress, and policy compliance.

G. Automation, Analytics, and Continuous Improvement

  • Identify and deliver automation opportunities using SAP MDG workflow enhancements, RPA, AI-based validations, rule engines, and Excel/Power BI automation.
  • Drive Lean, Six Sigma, simplification, and standardization initiatives to improve productivity, SLA compliance, quality, and business-user experience.
  • Develop dashboards and analytics for SLA, productivity, accuracy, backlog, business satisfaction, data quality, and operational trends.
  • Create management insights and recommendations for governance councils and leadership reviews.

H. Stakeholder Management and Governance Forums

  • Engage with Sales Heads, Commercial Heads, Business CFOs, Credit Control leaders, Taxation teams, IT leadership,  auditors, and governance councils.
  • Conduct periodic service reviews, governance reviews, escalation discussions, and data quality review meetings with business stakeholders.
  • Present performance trends, risks, control gaps, data quality insights, and improvement actions to senior stakeholders.
  • Build strong business partnerships while ensuring governance discipline and policy adherence.

I. Team Leadership and Capability Building

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Customer Master professionals, senior processors, SMEs, and quality reviewers.
  • Plan capacity, allocate workload, manage cross-training, maintain backup coverage, and ensure business continuity after transition from the outgoing team member.
  • Define individual KPIs, performance scorecards, role clarity, training plans, and succession pipelines for the team.
  • Conduct quality reviews, coaching discussions, knowledge-sharing sessions, and monthly performance reviews.
  • Build a high-performance culture focused on accuracy, accountability, stakeholder service, compliance, and continuous improvement.

J. Knowledge Management and Transition Ownership

  • Prepare and maintain standard operating procedures, work instructions, process maps, control checklists, exception logs, training materials, and knowledge repositories.
  • Ensure no single-person dependency remains for critical Customer Master processes, reports, governance meetings, or project deliverables.
  • Institutionalize learnings and establish maker-checker controls for high-risk or business-critical Customer Master activities.

Qualifications

  • Graduate in Engineering, Commerce, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • MBA or postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • SAP SD / SAP MDG / SAP S/4HANA certification preferred.
  • Data Governance, Data Quality, Lean Six Sigma, or Project Management certification will be an added advantage.
  • 12-15 years of experience in Customer Master, SAP SD, Master Data Management, Data Governance, Shared Services, or GCC operations.
  • Minimum 5 years of team-handling, service-delivery, governance, or process-leadership experience.
  • Prior exposure to cement, building materials, manufacturing, infrastructure, metals, mining, power, ports, logistics, or large diversified conglomerate environment.
  • Hands-on experience in SAP MDG, SAP ECC/S4HANA customer master/business partner processes, workflow governance, and data-quality controls.
  • Experience supporting SAP rollouts, migrations, acquisitions, business integrations, or transformation programs.
  • Ability to manage both operational execution and senior stakeholder-facing governance responsibilities.

job.title: Head - Project
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop project plans including scope, schedules, and resource allocation
  • Work with cross-functional teams to define project objectives, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of large-scale data center construction projects, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
  • Ensure effective resource utilization and manage project budgets to achieve cost efficiency.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks, addressing issues proactively to ensure success.
  • Oversee contracts management, including vendor selection, negotiation, and performance monitoring, to ensure alignment with project objectives.
  • Monitor and report on project progress, maintaining effective communication with stakeholders and senior management.
  • Facilitate project meetings, workshops, and status updates to keep stakeholders informed.
  • Implement and enforce robust quality management systems to meet global benchmarks in data center construction and operations.
  • Drive adherence to Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) standards, fostering a culture of safety and compliance across all project phases.
  • Coordinate with design, engineering, and operations teams to ensure seamless integration of project deliverables with AdaniConneX’s strategic goals.
  • Manage testing and commissioning activities to ensure operational readiness and compliance with technical specifications.
  • Monitor project schedules, risk management plans, progress reports, and project budgets for effective decision-making and stakeholder communication.
  • Lead and mentor multidisciplinary project teams, fostering collaboration and high performance.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders, including regulatory bodies, contractors, and consultants, to ensure project alignment and success.
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement in project management practices, leveraging digital tools and technologies.
  • Oversee project completion and ensure a smooth handover to clients.

Brand Positioning: Ensure Adani's brand values are shown in all interactions. Strengthen relationships to boost the organization's brand and trust within the market and company.

Team Development: Build a high-performing team. Set clear KPIs, track progress, and implement strategies for continuous improvement. Promote a respectful and safe workplace, lead collaborative and productive teams, and mentor for growth and success. Tracks and reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) for digital business success.

Digital mindset: Champions a digital mindset within the organization to drive innovation and competitiveness. Keep up with digital and AI advancements to enhance business and maintain competitiveness.

InterfacePurpose of Engagement

CEOStrategy, governance, reporting, decision-making, alignmentChief Projects OfficerStrategic alignment, progress reporting, and decision-making.Design & Engineering TeamsCoordination on design specifications and technical requirements.Operations TeamsIntegration of project deliverables with operational readiness.Contracts & ProcurementVendor selection, contract negotiations, and performance monitoring.EHS DepartmentImplementation and monitoring of safety and compliance standards.Quality Control & Assurance TeamsEnsuring adherence to quality benchmarks and standards.External Consultants/ContractorsCollaboration on project execution, timelines, and deliverables.KPIDescription

On-time project deliveryEnsure the project is completed within the agreed timeline.Budget adherenceDeliver the project within the allocated budget.Quality benchmarks achievedMeet or exceed global quality standards in construction and operations.EHS complianceAchieve zero incidents and full compliance with safety standards.Stakeholder satisfactionMaintain high levels of satisfaction among internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Civil or Mechanical or Electrical engineer.
  • 24+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure construction projects, including quality, safety, and commissioning.
  • Proven expertise in project management, contracts management, and EHS compliance within the infrastructure or data center industry.
  • Additional certifications in Project Management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) are preferred.

Type of Experience

  • Managing large-scale EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) projects (example: airports, power, real estate, data center, advanced technical facilities, ports, etc.)
  • Extensive experience in data center construction, quality assurance, and safety management.

Domain Expertise

  • In-depth knowledge of data center construction methodologies, standards, and best practices.
  • Expertise in quality management systems and EHS compliance specific to large-scale infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with testing, commissioning, and operational readiness processes for data centers.

Digital & Operational Tools

  • Basic to intermediate proficiency in project management software such as Primavera P6 or MS Project.
  • Familiarity with Building Information Modeling (BIM) tools for design and construction coordination.
  • Experience with digital tools for quality management, safety compliance, and progress tracking.
  • Familiarity with most commonly used Microsoft packages like MS-Word, MS-Excel, PowerPoint.

Leadership Capabilities

  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and drive high-performance outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including engagement with contractors, consultants, and internal teams.
  • Demonstrated success in managing large budgets and delivering projects within financial constraints.
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to address complex project challenges.

Non-Negotiables:

  • Expertise in Infrastructure Construction and Project Management
  • The Head-Project must possess extensive experience in infrastructure center construction (example: data center, airports, advanced technical facilities, real estate, ports, power, etc.), including planning, execution, and delivery of large-scale projects. This expertise is critical to ensure that the AdaniConneX vision of building a 2GW data center infrastructure platform by 2030 is achieved with global benchmarks in design, engineering, and operations. The role requires a deep understanding of project management principles to manage timelines, budgets, and resources effectively.
  • Proficiency in Quality and EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) Compliance
  • Ensuring adherence to quality standards and EHS compliance is non-negotiable for this role. The Project Head must have a proven track record of implementing and maintaining high-quality construction standards while prioritizing safety. This aligns with AdaniConneX’s commitment to delivering digital infrastructure with speed and safety, ensuring the well-being of all stakeholders involved.
  • Leadership and Team Management Skills
  • The ability to lead and manage diverse teams is essential for the Project Head. This includes fostering collaboration among cross-functional teams, mentoring team members, and ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Strong leadership is crucial to drive the successful execution of projects and to uphold AdaniConneX’s reputation for delivering mega structures with unmatched capability.

job.title: Business Development Manager - Aftermarket (Gordon Brothers)
job.description:
Senior Business Development Manager – Service & Aftermarket Gas Compression

Join a Global Leader in Sustainable Infrastructure and Industrial Refrigeration

At Johnson Controls (JCI), we're transforming how the world manages energy, buildings, and critical industrial operations. As a global leader in smart buildings, thermal management, energy efficiency and decarbonisation, we help customers operate more efficiently, reduce carbon emissions and build resilient, future-ready facilities across industries including data centres, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing and higher education.

For more than 140 years, JCI has delivered innovative solutions where performance matters most. Backed by cutting-edge technology, comprehensive lifecycle services and a world-class field organisation, we help our customers achieve measurable results while creating safer, more sustainable environments.

As part of the JCI family, Gordon Brothers Industries (GBI) brings more than 100 years of industrial refrigeration expertise and is recognised as Australia's largest industrial refrigeration company. With offices across every mainland state, GBI delivers end-to-end refrigeration solutions, including design, engineering, construction, commissioning, servicing and maintenance, supporting leading organisations across the food and beverage, cold storage, mining, chemical and industrial processing sectors.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Business Development Manager to drive growth across our Gas Compression and Industrial Refrigeration portfolio throughout Australia and New Zealand.

This is a unique opportunity for a qualified Engineer or Senior Technician who combines strong commercial acumen with deep technical expertise. You will be responsible for identifying, developing and securing complex service, overhaul, retrofit and upgrade opportunities while acting as the technical authority throughout the sales cycle.

Working with key customers across oil & gas, industrial processing, mining and refrigeration sectors, you will engage directly with engineering, operations and reliability teams to develop tailored solutions that improve asset performance, reliability and lifecycle value.

The successful candidate will be a qualified Mechanical or Chemical Engineer, or Senior Refrigeration Technician with a minimum of two years' relevant industry experience and strong knowledge of gas compression systems. Experience with Frick and/or Sabroe compressor technologies will be highly regarded.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities to achieve designated sales targets.
  • Manage and maintain the Salesforce (SFDC) pipeline in line with business expectations.
  • Lead the identification, development and sale of gas compressor rebuild, overhaul, retrofit and upgrade opportunities.
  • Act as the technical authority throughout the sales process, developing engineered solutions and advising customers on best-practice asset management strategies.
  • Engage directly with customer engineering, reliability and operations teams to identify technical challenges and convert opportunities into funded projects.
  • Provide expert guidance on compressor performance, maintenance strategies, overhaul planning, asset integrity and lifecycle management.
  • Coordinate support from APAC Product Specialists and OEM partners for complex applications, including Mycom compressor commissioning and rebuild projects.
  • Identify and generate spare parts, overhaul and upgrade opportunities based on asset condition and reliability assessment reports.
  • Advise customers on preventative maintenance programmes and long-term asset reliability strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with the Australia and New Zealand Business Development teams to support new equipment sales and convert maintenance opportunities into long-term service agreements.
  • Identify and recommend end-of-life Quantum and Unisab control system upgrade opportunities.
  • Identify and propose refrigeration package upgrade opportunities, including RWB to RWFII/RXFII conversions.
  • Support commissioning activities, major breakdown responses and complex customer projects requiring specialist technical expertise.
  • Provide leadership and direction to internal teams and contractors to ensure customer solutions are delivered safely and effectively.
  • Review project performance and provide technical and commercial insights to senior management.
  • Ensure compliance with all Quality Assurance (QA), Occupational Health, Safety and Environment (OHS&E) and company standards.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for continuous improvement, operational efficiencies and customer-focused solutions.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

Essential

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering, or demonstrated competency in the industry.
  • Minimum 2 years' relevant experience in gas compression systems, industrial refrigeration, rotating equipment or a related process industry.
  • Strong technical knowledge of compressor technologies, thermodynamics, refrigeration systems and rotating equipment.
  • Demonstrated success in business development, technical sales, applications engineering or solution development.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to develop opportunities from concept through to contract award.
  • Excellent written, proposal development, presentation and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with customers and influence technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • A commitment to frontline safety leadership and proactive risk management.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience with Frick and/or Sabroe compressor systems.
  • Experience with Mycom, Howden, Kobelco or similar industrial compressor technologies.
  • Experience within oil & gas, LNG, mining, chemical processing, industrial refrigeration or heavy industrial sectors.
  • Knowledge of Quantum and Unisab control platforms.
  • Experience with ammonia refrigeration systems and industrial process plants.
  • Experience developing overhaul, retrofit, brownfield upgrade and equipment reliability projects.

Why Join Us?

At Johnson Controls and Gordon Brothers Industries, you'll be part of a global organisation that values innovation, safety, sustainability and career development.

You'll have the opportunity to work with industry-leading technologies, partner with major industrial customers, collaborate with global technical specialists and contribute to solutions that improve reliability, efficiency and sustainability across critical industries.

Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?

Click Apply to submit your application in confidence.

JCI’s Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands. 

To learn more about our industrial refrigeration capabilities, visit [www.gordonbrothers.com.au](http://www.gordonbrothers.com.au).

Applicants must have full working rights in Australia.

Please note that pre-employment checks, including reference checks, medical assessments, criminal history checks, and drug and alcohol screening, will form part of the selection process.

job.title: BMS Hardware Design - Datacenter
job.description:
Job Description

Application Engineer (Hardware Design) – Datacenter

What you will do

The primary responsibility of this role is to lead global Data Center Building Management System (BMS) engineering projects, ensuring compliance with project specifications, customer requirements, and account-specific standards. The role requires independent ownership and execution of projects throughout the entire lifecycle, while serving as the first point of escalation for technical and project-related issues. Ensure adherence to data center-specific engineering and project execution processes, maintain high quality standards through a "First Time Right" approach, and deliver projects on schedule to achieve operational excellence and maximize customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review MEP drawings to generate following drawings / documents for systems covered into Datacenter Project

Shop Drawings (ACAD drawings)

  • Detailed IO List contains all hardware points, software points and integration points if applicable, along with trend and alarm details as applicable
  • Creation of Bill of material, selection of sensors, control valves, dampers, air flow stations, controllers etc.
  • Generation of Panel GA
  • Generation of detailed Control devices and controller wiring, terminations, interlock wiring

Engineering Documents

Preparation of BMS Network diagram as per specifications and approved solution

Generation of detailed description of operation control based on specifications and design intent

Generation of various schedules like Valve, Flowmeter, Damper, panel, DDC etc.

Preparation of test scripts for panel factory witness tests

Generation of initial review sheets and RFI’s

  • Coordination with all stakeholders for clarification on RFI’s, tracking progress and with different vendors during finalization of BOQ
  • Ensure quality assurance and defect free hardware package delivery
  • Adherence with all processes and guidelines to execute project within timeline
  • During pre-bid stage support sales team for providing/validating controls solution for systems into Datacenter project.

What we look for

  • BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical/ Electronics / Electronics & Communication
  • Hands on experience with Hardware Engineering scope for Datacenter Vertical
  • Good Understanding of Data Centre mechanical / electrical systems with expertise for instrumentation and control, panel wiring, complex relay logic
  • Experience in detailed panel design – power calculation, selection of panel enclosure, terminal blocks, fuses, panel heaters, light etc.
  • Knowledge of HVAC systems from Datacenter vertical like Chilled Water System, Cooling Towers, Primary & Secondary pumping systems, Fluid Coolers, Heat Exchanger, CRAH, CRAC, CDU, Different types of AHUs, FCUs, VAV systems etc.
  • Strong knowledge of BMS architecture with different types of Operator workstations, Supervisory Controllers, DDC controllers, Sensors & Actuators etc.
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, LON, Modbus, OPC, and other protocols
  • Must be proficient in wiring of starters, field devices, safety interlocks & panels
  • Experience in engineering, installing and commissioning of HVAC & BMS systems for Datacenter projects or other infrastructure projects like pharmaceuticals, airports, commercial buildings, hospitals
  • Must be a quick learner & should have a keen eye for problem solving
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills

Preferred

4 to 8 years of relevant experience in Building Automation Industry Datacenter Vertical, BMS Design Engineering or Industrial Automation.

Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou).

job.title: Vice President, Finance
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As Vice President, Finance, you will report to the Chief Financial Officer, serve as the most senior finance leader across the AirTrunk Group, and work closely with the Finance, Corporate Development, Treasury and Legal teams, as well as our shareholder partner, Blackstone.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the finance strategy of a leading global hyperscale data centre platform at a critical stage of expansion. The role provides direct exposure to a world-class infrastructure investor, influence over multi-billion-dollar capital allocation decisions, and a clear line of sight to value creation and exit.

This is a strategically critical role, central to growing and protecting enterprise value as AirTrunk scales across multiple jurisdictions. You will operate as a senior enterprise leader within the Group CFO leadership team.

We have grown at remarkable speed, and our ambition is even greater. To realise it, we need to lead the team to the next level, industrialise our operating model and make it scalable for the growth ahead.

Key accountabilities include:

  • Leadership: Lead a team across Financial Control, Financial Operations and Financial Planning & Analysis.
  • CFO partnership: Serve as the CFO’s deputy and act on the CFO’s behalf during periods of leave.
  • Lead and oversee outsourced and offshore finance teams, ensuring the effective delivery of finance activities and alignment with Group requirements.
  • Lead the financial elements of due diligence, REIT, asset monetisation and capital recycling initiatives, including valuation, financial modelling, transaction structuring and execution.

Your day to day

Financial Control:

  • Lead the annual statutory reporting and audit process.
  • Manage information undertakings and other requirements under financing arrangements.
  • Lead financial internal controls, delegations, policies and procedures, including the ongoing development of controls appropriate for a growing business across the APAC region.
  • Monitor changes in the operating environment and business developments, and advise on appropriate risk management practices.

Financial Operations:

  • Oversee the Group’s financial operations across Asia Pacific, including accounts receivable and accounts payable.
  • Own the company's financial systems, including the ERP and Integrated Business Planning system.
  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of operational best practices in accounting and finance.

Financial Planning & Analysis:

  • Lead the budgeting and forecasting processes alongside the CFO and in partnership with the leadership and management team.
  • Support the development and tracking of performance measures aligned with the company's strategic direction.
  • Lead the ongoing development of financial strategies.

Requirements

  • Previous experience as Deputy CFO or second-in-command to the CFO of a large company, or as CFO of a medium-sized company.
  • Experience helping organisations scale rapidly through better processes, technology and outsourced capability, without unnecessary headcount growth.
  • Preferred industry experience in property, funds management or infrastructure.
  • Preferred experience in private equity-backed or institutionally owned companies.
  • Collaborative, pragmatic and commercially minded, with a strong focus on outcomes and creating value for the business.
  • Builds strong, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and partners confidently and effectively with Blackstone, exercising sound judgement.
  • A strong people leader who brings out the best in others, builds capability and develops future talent.
  • An enterprise-minded leader who looks beyond Finance and understands the broader business and its strategic priorities.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Development Director
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As Development Director - Melbourne, you will provide senior leadership across AirTrunk's Victorian development portfolio. You will be accountable for leading campus project teams and their respective data centre projects end-to-end, including land acquisition, approvals, design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover. You will ensure each project is aligned with AirTrunk's customer, commercial, technical, safety, quality, programme, capital expenditure and operational requirements.

Working closely with the Design, Construction, Commercial, Cost, Procurement, Operations, Finance, Legal, Sustainability and Customer teams, you will create clarity across a complex portfolio, anticipate issues early and ensure Melbourne projects are positioned to deliver at pace and at hyperscale.

Your Day-to-Day

Portfolio leadership and strategy

  • Inherit and refine the development strategy for individual campuses and priorities across all Victorian projects, aligning the portfolio with AirTrunk's regional growth plans, customer commitments and investment objectives.
  • Develop funding request strategies.
  • Convert customer opportunities into executable, risk-managed developments.
  • Develop and maintain strategic supply chain plans and key partner relationships.
  • Maintain an integrated view of project status, key decisions, dependencies, risks, opportunities, approvals, resourcing and delivery readiness across the Melbourne portfolio.
  • Provide clear, timely reporting and recommendations to Development Leadership and relevant governance forums, escalating matters that may affect safety, quality, time, cost or customer outcomes.
  • Build a high-performing development team and create an accountable, collaborative culture focused on safe, sustainable and predictable delivery.
  • Lead portfolio risk management and mitigation.

Development, approvals and delivery readiness

  • Lead the end-to-end development of Melbourne data centre projects, from site and feasibility considerations through planning, design development, construction commencement, customer contracting and operational handover.
  • Oversee project development plans, stage gates, programme milestones and critical path activities, ensuring decisions are made at the right time and with the right evidence.
  • Engage and support AirTrunk teams working with government authorities, utilities, landowners, consultants, contractors, customers and community stakeholders to secure approvals and remove constraints.
  • Ensure projects are sufficiently defined and coordinated before major commitments are made, including scope, design intent, constructability, programme, procurement strategy, cost plan and operational requirements.

Commercial, cost and portfolio controls

  • Maintain accountability for development outcomes within approved investment parameters, working with Commercial, Cost, Finance and Procurement to protect value and manage risk.
  • Review project budgets, forecasts, cash flow, change, contracts, procurement decisions and commercial exposures across the Melbourne portfolio.
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and drive early intervention where cost, scope, programme or quality trends could affect project outcomes.
  • Support investment papers, business cases, governance submissions and portfolio reporting with accurate analysis and a clear narrative.

Stakeholder leadership and influence

  • Act as the senior development interface for Melbourne and the corporate business, creating alignment between internal teams, external partners and customer stakeholders.
  • Facilitate effective decision-making across competing priorities, balancing business objectives, customer needs, regulatory obligations and long-term asset performance.
  • Represent AirTrunk with credibility and professionalism in senior stakeholder, authority, industry and community forums.
  • Resolve issues quickly and transparently, building trust through clear communication, sound judgement and consistent follow-through.

Continuous improvement and sustainable growth

  • Identify and implement improvements to development processes, governance, reporting, risk management and project controls so AirTrunk can scale efficiently.
  • Champion and contribute to the use of data, digital tools and standardised ways of working to improve visibility, predictability and decision quality across the portfolio.

What You Bring

  • At least 15 years' experience developing and delivering large-scale projects.
  • Extensive senior leadership experience delivering complex, large-scale data centre, critical infrastructure, industrial, property or similarly complex development projects in Victoria.
  • Demonstrated responsibility for multiple concurrent projects or a significant development portfolio, with the ability to move between strategic oversight and detailed issue resolution.
  • Strong understanding of the full development lifecycle, including site evaluation, feasibility, planning and statutory approvals, utilities, design management, procurement, construction readiness and operational handover.
  • Experience managing projects with significant capital value and coordinating multidisciplinary internal and external teams across design, commercial, construction and operations.
  • Commercially astute, with a strong grasp of budgets, cost plans, cash flow, contracts, procurement, risk, governance and investment decision-making.
  • A proven record of engaging with government, utilities, customers, landowners, consultants, contractors and community stakeholders to achieve practical outcomes.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, influencing and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex matters clearly to senior leadership and governance forums.
  • Strategic, analytical and delivery-focused, with sound judgement, high autonomy and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment.
  • Relevant tertiary qualification in property, engineering, construction, project management, business or a related discipline. Professional accreditation is desirable.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

job.title: Vice President, Global Field & Partner Marketing - London, United Kingdom - Amsterdam, Netherlands - Dallas, Texas, United States - Hong Kong - Singapore
job.description:
Responsibilities

Global Field Marketing Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and implement a cohesive global field marketing strategy aligned with the evolution of the marketing function and the company's overall business objectives and go-to-market strategy
  • Oversee the planning and execution of regional marketing programs, including but not limited to events (virtual and in-person), webinars, workshops, and account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives, tailored to specific regional needs and market dynamics
  • Collaborate closely with regional sales leadership to understand their priorities and develop targeted marketing programs that drive pipeline and revenue in each region
  • Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of field marketing activities and provide regular reporting and analysis on program performance and ROI
  • Manage the global field marketing budget effectively, ensuring optimal allocation of resources across regions and programs
  • Build and mentor a high-performing global team of field marketing professionals, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability

Partner Marketing Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and execute a global partner marketing strategy to drive joint marketing activities and increase sales through our channel partner ecosystem
  • Establish and nurture strong relationships with key strategic partners, understanding their business goals and developing joint marketing plans that align with our mutual objectives
  • Create and deliver partner marketing programs, including co-branded content, joint webinars, partner events, partner campaigns and programs
  • Develop and maintain partner marketing resources, such as marketing templates, and campaign guides
  • Track and measure the effectiveness of partner marketing initiatives, providing regular reports on performance and ROI
  • Collaborate with the sales and partner management teams to ensure alignment on partner marketing priorities and activities

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with product marketing, content marketing, digital marketing, and corporate communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and integrated campaign execution
  • Partner with sales operations to ensure effective lead flow and reporting on the impact of field and partner marketing activities on sales pipeline and revenue
  • Collaborate with marketing operations and finance to manage budgets and track expenses effectively

Market Insights & Analysis

  • Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, and regional market dynamics to inform field and partner marketing strategies
  • Analyze marketing data and provide insights to optimize program performance and identify new opportunities for growth

Qualifications

Knowledge & Experience

  • Deep B2B marketing leadership across field, partner, and demand generation in global technology environments
  • Proven track record of delivering pipeline growth and revenue outcomes across regions and partner ecosystems
  • Experience building and scaling global marketing frameworks that drive consistency and regional execution
  • Deep expertise in partner ecosystems, including value propositions, MDF/incentives, and co-marketing strategies
  • Strong background in data-driven marketing, sales alignment, and cross-functional GTM integration

Skills & Attributes

  • Strategic and commercial leader with clear focus on pipeline, revenue, and business impact
  • Highly influential collaborator who aligns senior stakeholders across sales, marketing, and partners globally
  • Balanced strategist–operator who drives both vision and disciplined execution at scale
  • Data-driven decision maker who translates insights into measurable performance improvements
  • People leader and change agent who builds high-performing teams and drives transformation across a global organization
