job.title: Senior Creative Campaign Partner
job.description:
Employment Type

Fixed Term (Fixed Term)

Closing Date

8 Oct 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Senior Creative Campaign Partner

Job Summary

Job Description

Senior Creative Campaign Partner

We are Australia’s leading telecommunications and technology company. And with a global presence in more than 22 countries, we have a strong global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We are all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network. This includes making Telstra the place you want to work.

About the role

Telstra’s in-house creative agency is looking for a Senior Creative Campaign Partner to play a critical role in partnering with Marketing teams to develop and deliver effective, creatively ambitious marketing campaigns.

This role is a senior client and campaign lead within the in-house creative agency, acting as the key connection between our Marketing stakeholders and the agency’s strategy, creative and delivery teams. You will work closely with marketers to understand their business and customer objectives, shape high-quality briefs and ensure the agency is focused on the right problems and opportunities.

You will partner with Strategists, Creatives, Producers and Marketing teams across consumer, business, enterprise and corporate projects, providing continuity from initial brief and strategic development through to creative development and final campaign delivery.

This is a senior role requiring strong autonomy, strategic thinking and stakeholder leadership. You will build trusted relationships with senior marketers, constructively challenge briefs and requests, navigate competing priorities and help teams make informed decisions that lead to stronger creative and business outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings strong agency account management or client partnership experience, understands how great creative work gets made and can confidently operate at the intersection of business, marketing, strategy and creativity.

Key Responsibilities

In your role as Senior Creative Campaign Partner, you will be responsible for building strong partnerships between Telstra’s Marketing teams and the in-house creative agency. You will champion great briefs, effective collaboration and customer-led thinking, helping teams translate marketing objectives into strategically sound and creatively ambitious work.

Client Partnership & Campaign Leadership

  • Act as a senior day-to-day partner for Marketing stakeholders, building trusted relationships and a deep understanding of their business, customer and marketing priorities.
  • Lead campaigns from initial engagement and briefing through strategic and creative development, maintaining continuity and alignment throughout the agency process.
  • Partner with Marketing teams to interrogate and strengthen briefs, ensuring clear objectives, audiences, customer insights, propositions and measures of success.
  • Provide strategic counsel to stakeholders, constructively challenging requests and helping teams identify the right creative or communications response to the business problem.
  • Facilitate key campaign conversations, presentations and decision points, ensuring stakeholders and agency teams remain aligned.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness, creative ambition and the overall partnership between Marketing and the in-house agency.

Strategic & Creative Partnership

  • Work closely with Strategists and Marketing teams to ensure customer, business and brand insights are reflected in campaign briefs and creative development.
  • Partner with Creative teams to ensure they have the context, clarity and stakeholder access required to develop strong work.
  • Champion Telstra’s brand and creative ambition, helping stakeholders understand and support the strategic and creative rationale behind the work.
  • Consolidate and navigate stakeholder feedback, helping create clear direction for agency teams while protecting the integrity of the strategic and creative idea.
  • Connect learnings across campaigns and customer touchpoints to continually improve future briefs and creative responses.
  • Ensure relevant customer insights, data and previous campaign performance are considered during briefing and campaign development.

Agency & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Act as the key interface between Marketing stakeholders and the agency team, ensuring clear communication, expectations and accountability throughout each engagement.
  • Partner with Producers and Creative Services to translate agreed campaign requirements into clear scopes, timings and delivery plans.
  • Work collaboratively with agency teams to identify risks, dependencies or changes in scope and communicate these clearly with stakeholders.
  • Help manage competing stakeholder priorities and support effective prioritisation based on agreed marketing and business objectives.
  • Work with the Creative Services Lead and producers to continuously improve ways of working between Marketing and the in-house agency.
  • Build strong relationships across Marketing, Media, GTM, Brand, Digital and other relevant teams to enable integrated campaign development.

Campaign Effectiveness & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with Marketing, Media and Analytics teams to understand campaign performance and identify learnings that can strengthen future briefs.
  • Ensure agreed campaign objectives and measures of success remain visible throughout strategy and creative development.
  • Lead or contribute to campaign retrospectives, capturing learnings across the stakeholder and agency teams.
  • Identify recurring opportunities, challenges and customer insights across the portfolio and bring these back into future planning.
  • Help build a culture of creativity, strategic thinking, accountability and strong client partnership within the in-house agency.

The successful candidate will have:

  • 7+ years of experience in agency account management, client partnership or a similar senior agency-facing marketing role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing integrated marketing campaigns from brief through strategy, creative development and delivery.
  • Strong understanding of marketing strategy, creative development and integrated campaign processes across digital and offline channels.
  • Experience partnering with senior Marketing stakeholders and building trusted client relationships.
  • Strong strategic thinking with the ability to understand a business problem, interrogate a brief and translate complex requirements into clear direction for agency teams.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation and presentation skills, with confidence navigating senior stakeholders and challenging conversations.
  • A strong understanding of what makes an effective creative brief and the ability to champion both customer and creative outcomes.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Strategists, Creatives, Producers, Media and Marketing teams.
  • Proven ability to operate autonomously and manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Experience within an integrated creative agency, in-house agency or complex marketing organisation would be highly regarded.
  • Experience across B2B or Retail marketing would be advantageous.

This Senior Creative Campaign Partner role is a key position within Telstra’s in-house creative agency, helping connect business and marketing priorities with strategy and creativity. The role will ensure our teams are solving the right problems, our stakeholders have a trusted agency partner and our campaigns are strategically grounded, creatively ambitious and effective.

If this opportunity sounds like a perfect fit for you, we’d encourage you to apply!

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce in all its forms. We encourage applicants from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds and applicants who may be living with a disability. We also offer flexibility in all our roles, to ensure everyone can participate.

To learn more about how we support our people, including accessibility adjustments we can provide you through the recruitment process, visit [tel.st/thrive](http://tel.st/thrive).

Please Note: Before applying for internal vacancies, please ensure to advise your 1-up manager of your intention to apply for an internal role, regardless of the length of time you have been in your existing role.

Generally, you should have been in your current role at least 12 months (Band 2–4) before applying for a role internally, unless you have approval from your current 1-up manager.

job.title: Telecom Engineer
job.description:
We're enhancing the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions.

Position: Telecom Engineer

Location: Kochi

Employment Type: Siemens Direct Contract

Experience Level: Junior (5 Years)

Industry: Metro Rail / Transportation Telecom Systems

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Telecom Engineer to oversee our Metro Rail projects in the South Region, encompassing the state of Kerala (Kochi City).

The ideal candidate should possess an Engineering Graduate with minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience; out of which a minimum of 3+ years’ experience in Telecommunication domain in Metro Railway project or similar transportation system environment.

The Telecom Engineer will be responsible for design, installation, testing, commissioning, integration, operation, and maintenance of all telecommunication systems that support safe, reliable, and efficient train operations by ensuring compliance with safety, quality and regulatory standards.

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Engineering in Coordination with Design Manager:

  • Review Employer's Requirements, Specifications, and Standards.
  • Prepare telecom system architecture and detailed engineering designs.
  • Develop system layout drawings, schematics, cable routing plans, and interface documents.
  • Coordinate with signaling, power supply, rolling stock, civil, and MEP teams.
  • Ensure compliance with Metro Rail standards, IEC, EN, IEEE, and local regulations.

Telecommunication Systems Management in coordination with Project Manager, Design Manager,

Interface Manager, Testing & Commissioning Engineer, Quality Manager, EHS Manager, and system OEMS/Vendor partners:

  • Fiber Optic Communication Network (OFC)

o Design and supervise installation of fiber optic backbone networks.

o Conduct fiber splicing, OTDR testing, and link performance verification.

  • Telephone Systems

o Manage Emergency Telephone System (ETS).

o Manage Operational Telephone System (OTS).

o Configure IP-PBX and VoIP systems.

  • Radio Communication System

o Implement TETRA, LTE, or other radio systems.

o Ensure communication coverage throughout tunnels, stations, viaducts, and depots.

o Coordinate radio frequency testing and optimization.

  • CCTV Surveillance System

o Supervise installation of CCTV cameras and recording systems.

o Configure Network Video Recorders (NVRs) and video management software.

o Ensure integration with Operations Control Center (OCC).

  • Passenger Information System (PIS)

o Configure audio and visual passenger information systems.

o Integrate train arrival/departure information.

o Ensure real-time announcements and display functionality.

  • Public Address System (PAS)

o Design and configure station and depot PA systems.

o Ensure emergency and routine announcements are delivered effectively.

o Test audio clarity and coverage.

  • Master Clock System

o Implement synchronized master and slave clock systems.

o Ensure synchronization across all stations and operational areas.

  • Access Control & Intrusion Detection

o Implement access control systems.

o Configure card readers, biometric devices, and monitoring systems.

o Ensure integration with security management systems.

  • Installation & Site Supervision

o Supervise telecom equipment installation at stations, depots, tunnels, and OCC.

o Monitor cable tray installation and cable pulling activities.

o Ensure installation quality according to approved drawings and method statements.

o Verify contractor compliance with safety requirements.

  • Testing & Commissioning

o Prepare Inspection and Test Plans (ITP).

o Conduct Site Acceptance Test (SAT).

o Perform integrated system testing.

o Support Trial Running and revenue operation readiness activities.

  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Prepare:

o Method statements

o Risk assessments

o Inspection reports

o Test reports

o As-built drawings

o O&M manuals

  • Maintain project progress reports and punch lists.
  • Safety & Quality Management
  • Ensure compliance with:

o Metro Rail Safety Requirements

o Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) procedures

o HSE standards and regulations

  • Participate in safety audits and inspections.
  • Project Management Responsibilities.
  • Track telecom installation and commissioning progress.
  • Coordinate with vendors and subcontractors.
  • Participate in technical and progress review meetings.
  • Operation & Maintenance Support
  • Assist during trial operations.
  • Troubleshoot telecom system faults.
  • Train operations and maintenance personnel.
  • Support defect liability period (DLP) activities.

Qualifications and Skills:

? Education: Engineering Graduate, Bachelors of Degree in Electronics & Communications, Telecommunication or Electrical Engineering

Experience & Skills:

? Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience, out of which a minimum of 3+ years of hands-on experience in Telecommunication domain in Metro Railway Projects or similar transportation network system

? Sound technical skills on Telecommunication systems for Metro Railway project or similar environment

? Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

? Willingness to travel as per project needs.

? Ability to work independently and take ownership of project deliverables.

? Ability to adopt technical skills faster

? Demonstrated commitment to EHS practices.

If you are a motivated and capable individual and if you thrive in a dynamic and challenging work environment, we invite you to apply for this position. As the Telecom Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving successful project results and contributing to the growth of our organization. The Telecom Engineer selected report will be to the project head.

This role is based in Siemens Ltd., Kochi, Kerala (SI B OPS division) where you will get the chance to work with teams impacting cities, countries and the shape of things to come.

Make your mark in our exciting world of Siemens

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.

Find out more about Smart Infrastructure at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/company/topic-areas/smart-infrastructure.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers

job.title: Senior Manager - Hire to Retire
job.description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

We provide our Hire-to-Retire services along the complete lifecycle of an employee from onboarding to pension services and demonstrate our powerful ecosystem of leading external and internal partners and our network of key delivery centers. We believe in the value of industry best-practice standards achieved through evolving technology and digitalization. We focus on employee experience as a key driver of our actions. In doing so, we deliver flexibility, quality and efficiency for the businesses we partner with.

Position Overview

Lead end-to-end Employee Lifecycle operations across Siemens AG, ensuring seamless delivery of HR Administration and Payroll services with a focus on compliance, employee experience, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. The role is responsible for overseeing employee data management, onboarding, employee changes, offboarding, payroll governance, statutory compliance, service delivery performance, and process transformation initiatives. Partner closely with P&O, business leaders and global stakeholders to drive standardization, automation, risk mitigation, and a high-quality employee experience across the employee lifecycle.

You’ll make a difference by:

End-to-End Service Delivery Leadership

  • Own end-to-end Hire-to-Retire operations across ELC and Payroll processes for NAM and UK, ensuring seamless service delivery, compliance, and customer experience.
  • Accountable for operational performance, SLA/KPI achievement, payroll accuracy, service quality, employee experience, and regulatory compliance across all supported countries.
  • Drive operational stability while ensuring scalability of services to support organizational growth and transformation initiatives.
  • Lead service governance forums with Regional HR, Business Leaders, Payroll Providers, Compliance, and Digital HR stakeholders.

Payroll Operations & Governance

  • Provide strategic oversight of Payroll Operations, ensuring accurate and timely processing of payroll, statutory reporting, taxation, benefits administration, and vendor management.
  • Drive payroll risk mitigation, audit readiness, SOX and compliance controls, and continuous process reviews.
  • Lead resolution of complex payroll escalations, regulatory issues, and cross-functional dependencies impacting payroll delivery.

Transformation & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and execute the H2R transformation roadmap, leveraging automation, AI, analytics, RPA, and self-service solutions to improve efficiency and employee experience.
  • Lead standardization and simplification initiatives across countries, reducing process variations and technical debt.
  • Drive continuous improvement culture utilizing Lean Six Sigma methodologies, root cause analysis, and data-driven decision-making.

Stakeholder & Customer Management

  • Act as strategic advisor to Regional HR Leadership, fostering trusted partnerships and influencing decisions in a matrix environment.
  • Lead governance reviews, operational health assessments, customer satisfaction reviews, and executive service performance reporting.
  • Partner with Centers of Excellence, HR Digital, IT, Compliance, Legal, and external vendors to align operational priorities and transformation initiatives.

Workforce & Capability Development

  • Build high-performing teams through talent development, succession planning, capability building, and performance management.
  • Establish a culture of accountability, operational excellence, innovation, and customer centricity.
  • Drive upskilling of teams in Workday, Payroll platforms, AI-enabled tools, analytics, and digital HR solutions.

Risk, Compliance & Controls

  • Own service risk management framework, ensuring adherence to internal controls, audit requirements, data privacy regulations, and country-specific labor legislation.
  • Implement proactive monitoring of operational risks and establish preventive controls to reduce escalations and compliance breaches.
  • Lead remediation of audit findings and establish sustainable corrective and preventive action plans.

Data Analytics & Operational Excellence

  • Utilize workforce and operational analytics to identify trends, productivity opportunities, risk areas, and customer pain points.
  • Develop executive dashboards providing visibility into service performance, quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and financial outcomes.
  • Drive transaction-based productivity improvements, cost optimization, and service delivery efficiency through data-led insights.

Your success is grounded in:

  • 15+ years of experience in HR Operations, Shared Services, Payroll Operations, Service Delivery, or Global Business Services environments.
  • Proven experience handling large-scale multi-country H2R and Payroll operations across complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Demonstrated success leading operational transformation, process standardization, automation, AI adoption, and digital HR initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of global payroll operations, compliance frameworks, controls, and audit requirements.
  • Experience handling senior stakeholders and governance forums at executive leadership level.
  • Lean Six Sigma, Project Management, Organisational Change, or Digital Transformation certifications preferred.
  • Strong commercial foresight with experience handling budgets, productivity targets, and operational cost optimization.

Join us and be yourself!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

This role is based in Bangalore. You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

job.description:

Marketing & Sales Manager - Australia__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be the driving force behind ABB's service growth strategy across Queensland, identifying, creating, and securing new business opportunities within key segments. This is an opportunity for a highly motivated sales hunter who thrives on opening doors, building strategic relationships, and converting opportunities into profitable long-term partnerships.

You will leverage market intelligence, installed base (IB) insights, and customer engagement strategies to accelerate growth while expanding ABB's presence across target industries. Success in this role will come from your ability to identify untapped opportunities, influence key decision-makers, and position ABB's service solutions as a critical part of your customers' operational success.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop and execute strategic business development plans to identify, pursue, and secure new growth opportunities across Queensland's industrial market.
  • Proactively generate new business through prospecting, networking, customer engagement, and market penetration activities, creating a strong pipeline of opportunities.
  • Expand ABB's market share by selling the service portfolio, including upgrades, retrofits, modernization projects, digital solutions, maintenance agreements, and lifecycle services.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with senior stakeholders, operational leaders, and decision-makers, becoming a trusted advisor and long-term partner.
  • Identify opportunities within ABB's installed base while uncovering value added replacement opportunities to drive incremental revenue growth.
  • Lead the entire sales process from opportunity identification through to negotiation, commercial structuring, and contract award.
  • Maintain a disciplined sales approach through CRM management, pipeline forecasting, account planning, and strategic territory management.
  • Collaborate with technical and operational teams to develop compelling value propositions that address customer challenges and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Consistently achieve and exceed sales targets, demonstrating a strong drive for results and a passion for winning new business.

Qualifications for the role

  • Qualifications in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline, combined with a proven track record in business development, technical sales, or industrial services sales.
  • Demonstrated success in a hunter-style sales role, with experience identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities within industrial or infrastructure markets.
  • Strong technical knowledge of Medium Voltage Switchgear, Low Voltage systems, and Protection & Control solutions.
  • Deep understanding of Queensland's industrial landscape, including mining, utilities, manufacturing, energy, infrastructure, and related sectors.
  • Proven ability to engage, influence, and negotiate with senior-level stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Commercially astute with experience developing growth strategies, managing sales pipelines, and delivering profitable revenue outcomes.
  • Strong strategic thinking and market analysis skills, with the ability to identify emerging trends and translate them into business opportunities.
  • Self-driven, resilient, and highly motivated, with a passion for sales, customer engagement, and achieving ambitious growth targets.
  • Experience using CRM systems, sales forecasting tools, and account planning methodologies.
  • Knowledge of service delivery, lifecycle management, and OHS requirements within complex industrial environments.

Why this role would appeal

This role is ideal for a commercially driven Business Development Manager who enjoys hunting for opportunities, opening new doors, building executive relationships, and driving significant business growth rather than simply managing existing accounts. You'll have the autonomy to shape strategy, grow your territory, and make a tangible impact on ABB's market position across Queensland

More about us

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extracting the maximum value from them, and then recovering and regenerating products and materials at the end of their useful life.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Team Lead- Intercompany ###

Job Description

Accounting & Reporting Analyst (Grade 16) – Intercompany (R2R I2C)

Reports To: Team Lead - Intercompany Global Grade: Grade 16 Function: Record-to-Report (R2R) / Intercompany Accounting (I2C)

Position Summary

The Accounting & Reporting Analyst is responsible for managing end-to-end intercompany accounting activities, including intercompany reconciliations, month-end and year-end closing, accrual accounting, balance sheet reconciliations, and intercompany settlement processes. The role requires close collaboration with global finance teams to ensure accurate financial reporting, timely closure of books, and compliance with accounting standards and internal controls.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2 to 4 years of relevant experience in Accounting, Reporting, or Intercompany Accounting.

job.title: HVAC Site Supervisor
job.description:
Shape the Future of Smart Buildings with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls, we're transforming how buildings perform. As a global leader in smart building technologies, integrated building systems, and advanced HVAC solutions, we help customers create safer, healthier, and more sustainable environments.

Our solutions support some of Australia's most critical industries, including mining, healthcare, data centres, pharmaceuticals, education, industrial manufacturing, and commercial infrastructure. Through innovation, energy-efficient technologies, and world-class service delivery, we're helping organisations reduce carbon emissions while improving operational performance.

With over 140 years of global industry leadership, Johnson Controls offers the opportunity to work on complex, high-profile projects alongside some of the most experienced professionals in the industry.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on diverse and technically challenging HVAC projects across Far North Queensland
  • Join a global industry leader with strong local support and genuine career development opportunities
  • Be part of a team delivering innovative building and smart technology solutions
  • Competitive salary package and long-term career growth pathways
  • Collaborative, safety-focused culture where your contribution is valued

About the Role

Based in Cairns, this role offers the opportunity to lead the delivery of commercial HVAC projects across Queensland and surrounding regions.

As the HVAC Site Supervisor, you will oversee site installation, commissioning, testing, quality assurance, and project documentation, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and to the highest quality standards.

Working closely with customers, subcontractors, suppliers, and project teams, you will coordinate site activities, drive project outcomes, and provide hands-on leadership throughout project delivery.

This opportunity is ideal for an experienced HVAC Technician, Refrigeration Mechanic, Electrician, Leading Hand, or Site Supervisor looking to progress their career with a market-leading organisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate HVAC installation, commissioning, service, and maintenance activities across project sites
  • Manage site labour, subcontractors, and suppliers to achieve project milestones safely and efficiently
  • Monitor site productivity and ensure project schedules and delivery targets are met
  • Conduct site inspections and audits to maintain safety, quality, and compliance standards
  • Coordinate material deliveries, equipment, plant, and site resources to support project execution
  • Provide hands-on leadership, mentoring, and technical guidance to site personnel
  • Support commissioning, testing, defect resolution, and project handover activities
  • Ensure all works comply with customer specifications, company procedures, and quality assurance requirements
  • Maintain accurate reporting, project documentation, and site records
  • Identify and proactively resolve technical, operational, and site-related issues
  • Contribute to project performance by balancing customer, commercial, and operational requirements
  • Champion a strong safety culture and lead by example in all site activities

About You

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

Essential

  • Mechanical Trade Qualification (HVAC/Refrigeration & Air Conditioning) or Electrical Trade Qualification
  • Minimum 5 years' experience within the commercial HVAC industry, ideally across installation, construction, retrofit, or project delivery environments
  • Strong knowledge of commercial HVAC systems, construction methodologies, and site-based project delivery
  • Proven ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, subcontractors, and project activities
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and organisational skills
  • Demonstrated commitment to customer service and building strong client relationships
  • Current Driver's Licence
  • Construction White Card
  • Passion for safety leadership, hazard identification, and continuous improvement

Desirable

  • Previous Site Supervisor, Leading Hand, or Team Leader experience
  • Experience delivering commercial HVAC construction or retrofit projects
  • Exposure to Building Management Systems (BMS) and controls technologies
  • Experience with AutoCAD, BIM, Microsoft Project, or Visio
  • Additional industry certifications including Working at Heights, EWP, First Aid, or similar

Build Your Future with Johnson Controls

If you're an experienced HVAC Technician, Refrigeration Mechanic, Electrician, Leading Hand, or Site Supervisor looking for the next challenge, this is your opportunity to join a global industry leader delivering some of Far North Queensland's most exciting building and infrastructure projects.

Apply now or contact Janis for a confidential discussion at [janis.sotelo@jci.com](mailto:janis.sotelo@jci.com).

job.title: Senior Developer Enterprise Integration
job.description:
Job Description

Senior Integration Developer (6–9 Years)

Role Summary

A highly experienced, hands-on Senior Integration Developer responsible for designing and delivering complex, enterprise-grade integration solutions. Drives advanced development, owns Low-Level Design (LLDs), and ensures high-quality, CI/CD-driven delivery using Azure Integration Services, while mentoring teams and contributing to architecture alignment.

Key Responsibilities

Core Development (Primary Focus)

Lead the development of complex, large-scale integration solutions using Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Data Factory, Service Bus, Event Grid).

Build high-performance, scalable, and production-ready solutions, handling complex enterprise integration scenarios.

Develop reusable frameworks, advanced integration patterns, and shared components to accelerate delivery across programs.

API Development & APIM Governance

Design and implement enterprise-grade APIs using Azure API Management (APIM).

Configure advanced APIM policies including security, transformation, throttling, and routing.

Ensure APIs meet performance, security, and governance standards.

Low-Level Design & Technical Ownership

Own and drive Low-Level Design (LLDs) for modules and critical components.

Translate business and architectural requirements into scalable, well-structured technical designs.

Ensure strict adherence to architecture standards, design principles, and best practices.

Azure DevOps & CI/CD (Key Responsibility)

Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.

Drive end-to-end automation of build, deployment, and release processes using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

Ensure consistent, reliable, and high-quality releases across environments.

Improve deployment efficiency, rollback strategies, and release governance.

Testing, Debugging & Production Support

Lead unit testing, integration testing, and validation strategies.

Handle complex debugging and root cause analysis across APIs, events, and workflows.

Provide strong support for critical production issues and performance bottlenecks.

Monitoring, Reliability & Performance

Implement and enhance observability frameworks using Azure Monitor and Application Insights.

Ensure solutions meet SLAs for reliability, scalability, and performance.

AI & Copilot-Enabled Development

Actively leverage GitHub Copilot / M365 Copilot for:

Code acceleration and optimization

LLD and API documentation generation

Debugging and performance insights

Apply AI-assisted engineering practices to improve productivity and delivery quality.

Contribute to adoption of AI-driven development practices within the team.

Technical Leadership & Mentoring

Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding developers on design, coding, and best practices.

Conduct code reviews, design reviews, and quality checks.

Mentor engineers and junior developers, building strong technical capability across the team.

Collaboration in Complex Delivery Programs

Work closely with Leads, Architects, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders.

Drive alignment between design, development, and delivery timelines.

Actively contribute to high-velocity, agile delivery environments.

Required Skills

Experience: 6–9 years with strong focus on hands-on integration development in complex delivery environments.

Azure Integration: Deep expertise in Azure Integration Services (AIS).

API Development: Advanced experience with Azure API Management (APIM).

Programming: Strong coding expertise in C#, .NET, REST APIs, JSON, XML.

Design Skills: Proven experience in owning LLDs and contributing to HLDs.

Integration Patterns: Strong knowledge of event-driven, distributed, and microservices-based architectures.

Azure CI/CD: Hands-on expertise in designing and managing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.

Debugging & Performance: Advanced troubleshooting and optimization skills.

AI & Copilot Skills:

Active and effective use of GitHub Copilot / M365 Copilot

Practical understanding of AI-assisted development workflows

Preferred Skills

Experience with MuleSoft (architecture, migrations, or coexistence).

Exposure to AI/ML integration use cases and intelligent automation.

Knowledge of enterprise security, API governance, and compliance frameworks.

job.title: Engineer Service
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and customer-focused HVAC Service Engineer to manage the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of HVAC systems. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with air conditioning, ventilation, and refrigeration systems, ensuring optimal system performance and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive and breakdown maintenance of HVAC systems, including chillers, VRF/VRV systems, AHUs, FCUs, package units, and ventilation equipment.
  • Diagnose and rectify faults in HVAC equipment in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Conduct installation, commissioning, and testing of HVAC systems at customer sites.
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards and operational procedures.
  • Attend service calls and provide technical support to customers.
  • Prepare service reports, maintenance records, and site documentation.
  • Coordinate with customers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure timely resolution of issues.
  • Monitor equipment performance and recommend corrective actions or upgrades as required.
  • Support AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) activities and ensure SLA adherence.
  • Train customers and site personnel on the proper operation and maintenance of HVAC systems.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or a related field.
  • HVAC certification or relevant technical training is preferred.

Required Skills

  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, controls, and refrigeration principles.
  • Experience with Chillers, VRF/VRV, DX systems, AHUs, FCUs, and ventilation systems.
  • Ability to read technical drawings, schematics, and wiring diagrams.
  • Good troubleshooting and fault-finding skills.
  • Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance practices.
  • Familiarity with safety regulations and industry standards.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and service reporting tools.
  • Strong communication and customer-handling skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in commercial, industrial, or facility management environments.
  • Knowledge of BMS (Building Management Systems).
  • Understanding of energy efficiency and HVAC optimization techniques.
  • Experience managing AMC contracts and service schedules.

job.title: HR Operations
job.description:
HR Operations Specialist - Pune

Work Mode - 5 days work from Office

Johnson Controls is seeking a highly motivated and experienced HR Operations Specialist. The HR Operations Specialist will play a critical role in supporting day-to-day HR operations and ensuring processing of transactions with high accuracy and attention to detail. Scope involves processing of Hiring, Reference Letters, Personal data changes, Job data changes, Terminations and more. job.title: Mobility Specialist
job.description:
Job Title: Mobility Specialist

Position Summary

The Mobility Specialist provides operational support for enterprise mobile services, including mobile device provisioning, carrier support, eSIM management, and user assistance. This role works with employees, mobile service providers, and internal teams to ensure reliable mobile connectivity and timely resolution of mobility-related requests.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, organized, and experienced in supporting mobile devices, wireless services, and telecommunications processes.

Key Responsibilities

Position Location & Regional Coverage

We are currently hiring multiple Mobility Specialists to support employees across the following regions:

- North America (NAM)

- Latin America (LATAM)

- Europe, Middle East & Africa (EMEA)

- Asia Pacific (APAC)

Each Mobility Specialist will serve as the primary mobility operations resource for their assigned region, providing support for mobile services, carrier relationships, eSIM administration, provisioning activities, mobile number management, and end-user mobility support. While aligned to a specific region, team members will collaborate globally to ensure a consistent mobility experience and service delivery model across the organization.

Mobile Service Administration

  • Process mobile service requests including new activations, upgrades, line changes, suspensions, and disconnects.
  • Coordinate mobile device replacements and service transfers.
  • Maintain accurate records of mobile numbers, devices, and service information.
  • Assist with mobile inventory tracking and asset management activities.

SIM & eSIM Support

  • Provision and activate physical SIMs and eSIMs.
  • Support users with eSIM setup and activation.
  • Troubleshoot common SIM and eSIM issues.
  • Coordinate SIM replacements and device upgrade activities.

User Support

  • Provide day-to-day support for mobile phones, tablets, and wireless services.
  • Troubleshoot mobile connectivity, voice, text messaging, and data service issues.
  • Assist users with device setup and carrier-related issues.
  • Support requests involving lost, stolen, or damaged devices.
  • Provide white-glove support for VIP users when required.

Carrier Coordination

  • Submit support requests and service orders with mobile carriers.
  • Track carrier tickets and follow up on outstanding issues.
  • Escalate service-impacting issues when necessary.
  • Assist with number porting and mobile service changes.

Security & Account Support

  • Assist users with PIN and PUK code requests.
  • Support carrier verification and account authentication processes.
  • Coordinate SIM swap requests using approved procedures.
  • Report suspected mobile fraud or unauthorized activity.

Operational Support

  • Maintain mobility documentation and knowledge articles.
  • Assist with reporting and inventory audits.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Participate in mobility-related projects and service enhancements.

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 1-3 years of experience supporting mobile devices, telecommunications services, or end-user technology.
  • Experience working with mobile phones, tablets, and wireless carriers.
  • Basic understanding of eSIM technology and mobile service provisioning.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise mobile phone programs.
  • Experience working with wireless carriers such as Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Vodafone, Orange, or Telefónica.
  • Familiarity with telecom inventory management systems.
  • ITIL or customer support experience.
  • Experience supporting corporate mobile device deployments.

Key Competencies

  • Customer Service
  • Mobile Device Support
  • eSIM Administration
  • SIM Management
  • Carrier Coordination
  • Problem Solving
  • Inventory Management
  • Attention to Detail
  • Communication Skills
  • Organization and Planning

Success Measures

  • Timely completion of mobility requests
  • User satisfaction with mobility services
  • Accuracy of device and service inventories
  • Resolution of carrier and connectivity issues
  • Successful device provisioning and activations
  • Compliance with service-level expectations

Reporting To: Mobility Services Lead / EUC Manager

This role serves as the primary operational resource for employee mobility services, ensuring users receive timely support for mobile devices, carrier services, eSIM activation, and mobile connectivity needs. This version will typically attract Mobility Analysts, Telecom Analysts, Service Desk Leads, and junior Mobility Specialists rather than senior telecom administrators or mobility architects.

job.title: Senior Platform Reliability Engineer
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

AI FactoryOS Operations

AI FactoryOS is Firmus' proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system.

AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against.

The remit is an engineering one. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability, and builds and operates the shared services the estate's own operation depends on. The function works closely with the engineering teams that build the platform, supplying the production evidence that shapes what they fix and what they build next.

Role Summary

The Senior Platform Reliability Engineer is part of the team that operates Firmus AI FactoryOS in production: the GPU compute fleet, and the platform services it depends on, including exabyte-scale storage, the shared core services, the virtualisation hosting the management plane, and the observability infrastructure the estate is measured through. This is state-of-the-art AI infrastructure, among the largest deployments in Asia Pacific, built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation.

This is a hands-on senior role with deep technical expertise, working in a team that shares accountability for the compute fleet and the platform services it depends on. The team runs those to a declared service level and sets the acceptance requirements each service has to meet before it goes live. The team also builds the shared administrative infrastructure the estate is run from, in consultation with the AI Infrastructure team, and operates it as a shared service. Automation is a first-class part of this role: the team builds and maintains the guarded automation and remediation tooling that turns manual response into a self-healing capability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate the multi-tenant control and management plane that Firmus' AI and infrastructure services depend on, including the tenancy, quota and access controls that support separation between tenant workloads and data.
  • Operate Firmus' exabyte-scale distributed and high-performance filesystems (for example VAST, WEKA, Ceph) and S3-compatible object storage to their declared service levels, own the operational automation around them, and drive continuous improvement in how they are operated, feeding platform improvement requirements to AI Infrastructure with evidence.
  • Operate the GPU compute fleet in production: node health and readiness, GPU and node fault detection and handling, firmware and driver currency to the supported baselines, remediation and return-to-service, and the hardware fault and replacement workflow with vendors and site operations.
  • Build and maintain the guarded automation and remediation tooling that turns manual response into a self-healing capability, delivered as controlled code and reviewed by AI Infrastructure where it affects service behaviour.
  • Diagnose and tune performance across the full data path, applying a deep understanding of operating systems, computer networks and software-defined storage, and working with technologies including RDMA, GPU Direct Storage, RoCE and InfiniBand.
  • Deliver change as code, and drive continuous improvement in cluster validation, CI/CD automation, and provisioning and testing frameworks.
  • Operate the observability infrastructure as a shared service across metrics, logs, traces, alerting and retention, and work with service owners so that telemetry becomes alerting that is actionable and tied to a runbook.
  • Operate each service in the portfolio to its published service level, carry new services through production readiness review, and execute the monthly patching cycle and urgent vulnerability remediation.
  • Provide the deepest technical expertise for these platforms, taking on and diagnosing the faults that require internals-level knowledge to root cause, and driving the permanent fix to closure through AI Infrastructure, and manage vendor escalations at engineering level.
  • Lead technical recovery during major incidents, drive the changes that remove repeat causes, share the follow-the-sun on-call roster, and mentor the engineers who carry frontline diagnosis, documenting operational procedures, runbooks and performance results.

Skills & Experience

Required Skills

  • Strong skills in infrastructure, systems and platform engineering, with 8+ years of experience including substantial ownership of production storage and shared infrastructure services in a 24/7 environment.
  • Extensive experience with scale-out, parallel or enterprise storage supporting demanding workloads (for example VAST, WEKA, Ceph, Lustre, GPFS or NetApp), including diagnosis of performance and capacity problems across the full data path using evidence rather than assumption.
  • Substantial experience operating a virtualisation platform (for example Proxmox, VMware or KVM) and building shared services such as databases and object storage to a defined service level.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Linux systems, including storage and file system internals, kernel and driver behaviour, networking, memory and I/O subsystems, and systematic performance analysis.
  • Extensive experience operating observability infrastructure as a service across metrics, logs, traces and alerting (for example Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki or Elasticsearch), and designing alerting that is actionable.
  • Strong skills in infrastructure automation, infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices (for example OpenTofu or Terraform, Ansible, Argo CD, CircleCI), with change delivered through peer review, automated testing and progressive rollout.
  • Practical experience with scripting or programming for operational automation and tooling, such as Python, Go or Bash.
  • Working competence with Kubernetes, sufficient to diagnose faults where shared services meet the container estate.
  • Proven ability to act as a senior escalation point in production, including major incident response, on-call participation, post-incident review, vendor escalation, and the production of runbooks that others can execute successfully.
  • Practical application of least privilege, secrets management, certificate-based access and audited privileged operations, and an understanding of how operational practice produces audit evidence.
  • Clear technical judgement and communication skills, with the ability to produce incident updates, design notes and escalations that non-specialists can act on, and a working style suited to a small team that shares accountability for a broad portfolio.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in storage and infrastructure operations for GPU or HPC environments, including the demands of large-scale distributed training and inference.
  • Experience in multi-tenant service provider, cloud or colocation environments with contractual response commitments and customer-facing reporting.
  • Familiarity with bare-metal lifecycle and provisioning automation (for example NVIDIA Infra Controller, MAAS, Ironic or Metal3), and standard operating environments with known-good-state enforcement.
  • Experience with multi-tenant Kubernetes patterns and GPU-enabled Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of data centre and hardware fundamentals, including firmware management, DPU or SmartNIC-based networking, and high-performance fabrics such as InfiniBand or RoCE.
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code and software-supply-chain controls, such as image signing, software bills of materials and vulnerability gating.
  • Experience preparing for or operating under ISO 27001, or SOC 2, and responding to enterprise customer due diligence.
  • A Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and training.

Location & Reporting

Location: Based in Australia or Singapore, with travel to Australian AI Factory sites as required.

On-call: The function runs 24/7. First line monitoring and first response sit with the operations centre. This role shares the after-hours escalation roster for its domain with the other senior engineers in the function.

Reporting to:  Reports to the Head of AI FactoryOS Operations while the function is being established, working under broad direction with a high degree of autonomy and direct access to the decision makers. As the function reaches its planned structure, the role will report to the Service Reliability Manager, with the Head of AI FactoryOS Operations remaining accountable for the function. The scope, level and remit of the role do not change under either arrangement.

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Network Engineer – AI Network & Security
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why you’ll love working here

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work.

Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Role Summary

Firmus Technologies is seeking a skilled Network Engineer / Sr. Network Engineer to join our Engineering and Technology team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in leading the development of our network designs and supporting the network deployment for AI infrastructure projects. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of AI networking technology and contribute to the growth of AI infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy and Operate High-Performance Networks

Deploy and maintain low-latency, high-throughput interconnects (e.g.: Ethernet 100/200/400GbE) for HPC and AI workloads.

  • Optimise performance across multi-node clusters, high-speed storage fabrics and parallel computing AI environments.
  • Respond to and resolve escalated network issues, outages and performance degradations across the SMC Corporate and Compute network infrastructure.
  • Analyse logs, run diagnostics and coordinate with vendors, carriers as needed.
  • Work with internal observability team to setup and maintain monitoring tools to proactively identify bottlenecks, errors and abnormal behaviours.
  • Analyse trends for bandwidth, hardware utilisation, and growth to inform scaling and make recommendations to procurement decisions.
  • Participate in the operations standby roster and on-call from time to time, and work closely with other network engineers as a team.
  • Design and test redundant paths, failover mechanisms and DR playbooks to ensure uninterrupted connectivity during outages or maintenance.
  • InfiniBand/Ethernet and RDMA Networking

Design, monitor and troubleshoot InfiniBand/Ethernet fabrics and RDMA-enabled transport layers.

  • Maintain subnet managers (e.g.: Unified Fabric Manager and OpenSM) and ensure fabric health and topology visibility.
  • Perform verification and acceptance tests to the new fabric and new network infrastructure setups.
  • Understand various InfiniBand / RoCE optimisation protocols and mechanisms (e.g.: SHARP, CollNet) and use performance tools (e.g.: ibstat, perfquery, ib_write_bw, nccl, etc) to monitor fabric health, congestion and link errors.
  • Enable optimised networking for AI frameworks and work closely with GPU compute environments to ensure efficient multi-node communication.
  • Perform deep dive diagnostics to resolve layer 1-4 issues across HPC and AI workloads.
  • Network as Code and Automation

Develop and maintain automated network configurations using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g.: Ansible, Netbox, Python scripts).

  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for network changes to improve speed, consistency, and auditability.
  • Automate routine tasks such as provisioning, backups and compliance checks.
  • Network Security and Policy Enforcement

Implement and manage firewall and security devices. Apply firewall rules, segmentation, and Secure-by-default, Security-by-design principles to safeguard internal and external connectivity.

  • Collaborate with Security and Risk team to enforce policies and respond to security incidents.
  • Design and implement zero-trust network architecture across corporate and AI compute fabric, including segmentation and least-privilege access.
  • Implement authentication and access control (802.1X, NAC, MACsec) for fabric and out-of-band management networks.
  • Own network security posture for RDMA/RoCEv2 and InfiniBand fabrics, including multi-tenant workload isolation.
  • Support vulnerability management: coordinate scanning, patching cadence, and remediation tracking for network infrastructure.
  • Participate in security incident response — detection, containment, root cause analysis, and post-incident reporting — with the SMC Security and Risk team.
  • Contribute to compliance and audit activity (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2) relating to network controls.
  • Integrate network telemetry and logs with SIEM/observability tooling for security monitoring.
  • Project Management and Stakeholder Management

Support the deployment team in their project management and resource allocation for the network portion of AI cluster installations.

  • Collaborate and work closely with the Global Operations Centre, Software Defined Infrastructure team, Data Centre Infrastructure team and Solution Architects to support deployments and to maintain SLAs.
  • Work closely with both the Firmus Engineering and Commissioning teams to align network infrastructure with customers’ requirements.
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and communication between teams and create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation.
  • Maintain and build strong relationships with key technology partners and vendors and proactively manage and coordinate partner engagement on site.
  • Technology Expertise

Familiar with SASE cloud framework together with Zero Trust Network Access and Privilege Access Management

  • Maintain and expand expertise in physical network hardware and advanced networking technologies, including (i) NVIDIA InfiniBand; (ii) Spectrum Ethernet Platform, and (iii) RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE).
  • Familiarity with open-source network operating systems such as Cumulus Linux and Sonic.
  • Evaluate new technologies (RoCEv2, DPU/SmartNICS or quantum interconnects) for next-gen HPC fabrics.
  • Benchmark and validate new switches, nics, transceivers or firmware in lab environments before production roll-out.
  • Maintain and expand expertise in NetDevOps practices to maintain software defined network infrastructure.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for advanced networking technologies, escalating to vendors as needed.

Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in network engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years of experience in network engineering, with a focus on network security.
  • Experience in Linux systems especially host network configuration.
  • Strong project management skills and experienced in complex technical projects.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Willingness to undertake international and/or domestic travel for on-site deployments and commissioning as required.
  • Solid understanding of advanced networking technologies, particularly those related to AI would be highly advantageous.
  • Experience with zero-trust architecture, MACsec, 802.1X/NAC, and network segmentation in multi-tenant environments.
  • Relevant security certifications highly regarded (e.g. CCNP Security, CISSP, Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto PCNSE).
  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA InfiniBand, Spectrum Ethernet Platform, and/or RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE) preferred.

Location & Reporting

  • Singapore
  • Reporting to Senior Manager, Networking

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Senior Contracts Manager - Data Centres
job.description:
About Goodman

At Goodman, your career is more than just a job – it’s about growth, innovation, and making a lasting impact. Whether you’re building your career in property, data centres, finance, legal, or beyond, we value diverse perspectives and seek individuals who are passionate about driving our business forward.

As providers of essential infrastructure for the digital economy, Goodman has been developing its data centre capability since 2005. Since then, we have grown to become a large owner of powered sites globally. Our global power bank of 5.0GW includes completed facilities, secured power and potential data centre projects across 13 major international cities. This has been built up over time through our expertise in securing land, planning and power in highly sought after locations in major global cities.

Goodman is looking for a Senior Contracts Manager to join our Data Centre Delivery team in Melbourne. This is a senior commercial role supporting the delivery of complex, large-scale data centre projects, with responsibility for leading contract strategy, procurement, claims, variations, cost reporting, forecasting and commercial governance.

You’ll work closely with project leadership, development, finance, legal, consultants, contractors and suppliers to provide clear, practical commercial advice and ensure projects are delivered in line with approved budgets, timeframes, contractual obligations and Goodman’s risk appetite.

What you’ll be doing

  • Leading the commercial and contractual management of assigned data centre projects
  • Developing procurement and contracting strategies that support delivery certainty, value for money and risk management
  • Managing head contracts, consultant agreements, early works contracts, supply agreements and related project documentation
  • Overseeing contractual notices, variations, EOTs, claims, progress payments, final accounts and cost substantiation
  • Preparing and reviewing commercial reports, forecasts, cashflow, risk updates, approval papers and executive reporting
  • Supporting tender processes, commercial negotiations, tender evaluations and recommendation papers
  • Maintaining strong commercial discipline across the project team, including contract registers, procurement trackers, claims registers and audit trails
  • Building trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders while protecting Goodman’s commercial position

What we’re looking for

You’ll bring strong commercial judgement, contract management experience and the confidence to operate in a fast-paced, technically complex delivery environment. You will be comfortable balancing detail with the bigger picture, providing practical advice and influencing senior stakeholders.

You will have:

  • 10+ years’ experience in commercial management, contracts, quantity surveying or a related discipline
  • Experience across large-scale construction, infrastructure, engineering, industrial or mission-critical projects
  • Strong knowledge of construction contracts, procurement, claims, variations, EOTs, cost control and project governance
  • Proven ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships across contractors, consultants, suppliers and internal teams
  • Strong financial acumen, including forecasting, cashflow, budget management and cost reporting
  • Advanced Excel skills, with experience using Power BI or project reporting tools viewed favourably
  • A relevant qualification in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Law, Commerce or a related field

The Benefits

At Goodman we know that our people are integral to our company success. That’s why we have implemented some fantastic benefits for all to experience, these include:

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.
