job.title: Oracle SOA Developer
job.description:
Job Description

Locaiton: Noida -Onsite

Qualifications & Skills

Mandatory

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Hands-on experience in Oracle SOA Suite development and production support.
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SOA Suite components including BPEL, Mediator, Oracle Service Bus (OSB), Business Rules, and Oracle Adapters.
  • Strong knowledge of XML, XSD, XSLT, XPath, WSDL, SOAP, REST, and JMS.
  • Experience administering Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle Fusion Middleware environments.
  • Hands-on experience with middleware deployment, configuration, patching, migration, troubleshooting, and environment management.
  • Good working knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems and shell scripting.
  • Understanding of Oracle Database concepts, SQL, and database integration.
  • Experience troubleshooting production issues, log analysis, performance tuning, and root cause analysis.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes including Incident, Change, Release, and Problem Management.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience administering Oracle Service Bus (OSB) environments.
  • Knowledge of Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) monitoring and middleware performance optimization.
  • Experience with middleware security, SSL configuration, identity management, and access controls.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and scripting.
  • Experience working in Managed Services, Customer Success, or Production Support environments.
  • Oracle Middleware or Oracle Cloud certifications.

Self-Assessment Questions

  • Before applying, ask yourself:
  • Do I have hands-on experience developing and supporting Oracle SOA Suite integrations using BPEL, Mediator, OSB, and Oracle Adapters?
  • Am I comfortable administering Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle Fusion Middleware environments, including deployments, patching, configuration, and troubleshooting?
  • Have I successfully diagnosed and resolved production issues by analyzing middleware logs, performing root cause analysis, and implementing long-term fixes?
  • Do I have practical experience working with XML, XSLT, XPath, SOAP, REST, JMS, Oracle databases, and Linux environments?
  • Have I worked in customer-facing production support or managed services environments where platform availability, performance, and service excellence were critical success factors?

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and support enterprise integrations using Oracle SOA Suite components including BPEL, Mediator, Oracle Service Bus (OSB), Business Rules, and Oracle Adapters.
  • Develop and maintain integration services between Oracle applications and third-party systems using SOAP, REST, XML, XSD, XSLT, XPath, WSDL, JMS, and related technologies.
  • Participate in the complete software development lifecycle, including requirement analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.
  • Administer Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle WebLogic Server, and Oracle Fusion Middleware environments, ensuring platform stability, security, and high availability.
  • Perform deployments, environment configuration, cloning, migration, patching, and release management across development, test, and production environments.
  • Monitor middleware health, analyze logs, troubleshoot incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventive measures to improve platform reliability.
  • Manage WebLogic domains, managed servers, data sources, JMS resources, security configurations, SSL certificates, and environment maintenance activities.
  • Collaborate with application, database, infrastructure, and customer teams to resolve complex technical issues while driving automation, performance tuning, and operational excellence.

Qualifications

Career Level - IC4

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing [accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com](mailto:accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com) or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

job.title: Lead Data Center Support Services Technician
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, test, deploy, maintain, upgrade, and decommission data centre equipment and infrastructure.
  • Perform safe and efficient rack and stack activities, server deployments, hardware installations, equipment replacements, upgrades, and decommissioning.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve server, hardware, cabling, network, power, and supporting infrastructure issues, escalating appropriately when additional expertise or support is required.
  • Triage, prioritise, and respond to incoming incidents, service requests, and operational issues in a timely manner.
  • Perform preventative and corrective maintenance, including diagnosing hardware failures, replacing failed components, and applying firmware updates.
  • Monitor and support the reliability and performance of production server hardware and supporting data centre infrastructure.
  • Maintain accurate asset, hardware, and spare-parts inventory using internal systems and support tools.
  • Follow established SOPs, change-management processes, operational procedures, security requirements, and safety standards.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and improved service quality.
  • Plan and organise work effectively, balancing competing priorities and high work demands while maintaining attention to detail and delivery quality.
  • Monitor progress against assigned work, proactively communicate priorities, dependencies, blockers, and risks, and take appropriate action when delivery may be impacted.
  • Demonstrate initiative, accountability, and resourcefulness, independently using available documentation, tools, systems, and technical resources to investigate and resolve problems.
  • Recognise personal capacity and technical limitations and escalate workload, risk, or complexity appropriately before service quality, safety, wellbeing, or delivery is adversely affected.
  • Build collaborative working relationships with engineering teams, vendors, customers, internal stakeholders, and other technical and non-technical teams.
  • Communicate technical information clearly and professionally, adapting communication to the audience and proactively keeping relevant stakeholders informed.
  • Work effectively within a global matrix organisation, collaborating and influencing across functions, regions, teams, and reporting lines without relying on direct authority.
  • Balance customer, commercial, operational, and organisational requirements when prioritising work and making decisions.
  • Maintain professionalism, resilience, and sound judgement when working under pressure or responding to changing operational priorities.
  • Contribute to a psychologically safe, respectful, ethical, and inclusive workplace through constructive communication and behaviour consistent with organisational values and policies.
  • Remain open to feedback, resolve disagreements constructively, and demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and development.
  • Adopt new technologies, processes, tools, and ways of working that improve team and operational performance.
  • Deliver timely, accurate, customer-focused, and high-quality technical support within a mission-critical data centre environment.
  • Participate in a rotating 24x7 shift roster, including on-call responsibilities.

Technical Knowledge and Experience

The successful candidate will bring:

  • Previous hands-on experience working in a Data Centre or comparable mission-critical infrastructure environment.
  • Practical experience across the hardware lifecycle, including rack and stack, deployment, configuration, testing, maintenance, upgrades, break/fix activities, component replacement, and decommissioning.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to systematically identify root causes and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Experience following documented operational procedures while exercising sound judgement when situations require investigation or escalation.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when performing physical infrastructure changes, maintaining records, handling assets, and working on production systems.
  • Background in Linux.
  • Knowledge of Data Centre Ecosystem (cooling, electrical, networking, and structured cabling).

Professional Capabilities

Communication and Stakeholder Management

Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build collaborative relationships across technical and non-technical teams. Able to influence stakeholders, communicate priorities, risks, dependencies, and technical issues proactively, and balance customer, commercial, operational, and organisational needs.

Respectful and Inclusive Behaviour

A demonstrated commitment to fostering a psychologically safe, respectful, ethical, and inclusive workplace. Maintains professional behaviour, communicates constructively, makes responsible decisions, and works consistently with organisational values, policies, and expected standards of conduct.

Resilience, Adaptability and Customer Focus

Able to operate effectively in a dynamic, mission-critical environment, navigate ambiguity, embrace change, and remain resilient under pressure. Demonstrates emotional intelligence and maintains a strong customer focus while delivering required technical and business outcomes.

Planning and Delivery

Strong planning, organisation, prioritisation, and time-management skills. Able to manage competing priorities and high work demands, monitor progress, adjust plans as circumstances change, and consistently deliver safe, accurate, and high-quality outcomes.

Initiative and Accountability

Demonstrates a proactive, self-service mindset with strong initiative, ownership, accountability, and resourcefulness. Independently investigates and solves problems using available tools, documentation, systems, and resources while understanding when escalation or additional support is appropriate.

Recognises personal capacity, workload constraints, and technical complexity and proactively seeks support before quality, safety, wellbeing, customer outcomes, or delivery are adversely affected.

Collaboration in a Matrix Environment

Experience working effectively within a global matrix organisation, collaborating across multiple functions, regions, teams, and reporting structures. Able to build alignment and influence outcomes through credibility, communication, and collaboration rather than direct authority.

Continuous Learning and Improvement

Demonstrates openness to feedback, coaching, continuous learning, and constructive conflict resolution. Willingly adopts new processes, tools, technologies, and ways of working and actively contributes ideas that improve operational effectiveness and support a high-performing team culture.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, position, and move IT equipment weighing 15 kg or more.
  • Comfortable working within data centre environments, including standing for extended periods, bending, reaching, and working in confined or restricted spaces.
  • Able to safely and efficiently perform rack and stack, hardware installation, cabling, component replacement, and equipment decommissioning activities.
  • Commitment to following relevant workplace health, safety, and operational procedures.
  • Valid drivers license and access to a car.

job.title: Software Engineer, Google Pay, Growth and Communications
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our mission at Google Pay is to make digital finance simple, safe, and universally accessible.

Operating at an unprecedented scale, our Singapore-based team is the engine behind the overarching Growth and Communications (Comms) platforms. Our Comms infrastructure powers the high-throughput messaging systems required to reliably engage hundreds of millions of users. Simultaneously, under Growth, we fully own high-volume user acquisition channels including our core referral and reward engines that drive massive-scale traffic and generate multi-million dollar business streams.

In this role, you will design and deploy scalable features ranging from our core referral and reward engines to robust, high-throughput communication infrastructure that shape the financial journey for hundreds of millions of users, while leveraging agentic workflows and generative AI tools to accelerate delivery.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy features across Google Pay’s mobile, web, and backend ecosystems, focusing on seamless Remote Procedure Call (RPC) integration and UI excellence.
  • Lead technical designs for robust backend services and data processing pipelines that support massive-scale growth experiments.
  • Ensure long-term feature reliability by building comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and automated performance tracking.
  • Contribute to engineering excellence by participating in design reviews, improving code quality, and contributing to technical discussions within the team.
  • Leverage DevAI and agentic coding workflows to accelerate end-to-end development, setting a high standard for AI-assisted engineering productivity within the team.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Senior Engineer - Boomi integration
job.description:
Job Title - Senior Engineer - Boomi integration

Preferred Location - Bangalore/Hyderabad, India

Full time/Part Time - Full Time

Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

Key Responsibilities

Integration & API Development (Must-Have)

  • Design, develop, deploy, and maintain end-to-end integrations using Boomi AtomSphere (Application Integration, API Management, Cloud Integration).
  • Design and manage APIs using an API Management platform (Boomi API Management or Layer 7 or equivalent).
  • Build and maintain real-time, batch, and event-driven integrations between ERP systems (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle) and enterprise applications (CRM, MES, PLM, Finance, Data platforms).
  • Build API-first, service-oriented, reusable and discoverable services aligned to enterprise standards.
  • Implement integration patterns including synchronous/asynchronous messaging, event-driven integrations, error handling, retries, and idempotency.
  • Develop custom logic using JavaScript and/or Java within Boomi processes.

Platform Ownership & Operations

  • Own Boomi platform operations including monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
  • Manage integrations across Dev/Test/Prod environments with strong governance.
  • Implement enterprise-grade logging, exception handling, and recovery frameworks.
  • Support production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and drive permanent fixes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with application teams, DBAs, analytics, automation, and upstream/downstream system owners.
  • Translate business requirements into integration designs and technical specifications.
  • Review integration designs and provide technical guidance across teams.

Learning Agility & Platform Adaptability

  • Demonstrate ability to quickly learn and adopt new iPaaS platforms beyond Boomi (e.g., MuleSoft, SAP CPI, etc.) as enterprise integration strategy evolves.
  • Comfortable working in multi-iPaaS environments and transferring integration patterns, API standards, and best practices across platforms.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Must-Have Skills

  • 5+ years of enterprise integration development experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Boomi AtomSphere experience (mandatory).
  • Strong experience with API Management (design, governance, security, lifecycle management).
  • Hands-on experience building and consuming REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns and API-led architecture.
  • Solid SQL and relational database skills.
  • Experience with XML, JSON, flat files, transformations, and mappings.
  • Knowledge of API security (OAuth, certificates, authentication, authorization, IP whitelisting).
  • Experience with AWS services and cloud-native APIs.

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) is preferred.
  • Experience with other iPaaS platforms (MuleSoft, TIBCO, etc.).
  • Exposure to cloud data warehouse platforms such as Snowflake, etc., including data ingestion, API-based loads, and integration with enterprise systems.
  • Understanding of EDI concepts and X12 standards, Trading Partner Management/Configurations
  • Experience using Node.js, TypeScript, or Python for integration extensions or custom components.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks.

Enterprise & Delivery

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments within large, matrix organizations.
  • Exposure to customer-facing systems such as eCommerce platforms, Salesforce, CPQ, or API-first portals.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field.

Benefits

  • We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary.
  • Have peace of mind and body with our health insurance
  • Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules and leave Policy
  • Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Program.

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

job.title: Senior Business Development Manager - APAC
job.description:
Senior Business Development Manager - APAC

Singapore or Kuala Lumpur

Some people wait for opportunities to appear. Others create them.

Honeywell Process Automation is seeking a Senior Business Development Manager to help shape and win some of the region's most strategic and complex opportunities across energy, infrastructure, automation and emerging technologies.

This is not a traditional territory sales role. It is about identifying opportunities early, building executive relationships, influencing outcomes, bringing the right stakeholders together and turning strategy into revenue.

What You will Be Working On

You will lead business development activities across Asia Pacific, focusing on major projects and strategic opportunities that can span multiple countries, business units and years.

Your portfolio may include opportunities across:

  • LNG and energy infrastructure
  • Global Mega Projects
  • Energy transition and storage
  • Data centres
  • Industrial automation and digital technologies
  • Other large-scale capital projects across the region

No two pursuits will look the same. Some opportunities may begin with a conversation years before a project is formally announced. Others may require coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders across different countries and time zones.

What Success Looks Like

You know how to:

  • Spot opportunities before they reach the market
  • Build credibility with senior decision-makers
  • Navigate complex stakeholder environments
  • Influence strategy without direct authority
  • Shape customer requirements and commercial outcomes
  • Coordinate teams across functions, regions and businesses
  • Turn large, complex pursuits into booked orders

You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and understand that the most valuable opportunities are often the ones that take time to develop.

What You will Bring

We are less concerned with the exact industry you have worked in and more interested in the impact you've had.

You may have built your career in:

  • Energy
  • LNG
  • Oil & Gas
  • Industrial automation
  • Infrastructure
  • Power and utilities
  • Technology solutions
  • Engineering and project environments

Most importantly, you will have experience leading complex business development or sales pursuits and influencing outcomes in large organisations.

Why This Role?

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Influence growth across an entire region
  • Work directly with senior leaders and strategic customers
  • Engage on some of the largest opportunities in the market
  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy
  • Make a visible impact on business performance

If you are motivated by creating opportunities, solving complex commercial challenges, and building relationships that drive long-term growth, we would like to hear from you.

Discover More

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

Role Summary

We’re seeking a Principal Software Engineer to build and evolve large-scale, distributed systems that power mission-critical platforms. This is a senior technical leadership role for engineers who thrive on solving hard, ambiguous problems at scale, and who can influence architecture across teams.

You will drive system design, scalability, and engineering excellence, while remaining deeply hands-on in building high-performance backend systems on a modern cloud-native stack.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect and build high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems using Java and microservices
  • Lead end-to-end system design across services, data, and platform layers
  • Design for scale, resilience, fault tolerance, and operability from first principles
  • Build and operate containerized workloads on Kubernetes (multi-service, production scale)
  • Define and raise the bar on architecture, APIs, and engineering quality standards
  • Drive cross-team technical decisions and resolve complex system bottlenecks
  • Mentor senior engineers and act as a technical multiplier across teams
  • Influence platform roadmap, modernization, and developer productivity

Basic Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience building and operating backend systems at scale
  • Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Distributed Systems
  • Proven experience designing highly available, large-scale systems (traffic, data, or compute)
  • Hands-on with Kubernetes and Docker in production environments
  • Strong fundamentals in system design, concurrency, data modeling, and performance optimization
  • Deep experience with PostgreSQL or similar databases

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka / streaming systems)
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) and hybrid architectures
  • Experience with observability, reliability engineering, and production operations
  • Contributions to platform engineering, frameworks, or internal developer platforms
  • Track record of influencing architecture across multiple teams or product

Tech Stack

Java | Spring Boot | Microservices | Kubernetes | Docker | PostgreSQL | CI/CD | Cloud (AWS/Azure)

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Senior Data Quality Analyst - GFS Strategy -Global Finance Services Division.

The incumbent would Lead data quality initiatives for Finance platforms by designing and operationalizing DQ rules, pipelines and remediation processes. Partner with stakeholders to ensure trusted, governed data for analytics and financial reporting.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore-Shared Services

What you will do

  • Lead business and IT discussions for DQ solution development, enhancements and support
  • Accountable and responsible for overall data accuracy and completeness for priority data elements
  • Champion data governance framework and support data cataloging and glossary efforts
  • Good with documentation and creating process maps – for example - technical design documents, Requirement Docs, BRDs, Project Plan, Status Decks, etc.
  • Good requirement-gathering skills and experience as a technical business analyst.
  • Design, build and operate end-to-end data quality pipelines and validations to support reconciliation and data quality for finance datasets.
  • Author, implement and monitor data quality rules and expectations
  • Build and maintain data pipelines using Snowflake/Snowpark and/or AWS Glue (Crawlers, Jobs, Workflows, Glue Data Quality).
  • Integrate Glue workflows with Apache Airflow for orchestration; develop Lambda functions for processing and orchestration tasks.
  • Design and develop API integrations connecting AWS/Snowflake/Web UI etc. to support data quality solution
  • Drive DQ remediation with data owners and stewards: automate fixes where safe, escalate and manage manual remediation
  • Capture metadata, lineage and access controls; collaborate with governance and security teams.
  • Produce technical documentation, requirement specs and DQ dashboards; mentor junior analysts.

What you will have

  • 8 + years’ experience in data management, data quality/governance or related roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL and Python.
  • Experience with Snowflake and/or AWS data stack (AWS Glue, Glue Data Catalog, Lambda, Athena).
  • Proven experience authoring and operationalizing DQ rules and remediation processes.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, requirements-gathering and documentation skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating Glue workflows with Apache Airflow.
  • Experience with Alation or other data catalog tools.
  • Certifications: AWS (Data Analytics or Solutions Architect), DAMA/DMBOK, or DQ certification.
  • Experience with building dashboards or WebUI to support DQ dashboards
  • Proficient in AI tools like Co-Pilot, Github Copilot, VS code, Snowflake Cortex etc.

Core Skills & Competencies:

  • Data profiling, cleansing, enrichment and DQ frameworks
  • Pipeline orchestration and automation
  • Troubleshooting, logging and observability best practices (CloudWatch, monitoring tools)
  • Version control (Git) and collaboration tools (Azure Devops)
  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills

Skills desired:

Business Analysis: Knowledge of business analysis and the set of tasks, techniques and tools required to identify business needs; ability to recommend solutions that deliver value to stakeholders. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Analyzes the value of a business and its functions through the value estimation of assets.
  • Applies the prerequisites to a project before starting the business analysis process.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders, development teams, testing teams, etc., to deliver business solutions.
  • Documents the business case to justify the requirements of time and resources of a project.
  • Utilizes diverse analysis tools and methodologies to group different business activities based on shared characteristics or similarities.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Differentiates assumptions, perspectives, and historical frameworks.
  • Evaluates past decisions for insights to improve decision-making process.
  • Assesses and validates decision options and points and predicts their potential impact.
  • Advises others in analyzing and synthesizing relevant data and assessing alternatives.
  • Uses effective decision-making approaches such as consultative, command, or consensus.
  • Ensures that assumptions and received wisdom are objectively analyzed in decisions.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching.
  • Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience.
  • Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position.
  • Communicates well downward, upward, and outward.
  • Employs appropriate methods of persuasion when soliciting agreement.
  • Maintains focus on the topic at hand.

Software Change Request Management: Knowledge of software change request management; ability to manage software product change requests from customers, prospective customers, vendors, and internal staff. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Describes methods for estimating costs for request fulfillment.
  • Defines responses for non-standard or unsupported change requests.
  • Contributes to the design and development of request process flow and templates.
  • Clarifies description, components affected, need, cost estimate, risk, resources, status.
  • Manages all aspects of the change request process.
  • Researches new tools and techniques for monitoring product efficacy.

Software Engineering: Knowledge of software engineering; ability to deliver new or enhanced fee-based software products. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies considerations for product integration with multiple platforms and systems.
  • Works with development or delivery of a software package or component.
  • Describes phases, activities, deliverables and processes for a specific methodology.
  • Works with structured documents for developing features, functions, plans and schedules.
  • Describes software design practices, technologies, and considerations.

Software Problem Management: Knowledge of strategies, practices and tools for resolving software problems; ability to manage software problems in installed software products. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Documents resolution progress and provides feedback to customers.
  • Describes issues and consideration for resolving problems involving other products or vendors.
  • Works with tracking and resolving common types of problems for a product or product group.
  • Describes actions, tools, and procedures for problem reporting, solving, and resolution.
  • Cites examples of unusual problems; follows proper notifications and escalation procedures.

Software Product Business Knowledge: Knowledge of and experience with the business aspects and operation of a software product; ability to manage install base, current uses, future plans, and product vision. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Participates in enhancing the sales process and expanding sales opportunities.
  • Collects, documents, and maintains product functional requirements; makes recommendations.

  • Maintains and disseminates information on customer use and experiences.
  • Has knowledge of all advanced business features and functions of the product.
  • Relates experiences with unusual or non-traditional uses; assesses opportunities and challenges.

User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Knowledge of UAT activities, tasks, tools and techniques; ability to design, implement and evaluate acceptance tests for end-users. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Compares and contrasts features and benefits of major acceptance testing frameworks.
  • Critiques user acceptance plans for appropriateness and completeness.

  • Monitors end-users in defining the testing environment and acceptance criteria; explains the importance of being actively involved in test designs and other testing phases.
  • Applies user acceptance testing in typical software development scenarios.
  • Consults on test strategies, components, processes, plans and approaches during the user acceptance testing process.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and experienced IT Analyst Applications ( Data Engineer – AI & Analytics ) to join our India GCC – GCIO ETL Services -CAT IT Division.

Caterpillar is accelerating data‑driven decision making across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, services, and digital products. As a Data Engineer with AI skillset, you will design and build robust data pipelines, features, and platforms that power analytics, machine learning, and GenAI use cases—such as predictive maintenance, parts demand forecasting, warranty analytics, and intelligent knowledge retrieval.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN

What you will do

Data Pipelines & Integration

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable batch/streaming pipelines (e.g., telematics/IoT, SAP, PLM, MES, service/warranty, dealer systems).
  • Implement CDC, schema evolution, and data quality checks (Great Expectations/Deequ/custom).
  • Develop feature pipelines for ML and analytics (feature stores, time-series transformations).

Data Modelling & Storage

  • Model data for lakes/lakehouses/warehouses (Delta/Parquet/Iceberg) following medallion or similar architectures.
  • Optimize partitioning, compaction, and performance for large datasets.

AI/ML Enablement

  • Partner with Data Scientists to productionize models (batch/real-time), build inference pipelines/APIs, and manage feature stores.
  • Contribute to MLOps (CI/CD for models and data, model versioning, monitoring, drift detection).
  • Support GenAI use cases (RAG pipelines, vector indexing, prompt orchestration, governance).

Platform & DevOps

  • Implement infrastructure‑as‑code, CI/CD and observability (lineage, cataloging, logging/metrics).
  • Enforce security, privacy, and compliance (PII handling, role-based access, data contracts).

What you will have

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
  • Overall, at least 7+ years of experience in Data engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Snowflake, SQL, Python, and ETL tools (e.g. Snaplogic).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift).

AI/MLOps Exposure:

  • Building feature pipelines, packaging and deploying models (batch/real‑time).
  • Model serving (Databricks Model Serving, MLflow, Azure ML etc), model registry, experiment tracking.
  • Familiarity with vector databases and RAG patterns.

Behavioural Competencies

  • Ownership & bias for action; thrives in a product operating model.
  • Clear communicator who can bridge business and engineering.
  • Pragmatic, security‑first, automation‑oriented mindset.
  • Collaborative partner across global, cross‑functional teams.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design). Level Working Knowledge:

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Working Knowledge:

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms. Level Working Knowledge:

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle. Level Working Knowledge:

job.title: Supplier Development Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition Assesses the supplier quality and ensures that all the products are free from defects and are in compliance with manufacturing specifications and legal standards.

Responsibilities

  • Ensuring the quality of supplies by conducting tests and assessments on incoming supplies to identify any quality issues; Developing supplier inspection, testing, and evaluation mechanism.
  • Generating reports on supplier quality, by monitoring their defect rates and areas that can lead to potential flaws; Guiding suppliers to reduce these defect rates.
  • Researching the potential vendors, assessing their manufacturing environment, practices, and procedures; Conducting supplier quality control audits to ensure compliance with organizational and federal policies and standards.
  • Supporting suppliers in improving their performance through process enhancements, implementing process controls, and developing quality assurance plans.

Degree Requirement Degree or equivalent experience desired

Skill Descriptors

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Process Improvement: Understanding and insight into evaluating current product quality and production methods and ability to maintains focus on the continuous improvement of processes, products and services. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Defines the critical workflow for executing key processes.
  • Identifies process problems that limit performance.
  • Implements methods for improving and establishing controls for critical processes.
  • Focuses on the most significant problems to maximize efficiency gains.
  • Surfaces systemic problems to be addressed at the organizational level.

Quality Orientation: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques; ability to create and support an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Confronts root causes of problems wherever they exist.
  • Eliminates unnecessary work and all non value-added activities.
  • Uses objective quality criteria and data to drive decisions.
  • Documents learnings regarding quality outcomes so that the data can be used for improvement.
  • Surfaces quality problems whose root causes fall outside the group's responsibility.

Production Part Approval Process (PPAP): Knowledge of Production Part Approval Processes (PPAP) elements, submissions, and objectives; ability to determine whether a supplier can manufacture products that meet the quality requirements and standards of their customers consistently. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Develops testing and validation procedures to test the quality of manufactured parts/products so that it meets desired customer standards.
  • Identifies and resolves key issues with PPAP implementation and submissions.
  • Monitors the execution of PPAP steps within a facility and ensures their compliance with industry standards and internal guidelines.
  • Oversees PPAP implementation; establishes a high trust relationship between stakeholders.
  • Reviews the complex documentation and elements required during the PPAP submission process.
  • Trains others on the execution of PPAP to get the required approvals and teaches them about the different PPAP submission levels.

Manufacturing Standards, Procedures and Policies: Knowledge of organizational standards, procedures and policies in manufacturing activities; ability to plan, guide, and monitor manufacturing processes for compliance. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Contributes to the development and implementation of specific manufacturing procedures.
  • Investigates the need to refer potential exceptions upward for review and approval.
  • Explains the rationale for procedures and standards in own area of responsibility.
  • Participates in the implementation of manufacturing standards and procedures to one's own function.
  • Provides feedback for improvement of procedures.

Supplier Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Facilitates supplier partnering arrangements that share risk and reward.
  • Monitors supplier performance; works to resolve discrepancies between performance and agreements.
  • Develops quality standards and controls for suppliers.
  • Builds and maintains partnerships with multiple and/or large suppliers.
  • Evaluates issues and terminates supplier relationships as appropriate; works with legal departments.
  • Ensures the fulfillment of report and record-keeping requirements.

Supplier Evaluations and Certification: Knowledge of supplier evaluations and certification; ability to identify the methods, tools and documentation for evaluating, selecting and certifying vendors, suppliers and partners. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Documents and pursues results of reference calls or other sources for a specific supplier.
  • Participates in selecting and certifying a specific supplier and/or product.
  • Assists with the steps and procedures for supplier certification.
  • Researches several types of sources of information for a supplier's or a product's reputation.
  • Assesses a product or service using pre-defined evaluation criteria.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Posting Dates:

September 11, 2026 - September 21, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Senior Data Specialist (Lead Data Engineer) join our Financial Systems Tech Support -CAT IT Division

who can operate as a strong hands-on individual contributor while providing technical leadership and guidance across enterprise data initiatives. This role is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting scalable data solutions, analytics platforms, and automation capabilities that enable data-driven decision making across the organisation.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Data Engineering, Power BI, Microsoft Power Platform, Database Technologies, Cloud Platforms, System Design, and Modern Data Architectures. This individual should be capable of independently solving complex technical challenges, driving solution design, evaluating emerging technologies, mentoring team members, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality data products.

The role requires a balance of strong technical execution, architectural thinking, debugging expertise, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous innovation.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN

What you will do

Data Engineering & Platform Development

Hands-on Data Engineering

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable batch, near real-time or streaming data pipelines.
  • Build and optimise ETL/ELT solutions that process large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
  • Develop reusable data integration frameworks, ingestion components, and orchestration workflows.
  • Design and implement enterprise-grade data warehouses, data lakes, and modern data platforms.
  • Integrate data from databases, APIs, enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, files, and external systems.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, reliability, and traceability across all data assets.
  • Develop scalable data models that support reporting, analytics, operational workloads, and future AI/ML initiatives.

Data Quality & Governance

  • Implement data quality controls, validation frameworks, and reconciliation processes.
  • Establish monitoring, observability, lineage, metadata management, and auditing capabilities.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, security, and retention requirements.
  • Partner with governance and business teams to improve trust and usability of enterprise data.

Visualization Solutions (Good to have)

Power BI Development

  • Design and develop enterprise-grade dashboards, reports, scorecards, and executive visualisations using Power BI.
  • Create intuitive, interactive, and business-focused visualisations that provide meaningful insights.
  • Develop and maintain semantic models, datasets, KPIs, metrics, and reporting frameworks.
  • Design star schemas and dimensional models to support reporting and analytics requirements.
  • Implement advanced DAX calculations, measures, and performance optimisation techniques.

Business Intelligence & Reporting

  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into scalable BI solutions.
  • Establish Power BI development standards, governance practices, and reporting best practices.
  • Optimize report performance, data refresh processes, and dataset management.
  • Implement Row-Level Security (RLS) and data access controls where required.

Power Platform & Automation

Power Automate

  • Design and implement automated business processes using Microsoft Power Automate.
  • Build workflows for approvals, notifications, data synchronisation, document processing, and operational automation.
  • Integrate Power Automate with SharePoint, Power BI, Dataverse, Microsoft 365, APIs, and enterprise systems.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual business processes and improve operational efficiency.

Power Platform

  • Contribute to the design and implementation of solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem.
  • Support integration between Power Apps, Power BI, data platforms, and backend systems.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with governance standards.

Solution Design & Architecture

Solution Ownership

  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.
  • Design end-to-end architectures for data ingestion, transformation, storage, reporting, and automation solutions.
  • Develop high-level and low-level solution designs for complex technical initiatives.
  • Evaluate architectural trade-offs related to performance, scalability, security, reliability, and cost.

System Design

  • Design enterprise-scale data platforms and distributed systems.
  • Develop integration patterns for APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native solutions.
  • Define non-functional requirements including:Scalability
  • Performance
  • Availability
  • Reliability
  • Security
  • Maintainability
  • Observability

Participate in architecture reviews, design reviews, and technical governance activities.Problem Solving & Debugging Excellence

Complex Problem Resolution

  • Lead analysis and resolution of complex technical challenges across data platforms and applications.
  • Apply strong analytical thinking and systems-thinking approaches to troubleshoot issues.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into actionable technical solutions.

Debugging & Root Cause Analysis

  • Investigate and resolve issues across Data Pipelines, Power BI Reports, Dashboards, Database Platforms, Cloud Services, APIs and Integrations, and ETL/ELT Processes.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement long-term corrective actions.
  • Identify recurring issues and implement preventive engineering improvements.
  • Develop monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies to proactively identify potential failures.

Performance Optimisation

  • Optimise SQL queries, ETL workloads, Power BI datasets, data models, and reporting solutions.
  • Improve scalability, throughput, and performance of enterprise data platforms.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements.

Cloud & Modern Data Technologies

Cloud Platforms

  • Design and develop cloud-based data solutions leveraging modern cloud technologies.
  • Support cloud migration, modernisation, and optimisation initiatives.
  • Implement secure and scalable cloud-native data architectures.

Preferred Cloud Knowledge

  • AWS or Azure
  • Snowflake
  • Databricks

Responsibilities

  • Design highly available and fault-tolerant solutions.
  • Support infrastructure automation and cloud governance initiatives.
  • Implement secure storage, processing, and access patterns.
  • Optimise cloud cost, performance, and operational efficiency.

Technology Exploration & Innovation

Emerging Technologies

  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, tools, frameworks, and industry trends.
  • Research modern data engineering, analytics, automation, AI, and cloud platforms.
  • Conduct Proof of Concepts to assess business value and technical feasibility.

Innovation

  • Explore new tools, frameworks, and engineering practices that improve productivity and scalability.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, operational efficiency, and technical simplification.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across engineering teams.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Data Engineers.
  • Support design discussions, code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities.
  • Promote engineering standards, best practices, and consistent delivery approaches.

Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, Data Scientists, Infrastructure Teams, and Business Stakeholders.
  • Help prioritise work, remove technical blockers, and support successful project execution.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.

What you will have

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 10-14 years of experience in data engineering, data analysis, or software development.

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience on advanced SQL any Database. (Oracle, Teradata, snowflake).
  • Experience in data integration area and hands on experience in any of the ETL tools like Datastage , Informatica , Snaplogic etc.
  • Able to transform technical requirements into data collection query.
  • Should be capable of working with business and other IT teams and convert the requirements into queries.
  • Good understanding of ETL architecture and design.
  • Good knowledge in Databases, SQL, or PL/SQL
  • Good experience with CI/CD tools such as Github Actions (AzDO pipelines)
  • Good to have knowledge on Unix commands
  • Good to have an experience on AWS Glue
  • Good to have knowledge on Qlik replication tool
  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.
  • Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST

Data Engineering

  • Advanced SQL and database development expertise.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python for data engineering and automation.
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT architecture, data integration, and modern data engineering patterns.
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake, Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Teradata, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with integration platforms such as AWS Glue, SnapLogic, Informatica, DataStage, or equivalent tools.

Power Platform & Analytics

  • Strong experience developing Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
  • Expertise in Power BI DAX, data modelling, report optimisation, and visualisation design.
  • Experience with Power Automate workflow development and process automation.
  • Working knowledge of the broader Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem.

Architecture & Engineering

  • Experience designing enterprise data platforms and distributed systems.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Knowledge of API integration, microservices, and modern system design principles.
  • Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, source control, and deployment automation practices.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
  • Knowledge of cloud-native architecture patterns and modern data services.
  • Understanding of security, governance, monitoring, and operational support best practices.

Leadership & Professional Competencies

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Ability to independently lead technical initiatives with minimal supervision.
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability for outcomes.

job.title: Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

The data scientist is responsible to work with massive amounts of data to develop Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence (Al) models with Telco and other sets of data to help enterprises realise key business value through the use of Telco Insights. The data scientist works closely with key internal and external stakeholders to develop new Al products or new application areas for Al.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Architect scalable Agentic AI systems using multi-agent architectures that can autonomously plan, decide, and execute tasks, integrating with enterprise data, APIs, and business workflows to support internal and external
  • Design and develop next generation of scalable Telco Big Data Analytics Models to support commercial projects across various business verticals.
  • Propose and design effective analytical approaches taking into consideration performance and scalability to large datasets, adhering to best practices for model development, and perform unit and system testing to validate the results of the analytics models.
  • Constantly review and ensure that current methodology conforms and meets industry standards.
  • Propose and develop new analytics models and innovative techniques and algorithms to enhance SmartHub capabilities and value proposition of Telco Big Data.
  • Independently develop solutions that adopt and leverage on latest AI/ML models including GenAI and LLM to deliver exceptional value to internal/external stakeholders.
  • Participate and contribute to stakeholders' requirement gatherings sessions, co-creation workshops to size up stakeholders' problem statements and formulate and review best approaches to analytic solutions and models.
  • Lead the technical collaboration with industry or research institutes to propose new potential areas for collaboration..

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Analytics or related disciplines, along with at least 3 years of relevant experience in Big Data analytics application development OR Master’s degree or PhD in computer science or related disciplines
  • Experience with Business Intelligence Visualization (e.g. Tableau, AWS QuickSight)
  • Experience in presentation to stakeholders to articulate business values for analytical/data science projects
  • Experience in the following Big Data technologies: PySpark, Kafka
  • Programming experience in one or preferably more of the following languages: Python, Scala
  • Experience with Cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud)
  • Exposure to real-time streaming technologies (e.g. Spark Streaming, Apache Flink)
  • Good understanding of software agile development, continues integration and deployment
  • Attention to details, a self-starter and self-learner continuously keeping up to date with industry developments
  • Creative problem solver and ability to think out of the box
  • Experience in Telco industry will be an advantage

Job details

Sr. UX Research & Usability Professional

Job ID

520427

Posted since

03-Sep-2026

Organization

Siemens Healthineers

Field of work

Experience Design

Company

Siemens Healthcare Private Limited

Experience level

Experienced Professional

Job type

Full-time

Work mode

Office/Site only

Employment type

Permanent

Location(s)

  • Bangalore - Karnataka - India

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? At Siemens Healthineers, we pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere.

We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone and grow both personally and professionally. Sound interesting?

Then come and join our global Design and User Experience Community as a Sr. UX Research & Usability Professional (UXR) to generate actionable user insights, evaluate usability, and inform evidence-based design decisions, driving design excellence and fostering the continuous evolution of digital healthcare solutions.

As part of our team, you will work on next-generation healthcare solutions for healthcare professionals, patients, and customers. Supported by a collaborative global UX community, you will partner with cross-functional teams to create impactful digital experiences and improve healthcare outcomes through the power of human-centred design.

Please upload your portfolio with your application.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

As a Senior User Research & Usability Professional , you will play a key role in shaping end-to-end healthcare experiences across digital solutions, products, and platforms, helping healthcare professionals work more efficiently and effectively.

In this role, you will be responsible for working across all stages of UX research and usability evaluation: identifying, planning, driving, conducting, analysing, and reporting research insights, while building an in depth understanding of users within the context of the business and product portfolio.

  • Work closely with cross functional teams (UX, Product, Engineering, Clinical, Quality, Regulatory, and Business) to identify and evaluate research topics and clearly communicate research findings that increase empathy, inform decisions, and meet product evaluation criteria for usability, safety, and effectiveness.
  • Conduct UX research and usability evaluation activities to inform requirements, evaluate concepts, and assess the usefulness and usability of products and services at formative and summative stages.
  • Create and execute usability evaluation plans in compliance with the Quality Management System (QMS) and applicable standards, aligning usability activities with project and business objectives.
  • Apply a wide range of qualitative and quantitative research methods (e.g., generative research, task based usability testing, surveys, benchmarking) to understand and validate user needs, balancing business, technical, and regulatory requirements, and conducting research both in person and remotely.
  • Contribute to risk management oriented usability evaluation, including identifying use related risks and supporting mitigation strategies, to help ensure patient safety and regulatory compliance.
  • Responsible for producing clear, audit ready usability documentation, including research plans, protocols, study reports, and traceability of findings to design decisions and risk controls.
  • Represent user needs throughout the product development lifecycle, ensuring user insights are reflected in product direction and strategic decision-making.
  • Contribute to a strong UX culture by championing design quality, fostering collaboration, and driving the continuous improvement of healthcare experiences across our global design organization.

Your qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Factors, Cognitive Psychology, Social Sciences, HCI, Computer Science, Usability Engineering, or a related field focused on human behavior.
  • 7+ years of professional experience in UX research and usability evaluation/engineering. Experience in the medical technology or healthcare domain is strongly preferred.
  • Proven expertise in Usability Evaluation and a thorough understanding of IEC standards (e.g., IEC 62366) and human factors principles.
  • Hands-on experience with medical device development, FDA clearance/approval processes, and/or regulated product documentation. Demonstrated ability to plan, conduct, and formally document formative and summative usability studies
  • Proven experience collaborating with product, design, engineering, and regulatory teams to translate research findings into product requirements, design improvements, and usability risk mitigations.

Your attributes and skills

  • A user-centered mindset with deep expertise in usability, human factors, and user centered design applied to complex healthcare systems.
  • Proven ability to plan, conduct, and synthesize usability research, translating insights into actionable design and risk mitigation recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare workflows, clinical contexts, and patient safety considerations, with hands on experience working within regulated environments and the ability to produce clear, audit ready documentation.
  • Comfort working in cross functional and multidisciplinary environments, with a detail oriented and methodical approach that balances rigor with pragmatism in fast moving product teams.

Your Mindset

  • Forward-thinking and quality-driven mindset: A forward thinking UX research and usability practitioner who drives evidence based decision making through close collaboration. You position usability as a critical input to product quality and safety. You anticipate usability risks and advocate for user needs with clear, data backed rationale in cross functional discussions
  • Collaborative ownership mindset: You demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and initiative in problem solving, confidently aligning UX and usability strategies with business goals. You balance user needs with business realities to drive impactful, innovative solutions. As part of our team, you will work on next-generation healthcare solutions for healthcare professionals, patients, and customers. Supported by a collaborative global UX community, you will partner with cross-functional teams to create impactful digital experiences and improve healthcare outcomes through the power of human-centred design.

Please upload your portfolio with your application.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

As a Senior Interaction Designer, you will shape digital solutions, workflows, and interaction models for healthcare products across a variety of platforms, helping healthcare professionals work more efficiently and effectively.

In this role, you will design and evolve innovative digital healthcare solutions, contributing to their continuous improvement and development.

  • Create and iterate low- and high-fidelity prototypes in collaboration with UX researchers, designers, product managers, developers, and business stakeholders, incorporating continuous feedback throughout the design process.
  • Optimize user interactions to improve usability, reduce complexity, and deliver seamless user experiences while providing clear design specifications for implementation.
  • Continuously develop and refine interaction design patterns, applying your expertise across various technologies, including micro-interactions, transitions, and animations.
  • Partner with UX researchers to translate user insights into meaningful design solutions and implementation-ready specifications.
  • Represent user needs throughout the product development lifecycle, applying human-centered design methods to inform product decisions.
  • Contribute to a strong UX culture by championing design quality, fostering collaboration, and driving the continuous improvement of healthcare experiences across a global, cross-functional team.

Your qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in user experience design, human-computer interaction, or a related field
  • A strong portfolio showcasing your interaction design craftsmanship, systems thinking, and problem-solving skills across complex digital experiences.
  • 7+ years of experience in Interaction Design, Information Architecture, User Experience Design, or a related discipline.
  • Proficiency in design tools such as Figma and a willingness to explore new tools and technologies that enhance design outcomes and team effectiveness.
  • Proven experience partnering with software development teams, creating implementation-ready design specifications, and conducting design quality reviews to ensure accurate implementation and adherence to design system standards.
  • Experience in medical technology is a plus; curiosity and willingness to dive deep into complex clinical workflows are even more important.

Your attributes and skills

  • A user-centered mindset with strong interaction design and problem-solving skills, capable of transforming complex user needs and workflows into intuitive, efficient experiences.
  • Expertise in interaction modeling, information architecture, and prototyping, with a passion for usability, design quality, and attention to detail throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to advocate for user needs and align designers, researchers, developers, product managers, and stakeholders around a shared vision.
  • A proactive and collaborative team player who contributes to a strong UX culture, drives design excellence, and continuously seeks opportunities to improve healthcare experiences through human-centred design.

Your Mindset

  • Forward-thinking and quality-driven mindset: You stay curious, bring fresh ideas, and understand how exceptional interaction design contributes to outstanding product experiences and business success.
  • Collaborative ownership mindset: You build strong partnerships across disciplines, take ownership of design outcomes, and are committed to quality from initial concept through final implementation.
  • Continuous learning mindset: You actively seek opportunities to learn, stay current with emerging UX & Interaction design practices, and continuously develop your skills to enhance your impact on the team.

Radiologist

Job Description

The Medical Imaging Technology team of Siemens Healthcare Technology Center has an immediate opening in Princeton, NJ for an experienced Chest Radiologist to join our multidisciplinary team focused on advancing AI-based solutions in medical imaging. The ideal candidate will bring clinical expertise in thoracic imaging and play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and deployment of AI-driven diagnostic tools. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of clinical radiology and cutting-edge technology, contributing to the future of AI in healthcare.

What are my responsibilities?

  • Collaborate with data scientists, AI engineers, and clinical teams to develop algorithms for automated detection, diagnosis, and quantification of thoracic diseases (e.g., lung cancer, pneumonia, interstitial lung disease) in medical imaging.
  • Lead the clinical validation efforts for AI models by evaluating algorithm performance, ensuring diagnostic accuracy, and comparing AI outputs against radiologist interpretation.
  • Provide expert annotations and guidance on chest imaging datasets to improve AI model training. Ensure the quality and consistency of labeled datasets used in AI development.
  • Work with AI developers to refine algorithms, providing clinical feedback on areas for improvement and offering suggestions to enhance diagnostic performance.
  • Assist in integrating AI solutions into radiology workflows, ensuring tools are user-friendly, efficient, and improve clinical outcomes.

What do I need to qualify for this job?

  • Education: Doctor of Medicine (MD) degree with board certification in Diagnostic Radiology. Fellowship training in Chest or Thoracic Imaging is required.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in chest imaging, with a strong background in diagnosing pulmonary and thoracic conditions. Experience in AI development, clinical research, or advanced imaging techniques is highly desirable.
  • Technical Skills: Familiarity with AI applications in medical imaging, including automated segmentation, classification, and detection algorithms. Experience with AI platforms, machine learning models, and medical imaging software is a plus.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Brisbane South
job.description:
Beenleigh, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for a vibrant and motivated Casual and Part-Time Retail Service Consultant to join our Beenleigh team. If you love helping people, thrive in being a part of a supportive crew, and bring positive energy to every interaction, then we’d love to have you on board!

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other.

What you’ll do:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Explore our range of tech products and services, and share your knowledge in a way that’s simple, helpful and accessible.
  • Bring your personality and charm to uncover customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Work as one team, crafting a warm, welcoming environment where customers feel supported and memorable moments happen.

What you bring:

  • Service Superpower: You know how to understand customer needs, deliver genuine support, and let phenomenal service drive fantastic outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers make sense of tech by breaking things down simply and guiding them to the right solutions.
  • Problem Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You’re confident in navigating difficult enquiries, ease tricky situations with empathy and respect, and work toward the best solution for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support one another, stay accountable, and create a customer‑first environment where everyone succeeds.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and access to exclusive discounts.
  • Phenomenal perks, including 25% off Optus products and exclusive access to unique discounts with our retail partners.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, available 24/7 across multiple channels.
  • Flexible rosters that work around the life you live outside of work.

Intrigued, but not sure you tick every box? That’s completely okay! We still encourage you to apply. We all grow, learn and develop together, and this role might be the perfect next step in your career journey.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)
