job.title: IT Service Delivery Leader - Senior (SAP EWM)
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for the management, operations, delivery and support of defined IT applications and/or infrastructure services; directs and coordinates the efforts of people to accomplish goals and objectives using available resources.

Key Responsibilities

Contributes to the delivery and support of specific IT services. Supports the development and maintenance of services and ensures that tools and resources are capable and available (i.e. IT Service Catalog, Asset Management system) Generates and reports service delivery metrics and drives standards across regions and locations (i.e. Scorecards, Service Level Agreement (SLAs) and Customer Satisfaction or Net Promoter Scoring). Acts as a point of contact for customers for service related inquiries and maintains relationships with key customers and suppliers. Is familiar with SLA / Operational Level Agreements between other IT Services Provided. Encourages root cause analysis using the formal problem solving approach for recurring issues. Champions the use of Six Sigma to reduce costs and improve processes. Identifies opportunities for service improvements, discuss with the customer and raise the request for change for assessment if appropriate Maintains the accuracy of service related standards, procedures and work instructions in a knowledge management system. Able to support the Service Owner when needed. Champions the use of ITIL Standards for IT Service Deliverables Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.

Competencies:

Financial acumen - Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

IT Supplier Relationships - Leverages a vendor management framework to manage strategic supplier relationships and supplier performance based on business need throughout the contract life using the required processes and tools to control costs, drive service excellence, mitigate risks, and gain increased value from the suppliers.

Request Fulfillment - Manages a service request through its life cycle with efficiency and professionalism using the required processes and tools to maintain customer satisfaction.

Service Asset and Configuration Management - Manages service assets and configuration items by maintaining accurate configuration records to support other service management processes with documented and verifiable information.

Service Catalog Management - Maintains a service catalog that contains all details of active and approved services in service operations using the required processes and tools to provide clear and relevant information to users.

Service Level Management - Ensures the quality of the services delivered meet agreed levels using the required processes and tools in order to maintain customer satisfaction.

Troubleshooting - Diagnoses and resolves the customer-identified issue by utilizing appropriate department standards to satisfy customer expectations.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level of relevant work experience required. 3-5 years of experience.

  • Owns global operational accountability for SAP S/4HANA Extended Warehouse Management, Inventory Management, and adjacent logistics capabilities.
  • Oversees warehouse process performance, inventory accuracy support, fulfillment reliability, logistics execution stability, and operational insights.
  • Partners with warehouse, distribution, supply chain, logistics, and regional operations stakeholders to improve process performance and adoption.
  • Governs incidents, problems, enhancements, and operational risks impacting warehouse execution, inventory movement, order fulfillment, and distribution operations.

Drives continuous improvement opportunities across EWM, IM, RF/mobile warehouse execution, integration touchpoints, and warehouse operations reporting.

Job Systems/Information Technology

Role Category On-site with Flexibility

Job Type Exempt - Experienced

job.title: Technical Training Instructor
job.description:
Job Summary

The Technical Training & Dealer Capability Development Specialist is responsible for supporting the design, development, and delivery of technical training programs that strengthen the capability of dealer service engineers and service network personnel. This role focuses on enhancing product knowledge, troubleshooting expertise, service quality, and customer handling skills while ensuring compliance with Cummins standards, safety requirements, and operational excellence. The position works closely with cross-functional teams and dealership partners to build a skilled service network that delivers exceptional customer support and business performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, coordinate, and deliver technical training programs for dealer service engineers and service personnel to improve product knowledge, troubleshooting capability, technical proficiency, and customer service skills.
  • Assist senior technical trainers in the preparation, delivery, and continuous improvement of classroom, virtual, and hands-on technical training programs.
  • Complete product qualification requirements and continuously develop expertise on Cummins products, systems, and technologies.
  • Update and maintain training materials, participant handouts, instructor guides, and training documentation to ensure accuracy and consistency across training centers.
  • Communicate training material updates and best practices to regional training teams and relevant stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Service, Sales, Technical Support, Engineering, and Dealer Development to align capability-building initiatives with organizational objectives.
  • Partner with dealerships to ensure the availability of qualified technical manpower and support workforce capability planning based on required skill sets.
  • Establish and implement structured technical training and certification programs to improve service engineer competency, repair quality, and troubleshooting effectiveness.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning by promoting ongoing technical development, certifications, and participation in relevant learning programs.
  • Conduct regular audits of dealership service centers to evaluate repair quality, adherence to Cummins service processes, and compliance with operational standards.
  • Ensure dealership personnel follow Cummins safety requirements, standard operating procedures, compliance guidelines, calibration requirements, and proper usage of standard service tools.
  • Support training administration activities including maintaining training records, attendance, certifications, and learning documentation.
  • Coordinate training equipment, tools, and inventory to ensure effective execution of training programs.
  • Monitor training effectiveness and identify opportunities for continuous improvement in dealer capability development initiatives.
  • Build strong relationships with dealers, customers, and internal stakeholders to enhance service capability and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technical Education, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Additional technical certifications or training qualifications are advantageous.
  • Ability to obtain any licenses required for export control or regulatory compliance, where applicable.

Skills

  • Knowledge of technical training delivery methodologies and adult learning principles.
  • Strong understanding of technical service operations, dealer network management, and capability development.
  • Ability to develop and deliver engaging technical and customer service training programs.
  • Knowledge of troubleshooting techniques, service quality standards, and repair processes.
  • Familiarity with Cummins products, systems, and service procedures is preferred.
  • Excellent presentation, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to assess training effectiveness and identify capability gaps.
  • Planning, organization, and project coordination skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and learning management systems.
  • Customer-focused approach with a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Ability to adapt training delivery to different audiences and learning environments.
  • Strong commitment to health, safety, compliance, and quality standards.

Experience

  • Minimal to early-career experience in technical training, learning and development, field service, dealer support, or a related technical function.
  • Experience assisting with training preparation, delivery, or learning administration is preferred.
  • Exposure to dealer service operations, technical support, or customer service environments is advantageous.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and external partners is desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to build technical knowledge and support capability development initiatives through training and coaching.

job.title: Digital Tech Support Analyst, Bangalore
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Description

The Digital Technical Support Analyst is responsible for monitoring overall performance of assigned digital products and handling dealer and customer issues through resolution.

JOB DUTIES

Responsibilities of the incumbents are to provide worldwide front-line customer service advisor support for the overall Cat Digital portfolio (including on-board and off-board issues).

  • Serves as a Telematics Product expert / Subject Matter Expert. Stay current with all digital products and applications.
  • Manages cases to provide an appreciated, secure and effortless experience with customers, dealers, and internal Caterpillar for every interaction.
  • Triage / Troubleshooting – also support to other agents
  • Tactical – Timely resolution and follow-up with customer & dealers
  • Issue identification – reports in all forms from customers, dealers, industry reps and subsidiaries.
  • Issue investigation – basic triage, statistical analyses, basic testing and analysis of application failures, etc.
  • Resolution of commitments – formally document issues and provide follow-up on the resolution process with dealers, customers and appropriate internal teams.
  • Manages hand-ups/escalation paths in support of daily operations.
  • Manages requests to the urgency defined by our service level agreements.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact for advisors for the lines of business the Digital /Prod Service Engineering supports.
  • Supports continuous improvement efforts.
  • Creates and updates self-service and Tier 1 support knowledge articles for digital products and applications.
  • Analyze and develop new customer service rep training or customer self-service opportunities, based on improving customer experience, preventing lost sales, churn, and solving customer issues.
  • Support Digital Product training for CSRs
  • Supports the development and maintenance of Business Rules
  • Validate and create process maps
  • Provides input to digital product and application support teams.
  • Conducts occasional dealer and customer visits to personally provide expert technical assistance on urgent field issues for digital products and applications.

Employees are also responsible for performing other job duties as assigned by Caterpillar management from time to time.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Requires a college or university degree, technical certification or equivalent experience.
  • At least 2 years of experience in technical support work

Top candidates will also have experience in the following:

  • Telematics
  • Product Link
  • Scheduled Oil Sampling (SOS)
  • VisionLink
  • Energy & Transportation (E&T)
  • Cat Remote Asset Monitoring (RAM)
  • Health and Equipment Insights (HEI)
  • Cat Advanced Productivity (AP)

Posting Dates:

September 9, 2026 - September 22, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Digital Producer
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

26 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Digital Producer

Job Summary

Job Description

As Digital Producer you will have an obsessive attention to detail that dots all the i's and crosses all the t’s, but rest assured most days at Belong won’t look the same! You will be responsible for maintaining, updating and building our web content, contributing to the development of our website at an impeccably high standard using strong expertise in accessibility, responsiveness and usability. This will be paired with a strong understanding of web and customer experience analytics, as well as the design and development of CMS (Content Management System), HTML/CSS, Information Architecture, site structure, individual page design and content creation.

As a member of the Content Experience team in the Digital team, you will support rapid growth, improve our speed to market, deliver data-driven, automated and customer centric experiences via our digital channels. You must have experience working in cross functional teams and be able to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. Reporting to the Content Experience Manager, you will have a thorough understanding of the agile and scrum framework and HCD (Human Centred Design) approach.

You are a passionate and dedicated digital who wakes up every day wanting to create world class customer experiences developing delightful products and services that people absolutely love!

About the job

You will be responsible for:

  • Working in close collaboration with your Digital Content Experience Manager , the Content experience team and the delivery squads to deliver on our strategic customer and digital experience vision aligned to our business KPIs (Key Performance Indicators)
  • Planning, scheduling and managing the digital content from draft review to publishing using our Content Management System (CMS)
  • Gathering business requirements from stakeholders and translating to world-class digital solutions
  • Proactively monitoring and testing the site to identify maintenance and experience quality improvements
  • Working as a team; supporting, communicating and collaborating with other producers
  • Collaboratively working with other teams including design, technology and product to achieve a seamless digital customer experience
  • Prioritizing and triaging content requests from internal stakeholders
  • Continually refining and enhancing our CMS to maintain hygiene and best practice standards
  • Pushing your knowledge of industry best practice including website development, and CMS production

Skills and experience:**

  • Demonstrated professional experience in digital content publishing in a media corporate, business or agency setting
  • Ability to write, edit and proof-read quality written content
  • Strong editorial judgement
  • Ability to liaise with a variety of digital disciplines, from design to development
  • Challenge the norm with confident and assertive communication skills to influence and build relationships
  • Effectively able to manage changes to scope, budget and timeline
  • Knowledge of the WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) 2.1 accessibility standards
  • Strong SEO understanding
  • Experience with Contentful would be advantageous
  • Exposure to or experience with Design Systems and regard for implementation of visual identity of brand guidelines
  • Ability to brief relevant supporting functions, such as Content Writers and Designers, in a clear and concise manner
  • Provide Quality Assurance (QA) of the solution in testing environments to ensure our design quality and customer experience expectations are met
  • Customer-first mindset!

We’re flexible

We’re all about flexibility and choice at work. Will you choose to work from home, in our office workspace, or on the go? Somewhere regional or the city? We want you to work where, when, and how you're most engaged, safe, and productive – wherever in Australia that may be.

About Belong

It feels good to bring people together.

As a telco, we’re making our world a more inclusive place. That means giving Australians the tools they need to get things done in the digital world. Oh, and we’re doing that while being 100% carbon neutral.

As an organisation, we're focused on having a customer-first mindset and delivering effortless customer experiences.

As a workplace, we’re building a community of people who bring their whole selves to work. Workplaces can be brutally bland and that’s not good for anyone. Difference makes us all better and we’re always trying to get better.

Our values

We’re here to make our world a more inclusive place. That’s reflected in our four values:

  • We care
  • We’re better together
  • We make it simple
  • We’re change makers

They help remind us that we care about the work we do and that, if we do it together, we can make our world a better place for our team and our customers.

_______

We want our people to represent the customers we serve and encourage anyone with diverse experiences and unique perspectives to apply.

Get to know what life at [Belong is like and what we value](https://www.linkedin.com/company/belong.com.au/life/).

job.title: Intern, Corporate Communication
job.description:
Job Summary

As a Corporate Communications Intern at PCL, you will support both internal and external communications programs, gaining hands‑on experience in digital content creation, event coordination, and media relations. You will work closely with our communications team to deliver high‑impact messaging that reinforces our brand and engages key stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Digital & Offline Content: Assist in drafting, editing, and publishing communication materials, including social media posts, newsletters, press releases, infographics, and presentation decks.
  • Internal Communications Support: Help curate employee communications—town hall presentations, intranet articles, and email campaigns—to keep staff informed and motivated.
  • External Publicity: Support the creation of marketing collateral and media kits; conduct basic media outreach and maintain media contact lists.
  • Video Production: Aid in the planning, filming, and post‑production editing of short videos for internal comms and external marketing.
  • Event Coordination: Organize and execute internal and external events, including employee engagement events (e.g., Town Hall, roadshows) and stakeholder briefings; prepare materials, manage RSVPs, and handle on‑site logistics.

Key Requirements

  • Bachelors in Maritime Studies, Communications, Media, or equivalent
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Chinese is a plus.
  • Has interest in Communications and creating engaging storytelling content for different audiences
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks under tight deadlines.
  • Familiarity with basic video editing tools and design platforms (e.g., Canva).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Being AI Native is a plus
  • Positive attitude, proactive mindset, and eagerness to elevate skills proficiency in corporate setting

job.title: Foreman, Piping
job.description:
Job Summary

  • Plan & execute trade job task as per specification with safety, quality and productivity in ship building and ship repair.
  • Prepare micro schedule, manhour loading, materials take off and monitor the work.
  • Perform duty in the most productive method.
  • Planning to ensure instructions regarding work requirements are relayed from the appropriate documents (Specifications, tender, work instructions, procedure, manuals)\
  • Implement & follow up with operators to ensure compliance of productivity, quality, environment, occupational health, and safety requirements.
  • Co-ordinate simultaneously with supervisory staff of different trade and projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Read & understand technical specifications, prepare job list, work schedule, plan materials take off and manpower planning of yard men & contractor for each given job.
  • Order the materials required as per materials take off and co-ordinate with purchase department for timely delivery of the materials.
  • Plan out and prepare all permit to work system related to marine safety, prepare risk analysis (RA), conduct RA briefing before starting work.
  • Conduct morning RA briefing with foreman and workers generic and critical activities briefing in workplace to identify and eliminate the hazards.
  • Carry out daily toolbox talk.
  • Demonstrate excellent organizational skill, following polices, safe work procedures, work practice and developing improvements where necessary.
  • Plan & prepare tools, equipment, transportation, materials and manpower, control manhour for all given jobs.
  • Ensure workers or contractors understand and implement the work plan, by explaining and engaging in pro-active communication with them.
  • Understand all given jobs, supervise, and give detail instruction to subordinates and contractors.
  • Cooperate with SRM, owner rep & other trade supervisors on appropriate procedures and ensure job to be completed smoothly & on schedule.
  • Ensure safety, discipline, and welfare for all subordinates.
  • Ensure all work completion reports have been made & signed by owner rep and submit to commercial dept on time.
  • Ensure subcontractor work order to be raised immediately once confirmation of job by owner representative.
  • Maintain good housekeeping and safety at all the time onboard vessel & workshop. Ensure all workers follow safe work procedure all the time.
  • To attend VSCC meeting to report progress on daily basis, in the absence of Supervisor.
  • Responsible for minimum wastage of materials and balance materials to accounted and returned to store at the end of the project.
  • Liaising with Supervisor / Engineer and Manager to solve the problem and decision making for on-site issues.
  • Contribute Idea to improve working method.
  • Ensure permit to work system is followed strictly.
  • Co-ordinate with project manager/Engineers, owner rep., other trade supervisory staff as well as internally in the department with work preparation, fabrication and materials control.
  • Co-ordinate for resources from shop, other trade, as the case may be.

Key Requirements

  • 3 Years above with relevant working experience
  • Good computer leadership and communication skills.
  • Able to read and understand Piping specification, P & ID drawing.
  • Good Knowledge of pipe fitting and pipe welding.
  • Experience in working on new building or repair vessel inclusive of materials take off and Project Management.
  • Able to read and interpret technical Drawings, plan tools / equipment / materials take off, prepare project schedule and input manpower loading.
  • Able to manage people & must be willing to support other trades.

Education

Trade School in Engineering

job.title: Head of Design
job.description:
Job Summary

The Head of Design leads the engineering design function for data centre developments, overseeing the design of MEP plus CSA infrastructure, and related systems across new-build, retrofit, and expansion projects. This role owns design standards, leads a team of design engineers or technical specialists, and works closely with project delivery teams to deliver reliable, efficient, and scalable data centre facilities.

Key Responsibilities

Design Leadership

  • Lead the end-to-end design process for data centre projects, from concept through detailed design, construction support, and commissioning handover.
  • Own and continuously improve design standards, specifications, and basis-of-design documents.
  • Review and approve designs, calculations, and drawings prepared by internal teams or external consultants / contractors.
  • Drive design optimization from energy efficiency, reliability, modularity, speed to build with considerations of customer requirements as well as cost to build across all projects.
  • Continuously explore the latest technologies on the market and support internal design & innovation projects.
  • Lead internal standardisation initiative covering not only design related documents but also project management, construction management, commissioning management & etc., which are supported by relevant discipline leads.

Team Management

  • Build, mentor, and manage a team of design engineers and coordinate with external design consultants.
  • Set performance goals, conduct reviews, and support career development of direct reports.
  • Allocate resources across multiple concurrent projects and manage workload and priorities.

Technical Oversight

  • Evaluate and select power and cooling technologies appropriate to project requirements and industry trends (including AI/high-density rack cooling).
  • Evaluate and select appropriate construction method from CSA side to project requirements as well as customers’ standards.
  • Review vendor equipment selections, capacity calculations, etc.
  • Lead value engineering exercises to balance cost, reliability, and schedule.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate closely with project delivery teams to ensure integrated design delivery.
  • Liaise with clients, consultants, contractors, and regulatory bodies on design related matters.
  • Work with operations/facilities teams to ensure designs support maintainability and operational requirements.

Project & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage design timelines, budgets, and deliverables across multiple sites/projects.
  • Present design solutions and technical recommendations to senior leadership and clients.
  • Ensure compliance with local codes, standards (e.g., ASHRAE, Uptime Institute, TIA-942, LEED & etc.), and sustainability / energy regulations.

Key Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (or related discipline); Master's degree a plus.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent chartered engineer status preferred.

Experience

  • 10+ years of mechanical engineering design experience, with at least 5 years focused on mission-critical facilities or data centres.
  • 3+ years in leadership/managerial capacity overseeing a design team.
  • Proven track record delivering mechanical design for hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data centre projects.
  • Experience working with end users, EPC contractors, MEP consultants, and OEM equipment vendors.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of HVAC/cooling systems: CRAH/CRAC units, chillers, cooling towers, air/water-side economisers, liquid cooling & etc.
  • Familiarity Power distribution systems: HV/LV, generator, UPS, battery & etc.
  • Understanding of data centre redundancy topologies (N, N+1, N+2, 2N) and Uptime Institute Tier standards.
  • Understanding of energy efficiency metrics (PUE, WUE) and sustainability considerations.
  • Proficiency with design tools (AutoCAD, Revit/BIM, CFD modelling software).
  • Working knowledge of relevant codes and standards (ASHRAE TC9.9, local mechanical/building codes, fire & life safety requirements as they relate to mechanical systems).

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Strong people management and team-building capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills are required to establish effective and transparent communication channels.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, able to engage both technical and executive audiences.
  • Strong project management skills; able to manage multiple concurrent design projects.
  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset with attention to detail.

Others

  • Willingness to travel to project sites as required.
  • Experience in a fast-paced, growth-stage data centre or hyperscale environment is highly valued.

Bachelors in Electrical Engineering

Masters in Mechanical Engineering or Others

job.title: Manager, Diving
job.description:
Responsibilities

Overall Diving Operations:

  • Ensure project diving activities are in line with PS QHSE Management System and local regulations.
  • Oversee diving operations at different worksites for reliable assets, equipment, and trained personnel.
  • Lead and promote compliance with Diving operational procedures across offshore teams.
  • Expand IMCA compliance across regions using improvement plans.
  • Lead IMCA-based competency scheme for diving personnel.
  • Review and implement project diving plans on offshore worksites.
  • Promote equipment and process improvements, including safety-related items.
  • Lead Innovation in process, execution and documentation for enhancing safety and productivity.
  • Liaise with customers for project feedback and lessons learned, ensuring dissemination.
  • Ensure good communication and interfacing with Marine division.

Safety and Quality Assurance:

  • Review newly developed or revised QHSE programs.
  • Share lessons learned across the organization from various projects or worksites.
  • Audit risk assessments, management of change, and competency records during operations.
  • Manage diving-related incidents according to PS procedures, PS-QHSE-PRO-011 Incident and Near Miss
  • Reporting & Investigation Procedure and a root cause analysis is carried out on all high potential incidents.
  • Communicate employees' "STOP WORK Authority" responsibility without reprimand.
  • Demonstrate personal commitment to an incident-free work environment and expect the same commitment

from the organization.

Medical Emergencies:

  • Ensure awareness of communication protocols for diving medical emergencies on vessels and worksites.
  • Maintain communication with Diving Medical Advisor service provider for compliance and updates.
  • Coordinate with Diving Medical Advisor and OCS during emergencies.

Accountability

  • Overseeing diving operations with a focus on safety, compliance, and quality.
  • Ensuring that all diving activities align with QHSE regulations and procedures, overseeing operations at

various sites and enforcing IMCA compliance.

  • Implementing diving plans, advocating for equipment improvements, and fostering communication with

client.

Qualification / Experience

  • Bachelor’s / master’s degree or Diploma certificate in management and / or engineering fields
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in offshore oil and gas subsea construction industry in supervisory positions both onshore & offshore.
  • Air / Sat diving IMCA approved certification.

job.title: Team Lead, Post Fixture
job.description:
Job Summary

The Post Fixture Team Lead will oversee the full lifecycle of vessel operations following the conclusion of a fixture. This role requires a strategic leader to manage a team, optimize voyage P&L, and ensure strict compliance with Charter Party (C/P) terms. You will be the primary point of contact for complex disputes and the lead expert for the company's IMOS commercial management system.

This role entails overseeing all Post fixture duties right from the time when a vessel is fixed on a voyage or time charter basis till the completion of the voyage and settling of all accounts with charterers or Owners. Liaising closely with Operations, Commercial & Finance departments for successful execution of this role.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Execution & IMOS Management

  • Oversee the entry and maintenance of all fixture data into IMOS, ensuring 100% accuracy for financial reporting and voyage tracking.
  • Monitor vessel schedules, and off-hire events within the system.
  • Liaise with IT/Operations/Commercial/ Finance teams to implement IMOS workflow improvements.

Post-Fixture Management

  • Manage end-to-end post-fixture activities for time charter and voyage charter contracts.
  • Manage the issuance of hire/freight invoices and oversee the diligent collection of Accounts Receivable (AR).
  • Sending out notices of delivery / redelivery as per CP.
  • Sending notices of arrival to voyage charterers as per booking / fixture note requirement.
  • To supervise and perform complex Laytime/Demurrage calculations and lead negotiations for final settlements.
  • Ensure compliance with charter party terms and identify any contractual risks.
  • Review Vendor invoices, Proforma Disbursement Accounts (PDA) and Final Disbursement Accounts (FDA) to maximize voyage earnings.
  • Liaise with brokers, charterers/ owners, agents and vendors to make arrangements for timely charter hires/ SOAs, PDA / FDA/ vendor invoice arrangements as per company’s requirements
  • Track and report voyage results and deviations to management.
  • Optimize resource utilization and propose strategies to enhance operational efficiency

##

Documentation & Compliance

  • Create and /or update vendor details (Owner/Charterer/Agent/Supplier) in MDG for approval and timely payments. Conduct proper sanction check for vendor in line with Risk Management's requirements.
  • Preparing voyage Charter Parties based on the main term recap and proforma CP
  • Maintain accurate records of voyage documentation and file vessel-wise promptly in Sharepoint folders.
  • LOI logs creation and filing.

Key Requirements

  • Experience: Min. 8 to 10 years of direct experience in a post-fixture role within the shipping industry, with at least 3 years supervising 2-3 team members.
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced, hands-on experience with IMOS (Veson Nautical) is mandatory. Familiarity with other shipping platforms (e.g., Shipnet, Diabos) is an advantage.
  • Contractual Knowledge: Good understanding of maritime law, C/P clauses, and international shipping regulations.
  • Skills: Strong negotiation, analytical, and communication skills to manage diverse stakeholders including Owners, Charterers, and Brokers.
  • Education: Diploma/Degree in Maritime Studies or related field

job.title: Superintendent, HSSEQ
job.description:
Job Summary

To provide proactive HSSEQ leadership and operational assurance for a defined segment of the marine fleet. The Superintendent acts as the critical link between the Head HSSEQ and vessel-level HSSEQ Managers, ensuring consistent implementation of the Integrated Management System (IMS) across all assigned vessels, driving performance improvement, and ensuring full compliance with ISM, ISPS, MLC, MARPOL, ISO 45001, 14001, and 9001.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic & Operational Oversight (Segment Level)

  • Segment Performance Ownership: Accountable for all HSSEQ KPIs (TRIR, LTIF, near-miss reporting rate, audit closure rates, environmental incidents) across assigned fleet segment.
  • Risk Profiling: Maintain a live risk register for the segment (geographic, operational, asset-specific) – e.g., heavy weather routes, piracy-prone areas, client-specific HSSE requirements.
  • Fleet Assurance Schedule: Plan and execute a rolling program of announced and unannounced vessel visits, safety inspections, ISM internal audits, and ISPS security assessments (minimum 1 visit per vessel per 6 months).

Management of Offshore HSSEQ Managers & Vessel Leadership

  • Direct Support & Coaching: Provide technical guidance and performance feedback to Offshore HSSEQ PIC and Masters regarding incident investigation, PTW audits, safety culture interventions, and client HSSE interface.
  • Competency Assurance: Verify that all offshore HSSEQ PIC and vessel safety officers meet segment-specific competency requirements (e.g., DP familiarization, heavy-lift, anchor handling safety).
  • Succession Planning: Identify high-potential offshore HSSE talent for promotion within the segment.

Incident Management & Investigation (Segment Level)

  • Lead or escalate high-potential (HiPo) incidents, LTI, and major environmental breaches across the segment, ensuring consistent use of investigation methodology (e,g. TapRooT / 5-Why).
  • Review all incident reports from vessels before submission to the Head HSSEQ – ensure root causes and systemic corrective actions are identified.
  • Track corrective action closure rates across the segment and escalate overdue actions.

Client & Third-Party Interface (Segment-Specific)

  • Act as the primary HSSEQ point of contact for client HSSE teams within the segment (e.g., major oil companies, NOCs).
  • Lead client pre-qualification and tender responses for HSSE sections – present segment performance data during client audits.
  • Coordinate joint safety campaigns and client-led verification visits on assigned vessels

Compliance & Assurance (ISM / ISPS / MLC)

  • Serve as alternate or designated DPA (Designated Person Ashore) for vessels within the segment (if qualified under ISM Code).
  • Monitor certificate validity (Class, Flag, Oil Major COCs, DOC extension) and advise vessels on upcoming surveys.
  • Oversee external audit readiness (Flag state, Class, Oil Major, ISO) – pre-audit vessels and debrief findings.

Environmental & Quality Performance

  • Monitor segment-level environmental metrics – carbon intensity (CII), oil-in-water exceedances, garbage segregation deviations, NOx/SOx compliance.
  • Drive ISO 14001 segment objectives (e.g., reduction in single-use plastics, improved fuel efficiency measures).
  • Review customer satisfaction feedback (quality angle) and identify systemic non-conformities across the segment.

REPORTING & ANALYTICS (Segment Dashboard)

  • Weekly: Highlight report to Head HSSEQ – significant incidents, outstanding audits, permit deviations.
  • Monthly: Segment HSSEQ Dashboard (leading/lagging, trend analysis, vessel ranking by safety observation rate).
  • Quarterly: Segment Management Review input – resource gaps, training needs, risk profile changes.
  • Ad Hoc: Root cause analysis summaries for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 process safety events (per IOGP).

Key Requirements

  • A degree in Nautical Studies, Engineering or any relevant degree.
  • COC Class 1 Master/Engineer
  • Candidates should ideally have at least 10 years of experience in operations or HSE & Quality

Certifications

job.title: Superintendent, Technical
job.description:
Job Summary

The Technical Superintendent is responsible for the technical management of assigned Multipurpose Vessels (MPVs) and Bulk Carriers engaged in worldwide tramp trading. This role is responsible for ensuring the safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operation of the assigned fleet by overseeing maintenance, repairs, statutory and Class compliance, drydockings, and technical performance.

The Technical Superintendent provides independent technical support to shipboard personnel, manages technical budgets, coordinates with shipyards, equipment makers, service providers, and suppliers, and ensures compliance with applicable international regulations and company standards.The position requires close collaboration with Classification Societies, Flag Administrations, Port State Control authorities, and other regulatory bodies to ensure compliance with SOLAS, MARPOL, ISM Code, ISPS Code, MLC, and other applicable maritime regulations. Regular overseas travel for vessel inspections, drydockings, incident investigations, and shipyard attendance is required.The successful candidate should be capable of working independently, managing multiple priorities, and performing effectively under pressure.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Management

  • Ensure assigned vessels are maintained in accordance with Company procedures, Class requirements, Flag State regulations, and applicable international and local maritime regulations (e.g. USCG, AMSA, PSC and relevant MoUs).
  • Plan, coordinate, and supervise maintenance, repairs, drydockings, retrofits, and technical projects.
  • Ensure statutory surveys, Class surveys, certifications, calibrations, and safety-critical inspections are completed on schedule.
  • Monitor vessel technical condition, machinery reliability, and operational performance to minimize off-hire and operational downtime.
  • Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to Masters and Chief Engineers for machinery failures and operational issues.
  • Ensure the Company's Planned Maintenance System (PMS) is properly implemented, maintained, and updated.

Safety, Compliance & Performance

  • Promote compliance with Company safety, environmental, and quality management systems.
  • Conduct regular vessel inspections, technical audits, and sailing visits in accordance with Company requirements and RightShip expectations.
  • Investigate technical incidents, machinery failures, and recurring defects, and ensure effective root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Monitor vessel performance, fuel efficiency, emissions, CII ratings, and other technical KPIs, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

##

Budget & Cost Control

  • Prepare and manage annual operating budgets for assigned vessels.
  • Review and control maintenance expenditure, repair costs, and technical procurement within approved budgets.
  • Evaluate quotations and recommend cost-effective technical solutions without compromising safety or reliability.

Project & Contract Management

  • Coordinate with shipyards, equipment manufacturers, service providers, and contractors during repairs, drydockings, and technical projects.
  • Support vessel acquisitions, pre-purchase inspections, vessel takeovers, newbuilding deliveries, sea trials, and guarantee claim management where required.
  • Participate in technical improvement initiatives and special projects assigned by the Company.

Leadership & People Development

  • Coach and support Masters, Chief Engineers, and shipboard engineering teams to improve technical standards and operational performance.
  • Mentor junior Technical Superintendents, Technical Executives, and Purchasing personnel where required.
  • Participate in the recruitment, interview, appraisal, and development of shipboard personnel.
  • Monitor the performance and development of assigned team members and contribute to succession planning.

Key Requirements

Professional Qualification

  • Class 1 Marine Engineer Officer (MEO Class 1) Certificate of Competency (Motor) or equivalent unlimited Chief Engineer Certificate of Competency.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree, Diploma, or equivalent qualification in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • Previous sailing experience as Chief Engineer on merchant vessels.
  • Previous experience as a Technical Superintendent is preferred.
  • Experience with MPVs, Bulk Carriers, or similar vessel types will be an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong technical knowledge of marine engineering systems and shipboard operations.
  • Good understanding of Class, Flag State, Port State Control, and international maritime regulations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
  • Good planning, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with ship staff and external stakeholders.
  • Good commercial awareness and cost control mindset.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities under pressure.
  • Willingness to travel overseas at short notice when required.

job.title: Intern, Marine & HSSEQ
job.description:
Job Summary

We are offering an internship opportunity within our Group HSSEQ Department, focused on safety communication and performance improvement across our fleet. The intern will work alongside the Safety and Training team to analyse fleet safety data, identify performance gaps and incident trends, and develop targeted safety awareness campaigns for seafarers. Day-to-day activities will include reviewing incident reports and near-miss statistics, creating campaign materials such as toolbox talk guides, safety bulletins, and infographics, and supporting the evaluation of deployed campaigns. The intern will gain hands-on exposure to maritime safety management systems and contribute directly to evidence-based initiatives that improve shipboard safety culture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare HSSEQ and Compliance related Bulletins and Newsletter under supervision.
  • Monitor, track and trend the effectiveness of campaigns and projects rolled out to crew and vessels.
  • Prepare placards/ training materials under guidance for culture and awareness enhancements of ship and shore employees.
  • Support the planning of Crisis Management & incident management
  • Support the plans and strategies for continual improvement of HSSEQ delivery.
  • Support the analysis of all HSSEQ data.
  • Monitor, track and update Marine and HSSEQ KPIs scorecard.
  • Engagement and training to support safe operations of vessels.
  • Upkeep incident and injury database.

Key Requirements

  • Bachelors in Maritime Studies
  • Strong academic background with a keen interest in health, safety, security, and environmental management in the maritime industry.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to collect, analyze, and interpret data effectively.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and take on new challenges.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

job.title: Senior Manager, Project Cost Control
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Project Cost Control, will develop, implement, and maintain the project cost control framework and management reporting for post-award selected newbuild projects in Zhoushan. This role will also ensure the timely, accurate, and complete reporting of project revenue, costs, forecasts, and financial performance to support effective project management and decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take over post-award contracts, tender documents, and bid estimates from the Commercial team to establish the project Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and develop the project as-sold budget as the baseline for project cost control.
  • Set up client revenue reporting, where required under the contract, in collaboration with the Commercial team.
  • Monitor and update actual costs incurred, work performed and committed costs on a monthly basis using the ERP system, and perform detailed cost analysis.
  • Verify that costs are correctly allocated in accordance with the WBS and ensure that actual costs and budgets are measured and reported consistently at the same WBS level.
  • Identify cost variances, analyse their causes, forecast the Estimate at Completion (EAC), and report financial performance and cost trends.
  • Establish and maintain registers for change orders, invoices, budget transfers, and cost trends, and prepare the necessary supporting documentation.
  • Identify, quantify, monitor, and develop mitigation or action plans for project risks and opportunities.
  • Prepare the Monthly Project Status Report (PMSR), detailed project cost reports, cost phasing, and other project financial analyses.
  • Conduct monthly project cost reviews to identify cost optimization opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Work closely with Commercial, Engineering, Project Management, Finance,Procurement, and Subcontract teams to ensure alignment on project cost control objectives and financial performance.
  • Promote cost awareness, financial discipline, and best practices across the project team.
  • Prepare ad hoc financial and project performance reports as required by Senior Management.
  • Participate in the implementation and continuous improvement of ERP systems and other project management tools and processes.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and mentorship to Project Cost Control personnel in the Zhoushan Yard.
  • Undertake regular business travel (expected once a quarter) to support project execution and stakeholder engagement.

Key Requirements

  • Degree Holder in Engineering or Science with exposure in maritime industry.
  • 15 years relevant working experience.
  • Proficiency in project cost control management with strong reporting and effective communication skills
  • Microsoft Office (Advanced in MS Excel, Intermediate to Advanced Word and PowerPoint) and ERP system (like SAP, Oracle etc.)
  • Good analytical skill with the ability to interpret complex data and make sound recommendation.
  • Attention to detail, accuracy, and a commitment to meeting deadlines and objectives.
  • Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Education

Bachelors in Engineering or Science

job.title: Applied AI Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

The Applied AI Engineer supports POSH's AI programme by contributing to the delivery of prioritised use cases — assisting in the development of AI agents and solutions built on the Group's enterprise AI platform. This person will develop hands-on experience across the full AI delivery lifecycle: from translating business requirements into working prototypes, to deployment and user adoption support.

This is not a purely technical role. Equal weight is placed on business engagement, user adoption, and solution delivery as on technical execution. Prior domain knowledge is not a requirement for this role. This person is expected to spend time with the various functional and operational teams in POSH — understanding how the business works, what problems matter, and what good looks like in practice — and to bring that understanding back into everything they build.

Key Responsibilities

Use Case Delivery & Business Engagement

**

  • Work with POSH business functions to understand operational workflows, identify AI opportunities, and validate that proposed solutions address the right problems.
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications and working prototypes.
  • Facilitate structured user acceptance testing sessions with operational teams. Presenting solutions, capturing feedback, and documenting gaps for iteration
  • Manage expectations proactively on timelines, data dependencies, and scope.
  • Develop HITL review interfaces and feedback mechanisms in close collaboration with domain experts.
  • Support the handover of deployed solutions to operational owners with documentation, user guides, and structured walkthroughs.

Data & System Integration

  • Assess data quality, validate schemas, and surface integration issues with the Business Excellence Team and data owners.
  • Integrate AI solutions with POSH's / Group’s enterprise systems using the integration standards and infrastructure.
  • Flag aspirational data assumptions and system-dependent dependencies early for programme-level decision

AI Agent Development

  • Configure and deploy AI agents on the enterprise platform — applying agentic design patterns including multi-agent architectures, tool-use, and autonomous workflow execution.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines for POSH-specific knowledge bases: ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector indexing, and retrieval optimisation.
  • Implement LLM integration — prompt engineering, structured output design, and iterative refinement for operational and regulatory quality standards
  • Build document processing components: OCR pipeline integration, multimodal content extraction and pre-processing for AI consumption.
  • Document and escalate platform gaps or POSH-specific requirements for COE review.

Testing, Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

  • Assist in developing and maintaining AI evaluation frameworks for POSH use cases: accuracy benchmarking, hallucination detection, retrieval quality scoring, and regression testing across model updates.
  • Conduct structured testing of agent behaviour before any production deployment, including edge cases, adversarial inputs, and failure mode analysis
  • Monitor deployed solutions; escalate anomalies promptly and support resolution with clear documentation.
  • Collaborate with the Group Data & Automation COE on platform standards and technical governance.
  • Document all agents, configurations, data schemas, and integration points to enterprise standards.

Key Requirements

Experience

  • 1-2 years of software engineering or data/AI engineering experience – including exposure to LLM-based development in any context. Internships, research attachments, and early-career roles are all considered.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one AI or ML project from concept to working output. Production deployment is advantageous but not required
  • Some experience, or a demonstrated interest in, working with non-technical users: explaining technical concepts in plain language, gathering requirements, or presenting findings.
  • Final-year graduates with strong AI project portfolios are encouraged to apply.

Essential Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Python for AI/ML pipeline development and data processing.
  • Working knowledge of LLM-based application development: RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and structured output handling.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI design patterns and orchestration frameworks – multi-agent architectures, tool-use, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Exposure to cloud-native development (Microsoft Azure preferred) and vector databases
  • Good understanding of document processing pipelines — OCR, PDF/image extraction, chunking strategies, and multimodal content handling.
  • Basic understanding of API design (REST/ async) and microservices integration.

**

Advantageous — Domain & Industry Knowledge

  • Familiarity with maritime, offshore, or similarly regulated, asset-heavy industries.
  • Exposure to compliance-driven environments where audit trails and regulatory alignment are operational necessities.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint / Microsoft 365, SAP, or equivalent enterprise platforms.

Personal Attributes

  • Curiosity: Genuinely interested in how operations work and how AI can improve them — not just in the technology itself.
  • Structured thinking: Manages concurrent tasks, communicates priorities clearly, and keeps stakeholders informed.
  • Credibility with users: Communicates clearly without jargon. Earns trust through listening and delivering solutions that fit how people actually work.
  • Ownership mindset: Takes initiative, follows through, raises blockers early — and knows when to escalate rather than proceed alone.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: Makes sound technical decisions when requirements are evolving. Moves forward pragmatically and documents assumptions.
  • Engineering rigour: Builds things others can understand, maintain, and build on. Takes documentation and testing seriously.

job.title: Automation Engineer (Marine Automation & Cloud Systems)
job.description:
Job Summary

The Automation Engineer (Marine Automation & Cloud Systems) will bridge the gap between shipboard operations and digital intelligence, and be responsible for designing and testing robust marine control and automation systems, while architecting the cloud infrastructure required to deploy advanced AI-driven solutions. The ideal candidate will possess professional or research experience across most of the technical stack—from vessel-side PLC programming and data acquisition to cloud-based analytics pipelines and intuitive web-based user interfaces.

Key Responsibilities

  • Marine Automation & Control Systems
  • Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot PLC programs for marine vessel automation systems.
  • Design and test control system modeling and simulations using MATLAB and other industry-standard simulation platforms.
  • Program and optimize Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI) to ensure intuitive operator control and real-time data visualization.
  • Cloud Architecture & AI for Performance Analytics
  • Architect and manage scalable cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or equivalent) specifically for vessel performance analytics and remote condition monitoring.
  • Deploy and maintain robust server infrastructure, databases, and data pipelines to feed AI-driven vessel performance and predictive maintenance models.
  • Software Development & Integration
  • Develop web-based graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to visualize shipboard system data and AI-derived performance insights.
  • Write efficient code in Python, Java, and C for both research-oriented prototypes and commercial-grade maritime applications.

Key Requirements

  • Degree in relevant disciplines
  • Proven experience in PLC programming and control system modeling.
  • Hands-on experience with commercial cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) and the design of data architectures.
  • Proficiency in Python, Java, and C.
  • Demonstrated experience in building web-based GUIs for data visualization.
  • Keen on maritime decarbonization, new system’s design, prototyping and validation

job.title: Senior Executive, Commercial (Modules)
job.description:
Job Summary

This role supports the preparation of competitive and commercially sound proposals for shipyard, offshore, marine, and module construction projects.

You will work closely with engineering, procurement, operations, finance, and other internal stakeholders to understand project requirements, develop cost estimates, and prepare tender submissions.

The position is suitable for both early-career candidates and experienced professionals. While relevant experience is beneficial, we place strong emphasis on analytical thinking, attention to detail, openness to new ideas, and a willingness to learn.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review client enquiries, tender documents, technical specifications, engineering drawings, and requests for quotation.
  • Prepare project scope summaries and assist management in evaluating tender opportunities.
  • Coordinate with internal departments, suppliers, and subcontractors to obtain technical inputs, quotations, labour rates, material costs, and other tender information.
  • Develop project cost estimates and pricing using established costing templates.
  • Identify cost assumptions, commercial qualifications, exclusions, risks, and opportunities associated with each tender.
  • Prepare and compile commercial and technical proposal documents in accordance with client requirements.
  • Support project prequalification submissions and ensure all required documentation is complete and submitted on time.
  • Coordinate tender clarifications with clients and internal stakeholders before and after proposal submission.
  • Maintain proper records of quotations, costing information, tender correspondence, and supporting documents.
  • Assist with tender reviews, management approvals, price revalidation, and project handover following contract award.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Engineering, Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Quantity Surveying, Business, or related discipline.
  • Candidates with relevant tendering, estimation, engineering, shipyard, construction, or commercial experience are welcome to apply.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical specifications and engineering drawings would be advantageous.
  • Comfortable working with numbers, cost information.
  • Strong analytical, organisational, communication, and time-management skills.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to coordinate effectively across multiple departments.
  • Positive learning attitude, commercial awareness, and openness to new ideas and working methods.
  • Able to manage multiple tender deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willing to travel overseas when required.

Education

Diploma in Engineering or Marine Engineering

Bachelors in Engineering or Naval Architect

job.title: Engineer, Quality Systems
job.description:
Job Summary

This role ensures ISO 9001:2015 compliance by maintaining and improving the QMS, managing audits, training staff, analysing quality data, and addressing nonconformities. It includes overseeing KPIs, customer satisfaction, subcontractor performance, and continuous improvement initiatives while collaborating across departments to adapt the QMS to business needs and drive operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support the maintenance of ISO 9001:2015 certification by ensuring full compliance with applicable standards, corporate requirements, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Develop, review, update, and continuously improve QMS documents to ensure alignment with ISO 9001 requirements, best practices, and group-wide standardization across sister yards.
  • Manage the nonconformity reporting process, ensuring root cause analysis is conducted, corrective actions are implemented effectively, and closure is achieved within the defined timeframe.
  • Conduct QMS induction briefings for new employees and deliver quality-related training programs to enhance employee awareness, competency, and compliance with QMS requirements.
  • Prepare Management Review presentation materials, perform data analysis on quality performance indicators, and prepare meeting minutes. Follow up on action items and ensure timely closure with clear accountability.
  • Prepare and analyse monthly QS reports, identify key quality trends and recurring issues, and coordinate with relevant departments to implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage departmental KPI reporting, verify performance data accuracy, analyse trends, and follow up with departments to ensure performance targets are achieved and improvement actions are implemented.
  • Monitor Customer Satisfaction Questionnaire (CSQ) results, analyse feedback, identify improvement opportunities, and coordinate corrective actions to enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Oversee in-house calibration records and ensure measuring and test equipment (e.g., micrometres, pressure gauges) are properly calibrated, maintained, and compliant with calibration schedules and requirements.
  • Conduct subcontractor and supplier qualification audits, evaluate performance, and monitor ongoing compliance with quality requirements.
  • Collaborate with departments to identify, review, and update risks, opportunities, and interested party requirements to ensure the QMS remains effective and aligned with business objectives.
  • Actively participate in and support continuous improvement initiatives, quality improvement projects, and operational excellence programs.
  • Perform any other duties, as assigned by superior.

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Quality Management System (QMS), preferably in the maritime or engineering industry.
  • Experience in developing and maintaining procedures and work instructions.
  • Experience in conducting internal quality audits and follow-up on corrective actions.
  • Experience in root cause analysis, CAPA, and nonconformity management.
  • Experience in data analysis and identifying improvement opportunities.
  • Experience in continuous improvement activities.

Education

Bachelors in Engineering or Industrial and System Engineering

The role sets TA strategy and governance, leads the recruitment team, strengthens employer branding and candidate experience, and partners with business leaders on workforce planning and people priorities to support business growth.

Talent Acquisition Leadership & Strategy (Primary Focus)

  • Own POSH's end-to-end talent acquisition strategy, translating business growth plans into a proactive, scalable hiring roadmap across functions and levels.
  • Collaborate with business leaders and senior stakeholders to understand workforce requirements and align TA strategies with long-term organizational objectives.
  • Lead the end-to-end recruitment process — sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding — ensuring a smooth, efficient, and high-quality experience for candidates and hiring managers, with direct ownership of senior and critical hires.
  • Oversee onboarding processes to ensure a smooth transition for new hires, aligning them quickly with business operations, expectations, and culture.
  • Build and maintain a proactive pipeline of qualified talent for current and future roles, with particular focus on key capabilities and niche skill sets relevant to POSH's operations.
  • Define recruitment metrics and dashboards; use recruitment data and performance insights to inform decision-making, improve sourcing effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement in time-to-fill, quality-of-hire, and cost-per-hire.
  • Strengthen POSH's visibility and positioning in the talent market through employer branding initiatives, campus and industry partnerships, social/digital presence, and candidate engagement strategies.
  • Manage relationships with recruitment agencies, job boards, and other external partners; own the TA budget and ensure cost-effective, high-quality hiring outcomes.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing TA team; set clear goals, coach on sourcing and interviewing best practices, and instill a culture of speed, quality, and candidate-centricity.

HR Business Partnering (Secondary Focus)

  • Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, providing HR guidance on organization design, workforce planning, and people strategy that supports business objectives.
  • Support the broader employee lifecycle beyond hiring, including engagement, retention, and performance management alignment, in coordination with the wider HR team.
  • Provide guidance to managers and employees on HR policies, processes, and employee relations matters, escalating and resolving issues as appropriate.
  • Partner with HR and business leadership on initiatives that strengthen culture, employee experience, and retention across the region.
  • Provide input on compensation benchmarking and offer structuring for new hires in partnership with Total Rewards.

Key Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition and/or HR, including at least 4-5 years in a senior TA leadership or HR management capacity.
  • Demonstrated success owning an end-to-end TA function, including for senior/leadership hiring, ideally within a fast-growing or regional organization.
  • Prior exposure to HR business partnering, employee relations, or generalist HR responsibilities is strongly preferred.
  • Experience building and leading a recruitment or HR team.
  • Strong command of recruitment analytics, ATS platforms, and sourcing/employer branding tools.
  • Strategic thinking with the ability to translate business goals into workforce and hiring plans.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills at senior/leadership levels.
  • Data-driven decision-making and comfort working with recruitment metrics and dashboards.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Hands-on leadership style, comfortable both setting strategy and executing full-cycle recruitment personally when needed.
  • Sound judgment on employee relations and HR policy matters.
  • Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

job.title: Supervisor (Piping)
job.description:
Job Summary

  • Plan & execute trade job task as per specification with safety, quality and productivity in ship building and ship repair.
  • Prepare micro schedule, manhour loading, materials take off and monitor the work.
  • Perform duty in the most productive method.
  • Planning to ensure instructions regarding work requirements are relayed from the appropriate documents (Specifications, tender, work instructions, procedure, manuals)
  • implement & follow up with operators to ensure compliance of productivity, quality, environment, occupational health, and safety requirements.\Co-ordinate simultaneously with supervisory staff of different trade and projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Read & understand technical specifications, prepare job list, work schedule, plan materials take off and manpower planning of yard men & contractor for each given job.
  • Order the materials required as per materials take off and co-ordinate with purchase department for timely delivery of the materials.
  • Plan out and prepare all permit to work system related to marine safety, prepare risk analysis (RA), conduct RA briefing before starting work.
  • Conduct morning RA briefing with foreman and workers generic and critical activities briefing in workplace to identify and eliminate the hazards.
  • Carry out daily toolbox talk.
  • Demonstrate excellent organizational skill, following polices, safe work procedures, work practice and developing improvements where necessary.
  • Plan & prepare tools, equipment, transportation, materials and manpower, control manhour for all given jobs.
  • Ensure foreman understand and implement the work plan, by explaining and engaging in pro-active communication with workers or contractors.
  • Understand all given jobs, supervise, and give detail instruction to subordinates and contractors.
  • Cooperate with SRM, owner rep & other trade supervisors on appropriate procedures and ensure job to be completed smoothly & on schedule.
  • Ensure safety, discipline, and welfare for all subordinates.
  • Ensure all work completion reports have been made & signed by owner rep and submit to commercial dept on time.
  • Ensure subcontractor work order to be raised immediately once confirmation of job by owner representative.
  • Maintain good housekeeping and safety at all the time onboard vessel & workshop. Ensure all workers follow safe work procedure all the time.
  • To attend VSCC meeting to report progress on daily basis.
  • Responsible for minimum wastage of materials and balance materials to accounted and returned to store at the end of the project.
  • Liaising with Engineer and manager to solve the problem and decision making for on-site issues.
  • Contribute Idea to improve working method.
  • Ensure permit to work system is followed strictly.
  • To support foreman and planners in preplanning, generation of programs and follow up of all job in order to utilize optimum resources – manpower & equipment.
  • Pre-planning and follow up inter-trade sequence and interreference to ensure optimum usage of resources.
  • Co-ordinate with project manager/Engineers, owner rep., other trade supervisory staff as well ad internally in the department with work preparation, fabrication and materials control.
  • Co-ordinate for resources from shop, other trade, as the case may be.
  • Ensure all safety requirements for those reporting to them and process under their supervision are complied with-raise occurrence reports and safety infringements in case of non-compliance. Maintain good housekeeping in all work area of the project onboard, jetty and workshop.
  • Stop process if they do not meet the requirements, raise occurrence reports and approve satisfactory completion if any rework that may be necessary.
  • Motivate the team for optimum performance, monitor the performance and provide continue appraisal of all subordinates.
  • To communicate upwards -training needs, process improvements suggestions and follow up on implementation.
  • Have the ownership of success or failure, as the case may be on their projects.
  • Maintain all the management system and production records.
  • Prepare progress reports, KPI reports, Adjustment Work Request Form (AWRF) and Work Done Report (WDR)
  • If tasked for Night Shift, carry out Night Shift Duty Officer / Supervisor roles accordingly.

Key Requirements

  • 3 Years above with relevant working experience.

Education

Others

job.title: Lead Engineer
job.description:
POSH is looking for Lead Engineers to manage and execute the SURF (Subsea Riser Umbilical and Flowline) and diving construction scopes on a project.

The role reports directly to the Project Package Manager on a specific project and works closely with other members of the Project Management Team (PMT) on a day to day basis, such as Engineering Manager, Project Operations Manager, HSE and Quality Managers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinating with other departments and teams to ensure that SURF/Diving package activities are properly integrated into the overall project plan.
  • Provides specialist skills, integrity, and knowledge in key areas of discipline engineering, including design codes, legislative requirements and current good engineering practice.
  • Understands clients' needs; identifies and addresses design parameters and problems; develops and implements solutions.
  • Ensures project and HS&E compliance and adherence to project budget & schedule.
  • Under own supervision, independently evaluates, organises and prioritises work.
  • Undertakes responsibility for production of installation deliverables, which may include engineering support to the Drawing Office, installation procedures, technical bid evaluations, study reports and various 3rd-party submissions.
  • Signs and issues technical documentation as originator or checker, accepting personal responsibility for its adequacy.
  • Ensures all relevant safety objectives and legal requirements are observed.
  • Developing and managing procurement strategies and plans to ensure that equipment and materials are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Coordinating with suppliers and vendors to ensure that equipment and materials are manufactured, tested, and delivered to the required quality standards.
  • Coordinating with offshore installation teams to ensure that the SURF package is installed and commissioned according to the project schedule and quality standards.
  • Providing technical advice and guidance to senior management and other stakeholders.
  • Providing technical guidance and support to the team of engineers and technical professionals working on the package. Trains / mentors more junior engineers.
  • May manage a team of engineers on a project or within a discipline
  • Manage interfaces within a project structure, including other disciplines, drawing office, document control, project management, client and suppliers.
  • Manage change control within own remit on a project. Inform team members where constraints will affect a project in terms of programme or budget.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related field
  • At least 10-15 years of experience in SURF/Diving Installation operations
  • Relevant experience working on previous EPCI or T&I offshore construction projects is preferred
  • Previous track record of working on Saudi Aramco LTA Projects of similar scopes is an advantage
  • Knowledge: Must have a good understanding of SURF Installation operations including various lay spreads (horizontal lay for flexibles and umbilicals / basket carousel for cable lay), lay techniques and procedures, as well as relevant installation regulations and standards. Knowledge of project management principles and practices is also required.
  • Knowledge: Must have a good understanding of diving operations including DSV and diving spreads, diving techniques, and procedures, as well as relevant diving regulations and standards. Knowledge of project management principles and practices is also required.
  • Skills: Must possess strong leadership, communication and problem-solving skills. Must be able to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to lead and function within a design team and across multiple projects.
  • Ability to prioritise own and others’ workload, manage time accordingly and inform team members where constraints will affect a project in terms of programme or budget.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders
  • Fluent in English

job.title: Assistant Manager, Learning & Development
job.description:
Job Summary
