The role partners with business leaders and stakeholders to identify training needs, develop learning solutions, enhance workforce capabilities, and foster a culture of continuous learning. This position also supports talent development programmes, competency framework initiatives, and training effectiveness measurement to ensure employees are equipped with the skills required to meet current and future business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development and implementation of learning and development strategies that align with organisational goals and business priorities.
  • Conduct training needs analyses in collaboration with business units and key stakeholders to identify capability gaps and learning opportunities.
  • Coordinate and administer learning programmes, workshops, leadership development initiatives, and employee development interventions.
  • Support the development, maintenance, and implementation of competency frameworks across various functions and employee groups.
  • Assist in the management and execution of graduate, management trainee, and talent development programmes to support employee growth and succession planning initiatives.
  • Curate, source, and recommend internal and external training programmes that address organisational and employee development needs.
  • Monitor training participation, learning outcomes, and programme effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and data analysis.
  • Prepare training reports, dashboards, and insights to support data-driven learning and talent decisions.
  • Work closely with HR and business stakeholders to promote a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
  • Ensure proper administration of learning records, training databases, budgets, and vendor partnerships where applicable.

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 4–6 years of relevant experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Training, or related HR functions.
  • Experience in conducting training needs analyses and coordinating employee development programmes.
  • Familiarity with competency frameworks, learning management systems (LMS), and adult learning methodologies.
  • Ability to analyse learning data, identify trends, and recommend improvements based on insights.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively with employees and leaders across different levels of the organisation.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and credibility.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.

Education

Bachelors in Human Resources or Organization Development

Interpersonal Requirements

#JR444

job.title: Manager, Technology Solutions
job.description:
Job Summary

The IT Manager is an influential IT Application Owner responsible for delivering IT support operation excellence, continuous improvement, and strong application project delivery. This role emphasises delivering high-quality outcomes, bringing in emerging technologies — including AI and advanced analytics and delivering measurable business value while fostering sustainable growth. Ideal for a motivated individual passionate about driving digital transformation, deploying AI solutions, and delivering excellence in a complex, multi-site maritime and industrial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Application Ownership:

  • End-to-End Management: Serve as the IT owner for designated software applications, managing the full lifecycle including implementation, updates, support & maintenance, and decommissioning. IT owner also to ensure the application continues to meet business needs and performance standards.
  • System Stability and Performance Monitoring: Ensure quality support meeting SLA. Oversee the performance of applications, ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement to meet evolving business needs.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary point of contact between IT and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment between the organization's objectives and the application's capabilities. Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, ensuring optimal service delivery, ongoing support, and contract management. Work collaboratively across IT team to ensure seamless data flow and interoperability across systems.
  • Governance & Compliance: Ensure that applications comply with internal policies, industry standards, and legal regulations. Maintain security best practices and manage risks. Oversee VAPT exercises, vulnerability remediation, and security hardening for Application and Hosting environment.
  • Requirements Gathering: Lead the process of gathering business and technical requirements for enhancements or new software solutions, working closely with cross-functional teams to define project scope.

Application Landscape Management & Modernisation

  • Define, Design, Document and continuous modernization of application architecture landscape in partnership with SaaS providers and Developer Partners for bespoke Applications. Drive migration from legacy monoliths toward modern, cloud-native, microservices-based architectures with API and Agentic AI MCP readiness
  • Own availability and disaster recovery (DR) planning for critical applications; test and validate RTO/RPO targets.
  • Access cloud and hybrid deployment models to evaluate fit for applications under management. Assess data sovereignty, cost, and risk trade-offs when recommending hosting options

AI Adoption & Automation

  • Define and execute an AI adoption roadmap for the application support function, identifying high-value use cases for automation, augmentation, and intelligence.
  • Champion the integration of AI/ML-driven observability, AIOps tooling, and intelligent alerting to reduce noise and accelerate diagnostics.
  • Drive a shift-left culture — moving reactive break-fix toward proactive monitoring, self-healing automation, and knowledge management

Key Requirements

  • At least 5-7 years of experience in application management, with a proven track record of performing Support and Project implementations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science.
  • PMP, ITIL or equivalent certifications is an advantage.
  • Cloud or AI certifications (AWS, Azure, Salesforce AI Specialist) are advantageous.
  • Experience with Applications used by maritime related industry is advantageous.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based applications, SaaS solutions, and modern IT architecture.

job.title: HSE Coordinator

job.title: Assistant Manager, Commercial (Modules)
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible in preparation of all commercial aspects of Onshore and Offshore Modules Construction Projects tendering, which includes but not limited to Costing, Pricing, Tender Proposal and Prequalification, by coordinating with all relevant departments to collate the correct inputs necessary to prepare a compelling commercial and technical tender proposal for submission, with primary objective to achieve successful project awards.

Key Responsibilities

Project Prequalification

  • Review Pre-qualifications documentation requirements and deliverables received from customers.
  • Work with all relevant departments in the Company to collate the necessary supporting documents for Prequalification.
  • Prepare client’s prequalification questionnaire and supporting documents for submission.
  • Review the Prequalification response with AGM Commercial and Senior Management.
  • Submit deliverable either via client’s portal or email.
  • Monitor and ensure various deadlines by customer are strictly adhered to.

Project Tendering

  • Compile and review customer enquiries, tenders and/ or RFQs and provide a scope summary to Paxocean Management to review for bid decision.
  • Check sanction risk from company portal and credit risk of client company from company Risk and Compliance Team.
  • When bid decision is to proceed, determine the required tender deliverables and coordinate and work will all relevant departments to collate tender inputs for proposal preparations.
  • Review the technical specifications/ requirements/ engineering drawings and prepare commercial proposal/ bid for submission through coordination with various stakeholder in the yard. Collate all clarifications and send to client and follow up for response and advise.
  • Compile all inputs from relevant departments for submission based on client’s requirement on tender deliverable

Tender Costing & Pricing

  • Monitor and ensure various deadlines by customer are strictly adhered to.
  • Prepare costing and pricing using the established excel templates with supporting suppliers and subcontractor cost for substantiation.
  • Prepare tender qualifications and exceptions in accordance with the basis of the costing estimates.
  • Collate all material cost received from suppliers and labour cost from subcontractors in the respective disciplines folders, for further reference, price revalidations and project handover after tender award.
  • Review the commercial and tender proposal with AGM commercial when the preparation is completed and incorporate all comments received from AGM Commercial after the review.

Prior Submission and Post Submission

  • Invite Senior Management for Tender review to get approval for tender submission.
  • Upon approval for submission, prepare the clean copy of commercial and technical tender proposal, including cover letter for submission.
  • Follow up with Clients for tender status and feedback on the submitted proposal. Response to all clients clarifications.
  • Upon project award, prepare presentation highlighting scope of work, technical, commercial and contractual information of the project for commercial handover meeting.

Post Project Award

  • Maintain and cultivate good relationship with existing and potential associates/customers through regular communication.
  • Provide advice to Project Managers on any potential variation orders.
  • Compile all inputs from relevant departments for submission based on client’s requirement on tender deliverables.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Engineering from reputable institution.
  • At least 5-8 years of relevant industry experience including a minimum of 3 years in commercial roles and in addition, preferably also with experience in technical or commercial aspects in FPSO projects or module construction and project management.
  • Able to read, interpret and prepare applicable technical / commercial information including proposal, Engineering Drawings and suggest process changes to ensure functional and cost-effective results.

Education

Bachelors in Engineering

job.title: Supervisor (Mechanical)

job.title: Senior Executive, Cost & Contract
job.description:
K2 is an international developer, owner and operator of hyper-scale digital infrastructure assets. We are the specialists in providing critical digital infrastructure in the form of Data Centre environments to leading technology companies, we lay the physical foundations of the internet, cloud services and tomorrow's digital solutions, today.

With a proven track record operating to world leading service levels, we pride ourselves in being technically focused long term partners, providing our customers peace of mind when investing in significant physical network, storage and computing resources that provide the digital solutions to millions of users around the world everyday.

We seek to hire the best talent in the industry, who has the passion and motivation to join the growing team in K2.

Tasks and Responsibilities

You are required to provide support throughout each data centre project life cycle (across K2 locations) which includes the following:

  • Ensure effectiveness and consistency in application of internal policies and procedures for construction contracts and consultancy service agreements.
  • Support and advise project team on contract matters, procurement strategy and tendering procedures.
  • Engage and liaise with external consultants, contractors, and suppliers including managing a registry of these approved external providers.
  • Advise project team on construction costs, tender indices, market trends, benchmarking, value engineering and construction related cost risks.
  • Maintain development cost database and provide regular cost reports.
  • Using financial indicators, trends and models, identify opportunities for cost savings.
  • Execute procurement of provisional sum items for projects.

Other on-going tasks and responsibilities include:

  • Provide construction cost input for project feasibility studies.
  • Drive business process/continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Update of project cost information/status.
  • Safekeeping of contract documents and drawings, statement of final accounts, performance bonds and insurance policies (if any),
  • Perform other duties as assigned or instructed.

Experience and skills

  • 5 years’ minimum relevant working experience as quantity surveyor and/or in data centre industry preferred.
  • Good understanding in building services/data centre project lifecycle.
  • Proficiency in MS Office especially Excel
  • Strong communications skills and good command of written and spoken English. Additional language will be an advantage.
  • Ability to work independently, meticulous, analytical, proactive and able to meet tight deadlines.
  • Excellent interpersonal, stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

Educational qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Building Management or its equivalent

#JR398

job.title: Supervisor, NDT
job.description:
Job Summary

The NDT Supervisor is responsible for carrying out and overseeing non-destructive testing (NDT) activities across shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform NDT methods such as UT, MT, PT, RT, and VT on hull structures, piping systems, and critical components
  • Interpret test results and identify defects against acceptance criteria
  • Ensure testing is conducted in accordance with approved procedures and relevant codes/standards
  • Supervise and guide NDT technicians (if assigned), ensuring work is carried out correctly and safely
  • Coordinate inspection activities with production teams to minimise disruption to operations
  • Liaise with classification surveyors and client representatives during inspections
  • Prepare and submit accurate and timely Work Done Reports (WDR)
  • Maintain proper records of inspection results, calibration logs, and consumables
  • Ensure traceability of inspected items and compliance with documentation requirements
  • Ensure all NDT activities comply with classification society rules (e.g., ABS, DNV, LR) and project specifications
  • Verify calibration status of NDT equipment before use
  • Support internal and external audits related to NDT
  • Review drawings, ITPs (Inspection Test Plans), and work packs prior to execution
  • Plan daily NDT activities based on project schedules and priorities
  • Identify potential quality issues early and escalate when necessary
  • Follow and enforce safety procedures, especially for radiography and confined space work
  • Ensure proper use of PPE and adherence to shipyard safety regulations
  • Maintain good housekeeping and equipment handling practices
  • As-and-when instructed by the QA Manager

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant NDT experience in shipbuilding, ship repair, offshore, or marine industry
  • Prior supervisory experience leading NDT technicians and coordinating inspection activities
  • Good knowledge of classification society rules and international standards (ABS, DNV, LR, AWS, ASME, ISO, etc.)
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, welding details, ITPs, and technical specifications
  • Familiar with radiographic safety requirements and confined space work procedures
  • Strong understanding of QA/QC processes and documentation requirements
  • Proficient in preparing inspection reports, WDRs, and maintaining calibration/inspection records
  • Good communication and coordination skills with production teams, surveyors, and clients
  • Able to work independently under tight project schedules and operational demands
  • Strong commitment to workplace safety, quality standards, and compliance requirements
  • Possess good problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Candidates with shipyard or marine conversion project experience will have an added advantage

Education

Others in Engineering

job.title: Data Centre Solutions Architect (Design Manager/Senior Manager)
job.description:
Job Summary

The Data Centre Solutions Architect (Design Manager/Senior Design Manager) will be responsible for design and innovation, market research, evaluating, and implementing the newly technical solutions to optimize K2 future data centre’s infrastructure with high efficiency, and performance. This role plays a critical part in ensuring K2 always advanced and prepared to fulfil the quick change and demand of the global data centre requirements, ensure technical excellent, stand operational, sustainability, and scalability goals while aligning with industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Design, Innovation & Technical Solutions

  • Conduct market research to identify new ideas and technologies that can be used to develop a comprehensive K2 data centre design solution, including layout planning, power distribution, cutting-edge high-density cooling systems, critical control/monitoring infrastructure with different construction methods.
  • Ensure all K2 newly developed design solutions adhere to customer requirements, Uptime Institute’s Tier standards, ASHRAE thermal guidelines and relevant industry best practices.
  • Participate in the development of new MEP design and construction concepts, produce K2 data centre design libraries, and system specifications.
  • Lead and manage design and innovation projects, influence K2 technical design decision-making. Efficiently handle technical problems with demonstrate creativity in solutions.
  • Assisting customer RFP support, developing new ideas on MEP design to meet the new AI ready data centre on performance, operation and quality requirements.
  • Recommend and integrate advanced solutions to improve energy efficiency, reduce carbon footprint, and enhance facility performance and availability.
  • Works closely with internal teams as well as collaborating with external vendors to perform and support design and development activities.
  • Conduct feasibility studies on new MEP technology on the market, support technical due diligence for the new supply chain and manufacture data centre products.
  • Perform on going technology market research on Liquid Cooling on high density Data Centres. Develop a design scheme to how power delivery can be provided in a small footprint.
  • Design, develop the system prototypes of data centre solution with vendors to ensure the newly developed solution meets the specifications and K2 engineering requirements.
  • Writing white paper, producing reports and documentation. Participating in technical meetings, seminars and conferences.

Infrastructure Design Optimization

  • Evaluate and implement newly developed design and product solutions to optimize data centre power usage effectiveness (PUE) and water usage effectiveness (WUE).
  • Assess and improve construction methods, cooling design, rack layout, and power distribution for maximum construction, commissioning and operation efficiency.
  • Develop TCO strategies to improve equipment lifecycle management and reduce maintenance costs.

Management & Implementation

  • Lead design development and innovation, support technical discussions and provide guidance to project delivery teams during construction, commissioning, and handover stages.
  • Ensure proper documentation of design specifications, drawings, equipment details, and solution implementation processes.
  • Conduct risk assessments and ensure designs support redundancy and resilience for critical systems.
  • Implement vendor-agnostic procurement strategies / process with a multi-vendor design template for each MEP system.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Delivery, Operations, Facilities and IT to align the newly developed technical solutions with business needs.
  • Engage with suppliers and contractors to ensure solution/equipment developed fully aligns with K2 technical vision and design requirements.
  • Develop a geopolitical risk register to guide equipment selection and procurement strategies by customer type and region.

Compliance & Sustainability

  • Ensure all newly developed designs and solutions comply with local regulations, industry standards and company policies.
  • Integrate sustainable design practices including renewable energy solutions, heat recovery systems and carbon footprint reduction initiatives.

Key Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, data centre engineering, or related fields.
  • Certifications such as CDCP (Certified Data Centre Professional), DCD (Data Centre Design), or Uptime Institute Accredited Tier Designer are highly desirable.
  • Minimum 5–8 years of experience in data centre design, solutions architecture, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Sound technical knowledge and proven experience in delivering high-density data centres, colocation facilities, or hyperscale environments.
  • Strong understanding and technical background in electrical power or cooling system, excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with others.
  • Keen interest in construction industry and M&E infrastructure development
  • Demonstrate technical rigor and creativity, continuous learning and improvement, alignment to fast changing data centre industry needs.
  • Solid problem-solving skills and excellent understanding of data centre MEP system interface requirements.
  • Proficient in design software such as AutoCAD, Revit, or BIM (Building Information Modelling).
  • Ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision, including time management and prioritisation.
  • Ability to analyse and resolve complex technical issues at a basic principle level, collaborating across multiple disciplines of DC application.
  • Flexible approach to working in a small design and innovation team, requiring a hands-on approach to getting things done.
  • Familiarity with industry standards such as TIA-942, ISO 27001, and ASHRAE guidelines.

Education

Bachelors in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering

job.title: Manager, Finance (GL)

job.title: Assistant Engineer, Quality System.
job.description:

  • Drive consistency and standardisation across departments
  • Process Review & Improvement

  • Ensure proper document control practices are followed
  • Support standardisation of documentation across departments
  • Quality Report Preparation

  • Analyse trends in non-conformities, audit findings, and corrective actions
  • Provide insights and recommendations for improvement
  • Digital Application Power User

job.title: Manager, Vessel Operations
job.description:
Job Summary

The role oversees day to day ship operations, covering voyage planning, bunker optimization, port operations, cargo handling, compliance, and coordination between commercial, technical, and chartering teams. This role serves as the central point of contact for vessel masters, charterers, agents, and port authorities, ensuring voyages are executed in line with commercial contracts and international regulations.

Key responsibilities include monitoring vessel schedules, addressing operational issues in real time, managing claims exposure, optimizing voyage P&L, and driving continuous improvements in operational efficiency. This position is based in Singapore.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead day-to-day operations of vessels as shipowners or bareboat charterers.
  • Ensure safe vessel operations in coordination with ship managers, following industry regulations and internal procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with charter party requirements, company procedures, and operational standards across vessels, brokers, Charterers, and agents.
  • Monitor and document all voyage performance details, including off-hire, stoppages, and delays.
  • Arrange bunkers at designated ports.
  • Proactively conduct loss-prevention activities.
  • Handle claims, negotiate effectively, and resolve issues promptly.
  • Support the Chartering team with vessel information, requirements, questionnaires, certification, and scheduling for pre- and post-fixture activities.
  • Verify loading/discharging port plans with ship managers to ensure compliance with port requirements and hold-cleanliness standards.
  • Arrange routine invoicing and ensure timely processing.
  • Manage disputes with Charterers with support from the defence club when required.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of charter parties, ship-management contracts, and other relevant agreements.
  • Manage charter hire payments and final settlements upon completion of time charters.
  • Review ship managers’ operational and accounting reports.
  • Conduct briefings with deck and engine officers.
  • Optimize resource utilization and propose workflow improvements to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Represent the company at meetings, seminars, and industry conferences.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Key Requirements

  • Appropriate qualification in Shipping, Maritime Studies, Logistics, or a related field.
  • At least 6 years of experiences in dry bulk operations, ideally including steel, projects, general or other dry bulk cargoes.
  • Strong understanding of voyage execution, chartering operations, and post-fixture procedures.
  • Analytical mindset for evaluating voyage performance, TCE, off hire, demurrage/ despatch.
  • Commercial awareness of market conditions affecting freight, bunkers, and port costs.
  • Proficiency in voyage management software IMOS would be a plus.
  • Strong commercial acumen with maritime operational expertise.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities to handle complex operational demands.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills with strong stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and good organizational skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint familiarity preferred)
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and take on new challenges.
  • Proven leadership and team management capabilities.

job.title: Senior Executive II, Business Development
job.description:
Job Summary

The role is responsible for delivering revenue growth by consistently achieving individual sales targets and meeting annual budgeted revenue goals, through proactive ownership of sales strategy and execution across an assigned portfolio. The position focuses on expanding market share in targeted growth industries/business segments, building and maintaining strong customer relationships, and aligning sales efforts with overall commercial strategies. The role contributes to company profitability through proactive sales execution, cross-functional collaboration, and consistent customer engagement.

Sales Performance & Strategy

  • Proficient with MS Office Programs, with working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Salesforce CRM.

  • Positive and collaborative work attitude, able to work independently and in a team.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

job.title: Administrative Executive

We are looking for an organized and detail-oriented Administrative Executive to manage day-to-day office operations and coordinate seamless travel arrangements for our team.

job.title: Mobile & Full Stack Application Development Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary

We are an established property and retail organisation managing a portfolio of shopping destinations. Our loyalty programme connects members with participating malls and tenants through a mobile application that supports rewards points and other digital services.

The Loyalty team works closely with marketing teams and technology vendors to enhance the member experience and deliver new digital capabilities. We are looking for a Mobile & Full Stack Application Developer who can take ownership of the application’s technical design, development, testing and deployment across both iOS and Android platforms, as well as contributing to backend services, APIs and web-facing components that power our loyalty ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively analyse and clarify business requirements with the team, and technical requirements with internal and external system owners.
  • Work closely with relevant system owners to support application integration, investigate and troubleshoot production issues across interconnected systems in a timely manner.
  • Take ownership of translating business requirements into user journeys and technical designs for the loyalty programme’s iOS and Android applications, from development, integration, testing to release.
  • Be accountable for the complete testing lifecycle, including preparation of test scenarios and test cases, SIT, regression testing, UAT coordination, defect resolution and production release readiness.
  • Plan quarterly application releases, including submission and deployment through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
  • Monitor and optimise application performance, reliability, responsiveness and user experience.
  • Apply mobile and full stack development best practices relating to coding standards, security, maintainability, version control and release management, covering both client-side and server-side components.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date technical documentation, including system designs, integration specifications, deployment procedures and operational support guides.

  • Had experience using artificial intelligence tools to generate, automate or maintain test cases for regression and enhancement testing.

  • Strong sense of accountability for application quality, stability and successful delivery.

job.title: Commissioning Specialist
job.description:
Job Summary

The Commissioning Specialist is responsible for supporting and executing commissioning activities across multiple projects, ensuring systems and equipment are installed, tested, and operating in accordance with design requirements, project specifications, and applicable standards. The role supports the Commissioning Manager in delivering projects safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute commissioning activities from pre-commissioning through final acceptance.
  • Review commissioning procedures, method statements, test scripts, and technical documentation.
  • Witness and support FAT, SAT, functional testing, integrated system testing (IST), and performance testing.
  • Coordinate commissioning activities with contractors, vendors, consultants, and project teams.
  • Monitor Cx1–Cx5 commissioning progress and ensure activities are completed according to the project schedule.
  • Review test results, identify deficiencies, and follow up on punch list items through closure.
  • Verify equipment and system performance against design intent and project requirements.
  • Prepare and maintain commissioning reports, test records, trackers, and close-out documentation.
  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during commissioning.
  • Ensure compliance with project safety requirements and applicable codes and standards.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma/Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Relevant experience in testing, commissioning, construction, or facilities engineering.
  • Experience in data centre / mission-critical projects
  • Familiarity with relevant industry standards and commissioning practices.
  • Experience with electrical and/or mechanical systems such as generators, UPS, switchgear, cooling systems, CDU, CRAH, pumps, and BMS/EPMS is advantageous.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of testing and commissioning processes.
  • Ability to read and interpret drawings, SLDs, schematics, specifications, and technical documents.
  • Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong coordination and communication skills.
  • Able to manage multiple commissioning activities and priorities concurrently.
  • Detail-oriented with good documentation and reporting skills.
  • Able to work effectively with contractors, vendors, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Willingness to support FAT/commissioning activities outside normal working hours when required.
  • Proactive, responsible, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.

#JR815

Education

Bachelors in Electrical Engineering

Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering & Electronics

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As Senior Manager, Tax based in Singapore, you will work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • be part of shaping our approach to tax in a rapidly expanding regional business
  • with a focus on advisory work, you will cover the full spectrum of tax working on matters covering direct tax, indirect and other taxes (transfer taxes, employment taxes, property taxes etc.), as well as transfer pricing.

Your Day to Day

In this role, your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading APME tax matters across corporate income tax, consumption tax, withholding tax, employment taxes, and transfer pricing;
  • Advising the business on complex transactions, structuring, financing arrangements, and new investments relating to APME;
  • Providing technical analysis and practical recommendations on tax law developments and tax risks impacting the Group;
  • Managing relationships with external tax advisors, auditors, and tax authorities, including support for tax audits, reviews, and enquiries;
  • Supporting the Group’s tax governance framework and ensuring appropriate controls and processes are implemented;
  • Supporting Pillar Two, Country-by-Country Reporting, and other international tax initiatives;
  • Leading strategic tax projects in APME, including process improvements, and automation initiatives; and
  • Collaborating closely with regional and global tax teams to ensure consistency of tax positions and alignment with Group strategy.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in Big 4 and in-house roles;
  • Proven track record of demonstrating the ability to adapt in a fast paced environment
  • Appropriate professional qualifications (CA, CPA, Accredited Tax Practitioner or Accredited Tax Advisor or equivalent);
  • Proven ability to work independently to execute on strategic priorities; and
  • A self-starter with a growth mindset.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Profile Required

  • Excellent experience in cross-functional management and in leading and operating in a matrixed environment
  • Substantial experience in optimising a growing and evolving business – leading a large organisation through a period of rapid growth, merger integration, or business transition

job.title: Director, Design Delivery, Korea
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1 billion in committed capital.

Our mission is to bridge the digital divide across Asia Pacific by building the sustainable digital ecosystems of the future. Through building and operating state-of-the-art, energy efficient data centers rich with connectivity options, we bring new colocation and interconnect options to the Asian market, making digital infrastructure deployment in the region easy, efficient and economical.

Founded in 2020 the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across China, India, Indonesia, Japan, Korea, and the Philippines.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Responsibility: We take ownership of our actions and outcomes.
  • Innovation: We embrace change and create bold solutions.
  • Strive: We show grit, resilience and relentless drive.
  • Excellence: We pursue the highest standards in all we do.
  • Respect: We act with integrity and treat others with dignity.

What we need:

  • *

We are seeking a Director, Design Delivery with a strong background in either mechanical or electrical engineering to lead the end-to-end design execution of mission-critical data centre infrastructure across the North Asia region. This senior leadership role will own the integrated design delivery process from early concept through construction, driving consistency, technical excellence, and innovation across a growing portfolio of hyperscale and enterprise-grade data centre projects.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise (preferably in mechanical or electrical systems), strong leadership across multidisciplinary teams, and a track record of executing complex data centre designs at scale. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, design consultants, construction teams, and strategic partners to ensure project success in terms of quality, performance, time, and cost.

**

Key Responsibilities

Strategic & Technical Leadership

  • Lead the overall MEP design strategy for assigned data centre projects across the region, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and technical rigor.
  • Own the mechanical and electrical discipline leadership, including chilled water systems, HVAC, liquid cooling, or power distribution, UPS, and MV/LV systems.

Cross-Disciplinary Design Integration

  • Champion seamless coordination between mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, architectural, structural, and security disciplines.
  • Drive adoption of best practices, innovation, and lessons learned across the portfolio.

Design Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee the full design lifecycle from feasibility and concept through detailed design, IFC, and construction support – ensuring alignment with business goals and customer requirements.
  • Monitor and drive performance of external consultants and vendors, ensuring deliverables meet cost, quality, and schedule expectations.

Design Governance & Standardization

  • Establish and enforce internal design governance, including design reviews, technical due diligence, and risk assessments.
  • Maintain and evolve internal design standards, master specifications, and reference guides to support rapid and consistent deployment.

Innovation & Future Readiness

  • Lead technical innovation efforts including liquid cooling readiness, AI/HPC support, or grid-interactive power strategies.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to ensure future-proof design direction.

Execution Support & Commissioning

  • Provide senior oversight and troubleshooting during construction and commissioning phases to validate that design intent is maintained.
  • Review and validate Sequence of Operations (SOO) and critical systems performance during T&C.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Act as a key technical voice to internal leadership, customers, and partners—articulating design strategies, decisions, risks, and value propositions clearly and confidently.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

Candidate Profile:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (or equivalent).
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data centre design and delivery, including at least 5 years in hyperscale or colocation environments.
  • Proven leadership of complex, multi-disciplinary design efforts with responsibility for multiple projects across geographies.
  • Deep knowledge of mechanical and/or electrical systems including HVAC, chilled water, free cooling, UPS, MV/LV distribution, or liquid cooling.
  • Familiarity with regional APAC codes and international standards (ASHRAE, ISO, IEC, NFPA, etc.).
  • Experience with design tools such as AutoCAD, Revit/BIM, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer, or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Strong communicator and influencer with the ability to manage both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth, international environment is highly advantageous.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Sr. Officer, Account Payable & Treasury
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

Principal Purpose of the Position:

The Account Payable and Treasury Staff (Fluent English) will be an integral part of the company’s Finance Department in providing support to critical aspects of Account Payable, Disbursements, Purchase Order process, Compliance & Controls, Vendor & Stakeholder Management, Month-End Report, and Treasury activities.

**

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • *

Account Payable

  • Process vendor invoices (PO and non-PO) accurately and efficiently for multiple countries / entities.
  • Verify invoice details (quantities, pricing, approvals, tax compliance) and resolve discrepancies
  • Prepay and execute payment runs (EFT, wire transfers) in accordance with payment terms
  • Reconcile vendor statements and address unpaid invoices or disputes.

Cash Flow Planning

  • Develop, maintain, and refine short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts to ensure sufficient liquidity for operations, investments, and obligations.
  • Collaborate with Collection, Procurement, and other Business Units to align cash requirements with operational and strategic plans.
  • Provide insights on cash availability and funding needs to support capital planning, investment decisions, and financing strategies.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and lenders to plan loan drawdowns in line with project timelines, cash needs, and debt covenants, ensuring optimal cost of funds and compliance.

Employee Expense Disbursement

  • Review and process employee expense reports (T&E) for compliance with company policies.
  • Verify receipts, approvals, and verification on the GL coding
  • Reconcile corporate credit card transactions and follow up on discrepancies
  • Issues reimbursements via payroll and notification to employees on the payment.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary contact for regional vendors regarding payment inquiries.
  • Collaborate with procurement and business units to resolve PO/invoice mismatches.
  • Assist with vendor onboarding (tax forms, banking details)
  • *

Compliance & controls

  • Ensure compliance with local VAT/GST, withholding tax, and other statutory requirements
  • Maintain proper documentation for cross-border payments.
  • Adhere to SOX/Company policy based on approval hierarchies.
  • *

Month-End & Report

  • Reconcile sub-ledger to the general ledger
  • Prepare accruals for outstanding invoices
  • General regional AP aging reports to work with finance manager on cash flow management

**

The successful candidate:

**

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience in AP and Treasury experience, preferably in a multi-country/regional environment. Familiarity with ERP system (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite)

Proficiency in MS Excel, (VLOOK UP, Pivot table) Powerpoint and other MS Office applications

  • Strong analytical skills and high level of business acumen
  • English speaking, strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities, ability to manage deadlines in a high-volume environment, excellent communication skills (vendors, cross-functional team) and interpersonal skills

**

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Interconnection Product and Sourcing
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

Reporting to Director of Product Strategy, the Interconnection Product Manager will be responsible for platform-wide data center product development and lifecycle management. In this role, you will:

  • Lead the development and execution of the interconnection product roadmap across markets, covering Cross Connect, Data Centre Interconnect, Internet Access, and third-party network products and service enablement.
  • Define differentiated product positioning and strategy across different markets, in respect to different portfolios of shared colocation, dedicated building and campus.
  • Partner with in-country GTM Leadership, Business Development, Engineering and Operations teams to drive product readiness, adoption and performance.

Key responsibilities

Interconnection Product Roadmap Development and Execution:

  • Translate customer needs, market trends, competitive developments and business priorities into product requirements, propositions, policies and prioritised roadmap initiatives.
  • Align regional product direction with in-country requirements while promoting platform consistency, scalability and reuse.
  • Lead productization preparation for new and enhanced offerings, including service definitions, operational readiness, commercial alignment, internal training and launch planning.
  • Develop clear product documentation, governance processes and ownership models to support ongoing operation and lifecycle management.
  • Maintain and refresh product collateral, including sales decks, data sheets, product guides, use cases and other sales enablement materials.

Commercial and Product Performance Management

  • Monitor product performance across growth, revenue, profitability, cost, adoption and other agreed performance indicators.
  • Initiate and execute plans to improve product performance, with support from in-country leadership teams and relevant corporate functions.
  • Prepare, maintain and uphold the product business case, ensuring that investment, pricing, cost, demand and return assumptions remain current and properly governed.
  • Provide regular performance analyses, insights and recommendations to management to support portfolio decisions and prioritisation.

Technology and Innovation:

  • Work closely with Engineering, Solutions and Operations teams to identify, assess and introduce new interconnection technologies and innovations to the platform.
  • Define requirements and integration approaches that allow new capabilities to complement established products, systems, processes and operational standards.
  • Monitor developments across data centre connectivity, network ecosystems, automation and third-party platforms to maintain product relevance and competitiveness.
  • Closely coordinate pilots, Proof-of-Concept in controlled product introduction.

Sales and Customer Opportunities Support

  • Work closely with Go-to-Market, Business Development and Solutions teams to support interconnection opportunities, customer engagements and strategic pursuits.
  • Develop and deliver product training for Sales, Solutions, Operations and other internal stakeholders.
  • Build competitive intelligence and practical sales tools that improve opportunity qualification, solution consistency and customer communication.

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Business or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in product management, network services, telecommunications, data centre interconnection, cloud connectivity or digital infrastructure
  • Demonstrated success in managing products throughout their lifecycle, including product strategy, roadmap development, feature prioritisation, performance management, and continuous improvement. Preferred experience in driving standardisation, governance, and portfolio-level product initiatives across multiple markets or regions.
  • Strong understanding of interconnection and connectivity products such as cross connects, data centre interconnect, carrier access, internet exchange, cloud connectivity and third-party network services. Experience in dealing with 3rd party network product and services collaboration preferred.
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and resilient, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

job.title: Senior AI Data Engineer #AIDA
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Powering the Future with AIDA

**

To lead the next phase of our AI evolution, we’ve launched a new business unit AIDA – Artificial Intelligence & Data Analytics – a strategic engine driving our transformation designed to scale our AI ambitions with precision and purpose. This marks a pivotal shift in how we operate, innovate, and serve to embed intelligence into every layer of our business.

At Singtel, this is more than a technology upgrade. It’s a strategic transformation that redefines how value is created across the enterprise core— augmenting human capabilities and unlocking entirely new potential. It is a transformation journey by aligning people, platforms, and processes under one cohesive strategy. Our mission is to build AI literacy, and foster a culture where intelligence empowers people.

**

We welcome you to join us on a transformational journey that’s reshaping the telecommunications industry — and redefining what’s possible with AI at its core. Grow with us in a workplace that champions innovation, embraces agility, and puts human potential at the heart of everything we do.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

  • Responsible for designing, building, and operating scalable data ingestion, transformation, and serving capabilities across a modern hybrid cloud data platform, ensuring solutions are reliable, secure, reusable, and aligned to enterprise architecture and governance standards.
  • Develop and optimise batch and streaming pipelines using cloud tools such as Databricks and Kafka, applying sound engineering practices to ensure performance, resilience, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to the delivery of reliable, secure, and high-quality data for analytics, reporting, and machine learning use cases
  • Lead the implementation and operationalisation of knowledge base and retrieval-augmented generation solution stacks to support scalable GenAI and agentic use cases across business domains

Make an Impact by:

  • Design, build, optimise, and maintain batch and streaming data ingestion pipelines using platforms such as Databricks and Kafka, ensuring scalability, reliability, observability, and alignment with enterprise data architecture standards.
  • Perform data transformation and cleansing using PySpark or SQL based on business and technical requirements
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data workflows to ensure data quality and pipeline reliability
  • Provide technical guidance to engineers and delivery partners on data platform patterns, reusable components, code quality, deployment readiness, and production support practices.
  • Lead integration of data from diverse source systems including files, APIs, databases, and streaming platforms, working with source-system owners and consuming teams to define fit-for-purpose ingestion patterns and delivery timelines.
  • Help maintain metadata and pipeline documentation for transparency and traceability
  • Own production readiness for assigned data and AI platform components, including observability, incident triage, root-cause analysis, release coordination, and continuous improvement of operational runbooks.
  • Participate in integrating pipelines with tools such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Delta Lake, and other platform components
  • Build and maintain knowledge base and RAG solution on variety of hosting platforms
  • Implement and operate knowledge base storage, lifecycle management and embedding/vectorization
  • Contribute to automation efforts using version control and CI/CD workflows
  • Apply data governance, security, access control, and operational risk policies during solution design and implementation, ensuring pipelines and knowledge platforms meet enterprise compliance requirements.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5–8 years of experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or cloud-scale analytics solution delivery, with demonstrated ownership of production pipelines and platform components.
  • Proven ability to independently design, build, optimise, and operate production-grade batch or streaming data pipelines, including orchestration, observability, error handling, performance tuning, and operational support.
  • Hands-on experience with Python and SQL for data transformation and validation
  • Familiarity with Apache Spark (especially PySpark) and large-scale data processing concepts
  • Experience with implementing knowledge base and RAG solutions for agentic AI use cases
  • Self-starter with strong problem-solving skills and a keen attention to detail
  • Able to work independently and lead technical discussions with engineers, architects, product owners, source-system teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into secure and maintainable platform solutions.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data architecture, cloud security, access control, CI/CD, release management, and production operations for data and AI platform solutions.

**

job.title: Senior Manager, Advertising sales
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You’ll help shape how brands connect with audiences across Singtel’s media ecosystem, using the strength of our customer reach, digital platforms and first-party data to create compelling advertising opportunities.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As the Senior Manager, Advertising Sales, you will oversee the growth, maintenance and profitability of Singtel Consumer’s advertising sales business across a wide range of media platforms, including IPTV, OTT Video, SMS, RCS, email and bill inserts.

You will drive advertising revenue, manage internal and external sales partnerships, and shape the roadmap for new advertising capabilities across the Singtel ecosystem. The role will also focus on expanding advertising inventory and strengthening audience targeting through Singtel’s media assets and first-party customer data.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Achieving overall advertising sales revenue targets across all media formats and platforms.

job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

We are looking for an Associate Engineer to work in iLab, supporting testing and validation of broadband devices and services.

The role will mainly perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for broadband devices such as Residential Gateways (RG), ONT/ONR and Wi-Fi devices. The Associate Engineer will work closely with Engineering, Operations and vendors to ensure new devices and firmware meet the required test criteria before deployment to customers.

The role will also support daily lab operations, troubleshooting, test automation and maintenance of lab systems.

Make an impact by:

  • Perform UAT for broadband devices and new firmware according to test plans and acceptance criteria.
  • Test broadband devices such as RG, ONT/ONR, Wi-Fi routers and mesh devices.
  • Perform basic functional, regression, performance, stability and security testing.
  • Support GPON/XGS-PON broadband testing and new project implementation in the lab.
  • Perform basic network testing using tools such as Wireshark, iPerf, ping and other network test tools.
  • Perform Wi-Fi testing such as speed, connectivity, coverage, stability and roaming.
  • Monitor firmware soak and stability tests and report any abnormal behaviour.
  • Reproduce reported faults in the lab and assist engineers and vendors with troubleshooting.
  • Collect device logs, packet captures and test results for problem investigation.
  • Record test results and report defects or issues found during UAT.
  • Retest firmware after fixes are provided by vendors or Engineering.
  • Support development and improvement of test cases and test procedures.
  • Support test automation and RPA activities to reduce repetitive manual testing.
  • Perform basic scripting or automation using Python or other scripting tools, where required.
  • Maintain lab equipment, test devices and test environments.
  • Perform basic maintenance of lab servers, including OS updates, security patches and SSL certificate renewal.
  • Maintain proper documentation of test results, firmware versions and lab configurations.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Operations and vendors on testing and troubleshooting activities.
  • Perform other technical or lab-related tasks assigned by the manager.

Skills for Success:

  • Diploma in Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent from a recognised institution.
  • No experienced required.
  • Basic understanding of networking and TCP/IP.
  • Basic knowledge of IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLAN and Wi-Fi.
  • Familiarity with Windows and Linux environments.
  • Basic knowledge of network troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark, ping and iPerf would be an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of GPON, broadband routers, ONT/ONR or Wi-Fi devices would be an advantage.
  • Familiarity with VMware and Docker would be an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge of Python or scripting would be an advantage.
  • Interest in test automation, RPA and networking technologies.
  • CCNA or ITIL 4 certification would be an advantage but is not mandatory.

job.title: Data Scientist #AIDA
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. As a Data Scientist within the AI & Data Analytics (AIDA) business unit, you will assume a key role in driving insights discovery and AI/ML model development to predict and respond to market changes and their impact on Singtel’s business. Your work will influence critical decisions across the organization—enabling data-driven strategies that uncover new customer insights, optimize operations, and unlock new revenue streams.

In this role, you will play a leading part in advancing AI initiatives, where AI is used to personalize and scale telco product and service offerings. You will develop predictive models for network anomaly detection, customer behavioral analysis, and cross-sell optimization. This includes close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external partners to co-create data-driven AI/ML solutions.

Make an Impact By:

  • Lead Data Science Initiatives: Drive AI/ML initiatives supporting Singtel’s product and service offerings by working closely with stakeholders from Network, Enterprise, Sales, Product, and external partners. Define problem statements and architect end-to-end solutions—including the use of Generative AI and LLMs where applicable—to align with strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and partner needs.
  • Model Development & Integration: Design, build, and productionize analytical models that enable intelligent decisioning within customer journeys. Integrate these models into customer-centric decision engines while championing best practices around model governance, scalability, explainability, and continuous performance monitoring.
  • Customer Behavior & Lifecycle Analysis: Leverage customer behavioral data across Singtel’s Mobile, Broadband, and entertainment services to uncover actionable insights. Maintain and enhance analytical models that inform segmentation, product targeting, and value-based engagement strategies. Enable data exploration, insight discovery, and controlled experimentation (e.g., A/B testing, uplift modeling) to support lifecycle marketing and campaign optimization.
  • Data Exploration & Experimentation: Enable robust data exploration, insight discovery, and experimentation for lifecycle marketing campaigns. Devise and execute rigorous A/B tests, segmentations, and optimization strategies to continuously improve business outcomes.
  • Technical Mentorship & Code Quality: Provide guidance to junior data scientists and collaborate on code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices, maintain high code quality, and promote knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate complex analytical findings and recommendations to diverse audiences—ranging from technical teams to senior leadership—in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.

Skills for success:

  • Bachelor or Postgraduate degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a related field, with at least 3 years of relevant working experience.
  • Deep technical and data science expertise, demonstrating proficiency in:
  • Machine Learning & Statistical Modelling: Including linear regression, GLMs, time series forecasting, supervised learning (e.g., gradient boosted trees, neural networks), segmentation, clustering, design of experiments, and causal inference.
  • LLMs & Generative AI: Fine-tuning and evaluation of large language models (e.g., GPT, LLaMA), prompt engineering, red-teaming, and performance monitoring
  • Efficient data manipulation (with skills in SQL, Python, Spark, Hadoop/Hive, and Databricks) and data visualization (using tools like Power BI).
  • Familiar with software engineering best practices, including modular code design, reproducibility, and testing. Proficient with version control tools such as GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AWS, GCP) and ML lifecycle tools (e.g., MLflow, Airflow)

Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and solve complex business problems through data analysis.

  • A team player with a customer-focused mindset, able to work well in a team and passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Excellent data visualization and communication skills, with the ability to present insights and findings in a clear, concise, and compelling manner, both in written and verbal form.

job.title: Senior Director, AI-Ready Data & Harness Engineering
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel.
