This position supports the end-to-end financial close process while maintaining compliance with GAAP, internal controls, and organizational policies. The role combines strong accounting expertise, analytical capability, and stakeholder collaboration to deliver reliable financial information that supports business decision-making.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore Office, KA-India

What you will do

  • Maintain financial records and accounting transactions in compliance with GAAP, statutory requirements, and company policies.
  • Prepare, review, and analyze journal entries, account reconciliations, and month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities.
  • Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of the general ledger and supporting financial documentation.
  • Generate, validate, and distribute financial reports for management, auditors, and external stakeholders.
  • Support financial statement preparation and reporting requirements across multiple legal entities and business units.
  • Develop, enhance, and leverage automation tools and reporting solutions to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and timeliness of financial processes.
  • Perform financial analysis to identify trends, variances, risks, and opportunities for business improvement.
  • Support internal and external audit requests and ensure adherence to internal control requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve accounting issues and drive continuous process improvements.
  • Contribute to standardization, operational excellence, and digital transformation initiatives within the RTR organization.

What you will have

  • 3-4 years of Accounting Degree or equivalent.
  • Professional Certification from CA/CMA institute/US CPA/CMA preferrable
  • 4-5 years of relevant experience in captive accounting service centers or large corporates with Manufacturing, Service & Trading nature of business.
  • Expert in handling multiple ERP's and varied accounting tools
  • Expert in Data Analytical skills and Interpretation of results
  • Expert in understanding end to end accounting/business issues
  • Shift Timing: EAME shift 1PM-10PM
  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.

Skill Descriptors:

Accuracy and Attention to Detail

Understanding the importance of precision and quality in financial processes and reporting; ability to consistently deliver accurate and reliable results.

Level: Extensive Experience

  • Champions and contributes to accounting and reporting best practices.
  • Accurately processes and reviews large volumes of complex financial data.
  • Maintains an effective balance between productivity, quality, and compliance requirements.
  • Establishes controls and review mechanisms to ensure data integrity and minimize errors.
  • Drives a culture of quality and accountability within the team.
  • Demonstrates advanced knowledge of quality assurance techniques, compliance standards, and validation methodologies.

Analytical Thinking

Knowledge of analytical tools and methodologies; ability to evaluate information, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions to business and operational challenges.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Evaluates accounting and financial issues by identifying key drivers and business impacts.
  • Systematically assesses alternative solutions and recommends appropriate actions.
  • Utilizes analytical tools and methodologies to identify trends, patterns, and process improvement opportunities.
  • Understands the broader business implications of financial data and operational decisions.
  • Applies logical reasoning and professional judgment to interpret data and support decision-making.

Effective Communications

Ability to communicate information clearly, professionally, and effectively across all organizational levels.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Provides constructive and actionable feedback focused on continuous improvement.
  • Actively listens, seeks clarification when needed, and incorporates feedback effectively.
  • Prepares clear reports, presentations, and business documentation.
  • Communicates complex financial concepts in a concise and understandable manner for diverse audiences and avoid technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Demonstrates awareness of verbal and non-verbal communication cues to strengthen stakeholder engagement.

Managing Multiple Priorities

Ability to effectively manage competing priorities, deadlines, and stakeholder expectations in a dynamic environment.

Level: Extensive Experience

  • Successfully manages multiple concurrent activities and deliverables.
  • Adjusts priorities to meet changing business requirements and deadlines.
  • Anticipates and proactively addresses resource constraints and scheduling conflicts.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to reprioritize activities while maintaining service commitments.
  • Maintains high levels of performance during peak close cycles and business-critical periods.
  • Demonstrates adaptability and resilience in fast-paced, evolving environments.

Problem Solving

Knowledge of problem-solving methodologies and the ability to identify, analyze, and resolve accounting, operational and organizational challenges.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Identifies, documents, and analyzes accounting and process-related issues.
  • Evaluates the perspectives and requirements of key stakeholders when determining solutions.
  • Assesses the validity, reliability, and relevance of financial information.
  • Analyzes risks and impacts of alternative solutions and supports decision-making processes.
  • Utilizes structured problem-solving techniques and root cause analysis tools to drive effective resolutions.

Accounting

Knowledge of accounting principles, standards, processes, and systems; ability to accurately record, analyze, and report financial information.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Applies accounting principles and industry best practices in daily operations.
  • Processes and reviews financial transactions in compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Supports the classification, recording, and reconciliation of financial data.
  • Maintains charts of accounts and related financial master data structures.
  • Ensures accurate reporting and compliance within enterprise financial systems.
  • Supports month-end and year-end closing activities, including journal entries and account reconciliations.

Financial Analysis

Knowledge of financial analysis methodologies and the ability to interpret financial information to support business decisions.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Analyzes financial data to identify business performance drivers, trends, and risks.
  • Interprets financial statements and related disclosures to provide meaningful insights.
  • Utilizes quantitative and qualitative analytical techniques to support decision-making.
  • Leverages financial systems and analytical tools to perform data-driven evaluations.
  • Provides recommendations based on sound financial analysis and business considerations.

Financial Reporting

Knowledge of financial reporting frameworks, processes, and controls; ability to prepare accurate and meaningful financial reports.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Prepares and reviews financial reports in accordance with organizational standards and reporting requirements.
  • Identifies, investigates, and resolves reporting discrepancies and data quality issues.
  • Utilizes reporting tools and systems to develop accurate and timely financial reports.
  • Ensures compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and reporting guidelines.
  • Supports the preparation of management reports, statutory reporting, and audit-related deliverables.
  • Contributes to continuous improvement of reporting processes, controls, and automation initiatives.

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

At Caterpillar, we work to help our customers build a better world. Without our team of talented, bright and driven individuals, we wouldn’t be the Caterpillar we are today. Now, this is your chance to join our team and do work that matters. We want you to help us enable customer success, make progress possible around the world and help our communities grow and thrive.

As a Condition Monitoring Advisor at Caterpillar, you will help our customers prevent downtime through condition monitoring techniques. You will generate powerful & accurate recommendations that will enable aftermarket services growth as well as stronger relationships with our customers. This includes analysis of electronic, fluids, and and other equipment and fleet data. This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Skills You Have:

Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.

Growth Mindset: Demonstrates a strong desire to learn and understand new concepts, technologies, and methodologies. Continuously seeks out opportunities for growth and improvement, and is not afraid to ask questions or challenge the status quo.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Data Gathering & Analysis: Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.

Service Excellence: Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8 years of relevant work experience
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex data sets.
  • Programming skills in Python or Snowflake

job.title: Sales Account Manager (Senior Connectivity Sales Specialist)
job.description:
Job Description

Job purpose

We are looking for a motivated Enterprise Connectivity Sales Specialist to drive revenue growth by selling both core infrastructure and advanced networking and connectivity solutions to C-level executives and IT leaders. You will own the full client sales lifecycle—from lead discovery and solution scoping to closing complex, multi-year service contracts.

Responsibilities

  • Account Acquisition & Expansion: Target and close mid-market and enterprise prospects through strategic prospecting, executive networking, and consultative selling.
  • Account Ownership and Supported : Own targeted key Enterprise Connectivity accounts and support rest of EBG base
  • Responsible for meeting and exceeding Orderbook, Revenue and Gross Margin targets
  • Solution Architecture & Scoping: Partner with Solutions Engineers to design tailored connectivity solutions addressing client needs around bandwidth, latency, redundancy, and security.
  • Pipeline & Deal Management: Build and manage a strong sales pipeline using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), providing accurate revenue forecasting.
  • Contract & Negotiation: Lead contract negotiations, service level agreement (SLA) terms, and pricing strategies for high-value enterprise accounts.
  • Market & Product Expertise: Maintain deep subject matter expertise in core enterprise connectivity solutions:
  • Network & Transit: Layer 1-3 services including but not limited to Dedicated Internet, Dark Fiber, Ethernet/MPLS
  • Cloud & Edge: Direct Cloud Connect (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute), SD-WAN, SASE
  • Platform and Managed Services: Managed CPE solution eg Managed Router, Managed Firewall

Qualifications

  • Diploma in IT/Engineering/ICT related field with at least 5 years of B2B sales experience within telecommunications, network service providers, or cloud connectivity vendors.
  • Advantageous to possess experience managing accounts in Healthcare, Education (Institutes of Higher Learning) and Hospitality
  • Proven understanding of WAN architectures, SD-WAN, multi-cloud interconnectivity, and enterprise networking hardware for both domestic and international connectivity.
  • Demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding revenue and order book quotas with complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Demonstrated ability to pitch and build trust with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, and VP-level decision-makers.

Critical Competencies:

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

job.title: Regional Capability Trainer - Western
job.description:
Completes troubleshooting, repairs and rebuilds on engine products in a service workshop independently while coaching and developing less experienced technicians

Key Responsibilities

1. Hands-On Workshop Coaching

  • Teach apprentices how to use hand tools, power tools, torque tools, and precision measurement gear correctly.
  • Show them how to dismantle, inspect, and reassemble components safely and cleanly.
  • Demonstrate how engines, fuel systems, air systems, and aftertreatment systems work—using real examples in the shop.
  • Walk apprentices through “what goes wrong” and how to identify faults, damage, wear, and failure modes.
  • Build foundational troubleshooting skills using real units, real jobs, and real failures.

2. Apprentice Readiness & Confidence Building

  • Help first-years get comfortable in the workshop—how to move safely, set up their workspace, and think like a technician.
  • Teach shop etiquette: teamwork, communication, keeping a tidy bay, and respecting the craft.
  • Support apprentices who may lack confidence or exposure by giving them structured, achievable tasks.

3. Capability Tracking & Individualised Support

  • Use the standardised capability tracker to guide development, set expectations, and maintain consistency across regions.
  • Adapt coaching approaches to each apprentice—ensuring flexibility to address gaps, strengths, and real-time needs.
  • Provide apprentices with targeted support in areas flagged through the tracker or identified in the workshop.

4. Branch Support & Integration

  • Work closely with Service Managers, Supervisors, and Technicians to ensure apprentices are developing the right skills.
  • Identify capability gaps at each branch and provide targeted hands-on coaching sessions.
  • Support the embedding of standard work practices and safe working methods in day-to-day workshop tasks.
  • Travel to nearby or regional sites when required —usually infrequent and planned (<10%), but may increase as program needs evolve.

5. Technical Demonstrations & Practical Learning

  • Run short, practical mini-sessions in the workshop (e.g., correct measuring techniques, wear pattern identification, torque procedures).
  • Set up hands-on problem‑solving activities using failed components or stripped-down engines.
  • Guide apprentices through real diagnostic processes using actual customer units when appropriate.

6. Apprentice Progression & Support

  • Provide input for apprentice capability reviews based on observed workshop performance.

  • Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.
  • Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

The incumbent collaborates across engineering, operations, and product teams to ensure robust system performance, quality assurance, and adherence to enterprise standards.

job.title: Electrician - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for performing electrical maintenance and supporting machine operations to ensure equipment reliability and availability. This role involves working on industrial automation systems, PLC/HMI programming, and control systems while adhering to safety, quality, and operational standards. Assists in technical analysis of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial-of-the-shelf products versus custom built solution. Delivers solution design, adhering to standards and leveraging re-use of components. Analyzes and revises existing systems and documentation to identify remediation or improvements in the application or infrastructure solution. Provides level 3 support for critical issues. Competencies:

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Solution Functional Fit Analysis - Composes and decomposes a system into its component parts using procedures, tools and work aides for the purpose of studying how well the component parts were designed, purchased and configured to interact holistically to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs and formulates models, diagrams and documentation using industry standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

job.description:
Job Summary

This applied technology role is responsible for developing and delivering embedded software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins products. The role involves understanding stakeholder and system requirements, contributing to software specifications, and owning the design, integration, testing, release, and quality of AUTOSAR-based embedded software solutions. The position operates as a recognized technical specialist within the team, delivering independently while collaborating across global product, software, and architecture teams to ensure robust, high-quality software that meets Cummins’ product, platform, and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform AUTOSAR BSW integration and support full end-to-end software build activities across product platforms.
  • Configure and integrate AUTOSAR stack and BSW modules (e.g., COM, DCM, DEM, NvM) using industry-standard tools such as DaVinci Configurator / Developer and EB Tresos , including SIP integration activities.
  • Analyze, debug, and resolve software integration issues , including build failures, RTE runtime errors, and system-level failures.
  • Perform stack analysis, timing analysis , and advanced debugging using Trace32 and related timing analysis tools.
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain automation scripts using Python and Groovy to support build, integration, and test activities.
  • Support and improve continuous integration (CI) and automated build pipelines to enhance software quality and delivery efficiency.
  • Investigate product software problems, identify causal mechanisms, recommend corrective actions, and own problem resolution through closure with appropriate documentation.
  • Apply and continuously improve software development processes and tools , including coding, compiling, testing, static analysis, and integration workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with application software, BSW, architecture, project, and product teams across business units to deliver verified software builds and components.
  • Ensure compliance with project governance, quality standards, and process frameworks , including ASPICE and Cummins software development practices.
  • Review and provide technical guidance on work performed by less-experienced engineers or testers to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient software designs.
  • Provide technical leadership on complex components or smaller projects with moderate ambiguity, maintaining full accountability for deliverables.
  • Contribute to the improvement of work processes and systems within the function or across global business units.
  • Support knowledge transfer and mentoring of technicians, early-career engineers, and student employees.
  • Influence technical direction within project teams through systems thinking, requirements understanding, and design decision-making.
  • Operate as a recognized specialist within the immediate team or product area.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a relevant STEM discipline is required.

  • Drives Results

  • Values Differences

Skills

  • Advanced debugging and system analysis skills using Trace32 .
  • Proficiency in Python and Groovy scripting for automation and software integration support.
  • Experience with DaVinci tools (Configurator and Developer); exposure to EB Tresos .
  • Understanding of embedded C programming and embedded software development best practices.
  • Working knowledge of software build systems, CI/CD pipelines , and automated testing environments.
  • Familiarity with Vector DaVinci Teams is desirable.
  • Strong systems thinking and ability to analyze complex interactions across software, hardware, and product platforms.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills across cross-functional and global teams.

Experience

The AI Software Engineer – Senior is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and high-performing AI-powered software solutions and platforms. This role focuses on building reusable agentic AI frameworks, enterprise integrations, orchestration capabilities, governance mechanisms, and development accelerators that enable the rapid delivery of enterprise AI solutions.

The position combines strong software engineering principles with modern AI platform development, ensuring solutions are built using industry best practices, enterprise architecture standards, and modern development methodologies. AI Platform & Framework Development

Enterprise Integration & MCP Enablement

  • Coding standards

  • LangGraph

job.title: Service Supervisor - FIFO
job.description:
_Our culture believes in POWERING YOUR POTENTIAL._ We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what _\#LifeAtCummins_ is all about.

We are looking for a talented Service Supervisor to join our team supporting workshop and field operations within our Port Hedland workshop. This is an 8:6 FIFO temporary secondment opportunity from Perth, giving employees the chance to experience FIFO life, gain exposure to the Pilbara and broaden their leadership capability while maintaining their connection to their current Cummins branch.

The role will suit a safety-focused and customer-driven leader who enjoys coaching teams, managing priorities and ensuring service work is completed to a high standard. It is also a great opportunity for employees who are curious about FIFO, want to experience life in the Pilbara and are interested in developing new skills without committing to a permanent move away from their home branch or team.

Ever wondered what FIFO is really like? This temporary secondment offers the chance to step into a FIFO leadership role, experience the Port Hedland operation firsthand and return to your home branch at the completion of the assignment.

Why consider this temporary secondment?

  • Gain leadership experience in a FIFO environment while supporting a busy Port Hedland operation.
  • Experience life in the Pilbara and build exposure to a key Cummins regional operation.
  • Develop new skills, broaden your operational knowledge and strengthen your leadership capability while remaining within Cummins.
  • Return to your home branch at the completion of the secondment, with valuable FIFO and Pilbara experience to bring back to your team.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Supervise and coordinate daily service activities across workshop and/or field operations, ensuring work is planned, prioritised and completed safely and efficiently.
  • Provide leadership, coaching and technical support to technicians and apprentices, helping build capability and maintain high standards of workmanship.
  • Drive a strong safety culture by ensuring adherence to all relevant Health, Safety and Environmental policies, procedures and legislative requirements, while reporting and escalating any issues or incidents appropriately.
  • Support service delivery by reviewing work requirements, allocating resources, monitoring progress, resolving operational issues and ensuring quality documentation is completed accurately.
  • Build strong customer relationships by communicating effectively, responding to service priorities and supporting timely, customer-focused solutions.
  • Monitor service performance, technician utilisation and job progress to help maintain productivity, quality outcomes and customer satisfaction.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Mechanical trades qualification as a Heavy Vehicle Mechanic, Diesel Mechanic or equivalent trade background.
  • Previous supervisory, leading hand or team leadership experience within a workshop, field service, mining, heavy diesel or engine product environment.
  • Strong technical understanding of diesel engines, diagnostics, repairs, preventative maintenance and service operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop and support technicians while managing competing priorities in a fast-paced service environment.
  • Strong communication, customer service, planning and problem-solving skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with customers and internal teams.
  • Solid diagnostic and IT capability, including confidence using service systems, documentation tools and business system input screens.
  • Experience with Cummins engines and heavy diesel products is highly regarded.

_At Cummins, we are an equal opportunity employer dedicated to diversity in the workplace. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, gender, colour, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity and/or expression, or other status protected by law._

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Situational adaptability - Adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Preferred)

Vocational diploma from relevant technical institution

Locally valid driving permit (Preferred)

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Advanced level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products

Experience providing technical advice and coaching to more junior technicians (preferred)

Looking after both Workshop and Field operations.

FIFO 8:6 roster

HR and forklift licence required

job.description:
Job Summary

Servant leader and coach to cross-functional teams in their understanding of delivering valuable outcomes through modern delivery practices and product centric operating model. Coaches on frameworks and methodologies, enabling the teams and Product Managers to inspire innovation, high performance and to embrace continuous improvement. When opportunities arise, coaches in organizational change to help the teams embrace agility. Help form the teams, establish practices and norms, ensure focus, facilitate events, identify and manage risks, dependences and remove impediments.

Key Responsibilities

Establishes lean/agile leadership, supports the Product Manager, and promotes quality practices; Coaches team members on modern delivery practices & provides developmental feedback to team members using a servant leadership style and leading by example. Support Product Managers and teams' backlog refinement and release planning, and identifying tangible and measurable business outcomes across multiple teams. Fosters an environment of mutual respect and cooperation, transparency, and autonomy; Coaches the adoption of product centric operating model reducing the gap between theory and practice; facilitates continuous improvement process and creates the right environment. Monitors and reports key metrics that impact value driven delivery and indicate potential problems; facilitate the creation of definition of done to ensure organizational standards are met for the solution (Documentation, Compliance, Architectural and Governance constraints). Establishes and communicates team progress and goals to keep the teams work visible, celebrate wins, highlight roadblocks through various methods. Supports team rules and norms and protects the team from outside interference; removes impediments for the teams and/or finds the right personnel to remove impediments. job.description:
Job Summary

Defines the product vision, and roadmap, ensuring alignment with customer needs, business goals, and market trends; Leads the end-to-end lifecycle of a complex, high-impact product. Drives business outcomes and continuous improvement leveraging financial insights, team metrics, KPIs and inspiring teams to achieve excellence. Accountable for maximizing product value. Act as the voice of the customer in planning sessions and related events.

Key Responsibilities

Define and evolve the product vision and roadmap; lead the teams in delivering solutions oriented around business impact ensuring it supports business goals and representing the voice of the customer. Conducts market research, user interviews, and data analysis to inform product decisions, define personas and their pain points ensuring these insights inform product requirements and solution development. Technical understanding of the scope of enabler work; Collaborates with Enterprise and Solution Architect/Engineering to assist decisions and sequencing of technology enablers. Shape product backlog with clearly defined and prioritized user stories, defects, enablers and acceptance criteria, ensuring ongoing alignment with evolving business priorities and stakeholder expectations. Accepts user stories as done, including validation of the stories meeting acceptance criteria; has appropriate acceptance tests, and complies with the Definition of Done (DoD). Drive user acceptance testing and ensure features meet business and quality standards before release. Partner with the Scrum Master/s and Agile Coach/s to drive continuous improvement. In partnership with InfoSec / legal teams, ensure that systems meet company standards for security, compliance and data privacy. Participate in release planning, sprint planning and demos with stakeholders; Actively participate in PI Planning, System Demos, and Inspect & Adapt events as the voice of the customer. Define and track key team performance metrics, KPIs and objectives and key results (OKRs) to ensure alignment with strategic goals. Work closely with business owners and other stakeholders to define product goals, success metrics, roadmap and establish the products’ business value, support messaging, communication and customer outreach as necessary. job.title: Procurement Risk Analyst
job.description:
The Procurement Risk Analyst supports procurement and supply chain operations by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating supplier and supply chain risks to ensure business continuity and operational efficiency. This role executes procurement strategies aligned with material buying plans, with a focus on improving supplier performance, capacity readiness, and risk mitigation ahead of demand. The position requires strong analytical capabilities, supplier risk management expertise, data visualization skills, and stakeholder collaboration to provide actionable insights that support procurement decision-making and supply continuity. The analyst will also act as a data steward, ensuring data quality, governance, and consistency across procurement systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze supplier and supply chain data to identify risks, vulnerabilities, and potential business impacts, and provide actionable insights to procurement and business leaders.
  • Coordinate with sourcing managers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to assess risks and develop mitigation and business continuity plans.
  • Support supplier performance improvement initiatives while maintaining high-quality product and service delivery.
  • Monitor supplier capacity, continuity of supply, reputational risks, and margin-related risks, and proactively implement risk mitigation strategies.
  • Prepare and present recommendations for process improvements, risk reduction opportunities, and alternative courses of action to procurement leadership.
  • Support procurement operations related to supplier onboarding, qualification, contract management, payment issues, and order fulfillment.
  • Serve as the communication conduit between suppliers, sourcing teams, and manufacturing facilities during supplier issues or disruptions.
  • Provide delivery and expediting support to plants/sites during supplier constraints or operational challenges.
  • Support management and execution of engineering releases impacting suppliers.
  • Collect, validate, and maintain supplier scorecard data and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Act as a Data Steward by ensuring data integrity, governance, quality, and consistency across procurement systems.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and automations using tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Excel, and database systems to improve efficiency and visibility.
  • Proactively monitor procurement systems, identify issues, and drive corrective actions to ensure uninterrupted operations.
  • Document and share best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement initiatives across procurement teams.
  • Drive process automation and system enhancements to improve productivity and reduce manual effort.

Skills & Competencies

  • Supply Base Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate supplier risks related to supply continuity, reputation, and profitability.
  • Data Analytics & Visualization: Strong capability to analyze qualitative and quantitative data, identify trends, and present actionable insights using dashboards and reporting tools.
  • Procurement Systems Knowledge: Proficiency in ERP and procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle, Ariba, and related purchasing, quality, and payment systems.
  • Advanced Technical Skills: Expertise in Advanced Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA, Macros), Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, and reporting automation.
  • Supplier Performance Management: Ability to monitor supplier KPIs, manage corrective actions, and drive continuous supplier improvement.
  • Supplier Capacity Management: Understanding of supplier capacity planning, forecasting, and demand alignment.
  • Contract Management: Ability to assess contractual terms, monitor supplier compliance, and manage contract lifecycle activities.
  • Problem Solving: Strong root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving using data-driven methodologies.
  • Negotiation Excellence: Ability to support negotiations to achieve mutually beneficial business outcomes.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong collaboration and relationship-building with suppliers, sourcing teams, manufacturing, and internal stakeholders.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence and present insights effectively.
  • Escalation & Conflict Management: Ability to manage escalations calmly and resolve issues with minimal business disruption.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: Ability to identify inefficiencies, implement process improvements, and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Agility & Decision Making: Quick decision-making capability with strong business judgment in dynamic environments.

Experience

  • Minimum 5–6 years of experience in procurement, supply chain analytics, supplier management, or source-to-pay operations.
  • Hands-on experience in procurement data analysis, business intelligence, and visualization tools.
  • Experience in supplier risk management and business continuity planning.
  • Exposure to end-to-end Source-to-Pay processes including supplier qualification, onboarding, contract management, and payment cycles.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in global or matrix organizations.
  • Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments preferred.

Additional Information

  • Work Location: Cummins India Technical Center (IOC), Pune, India
  • Shift Timing: Afternoon / EMEA Shift (12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST)
  • Work Mode: Hybrid / On-site with flexibility

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred, with specialization in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations.
  • Additional certifications in Risk Management, Procurement, Project Management (PMP/Prince2), or Data Analytics are an advantage.

job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for analyzing and gathering business and technical requirements to design and document fit-for-purpose solutions. Contributes to solution development, design, integration and testing, and configuration of technology solutions ensuring that delivered solutions adhere to defined architecture and security standards. Works closely with with cross-functional teams, vendors, and business partners to ensure smooth execution and continuous improvement in solution performance and quality. Ensure seamless solution implementation and effective issue resolution.

Key Responsibilities

Supports the design of fit-for-purpose solutions by collaborating with stakeholders to identify integration points and ensure alignment with business processes and goals. Supports technical analysis, design and customization of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial-off-the-shelf products versus custom built solution. Develops and maintains technical design documents, workflows, and architecture diagrams. Assists in defining and executing the test strategy and validating solutions against business objectives. Ensures smooth interoperability by validating integrations and documenting configuration steps. Identifies and communicates potential technical dependencies and risks. Works with vendors and IT service providers to address technical issues, evaluate and improve product functionality and ensure proper configuration according to design specifications. Designs and implements data migration solutions to ensure data accuracy and reliability. Develops, designs, tests, maintains and configures solutions and systems as needed. Serves as subject matter expert and point of contact on content, processes, procedures and functionality associated with assigned applications for projects and application support (as needed). Documents recommendations to enhance business process efficiency and increase adoption of standard application features and capabilities, aligning solutions with enterprise standards. Supports continuous improvement initiatives by following established design standards and learning to identify potential enhancements in solution design or workflow efficiency. Assists technical and infrastructure groups in understanding the solution design and specifications. Works closely with IT technical service providers to ensure outsourced work packages are delivered to specifications, meeting key parameters of quality, schedule, cost, data privacy, security, performance, and scalability. job.title: Electrician - Level I
job.description:
Job Summary

As part of a formal skilled trades training program, assists site Electrician skilled trades to learn and develop electrical skills in a manufacturing environment under direct guidance. Apprentice will be required to successfully complete and document specified classes and a minimum quantity of on the job training hours. Learns and understands the protocols of working safely with electricity and other energy sources with industrial equipment.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards.
  • Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard.
  • Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment.
  • Promote interdependence by looking out for one another.
  • Correct hazards within your control and capabilities.
  • Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact.
  • Engage in HSE Training.

Quality

  • Learns and applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship.
  • Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis.
  • Performs supervised work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments.
  • Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system.
  • Follows all process documentation and quality procedures.
  • Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures.
  • Performs quality inspections.

Delivery

  • Attends required classes to build basic electrical skills and knowledge to qualify as an Electrician.
  • Completes all required on the job training hours.
  • Repairs and maintains manufacturing equipment and other miscellaneous duties within their capabilities .
  • Assists with preventive, emergency, corrective and predictive maintenance activities.
  • Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks.

Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork

  • Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams.
  • Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements.
  • Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Electrical System Troubleshooting - Analyzes an electrical control system to resolve and repair electrical issues to return the system to proper operating conditions.

Factory Automation and Control Systems - Implements changes to further automate manufacturing processes using available technology, programming techniques, and identifying needed material and resources for project completion to provide the optimum automation for the manufacturing environment.

Machine Programming - Creates factory floor machine programs by designing and implementing solutions to improve usage of machine and overall operation.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Minimal or no work experience required.

CNC HMC Electrical / Mechatronics - Maintenance Technician :

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform routine maintenance and repairs on CNC HMC machines to ensure optimal performance.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical issues, including electrical ,hydraulic, pneumatic, and lubrication , coolant systems.
  • Conduct inspections and preventative or Predictive maintenance to minimize machine downtime.
  • Coordinate with production staff to schedule maintenance activities without disrupting operations.
  • Document maintenance activities, repairs, and parts usage accurately and timely ordered shortages required parts. and coordinate with CIP team for spare parts procurements and localization and on time delivery.
  • Train and supervise less experienced maintenance staff as needed. prepares SOPs / One point lessons for important learnings and procedures.
  • Implement maintenance programs and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Work on cost saving / energy saving / Kaizens / and promote and initiate to use of green energy in plant.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 4-5 years of hands-on electronics /electrical maintenance experience, specifically with CNC machines, preferably HMCs.
  • Education: Technical diploma / degree or certification in mechatronics engineering, industrial maintenance, or a related field.
  • Knowledge:
  • Strong understanding of CNC machine operation and maintenance. Ball screw / Table / Fixture / APCs / Guideways / HMCs Spindle / Bearing replacement / Pump - motor replacements repairs.

and Homing / Backlash / MDI - edit mode uses / of Siemens CNC - Sinumeric 1 and Siemens 828 systems with Siemens TIA Portal V 17 / 18 /19.

ATLAS COPCO / DESOUTERS nut runners. / LASER MARKING / GUDEL GANTERY / NAGEL HONNING / ECO Clean Cylinder block and cylinder head washing machine / Intermediate washing machines / TOX Leak test and Cup plug pressing / MARPOSS Gauging system in Nagel / VISION System and End to end traceability / CMES system understanding / Siemens Servo motor / Grundfos's pump motor / VFDs maintenance / CENTRALIZED COOLANT SYSTEM - PUMP out technologies / Over head Cranes 5T / 3T / 2T and .5T / Material Handling equipment's /Gauges and MMD calibrations / able to create GHOST Backups of IPCs on regular interval and backup management of PLC/CNC and other Programs / able to read and understand the ckt. diagrams of electrical / Pneumatics / lub / coolant and mechanical drawings.

  • Familiarity with mechanical components, hydraulic systems, and basic electrical circuits.
  • Knowledge of tooling and work holding systems relevant to HMC operations.
  • Skills:
  • Proficiency in using hand tools, diagnostic equipment, and machine tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Backup management / Software management / I4.0 automations and others
  • Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, schematics, and blueprints and other maintenance documentation work.
  • Certifications: Relevant certifications (e.g., OSHA safety, CNC machining) are a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Effective communication, teamwork, and time management abilities. And able to report collection related to maintenance facilities parameter and prepare and share MIS on weekly /basis.

Additional Preferences:

  • Experience with specific brands or models of CNC HMCs.
  • MAG / MAKINO / MAZAK
  • Prior experience in a manufacturing or production environment. in Cylinder block and head manufacturing.

Working Conditions:

  • Ability to work varying shifts and overtime as required. with self motivated and positive attitude.
  • Physical ability to lift heavy machinery components and perform tasks in confined spaces.
  • Follow Cummins Safety Policy and standards.

job.description:
Our culture believes in POWERING YOUR POTENTIAL. We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what #LifeAtCummins is all about.

Working under the supervision of a qualified Cummins Technician, you will learn everything that comes with the diagnosis and repair of Cummins engines and products.

What’s in it for you?

  • Earn while you learn, we pay above award rates.
  • Mechanical starter toolkit provided upon commencement.
  • Obtain a nationally recognized Certificate III trade qualification.
  • Complete off-the-job TAFE/Registered Training Organization study.
  • Receive structured on-the-job training, under the supervision of our Regional Capability Trainers, as well as the qualified technicians and supervisors in your workshop.
  • Gain your experience working on a range of our world class Cummins engine products.
  • Improve your technical expertise by completing a range of engine product training with Cummins Technical Trainers as you progress through your apprenticeship

About you

Cummins are looking for applicants with the following attributes:

  • A positive attitude and eagerness to learn.
  • A passion for working on our products and in the industry.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well in a team.
  • Excellent level of language, literacy, and numeracy skills
  • A willingness to work across regional areas and rotate through different departments to gain experience on automotive, industrial, marine, and mining engine products as you progress through your apprenticeship.
  • Right to work in Australia
  • Preference to have completed year 12 or equivalent.
  • A strong focus on safety and wellbeing that will lead to a successful career at Cummins.
  • Willingness to embrace diversity and make Cummins a great place to work.

Applications close date: 31st July 2026

At Cummins, we are an equal opportunity employer dedicated to diversity in the workplace. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, gender, colour, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity and/or expression, or other status protected by law.

job.title: On Site Service Technician - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

Technical specialist and regular customer support contact to diagnose and complete less complex repairs to Cummins products at a single customer’s site.

Key Responsibilities

Engages customers in a courteous and professional manner. Anticipates and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs Applies the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete less complex repairs, including identifying and preparing required parts and tools Coaches on preventative maintenance activities and basic repairs completed by customer employees Escalates unresolved issues to more experienced On Site Technicians and/or Supervisor Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens. Completes training in line with skill and business requirements Maintains work area and tools for cleanliness and proper operation Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Apprentice Certified Power Generation or Engine Technician (Preferred)

Vocational diploma from relevant technical institution

Current relevant electrical certification (optional)

Locally valid driving permit

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Basic level field service work experience

Intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with power generation or engine products

High Voltage/ Low Voltage experience (optional)

Customer service experience

job.title: Field Service Supervisor
job.description:
We are looking for a talented Supervisor – Field ServiceMechanical to join our team specialising in, repairs and servicing and support of Cummins engines in Automotive, industrial, Marine, High horsepower and Power generation applications for our Adelaide branch. This key appointment is responsible for coordinating all off-site based activities whilst providing direction to a team of dedicated field service technicians.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Efficiently manage the day to day running of field service work,
  • Plan, schedule and allocate all field service repair events for the branch,
  • Lead, mentor, and coach field service technicians - remotely supervise repairs and sign off on Technicians work - track and measure technician productivity and performance,
  • Building and maintaining relationships with customers and suppliers,
  • Provide technical support to the staff.
  • Maintain a safe workplace in accordance with OH&S requirements. Conduct quality checks. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement initiatives
  • Maintain a high level of housekeeping, workflow, and traffic management in the site.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Proven supervisory/leadership experience with a strong technical background – ideally within heavy diesel
  • Significant experience in a workshop environment with Strong leadership and people management skills
  • Heavy Vehicle qualification - preferred
  • Motivated towards developing a high performing and professional team and their commitment to safety and providing exceptional customer service

Provide strong HSE direction , maintain Compliance standards

100% On-Site No

job.title: People Support Specialist Lead - CDBS India
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for the deployment of specialized HR processes and programs within designated geography or sub-geography, specialization may include but not limited to employee/labor relations, compensation or talent development. Provides specialized support for complex enquiries. Delivers specialist solutions that enhance the employee experience, create seamless HR solutions for the end-user, drive efficiency and are compliant with local legislation and company policies. The role will leverage the full HR function to meet business needs and deliver as one HR team.

Key Responsibilities

Addresses escalated inquiries promptly and effectively, providing high-quality support for complex issues to deliver enhanced experiences to managers and employees.

Coaches employees and managers on specialist Human Resources processes, programs and initiatives.

Builds and maintains relationships with key stakeholders including employees, managers, and internal HR teams to ensure effective communication and collaboration for the HR specialism.

Oversees local adjustments to specialist HR policies and processes.

Efficiently and proactively execute specialized processes, ensuring delivery is in accordance with established standards; monitors legislative compliance and takes action to ensure all requirements and agreements are met.

Ensures the consistent delivery and application of HR knowledge to resolve employee and manager specialist enquiries.

Ensures the voice of employees and managers are heard and shared with the right stakeholders.

Champions excellence in customer support and drives continuous improvement, setting high standards for the team in delivering HR solutions.

Leads and participates in initiatives to improve the overall effectiveness of human resources processes; leads specific improvement initiatives in specialist areas, and/or for the enterprise or geography/sub-geography.

Competencies:Employee Relations - Builds constructive relationships with employees and other stakeholders; reinforces consistent application of Cummins standards applies knowledge of employment and labor law; effectively manages conflict; builds and maintains a collaborative, productive work environment through information sharing and consultation.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Human Resources Consulting - Collaborates with partners to observe the environment and apply sound judgment informed by knowledge, skills, and experiences to diagnose, identify and optimize opportunities to provide holistic solutions, while balancing the needs of stakeholders, primarily employees, with those of the organization.

Human Resources Business Process Execution - Manages the execution of Human Resources business processes, seeking efficiency, accuracy, positive business performance outcomes and operational agility; integrates activities across processes as needed; assures compliance with process and legal requirements; effectively balances process requirements and business leader needs.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Demonstrates self-awareness - Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Facilitation - Guides group discussions or training by creating an active environment where questions are posed, perspectives are shared, and debates occur with the goal of gaining understanding, analyzing issues, resolving conflict, exploring solutions, or making decisions.

job.title: Product Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, product focused position performs established technical tasks at the sub-system and/or component level for current and future products within a given business unit or corporate area. This involves work across many steps in the product life cycle. Because of the product centered nature of this position, they are very often a central point of coordination and decision making between product line engineers, customer teams, systems engineers, purchasing, suppliers and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Main focus will include working in business processes of Product Preceding Technology (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI) or Current Product Support (CPS) and executing technical processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) while using tools such as 7-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Applies academic knowledge and existing experience to take action and make decisions that progress projects forward without sacrificing project quality expectations. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Competencies:

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.

Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems - Acquires and applies an in-depth understanding of mechanical systems through working knowledge that guides a designer’s ability to create innovative and sound design concepts to meet Cummins and customer expectations; designs for requirements of all lifecycle stages by considering the customer requirements in different operating environments to ensure a robust system.

Mechanical Design Specification - Creates complete specifications in the form of solid models, configured engineering bill of materials and detailed drawings that cross-functionally communicate the information required to manufacture and inspect a product per its design intent; considers national, international, industry, and Cummins’ standards that accurately and concisely define the part specification.

Product Configuration and Change Management - Establishes a baseline of identified product artifacts to be placed under configuration management; releases, tracks, controls and communicates changes from concept to obsolescence often through work requests; establishes and maintains the integrity of the product artifact baselines.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Interface Management and Integration - Identifies and analyzes the interfaces and interactions across system boundaries by specifying the requirements and limits to ensure that the product meets requirements; controls the interactions across the system element boundaries by making sure that they remain within specified limits; integrates system elements by creating an integration plan, including identification of method and timing for each activity to make it easier to find, isolate, diagnose, and correct.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
