job.title: Solution Engineering Manager – Primary Engineering (AIS/GIS Substations)
job.description:
Solution Engineering Manager – Primary Engineering

Location: Kolkata

A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Solution Engineer – Primary Engineering, you will play a key role in the engineering and design of High Voltage (HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) substations, supporting the successful execution of power transmission and distribution projects across industries, data centers, utilities, and grid substations.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing primary engineering solutions for AIS substations up to 765kV and GIS substations up to 400kV. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams including Secondary Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Procurement, Project Management, and Customers to deliver technically optimized, compliant, and cost-effective solutions. Your technical expertise will contribute to ensuring quality, reliability, safety, and operational excellence throughout the project lifecycle.

We are looking for a passionate and technically strong electrical engineering professional with experience in substation primary engineering, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within diverse project teams.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Prepare Design Basis Reports and technical specifications for electrical systems.
  • Develop Single Line Diagrams (SLD), substation layouts, sections, and arrangements for various bus configurations.
  • Design electrical clearance diagrams, cable containment systems, and earthing systems.
  • Perform DSLP and grounding design calculations in compliance with project requirements and industry standards.
  • Conduct conductor sizing, short-circuit force calculations, and sag-tension calculations for transmission and substation applications.
  • Perform sizing calculations and equipment selection for Transformers, MV/LV Switchgear, DC Systems, Battery Systems, Battery Chargers, and UPS systems.
  • Support preparation of customer proposals, Bill of Materials (BOM), Request for Quotations (RFQs), and technical documentation.
  • Review customer specifications and perform vendor drawing reviews for EHV equipment, transformers, cables, and associated systems.
  • Collaborate with Secondary Engineering teams and support mechanical system design activities.
  • Coordinate engineering interfaces with Civil, Mechanical, Protection, and Substation Automation System (SAS) teams.
  • Participate in offer reviews, technical discussions, and engineering clarifications with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable Indian and international standards, project specifications, and quality requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing engineering quality, efficiency, and standardization.
  • Contribute to successful project execution by providing innovative and technically optimized engineering solutions.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Electrical Engineering.
  • Experience in Primary Engineering for AIS and GIS Substation Projects serving Industrial, Data Center, State Electricity Board (SEB), and Grid Substation customers.
  • Experience related to AIS Substations up to 765kV and GIS Substations up to 400kV is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of primary engineering design principles for HV and EHV substations.
  • Expertise in preparation of SLDs, layouts, sections, electrical clearance diagrams, cable containment systems, and earthing designs.
  • Knowledge of equipment sizing and selection for Transformer, MV, LV, DC, Battery, Battery Charger, and UPS systems.
  • Familiarity with conductor sizing, short-circuit force calculations, and sag-tension calculations.
  • Understanding of load flow studies, short-circuit studies, and relay coordination principles will be an added advantage.
  • Basic understanding of Protection Systems, Substation Automation Systems (SAS), and Auxiliary System Design.
  • Working knowledge of Indian and International standards and regulations relevant to substation engineering.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, ETAP, MS Office, and other engineering design tools.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams.
  • Demonstrated commitment to technical excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous learning.

Key Success Indicators

  • Engineering Quality and Design Accuracy
  • On-Time Engineering Deliverables
  • Compliance with Technical Specifications and Standards
  • Customer Satisfaction
  • Proposal and Tender Quality
  • Design Optimization and Cost Competitiveness
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration Effectiveness
  • Engineering Productivity
  • Project Execution Support
  • Continuous Improvement Contributions

About Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL)

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customer installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping countries navigate their energy transition and achieve their net-zero ambitions.

SEIL is a pure-play energy technology company, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support customers across the entire energy value chain. Our portfolio includes low-to-zero emission power generation, power transmission and storage, and industrial decarbonization solutions.

More information: www.siemens-energy-india.com

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by #TeamPurpleIndia. Siemens Energy celebrates character regardless of ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical insurance coverage for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Meal Card options as per company policy.
  • Flexi Pay structure enabling employees to optimize select salary components within approved ranges.
  • Opportunities to work on innovative power transmission and substation engineering projects supporting the global energy transition.
  • Exposure to multidisciplinary engineering teams and advanced substation technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities in a global engineering environment.

Job Title: Account Manager

Industry: Smart Infrastructure / Energy Efficiency, Decarbonization and Digital Solutions

Function: Sales – Sustainability Solutions

________

About the Role

As the Sales Manager for Sustainability and Digitalisation for Fleet Vertical, you will drive strategic sales efforts focused on Siemens’ sustainability themes of energy efficiency and decarbonization. You will be responsible for independently generating leads, engaging hospitality, healthcare, aviation and data-centre clients, and driving adoption of Siemens’ integrated solutions that help reduce energy consumption, optimize operations, and support clients’ net-zero goals.

________

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation & Prospecting

  • Independently identify and qualify manufacturing clients with sustainability ambitions.
  • Develop outreach strategies using industry networks, events, digital platforms, and referrals.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities aligned with Siemens’ energy efficiency and decarbonization themes.

Sales Strategy & Business Development

  • Execute go-to-market strategies for Siemens’ sustainability offerings in manufacturing.
  • Collaborate with regional and vertical sales teams to expand market reach.
  • Drive strategic account planning and territory development.

Consultative Selling & Client Engagement

  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand client sustainability goals and operational challenges.
  • Present tailored solutions focused on energy optimization, carbon footprint reduction, and sustainable operations.
  • Co-create proposals with technical teams and ensure alignment with client ROI and ESG targets.

Revenue Growth & Target Achievement

  • Own and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets with accurate forecasting.
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts.

Market Intelligence & Positioning

  • Stay updated on sustainability trends, regulatory changes, and competitor strategies.
  • Provide feedback to product and marketing teams to refine positioning and messaging.
  • Represent Siemens in industry forums and sustainability events.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, delivery, and product teams to ensure solution feasibility and client success.
  • Support post-sales implementation and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Share client insights to influence roadmap and innovation.

________

What You Bring

  • Experience: 8+ years in sales, with strong exposure to sustainability and energy solutions.
  • Sales Expertise: Proven track record in lead generation, consultative selling, and strategic account management.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of manufacturing operations, energy systems, and sustainability drivers.
  • Solar Experience: Prior experience in selling solar solutions will be a strong advantage.
  • Tools Proficiency: CRM systems (Salesforce), MS Office is a must
  • Communication: Strong presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Electrical & Technical Acumen: You demonstrate strong knowledge of complex technical products, including modular electrical buildings (eHouses), Medium Voltage (MV) and Low Voltage (LV) systems, switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, and related site installations.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience working across time zones

job.title: Director, Global Service Delivery - APAC based
job.description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Director, Global Service Delivery (SD) is a senior leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across three global regions — Americas, EMEA, and APAC — serving approximately 17,000 software engineers worldwide. The Director is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, people leadership, and the ongoing transformation of the SD function.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and execute the global Service Delivery strategy aligned with GES and GTI priorities.
  • Set the vision, operating model (Follow-the-Sun), and performance standards for SD across all three regions.
  • Lead the annual planning cycle for SD: headcount, budget, initiatives, and OKRs.
  • Represent the SD function at GES leadership reviews, executive briefings, and cross-functional forums.
  • Drive continuous improvement in service delivery maturity, tooling, and process standardization.

Operational Excellence

  • Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported.
  • Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance.
  • Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices.
  • Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc).
  • Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively.

People Leadership

  • Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.
  • Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.
  • Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

  • Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.
  • Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

  • Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.
  • Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.
  • Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.
  • Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Required

  • Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.
  • Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.
  • Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).
  • Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.
  • Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.
  • Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.
  • Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.
  • Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.
  • Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

  • Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.
  • Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).
  • Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.
  • Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.
  • Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.
  • Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION

Degree — Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS

IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

  • ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.
  • COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

  • PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.
  • PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL

This is a global role with flexibility on base location.

Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE

Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)

Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC

Functional scope: Full global SD organization

We are Siemens:

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.

You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

job.title: Critical Power Solution Engineer
job.description:
Are you a creative Critical Power Architect who wants to shape reliable, efficient, and more sustainable power infrastructure for hyperscale and colocation data centres? Join our Center of Competence for Data Centers team at Siemens and help shape the future of smart critical power solutions in a role that combines technical ownership with customer interaction in an international environment.

You'll make a difference by:

  • Designing end-to-end critical power architecture: Taking charge of the main electrical infrastructure for Data Centers (from grid connection and MV distribution down to LV distribution) and translating complex client requirements into engineered solutions.
  • Driving the technical sales and execution strategy: Serving as the technical conscience for customers, leading clarifications, proposing value engineering solutions, and owning key design choices from the initial capture phase through to project execution.
  • Integrating complex, large-scale systems: Collaborating with international factories and specialists to seamlessly integrate switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, and automation into complete packaged solutions like modular E-Houses or pre-assembled skids.
  • Managing critical interfaces and project lifecycles: Coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders (consultants, contractors, operators) to resolve technical gaps while maintaining a sharp focus on safety, risk management, and long-term efficiency.

You'll win us over by:

  • Bringing deep technical expertise: Holding a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Power Engineering alongside at least 8 years of experience designing medium-to-low voltage power distribution systems, ideally in critical data center environments.
  • Demonstrating a holistic, generalist mindset: Showing a strong understanding of how multiple subsystems interact (switchgear, protection, batteries, HVAC) and possessing a passion for interface management and creative, out-of-the-box thinking.
  • Exhibiting stellar communication and resilience: Having the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, while confidently navigating both short and long design cycles.
  • Balancing a big-picture view with sharp execution: Proving you can successfully juggle multiple projects and tight deadlines without losing sight of critical details, industry standards (like IEC), or compliance requirements.

What we offer

  • Flexibility: Inclusive and flexible working environment with hybrid and remote options.
  • Welfare: Comprehensive welfare programs and health insurance extendable to your family; professional accident insurance.
  • Growth opportunities: Continuous and individual learning journeys.
  • Inclusive culture: A team culture where you can be yourself.

This is what happens after you apply:

  • CV Screening
  • Talk with our recruiter to get to know your motivation & your experience
  • 2-3 Business Interviews
  • Offer

Come join us, and #TransformTheEveryday through technology!

Siemens is an equal opportunity employer, offering a safe and inclusive work environment, based on mutual respect and the appreciation of uniqueness, guaranteeing equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates to unleash their full potential.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Join an established Siemens delivery team as a Project Manager – Electrification & Automation, leading the successful delivery of medium and low voltage electrical systems and packaged solutions across a diverse range of markets, including utilities, renewables, mining, infrastructure, and data centres.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of projects from initial requirements clarification through to design, procurement, manufacture, FAT, delivery, installation, testing, and final verification. You’ll work closely with customers, engineering teams, factories, and suppliers to develop practical, technically sound solutions that meet customer requirements while delivering strong commercial outcomes.

You’ll be responsible for the overall performance of your projects, including project profitability and P&L, contract compliance, variations and change management, risk management, quality, delivery milestones, and customer satisfaction. A key part of the role will be understanding customer needs, providing technical guidance and identifying opportunities to optimise solutions and project outcomes.

Working across internal engineering and factory teams, as well as external partners and suppliers, you’ll coordinate resources and provide clear direction to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required technical and commercial standards. You’ll also represent Siemens throughout the project lifecycle, building strong customer relationships and providing transparent, timely reporting on project performance and risks.

You’ll bring proven experience in project management and/or switchgear delivery management, with a track record of successfully delivering projects against customer, technical, commercial and time requirements. You’re a confident problem solver and communicator who can build strong relationships with customers and stakeholders while maintaining a clear focus on achieving reliable project outcomes.

Knowledge of medium and low voltage switchgear and associated electrical equipment will be highly advantageous, as will experience working with Siemens factories and/or third-party supply chains and procurement across relevant markets.

You’ll be comfortable managing competing priorities, identifying and mitigating technical and commercial risks, and taking ownership of project outcomes from concept through to completion.

Full working rights in Australia are required for this position.

If you’re looking to take the next step in your project management career and play a key role in delivering complex electrification solutions across some of Australia’s most important industries, we’d love to hear from you.

We are committed to ensuring our workplace reflects the communities in which we operate, that everyone has access to the same opportunities and is treated fairly, and that we actively empower the voices of every individual voice.

We strive to provide a safe working environment for each member of our diverse team and commit to continuously develop our ways of working on this journey. job.title: Medallia Solution Architect
job.description:
Job Summary

As a Medallia Architect, you will be responsible for leading the implementation, configuration, support and continuous improvement of the Medallia Experience Management platform. The role will oversee platform administration, survey programs, integrations, reporting, case management, user enablement and operational governance to ensure reliable delivery of customer and employee experience insights. You will work closely with business stakeholders, CX teams, IT teams, data teams, vendors and regional users to translate business requirements into scalable Medallia solutions and ensure high-quality platform operations across global or regional deployments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the Medallia platform team responsible for configuration, administration, support, enhancement delivery and operational governance of Medallia programs.
  • Translate business requirements into Medallia solution designs covering surveys, forms, feedback channels, dashboards, reports, alerts, workflows, case management and role-based access.
  • Manage end-to-end delivery of Medallia enhancements, including requirement analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, hypercare and handover to operations.
  • Coordinate integrations between Medallia and enterprise systems such as CRM, contact center platforms, data warehouses, identity management, ticketing tools and reporting platforms.
  • Provide functional and technical guidance to team members on Medallia configuration standards, data structures, survey logic, reporting design, workflows and platform best practices.
  • Monitor platform performance, data quality, user adoption, issue trends and operational KPIs to ensure stable and effective Medallia service delivery.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex Medallia incidents, integration issues, reporting defects, access concerns and business-critical platform queries.
  • Maintain solution documentation, configuration standards, release notes, operating procedures, support playbooks and continuous improvement backlog for Medallia capabilities.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Strong hands-on experience in Medallia Experience Management platform administration, configuration, program setup and operational support.
  • Good understanding of Medallia capabilities including survey design, invitations, feedback collection, reporting, dashboards, role-based access, alerts, workflows and case management.
  • Experience managing customer experience, employee experience, contact center feedback, transactional surveys or relationship survey programs.
  • Knowledge of data management concepts, data feeds, integrations, SSO, user provisioning, hierarchy management, file-based interfaces, APIs and reporting data structures.
  • Hands-on experience with data lake platforms such as Snowflake, including data ingestion, transformation, integration patterns and operational data management for enterprise applications.
  • Practical experience setting up integrations with enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, CRM platforms and other business applications using APIs, middleware, file-based interfaces or data connectors.
  • Strong SQL and database management skills, with experience in SQL Server and MySQL, including data querying, analysis, troubleshooting, and reporting to support business and operational requirements.
  • Experience working with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define use cases, document process flows and convert feedback program needs into platform configuration.
  • Ability to lead a small technical or functional team, assign work, review deliverables, manage priorities, create roadmap and ensure timely resolution of incidents and enhancement requests.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret feedback data, reporting issues, integration errors and platform behavior to support business decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with business, IT, vendors and regional teams in a global delivery environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
  • 8-10 years of overall IT, customer experience, analytics, digital platform or enterprise application experience.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of practical experience with Medallia platform implementation, integration, configuration, administration, support or program management.
  • Medallia certifications or formal Medallia product training in platform administration, reporting, integration or experience management are preferred.
  • Experience with CX metrics such as NPS, CSAT, CES, closed-loop feedback, journey analytics, text analytics or contact center experience programs is an advantage.
  • Experience working in global transformation programs, multi-country rollouts, managed service environments or distributed delivery teams is preferred.

job.title: Senior System Engineer – BIM/AutoCAD
job.description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a phenomenal addition to our vibrant international team.

We are looking for a Senior System Engineer – BIM/AutoCAD

We are looking for a Senior BIM/AutoCAD Engineer to create, coordinate, validate and deliver BIM models and CAD drawings for Mobility Telecom projects. The role will transform telecom design inputs into accurate digital models, coordinated layouts, quantity outputs, customer submissions and as-built handover deliverables.

You’ll make a difference by:

  • Develop and coordinate BIM models and AutoCAD drawings for Network, Radio, PAS/PIDS, CCTV and related Mobility Telecom infrastructure.
  • Prepare telecom room layouts, rack elevations, equipment placement, cable tray/duct/conduit routes, routing drawings, BOM/BOQ and as-built documentation.
  • Create Revit families, templates and telecom content libraries for antennas, radios, BBUs, cabinets, racks, fibre, power and data equipment.
  • Coordinate with design engineers, project managers, customers, suppliers and other disciplines to align design inputs, BIM models and CAD deliverables.
  • Lead model federation, clash detection, issue tracking, model reviews and resolution workflows using Revit, Navisworks and collaboration platforms.
  • Perform QA/QC checks, model health reviews and draw audits for accuracy, completeness, spatial coordination, metadata and submission readiness.

BIM Standards and Delivery:

  • Apply BIM standards, modelling protocols, naming conventions, CDE workflows and ISO 19650-aligned information management practices.
  • Support BEP, MIDP, TIDP, EIR alignment, model acceptance criteria and handover requirements across design, construction and as-built stages.
  • Review BIM scope, deliverables, compliance requirements, risks and effort estimate during tender and execution phases.
  • Ensure BIM models, federated models, Asset Information Models and as-built datasets meet project, regulatory and stakeholder requirements.
  • Generate cable length calculations, quantity take-offs, structured reports, progress updates, issue dashboards and handover documentation.

Continuous Improvement and Technical Leadership:

  • Resolve BIM coordination, model compliance, data quality, workflow and CDE-related issues during project delivery.
  • Improve BIM guidelines, templates, checklists, model audit processes and return-on-experience documentation.
  • Improve model accuracy, reduce clashes and rework, and strengthen collaboration between design, site and project teams.
  • Support OpenBIM, IFC/BCF, COBie, 4D/5D BIM, Digital Twin readiness and BIM automation initiatives.
  • Mentor BIM engineers, coordinators and modellers on standardised methods, technical discipline and knowledge sharing.

You’ll win us over by:

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or related field.
  • 8–12 years of BIM / Digital Engineering experience, preferably in mobility, rail, metro, telecom, infrastructure, data centre, industrial or building projects.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on Revit and AutoCAD experience in BIM modelling, CAD production, coordination and customer deliverables.
  • Knowledge of 4G/5G, fibre connectivity, telecom rooms, rack layouts, radio systems, network systems, PAS/PIDS and CCTV preferred.

Tools and Technical Skills:

  • Proficient in Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks Manage and clash detection / model review workflows.
  • Working knowledge of Civil 3D, Autodesk Recap, Solibri, BIMCollab, Autodesk Construction Cloud, ProjectWise, Wrench, Procore and Bluebeam Revu.
  • Familiarity with Dynamo, Twinmotion, Synchro, automation, visualisation, planning tools, COBie, IFC, BCF and asset information management is an advantage.

Behavioural Competencies:

  • Strong ownership, autonomy, responsiveness and accountability in managing deliverables, risks and coordination actions.
  • Excellent communication skills to explain BIM topics, influence stakeholders and convert findings into practical actions.
  • Collaborative mindset with willingness to mentor, share knowledge and support continuous improvement within the BIM network.
  • Advanced English speaking, writing and reading skills for global collaboration.

Summary

  • This position is suitable for an experienced BIM and AutoCAD professional with strong telecom project exposure, coordination capability, quality focus and digital delivery mindset. The candidate should be able to deliver accurate models and drawings, support project execution, improve BIM workflows and mentor team members across the project lifecycle.

Key Performance Indicators:

  • Delivery quality: BIM models and AutoCAD drawings accepted with minimal major comments.
  • Schedule adherence: On-time delivery of models, drawings, reports and as-built outputs.
  • Coordination effectiveness: Reduced clashes, repeated comments, interface gaps and rework.
  • Standards compliance: Consistent use of BIM standards, naming conventions, CDE workflows and ISO 19650-aligned practices.
  • Data accuracy: Reliable cable lengths, quantity take-offs, asset data, metadata and structured reports.
  • Digital improvement: Practical improvements to templates, checklists, workflows, automation and model audit practices.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction: Positive feedback on responsiveness, communication, technical support and deliverable usefulness.
  • Team development: Effective mentoring, knowledge sharing and capability building for BIM team members.

job.title: SRE Engineer
job.description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

Define, monitor, and enforce Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and Error Budgets for AI services, understand scalable, fault-tolerant infrastructure for AI model serving, training pipelines, and data workflows, maintain comprehensive observability stacks (metrics, logs, traces) using tools like Datadog or Open Telemetry.

Responsibilities

Enforce Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and Error Budgets for AI services

Lead incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortem processes to minimize downtime and prevent recurrence

Proactively identify and resolve reliability risks before they impact end users

Maintain scalable, fault-tolerant infrastructure for data pipelines, ML workflows and data workflows

Handle cloud infrastructure (Azure) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform

Oversee Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads (Docker) supporting AI microservices

Maintain comprehensive observability stacks (metrics, logs, traces) using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Open Telemetry

Develop intelligent alerting systems to detect anomalies in AI model performance, latency, and efficiency

Automate repetitive operational tasks through scripting and tooling (Python, Bash, Go)

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for model deployment and service updates

Implement MLOps practices to streamline the deployment and monitoring of ML models in production

Ensure infrastructure and services align with security guidelines and relevant regulatory standards

Partner with data engineers and data scientists to make AI systems production-ready

Foster a reliability-first culture across engineering teams

Contribute to on-call rotations and continuously improve on-call runbooks and playbooks

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field with 6-8 years of meaningful experience.

Demonstrated experience supporting production-grade, high-availability systems

Strong experience with Azure cloud services, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure DevOps, Azure Resource Manager (ARM), and monitoring tools.

Proven expertise in handling multi-tenant, microservices-based architectures and deploying high-availability solutions.

Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, or ARM templates for handling and automating cloud resources.

Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps/MLOps) and configuration management.

Solid understanding of containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes).

Secondary experience or familiarity with security practices, such as identity and access management (IAM), threat detection, and compliance standards.

Solid understanding of secure supply chain practices, including management of code dependencies and open-source libraries.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a proactive approach to operational and security issues.

Preferred Skills

Experience with supervising and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack) for proactive issue resolution.

Familiarity with zero-trust architecture principles

Knowledge of industry compliance standards, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR, is a plus.

Experience with scripting and automation tools, such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

Opportunities to work on ground breaking projects in cloud infrastructure and MLOps.

A collaborative, innovative work environment with room for career growth.

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

job.title: Medallia Developer
job.description:
Job Summary

As a Medallia Solution Designer, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, supporting and improving Medallia Experience Management solutions for customer and employee feedback programs. The role will focus on translating business requirements into practical Medallia configurations across surveys, feedback channels, dashboards, reporting, alerts, workflows, case management and user access. You will work closely with business stakeholders, CX teams, IT teams, data teams, vendors and regional users to deliver scalable, reliable and user-friendly Medallia solutions that support customer experience insights and closed-loop feedback processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and configure Medallia solutions for feedback programs, including surveys, forms, invitations, dashboards, reports, alerts, workflows and role-based access.
  • Work with business stakeholders to understand requirements, document use cases and translate customer experience needs into Medallia solution designs.
  • Support end-to-end delivery of Medallia enhancements, including requirement analysis, configuration, testing, deployment, hypercare and operational handover.
  • Assist in implementing and maintaining integrations between Medallia and enterprise systems such as CRM, contact center platforms, data warehouses, identity management and reporting platforms.
  • Configure and validate Medallia survey logic, reporting structures, user hierarchies, alert rules, case management workflows and access controls.
  • Analyze platform issues, data quality concerns, reporting defects and integration errors to support timely resolution and stable platform operations.
  • Collaborate with architects, product owners, developers, vendors and support teams to ensure Medallia designs align with platform standards and business needs.
  • Maintain solution documentation, configuration guides, test evidence, release notes and operational support documentation for Medallia capabilities.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Hands-on experience in Medallia Experience Management platform configuration, administration, survey setup, reporting and operational support.
  • Good understanding of Medallia capabilities including survey design, invitations, feedback collection, reporting, dashboards, alerts, workflows, case management and role-based access.
  • Experience supporting customer experience, employee experience, contact center feedback, transactional survey or relationship survey programs.
  • Knowledge of data management concepts, data feeds, hierarchy management, user provisioning, SSO, file-based interfaces, APIs and reporting data structures.
  • Experience of SQL development + hands on experience of Data Lake (Snowflake) including data ingestion, DBT setup will be an added value
  • Ability to gather requirements, document business processes, create functional designs and convert feedback program requirements into platform configuration.
  • Experience in testing, troubleshooting and supporting Medallia configurations, dashboards, survey logic, access issues and data-related defects.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand business requirements, platform behavior and reporting outputs.
  • Good communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with business, IT, vendor and regional teams in a global delivery environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
  • 4-5 years of overall IT, customer experience, analytics, digital platform or enterprise application experience.
  • Minimum 1-2 years of practical experience with Medallia platform implementation, configuration, administration, support or program delivery.
  • Medallia certifications or formal Medallia product training in platform administration, reporting, integration or experience management are preferred.
  • Experience with CX metrics such as NPS, CSAT, CES, OSAT, closed-loop feedback, journey analytics, text analytics or contact center experience programs is an advantage.
  • Experience working in global transformation programs, multi-country rollouts, managed service environments or distributed delivery teams is preferred.

job.title: Head of Data Centre Operations
job.description:
As Australia's digital economy continues to accelerate, Siemens is playing a critical role in enabling the next generation of data centre infrastructure. Through our Electrification & Automation business, we deliver innovative power distribution, automation, digitalisation and energy solutions that help hyperscale, colocation and enterprise customers build resilient, sustainable and high-performing facilities.

With significant growth across the Australian data centre market, we are expanding our leadership team and seeking an exceptional Head of Data Centre Operations to build and scale our project delivery capability nationally. This is a rare opportunity to lead one of Siemens' fastest-growing market segments, driving operational excellence across a portfolio of complex, mission-critical infrastructure projects while shaping the future direction of our data centre business.

Sitting within our Electrification & Automation business and reporting at senior leadership level, you'll be accountable for building a high-performing organisation that delivers complex, large-scale data centre programs from end to end — driving delivery excellence, strong commercial outcomes, and exceptional customer experience.

This role is central to our growth strategy as we scale to meet the rapid expansion of the Australian data centre market and deepen our position as a trusted partner for hyperscale and colocation clients. Key responsibilities will be to:

  • Define and execute the operational strategy for data centre project delivery across Australia, overseeing a portfolio of concurrent programs with full accountability for delivery, commercial, and customer outcomes
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing project organisation — including Project Directors, Project Managers, and Engineers — shaping structure, capability, and workforce planning to meet current and future demand
  • Establish governance frameworks, delivery models, and operational standards that drive consistency, efficiency, and scalability across all projects
  • Own senior client relationships across key strategic accounts, leading high-value commercial engagements including contract negotiations, variations, and dispute resolution
  • Partner with Sales and Business Development to support market expansion, bid strategy, and solution positioning
  • Leverage digital tools, data analytics, and automation to continuously improve project execution and operational performance
  • Champion a zero-harm safety culture, ensuring full compliance with Siemens and Australian regulatory standards

You'll have proven experience in a senior operations or program leadership role within the data centre, utilities, or mission-critical infrastructure sector, with a strong background in electrification, MV/LV power systems, and digital infrastructure. You're commercially sharp, with experience managing P&L, contracts, and risk across large EPC or integrated delivery environments, and you have a deep understanding of the Australian data centre market and its regulatory landscape. A tertiary qualification in Electrical Engineering or Project Management is required; an MBA is desirable.

You think beyond individual projects to build long-term organisational value. You develop and inspire high-performing teams, build lasting client partnerships, and thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments. You communicate with influence across executives, clients, and geographically dispersed teams — and you hold yourself accountable for portfolio outcomes.

A strong network across the Australian data centre ecosystem — spanning hyperscale providers, colocation operators, Tier 1 contractors, and engineering consultants — will be a significant advantage in this role.

If you are passionate about building high-performing teams, delivering operational excellence and leading large-scale infrastructure programs in a rapidly growing market, please get in touch for a confidential discussion.

Siemens are committed to ensuring our workplace reflects the communities in which we operate, that everyone has access to the same opportunities and is treated fairly, and that we actively empower the voices of every individual voice.

job.title: Business Development - Data Centres LV
job.description:
Shape the future of critical infrastructure with Siemens

Australia and New Zealand’s data centre market is growing rapidly — and Siemens is right at the heart of this transformation.

As demand for hyperscale, colocation and mission-critical digital infrastructure continues to accelerate, the need for reliable, sustainable and high-performing electrical infrastructure has never been greater.

We’re looking for a commercially driven and technically capable Business Development – Data Centres LV professional to help us grow our Low Voltage

Electrical Products business and strengthen the success of our switchboard builder partner network across Australia and New Zealand.

This is an opportunity to make a real impact in one of the most exciting infrastructure markets in the region - working with major customers, consultants and industry partners to influence projects from the very beginning and shape the solutions that power the digital world.

The role can be based in either Sydney or Melbourne.

The Opportunity

As Business Development – Data Centres LV, you will take ownership of developing Siemens’ Low Voltage position within the data centre market across Australia and New Zealand.

You’ll be at the forefront of identifying opportunities, building strategic relationships and influencing projects well before they reach procurement. Working closely with customers, consultants, contractors and our valued switchboard builder partners, you’ll help bring Siemens solutions to life and enable our partners to deliver competitive, compliant and locally supported LV solutions.

It’s a role that combines strategy, technical understanding, commercial acumen and relationship building - with plenty of opportunity to make your mark.

What you’ll be doing

  • Drive growth: Own and execute the Low Voltage data centre growth strategy, identifying target accounts, market opportunities, partner priorities and project pursuits.
  • Know the market: Develop a strong understanding of the Australian and New Zealand data centre landscape, including hyperscale, colocation and enterprise opportunities, customer requirements, competitors and market trends.
  • Enable our partners: Work closely with Siemens’ switchboard builder partners to strengthen their capability to design, quote, build, test and support Siemens-based LV solutions.
  • Build influential relationships: Develop trusted relationships with data centre owners and operators, consultants, contractors, distributors, switchboard builders and technology partners.
  • Get in early: Identify major opportunities before procurement, influence technical specifications and develop commercial strategies that position Siemens for success.
  • Bring people together: Collaborate across Siemens sales, product management, technical support, supply chain and global data centre teams to deliver the best outcomes for customers.
  • Be our industry ambassador: Represent Siemens at industry events, customer meetings, partner workshops, training sessions and networking opportunities.
  • Turn insight into action: Maintain strong visibility of pipeline, forecasting, account activity, partner engagement and market intelligence.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for someone who combines commercial drive with strong technical understanding and who enjoys building relationships and creating opportunities.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • Strong knowledge of the data centre market, including critical power infrastructure and LV distribution systems.
  • Experience in business development, project sales, major project pursuits or technical sales within electrical infrastructure, switchgear, switchboards, power distribution or a related industry.
  • A proven ability to build relationships with senior customers, consultants, contractors, distributors, switchboard builders and internal stakeholders.
  • A customer-focused and commercially minded approach, with the ability to turn early-stage opportunities into meaningful project outcomes.
  • Strong communication, influencing, negotiation and analytical skills.
  • The confidence to navigate complex stakeholder environments and connect technical solutions with commercial outcomes.
  • Experience with CRM systems, forecasting, pipeline management and structured project tracking will be highly regarded.

Why Siemens?

Because at Siemens, our people genuinely matter.

We’re proud of the technology we create, but equally proud of the people and culture behind it. You’ll join a team of smart, passionate and supportive people who collaborate, share ideas and genuinely want to see each other succeed.

We’re committed to your development, career growth and wellbeing, giving you the opportunity to build your skills, take on new challenges and explore opportunities across Siemens globally. We also support flexible ways of working because we understand that life extends beyond work.

You’ll have access to global expertise, innovative technology and experienced colleagues, while playing an important role in one of Australia and New Zealand’s fastest-growing infrastructure markets.

If you’re looking for a role where you can grow, make an impact and work with great people, we’d love to hear from you.

Our commitment to you

Siemens is a proud equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can belong, thrive and prosper.

We believe diversity makes us stronger. Different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives drive better ideas, better innovation and better outcomes - and we’re committed to creating an environment where everyone can reach their full potential. If you require reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process, please let us know.

It offers a unique opportunity to shape low voltage design strategy across some of the region’s most advanced data centre developments, working directly with customers and through key partner networks.

The Opportunity

You will be responsible for driving growth across Siemens’ low voltage switchboard and product portfolio within the data centre segment, with a strong focus on technical solution design, cost optimisation and modular innovation.

Working closely with Sales, Engineering and the Data Centre Vertical team, you will design and influence LV architectures including switchboards, PTUs and kiosks, ensuring solutions are technically robust, scalable and aligned with modern data centre requirements.

You will also play a key role in positioning Siemens’ LV offering within the broader end-to-end data centre portfolio, including MV/LV power distribution (up to 33kV), digital twin and planning software, PLC-based process control systems, and integrated BMS, security and access control solutions.

About You

You are an experienced Solution Architect or senior technical specialist with strong expertise in low voltage systems, particularly within switchboard design, modular distribution and LV product applications. You bring at least 5 years’ experience in electrical engineering or a related discipline, ideally within the data centre, critical infrastructure or power distribution sectors.

You have strong knowledge of LV systems, installation practices and relevant industry standards. Experience with medium voltage systems (up to 33kV), modular switchboard design or estimation will be highly regarded, though not essential.

You are commercially aware, technically confident and enjoy working in collaborative environments where innovation and problem-solving directly influence customer outcomes.

At Siemens, you will contribute to some of the most advanced data centre infrastructure projects in the region, working at the forefront of electrification and digitalisation. job.title: Quality Engineer - Electrical Install Design Engineering, Chennai
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Overview

The Quality Engineer – Electrical systems Integration Design engineering is responsible for governing product and process quality performance, analysing quality data, and leading continuous improvement initiatives for Electrical systems integration for mining trucks. This role serves as the focal point for Electrical design engineering quality performance across facilities, also ensuring effective execution of quality issue resolution processes.

The incumbent will monitor defect/warranty spent trends, identify design & process gaps and drive actions with cross functional teams to achieve DPU targets by improving overall design and manufacturing quality.

Job Duties/Responsibilities include :

  • Govern quality performance by driving governance across DFM, all quality events, Engineering Deviations, and CPI (ICA/PCA) ensuring timely, effective, and sustainable closure of quality actions by coordinating with Team Leads and Design Engineers
  • Analyze field issues and warranty trends to identify top defects and Lead corrective and preventive actions to achieve DPU targets. Translate customer pain points into engineering and manufacturing quality actions.
  • Review defects for Missed/Found/New classifications, monitor defect trends and facilitate process corrective actions for recurring or high-impact defects.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve Electrical Install Standard & BIQ checklists and standard work procedures/guides.
  • Develop and publish quality dashboards providing visibility to quality event status, DPU performance, defect trend analysis, and process adherence metrics like APQP and End-to-End BIQ compliance.
  • Develop and enhance dashboards, reports, and digital tools supporting quality initiatives.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Design, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Support, and Operations to drive defect reduction, process improvements, and overall quality performance.
  • Pay attention to quality events in the factory, participate in RCCA of issues with cross-functional teams as required
  • Maintain a strong focus on safety and quality in all activities.
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to follow established processes and employs a systematic approach to problem-solving.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering , Mechanical Engineering, or related Curriculum
  • Previous experience in design engineering, product quality, manufacturing quality in electrical domain
  • Good understanding of Engineering Drawing, Electrical Harness Print/Schematics reading , Bill of material and NPI process, Change management process, APQP, PPAP, DFMEA
  • Experience with Power BI, Azure DevOps, reporting tools, and data analytics.
  • Strong analytical & problem-solving skills
  • Effective leadership, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Self-driven with a strong learning mindset and ability to work independently.

Skill Descriptors:

Information Capture: Knowledge of the methods, channels and processes to obtain needed information; ability to identify, capture and document relevant business information in an auditable, organized, understandable and easily retrievable manner.

Standard Operating Procedures: Knowledge of established standard operating procedures (SOP); ability to design, implement and evaluate standard operating procedures affecting daily and strategic business operations in order to increase operational efficiency.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Design for Manufacturability (DFM): Knowledge of design for manufacturability guidelines, methodologies, and use cases; ability to use this knowledge to optimize product designs and manufacturing operations.

Engineering - MFG: Basic Knowledge of processes, techniques and methods of electrical & electronics components in a manufacturing environment;

Product Testing: Knowledge of product testing approaches, techniques and tools; ability to design, plan and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure product quality at all stages of product design & manufacturing

Troubleshooting Technical Problems: Knowledge of troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, detect and resolve technical problems in a manufacturing or product development environment.

Top candidates will also have:

  • Knowledge of electrical and electronic systems used in heavy equipment applications.
  • Experience leading quality improvement or cross-functional projects.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt certification or equivalent problem-solving experience.
  • Familiarity with Creo, Teamcenter, and product development processes.
  • Experience in defect analytics, quality governance, and continuous improvement methodologies.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Posting Dates:

September 8, 2026 - September 15, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: IT Analyst Technical Infrastructure (ITSM Analyst and Reporting)
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. Job Description

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed to and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled hands-on IT Analyst Technical Infrastructure (ITSM reporting/SLM Metrics) to join our ITSM team – Caterpillar IT, India GCC.

The role involves design, develop, deploy and maintain enterprise ITSM data, analytics, reporting, automation and AI capabilities. The role will support ServiceNow reporting and Platform Analytics, Snowflake data structures, Power BI dashboards, Python/SQL-based automation, service-level metrics and data governance. The incumbent will partner with ITSM process owners and business stakeholders to provide reliable operational insights, improve reporting efficiency and enable data-driven decisions across Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Level Management.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN , Whitefield

What you will do

Job Duties/Responsibilities will include:

  • Design, develop and maintain enterprise ITSM dashboards, reports and analytical solutions using Microsoft Power BI, ServiceNow and Platform Analytics.
  • Develop and maintain Snowflake tables, views, queries and data models supporting ITSM reporting, service-level metrics and operational analysis.
  • Use Python and SQL to automate data preparation, validation, reconciliation and recurring reporting activities.
  • Maintain data quality, reporting accuracy, metric definitions and appropriate governance for ITSM data consumed through ServiceNow, Snowflake, Power BI and approved AI solutions.
  • Support the modernization and migration of legacy ITSM reporting and ServiceNow Platform Analytics solutions.
  • Analyze Incident, Problem, Change and Release data to identify recurring issues, root-cause trends, operational risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop reporting for SLA performance, service-level trends and business-facing service reviews.
  • Partner with ITSM process owners and stakeholders to translate business and operational requirements into reliable analytical solutions.
  • Create clear technical documentation, data definitions, operational procedures and knowledge-transfer materials.
  • Support testing, deployment, monitoring and maintenance of reports, data pipelines and automation solutions.
  • Develop or support approved Microsoft Copilot and agent-based solutions for ITSM use cases.
  • Participate in ITSM governance activities, including Incident, Problem, Change, CAB/eCAB, Release, Service Level Management and IT controls.
  • Provide production support for critical reporting and analytics solutions, including planned off-hours or weekend support when required.
  • Contribute into ITSM responsibilities -Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management processes within ServiceNow
  • Root cause analysis, trend identification, recurring issue elimination, and service improvement initiatives
  • Enterprise CAB (Americas, EMEA, APAC), ICW calendar coordination, eCAB facilitation, and moratorium governance
  • Service level monitoring, SLA reporting, stakeholder alignment, and continual service improvement
  • ServiceNow release testing, Platform Analytics migration initiatives, and tool governance activities
  • IT controls, compliance, audit readiness, and process documentation
  • Development and support of Agentic AI, Microsoft Copilot, Sidekick, and automation solutions that improve ITSM processes, reporting, knowledge management, and operational efficiency

What you will have

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, data engineering or a related technology area.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including data modelling, dashboard development and report maintenance.
  • Working proficiency in Python and SQL for analytics, automation and data processing.
  • Experience working with Snowflake, Data Lake or comparable cloud data platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data, validate results and communicate actionable insights.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, customer-service, teamwork and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to manage priorities independently while working effectively in a global, collaborative environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with ServiceNow reporting, Performance Analytics or Platform Analytics.
  • Familiarity with ITSM or ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Level Management.
  • Experience developing solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform or comparable AI and automation technologies.
  • Experience with data governance, data access controls, metric definitions and reporting-quality assurance.
  • ITIL Foundation, Microsoft Power BI, ServiceNow or Snowflake certification.
  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week in the office from 1pm -10pm IST.

Skills desired:

Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Advises others on the assessment and provision of all technical solutions.
  • Engages appropriate subject matter resources to effectively resolve technical issues.
  • Mentors others to enhance their technical competence and its application to achieve more effective technical solutions.
  • Coaches others in promoting, defining, analyzing, and providing superior technical solutions to business problems.
  • Provides effective solutions to moderate technical challenges through strong technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
  • Assumes accountability for personal technical performance and holds others responsible for theirs.

Technology Advising: Knowledge of effective advisory methods and ability to provide valued information and advice to clients regarding products, technologies, services and solutions for a specific technology domain. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Assesses the current technology environment, expressed needs and initiatives of client organizations.
  • Uses an effective consulting method to present technology solutions that resolve stated client business issues.
  • Advises clients regarding a family of specific products, technologies or services in a technology domain.
  • Demonstrates basic competence and sound business knowledge regarding specific products, technologies or services within a domain of technology expertise.
  • Achieves consulting relationship rating of 'professional' by delivering timely, meaningful advice meeting client needs in a narrow set of specific technologies.

Hardware Infrastructure: Knowledge of computer architecture and systems programming; ability to design, build and integrate IT hardware into multi-platforms for the organization. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Evaluates IT hardware vendors in the market and selects the most suitable products for the organization.
  • Guides employees on the integration of IT hardware throughout other organization-wide platforms.
  • Supervises the implementation process of IT hardware ensuring consistency in productivity and overall effectiveness.
  • Advises others on business standards and practices for IT hardware in order to meet designer requirements.
  • Evaluates the advantages and disadvantages of an organization's hardware components.
  • Diagnoses IT hardware problems and recommends dynamic solutions.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.
  • Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
  • Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
  • Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
  • Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
  • Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
  • Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
  • Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
  • Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
  • Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

Systems Software Infrastructure: Knowledge of computer architecture and system software interaction; ability to design and build a fundamental architecture of operating systems, database management systems, communications protocols, compilers and other development tools. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Reports software connectivity and integration issues.
  • Demonstrates planned software changes on the local environment.
  • Administers software migration and contingency plans related to own function.
  • Analyzes the local software architecture components and products.
  • Tests key features for the entire software infrastructure environment.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Emphasizes the business impact of failure and the criticality and timing of needed resolution so that problems can be avoided in the future.
  • Creates trouble reports for all issues found and reviews solutions for completeness and correctness.
  • Directs the resolution of communications problems in multi-vendor environments.
  • Resolves a variety of hardware, software, and communications malfunctions.
  • Coaches others on advanced diagnostic techniques and tools for unusual or performance-related problems.
  • Facilitates the distribution of releases reports and correction packages to departments or clients.

Technical Writing/Documentation: Knowledge of technical writing; ability to write technical documents such as manuals, reports, guidelines or documents on standards, processes and applications. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Conducts training on alternative documentation delivery mechanisms, tools and techniques.
  • Manages cost items in producing and maintaining documentation.
  • Designs and implements formal methodologies for producing documentation.
  • Collaborates with support function managers, the product management team, and design engineers with writing projects.
  • Supervises the analysis, design and data collation on large documentation initiatives.
  • Establishes and references best practices for existing and planned tools and delivery vehicles for proper documentation.

What you will get:

  • Work Life Harmony
  • Earned and medical leave.
  • Relocation assistance

Holistic Development

  • Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
  • Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness

  • Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
  • Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness

  • Employee investment plan
  • Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Additional Information:

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers)

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Posting Dates:
