job.title: Director, Corporate Systems
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

Reporting to the Head of Corporate Systems, the Director, Corporate Systems is a senior technology leadership role accountable for partnering with Corporate Functions and leading the strategy, transformation, delivery and operations of enterprise corporate platforms across Singtel Group.

The role combines two integrated accountabilities:

IT Business Partner for Corporate Functions. Serve as the trusted technology adviser to the People and Culture and Sustainability leadership teams. Translate business strategy into a prioritised technology roadmap and investment portfolio, with end-to-end accountability for demand, delivery, service performance, cost, risk and value realisation.

Platform Lead for Corporate Systems - People and Culture and Sustainability across Singtel, Optus and NCS. Own the platform strategy, architecture, product roadmap and lifecycle. Drive a secure, resilient and scalable common core while enabling justified local requirements; simplify and modernise the application landscape; strengthen data and integration foundations; and improve speed, employee experience and unit cost.

The Director, Corporate Systems will:

  • Shape and execute multi-year platform and technology strategies aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture, cyber security, data and cloud principles.
  • Sponsor major transformation programmes and ensure disciplined delivery, adoption, operational readiness, benefits realisation and sustainable support.
  • Establish clear governance and decision rights for demand, investment, architecture, change, service performance, risk, privacy, resilience and vendor management.
  • Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing regional team and partner ecosystem, supported by a strategic workforce and capability plan.
  • Advise and influence senior stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and make balanced decisions across business value, employee experience, cost, risk and delivery speed.

The successful candidate will combine strategic business insight, enterprise technology depth, commercial acumen and strong people leadership. They will be comfortable operating across a federated Group, influencing at executive level and translating complex technology choices into clear business outcomes.

Make an impact by

Shape Corporate Systems strategy, business partnership and portfolio value

  • Partner with People and Culture, Sustainability and Group/OpCo leadership to understand business outcomes and translate them into an integrated, multi-year technology strategy and roadmap.
  • Lead demand management and portfolio prioritisation across run, grow and transform initiatives, balancing value, risk, regulatory needs, dependencies and capacity.
  • Develop robust business cases, investment proposals and outcome measures; own value and benefits realisation.
  • Provide clear executive advice on technology options, trade-offs and emerging trends.
  • Success measures: stakeholder confidence, roadmap alignment, benefits delivered, demand transparency and portfolio health.

Own platform/product strategy, architecture and lifecycle management

  • Define platform/product vision, roadmap, target architecture and lifecycle for People and Culture and Sustainability platforms across Singtel, Optus and NCS.
  • Establish common-core standards, design principles and decision rights while enabling justified local requirements and regulatory obligations.
  • Drive application rationalisation, technical-debt reduction, cloud/SaaS optimisation, integration and API reuse, and data quality.
  • Lead responsible adoption of automation, analytics and AI-enabled capabilities where they improve employee experience, controls and productivity.
  • Ensure solutions comply with enterprise architecture, security, privacy and data-governance requirements.
  • Success measures: adoption, reuse, simplification, reduced technical debt, data and integration quality, and unit-cost improvement.

Lead transformation delivery, adoption and change

  • Sponsor and govern complex regional programmes from business case through design, delivery, migration, go-live and stabilisation.
  • Set delivery outcomes, milestones, quality gates, controls and accountabilities across internal teams, business owners and partners.
  • Ensure business process, data, integration, testing, change, training and operational-readiness plans are fully integrated.
  • Proactively manage interdependencies, risks, issues and executive escalations.
  • Embed product and agile delivery practices where appropriate and create a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Success measures: delivery to scope, time, budget and quality; user adoption; benefits realisation; and stable transition to operations.

Assure service performance, operational resilience and technology risk

  • Own end-to-end service performance and ensure production systems meet agreed SLAs, availability, performance and experience targets.
  • Establish service, incident, problem, change and release governance; drive root-cause elimination and measurable improvement.
  • Be accountable for cyber security, privacy, technology risk, audit, regulatory compliance and third-party risk within the domain.
  • Define and test business continuity, disaster recovery and operational-resilience arrangements, including critical dependencies.
  • Maintain transparent risk-acceptance and remediation plans and escalate material exposures.
  • Success measures: SLA attainment, availability, incident reduction, recovery readiness, control effectiveness and timely audit/risk closure.

Optimise financial, commercial, vendor and workforce performance

  • Manage approved OPEX and CAPEX, forecast demand and optimise total cost of ownership and unit cost.
  • Define sourcing and vendor strategy; lead commercial negotiations, contract performance, licensing optimisation and strategic partner relationships.
  • Establish KPIs, scorecards and governance to hold internal teams and vendors accountable for outcomes.
  • Build a strategic workforce plan covering organisation design, skills, succession, capacity and partner mix.
  • Coach and develop a diverse, high-performing team that operates as trusted advisers, product owners and change leaders.
  • Success measures: budget performance, savings and value capture, vendor outcomes, capability growth, engagement and retention.

**

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 12+ years of relevant technology experience, including at least 3-5 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Proven end-to-end ownership of enterprise corporate platforms and services in a large, complex or multi-entity organisation.
  • Track record of leading regional transformation programmes and enterprise SaaS/cloud implementations from strategy through adoption and operations.
  • Experience managing executive stakeholders, cross-functional teams, budgets, vendors and outsourced delivery partners.
  • Strong commercial experience in business cases, sourcing, contracts, licensing and total-cost optimisation.
  • Demonstrated people leadership, organisation development and succession planning.
  • Enterprise platform/product strategy and lifecycle management
  • Business and enterprise architecture; application rationalisation
  • Enterprise SaaS/cloud, integration/API and data-management concepts
  • Portfolio, programme and change management
  • IT service management, operational resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity
  • Cyber security, privacy, technology risk, audit and governance
  • Financial, commercial, sourcing and vendor management
  • Performance management, benefits realisation and continuous improvement

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We are seeking a Senior Security Platform Engineer – DevSecOps to lead application security engineering and DevSecOps uplift across Optus. You’ll work closely with development, platform, architecture and security teams to embed secure-by-default practices across the software development lifecycle, automate security controls and improve the way teams deliver secure software.

If you thrive in a hands-on senior role where you can shape AppSec strategy, provide technical leadership, mentor engineers and turn security requirements into practical, reusable controls, this role is for you.

  • Lead and enhance DevSecOps and secure software development lifecycle practices.

job.title: Product Manager, Middleware & Integration Platforms
job.description:
##

Role Mission

Own and govern StarHub's enterprise middleware and integration ecosystem, providing a common technology umbrella for integrations connecting BTS and non-BTS systems. The role ensures integrations are designed, delivered and operated through secure, scalable and reusable enterprise patterns, with clear ownership across their full lifecycle.

The role provides product ownership and governance for middleware, integration, orchestration and automation platforms, including Workato, UiPath and future approved enterprise integration technologies.

Accountabilities

  • Own the enterprise middleware and integration platform portfolio across BTS and the wider StarHub technology ecosystem.
  • Establish clear platform ownership, governance and operating standards for middleware, integration, orchestration and automation capabilities.
  • Ensure integrations across BTS and non-BTS systems are visible, governed and managed under a common enterprise framework.
  • Drive adoption of reusable integration patterns to reduce duplication, manual effort, unmanaged interfaces and point-to-point solutions.
  • Define platform roadmaps, investment priorities and lifecycle strategies aligned with StarHub's modernisation, automation and AI agenda.
  • Partner with application, architecture, data, infrastructure, identity, cybersecurity and service management teams to enable secure and resilient integration.
  • Optimise platform utilisation, licensing, vendor performance and total cost of ownership.

##

Responsibilities

1.Enterprise Middleware & Platform Ownership

  • Own the product lifecycle for enterprise middleware, integration, orchestration and automation platforms, including Workato, UiPath and other approved technologies.
  • Maintain an enterprise view of middleware platforms, major interfaces, workflows, automations and dependencies.
  • Ensure platforms remain fit-for-purpose, scalable, supported, secure and aligned to target architecture.
  • Establish clear service ownership, support models and lifecycle controls for critical integration capabilities.
  • Integration Governance & Standards
  • Establish enterprise standards and guardrails for APIs, application-to-application integration, workflow orchestration, event-driven integration and automation.
  • Define decision principles for the use of middleware, native application integration, APIs, RPA and workflow automation.
  • Govern new integration demand to prevent uncontrolled point-to-point development, duplicated tooling and technology sprawl.
  • Drive reuse of approved APIs, connectors, integration patterns and automation components.
  • Ensure designs comply with architecture, cybersecurity, identity, data protection, resilience and operational support requirements.
  • Cross-Domain Integration Accountability
  • Provide the governance umbrella for integrations across BTS domains and integrations originating outside BTS that connect into BTS-managed platforms.
  • Support cross-domain integration across Finance, People, Productivity, Identity, Data, Customer and other enterprise technology domains.
  • Identify integration ownership gaps and establish accountable owners for interfaces crossing organisational or technology boundaries.
  • Ensure critical integrations have documented architecture, technical ownership, business ownership, monitoring and support arrangements.
  • Coordinate resolution of cross-platform integration risks, dependencies and service issues.

##

  • Automation & Orchestration
  • Govern enterprise use of automation platforms such as UiPath to ensure sustainable, reusable and supportable adoption rather than isolated automations.
  • Identify opportunities to remove repetitive manual work through integration, workflow automation and orchestration.
  • Assess automation opportunities based on business value, complexity, risk, scalability and maintainability.
  • Promote reusable automation components and patterns across business functions.
  • Measure realised benefits including effort reduction, cycle-time improvement, error reduction and productivity gains.
  • Product Roadmap & Portfolio Management
  • Develop and maintain the Middleware & Integration product roadmap and backlog.
  • Prioritise platform enhancements, new capabilities, migrations, rationalisation and decommissioning based on enterprise demand and value.
  • Manage platform dependencies, risks, releases and delivery priorities.
  • Build business cases for material investments and track measurable value realisation.
  • Continuously assess emerging middleware, integration, automation and AI-enabled orchestration capabilities.
  • Vendor & Commercial Management
  • Manage strategic relationships with middleware, integration and automation technology vendors and delivery partners.
  • Lead platform licensing, consumption, capacity and commercial reviews.
  • Identify opportunities for licence optimisation, platform consolidation and cost reduction.
  • Establish vendor performance measures and regular service reviews.
  • AI & Intelligent Integration Enablement
  • Enable governed integration patterns that allow approved AI and agentic capabilities to securely interact with enterprise systems and data.
  • Partner with relevant AI, architecture, cybersecurity and identity teams on connectors, APIs, orchestration and tool-access patterns.
  • Ensure AI-enabled integrations follow least-privilege access, auditability, data protection and appropriate human approval controls.
  • Evolve middleware capabilities to support future agent-to-system and machine-to-machine integration patterns.

##

Scope Boundary

The role owns the middleware capability, platforms, standards and governance. Individual application teams remain accountable for their application functionality and domain-specific requirements, while integrations crossing systems or domains are governed through the Middleware & Integration capability.

Areas of Impact

  • A single governed enterprise approach to middleware and integration across BTS and non-BTS platforms.
  • Reduced proliferation of point-to-point integrations, duplicated automation tools and unmanaged workflows.
  • Increased reuse of enterprise APIs, connectors, integration patterns and automation components.
  • Faster and more reliable delivery of cross-platform business capabilities.
  • Improved resilience, observability, supportability and lifecycle ownership of critical integrations.
  • Reduced manual effort and operating cost through governed automation.
  • A secure integration foundation for AI-enabled and agentic business processes.

Ideal Track Record

  • 7-10 years of experience in enterprise integration, middleware, automation, product management or technology transformation.
  • Proven experience managing enterprise integration or automation platforms in a complex organisation.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, middleware, workflow orchestration, event-driven integration, system-to-system connectivity and RPA.
  • Experience with platforms such as Workato, UiPath, MuleSoft, Boomi, ServiceNow IntegrationHub or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience managing technology products across multiple business and technology domains.
  • Good understanding of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, identity, ITSM and operational support requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, commercial arrangements, product roadmaps and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable integration solutions.
  • Experience with AI-enabled automation, orchestration or agentic integration patterns is advantageous.

job.title: Procurement Buyer II
job.description:
India

(On-site)

The Procurement Buyer role is accountable for executing and managing critical steps in the order to cash cycle. It is the responsibility of the Buyer to manage a portfolio of both internal and external suppliers, placing orders and managing the fulfillment in a timely manner.Ensuring a robust MOS to manage key stakeholders and process flow is critical to achieving key customer and business metrics including OTTR and revenue targets.

Procurement Buyer

  • Review all Open orders on daily basis and ensure it is delivered from Supplier
  • Review Pending PR’s daily twice and ensure all PO’s are sent to supplier
  • Ensure all orders are duly acknowledged by supplier in the system
  • Follow up and update missing OA’s in the system
  • Ensure OA dates are within lead time
  • Review open orders with internal customers and be proactive in expediting deliveries
  • Schedule daily/weekly call with supplier to address, delivery, logistics and other queries
  • Ensure to work with all suppliers to achieve revenue forecast
  • Review LOC instructions and arrange documents from shipper. Control LOC shipments from the date of order till it is submitted in bank
  • Scheduling weekly / Daily calls with suppliers and ensure past due lines are closed and minimize the OTTR failures
  • Work closely with CPT freight forwarders for delivering material to customer. Resolve issues and escalate as required.
  • Timely IBD creation, GR completion and verify posting of customer invoice.
  • Verify shipping documents, coordinate with shipper/Customers on COC process
  • Ensure to update all tracking details for CPT shipments in team room
  • Execute MRBR report daily and ensure GR posted through batch job
  • Resolve vendor invoice disputes in Dolphin and MRBR
  • Resolve discrepancies with supplier, FF, and provide timely feedback to customers
  • Performance Matrix to be published weekly (Missing OA’s, Past due, Dolphin)
  • Review and handle Vendor expedite payments

Knowledge required

  • End to end knowledge on supply chain management process
  • Planning and Revenue forecast activities
  • Knowledge on Trade compliance and COC process
  • Responsible for end to end LOC Process
  • Supplier Negotiation skills.
  • Working experience with Freight Forwarder for all CPT shipments
  • Experience required 3-5 years
  • Experience with Six Sigma and Lean Tools
  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Good Knowledge on SAP
  • Soft Skills Powe r Point and Expertise in Excel

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

job.title: Advanced Software Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

THE FUTURE IS WHAT WE MAKE IT

_Advance Software Engineer (Honeywell Building Operation Center)_

_Singapore, Singapore_

Building Automation \| Honeywell Building Solutions

| | | --- | | Lead the day-to-day technical and operational delivery of a team that monitors Honeywell’s Forge cloud applications. You will guide service-case resolution, strengthen connectivity and service performance, and turn platform data into opportunities that improve customer outcomes. |

THE OPPORTUNITY

In this role, you will combine hands-on technical expertise with team leadership. You will help ensure service-level commitments are met, complex issues are driven to resolution, and operational insights are translated into improvements for customers, field teams, and the platform.

Leadership scope:This position includes people leadership and hands-on technical ownership, with accountability for team execution and service-level performance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and manage a team of software engineers, setting clear priorities and helping ensure service-level agreements are met.
  • Oversee remote monitoring of Forge cloud applications, with a focus on system health, connectivity, and service performance.
  • Guide the triage and analysis of Forge-generated service cases, supporting efficient resolution with Field Service Leaders and Field Service Professionals.
  • Take ownership of complex or high-impact connectivity and performance issues, coordinating escalation and follow-through as needed.
  • Use Forge data to identify potential Spot opportunities and ensure clear, actionable recommendations are shared with field service teams.
  • Promote consistent incident-management practices, operational discipline, and effective knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Partner with cross-functional and back-end development teams to improve system reliability, monitoring quality, and customer outcomes.
  • Coach team members through technical problem-solving and support continuous capability development.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Diploma or bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Controls Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, with a focus on monitoring and troubleshooting cloud-based applications.
  • Working knowledge of a major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, including cloud-monitoring tools and practices.
  • Experience collaborating with field service teams or comparable operational groups.
  • Experience using logging, alerting, and incident-management systems to support timely issue resolution.
  • Experience with Building Management Systems and Heating, Ventilation and Air-Conditioning (HVAC) systems.

WE VALUE

  • Ability to identify energy waste or sub-optimal HVAC operation and recommend practical improvements.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices for cloud environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a distributed team environment.

job.title: Advanced R&D Engr/Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

_Advanced R&D Engr/Scientist – Gas Processing Technologies_

Innovate to solve the world's most important challenges.

The future is what you make it.

When you join Honeywell UOP, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers, and doers that are developing sustainable technologies that will accelerate the energy transition to net-zero carbon.

Are you ready to help us shape the future? Become a #futureshaper!

An excellent career opportunity is currently available for anAdvanced R&D Engr/Scientist –Gas Processing Technologiesat Honeywell India Technology Center in Gurugram. This position is dedicated to accelerating the development and commercialization of cutting-edge Hydrogen and Carbon Capture technologies, focusing specifically on solvent-based technology solutions. The selected candidate will spearhead the development of novel technologies and will be responsible for creating integrated solutions that leverage UOP’s Hydrogen and Gas Processing technology portfolio.

Responsibilities

Position Responsibilities:

  • Leadership in New Product Development:Lead and support New Product Development (NPD) initiatives by managing cross-functional teams tasked with creating intricate integrated technology solutions. Conduct research on solvent-based carbon capture technologies, focusing on their effectiveness and efficiency in reducing CO2 footprint.
  • Project Management Excellence:Implement Z21 methodologies and project management best practices to ensure that all technology deliverables are met on schedule and within budget.
  • Pilot Plant Experimentation:Direct and facilitate pilot plant experiments while driving a model-based design of experiments (MBDOE) approach to expedite technology advancement.
  • Innovation and Intellectual Property:Identify and develop innovative solutions, authoring invention disclosures to contribute significantly to Honeywell UOP’s innovation initiatives.
  • Collaboration and Growth Strategies:Engage with business colleagues to effectively develop technologies that bolster existing business lines and support growth strategies.
  • Competitive Landscape Monitoring:Stay informed about competition, monitor advancements in relevant technological areas, and lead projects designed to address gaps.
  • Mentorship Role:Act as a mentor for less experienced scientists and engineers, fostering their growth and professional development.

Qualifications

You Must Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering.
  • Experience in carbon capture technologies, with a focus on solvent methods, is highly desirable.
  • Strong interest in R&D work.
  • Strong technical skills for leading experimentation and data analysis skills.
  • A self-starter and ability to drive innovation.

We Value:

  • Advanced degree (Masters, PhD) in Chemical Engineering.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in Technology Development, specifically in solvent-based technology commercialization.
  • Profound understanding of chemistry and chemical engineering principles, with applications in process, absorption, catalyst, and adsorbent technology development.
  • Proven experience in formulating and executing experimental plans, with proficiency in statistical tools for comprehensive data analysis. Ability to design experimental set-ups to meet project objectives.
  • Knowledge of Six Sigma principles with practical applications for managing risks and uncertainties; Six Sigma Green Belt certification is preferred; Black Belt certification is ideal.
  • Strong business acumen combined with an entrepreneurial mindset to drive technological development in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to deliver impactful presentations to diverse audiences and effectively manage customer relationships.
  • Familiarity with laboratory techniques, data analysis software, and chemical engineering principles.

job.title: Account Manager II
job.description:
Job Description

Achieve Sales Orders Annual Operating Plan (AOP) quota targets (Orders, Rev/GM and Profit) by closing sales while adhering to pricing and sales policies.

  • Grow the pipeline of opportunities with the designated portfolio in pursuit of sales growth and in line with targets for HBS.
  • Together with the Vertical Sales Leader formulate robust long-term strategies and plans to develop the Service vertical and identify emerging and new strategic accounts and opportunities, creating sales plans and strategies for the portfolio aimed at serving and expanding the customer portfolio base in their assigned area or vertical.
  • Dissemination of key messages, initiatives and information pertaining to the value proposition HBS brings to targeted customers, opportunities, and solutions.
  • Driving and securing sales through understanding of the target customer’s business, their drivers, organization structure/key decision makers and influencers and the industry sector as a whole. Ensure you utilize this information to communicate the value that Honeywell brings to them and obtain orders accordingly.
  • Partner with potential customers as well as establishing relationships with builders, developers and relevant industry consultants with a view to maximizing sales and the business potential for all parties.

Responsibilities

  • Business Relationships: Develop new customer relationships; calling at all levels, including senior levels, of target customer organizations; engaging early in the customer buying process to discover customer needs HBS can fulfill and/or influence customer specification prior to bid.
  • Sales Process: Achieve designated annual sales quota and grow the qualified pipeline of opportunities within the Vertical. Continuously identifies new sales opportunities and focuses on providing consultative support by building value propositions for the customer; Manage and build customer contacts; Focal point for relationship strategies, sales plans, proposal strategies, and contract negotiations, for pursuits in play.
  • Customers: Engage technical buyers, economic buyers, and relationship buyers; engage customers and other intermediaries at all levels in any organization including executive level decision makers; target major pursuits (value approximately $1-$10M opportunities) with the objective of gaining competitive advantage and securing major project work.
  • People Management: Leverages resources to address customers’ drivers and initiatives; Guides and leverages management and executive sponsor interactions with new customers.
  • Result: Achievement of sales targets, profitable growth and focus on new customers and new opportunities; Orders and margin above set quota in support of Annual Operating Plan whilst operating within company policy. .

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in account management or sales, with a proven track record of managing key accounts and driving revenue growth
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Proficient in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite

WE VALUE

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, Marketing, or a related field
  • Proven ability to drive revenue growth and achieve sales targets
  • Strong business acumen and understanding of market dynamics
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple accounts and prioritize tasks
  • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional service
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Continuous learning mindset and willingness to adapt to changing market trends

Required Skills

  • Sales

We have a tonne of great benefits here at Telstra, from thousands of training and career-growth opportunities, to exclusive discounts across hundreds of brands and partners. Take a look at all that’s on offer [and how you can shape your benefits, your way](https://www.telstra.com.au/careers/why-telstra/benefits-your-way).

Below is a snapshot of just some of the cool things we offer:

  • Store performance-related commission
  • 30% off Telstra services
  • Telstra mobile and Sim card
  • Exclusive discounts and offers across 240 brands and partners.
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary and secondary carers

As an Assistant Retail Store Manager at Telstra, you’ll work closely with the Store Manager to coach and grow your team. You’ll use your management experience to help coach our retail consultants to success, making sure they’re driven and energised to reach and exceed store targets.

What you’ll do

  • Oversee the induction of your new team members
  • Coach the store’s team to meet (and exceed) store targets
  • Help support your team with customer query escalations
  • Be the Store Manager’s right-hand person, stepping up to act as Store Manager when needed
  • Executing business initiatives in store to meet financial and customer key metrics.
  • Act as team cheer leader – leading from the front and helping to motivate the team, and foster an awesome store culture
  • Organise the store floor and team’s work schedules, to meet customer demand.

About you

  • You have previous experience in a retail leadership / assistant management role
  • You’re able to energise and drive a retail team to exceed sales targets and KPIs with demonstrated success
  • You lead from the front and are able to influence and build rapport with a diverse and varied team
  • You’re able to resolve customer issues with your eyes closed and can put a creative spin on problem solving
  • You’re an excellent communicator who can help support the Store Manager in taking team members through change.

What’s next?

After you’ve submitted your application, the next step is a video assessment supported by our partner, Hire Vue. Please keep an eye out for the email to move your application along swiftly.

Why Telstra?

When you join our team, you become part of a welcoming and inclusive community where everyone is respected, valued, and celebrated. We actively seek individuals from various backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, and abilities because we know that diversity not only strengthens our team but also enriches our work. We have zero tolerance for harassment of any kind, and we prioritise creating a workplace culture where everyone is safe and can thrive.

job.title: Manager, Procurement
job.description:
Build a career with confidence

##

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

About the Role

Leads team of intermediate to experienced Procurement professionals, setting objectives and guiding others on RFPs, negotiation strategy, cost accountability, and/or program execution. Reviews prices, manufacturing processes, and contracts and makes recommendations for changes to ensure a successful procurement process.

The Manager, SCM – Business Excellence: Data & Process Transformation will lead the supply chain transformation agenda across Productivity & Cost Savings, Price Change Governance, Payment Terms, and Master Data (Vendor Master & Supplier Onboarding). This role demands deep experience in supply chain operations, strong people leadership, and the ability to execute high-impact programs that drive measurable business value.

The Manager will own strategy, design, and execution of supply chain data and process transformation initiatives spanning procurement, sourcing, and category management, including price change governance, payment-term centralization, vendor master management, and supplier onboarding, with direct accountability for portfolio delivery across global sites and stakeholders. The role includes managing a team of specialists/analysts, leading cross-functional programs, and partnering with global supply chain, finance, and operations leaders to deliver scalable, digitally enabled business solutions.

Job Description

  • ## Manages execution of processes, standards, and operational plans in support of Procurement strategy, including RFPs, negotation strategy, cost accountability, and/or program execution.
  • ## Directs programs for effective vendor selection and management with a view to minimize purchasing costs without compromising quality or reliability of supply.
  • ## Reviews changes in price trends and manufacturing processes and makes recommendations to ensure successful procurement process.
  • ## Manages resolution of client issues or problems.
  • ## Monitors and coordinates suppliers to schedule or expedite deliveries to ensure resolution of problems such as shortages and missed or late deliveries.
  • ## Authorizes purchase orders, negotiates prices and approves payments to support the procurement process in large territories.
  • ## Reviews and assesses request for proposals (RFP) and bid packages.
  • ## Analyzes and monitors contract performance to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and to help determine need for changes.

Responsibilities

##

1. Strategy & Leadership in Process Transformation

##

  • Define and own the transformation roadmap across the core pillars: Productivity & Cost Savings (reporting, value-capture tracking & automation), Price Change / Price Updating Governance, Master Data governance & standardization (vendor master, item, and contract data), Supplier Onboarding centralization, and Payment Terms & Working Capital optimization (DPO, 1x centralization).

·Lead a team of specialists/analysts and drive portfolio execution against business targets for these pillars: -

o Productivity & Cost Savings: Centralize productivity and cost-savings reporting across factory, indirect, and logistics sites; run the stage-gate / value-capture process end to end, and identify and recover clawbacks and missed opportunities to convert pipeline into realized savings.

o Master Data & Vendor Master: Standardize and govern supplier, vendor, item, and contract master data; own data quality, validation rules, and de-duplication to maintain a clean, reliable vendor master consistent across systems and regions.

o Payment Terms & Working Capital: Expand payment-term (DPO) initiatives, centralize 1x governance, and target WAPT improvements with measurable working-capital impact.

o Supplier Onboarding: Centralize and simplify the supplier onboarding process; standardize intake, documentation, and data setup with clear SLAs and controls to enable faster, compliant onboarding across regions.

o Price Change / Price Updation Governance: Own the end-to-end price change process and controls; ensure timely, accurate price updation in the system with the right approvals, audit trail, and exception management, working closely with category, materials, and finance teams.

##

  • Analyze end-to-end supply chain processes to identify structural improvement opportunities; drive strategic changes to improve cost, speed, compliance, and operational resilience.

·Lead, coach, and develop specialists/analysts; allocate resources, prioritize work, and review deliverables to ensure high-quality outcomes and meet business milestones.

##

##

2. Reporting, Governance, and Oversight

·Lead the design and implementation of Power BI/Excel dashboards for executive-level analytics, insights, and business metrics across procurement and inbound supply chain.

·Own the governance model for critical procurement metrics, including cadence, definitions, and alignment with finance and category teams.

·Drive transformation and centralization of reporting with a strong focus on automation, data integrity, and auditability.

·Own procurement master data quality KPIs and governance processes, ensuring consistency across systems (e.g., SAP/Oracle) and regions.

##

3. Advanced Stakeholder & Team Management

##

  • Act as the primary point of contact for global and regional procurement, category management, and sourcing leaders on master data and reporting topics.

##

  • Align transformation projects with business priorities; provide regular updates to senior leadership on progress, risks, and impact.

##

  • Promote effective collaboration and communication across global teams; facilitate workshops and steering meetings to harmonize processes and standards.

##

  • Influence stakeholders to adopt standardized processes, data definitions, and tools, balancing global governance with local business needs.

##

4. Technical Competencies & Advanced Analytics

·Oversee the use of Excel, ERP, Power BI, and other tools for scalable enterprise reporting and analytics.

·Lead advanced analytical initiatives driving business value across the key projects owned.

·Sponsor and guide automation and system-integration efforts to reduce manual work and improve data reliability.

·Champion digital and analytics innovation in supply chain reporting and master data (e.g., standardization, data quality rules, exception management, and workflow).

##

Qualifications

  • ## Master’s or Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
  • ## 12+ years’ experience in supply chain or manufacturing, with significant exposure to data/process transformation, procurement, sourcing, and category management.
  • ## Deep expertise in supply chain management, master data governance, procurement analytics, and operational finance with hands-on experience in data quality initiatives and reporting automation
  • ## Proven experience managing teams (5+) and leading complex programs or transformation initiatives in a global environment.
  • ## Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; advanced experience with Power BI, ERP systems (SAP/Oracle), and emerging digital tools strongly preferred.
  • ## Demonstrated track record of driving transformation, simplifying complex data landscapes, and delivering measurable business impact.
  • ## Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive organizational change.
  • ## High learning agility, accountability, and strong collaboration skills across cross-functional and cross-regional teams.

Additional Comments

##

  • ## Full time role

##

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

job.title: HVAC Equipment Service Technician 2
job.description:
Who we are:

Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. It’s changing the way we design, operates and maintains indoor environments and driving to a new era of autonomous buildings.

We deliver the blueprint of the future for industries such as healthcare, schools, data centers, airports, stadiums, hotels, manufacturing and beyond through OpenBlue, our comprehensive suite of connected solutions.

Johnson Controls offers the world’s largest portfolio of building technology, software and services. Supported by a team of more than 100,000 dedicated employees working across 150 countries, we’re helping customers achieve their sustainability goals and power their mission.

###

Please visit and follow Johnson Controls linkedin for recent exciting activities.

APAC Linkedin [Johnson Controls APAC Linkedin ](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/)

Career [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://youtu.be/EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue [OpenBlue: This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://youtu.be/bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Service Engineer responsible for installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of HVAC systems and commercial/industrial chillers. The candidate will ensure optimum performance of cooling systems, provide technical support to customers, and maintain high service standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair HVAC systems, air conditioning units, and water-cooled/air-cooled chillers.
  • Perform preventive maintenance and breakdown service activities.
  • Analyze refrigeration circuits, compressors, condensers, evaporators, controls, and electrical systems.
  • Attend customer complaints and provide timely resolution to minimize downtime.
  • Conduct system performance testing and commissioning of HVAC and chiller equipment.
  • Interpret electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and refrigeration schematics.
  • Monitor and optimize equipment efficiency and energy consumption.
  • Maintain service reports, maintenance records, and spare parts documentation.
  • Coordinate with customers, service teams, and vendors for smooth execution of service activities.
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards, company policies, and industry regulations.
  • Provide on-site technical support and training to customers when required.

Required Skills

  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, chillers, refrigeration cycles, and cooling equipment.
  • Expertise in troubleshooting compressors, VFDs, PLC controls, sensors, pumps, and electrical panels.
  • Knowledge of refrigerants, charging procedures, leak detection, and recovery practices.
  • Ability to read electrical and mechanical drawings.
  • Hands-on experience in preventive and corrective maintenance.
  • Good analytical, communication, and customer-handling skills.
  • Familiarity with BMS (Building Management Systems) is an added advantage.

Educational Qualification

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or related field.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with brands such as Carrier, Trane, Daikin, Blue Star, Johnson Controls, York, Kirloskar, or equivalent HVAC/chiller equipment.
  • Experience in commercial buildings, manufacturing plants, data centers, hospitals, or industrial facilities.

Join Johnson Controls and be part of a team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and provides a rewarding work environment.

###

job.title: HVAC Design Engineer
job.description:
Who we are?

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.

Visit [johnsoncontrols.com](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/) for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.

Job Specification

Within the Global Marine & Navy business at Johnson controls, the Navy systems business works on the bespoke design of the HVAC and refrigeration systems on Navy vessels around the Globe. We are designing, supplying and commissioning complex systems on OPVs, Mine Hunters, Submarines and Aircraft Carrier in a variety of countries.

We are looking for a Design Engineer to join the HVAC Design team in Kochi, India.

What will you do?

  • Working on technical proposal for HVAC enquiries
  • Working on projects from concept and detailed design through to providing design support during installation and commissioning.
  • Carrying out HVAC design load calculations.
  • Writing detailed specifications of the system and components, to align with the client specification and in accordance with any class rules
  • Preparing the system/components test procedures and writing technical reports
  • Conducting site visits and site surveys if necessary
  • Meeting with clients and project stakeholders during the project lifecycle
  • Carrying out work in accordance with all health and safety requirements and adhere to best safety working practices at all times.
  • Identifying new products or technologies enabling differentials for Johnson Controls in the market
  • Proposing alterative design philosophies and/or arrangements to reduce energy consumption, install costs and through life maintenance costs
  • Providing technical review of OEM designs to ensure their compliance to our client requirements prior to manufacture.

What we look for?

  • Great communication skills.
  • Great team working skills
  • The ability to prioritise workloads
  • Degree qualified – Mechanical Engineering or HVAC or Refrigeration
  • General knowledge about fluid dynamics, heat transfer, air conditioning system necessary
  • Experience in HVAC or Mechanical Systems design
  • Good skills in using AutoCad 2D and 3D and/or Inventor
  • Good skills in Using Microsoft Office – Word, Excel, Power Point

What we offer:

We offer a challenging and exciting position as part of a global, multi-industrial corporation. Joining us provides a stimulating work environment, career development opportunities, and the chance to make a significant impact on society.

Diversity & Inclusion:

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion stems from our core values. We lead with integrity and aim for a future aligned with our customers' vision for success. Our culture fosters engagement, innovation, and collaboration, ensuring every employee contributes to our collective mission.

job.title: Application Engineer III
job.description:
Job Description

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA, Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc)
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Fire Alarm Panels, Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA, Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc)
  • Knowledge on Simplex & Zettler fire alarm product along with Xtralis, Securiton & Wagner product for Aspirating Smoke Detection system
  • Simplex & VESDA certifications will have added advantage
  • Expertise in Fire Alarm Code and Guidelines. Should be familiar with local code requirement for Singapore, Hong Kong & Malaysia region.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.), Blue Beam
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, Modbus, and other protocols.
  • Should have good experience for subcon/vendor engagement keeping close

co-ordination with procurement

  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

10+ years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System’s Desing and Estimation.

job.title: HVAC Service Technician
job.description:
Join a Global Leader in HVAC, Building Technologies & Sustainability

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the future of smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. As a global leader in building technologies and advanced HVAC solutions, we help customers improve energy efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, and maintain mission-critical environments across sectors including mining, healthcare, data centres, pharmaceuticals, education, industrial facilities, and commercial infrastructure.

With more than 140 years of industry leadership, Johnson Controls combines world-class technology, premium service delivery, and a highly skilled technical workforce to solve complex challenges and create smarter, more sustainable spaces.

Why Experienced Technicians Choose Johnson Controls

  • Competitive hourly rates and ongoing earning potential
  • Choose the work-life balance that suits you with RDOs or paid overtime
  • YORK OEM training and manufacturer-backed technical development
  • In-house chiller training and exposure to industry-leading HVAC technologies
  • Strong technical support network and remote expert assistance
  • Career pathways into specialist technical, supervisory, and leadership roles
  • Opportunities for dual-trade qualifications and continued professional development
  • Work with a diverse range of commercial and industrial clients across the Mackay region
  • Be part of a global organisation that values safety, innovation, diversity, and inclusion

About the Opportunity

Due to continued growth in our service business, we are seeking an experienced HVAC Service Technician to join our Mackay team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Refrigeration Mechanic or Electrician with commercial HVAC experience who enjoys working autonomously, solving technical challenges, and expanding their expertise across a diverse range of equipment and customer sites.

As part of our team, you'll work on some of the industry's most recognised HVAC systems while receiving ongoing support and training from one of the world's leading building technology companies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Preventative maintenance and reactive service work
  • Fault finding, diagnostics, repairs, and commissioning
  • Installation, overhaul, and servicing of commercial mechanical systems
  • Maintenance of equipment ranging from package units and split systems through to chillers and central plant
  • Exposure to Johnson Controls' Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • Preparing quotes for small works and minor projects
  • Site coordination and customer engagement
  • Reading plans and supporting small commercial installation projects

About You

We're looking for someone who takes pride in delivering quality workmanship and building strong customer relationships.

Essential

  • Refrigeration or Electrical Trade Qualification
  • HVAC service and maintenance experience
  • Restricted Electrical Licence
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence
  • Full Australian working rights

Highly Regarded

  • Experience working on chillers and commercial air-conditioning systems
  • Industrial, mining, or large commercial HVAC experience
  • Building Management Systems (BMS) exposure
  • Experience in commissioning and project work

The YORK Advantage

As the OEM for YORK chillers, Johnson Controls provides specialist manufacturer training that few employers can offer. You'll gain access to industry-leading technical resources, in-house chiller training, and opportunities to develop expertise across a broad range of HVAC technologies.

Pre-Employment Requirements

Successful applicants will be required to complete:

  • Reference checks
  • Pre-employment medical assessment
  • Criminal history check
  • Drug and alcohol screening

Ready for Your Next Career Move?

If you're looking to join a market-leading HVAC employer that invests in its people, offers genuine career growth, and provides exposure to world-class technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now in confidence.

For a confidential discussion, contact Janis Sotelo at janis.sotelo@jci.com.

At Johnson Controls, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work every day.

job.title: Head of Risk for Security of Critical Infrastructure (SOCI)
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

17 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Head of Risk for Security of Critical Infrastructure (SOCI)

Job Summary

Job Description

Focus of the role

Telstra operates in an environment where national security, cyber threat and regulatory expectations are increasing in pace, complexity and consequence. This role exists to ensure Telstra can demonstrate confident, end‑to‑end security compliance and risk posture across telecommunications critical infrastructure - spanning technology, operations, people, physical assets, suppliers and third‑party dependencies.

Who We Are

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network. This includes making Telstra the place you want to work.

For you, that means a having career that grows with you, and working with a team powered by human connection that prioritises wellbeing and choice.

What you'll do

In this role, you will provide independent Line 2 leadership, oversight and strategic challenge across Telstra's critical infrastructure environment, ensuring risks and obligations are effectively identified, assessed and managed in accordance with the Security of Critical Infrastructure (SOCI) Act and associated regulatory obligations. As a recognised leader in Risk & Compliance with subject matter expertise in SOCI risk management, you will maintain deep expertise across the full spectrum of SOCI hazards and their potential impact on Telstra's critical assets.

Working closely with Line 1 executives and delivery leaders, you will drive a consistent approach to hazard identification, risk assessment, control effectiveness and assurance across Telstra's domestic and international fixed and mobile networks, cloud infrastructure, operational environments and critical components. This includes providing enterprise leadership on key risk domains such as cyber security, supplier risk and operational resilience, while promoting a strong culture of accountability, preparedness and continuous improvement.

The role will take an end-to-end view of critical infrastructure risk across the company, strengthening resilience outcomes, supporting regulatory compliance and helping ensure Telstra maintains the governance, assurance and operational capability expected of Australia's leading critical infrastructure provider.

In this role, you will join a connected network of risk professionals who partner with leaders across the business to enable better decision-making, strengthen risk culture, and support Telstra to achieve its strategic objectives safely and sustainably.

Key responsibilities will be:

  • Providing enterprise-wide thought leadership on SOCI risk, resilience and regulatory compliance, shaping executive decision-making, strategic priorities, risk appetite and investment outcomes across Telstra's critical infrastructure landscape.
  • Leading cross-functional engagement across Technology, Security, Operations, Procurement, Legal and Risk functions to drive a coordinated approach to managing critical infrastructure risks, influencing senior stakeholders and resolving complex risk, governance and compliance challenges.
  • Maintaining and continuously maturing an integrated Line 2 view of material SOCI risks and controls across cyber, physical, personnel, operational and network, product & technology (NPT) supply‑chain domains to enable confident executive decision‑making, regulatory engagement and prioritised security investment.
  • Ensuring Telstra can clearly demonstrate compliance with key SOCI requirements, including TSRMP‑aligned risk management programs, ‘protect your asset’ outcomes, mandatory cyber incident reporting, and notification of material changes.
  • Assessing whether cyber security controls including privileged access, network segregation, monitoring, incident response and vulnerability management, are well designed and operating effectively to protect critical assets, manage threat exposure and support SOCI concepts of competent supervision and effective control
  • Ensuring NPT supplier and delivery models are assessed through a security, cyber and national interest lens, ensuring third‑party arrangements support effective control, competent supervision and ongoing compliance.
  • Defining & enforcing clear expectations for Line 1 teams regarding supplier due diligence, contractual controls, access management, data handling, monitoring and exit strategies.
  • As high‑risk suppliers and delivery models are subject to relevant Line 2 assurance activity, validating that expected controls are implemented and operating effectively.

What We Offer

  • Performance-related pay
  • Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up
  • Global presence across 22 countries; opportunities to work where we do business.
  • Purchased annual leave scheme
  • Additional Telstra day off Additional 30% off Telstra products and services
  • Toolkit provided (laptop + mobile phone + plan paid for)

About you

To be successful in this role, you’ll have:

  • Experience managing security risk in regulated/critical environments, with strong SOCI knowledge, including an understanding of associated legislation and obligations.
  • Experience as a senior leader in telecommunications risk & compliance
  • Broad understanding of cyber, physical, people, operational and supply-chain risks.
  • Experience assessing supplier/partner risk (access, data, control, offshore delivery).
  • The ability to assess SOCI risk end to end across services, assets and dependencies.
  • A good understanding of complex networks/infrastructure and how change impacts SOCI outcomes.
  • Line 2 risk/compliance experience (controls testing, issues, exec reporting).
  • Confident influencing senior leaders and challenging constructively.
  • Clear communication skills with an ability to translate SOCI and risk for executives.
  • The ability to work well in ambiguity; simplifies complexity and aligns teams (Line 2 independent).

Interested? Apply now! If this opportunity sounds like a perfect fit for you, we'd encourage you to apply!

To be considered for this role, please ensure a current copy of your CV is attached to your application.

As part of your application with Telstra, you may receive communications from us on +61 440 135 548 (for job applications in Australia) and +1 (623) 400-7726 (for job applications in the Philippines and India).

job.title: Security Technician
job.description:
Job Description

THE FUTURE IS WHAT WE MAKE IT.

Security Technician

Darwin, NT

Enhance your career by making an impact and real connections with some of the most meaningful challenges around. When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our performance culture comprised of diverse leaders, thinkers, innovators, dreamers, and doers who are changing the future.

Make the Best You.

Working at Honeywell is not just creating incredible things. You will collaborate with top minds, grow through continuous learning, and thrive in an environment that rewards and celebrates achievements.

Join Us and Make an Impact.

We are currently seeking a Security Technician to join our Honeywell team at the Darwin Correctional facility. This customer-facing role requires a strong focus on understanding and addressing customer needs within the electronic security industry.

Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers to assess their security requirements and identify suitable solutions
  • Generate tailored solutions with a specific emphasis on Electronic Access Control Systems (EACS), CCTV, and alarm systems
  • Collaborate with the Field Service Supervisor to ensure customer satisfaction and delivery success
  • Provide expert knowledge of our products and services to help guide customers' purchasing decisions
  • Service and maintenance of Honeywell and third-party equipment (training provided)
  • Configuration of security systems hardware and software
  • Diagnose faults and repairs on security systems

Qualifications

  • Experience as Security Technician or Electrician
  • Ability to understand and explain electronic security systems to clients. (training provided)
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-focused approach
  • Self-motivated and the ability to work independently without supervision
  • EWP licence
  • Ability to be on call, work a rotating roster

Who We Are

The Future Is What We Make It at Honeywell. From sustainable aviation fuel and life-saving healthcare sensors to collaborating on every NASA space mission since the 1950’s, over 100 years of innovation has always been driven by an investment in our people. Learn more about Honeywell: youtube.com/watch?v=CG-rmG0eKLk

Discover More

Our focus at Honeywell is innovation that drives business, improves the bottom line and creates solutions for our customers and communities around the world. There’s a lot for you to discover. Our solutions, our case studies, our #Futureshapers, and so much more.

Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer, and we support a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples are encouraged to apply.

We are proud to be recognised as a great place to work for women by WORK180. Visit our WORK180 page to learn more about our commitment to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace for all. work180.com/en-au/for-women/employer/honeywell

Honeywell is a proud advocate of the LGBTQ+ community, and we are celebrating Pride Month in the Pacific by launching Pride Connect, our LGBTQ+ employee network, we encourage members of the LGBTQ+ community to apply to join our team of future shapers.

For more information on how we process your information in the job application process, please refer to honeywell.com/us/en/privacy-statement.

If a disability prevents you from applying for a job through our website, email[accessibility@honeywell.com](mailto:accessibility@honeywell.com). No other requests will be acknowledged.

Copyright © 2026 Honeywell International Inc.

Required Skills

  • Electronic security

job.title: Machine Setup Operator-Level 1
job.description:
Job Description

In this role, you will impact on the overall manufacturing efficiency and product quality by ensuring machines are properly set up and maintained, helping to meet production targets and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and adjust machinery and equipment to meet production specifications and quality standards.
  • Conduct routine inspections and quality checks to ensure machine performance and product consistency.
  • Collaborate with maintenance and production teams to troubleshoot and resolve machine issues promptly.
  • Maintain accurate records of machine setups, adjustments, and production outputs.
  • Follow safety protocols and maintain a clean and organized work environment.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Experience in machine setup and operation within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of machine tools and equipment, including the ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications.
  • Proficiency in performing quality inspections and using measurement tools to ensure product accuracy.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and the ability to maintain a safe working environment.
  • Basic troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve machine issues efficiently.

WE VALUE

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 1-3 years of experience in machine setup or manufacturing operations.
  • Attention to detail and strong problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Willingness to learn and develop new technical skills related to machine operation and maintenance.

ABOUT HONEYWELL

Honeywell International Inc. (Nasdaq: HON) invents and commercializes technologies that address some of the world's most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, productivity, and global urbanization. We are a leading software-industrial company committed to introducing state-of-the-art technology solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, sustainability, and safety in high-growth businesses in broad-based, attractive industrial-end markets. Our products and solutions enable a safer, more comfortable, and more productive world, enhancing the quality of life of people around the globe. [Learn more](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en)

THE BUSINESS UNIT

Honeywell’s Manufacturing and Machining operations focus on delivering precision-engineered components and assemblies that meet the highest standards of quality and reliability. Our teams leverage advanced machining technologies and continuous improvement methodologies to support diverse industries including aerospace, automotive, and industrial markets. We are committed to operational excellence and developing talent to drive innovation and customer satisfaction.

_Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status._ [Learn more](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/company/inclusion-and-engagement)

The salary range for this position is ($35,400.00 – $44,300.00). Please note that this information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status

BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL

In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. [Learn more](https://benefits.honeywell.com/)

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Job Posted: September 03, 2026
