job.title: Lead AI Platform Architect #AIDA
job.description:
Role Summary

As a Lead AI Platform Architect, you will be the technical authority responsible for defining the architecture, technology strategy and roadmap for Singtel's enterprise AI platform, including the Central AI Kitchen (CAK) and its supporting AI ecosystem. You will drive the evaluation, adoption and governance of emerging AI technologies, ensuring the platform provides secure, scalable, reusable and enterprise-ready AI capabilities that accelerate AI innovation across the organisation.

Working closely with Enterprise Architecture, AI Platform Engineering, AI Platform Operations, Cybersecurity and business stakeholders, you will define the enterprise AI reference architecture, platform standards, reusable technical frameworks and architectural guardrails that enable consistent and scalable AI solution delivery.

You will provide technical leadership across AI platform strategy, foundation models, agentic AI, model lifecycle management, AI engineering frameworks and platform capabilities, ensuring the AI platform evolves in line with business priorities, technology advancements and enterprise governance requirements.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Define and maintain the enterprise AI platform architecture, technology roadmap and reference architecture for the Central AI Kitchen (CAK) or equivalent AI platforms.
  • Establish reusable AI platform capabilities, architectural principles, design standards and technical frameworks to enable secure, scalable and consistent AI adoption across the enterprise.
  • Evaluate, benchmark and recommend hosted, self-hosted and open-weight foundation models, defining enterprise model selection strategies based on business, technical and governance requirements.
  • Engage with technology partners, cloud providers, AI vendors and the broader technology ecosystem to explore emerging platform capabilities, evaluate new products and identify opportunities to enhance the enterprise AI platform.
  • Lead and oversee proof-of-concept (PoC), technology evaluation and pilot initiatives for emerging AI technologies, validating technical feasibility, business value, scalability and enterprise readiness while staying abreast of industry trends and advancements to continuously evolve the AI platform roadmap.
  • Establish platform architecture and best practices for model optimisation techniques
  • Define the enterprise architecture for multimodal AI capabilities, including language, speech, voice, document, image, vision-language and video models.
  • Define enterprise standards and governance for AI model lifecycle management, including model versioning, retraining strategies, regression management, performance evaluation and model retirement.
  • Lead technical evaluations, benchmarking and proof-of-concept initiatives for emerging AI technologies, frameworks, platforms and commercial solutions.
  • Assess emerging AI technologies and recommend Build, Buy or Partner strategies based on business value, enterprise architecture alignment, scalability and total cost of ownership.
  • Publish and maintain AI platform reference architectures, reusable design patterns, technical standards, implementation guidelines and best practices.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity and other governance teams to ensure AI platform architecture aligns with enterprise architecture principles, security requirements and regulatory standards.
  • Review and govern architecture proposals for new AI platform capabilities, technology adoption and platform enhancements to ensure consistency with enterprise architecture, platform strategy and governance standards.
  • Prepare, present and defend AI platform architecture proposals to the Solution Review Board (SRB), senior management and Group/Enterprise Architecture, and seek Architecture Review Board (ARB) clearance, where required, for new platform capabilities, architecture patterns, technology adoption, technology exceptions or enterprise architectural changes.
  • Provide architectural direction and technical guidance to AI Platform Engineering teams throughout platform capability planning and implementation.
  • Collaborate with AI Platform Engineering and Operation team to define platform observability, operational architecture, reliability requirements and lifecycle management strategies for production AI services.
  • Partner with AI Solution Architects to ensure reusable platform capabilities meet evolving business requirements and support scalable AI solution delivery.
  • Work closely with AI Security Architects to embed AI security, Responsible AI, privacy and governance requirements into platform architecture and design.
  • Mentor Platform Architects and senior technical engineers, fostering architecture excellence, innovation and continuous improvement across the AI platform.
  • Serve as the primary technical advisor for enterprise AI platform strategy, engaging senior management, Group/Enterprise Architecture, technology teams and business stakeholders to influence platform direction and drive the continuous evolution of a secure, scalable, interoperable and future-ready AI platform.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong foundation in enterprise platform architecture, distributed systems and cloud-native technologies.
  • At least 10 years of experience in enterprise architecture, platform architecture, software architecture or cloud architecture, designing large-scale enterprise platforms.
  • At least 3 years of experience designing AI, Machine Learning or Generative AI platforms in an enterprise environment.
  • Proven experience defining platform architecture, technology roadmaps, architecture standards and reusable platform capabilities.
  • Experience leading architecture governance, including presenting architecture proposals to senior management and Architecture Review Boards (ARB).
  • Experience working across Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Data and Business teams.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise AI platform architecture, including AI application platforms, AI engineering ecosystems, Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) and agentic AI platforms.
  • Strong understanding of foundation models, Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), multimodal AI and enterprise AI deployment strategies.
  • Experience defining AI model lifecycle architecture, including model evaluation, fine-tuning strategies, deployment, versioning, monitoring and governance.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native, hybrid cloud and on-premises platform architectures, distributed computing and container orchestration principles.
  • Good understanding of enterprise AI application patterns, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, workflow orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), API integration and enterprise integration architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture principles, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures and API-first design.
  • Experience defining architecture standards for AI security, Responsible AI, data governance, model governance, privacy and regulatory compliance.
  • Good understanding of AI platform reliability, scalability, observability, resiliency and performance optimisation principles.
  • Strong ability to evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate technology trends into enterprise platform capabilities, architecture standards and technology roadmaps.
  • Strong strategic, analytical and systems thinking, with the ability to simplify complex architecture and technology decisions for diverse stakeholders.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Enterprise Architecture, AI Solution Architecture, Platform Engineering, Platform Operations, Cybersecurity and Business teams.
  • Strong communication, presentation and documentation skills, with experience presenting architecture proposals and influencing senior management and governance boards.
  • Proven technical leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to guide architects and engineers, influence platform direction and drive architecture best practices.
  • Strong innovation mindset and continuous learning, with a passion for exploring emerging AI technologies and translating industry trends into enterprise platform capabilities.

As a Senior AI Platform Architect, you will be responsible for the architecture, technical design and evolution of assigned AI platform domains within Singtel's enterprise AI platform, including the Central AI Kitchen (CAK) or equivalent and its supporting AI ecosystem. You will define domain architecture, evaluate emerging technologies and develop reusable platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable and enterprise-ready AI services across the organisation.

Working closely with the Lead AI Platform Architect, Enterprise Architecture, AI Platform Engineering, AI Platform Operations, AI Security and AI Solution Architecture teams, you will translate enterprise AI platform strategy into domain-specific architectures, technical standards and implementation guidance, ensuring platform capabilities align with enterprise architecture, governance and business requirements.

You will serve as the technical lead for your assigned platform domain(s), providing architectural guidance throughout capability planning, implementation and lifecycle evolution while continuously evaluating emerging AI technologies to improve platform capabilities.

**

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Own the architecture, technical design and roadmap for assigned AI platform domain(s) or capability areas, ensuring alignment with the enterprise AI platform strategy.
  • Design for the particular reusable platform capabilities such as Model Gateway, MCP, Observability, Eval and AgentOps architecture, etc architectural patterns and technical standards for assigned platform domains.
  • Engage with technology partners, cloud providers and AI vendors to evaluate emerging technologies relevant to assigned platform domains.
  • Implement proof-of-concept (PoC), technology evaluation and pilot initiatives for assigned platform capabilities, validating technical feasibility, scalability and enterprise readiness.
  • Work with the Lead Platform architect to design the architecture and best practices for assigned AI platform capabilities, including model optimisation, inference, orchestration or other specialised domains.
  • Design platform capabilities supporting multimodal AI, AI agents, model lifecycle or other assigned technical domains.
  • Define architecture and governance for assigned platform capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise AI standards and lifecycle management practices.
  • Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, technologies and commercial platforms, recommending adoption within assigned platform domains.
  • Contribute to Build, Buy or Partner recommendations by assessing technologies against enterprise architecture principles, business requirements and platform strategy.
  • Develop and maintain architecture documents, reusable design patterns, implementation guidelines and technical standards for assigned platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity and governance teams to ensure assigned platform architectures comply with enterprise standards and security requirements.
  • Review architecture proposals for assigned platform capabilities and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture principles, platform standards and governance requirements.
  • Prepare and present architecture proposals for assigned platform capabilities to the Solution Review Board (SRB), senior management and Group/Enterprise Architecture, and support Architecture Review Board (ARB) submissions where required.
  • Provide architectural guidance and technical direction to AI Platform Engineering teams throughout implementation of assigned platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate with AI Platform Engineering and AI Platform Operations to ensure platform capabilities are designed for operational excellence, observability, reliability and maintainability.
  • Partner with AI Solution Architects to ensure platform capabilities effectively support business solutions and evolving enterprise AI requirements.
  • Work closely with AI Security Architects to incorporate AI security, Responsible AI, privacy and governance requirements into assigned platform capabilities.
  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of the enterprise AI platform by identifying improvements, technology innovations and optimisation opportunities within assigned platform domains.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong foundation in software architecture, cloud-native technologies, distributed systems and AI platform technologies.
  • At least 5 years of experience in platform architecture, software architecture, cloud architecture or infrastructure architecture, designing enterprise platforms.
  • At least 2 years of experience designing AI, Machine Learning or Generative AI platforms or platform capabilities.
  • Proven experience designing architecture for one or more AI platform capabilities, reusable platform services or enterprise technical platforms.
  • Experience preparing architecture proposals and participating in architecture governance activities (e.g. SRB, ARB or equivalent).
  • Experience collaborating with Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Platform Operations, Cybersecurity, Data and Business teams.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineering Analyst
job.description:
Responsibilities

The Manufacturing Engineer will be responsible for supporting and improving manufacturing processes, will ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality production in accordance with engineering standards, Lean principles, and Vertiv requirements. The role will act as a key interface between engineering, production, quality, and supply chain, will drive continuous improvement, process optimization, and product industrialization.

Job Description

  • Respects the principles of environmental protection
  • Support and optimize manufacturing processes in accordance with drawings, BOMs, work instructions, and technical standards
  • Analyze production flows and will propose improvements related to safety, quality, cost, and delivery
  • Participate in the industrialization of new products and engineering changes (NPDI / ECO / ECN)
  • Define and update manufacturing documentation (work instructions, process flows, layouts, routings)
  • Support production during daily operations, troubleshooting technical and process-related issues
  • Analyze root causes of production problems and will implement corrective and preventive actions
  • Cooperate closely with other departments (Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, EHS)
  • Support line balancing, capacity analysis, and layout optimization
  • Support validation of tools, equipment, and production processes
  • Ensure compliance with internal standards, quality procedures, and safety regulations
  • Work in accordance with LEAN manufacturing principles and 5S methodology (VOS)
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by submitting and implementing improvement proposals
  • Perform all other activities related to the agreed type of work
  • Follow the procedures, rules, and principles of the integrated management system
  • Contribute to the development and adherence to standards with a focus on customer satisfaction, company culture, and continuous improvement

What will make you successful?

  • Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related fields
  • At least 7 years of experience in a manufacturing or industrial engineering role
  • Be able to read and interpret technical drawings and manufacturing documentation

Have knowledge of manufacturing processes and assembly methods

Have experience with process improvement and problem-solving techniques

Have basic knowledge of Lean tools (5S, Kaizen, Standard Work, VSM)

Be able to work with measuring equipment

Have basic PC skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Have good English knowledge

  • Comply with all health and safety and environmental protection requirements defined in the company's internal regulations or communicated during training.
  • Comply with required emergency prevention and operational control measures.
  • Report all accidents, occupational illnesses and emergencies.
  • Implement, implement and manage all health and safety and environmental protection matters related to the position.
  • In addition to the tasks listed above, other activities and responsibilities may be individually defined

Kickstart your manufacturing career with a role that offers real responsibility and meaningful learning opportunities. You will join the Method Engineering Team, where you will proactively solve problems and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

In this role, you will play an important part in improving manufacturing quality, efficiency, and capacity to ensure customer demand is fulfilled on time. This position offers a unique opportunity to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on our manufacturing processes and new product introductions. By contributing to Schneider Electric's commitment to excellence, you will gain valuable skills and hands-on experience that will support your professional development.

Manufacturing process and Engineering process understanding

  • Assist in the collection, analysis, and reporting of production process time data to support operational improvements.
  • Support the preparation, maintenance, and updating of manufacturing and process-related documentation.

Collect improvement opportunities

  • Identify and propose process improvement opportunities through process reviews and observations, with a focus on optimizing material flow and simplifying documentation and administrative processes.
  • Explore and recommend AI-driven digitalization solutions to automate workflows, improve operational efficiency, and support continuous process improvement.

Deploy solutions

  • Develop digitalization and AI-powered solutions using available automation and AI tools to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Assist in implementing automation solutions to streamline processes, reduce manual work, and improve productivity.

What qualifications will make you successful:

  • Pursuing a Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Comfortable working on the manufacturing shop floor and actively engaging in hands-on operational activities.
  • Possess a customer-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving skills and a passion for delivering effective solutions.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications. Basic knowledge or experience in coding/programming is preferred. Familiarity with AI tools will be an added advantage.

Job Description

We are looking for a motivated and execution-oriented analyst to support Digital M&A for R&D and Cybersecurity initiatives.

This role focuses primarily on supporting acquisitions, divestitures and integration initiatives impacting R&D, software engineering and digital platforms.

The analyst will coordinate integration of workstreams, support onboarding of newly acquired engineering teams, track execution plans, manage stakeholder collaboration and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives.

Approximately 80% of the role is dedicated to Digital M&A activities within the R&D and Engineering ecosystem, while 20% focuses on cybersecurity andsource code governance initiatives.

What will you do?

  • We are looking for a motivated and execution-oriented analyst to support Digital M&A for R&D and Cybersecurity initiatives.
  • This role focuses primarily on supporting acquisitions, divestitures and integration initiatives impacting R&D, software engineering and digital platforms.
  • The analyst will coordinate integration of workstreams, support onboarding of newly acquired engineering teams, track execution plans, manage stakeholder collaboration and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives.

job.title: Sr. Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
job.description:
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”

As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.

As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.

Key job responsibilities Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:

  • You’ll build solutions, provide technical guidance and advocate for the customer
  • Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
  • Develop trusting relationships with customers, understanding their business needs and technical challenges
  • Using your technical acumen and customer obsession, you’ll drive technical discussions regarding incidents, trade-offs, and risk management
  • Consult with a range of partners from developers through to C-suite executives
  • Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services Consultants, and Sales Account Managers
  • With a bias for action, you'll proactively find opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS
  • Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, detailed pre-launch planning
  • Solve a variety of problems across different customers as they migrate their workloads to the cloud
  • Uplift customer capabilities by running workshops, brown bag sessions, etc.

Watch a short video about life as a Technical Account Manager here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J_Rm0QgWvQ8 The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!

A day in the life As a Senior TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services - including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, Bedrock, SageMaker, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support, and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS.

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
  • Knowledge of of cloud based architecture, cloud services and experience in customer facing roles
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, math, or equivalent, or experience in a STEM field equivalent to a four year degree
  • Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
  • Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead
  • Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas: software design or development, content distribution/CDN, scripting/automation, database architecture, IP networking, IT security, BigData/Hadoop/Spark, operations management, service oriented architecture

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Automotive and Manufacturing, AWS Industries
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner some of the worlds largest Automotive and Manufacturing companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

Here are some other qualities we are looking for:

Be great fun to work with. At AWS, we have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.

Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud and AI solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.

You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, understanding their business needs and technology challenges to architect customized solutions
  • Lead discussions to shape a customer's long-term technology and AI strategy and guide them on trade-offs between short-term fixes and extensible, scalable solutions
  • Design end-to-end solutions leveraging both technical expertise and business acumen, driving consensus across multiple teams to deliver impactful solutions
  • Proactively identify opportunities to accelerate implementation through reusable components, parallel workstreams, etc.
  • Share knowledge by developing technical content like sample code, presentations, workshops to exemplify best practices and educate customers
  • Drive product innovation by gathering customer feedback, translating needs into clear requirements, and partnering with product teams through development
  • Resolve complex technical problems through root cause analysis, both for customers and internally

A day in the life

  • Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
  • Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
  • Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
  • Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
  • Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

About the team The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

The Automotive & Manufacturing Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic automotive and manufacturing accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
  • Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).
  • Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
  • Experience working with end user or developer communities
  • 2+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning), GenAI (Generative AI), Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
  • Experience in IoT, Automotive or Manufacturing domain

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Executive Assistant, AWS India
job.description:
AWS India is looking for an experienced, resourceful and highly organized Executive Assistant to support two senior leaders. The role supports a Director-level organization that operates across multiple cities in India as well as a Director, who supports multiple countries in Asia-Pacific & Japan. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, experienced planner who can respond effectively and efficiently whilst maintaining flexibility, composure and have good communication skills. The individual in this role must understand business priorities, anticipate needs, and help build capacity for the leadership team. A high level of integrity and discretion in handling confidential information, and professionalism in dealing with senior executives inside and outside the company, is essential. The successful candidate can complete complex tasks with little to no guidance, react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround, and take effective action without always knowing the whole picture.

  • Manage calendars, resolving conflicts and ensuring time reflects business priorities.
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel for 2 Directors, and manage expense report coordination and submission. Drive reduction of travel spending.

Operating Cadence & Organizational Effectiveness

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Work with the leadership team, recruiting and other Executive Assistants to provide support across the organization.
  • Act as a liaison for the leaders' direct reports.

Events, Projects & Process Improvement

  • Organize, execute and assist with team activities: staff meeting agendas, all-hands meetings, off-sites and team social events, including events held outside the home location.
  • Identify and implement improvements to administrative processes that reduce friction and improve efficiency.
  • Organize team events within budget. Recommend to reduce budget.
  • Help manage seating capacity and allocation across few AWS India locations

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
  • 5+ years of senior level leadership support experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading process improvements
  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company
  • Experience designing processes to maximize efficiency
  • Experience with domestic or international travel coordination, or experience managing multiple calendars
  • Experience with executive level calendar management, or experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines

job.title: Controls Engineer, Controls Deployment & Service India
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems that ensure the health of AWS data centers. Operating across Australia & New Zealand, India, North Asia, and Southeast Asia, APAC CDS manages 41 leased/owned sites and supports global follow-the-sun operations. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines: deployments (control systems in new data centers), projects (capital improvement works at live sites), and service (control systems at live sites), with additional specializations in colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, program management, and coordination.

As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.

To be successful in this team, you will also have:

  • Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
  • Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed

Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade colocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.

Key job responsibilities Deployment of data center controls, on time, with effective management of vendors to ensure minimal defects at the point of Power and Facilities Hand-Off (PFHO)

  • Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
  • Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events
  • Resolution of tasks within predefined Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Delivery of further initiatives to improve the efficiency of our data centers or our operations procedures

A day in the life

  • Join the cloud leader: AWS has the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip—especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom-designed processors and chips.
  • Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.
  • Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.
  • Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career.

About the team About AWS Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
  • Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
  • Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience

job.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
job.description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.

You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

  • Here are some other qualities we are looking for:
  • Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
  • Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

Key job responsibilities

  • Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
  • Architect AI-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
  • In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
  • Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
  • Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
  • Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
  • Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers
  • Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
  • Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

A day in the life

  • Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
  • Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
  • Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
  • Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
  • Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

About the team The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

job.title: Data Center Regional Engineer - Electrical, Colo Regional Engineering
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We have an immediate opening for an Electrical Colo Regional Engineer in Auckland. If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you! As an Electrical Colo Regional Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Electrical Colo Regional Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out the data centers we support to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:

  • Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty
  • Are detail and data oriented
  • Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.
  • Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Commissioning, Construction and Design)
  • Be inclined to get into the field to see things up close.

Key job responsibilities

  • Work with colo vendors to review the design for new Data Centers in your region, including design input, submittal review and incorporating AWS products to ensure the design is meeting AWS expectations.
  • Act as resident engineer during new colo construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and handover.
  • Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
  • Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including essential equipment, and event support.
  • Provide technical support to the design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, and increase efficiency.
  • Supporting operating partners to lead, review, and approve designs for existing co-location (colo) data center upgrades which improve availability/efficiency.
  • Interface with operating partners, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered by operating partners.
  • Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
  • Initiate and lead engineering site audits within leased or colo data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation's.

A day in the life Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • NETA or ASHRAE certification or commissioning specific education courses
  • Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
  • Experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical facilities, especially data centers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
  • Knowledge of commercial or industrial power systems or mechanical systems
  • Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
  • Experience using a variety of web-based and other software tools for calculation and data processing

job.title: Security Engineer, AWS Security Incident Response
job.description:
AWS Security Incident Response is looking for technical Security Engineers that are passionate about learning new concepts and work well within a team environment to keep customers secure. We value engineers that can work through ambiguity to identify suspicious activity, lead security response, and can explain technical security concepts to non-technical audiences.

Key job responsibilities

  • Respond to threat findings that indicate unauthorized activity has occurred
  • Identify, evaluate and communicate security threats, risks and vulnerabilities, and propose recommended remediation for security issues.
  • Contribute to the development of security automation and security posture improvements.
  • Track and report on the effectiveness of AWS detective controls such as Amazon GuardDuty and partner products such as CrowdStrike Falcon or Wiz Defend
  • Develop processes and policies to increase security response effectiveness.
  • On-call support: This role requires periodic on-call responsibilities including weekends.

A day in the life As a Security Engineer in AWS Security Incident Response, your responsibilities include monitoring networks and systems for potential threats, performing triage for security alerts, documenting suspicious activity, and reporting issues so they can be adequately handled. You will work alongside our security engineers and partner teams to perform daily threat detection and incident response, using the full capability of AWS technologies and services to detect and mitigate cyber threats at a massive scale and help protect AWS Customers. You should also enjoy learning about the most up-to-date new technologies and procedures to protect information systems and data.

About the team AWS Security Incident Response provides 24/7 threat monitoring, investigation, and response across for customer’s AWS environments. The service enhances existing security capabilities by providing security monitoring for all native AWS services and supports vendor agnostic detective and protective controls to provide holistic security controls for customers. This is done by leveraging data on common attack techniques to enhance detective controls and incident response, then building auto-remediation capabilities to minimize disruption to customer workloads. When a security event does happen, you will be there provide guidance.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Experience with web protocols, common security attacks, and remediation (non-internship)
  • Knowledge of system, network and OS
  • Experience with coding/scripting in one or more languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, Ruby, or PowerShell)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
  • Experience triaging security alerts, front-line analysis, and escalation
  • GCIH (GIAC Certified Incident Handler) or GSEC (GIAC Security Essentials) or Security+

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Math, or a related field
  • Experience in IT consulting/management with IT Transformation in a customer-facing role
  • 8+ years in IT and/or Management Consulting, with at least 3 years in a people leadership role.
  • Experience owning and managing IT transformation projects
  • Experience recruiting, onboarding, training, mentoring, and/or staffing consultants or other customer-facing professionals
  • Fluency of English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with customer relationship management, especially C-suite level customer engagement
  • Experience with design of modern, scalable delivery models for technology consulting services
  • Advanced technology degree or AWS Professional level certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional) preferred Strong project management and resource management capabilities
  • Financial acumen with P&L management experience
  • Ability to navigate complex stakeholder relationships and drive change
  • Sales and negotiation skills for opportunity capture and proposal development

job.title: Senior Marketing Audience Specialist
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

18 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Senior Marketing Audience Specialist

Job Summary

Job Description

Role Purpose

The Senior Marketing Audience Specialist is responsible for defining and governing audience segmentation strategies across the customer lifecycle to ensure marketing communications reach the right customers, through the right channels, at the right time. Leveraging customer data, behavioural insights, and experimentation, the role develops audience frameworks and targeting approaches that optimise customer engagement, experience, and commercial outcomes across channels including email, SMS, RCS, push notifications, paid media, and direct mail.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain audience segmentation strategies aligned to business objectives, customer needs, and lifecycle stages.
  • Define audience frameworks, targeting rules, contact strategies, and eligibility criteria across marketing and customer communications.
  • Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Digital, Data, Analytics, Product, and Customer teams to translate business objectives into audience strategies.
  • Design and oversee test-and-learn programs to determine the most effective channel mix, communication cadence, and audience approach.
  • Analyse customer behaviour, preferences, and engagement trends to identify opportunities for improved targeting and personalisation.
  • Provide strategic recommendations on audience selection, prioritisation, suppression, and channel optimisation.
  • Ensure audience strategies balance customer experience, regulatory requirements, and commercial outcomes.
  • Build and manage audience definitions within marketing automation platforms or customer data platforms (CDP) and ensure audience integrity and governance.
  • Monitor audience performance and provide insights to continuously improve engagement, conversion, retention, and customer value.
  • Support the evolution of customer data and marketing technology capabilities to enable more advanced segmentation and targeting.

Key Skills & Experience

  • Graduate Degree – Marketing, Commerce, or equivalent
  • At least 5 years’ experience working in data-driven marketing
  • Ability to build and manage audiences in marketing automation, customer engagement, or customer data platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Tealium, Data360 or similar)
  • Strong understanding of customer segmentation, targeting, and lifecycle marketing principles.
  • Experience using customer data and insights to develop audience and contact strategies.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret performance data and generate actionable recommendations.
  • Experience designing experiments and applying test-and-learn methodologies.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders across marketing, digital, data, and technology teams.
  • Strong communication and strategic thinking skills with a customer-centric approach.

Success Measures

  • Effective use of experimentation to inform audience and channel decision-making.
  • Improved audience precision and relevance across marketing communications.
  • Increased customer engagement and campaign effectiveness through optimised targeting and channel strategies.
  • Development of scalable audience frameworks that support consistent customer experiences.
  • Delivery of actionable insights that drive improved commercial and customer outcomes.

If you are looking to take the next step in your career, we want to hear from you!

As part of your application with Telstra, you may receive communications from us on +61 440 135 548 (for job applications in Australia) and +1 (623) 400-7726 (for job applications in the Philippines and India).

When you join our team, you become part of a welcoming and inclusive community where everyone is respected, valued and celebrated. We actively seek individuals from various backgrounds, ethnicities, genders and disabilities because we know that diversity not only strengthens our team but also enriches our work. We have zero tolerance for harassment of any kind, and we prioritise creating a workplace culture where everyone is safe and can thrive.

As part of the hiring process, all identified candidates will undergo a background check, and the results will play a role in the final decision regarding your application.

We work flexibly at Telstra. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you. When you apply, you can share your pronouns and / or any reasonable adjustments needed to take part equitably during the recruitment process.

We are aware of current limitations with our website accessibility and are working towards improving this. Should you experience any issues accessing information or the application form, and require this in an alternate format, please contact our Talent Acquisition team on DisabilityandAccessibility@team.telstra.com or via the additional contact options found at [www.telstra.com.au/careers/diversity-equity-and-inclusion/disability-employment](http://www.telstra.com.au/careers/diversity-equity-and-inclusion/disability-employment).

job.title: Analyst (2-Years Contract)
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

Responsibilities​

  • Conduct thorough reviews of additional property tax payable by tenants, ensuring accuracy and compliance with lease terms.
  • Work with asset managers, account managers and tenants on the clawback of additional property tax.
  • Timely submission of periodic and ad-hoc leasing reports, management reports, budgetary controls, and budgeting.
  • System security controls and administration, data integrity management and updates, and IT-enabled initiatives support.
  • Assisting with the review of internal and inter-department workflow relating to system and reporting needs
  • Assisting in managing system-level space requirement.
  • Assisting the manager in communicating leasing deal structure/process to put the data back to system.
  • Leading or assisting in budgeting, forecasting and valuation exercises.
  • Monitoring operational and financial performance of portfolio assets.
  • Formulating asset business plans to enhance the value of portfolio assets.
  • Conducting market research, competitors’ analysis and data analysis for insights.
  • Prepare management reports and performance updates for key stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Degree/Diploma in Business/Real Estate, with knowledge on real estate reporting (including financial analysis), management reporting, documentation, processes, and procedures.
  • Highly numerate with sharp analytical, research and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to details and sound quantitative skills, including a strong foundation in financial analysis.
  • Good working knowledge of real estate practices and documents is advantageous.
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications and IT-savviness.
  • Good analytical skills and ability to work under pressure to meet tight deadlines.
  • Dedicated, service-oriented team player with initiative, and multitasking abilities.
  • Candidates with no prior experience are welcome to apply.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical coverage
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Financial Planning & Analysis Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this role, you will have the opportunity to collect, analyze, and interpret financial data. You will update budgets and forecasts and identify trends and problems. You will also showcase your expertise by communicating insights and collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to drive financial performance and optimize business outcomes. This position reports to FP&A Manager.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Collaborate with the other financial professionals in Divisions / Hubs / Countries / functions to understand on-going accounting practices and adhere to audit compliance and standards.
  • Responsible for end-to-end bottom-up accounting (including monthly/ quarterly closing) for the respective local units pertaining to Real Estate Product Groups. This includes Monthly Journal entries, reclassification entries, review of profit and loss account, Operational Free cash flow and Balance Sheet.
  • Overseeing commercial execution of all Capex Projects and implements finance control processes with precise quarterly Capex projections. Monitoring Fixed Asset Register and timely recording of Capitalization, Transfer and Retirement including quarterly disclosure.
  • Prepare Annual Budgeting including Capital Investments and Occupancy Cost. Supporting the analysis of business actual performance versus plan and proposing improvement actions.
  • Prepare business cases (GMAS - Internal tool) and performing cost - benefit analysis under various scenarios and support decisions. Preparing financial modeling for various hypotheses and analyzing impact to the organization and validating the accuracy.
  • Performing benchmarking of key performance indicators (i.e. Operational EBITA, Net Working Capital and Capex Spending). Working with local/ global management team to understand and analyze drivers of financial performance and identifying market trends of financial data and business information and reporting through reconciliation and review of exceptions.
  • Support preparing management reports including CRIMS internal tool – for Portfolio Management and Capex Tracker and need based MIS.
  • Improve finance engagement across cross function team (example: collaborate with local team/Purchase to Payment (P2P), R2R, AR, Fixed Assets so on)
  • Manages relationship with the stakeholders in their area of responsiblity and ensures alignment.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

  • Total 3-5 Years of post qualification experience. You are immersed in Financial Planning and analysis.
  • Possess enhanced knowledge of SAP, BI Tools. Degree in CMA/CA/US CMA/CIMA/ACCA/MBA with Excellent communication skills. Those pursuing degree in the final year / intermediate/awaiting results can also apply.

###

job.title: SoD Ruleset Specialist
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Assurance, Risk & Internal Controls Mngr ###

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this role, you will own the Global SoD ruleset for ECC/FIORI. Review / enhance / issue guidance, support risk analysis (SoD), risk management (elimination or mitigation) guidance, Control Performance guidance, SAP role designing guidance, user access review guidance at a global level. You will also be responsible for process improvements, internal and external audit co-ordination.

The work model for the role is Hybrid #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the IS Services.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Design, develop, and maintain SoD rulesets for ECC and S/4HANA systems (both T-code & Fiori-based).
  • Perform ruleset testing and validation to ensure compliance and accuracy across different system landscapes.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to align rulesets with critical business processes (R2R, O2C, P2P, H2R, Tax, Treasury, ITGC).
  • Support role design and role creation strategies, ensuring alignment with organizational security principles.
  • Support in analyzing, troubleshooting, and suggesting remediation for SoD conflicts, proposing sustainable solutions.
  • Work closely with change management and audit teams to maintain compliance with ITGC and regulatory requirements.
  • Organize and facilitate SoD Reference Group meetings, maintain minutes and track action items.
  • Collect stakeholder feedback and present it during SoD Reference Group meetings.
  • Track, document, and monitor all changes to the ruleset, maintaining traceability from business requirements to ruleset design and testing results as well as maintaining a documented decision log.
  • Communicate ruleset changes to senior management in non-technical language
  • Coordinate with internal and external auditors during SoD ruleset reviews / audits.
  • Act as the primary point of contact on SoD ruleset matters across the organization, including addressing helpdesk requests related to SoD.
  • Respond to stakeholder questions regarding ruleset design, conflicts, and compliance.
  • Own, maintain, and version the SoD documentation set.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to team members on SoD methodologies and best practices.
  • Bring innovative ideas to strengthen access governance and enhance organizational risk management.
  • Suggest and implement new controls related to UAM/SoD globally.
  • Coordinate the creation and maintenance of Global Mitigation Control Library in collaboration with respective stakeholders.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

  • Graduate in any discipline with 8–10 years of relevant experience.
  • Strong knowledge of ECC & S/4HANA authorization concepts (T-code & Fiori-based).
  • Proven expertise in ruleset development, testing, and maintenance for ECC & S/4HANA.
  • Experience with multi-system SAP landscapes including S/4 environments.
  • Adequate knowledge of core business processes: R2R, O2C, P2P, H2R, Tax, Treasury, ITGC.
  • Adequate knowledge of Identity & Access Management (IAM).
  • Familiarity with application change management processes.
  • Experience with role design and various schemas of role creation in SAP.
  • Hands-on expertise with SAP GRC ARM, ARA & BRM.
  • Exposure to new SAP technologies such as PI, SAC, IAG.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CIAM) are an added advantage.

job.title: Lead, Regulatory Affairs and Customer Assurance
job.description:
About the job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As part of the Cloud Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) Risk & Compliance organization, the Regional Regulatory Affairs & Customer Assurance team is a proactive engine of advocacy and customer growth. We serve as the Regional Technical Liaison—the high-impact bridge between Google’s global engineering, local regulators, and our most strategic customers. Our goal is to unblock markets and shape the regulatory landscape, ensuring compliance is a competitive advantage rather than a barrier.

You will protect business growth and unblock markets by representing Google Cloud compliance position anad provide assurance to customers, partners and regulators. You will drive Google Cloud’s success and our customers’ AI adoption through trust-based advocacy, regional leadership, effective assurance engagements. As the convergence of AI and cloud redefines global critical infrastructure, we face a new regulatory reality defined by sovereignty, safety, and resilience mandates.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Unblock Australia & New Zealand (AUNZ) regulatory hurdles to accelerate Google Cloud adoption, AI workloads, and complex agreement closures across regulated and public sectors.
  • Maintain Google’s risk/control environment and lead audit engagements for major enterprise customers, independent auditors, and regulators.
  • Review and approve high-impact agreement terms, geo-expansions, and industry-tailored cloud architectures.
  • Represent the regulators to shape global product roadmaps while advocating business compliance.
