job.title: Technical Program Manager, Security Engineering
job.description:
About the job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Information Security Engineering (ISE) Technical Program Manager (TPM) team leads the charge in safeguarding Google and Alphabet's extensive product ecosystem. We equip developers to build secure applications across Core, Cloud, and hybrid environments, ensuring users can trust our products. Our core mission includes, advocating for best practices and secure coding principles to minimize vulnerabilities across our products and services. We design and implement solutions that protect user data and infrastructure, maintaining the highest levels of security. We create scalable and efficient processes and tools to strengthen the security posture of Google and Alphabet products. ISE is at the forefront of securing AI products, and leveraging AI to scale our security solutions.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the full lifecycle of complex security initiatives, from initial requirements planning with stakeholders to final deployment and launch across Google’s infrastructure as needed.
  • Lead engagements with engineering partners across multiple teams to drive the adoption of centralized security solutions. Translate complex security requirements and challenges into actionable project plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks to project timelines.
  • Define, track, and report on key program metrics to demonstrate measurable risk reduction and program health to executive leadership.
  • Align team-level security objectives with broader organizational engineering plans, ensuring that commitments are met on schedule and blockers are surfaced early.
  • Drive the development of "well-lit paths," including self-service documentation, training materials, and codelabs, to support product teams in migrating to secure standards with minimal direct intervention.

job.title: Data Center Technician, Global Data Center Server Operations
job.description:
About the job

Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or teams (e.g. Machine Learning platforms, network architecture).
  • Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose moderately complex issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and identify the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
  • Diagnose, repair, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, and infrastructure based on identified issues with multiple solutions, independently. Independently execute advanced operational procedures as part of daily work activities and follow security policies and processes.
  • Shift work is required to meet evolving business needs and operational schedules.
  • Collaborate with the partner teams (e.g., Program Managers, Data Center Operations, and Software and Hardware Engineers) to complete tasks, and to escalate and resolve defined problems.

job.title: Data Center Facilities Electrical Technician
job.description:

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**

job.title: Senior Delivery Manager, Platform
job.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Senior Delivery Manager, Platform to own the delivery of Firmus' software platform into each of our data centres, taking it from plan through commissioning and go-live to operational handover. The platform is what makes our GPU compute operable: the cloud and Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, API, and the tooling our teams build on. You work across internal engineering teams, delivery partners, and contractors to bring each site live, holding delivery to scope, schedule, quality, and commercial commitments. This role is critical to ensure each site deployed securely, on schedule, and with increasing repeatability.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Per-Site Delivery Planning & Sequencing

Own the platform's per-site delivery plan: scope, sequencing, milestones, critical path, and the readiness and acceptance criteria for each go-live. Align with the overall per-site schedule owned by the overall Technical Program Manager (TPM) and hold scope against agreed statements of work.

Deployment & Commissioning

Execute the plan at each site: integration, configuration, migration, and commissioning through to production validation and go-live against the agreed gates. Keep the deployment playbook, runbooks, and standards so every rollout is repeatable rather than bespoke.

Risk, Dependency & Change Governance

Own risk, issue, and change management across the delivery, and coordinate cross-squad and external dependencies with the Tech Leads, platform architect, and delivery TPM. Run the governance cadence of status, milestone tracking, delivery KPIs, and decision logs, and track scope change and budget against plan.

Partner & Contractor Management

Own the delivery-partner and contractor relationship end to end. Scope and brief the work, hold systems integrators and contractors to schedule, quality, and commercials, and retain internal accountability for what they execute in the blended delivery model.

Stakeholder Alignment, Reporting & Handover

Act as the single interface between platform engineering and the site programme, keeping engineering, operations, partners, and executive stakeholders aligned through each deployment. Give the leadership team straight read on status, risk, and the decisions needed. Drive the transition to operations: knowledge transfer, on-call readiness, hyper care, and the exit criteria that let a site hand over clean.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent delivery experience.
  • 10+ years delivering complex software or platform programmes to production, owning delivery end to end rather than a single workstream with at least 15 engineers.
  • Delivery is your core craft: you bring the pace and ownership that rapid, multi-site expansion demands, and you turn ambiguity and shifting requirements into a workable plan that keeps moving.
  • Track record running an integrated plan and critical path across parallel workstreams to a hard go-live, owning dependencies, risk, change, and budget, and coordinating with a wider programme management.
  • Proven experience managing delivery partners, systems integrators, and contractors in a blended model, holding them to schedule, quality, and commercials while retaining internal accountability.
  • Experience deploying a platform across multiple sites or environments, from commissioning and go-live through operational handover to a run team, and building the repeatable playbook of standards, runbooks, and acceptance gates that makes each rollout faster than the last.
  • Proven ability to align engineering, operations, delivery, vendor, and executive stakeholders through complex programmes.
  • Enough technical fluency to challenge engineers on software architecture, Kubernetes, CI/CD, cloud and API without a translator, plus a working understanding of the hardware and telemetry domain, including GPU or high-performance compute, out-of-band telemetry such as Redfish and network fabric, enough to manage integration and commissioning.
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication in English. You can give leadership a straight read on a complex delivery, explaining the situation and the decision needed without losing the substance.
  • Awareness of delivering against security and compliance controls such as SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001.

Bonus points

  • Experience delivering GPU or AI compute, high-performance computing, or high-density data centre platforms.
  • Experience delivering observability, monitoring, or telemetry platforms across metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Formal delivery or programme management certification, such as PMP and Agile or Scrum experience.
  • Experience introducing AI-assisted or agent-based tooling into delivery or operations.

LOCATION

Singapore

Required

Role: Airside Product Design Development

Location: Gurugram, India

Full/ Part-time: Full time

Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

About the role

This role will be responsible for Airside Product development(AHU / FCU / CRAH / CRAC / Fan-wall products), Product engineering, New product development programs.

Key Job deliverables

  • Lead design and development of new airside products and platform enhancements.
  • Develop product concepts, layouts, detailed designs, and engineering documentation.
  • Translate customer and business requirements into engineering specifications.
  • Own product engineering deliverables throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Engineering Design : Perform engineering calculations related to Airflow, Pressure drop, Fan selection, Acoustic performance, Coil Design, Structural integrity. Create and review: GA drawings, Manufacturing drawings, BOMs, Design documents, Technical specifications, ETOs, Value engineering
  • Cross Functional Collaboration : Work with Sales, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Quality, Product Management, Lab teams, Global Engineering teams. Support factory launch and production readiness activities.
  • Strong technical know-how and ownership in data center/non-DC airside cooling products

EDUCATION & EXPERINCE PREFERRED

Bachelors / Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering.

10- 15 years Experience in HVAC product design and development Airside products (AHU / FCU / CRAH / CRAC / Fan-wall products), Product engineering, New product development programs

Essential Competencies/ Primary Skill Set:

**

1. Airside Engineering & HVAC Expertise

  • Strong technical knowledge of airside products including AHU, FCU, CRAH, CRAC, fan-wall, ducted and related HVAC systems.
  • Sound understanding of airflow dynamics, pressure drop calculations, fan selection, heat transfer, psychrometrics, IAQ and thermal performance.
  • Ability to perform engineering analysis and optimize product performance, efficiency and reliability.
  • Knowledge of data center airside cooling applications and high-density cooling requirements is preferred.

2. Product Development & System Engineering

  • Hands-on experience in new product development from concept through production release.
  • Strong understanding of stage-gate / NPD processes and engineering design methodologies.
  • Ability to translate customer requirements into product specifications and engineering deliverables.
  • Experience in product architecture definition, design reviews, prototype development and product validation.

3. Mechanical Design & Engineering Analysis

  • Experience in airside product design, component selection and engineering calculations.
  • Ability to perform airflow, fan performance, pressure drop and thermal analysis.
  • Understanding of product performance optimization, design robustness and reliability requirements.
  • Familiarity with design for manufacturability (DFM) and design for cost principles.

4. Product Validation & Testing

  • Experience in developing validation plans and supporting product qualification activities.
  • Ability to analyze test data, identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Knowledge of product performance testing, reliability testing and engineering problem solving.
  • Strong focus on delivering quality and first-pass validation success.

5. Compliance & Regulatory Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of relevant HVAC industry standards such as AHRI, ASHRAE and ISO.
  • Understanding of product certification, compliance requirements and design verification processes.
  • Ability to ensure engineering designs comply with applicable regulations and customer specifications.

6. Design Tools & Digital Engineering

  • Proficiency in CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, Inventor or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience with AutoCAD, BOM management and PLM systems.
  • Ability to create and review engineering drawings, specifications and product documentation.
  • Familiarity with engineering databases and product configuration tools.

7. Program Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Ability to manage multiple engineering activities and deliver to committed timelines.
  • Strong collaboration skills while working with manufacturing, sourcing, quality, laboratory and product management teams.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a global engineering environment.

Desirable Competencies/ Secondary Skill Set:

**

1. Data Center Cooling Applications

  • Experience in Data Center AHU, CRAH, fan-wall systems and mission-critical cooling solutions.
  • Understanding of containment strategies, redundancy concepts and high-density cooling applications.
  • Exposure to hyperscale and colocation data center cooling requirements.

2. Advanced Engineering & Simulation Tools

  • Knowledge of CFD analysis for airflow and thermal optimization.
  • Exposure to FEA analysis for structural assessment and product durability.
  • Familiarity with engineering simulation and virtual validation tools.

3. Cost Optimization & Localization

  • Experience in value engineering, cost reduction and product localization initiatives.
  • Understanding of supplier selection, alternate components and cost-driven design decisions.
  • Ability to support regional product competitiveness through localization activities.

4. Manufacturing & Industrialization Support

  • Understanding of manufacturing processes related to airside products.
  • Exposure to factory launch activities, pilot builds and production readiness assessments.
  • Experience supporting smooth transition from development to manufacturing.

5. Controls & System Integration

  • Basic understanding of HVAC controls, sensors and system integration requirements.
  • Familiarity with product selection tools and digital product configuration platforms.
  • Understanding of connected and intelligent HVAC solutions is desirable.

6. Continuous Improvement & Certifications

  • Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma or structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Professional certifications such as Six Sigma Green Belt, PMP or equivalent are desirable.
  • Participation in technical forums, professional bodies or industry standards activities is an added advantage.

7. Customer & Market Orientation

  • Understanding of customer requirements and application engineering concepts.
  • Ability to support technical discussions with customers, consultants and internal stakeholders.
  • Awareness of market trends, competitor offerings and emerging technologies in the airside industry.

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary.

  • Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities

job.description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. Role Definition

Lead Engineer – Platform Integration role is to provide technical leadership for the development and integration of next-generation power generation products. This role is responsible for the end-to-end technical integration of generator set and package platforms, ensuring that complex subsystems are delivered as a validated, compliant, cost-effective, and production-ready solution. As the technical leader for the platform, you will drive system-level decision making, coordinate cross-functional engineering activities, and ensure successful execution from concept through production launch.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end integration of generator set and power system platforms across mechanical, electrical, controls, cooling, structural, acoustic, fuel, and exhaust systems.
  • Own platform-level technical decisions, architecture, and integration trade-offs to achieve performance, quality, cost, and schedule targets.
  • Drive product development execution from concept through production launch, ensuring successful delivery of customer and business requirements.
  • Lead system design reviews, architecture reviews, DFMEA activities, and engineering readiness assessments.
  • Define and execute platform validation strategies, including thermal, structural, vibration, acoustics, electrical, durability, and compliance requirements
  • Provide technical leadership across cross-functional teams including Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Service, and Compliance.
  • Drive issue resolution, risk management, and technical escalation to ensure product readiness and successful program execution.
  • Champion quality, cost, and velocity objectives through strong systems engineering, integration discipline, and proactive problem solving.
  • Ensure adherence to engineering processes, documentation standards, DFMEA practices, and product governance requirements.
  • Communicate platform status, technical risks, and key decisions to leadership and stakeholders.

Degree Requirement Degree required

  • Requires a degree in an accredited in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering,

Skill Descriptors Products and Services: Knowledge of major products and services and product and service groups; ability to apply knowledge of product and service appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Provides effective solutions to moderate technical challenges through strong technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
  • Assumes accountability for personal technical performance and holds others responsible for theirs.

Influencing Through Expertise: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to use these to deepen own expertise and impact or challenge decisions within and outside own organization. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Acquires expertise through training and practical experience in the relevant field.
  • Analyzes the needs, desires, and motivations of the other party to effectively understand a given scenario.

  • Provides evidentiary support while giving opinions or recommendations to influence decision-making.
  • Conducts tasks in such a way as to build a strong reputation and credibility as an expert in the field.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Utilizes preferred tools, techniques and methods for estimating project cost and time.
  • Plans, estimates, staffs, organizes and monitors significant projects.
  • Identifies risks and vulnerabilities; creates contingency plans.
  • Conducts regular and ad-hoc project reviews with project team, sponsors, and clients.
  • Maintains open communication among project participants and interested parties.
  • Communicates reporting requirements; creates monitoring and control mechanisms.

Team Management: Knowledge of effective team building techniques; ability to form and manage effective teams. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Facilitates discussion of team goals, roles, needs, and responsibilities.
  • Participates in defining the ground rules for individual and team responsibilities.
  • Manages a team to the successful completion of a project or task.
  • Recognizes the contribution of each and every team member publicly.
  • Leads team meetings to review progress and performance, ensuring follow-up on previous decisions.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
  • Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
  • Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.

  • Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

Troubleshooting Technical Problems: Knowledge of troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, detect and resolve technical problems in a manufacturing or product development environment. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Coaches others how to resolve integration or communications problems in multi-vendor environment.

Product Design and Development: Knowledge of product features; ability to design, build, and develop a new product, technology, or service from concept through to production. Level Extensive Experience:

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

IPSD Application Engineers work in Caterpillar Aftermarket & Customer Solution organization, belong to S&CS (Service & Customer Support) team. This position is 100% focused on third party business, with the responsibility of supporting Dealers & Distributors A&I capability. Application engineer will primarily work with third party OEM power system and control team on new product development, and internally collaborate with sales, product group & engineering team, product support, etc.

What You Will Do:

  • Understand customer's business, leading OEM technical relationship becoming a trusted power system advisor. Drive quality, innovation and new business through application collaboration and installation services.
  • Execute customer projects through the A&I process, delivering integrated engines to quality, time and cost targets making timely decisions on approval risks. Alert customer to mandatory and recommended improvements.
  • Manage engine spec development, supporting customer and engine design change impact, supporting any A&I related CPI projects. Liaise with customer personnel at all levels.
  • Tune the engine performance at OEM site in collaboration with OEM power and control team to achieve the machine performance target.
  • Complete assessment of machine design against A&I guidelines and complete design calculations. Work with customer on machine design improvements to enhance performance, reliability and cost utilizing existing engine designs where possible.
  • Conduct Genset site installation check for Critical EP Projects (for example, Data Center projects).
  • Capture customer/ market sector technical requirements, create FRD’s from VOC and support development to translate into standard or bespoke product offering.
  • Critical customer information, drawings and production intent photos and data recorded, key actions successfully followed through with customer and machine recommended for production approval with engine warranty cover.
  • Liaise with engineering to create applications guidelines that can be practically checked during machine development. Including A&I Guides, Installation Audit Forms, tests procedures.
  • Provide technical sales support to help win new business.
  • Track emissions exempt engines at customers ensuring compliance.
  • Ability to capture, collate, engine diagnostic data using specialist tools (CANAPE/ DATALOGGER /EST/ET, etc.). Interpret results and draw conclusions and implement permanent solution.
  • Evaluate & Contribute to the design of new products and processes setup.
  • Support and drive Dealer & Distributor A&I team capability improvement through Distributor Excellence review, responding to A&I technical queries.
  • Fully represent customers in Engineering and Program teams.
  • Help support other customer field and service issues.

What Skills You Will Have:

  • Technical Excellence: Provide tailored technical solutions to customers, be a trusted technical advisor to OEMs.
  • Effective Communication: Clearly understand customers’ technical requirements, effectively feedback to product group and seek for solutions. Have the courage to manage tough conversations with customers.
  • Problem Solving: Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate to resolve customer issues during A&I phase.
  • Project Management: Be able to manage project timeline, identify risks and develop risk mitigation plan, ensure project to be delivered to quality and in time.

Required Qualifications

  • Competent in use of Standard business tools including, Excel, Power Point, Word, Outlook, Teams, etc.
  • Speak fluent English and excellent in reading, writing.
  • Independently manage customers programs with minimum supervision.
  • Well understanding of engine knowledge, performance, aftertreatment, NVH.
  • More than 8 years of engine experience including application, design, performance, validation, etc.
  • Bachelor degree or above in Engineering

Desired Qualifications:

  • Transmission and hydraulic knowledge.
  • EP Knowledge, especially Data Center experience.
  • External customer facing experience.

Additional Information:

  • Able to travel globally up to 50% of time to meet customer expectation and support sales.
  • Willingness to visit customer site at short notice (less than 24 hrs) to investigate customer critical field issues.

job.title: Mechanical Design Engineer - Inverter & Charger Cabinet Systems
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition Designs, develops, validates mechanical systems and enclosure solutions for power conversion products, including inverter cabinets, charger cabinets, power distribution equipment, switchgear cabinets, and containerized electrical systems. Responsible for translating system requirements into robust, manufacturable, cost-effective mechanical designs from concept development through production release.

Key Responsibilities

Product Design & Development

  • Lead the mechanical design and development of inverter cabinets, battery charger cabinets, power conversion enclosures, and switchgear systems from concept to production.
  • Develop cabinet architectures, structural frameworks, mounting arrangements, cooling systems, access provisions, cable routing, and serviceability features.
  • Create detailed 3D CAD models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, BOMs, and engineering documentation.
  • Define enclosure layouts considering electrical clearances, creepage distances, thermal management, ingress protection (IP), EMC requirements, maintainability, and safety standards.
  • Design sheet metal, fabricated structures, welded assemblies, busbar support structures, mounting brackets, doors, locks, hinges, and internal equipment arrangements.
  • Participate in product architecture reviews and cross-functional design reviews with electrical, manufacturing, sourcing, and quality teams.

Thermal & Structural Design

  • Develop cooling concepts utilizing natural convection, forced-air ventilation, heat exchangers, or liquid-cooling interfaces as required.
  • Perform or support structural, vibration, seismic, to ensure product reliability and compliance.
  • Evaluate cabinet strength, transportation loads, lifting provisions, and environmental performance requirements.

Manufacturing & Supplier Collaboration

  • Work closely with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing teams to optimize designs for manufacturability, assembly, installation, and cost.
  • Support prototype builds, factory testing, design validation activities, and issue resolution.
  • Assist sourcing and supplier quality teams with supplier selection, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Drive cost reduction, value engineering, and standardization initiatives.

Verification & Compliance

  • Develop and execute design verification plans.
  • Support certification and compliance activities related to applicable industry standards.
  • Investigate field issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent engineering discipline.
  • 6+ years of hands-on mechanical design experience in design and development of enclosures and structures for electrical equipment, power electronics, switchgear, power conversion systems, or related industries.
  • Proven experience designing inverter cabinets, charger cabinets, switchgear enclosures, electrical control cabinets, or containerized power systems from the ground up.
  • Experience with sheet metal design, structural fabrication, and enclosure development.
  • Proficiency in 3D CAD tools such as Creo, SolidWorks, NX, or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with: Utility-scale energy storage systems (BESS) Power conversion systems (PCS) Renewable energy products UPS systems EV charging infrastructure MV/LV switchgear Containerized electrical substations or E-Houses

  • Familiarity with IEC, UL, NEMA, IP, and electrical equipment enclosure standards.
  • Knowledge of thermal management and cooling system design.
  • Experience coordinating with electrical engineering teams on controls, power electronics, and cable management design.

This job requires working from office 5days in a week.

job.description:
Job Description

Legal Recovery & Insolvency Management

  • Manage legal recovery and insolvency cases, including filing Proof of Debt (POD) claims with Liquidators and the Official Assignee (OA).
  • Monitor, track, and provide regular progress updates on ongoing legal cases to internal stakeholders.
  • Gather, compile, and verify legal documentation required for submission to external legal counsels.
  • Represent the company in Small Claims Tribunals (SCT) hearings and consultations (online and in-person).

Vendor Management & Dunning Operations

  • Manage relationships with Debt Collection Agencies (DCAs) and law firms; monitoring performance metrics and reviewing of billing/commission computations.
  • Oversee internal dunning workflows, and common mailbox inquiries/complaints.
  • Review and manage accounts under Specific Provisioning (SP) to maintain accurate provisioning
  • Prepare justification paper for bad debt write-offs (WO) for management approval.
  • Support process improvement initiatives, ad-hoc operational tasks, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements

BPO Managment

  • Supervise and review the work of BPO staffs handling credit reporting, Specific Provisioning (SP), and bad debt write-off (WO) preparation.

Qualifications

  • Degree or Diploma in Finance, Business, Economics, Accounting, or a related discipline, with a solid grasp of credit control and provisioning frameworks.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in dunning, credit recovery, and legal insolvency workflows, preferably within the telecommunications industry.
  • Proven experience supervising BPO/offshore teams and reviewing operational submissions
  • Practical knowledge of local legal processes (POD filings, OA/Liquidator administration) and SCT hearing protocols.
  • Strong financial acumen in tracking Specific Provisioning (SP) and preparing write-off proposals.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and MS Office, with advanced spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets / Excel; knowledge of Google Apps Script or VBA preferred), alongside hands-on experience with SAP
  • Strong written communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills under tight timelines.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Finance

Job Description

The Assistant Manager will oversee Point of Sales (POS) and Payment Modes operations within Finance. This role ensures accurate transaction processing, compliance with controls, and continuous improvements. The Assistant Manager will lead a small team, resolve operational issues, and partner with both internal stakeholders and external parties (e.g., collecting agents, banks, and payment providers) to drive automation, efficiency, and cost savings, while enhancing customer and business experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end POS and payment operations, including validation, reconciliation, settlement, and exception handling.
  • Monitor and strengthen internal controls, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and risk mitigation.
  • Resolve issues across POS systems, payment gateways, and related platforms in collaboration with IS and product owners.
  • Collaborate with external collecting agents, banks, and payment service providers to ensure smooth operations, accurate settlements, and issue resolution.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, automation, and cost-saving initiatives to reduce manual work, errors, and transaction costs.
  • Partner with stakeholders such as IS, product owners, finance teams, etc to ensure accurate data flow, resolve issues, and recommend operational efficiencies.
  • Provide insights to enhance efficiency, customer experience, and support digital/technology initiatives.
  • Lead, coach, and develop team members, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to propose practical, efficient, and cost-effective solutions.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to prioritise multiple deadlines under pressure, with a growth mindset focused on innovation and efficiency.

job.title: Senior Executive, Marketing (Social Media)
job.description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a creative, driven Senior Executive to shape our brand’s voice on social media and engage consumers across Singapore in ways that build lasting brand affinity. You’ll bring a minimum of 3 years of experience managing social media accounts and influencer marketing programmes, and a proven track record of turning content into real engagement and growth. Based in Singapore, this role is for someone who is genuinely passionate about social media trends, content creation, and influencer marketing, and who thrives in a fast-paced, agile environment.

Responsibilities

  • Planning & Execution: Translate the social media strategy into actionable plans and drive execution, ensuring alignment with business goals and timelines.
  • Influencer Marketing Management: Identify and engage the right creators, negotiate terms, manage briefings and deliverables, and track campaign performance and ROI.
  • Content Creation: Conceptualise and produce engaging content across social media platforms, including filming and editing as needed.
  • Trend Monitoring: Stay up to date with the latest social media trends, tools, and best practices to ensure our content remains cutting-edge.
  • Community Management: Manage and grow online communities, responding to comments and messages promptly and professionally.
  • Analytics & Reporting: Track, analyse, and report on social media performance, making data-driven decisions to optimise content and engagement.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, product, and sales teams to maintain a consistent brand voice across all channels.
  • Campaign Management: Plan and execute social media campaigns end-to-end, including paid promotions.
  • Agile Adaptation: Adapt tactics and content quickly to real-time performance data and evolving business needs.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience managing social media accounts, preferably for consumer brands.
  • Prior experience in influencer marketing, including sourcing, negotiation, and campaign management, is preferred.
  • Strong creative mindset with the ability to generate content ideas that are practical and easily executable, from concept to final cut.
  • Deep, up-to-date understanding of social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, etc.) and their respective best practices.
  • Familiarity with paid social advertising platforms (e.g. Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager) is a plus.
  • Proficient in using social media management and analytics tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Genuine interest in digital marketing and social media developments.
  • Hands-on photo/video editing skills (e.g. CapCut, Adobe) are a big plus.
  • Experience in the Singapore market is highly preferred.

job.title: High Voltage Site Engineer
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the HV Site Engineer reporting to the Associate Director, HV Infrastructure, you will work closely with our Technology, Development, Construction, Commissioning and Operations teams, making your mark in several ways:

  • Lead the safe and effective on-site delivery of high voltage (HV) infrastructure across AirTrunk projects, ensuring installations meet approved designs, quality requirements, programme commitments and operational needs
  • Coordinate contractors, consultants, network service providers and internal teams through construction, testing, energisation, commissioning and handover
  • Provide practical site-based engineering solutions to HV issues, with a strong focus on safety, constructability, reliability and continuity of operations

Your Day to Day

  • Manage the on-site delivery of HV networks across new and existing AirTrunk sites, ensuring work is completed safely and in accordance with approved designs, applicable codes, standards and AirTrunk requirements
  • Oversee the installation of HV equipment and systems, including switchgear, transformers, protection relays, SCADA, earthing, cabling and DC systems
  • Review issued-for-construction drawings, specifications, method statements, inspection and test plans, safe work method statements and vendor documentation before site execution
  • Supervise and collaborate with principal contractors, specialist subcontractors and suppliers to achieve safe, practical and high-quality outcomes on time and within budget
  • Complete site inspections, monitor workmanship and quality records, and drive the timely resolution of non-conformances, defects and punch-list items
  • Coordinate HV access, isolations, permits and switching activities with authorised personnel, Site Specialists and Operations teams
  • Act as the site technical interface between designers, consultants, contractors, vendors, network service providers and AirTrunk stakeholders
  • Support testing, energisation and commissioning activities, including witnessing tests, reviewing results and confirming that systems are ready for safe operation
  • Prepare and review methods of procedure, switching plans and other site execution documents in conjunction with the Site Specialist and commissioning teams
  • Resolve site queries, constructability issues, clashes and design discrepancies through timely technical clarification and controlled change processes
  • Support the investigation and resolution of HV incidents, standing issues and emerging technical risks that fall outside local Operations capability
  • Identify opportunities to improve safety, programme, cost, quality and system performance, and share lessons learned across projects
  • Ensure complete project handover, including as-built drawings, test records, operation and maintenance manuals, asset information, training and outstanding-action close-out

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum five years of experience in HV construction, site engineering or project delivery, preferably within data centres, critical infrastructure, utilities or large-scale industrial projects.
  • Strong practical knowledge of HV equipment and installations, including switchgear, transformers, protection systems, SCADA, earthing, cabling and auxiliary DC systems.
  • Working knowledge of applicable Australian electrical standards, network service provider requirements, workplace health and safety obligations and HV safe systems of work.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret single-line diagrams, schematics, layouts, specifications and issued-for-construction documentation.
  • Experience reviewing method statements, safe work method statements, inspection and test plans, test documentation and contractor quality records.
  • Sound understanding of HV installation, testing, protection, energisation, commissioning and operational handover requirements.
  • Experience supervising contractors and coordinating multiple work fronts within a live construction environment.
  • Strong commitment to electrical safety, permit-to-work controls, risk management and high-quality site execution.
  • Ability to identify and resolve technical, constructability and interface issues while maintaining programme and operational priorities.
  • Experience managing RFIs, non-conformances, defects, punch lists, red-line mark-ups and as-built documentation.
  • Competency with common engineering and document-control tools; familiarity with AutoCAD, PowerFactory, ETAP or similar applications is advantageous.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to coordinate contractors, consultants, authorities and multidisciplinary internal teams.
  • Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.

job.title: Senior Commercial Manager - Construction & MEP - Mumbai, India
job.description:
Job Summary

This position reports directly to the Director, Commercial Management, India, within the Global Design & Construction organization. The primary responsibility of this role is to provide commercial management oversight across Equinix's portfolio of major expansion and construction projects throughout India. The incumbent will work closely with cross-functional internal project teams and stakeholders at various levels of seniority to support successful project delivery.

The role is expected to provide strategic and day-to-day leadership specifically focused to drive down construction costs, provide assurance against internal financial controls, reporting processes and help manage all major contract risks.

Responsibilities

Pre-Contract

  • Procurement of third-party consultants including Design, Commercial and Pre-Construction Services
  • Development of detailed Request for Proposals (RFP) and service deliverables for the commercial management services
  • Day to day management of third-party commercial consultants to ensure deliverables are met in a timely manner and to a high standard
  • Development of General Contractor and supplier procurement strategies in conjunction with the Construction Management (CM) team
  • Working with Legal and Procurement Centre of Excellence (COE) to prepare General Contractor Contracts including negotiation of Contract terms
  • Collation and presentation of market insights for the construction industry in the relevant country including market activity, comparative builds, construction cost indices, key suppliers and benchmarking information
  • Preparation of budgets for all design stages including feasibility estimation, detailed cost modelling, benchmarking analysis and presentation of this to senior management throughout funding approval stages
  • Advice on the most economical design and construction delivery strategy including budget comparisons
  • Identification of market and region-specific commercial risks and development of practical mitigation strategies
  • Ensuring that all cost data is prepared and presented in the Equinix WBS throughout the Project lifecycle
  • Input and action of Value Engineering (VE) exercises at all stages of design. The output must include clear cost evaluation to support decision making
  • Prepare annual and quarterly cashflow forecasts for active and pipeline projects
  • Prepare and oversee monthly reports for budget, cashflow, risk and change management

Post Contract

  • Day to day management of third-party commercial consultants to ensure deliverables are met in a timely manner and to a high standard
  • Monitor adherence against budget throughout the project lifespan including cost checks and reviews, value engineering and cost saving initiatives and evaluation of alternates
  • Oversee and provide guidance on commercial change management and change evaluation efforts on all projects
  • Monitor and report monthly and quarterly on project portfolio cash flow for the region
  • Provide Construction in Place (CIP) data to Finance
  • Pro-actively lead all commercial risk management efforts including commercial audits, contingency analysis and management
  • Prepare and oversee monthly cost reports for budget, cashflow, risk and change management
  • Monitor the financial close-out on all projects including settlement of all vendors
  • Prepare lessons learned cost analysis and detailed Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) analysis of outturn costs

Qualifications

Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in quantity surveying, construction, business, financial, Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 12 Years of experience in Commercial Management
  • Proven Data Center and strong MEP experience
  • Preferably RICS accreditation
  • Must be detail orientated, with accurate input and proof-reading skills
  • Must be able to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Must have strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Must have strong sense of accountability, ownership and urgency
  • Must have strong computer skills, particularly with Excel, Power BI, Cost Management Tools

job.title: Data Center Concierge III - Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
job.description:
Job Summary

The position will suit someone who is a strong communicator, experienced and organised in completing routing and ad-hoc tasks, admin focused and with the ability to deliver outstanding customer service at all times. Applicants may come from multifaceted industries including but not limited to hospitality, reception, administration or other customer centric roles and will be working Monday-Friday in a permanent position.

This is a customer facing role, so applicants should enjoy client interaction and have the confidence to identify customer trends, issues or concerns, taking appropriate actions where possible and call out accordingly when needed.

Key responsibilities

Our Concierge will provide support to datacenter facilities and administrative duties following standard procedures:

  • Supports customers by coordinating visits and schedules in the data center; assists on semi-routine inquiries and issues
  • Directly coordinates activities with the Equinix Response Center (ERC), as needed
  • Keeps records of activities within the data center including circuit inventories, installed power inventories and labor hours expended
  • May generate purchase requisitions and coordinate with vendors for delivery and invoicing
  • Generating Siebel Reports for customer SH requests
  • Assist security with supervising the security office, signing in visitors, validation and assignment of access via the Siebel and EACS
  • Work closely with site security and report security related incidents to the Security Operations Control Centre
  • Perform ad hoc support tasks for IBX Operations teams, including but not limited to parking administration, CCTV and access control data retrieval and analysis, event coordination, and maintenance management system administration.
  • Take an active role in emergency response preparedness, including participating in evacuation drills and incidents by coordinating and managing designated muster areas, accounting for personnel, and supporting site emergency procedures.

Customer Support and onsite Customer Liaison

  • Supports the coordination of tasks to the appropriate cross-functional teams
  • Maintains positive business relationships with local vendors in support of customer's administrative needs; provides information about local vendors to customers upon request
  • Maintains customer care areas/conference rooms for cleanliness and fully stocking amenities as the need arises; may provide backup coverage to cross functional teams to support inventory ordering
  • Communicates semi-routine operating datacenter procedures to customers on-site, while building and developing positive customer relationships
  • Coordinates customer work visits with security and escorts customers and/or vendors, within a reasonable vicinity, as required
  • Assists with tracking, following-up, and reporting on routine or new customer inquiries and issues while customers are on-site
  • Provides general induction learning tours to new customers to orient them to the site and escorting customers to their spaces within the data center and unlocking racks where required
  • Resolving issues related to lower customer satisfaction score by coordinating with cross functional team

Benefits of Equinix and the role:

job.title: Construction Safety Manager ( Data Centre)
job.description:
Overview

Lead regional Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) governance for data centre construction projects, ensuring compliance with company standards, local regulations and industry best practices. The role provides independent oversight of project safety performance, contractor compliance, incident management and continuous improvement across the project lifecycle.

**

Make an Impact by

EHS Governance & Compliance

  • Develop and maintain regional construction EHS standards, procedures and governance requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with project HSE plans, environmental requirements, Permit-to-Work systems, Design for Safety principles and local regulations.
  • Review key contractor safety documents such as risk assessments, method statements, lifting plans and emergency response plans.
  • Conduct compliance reviews and audits and track corrective actions to closure.
  • Review and evaluate contractor EHS capability for regional tender including tender evaluation assessment.

Site Safety & Contractor Oversight

  • Conduct regular site inspections and governance reviews across regional projects.
  • Monitor high-risk activities including excavation, lifting, working at height, electrical works, hot work, confined space, MEP works, testing and commissioning.
  • Assess and monitor contractor EHS capability and performance, escalating significant concerns where required.
  • Drive safety improvement initiatives with project and contractor teams.

Risk & Incident Management

  • Oversee project risk assessments and verify appropriate controls are in place before work starts.
  • Ensure Design for Safety principles are integrated into design and construction activities.
  • Review incident investigations and root cause analyses, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
  • Analyse incident trends and share lessons learned across the region.

EHS Performance & Reporting

  • Participate in project and regional EHS governance monthly and quarterly meetings.
  • Prepare EHS dashboards and reports covering incidents, audits, training compliance, safety observations and key performance indicators.
  • Conduct regular EHS performance reviews with project leaders and senior management.

##

Environmental & Commissioning Safety

  • Monitor compliance with environmental requirements, including noise, dust, waste, chemical storage, water discharge and spill prevention.
  • Provide safety oversight for mission-critical works, including HV/LV electrical installation, energisation, testing and commissioning.
  • Review isolation procedures and risk controls before energisation and commissioning activities.

##

Authority

  • Request the Project Lead to stop or suspend unsafe work where there is imminent danger or serious non-compliance.
  • Require corrective actions before work resumes and escalate repeated or severe violations to senior management.
  • Recommend contractor suspension for serious or repeated safety breaches.

##

Skills for Success:

  • Degree or Diploma in Occupational Safety & Health, Engineering, Construction Management, Environmental Management or a related discipline.
  • Preferred certifications include WSH Officer/Manager, NEBOSH, IOSH, ISO 45001/14001 Lead Auditor, CSP, OSHA or equivalent.
  • Minimum 10 years of construction safety experience, including at least 5 years in data centre or mission-critical infrastructure projects.
  • Experience managing EPC/general contractors, safety consultants and multi-country projects within APAC.
  • Proven experience in incident investigation, root cause analysis and contractor performance management.
  • Strong knowledge of construction safety, risk management, environmental compliance and Design for Safety.
  • Strong leadership, communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills with sound, independent judgement.
  • Proactive and collaborative working style, with willingness to travel across the region

##

job.title: Hardship Controls and QA Manager
job.description:
Melbourne, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband, and digital solutions.

The Hardship Controls & Quality Assurance Manager is a senior leadership role responsible for safeguarding the integrity of Hardship operations through effective controls, quality assurance, and compliance oversight. Acting as a key guardian of customer outcomes and regulatory compliance, the role ensures processes and customer interactions meet the highest standards of quality, fairness, and risk management. The position also leads offshore QA teams across Melbourne and Manila, driving performance, consistency, and continuous improvement.

**

What You’ll Do | Your day to day will consist of

  • Ensure complete adherence to ACCC, ACMA, Hardship frameworks, Vulnerable Customer obligations, Privacy Act, Telecommunications Consumer Protections (TCP) Code, ASIC Debt Collection Guidelines, and all applicable state and federal regulations.
  • Complete and maintain Hardship controls, ensuring full compliance with regulatory obligations including the ACCC, ACMA, TCP Code, and relevant industry guidelines.
  • Document, build, and implement internal controls to mitigate operational risks and ensure adherence to Hardship policy and standards.
  • Manage and lead the quality assurance groups operating within the offshore contact centres in Melbourne and Manila, providing everyday leadership, performance monitoring, and professional development.

**

What You Bring | What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Demonstrated experience in control building, documentation and testing, quality assurance, or internal audit, ideally within telecommunications, financial services or a regulated industry.
  • Strong understanding of risk and compliance frameworks, regulatory environments, and governance practices, with proven ability to apply these in a fast-paced operational setting.
  • Experience leading or coordinating quality assurance programs, including the management of offshore or outsourced service delivery.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data and insights into clear, actionable recommendations.

**

The good stuff…. | What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration, plus $80 monthly credit, 25% off Optus products and exclusive shopping discounts with our retail partners — making everyday life a little more affordable. Genuine Flexibility - work three days in the office, two days from wherever works best for you.
  • Great leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever matters most to you.
  • Inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks, because family comes first.
  • Build meaningful connections through colleague-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Your wellbeing matters, so we offer with free counselling and support services, available 24/7 in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other.

What you’ll do:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Explore our range of tech products and services, and share your knowledge in a way that’s simple, helpful and accessible.
  • Bring your personality and charm to uncover customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Work as one team, crafting a warm, welcoming environment where customers feel supported and memorable moments happen.

What you bring:

  • Service Superpower: You know how to understand customer needs, deliver genuine support, and let phenomenal service drive fantastic outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers make sense of tech by breaking things down simply and guiding them to the right solutions.
  • Problem Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You’re confident in navigating difficult enquiries, ease tricky situations with empathy and respect, and work toward the best solution for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support one another, stay accountable, and create a customer‑first environment where everyone succeeds.

What’s in it for you?

  • $36 p/h + super + applicable loadings.
  • Phenomenal perks, including 25% off Optus products and exclusive access to unique discounts with our retail partners.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, available 24/7 across multiple channels.
  • Flexible rosters that work around the life you live outside of work.

Intrigued, but not sure you tick every box? That’s completely okay! We still encourage you to apply. We all grow, learn and develop together, and this role might be the perfect next step in your career journey.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. job.title: Director, Group Network Cyber Security
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

This is a technical leadership role within Group Strategy, Engineering and Innovation (GSEI) in Group Technology Network, responsible for providing strategic direction and deep expertise in telecommunications network cybersecurity across the Singtel Group, including its regional associates.

The role will lead and collaborate with network and cybersecurity subject matter experts across Singtel Operating Companies (OpCos) and regional associates to ensure alignment with Singtel Group’s broader strategic objectives.

The person will define, develop, and institutionalise network cybersecurity design principles, frameworks, and guidelines across multiple network domains, drawing from industry standards, best practices, and lessons learned from past incidents and operational experience.

Make an Impact by

**

a. Strategy Development

  • Partner closely with Group Cybersecurity to define and evolve the network security strategy and framework in alignment with Singtel Group’s business objectives, risk appetite, and industry trends.
  • Provide thought leadership on network cybersecurity, ensuring long-term resilience, scalability, and regulatory readiness across the Group.

b. Network Architecture & Design Governance

  • Establish and maintain a group-wide network security architecture framework, incorporating industry-recognised standards, specifications, and best-practice design principles.
  • Drive consistent adoption of network security guidelines across multiple network domains (e.g. core, access, transport, cloud, edge) to strengthen the Group’s overall security posture and operational resilience.

c. Technology Evaluation & Future Readiness

  • Identify, assess, and provide strategic guidance on emerging technologies and trends such as 6G, AI for Networks, and Networks for AI.
  • Articulate how evolving network security requirements and capabilities will both influence and be influenced by—the design, deployment, and operation of these technologies.
  • Translate complex technical implications into clear recommendations for leadership and stakeholders.

d. Group Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Foster strong collaboration and knowledge sharing across Singtel Group and regional associates within the network security domain.
  • Create and sustain platforms, forums, and communities of practice to share experiences, expertise, lessons learned, and incident insights.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, collective ownership, and proactive risk and incident management across the Group.

**

Skills for Success

**

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in telecommunications networks, with significant depth in network cybersecurity across large-scale, carrier-grade environments.
  • Proven experience in a technical leadership, architecture, or strategy role, within a telco network environment.
  • Strong track record of defining and implementing network security frameworks, architectures, and design principles across multiple network domains.
  • Hands on experience translating industry standards and best practices (e.g. 3GPP, ETSI, NIST, ISO/IEC, Zero Trust, Security by design) into practical, deployable network security controls.
  • Experience working with or influencing regional operating companies or affiliates, balancing group governance with local regulatory and operational requirements.
  • Experience evaluating and shaping security requirements for emerging technologies such as Quantum safe, 5G/6G, network virtualisation, cloud-native networks, AI-enabled networks, and automation.

**

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Deep understanding of telecommunications network architectures and protocols, including fixed, mobile, IP, transport, and cloud-native network environments.
  • Strong expertise in network security domains, including network segmentation, identity and access management, encryption, key management, signalling security, API security, and monitoring/detection.
  • Knowledge of secure network design and security tools, resilience engineering, redundancy, and high-availability principles in carrier-grade environments.
  • Familiarity with regulatory, compliance, and assurance requirements relevant to telecommunications and critical infrastructure security.

**

Leadership & Collaboration Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organisation, working across multiple OpCos, functions, and geographies without direct authority.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with various layer of stakeholders in various domain as such cybersecurity, network engineering, operations and risk/
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven capability to build communities of practice, encourage knowledge sharing, and foster a culture of security-by-design across the Group.

**

Professional Attributes

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to balance security, business objectives, cost, and operational practicality.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and forward-looking approach to risk management.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
  • Relevant professional certifications and knowledge (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CIS controls, GSMA security guidelines and control, cloud security controls) are advantageous.

**

**

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

**

**

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

**

**

job.title: Manager, Hardware Marketing
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll shape the devices and propositions that millions of customers use every day, partnering with leading global handset brands to deliver innovative products and compelling customer experiences.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As the Manager, Hardware Marketing, you will own the commercial success of assigned handset brands by driving product strategy, pricing, vendor partnerships and go-to-market execution.

Working closely with global device manufacturers and cross-functional teams, you will develop compelling product propositions, lead integrated marketing campaigns and optimise portfolio performance to drive hardware revenue, customer acquisition and market competitiveness.

##

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Own the end-to-end commercial performance of assigned handset brands, including revenue, profitability and product lifecycle management.
  • Develop pricing strategies, promotional offers and value propositions that maximise commercial performance and strengthen market competitiveness.
  • Build strong partnerships with handset vendors, leading commercial negotiations, joint business planning and marketing investments.
  • Lead go-to-market planning and execution for new handset launches, seasonal campaigns and portfolio refreshes across all customer channels.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Digital, Retail and Consumer Operations teams to deliver integrated marketing campaigns and exceptional customer experiences.
  • Drive in-base upsell, cross-sell and customer acquisition initiatives to increase hardware sales, attachment rates and overall revenue.
  • Monitor portfolio performance through financial reporting, sales analysis and commercial insights, recommending actions to optimise results.
  • Conduct competitive analysis on pricing, products, promotions and market trends to identify opportunities and maintain market leadership.
  • Manage marketing operations, including pre-sales readiness, post-sales processes, rebate claims and operational governance.
  • Handle customer escalations relating to handset products, promotions and commercial policies, working closely with internal stakeholders to deliver timely resolutions.
  • Develop business cases for new initiatives and evaluate commercial opportunities, investment returns and business impact.
  • Continuously improve business processes and reporting to enhance operational efficiency and commercial execution.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing or a related discipline.
  • At least 5–7 years of experience in Product Marketing, Category Management or Commercial Marketing, preferably within the telecommunications, mobile device, consumer electronics or hardware industry.
  • Strong experience managing product portfolios, pricing strategies and commercial performance.
  • Proven experience leading go-to-market planning and integrated marketing campaigns.
  • Strong vendor management and commercial negotiation skills.
  • Experience managing P&L, revenue performance and financial analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to drive commercial decisions.
  • Experience conducting market research, competitive analysis and product positioning.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple business functions.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with experience creating compelling presentations and business cases.
  • Experience with Power BI or similar business intelligence tools is an advantage.
  • Detail-oriented, commercially driven and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: Information Security Engineer
job.description:
Role Summary

The Information Security Engineer plays a key role in supporting Singtel Singapore Cyber Security ecosystem through hands-on technical execution. This role partners with business stakeholders to understand access requirements and ensure alignment with security controls.

The role involves

  • Supporting and ensuring the uptime of tools used within CISO Singtel Singapore, Cyber Security Team.
  • Collaborating with various technical teams in Singtel Singapore to ensure delivery of the outcome, on time and on budget.

Primary Responsibilities will be

  • Supporting and ensuring adequacy of Cyber Security posture for security tools managed by CISO Singtel Singapore, Cyber Security Engineering
  • Deploy new technology stack managed by the team where applicable to ensure fit for us and cost effectiveness.

**

How You will Make An Impact:

**

Engineering:

  • Expand scope of various security systems such as but not limited to EDR, DAM, SIEM, SOAR, UEBA and Privileged Access Management where required to increase visibility of the tools
  • Deliver new security tools to uplift overall security posture of Singtel Singapore
  • Ensure that SOPs are documented, performed and in compliance with relevant security policies and standards
  • Work with stakeholders in IT and Enterprise to uplift coverage for assigned technology stack(s) where applicable
  • Work with the various SMEs of the various security systems managed by Cyber Engineering or other technical SMEs to ensure delivery of outcomes including tracking of the tasks required to meet the outcome
  • Engage relevant teams and/or vendors to diagnose and rectify technical problems where necessary
  • Ensure documents or processes required as part of project delivery methodology is adhered to

**

Customer Experience and Teamwork:

  • Demonstrate professional, pro-active qualities in dealing with internal clients and stakeholders.
  • Work with all stakeholders to meet operation and security requirements.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, effective communication and teamwork with peers.

**

Continuous Improvement:

  • Maintain strategic vendor partnerships, relevant education and certification.
  • Complete relevant education and training as required.
  • Keep abreast of relevant technology and cyber threat landscape.

**

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cyber Security, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline
  • A minimum of 1 to 3 years of relevant experience, with at least 1 years focused on cybersecurity in telco operations, network environments, or enterprise IT within the telecommunications domain including minimally 1 years hands-on experience in designing, administration or deployment of IT infrastructure components including implementing best practices like security hardening
  • Knowledge in common OSes used on-premises systems like Windows and Linux, and cloud service providers including AWS and Azure
  • Good analytical and communication skills
  • Possess initiative with positive working attitudes and customer services oriented
  • Strong teamwork, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Independent and goal-oriented

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.
