  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively as a team player, building strong relationships at all organizational levels.
  • Strong capability to work both independently and as part of a team, with a service-oriented mindset.
  • Proficiency in English (written and verbal communication).

Benefits

  • Competitive salary package + Full time opportunity
  • Excellent job stability + Ongoing training and development opportunities
  • Inclusive work environment + Supportive management team
  • Opportunity to work across diverse operations throughout Australia

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. Join us and make a difference.

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About IPSD:

Caterpillar’s Industrial Power Systems Division (IPSD) designs, tests and manufactures 0.5 to 18L engines that not only power Caterpillar machines, but also power over 5000 other applications including Marine, Petroleum, Industrial Applications, Electric Generators, and Locomotives. Caterpillar’s company strategy includes sustainability as one of four focus areas and IPSD is engaged and actively preparing green energy solutions for the future.

Job Summary

Caterpillar’s 11-18L Engine Platform Team, within IPSD-L, is focused on delivery industry leading engine systems for Caterpillar and Third-Party customers through the Cat and Perkins Brands. We enable customer success by delivering products that meet or exceed expectations for performance, value, and durability within our portfolio of engines.

Role Definition Designs, develops, builds, and implements new components, products, technologies or services from concepts to production

Responsibilities

  • Develop and document functional requirements and convert them into detailed design specifications. Participate in buy-versus-build evaluations for product components.
  • Support product design and development activities, including prototype builds, testing, design validation, manufacturability reviews, and launch readiness.
  • Analyze production, engineering, and quality data to identify root causes, risks, constraints, and improvement opportunities.
  • Coordinate engineering changes, product transitions, and new product introductions while minimizing manufacturing disruption.

  • Foster collaboration within the team and with global partners and communicate results effectively across stakeholders like global customers, process partners, and other business units.

Knowledge of self-management practices, including managing multiple priorities, projects, and activities effectively.

Knowledge of specialized design and graphics tools to create, analyse, simulate, and test product designs.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviours.

job.title: Lead, Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

Establish reliable and scalable quality engineering practices for StarHub’s digital platforms across mobile, web, backend and cloud-native systems. The Senior SDET will partner with engineering, product, architecture, DevOps/SRE, security and delivery teams to shift quality left, build meaningful automated quality gates, transition vendor-owned automation into sustainable in-house ownership, and provide fast, risk-based release confidence during migration, refactoring and platform modernisation initiatives.

Accountabilities

  • Take ownership of the existing test automation from vendors and establish clear quality and governance standards, documentation, CI integration, reliability and maintainability expectations so automation becomes an integral part of product engineering.
  • Improve coverage, reliability and efficiency of automated tests across different platforms like web, mobile and backend
  • Improve quality of releases in terms of user experience and satisfaction by ensuring testability and automated tests are treated as first class citizens in the SDLC

Responsibilities

  • Partner with developers to design and implement tests at the right layer of the test pyramid or testing trophy, including unit, component, contract, API, integration, e2e, visual, accessibility
  • Setup automated quality gates across the SDLC to ensure issues are found as early as possible
  • Establish and track metrics for test automation to drive improvement and accountability
  • Improve test automation coverage, reliability and efficiency.
  • Use AI agents and coding assistants responsibly to assist with test planning, requirements analysis, risk discovery, test design, automation development, test data generation, failure triage, coverage gap analysis, documentation and refactoring.
  • Build internal tools, libraries, and platforms that make quality practices easier for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, data setup, environment reliability and release confidence.
  • Work with stakeholders across engineering and QE to ensure alignment on automation approaches and goals.
  • Work with vendors to deliver automation solutions to the standards defined.
  • Write clear technical documentation, RFCs, test plans, READMEs, onboarding guides and quality playbooks.

Areas of Impact:

  • Stakeholders: QA, Engineering, Program/Delivery Management, Product
  • Decision Rights: Strongly advise QA/Automation tools and license purchase, strongly advise KPIs for the test automation team
  • Resources: ~10 automation resources from vendors as peers, some existing licenses for UiPath, BrowserStack

Ideal Track Record:

  • Delivered automated tests (unit, integration, e2e) covering significant critical user journeys and behaviours, measurable regression improvement times in hours if not in days
  • Designed, or at least significantly contributed to, and implemented automated test frameworks from scratch that have measurably improved test efficiency.
  • Designed dashboards for reporting on test automation stats to stakeholders
  • Integrated tests with CI/CD pipelines
  • Used AI coding assistants or agents such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent for testing, automation, documentation, triage or quality analysis.
  • Managed test environments and test automation infrastructure on cloud services like AWS, GCP, Browserstack, LambdaTest.
  • Built internal tools and utilities to make testing and QE easily accessible for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders improving productivity.

job.title: Director, Enterprise Client Solutions

Job Description

The Director of Enterprise Client Solutions acts as the primary deal architect, story orchestrator, and strategic execution lead for the Chief of Enterprise. He / she leads a team of client-facing orchestrators to align multidisciplinary teams to pitch and convert large complex enterprise opportunities into technically feasible, commercially sound, multi-year deals. This role requires a highly effective communicator who can engage and influence C-suite, procurement, and Board-level stakeholders through clear, compelling executive narratives that articulate EBG’s distinctive value proposition.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Technology Advisor

  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, including business, technology, procurement, and operational leaders.
  • Works closely with Strategic Account GMs to drive strategic account plans, including client priorities, whitespace opportunities, stakeholder maps, competitive position, and growth actions.
  • Lead executive client engagements, value-discovery workshops, solution briefings, and business reviews.
  • Act as the single orchestration point for strategic clients, ensuring coordinated engagement across internal teams.

Solution and Pursuit Leadership

job.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI, App and EcoSystem Safety
job.description:
About the job

As the Principal Engineer for the Singapore AI Center of Excellence, you will serve as the senior-most on-site technical leader and Individual Contributor (IC) guiding technical efforts across Singapore and the broader Asia-Pacific (APAC) region. In this high-impact, strategic role, you will define and execute the technical vision and roadmap for production-ready AI applications, focusing on applying deep AI and agentic capabilities to real-world product safety and security challenges rather than strictly research-oriented work.

This role requires a rare full-stack ability to operate as both a high-level strategic architect and a deep technical expert. You will lead the transition to Autonomous Defense, securing the Android ecosystem and Play Store by innovating on safety defenses for malware and content abuse to establish trust for our users and developers. Additionally, as the world moves toward an increasingly agentic environment, you will define what "agentic safety" means at Google, architecting frameworks to secure AI agents as they interact with connected apps and servers.

You will provide technical direction, oversight, and guidance to engineering staff. Regionally, you will serve as the technical lead for the APAC region, providing technical oversight and guidance to teams in India and collaborating closely with engineering and product leadership with other teams across the US and UK.

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices & Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices & Services team is making people's lives better through technology.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the technical vision, multi-year roadmap, and execution strategy for Google’s transition to autonomous defense, ensuring we can scale our defenses ahead of emerging AI-driven threats.
  • Define what "agentic safety" means at Google, creating safety guardrails, policy engines, and architectures to secure environments where AI agents interact with each other and connect to MCP servers and various applications.
  • Apply deep AI and machine learning skills to build production-ready, real-world security applications to automate malware detection and content abuse identification across the Google Play Store and Android ecosystem.

job.title: Technical Program Manager, Digital Solutions
job.description:
About the job

Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.

Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs.

As a Technical Program Manager, Data Center Digital Delivery, you have experience in the area of complex, multi-disciplinary, and geographically dispersed data center design, development, construction and commissioning projects. You will bridge the gap between design and construction operations and emerging automation technologies, translating complex design and construction workflows into scalable agentic digital solutions that drive significant efficiency gains. You are a business transformation leader who can tolerate ambiguity and demonstrate problem-solving leadership to fundamentally transform how data center projects are delivered.

**

Responsibilities

  • Lead regional Building Information Modeling (BIM), digital delivery, and information management strategy. Standardize virtual design and construction processes to drive model reuse across data center projects, enforcing global asset tagging, spatial rules, and generative design data standards.
  • Define regional digital controls from design to closeout, including software interfaces and modeling rulesets. Manage operational vendor scopes while integrating AI-driven metrics to track time and cost performance.
  • Advise leadership on BIM software integration (e.g., Revit, Forma, MCAD) and AI/Large Language Model (LLM) data use. Architect automated agentic workflows for compliance and deploy machine learning models to extract operational insights from project records.
  • Modernize project controls through proactive, data-driven change management. Deliver AI and digital engineering onboarding programs while embedding Agile/Scrum methodologies to streamline deployment cycles.

job.title: Data Center Operations Facilities Manager
job.description:
About the job

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facility Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You'll provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

You will develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

The Google Australia Sovereign Cloud team builds, delivers, and operates secure private cloud services. We provide a flexible, reliable, and scalable end-to-end capability—from the cloud to the edge—to enable operation in complex environments. We deliver and operate these private cloud deployments for the most critical Australian Federal Government customers, helping scale, secure, and maintain the deployment while working closely with Google product teams to continually improve our technology.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Responsibilities

  • Own efforts to perform compliance activities for a data center and analyze compliance results for data centers globally. Ensure regional and global teams are complying with project/schedule guidelines and Google design standards.
  • Lead efforts to monitor data center systems operations, control site activities to minimize risk, and to ensure effective response to any excursions.
  • Lead efforts to ensure all sites are following facility, maintenance, and standard programs globally while exhibiting strength in improvement to said policies and programs.
  • Own the development of strategies to keep operational costs to a minimum, improve efficiency, and reduce environmental impact at a site, along with driving site-level development of programs and initiatives.
  • Incorporate subdomain expertise and experience to enhance data center design to optimize equipment and operations for next generation data centers.

job.title: Digital Designer
job.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Digital Designer sits at the front end of scale, shaping the creative assets that fuel our performance marketing and automated ad workflows. The role brings strong design judgement to layout, visual hierarchy, typography, and composition, while taking a results-driven, test-and-learn approach to creative development. Working within structured design systems, the ideal candidate creates brand-consistent assets that can scale across formats and campaign variants, responds to platform performance, and iterates creative work to drive stronger marketing outcomes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Interpret campaign production briefs and execute digital creatives across approved template systems and format families
  • Populate dynamic creative templates with campaign content including copy, pricing, product imagery, and CTA elements
  • Generate digital ad variants across all required placements using the ad automation platform, understanding template logic and catching layout anomalies proactively
  • Adapt and optimise assets for platform-specific specifications using Adobe Creative Suite
  • Ensure layout accuracy, brand consistency, copy integrity, and technical compliance across all outputs
  • Export and package final deliverables across required formats including static and animated assets
  • Maintain organised asset management, naming conventions, version control, and production file structures
  • Identify layout inconsistencies, formatting issues, or outputs outside approved templates and escalate when necessary
  • Support scalable production workflows and contribute to operational efficiency improvements
  • Undertake other duties, responsibilities, and projects as assigned by the supervisor or management, in line with evolving business and operational needs

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in digital production, graphic design, advertising production, or performance marketing creative environments
  • Portfolio demonstrating strong digital campaign execution and high-volume production capability
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency, in-house, or commercially driven production environments
  • Experience producing creatives for sales campaigns, festive campaigns, product launches, and promotional events
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, composition, and visual hierarchy
  • Experience adapting digital creatives across multiple placements and format requirements
  • Able to work accurately within established template systems and brand guidelines
  • Strong attention to detail and self-review discipline before final submission
  • Experience handling multiple deliverables and timelines within fast-moving production environments
  • Able to work independently while maintaining consistency and production accuracy

REQUIREMENTS

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Familiarity with ad automation and dynamic creative workflows is advantageous
  • Basic motion or After Effects skills is advantageous
  • Basic proficiency in AI-assisted creative tools is advantageous
  • Solid understanding of digital ad specifications across social and display platforms
  • Strong file management and version control discipline

job.title: Senior Copywriter
job.description:
Employment Type

Fixed Term (Fixed Term)

Closing Date

28 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Senior Copywriter

Job Summary

Job Description

Senior Copywriter – Roam (Telstra’s In-House Creative Agency)

Location: Sydney, NSW Reports to: Creative Lead (Copy) Type: 6-month contract

About Roam

Roam is Telstra’s in-house creative team. We’re a collective of hybrid makers and storytellers from all corners of the industry. We partner closely with Telstra’s marketing team and agency partners to push craft and creativity in everything we do. We move fast, think sharp, and make it memorable. We’re here to raise the bar, create meaningful customer experiences, and make every interaction count.

##

The Role

We’re looking for a copywriter who thrives in the world of 1:1 communications and service messaging. From emergency comms to basic customer service updates, you’ll have a keen eye for detail, and the ability to create clear, compelling, and customer-focused copy that strengthens relationships and drives action across a range of 1:1 channels.

This is a hygiene job for a large communications platform. The right candidate won’t mind rolling up their sleeves and deep diving into a range of different copy templates to weed out repetition and delete unnecessary comms.

With that in mind, you’ll get to shape communications that feel relevant, useful, and distinctly human. Working closely with our strategists, producers, marketers, and channel specialists, you’ll also be required to deliver consistent customer communications that adhere to Telstra’s brand and tone of voice.

A strong understanding of customer behaviour, personalisation, accessibility, and compliance is essential. You’ll know how to turn complex messages into simple, engaging communications that connect with our customers and drive action.

What you’ll do

  • Write engaging, customer-centric service messaging across a range of channels, including email, SMS, push notifications, in-app messaging, and other 1:1 communications.
  • Occasionally develop messaging across the customer lifecycle, including acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and loyalty initiatives.
  • Collaborate with designers, strategists, producers, and marketing teams to create effective customer experiences.
  • Translate customer insights and business objectives into relevant, actionable communications.
  • Apply personalisation principles to create messages that feel timely, useful, and tailored.
  • Ensure all copy meets accessibility, legal, and compliance requirements, while maintaining a strong brand voice.
  • Use testing, performance insights, and customer feedback to continually improve communications.
  • Work fast without sacrificing craft, clarity, or attention to detail.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven experience as a copywriter within service messaging, CRM, direct marketing, customer communications, or a creative agency environment.
  • Exceptional writing skills across short-form and long-form communications, with a sharp eye for detail.
  • Experience writing for email, SMS, push notifications, and customer journey communications.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, personalisation, and behavioural messaging.
  • Ability to balance creativity with performance objectives, compliance requirements, and accessibility standards.
  • Strong collaboration skills and a passion for customer-centred thinking.
  • A curiosity for optimisation, testing, and continuously improving customer experiences.

job.title: Treasury Manager - Reporting & Operations
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As a Treasury Manager (based in Sydney, Australia) for an initial 6 month fixed term contract, you will work closely with our global and local Treasury, Finance and Corporate Development teams, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Functional responsibility for treasury reporting to internal and external stakeholders
  • Contribute to development and refinement of best in class treasury framework, policies and other financial governance.
  • Lead and/or contribute to group treasury initiatives such as process improvements, system implementations and upgrades etc...
  • Collaborating with local and offshore stakeholders, maintaining and strengthening these relationships and building new relationships over time.

What You'll Do

Reporting & Compliance

  • Prepare and deliver comprehensive financial reports on treasury activities for various stakeholders, including board packs, due diligence packs, and investor roadshow packs.
  • Ensure accurate accounting and reporting of all treasury instruments, including mark-to-market valuations.
  • Support internal and external audits, ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal policies as required.
  • Monitor compliance of all treasury activities with relevant policies, market best practices and debt facilities and escalate for management and execution as required.
  • Conduct regular reviews and audits to meet and exceed compliance obligations, target to build centre of excellence.
  • Modelling and analysis of cash and liquidity risks, interest rate risks and FX risks (transaction and translation)

Treasury Systems & Operations

  • Help implement and promote best practices in treasury management, operational processes, and reporting.
  • Contribute to the definition and delivery of business requirements for interfaces between the Treasury Management System (TMS) and other internal and external systems (e.g. ERP, banking platforms).
  • Manage TMS notional accounts and reconciliations, establish Middle Office (MO) controls to ensure alignment between physical bank accounts in TMS, ERP, and bank platforms for reporting obligations
  • Drive process improvements, automation, and system enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and control.

Treasury Data, Controls & Oversight

  • Hold functional responsibility for treasury data quality, ensuring all transactional data is complete, accurate, timely, and fit for decision‑making.
  • Own and maintain controls over data capture, validation, and reporting, providing independent oversight of Front Office execution and assurance over Back Office processing.

Leadership:

  • Lead the middle office accounting and reporting function maintaining the collaborative and high-performance culture in place today.
  • Balance project management responsibilities with day-to-day operations

What You'll Bring

  • A Bachelor's degree (or above) in business, commerce, economics, finance or similar field
  • 10+ years previous corporate treasury experience ideally in a business with an international footprint
  • Group Treasury roles within multicurrency, multi-jurisdictional organizations ideally in Data Center/Technology and/or Commercial real estate/REIT and/or project finance
  • Curiosity about Sustainability/ESG (some knowledge of ESG financing desirable)
  • A fast learner who thrives working in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail, integrity and ambition

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Senior Accountant, Statutory Reporting - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India - Manila, National Capital Region (Manila), Philippines
job.description:
Job Summary

Join our Equinix Corporate Controlling team and step into a dynamic role as a Senior Accountant (Statutory Reporting). The Statutory Reporting team plays a vital role in overseeing statutory reporting, external audit management, and financial control activities related to tax, treasury, and legal transactions.

As a Senior Accountant on this team, you will be at the forefront of managing statutory accounting and reporting for our legal entities across APAC. Your responsibilities will include coordinating the statutory accounts preparation process, overseeing local statutory audits for a portfolio of Equinix APAC legal entities, and ensuring rigorous adherence to control fundamentals that safeguard our organization's financial posture.

Responsibilities

  • Craft Precision: Prepare meticulous financial statements, complete with comprehensive notes, designed to meet statutory filing requirements in compliance with various GAAP regulations
  • Navigate Complexity: Manage reorganization, M&A, and Legal Entity formation transactions in accordance with local GAAP requirements, ensuring accuracy and consistency with local procedures
  • Bridging Expertise: Review the US GAAP to Local GAAP bridges provided by GL, Revenue, Leasing, and FA teams, offering valuable insights and guidance in line with local GAAP procedures
  • Precision Champion: Provide insightful review comments to Accountants, following up to ensure timely corrections and maintain local GAAP accuracy
  • Compare & Analyze: Prepare year-over-year analysis for local GAAP statements, offering clear explanations for major differences to support decision-making
  • Audit Oversight: Review annual local GAAP trial balances prior to submission to third-party financial statement preparers, managing collection of essential reports and supporting documentation for auditors
  • Disclosure Specialist: Assist in preparing specific disclosure schedules to support local GAAP financials, serving as a liaison between accounting teams and auditors
  • Audit Project Management: Support local GAAP and Tax audits, managing the timing and execution of local GAAP adjustments and audits
  • Efficiency Driver: Ensure the timely submission of local GAAP requests, updating and maintaining local GAAP procedures for optimal performance
  • KPI Management: Track and report on late submissions and other key performance indicators (KPIs), enhancing accountability and efficiency
  • Flexibility and Initiative: Embrace ad hoc analysis as need ed, showcasing your adaptability and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

Qualifications

We're seeking a dedicated individual with:

  • 6+ years expereince in audit and accouting preferred
  • Well-Rounded Expertise: Ideally, you bring a background either in combined US GAAP/Local statutory audits or in the preparation of multi-country statutory reporting for a US-listed corporation

job.title: Manager, Interconnect & Fixed Voice Operations
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

Singtel Networks, the most established telecommunications infrastructure provider in Singapore is transforming to enable the digital generation of tomorrow. We are introducing new capabilities in 5G, Cloud, Analytics, Digital Commerce, Software Engineering, Cyber Security to enhance our core competencies and deliver innovative and differentiated Mobile and Fixed services (Broadband, TV and Telephony) for our customers. We are committed to celebrating inclusion and diversity and is a strong believer to upskill and nurture all individuals. Come join us today as we build Singtel’s Networks of tomorrow, and Empower Every Generation to live, work and play in new ways!

The Manager, Interconnect & Fixed Voice Operations is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and performance of Singtel’s local fixed voice interconnect systems. This role ensures seamless connectivity between Singtel and local and international operators, while maintaining high service availability, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

The incumbent will lead operational activities including system administration, fault management, service provisioning, and number portability operations. The role also drives cybersecurity compliance through system patching, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.

In addition, the role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders, external operators, and vendors to resolve service issues, implement system enhancements, and support regulatory directives such as scam call mitigation in partnership with IMDA and SPF.

Operations & Service Management

  • Oversee daily BAU operations of local fixed voice and interconnect systems to ensure high availability and performance
  • Ensure timely service provisioning, system monitoring, and execution of number migration/porting activities
  • Manage interconnect junctions and signalling links between Singtel and local/overseas operators (FBO/SBO/OLO)

Incident & Fault Management

  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of service issues, including call failures, signalling faults, and number portability issues
  • Manage and resolve escalations from TAC, INOC, ISMC, 1608, and external partners
  • Ensure timely handling of critical and urgent incidents, including after-office-hours escalations (e.g. VIP/VVIP cases)

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Act as the key point of contact for interconnect-related matters with external operators and partners
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders (Work Order, Product, Account teams) to ensure accurate order capture and timely provisioning
  • Engage vendors for issue escalation, including hardware replacement, software fixes, patching, and system upgrades

System Administration & Lifecycle Management

  • Manage system configuration, software upgrades, patching, and performance optimization
  • Oversee equipment lifecycle management, including refresh planning and execution
  • Review and govern Method of Procedure (MOP) for system changes and upgrades

Security, Compliance & Audit

  • Ensure systems meet cybersecurity standards through regular patching, vulnerability scanning, and mitigation
  • Support internal and external audit exercises and ensure proper documentation and controls
  • Manage IMDA directives related to scam prevention, including testing and implementation

Regulatory & Special Operations Support

  • Work with IAR, IMDA, and SPF to support scam call blocking initiatives and regulatory requirements
  • Support special events and emergency preparedness activities (e.g. SPF contingency planning)

Resource & Capacity Management

  • Manage C4 resource planning, including onboarding of new interconnect partners and capacity expansion

Skills for success:

  • Degree in IT/Computer or equivalent work experience in telecom,networking and IT
  • Strong knowledge of telecom networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
  • Experience with legacy signaling protocols (SS7/ISDN) and SIP-based voice systems

Linux knowledge

  • Understanding of interconnect architecture, number portability, and call routing
  • Good to have CCNA , CCNP or equivalent certification

job.description:

Make an Impact by:

You will formulate strategic and operational customer lifecycle management strategies- supporting new technology penetration through scientific and data-driven marketing techniques.
  • Conceptualizing Lifecycle Marketing Strategies: Lead a team in conceptualizing customer lifecycle marketing strategies and translating them into executable plans. Your focus will be on driving retention, achieving upsell targets, and increasing service holding to achieve revenue and retention objectives. You will also drive recontracting through customer engagement and loyalty initiatives.
  • Championing AI-Enabled Marketing Transformation: Lead strategic integration of AI into Singtel’s lifecycle marketing agenda. You will oversee the implementation of hyper-personalization frameworks including content generation capabilities. Your focus will be on embedding AI-enabled segmentation, modelling, and real-time decisioning engines into lifecycle strategies.
  • Market Monitoring and Strategy: Stay abreast of market developments and monitor the competitive landscape to position the Consumer Business for new services. You will respond quickly and proactively to market intelligence and competitor feedback, steering marketing strategies to remain market relevant and customer-friendly. Customer insights will be a key focus, allowing you to tailor messaging and distribution channels accordingly.
  • Innovative Marketing Campaigns: Spearhead the execution of new approaches in marketing campaigns, such as hyper personalization, contextual targeting, improved automation, and tracking. Collaboration with marketing, sales, and data science teams will be crucial to develop and launch automated flows based on propensity models and behavioral data.
  • Customer Base Analysis and Reporting: Responsible for analyzing the customer base, owning customer information, data extraction, and regular tracking of marketing campaign effectiveness. Weekly reporting on key metrics and performance indicators will be part of your responsibilities.
  • Team Development: Develop and build a high-performance team through active resource planning, workload balancing, skill and expertise development, talent acquisition, and retention.
  • Campaign Strategy and Execution: Partner with various workstreams to manage campaign strategies and executions, including base management, calendar planning, targeting, segmentation, and reporting. You will implement processes to effectively prioritize and streamline user communications.

Skills for Success:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Accountancy, or related field. A Master of Business Administration (MBA) is desirable.
  • Relevant experience working in large corporations or MNCs. Competency and experience in customer management, churn, and lifecycle marketing.
  • Strong results orientation and stakeholder management experience.
  • Proven marketing strategy and management skills.
  • Experience in building customer journeys, including online and social media marketing, customer loyalty program management, web applications, and mobile and home business applications.
  • Experience and knowledge in devices, Telco data, customer analytics, and customer experience management (e.g., retail shops, call center, loyalty programs).
  • Possess Business acumen, presentation skills (both written and verbal), creativity, resourcefulness, analytical skills, leadership and people management capabilities, stakeholder management, solid budget management, and a challenger mindset.

job.title: Application Development & Support Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

The Data Quality Developer will play a hands-on technical role in implementing and maintaining data quality controls, monitoring frameworks, and integration solutions across our enterprise MDM ecosystem. This position requires a strong technical background combined with excellent communication skills to work effectively with business stakeholders across the globe.

Working closely with the Data Governance Council Lead, this role will be responsible for configuring data quality platforms, implementing validation rules and workflows, developing dashboards and reports, and remediating data quality incidents across customer, supplier, contact, and item domains.

Two Data Quality Developers will be hired — one focused primarily on the Ataccama platform (configuration, rules, profiling, monitoring) and the other focused on data quality operations outside of Ataccama (cross-system reconciliation, integrations, dashboards, remediation). Both developers serve as each other's backup and are expected to be cross-trained across all responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities Data Quality Platform Configuration & Customization

  • Configure and customize data quality platforms (primarily Ataccama) to ensure optimal user experience for data management
  • Implement data quality rules, validation logic, and automated controls within the DQ platform
  • Develop and maintain workflows to manage reference data across systems
  • Build monitoring capabilities for operational processes and data quality metrics
  • Perform data profiling and analysis using platform-native tools to identify data quality issues and patterns
  • Configure DQ platform integrations with MDM, Snowflake, and enterprise source systems

Data Quality Analysis & Remediation

  • Run reports across systems to calculate data quality dimensions (completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness)
  • Execute data reconciliation reports across multiple systems (MDM, ERP, CRM, data lake)
  • Remediate data quality incidents in a timely manner — triage, investigate root cause, and resolve
  • Identify recurring incidents and implement permanent fixes to resolve root cause issues
  • Manage incident resolution using ServiceNow to meet SLAs
  • Collaborate with MDM developers and integration developers to trace data quality issues across system boundaries
  • Analyze logs and data flows to isolate where quality degradation occurs in the pipeline

Dashboard & Reporting Development

  • Implement and maintain data quality dashboards using Power BI
  • Create business-friendly visualizations of data quality findings and trends
  • Develop reports to track quality metrics across all domains (customer, supplier, contact, item)
  • Build monitoring reports for operational processes and controls
  • Design health scoring dashboards that provide at-a-glance quality status for each domain

Data Integration & Synchronization

  • Implement data integrations to synchronize data across systems for quality monitoring and reconciliation
  • Develop ETL processes to support data quality and reconciliation needs (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, or platform-native connectors)
  • Work hands-on with MDM, Snowflake, and related systems to implement quality controls
  • Ensure data consistency and accuracy across the enterprise data landscape
  • Build automated data validation checks within integration pipelines

Stakeholder Collaboration & Requirements Gathering

  • Participate in requirements gathering sessions with business users
  • Elicit and document data quality requirements from stakeholders
  • Present data quality findings in a business-friendly format
  • Conduct meetings with large audiences independently
  • Work effectively with business users across multiple regions and time zones

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to enhance data quality processes and controls
  • Contribute to the evolution of data quality maturity in the organization
  • Support the long-term data quality roadmap
  • Stay current with data quality best practices and emerging technologies

Required Qualifications Experience

  • 8+ years of total experience in data quality, data development, or related fields, preferably in an MDM and data governance environment
  • 5+ years hands-on experience with at least one data quality platform (e.g., Ataccama, Informatica Data Quality, Talend Data Quality, or similar)
  • 5+ years advanced SQL proficiency for data analysis, profiling, quality checks, and reconciliation (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake)
  • 4+ years ETL development experience for data integration and transformation (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, Talend, or platform-native connectors)
  • 3+ years experience building reports and dashboards using Power BI or similar visualization tools
  • 3+ years experience with data profiling tools and techniques for root cause analysis
  • 3+ years experience with data reconciliation across multiple systems (MDM, ERP, CRM, data lake)
  • 2+ years experience with incident management and SLA-driven resolution using ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira)
  • Experience working with business stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones
  • Proven track record of implementing data quality solutions and controls

Communication & Collaboration

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business-friendly language
  • Experience presenting to diverse audiences including business stakeholders and leadership
  • Proven ability to conduct meetings with large audiences independently
  • Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills
  • Comfortable working across global teams and time zones

Security & Compliance

  • Working knowledge of data security, information security practices, and SOX compliance procedures for data quality changes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ataccama Experience: Hands-on experience with Ataccama ONE platform (DQ rules, profiling, monitoring, workflows)
  • Multi-Domain MDM Experience: Experience working with customer, supplier, contact, or item master data domains
  • Manufacturing Industry: Background in manufacturing industry, particularly across multiple countries
  • Snowflake / Data Lake: Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms for data quality monitoring and reconciliation
  • ServiceNow: Experience using ServiceNow for incident management and meeting SLAs
  • MDM Platforms: Familiarity with MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica MDM, Reltio) and how DQ integrates with MDM workflows
  • Certifications: Data quality or data management certifications (e.g., CDMP, vendor-specific certifications)
  • Additional Tools: Experience with data governance tools, metadata management platforms, or data catalogs
  • Agile/Scrum: Experience working in Agile delivery environments

job.title: Sr. Manager IT Management
job.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

The Engineering Manager, MDM will lead a team of developers responsible for the ongoing development, support, and enhancement of our enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) platform. This is a hands-on technical leadership role — the Engineering Manager will personally design solutions, write and review code, estimate work from loosely defined requirements, and solve complex technical problems — while also managing team delivery and performance.

This role operates under a "you build it, you support it" model — there is no separation between development and support teams. The Engineering Manager is accountable for platform stability, sprint delivery, code quality, SLA compliance, and team performance across customer, supplier, contact, and item domains.

The successful candidate must be a seasoned technical problem-solver first and a people manager second. They will work closely with the MDM Architect (who drives technical direction and design authority) and the Program Manager (who drives roadmap, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional coordination).

Key Responsibilities Engineering Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and manage a team of developers supporting and enhancing the MDM platform
  • Conduct sprint planning, prioritization, and ensure consistent monthly sprint delivery
  • Perform code reviews to maintain high code quality standards
  • Hire, onboard, and rapidly build capability in new team members
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement
  • Enforce the "you build it, you support it" model — ensure developers own their features through production support
  • Drive technical debt reduction and code optimization initiatives
  • Monitor and report on platform KPIs and team performance metrics
  • Work with platform vendors to drive open product issues to closure

Platform Development, Enhancement & Support

  • Lead the design and development of new MDM capabilities and features
  • Personally design solutions for complex problems and estimate effort from loosely defined requirements
  • Evaluate user stories, establish story points, and create delivery schedules

  • Ensure adherence to software development best practices across the full SDLC
  • Manage incident resolution within established SLAs

  • Handle complex data reconciliation and synchronization across systems

Platform Migration & Modernization

  • Lead the technical execution of MDM modernization
  • Plan and execute phased migration strategy ensuring zero data loss and minimal business disruption
  • Design and validate data mapping between legacy and target platforms
  • Ensure feature parity and regression testing throughout migration phases

Technical Quality & Testing

  • Design and think through complex testing scenarios for platform changes
  • Lead unit testing, system integration testing, UAT, and non-functional testing efforts
  • Maintain and execute regression test cases during significant platform changes
  • Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment
  • Conduct DR (Disaster Recovery) testing and ensure business continuity
  • Debug, refactor, and rewrite code to improve performance and maintainability

Security & Compliance

  • Ensure security best practices are followed across all platform development
  • Oversee static and dynamic code analysis to identify and remediate vulnerabilities
  • Ensure SOX compliance for all platform changes and controls
  • Maintain secure coding standards and conduct security reviews as required

Required Qualifications Technical Expertise

  • MDM Platform Experience: 8-10 years hands-on experience working with at least one MDM platform (e.g., Informatica MDM, Reltio, SAP MDM, or similar)
  • SQL Proficiency: 8-10 years of experience and advanced knowledge of SQL for complex queries, data analysis, and troubleshooting
  • Coding Skills: Hands-on ability to write, debug, refactor, and rewrite code — this is not a management-only role
  • Problem-Solving: Proven ability to design solutions for complex problems and triage issues spanning multiple systems
  • Data Migration: Extensive experience with large data migrations and bulk update operations in MDM environments
  • System Integration: Experience onboarding new systems, organizations, and datasets to MDM platforms
  • Data Mapping & Integration: Hands-on experience with data mapping and integration using at least one integration platform
  • Event driven architecture: Experience with event-driven architecture and API-first integration patterns
  • AI/ML: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts for data matching and deduplication
  • Agile: Experience with Service Now agile and project management modules

Software Development Discipline

Deep knowledge of the complete software development lifecycle including:

  • Requirements gathering and analysis
  • Technical design and architecture
  • Development and coding standards
  • Unit testing and test automation, System integration testing (SIT), User acceptance testing (UAT), Non-functional testing (performance, security)
  • CI/CD pipeline implementation and management. Change management and deployment processes
  • Release management including release, post-production validation, roll back planning and execution

Delivery Management

  • Ability to estimate effort, duration, and resource requirements from loosely defined requirements
  • Experience evaluating user stories, establishing story points, and creating delivery schedules
  • Proven track record of sprint planning, prioritization, and consistent delivery
  • Experience managing SLAs and meeting incident resolution targets
  • Discipline to maintain regression test cases and ensure platform stability during significant changes
  • Experience running daily scrums

Leadership & Communication

  • 5+ years of experience managing technical teams of 8+ developers
  • Experience hiring, onboarding, and retaining technical talent
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to explain complex technical problems in business-friendly language
  • Experience creating design and technical documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Multi-domain MDM experience (customer, supplier, contact, item)
  • Manufacturing industry experience across multiple countries
  • Familiarity with AI and ML modeling and production integration

  • Company leaders have many years of hands-on Field Service experience in this industry and many others

job.title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.

Key job responsibilities 🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling

  • Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
  • Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
  • Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
  • Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities

🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations

  • Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
  • Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
  • Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
  • Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation

🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support

  • Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
  • Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

🔷 Handover & Documentation

  • Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
  • Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
  • Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase

🔷 Rack Decommissioning

  • Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
  • Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
  • Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
  • Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
  • Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool

🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
  • Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
  • Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity

🔷 Cross-Team Coordination

  • Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
  • Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

🔷 Continuous Learning & Development

  • Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
  • Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
  • Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
  • Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
  • Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

A day in the life As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

ADSIPL offers an exciting, dynamic and challenging environment encouraging creativity and personal development while maintaining AWS computing environments in a secure, scalable, and cost-effective manner.

  • This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

job.description:

You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Data Center Operations designs, installs & maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.

To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build & manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. job.title: Site Supervisor, Network & Fibre Installation
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

The Site Supervisor is responsible for the day-to-day site supervision and execution of Network Layer 1 installation works for large-scale data centre deployment projects.

Reporting to the Site Manager, the Site Supervisor will directly supervise subcontractors and installation crews carrying out fibre optic cabling, network rack installation, rack & stack, patching and associated physical network infrastructure works.

The Site Supervisor is responsible for managing the 4Ms of construction – Manpower, Method, Machine and Money (Change Management) – within assigned work fronts and ensuring daily construction activities are properly planned, resourced and executed.

A key responsibility of this position is maintaining strong control of planned versus actual progress. The Site Supervisor is expected to develop daily and weekly work plans, monitor actual productivity and completed quantities, identify variances early, and implement corrective actions to maintain the project schedule.

This is a full-time site-based position requiring practical fibre installation experience and strong hands-on construction supervision capability.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Network & Fibre Installation

  • Supervise daily Network Layer 1 installation activities.
  • Supervise fibre optic cable installation, pulling, routing, dressing, termination, splicing, patching and labelling.
  • Supervise network rack move-in, positioning and installation.
  • Coordinate rack & stack activities and physical installation of network equipment.
  • Ensure installations are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, cable schedules, port maps, rack elevations, method statements and project standards.
  • Verify installation quality and ensure defects are identified and rectified promptly.
  • Support fibre testing activities including OTDR, insertion loss and continuity testing.
  • Coordinate physical Layer 1 rectification works arising from network testing and troubleshooting.

4M Construction Management

The Site Supervisor is responsible for managing the following four key construction areas within assigned work fronts:

Manpower

  • Plan daily manpower requirements based on scheduled activities and installation targets.
  • Allocate installation crews to specific work fronts and activities.
  • Monitor subcontractor attendance, manpower deployment and productivity.
  • Identify manpower shortages or productivity issues and escalate them to the Site Manager.
  • Ensure appropriate skilled resources are deployed for specialised activities such as fibre splicing, termination and testing.

Method

  • Ensure construction activities follow approved drawings, method statements, installation procedures and quality requirements.
  • Brief installation teams on the correct sequence and methodology before work commences.
  • Identify buildability and installation issues and coordinate resolutions with the Site Manager and Project Team.
  • Ensure approved installation methods are consistently implemented across different work crews.

Machine

  • Ensure required tools, equipment and machinery are available before commencement of planned activities.
  • Coordinate access equipment, lifting equipment, cable pulling equipment, fibre splicing machines, fibre test equipment and other specialist tools.
  • Verify equipment readiness and certification where applicable.
  • Identify equipment constraints that may impact productivity or scheduled activities.

Money / Change Management

  • Identify site conditions, instructions or changes that may result in additional work or variation to the original scope.
  • Maintain records of changes, additional works and associated site instructions.
  • Avoid proceeding with unrecorded or unauthorised additional works without appropriate escalation.
  • Capture supporting information including manpower, materials, equipment, photographs and work records for potential variations.
  • Escalate potential commercial changes promptly to the Site Manager and Project Team.
  • Support verification of subcontractor variation claims and additional work quantities.

Daily & Weekly Planning

  • Develop detailed daily work plans based on the project schedule and Site Manager’s priorities.
  • Develop weekly work plans and short-term look-ahead activities.
  • Break planned activities into measurable installation quantities and targets.
  • Confirm manpower, work fronts, materials, tools, access and information are available before work commences.
  • Coordinate daily activities with subcontractors and installation teams.
  • Conduct daily briefings to communicate work priorities, targets, constraints and safety requirements.

Planned vs Actual Progress Control

The Site Supervisor is expected to maintain clear visibility of what was planned, what was actually completed, and why any variance occurred.

  • Establish measurable daily and weekly installation targets.
  • Record actual completed quantities against planned quantities.
  • Monitor productivity of individual work fronts and installation crews.
  • Identify deviations from the daily and weekly plan as early as possible.
  • Determine causes of delays including manpower, materials, access, design information, equipment, quality issues or other trade dependencies.
  • Implement corrective actions with subcontractors to recover lost productivity.
  • Escalate significant schedule risks and unresolved constraints to the Site Manager.
  • Support development and implementation of recovery plans where required.
  • Maintain accurate records of planned versus actual progress.

Subcontractor Supervision

  • Directly supervise subcontractors and installation crews within assigned work areas.
  • Communicate daily installation targets and priorities.
  • Monitor contractor productivity, workmanship and compliance.
  • Ensure contractors have sufficient manpower, materials, equipment, drawings and access to achieve planned activities.
  • Coordinate multiple installation crews and work fronts where required.
  • Identify poor performance early and drive corrective action.
  • Maintain strong discipline around work completion and closure.

Troubleshooting & Rectification

  • Support the Site Manager in daily network troubleshooting and issue closure.
  • Mobilise fibre installers and subcontractors quickly when Layer 1 faults are identified.
  • Coordinate cable tracing, fibre testing, re-patching, re-termination, cleaning and other physical rectification works.
  • Work closely with Network Engineers during fault isolation where Layer 1 verification is required.
  • Ensure troubleshooting actions assigned to installation contractors are completed within agreed timelines.
  • Report troubleshooting status and unresolved issues to the Site Manager.
  • Capture recurring installation problems and ensure lessons learned are applied to subsequent installations.

Quality & Testing

  • Inspect installation workmanship throughout construction rather than relying solely on final inspection.
  • Ensure fibre installation complies with bend radius, routing, segregation, termination, cleanliness, labelling and cable management requirements.
  • Coordinate inspection and testing activities.
  • Verify fibre test results and ensure failed links are investigated and rectified.
  • Manage punch-list and defect rectification activities.
  • Support preparation of redlines, test records and as-built documentation.

Safety

  • Ensure all site activities comply with project HSE requirements.
  • Conduct daily toolbox talks and pre-task briefings.
  • Ensure subcontractors follow approved method statements and safe working procedures.
  • Monitor housekeeping and work-area conditions.
  • Stop and escalate unsafe activities where required.

Daily Reporting

Provide clear daily reporting to the Site Manager covering:

  • Planned activities versus actual completed works.
  • Installation quantities achieved.
  • Manpower deployed.
  • Productivity achieved.
  • Active work fronts.
  • Outstanding works.
  • Constraints and blockers.
  • Quality issues and defects.
  • Troubleshooting activities.
  • Changes and potential variations.
  • Required actions for the following shift/day.

Qualifications

  • Diploma, Technical Certificate or relevant vocational qualification in Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Network Infrastructure or a related technical discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
  • Candidates without formal technical qualifications will be considered where they can demonstrate strong practical experience in fibre optic installation, network infrastructure deployment and site supervision.
  • Relevant fibre optic installation, splicing, testing, structured cabling or networking certifications are advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Practical field experience and demonstrated installation capability will be given strong consideration.

Experience

  • 3–8 years of site supervision or network installation experience.
  • Practical fibre optic installation experience is required.
  • Strong preference for candidates from structured cabling contractors, fibre installation contractors, telecommunications contractors, network infrastructure contractors or systems integrators.
  • Experience supervising subcontractors and installation crews.
  • Experience with data center, telecommunications or mission-critical infrastructure projects is highly desirable.
  • Experience working in fast-track construction environments is advantageous.

Technical Knowledge

The successful candidate should have practical knowledge of:

  • Fibre optic cable installation.
  • Fibre pulling and routing.
  • Fibre termination and splicing.
  • Fibre patching and labelling.
  • OTDR and insertion-loss testing.
  • Fibre cleaning and inspection.
  • Structured cabling systems.
  • Network racks and cabinets.
  • Rack & stack activities.
  • ODFs and patch panels.
  • Cable containment systems.
  • Cable schedules, port maps and rack elevations.
  • Basic Network Layer 1 troubleshooting.

Location

  • Location: Wesley Vale, Tasmania

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.
