The role also coordinates closely with the Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) team to progressively bring up power and cooling infrastructure in line with the network deployment sequence.

A critical part of this role is daily troubleshooting management. The Site Manager is expected to establish clear ownership of faults, coordinate contractors and engineering resources, drive root-cause identification, remove blockers and ensure issues are followed through to closure without allowing unresolved problems to accumulate.

This is a site-based, hands-on delivery role requiring strong contractor management, network installation knowledge and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced data center deployment environment.

Network Layer 1 Construction & Installation

  • Take ownership of site execution for Network Layer 1 infrastructure.
  • Plan, coordinate and supervise network rack move-in, positioning and installation.
  • Manage rack & stack and physical network equipment deployment.
  • Coordinate installation of fibre optic cabling, copper cabling, patch panels, ODFs and associated network infrastructure.
  • Manage fibre pulling, termination, splicing, patching, dressing, labelling and testing activities.
  • Ensure installations comply with approved drawings, rack elevations, cable schedules, port maps, method statements and project standards.
  • Ensure physical installation readiness ahead of network configuration, testing and commissioning.
  • Coordinate rectification of installation defects and punch-list items.

Subcontractor & Contractor Management

  • Manage network installation subcontractors and specialist vendors on site.
  • Translate project requirements and construction schedules into clear daily execution plans for contractors.
  • Coordinate contractor manpower, materials, tools, machinery and work fronts.
  • Monitor contractor productivity and installation performance against daily and weekly targets.
  • Ensure contractors have required drawings, materials, access, permits and information before commencing work.
  • Conduct daily coordination meetings and clearly communicate priorities and constraints.
  • Hold contractors accountable for quality, productivity, safety and timely completion.
  • Escalate resource or performance issues and drive corrective or recovery actions.

Construction Planning & Site Coordination

  • Develop detailed daily plans and short-term look-ahead plans aligned with the overall project master schedule.
  • Manage construction sequencing and work-front readiness.
  • Coordinate installation activities with other trades and project stakeholders.
  • Identify access, material, design, resource and sequencing constraints before they impact installation.
  • Coordinate closely with Project Managers, Project Engineers, Site Engineers, Network Engineers, logistics teams and other construction disciplines.
  • Track physical installation progress and maintain accurate site status.

M&E Interface & Progressive Power/Cooling Bring-Up

  • Work closely with the M&E team to coordinate progressive power and cooling readiness in line with the network deployment sequence.
  • Maintain alignment between rack installation, power availability, cooling availability and network equipment activation.
  • Coordinate progressive energisation of network racks and associated infrastructure based on construction and commissioning priorities.
  • Verify rack power, PDUs, grounding/bonding and associated electrical infrastructure readiness before equipment energisation.
  • Coordinate with the Mechanical team to ensure cooling systems and suitable environmental conditions are available before network equipment is powered and placed under load.
  • Participate in M&E readiness reviews and identify dependencies that could impact network rack bring-up.
  • Establish readiness progression from rack installation to power/cooling readiness, equipment energisation, Layer 1 verification, Layer 2 configuration, network testing and commissioning.
  • Coordinate with M&E, Network Engineering and Commissioning teams to develop rack, row, zone or data hall bring-up sequences.
  • Track and escalate power and cooling constraints that could delay network activation or project milestones.
  • Support troubleshooting where network equipment issues may be related to power, cooling, environmental conditions or other facility infrastructure.

Layer 1 to Layer 2 Integration

  • Act as the primary site interface between physical network installation contractors and Network Engineers.
  • Ensure Layer 1 infrastructure is complete, tested and ready before Layer 2 configuration and activation.
  • Coordinate with Network Engineers during switch configuration, network activation, connectivity testing and commissioning.
  • Support Network Engineers in isolating whether faults originate from physical infrastructure, equipment installation, cabling or configuration.
  • Coordinate physical checks, cable tracing, re-patching, fibre testing, equipment replacement and other field activities required during troubleshooting.
  • Ensure physical installation teams are available to support network activation and commissioning activities when required.

Troubleshooting & Issue Closure

A major responsibility of the Site Manager is to drive troubleshooting activities efficiently from identification through to closure.

  • Lead daily troubleshooting coordination across contractors, installation teams, vendors and Network Engineers.
  • Maintain clear visibility of all open installation, connectivity and commissioning issues.
  • Ensure every issue has a clearly assigned owner, priority and target closure time.
  • Rapidly mobilise the appropriate contractor or engineering resource when faults are identified.
  • Coordinate Layer 1 physical checks and Layer 2 engineering troubleshooting in parallel where appropriate.
  • Drive systematic fault isolation rather than repetitive or unstructured troubleshooting.
  • Remove blockers preventing troubleshooting activities from progressing.
  • Prioritise issues according to their impact on network activation, commissioning and project milestones.
  • Escalate critical or ageing issues promptly.
  • Conduct daily review of outstanding issues and drive actions through to verified closure.
  • Capture recurring issues and lessons learned to prevent repetition across subsequent racks, network zones or deployment phases.

Quality, Testing & Handover

  • Ensure Layer 1 installations meet project quality requirements.
  • Coordinate fibre OTDR, insertion-loss and continuity testing as applicable.
  • Verify rack installation, equipment positioning, cabling, patching and labelling against approved documentation.
  • Manage installation punch lists, defects and non-conformances through closure.
  • Ensure test records, redlines, as-built drawings and installation documentation are completed.
  • Support network readiness reviews and final handover to Network Engineering and Operations teams.

Safety

  • Ensure all installation activities comply with project HSE requirements.
  • Coordinate permits, toolbox meetings and pre-task briefings.
  • Ensure contractors comply with approved method statements and safe working procedures.
  • Stop and escalate unsafe work where required.

Planning & Reporting

  • Maintain daily installation and deployment trackers.
  • Report progress against planned quantities and milestones.
  • Maintain an active troubleshooting and issue register.
  • Provide clear daily reporting covering completed works, upcoming activities, blockers, troubleshooting status and critical actions.
  • Identify schedule risks early and develop recovery plans with contractors and the project team.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Construction Management or a related technical discipline.
  • Relevant structured cabling, fibre optic or networking qualifications are advantageous.

Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in network infrastructure deployment, telecommunications, structured cabling, data center fit-out or related construction environments.
  • Strong preference for candidates with a network installation contractor, structured cabling contractor, telecommunications contractor or systems integrator background.
  • Demonstrated experience managing subcontractors and installation crews.
  • Practical experience with network rack deployment, rack & stack and fibre optic installation.
  • Experience supporting network testing, activation, commissioning and troubleshooting.
  • Experience coordinating with M&E teams for progressive power and cooling bring-up is highly desirable.
  • Data center or mission-critical infrastructure experience is highly desirable.

Technical Knowledge

  • Network Layer 1 infrastructure and structured cabling systems.
  • Fibre optic installation, termination, patching and testing.
  • Network rack and cabinet installation and rack & stack activities.
  • ODFs, patch panels, cable containment and routing.
  • Cable schedules and port maps.
  • Fibre OTDR and insertion-loss testing.
  • Network equipment installation.
  • Basic understanding of Layer 2 networking and switch configuration.
  • Network testing, commissioning and fault isolation processes.
  • Basic understanding of data center rack power, PDUs, grounding/bonding and cooling readiness.

Key Competencies

  • Strong site and subcontractor management capability.
  • Strong understanding of network installation and deployment.
  • Highly effective troubleshooting and issue-management capability.
  • Ability to quickly organise resources around technical problems and drive them to closure.
  • Strong construction planning and sequencing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent work fronts and technical issues.
  • Decisive and comfortable working in a fast-moving site environment.
  • Strong communication between construction, network engineering and M&E teams.
  • High level of ownership and accountability.
  • Strong attention to installation quality and detail.
  • Ability to prioritise activities according to their impact on overall project milestones.

Location & Reporting

  • Location: Wesley Vale, Tasmania

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Specialist, Strategic Sourcing
job.description:
Job Description – Procurement Specialist**

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Procurement Specialist to join our fiber cable manufacturing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and procuring critical materials and services essential for our production processes, with a strong emphasis on cost reduction, contract manufacturing, and supply chain efficiency. This role demands expertise in sourcing a diverse range of components.

  • Strategic Sourcing & Cost Reduction:
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies to achieve significant cost savings and total cost of ownership (TCO) improvements across assigned categories (polymers, molded plastics, mechanical components).
  • Conduct thorough market research and analysis to identify potential new suppliers, predict cost trends, and assess supply chain risks.
  • Lead renegotiations of existing vendor contracts and terms to ensure the best value and favorable pricing for the company.
  • Implement e-sourcing tools and data analysis techniques to optimize procurement processes and identify ongoing cost-saving opportunities.
  • Market Analysis:Analyze industry and market trends for fiber optic components and raw materials to inform sourcing strategies and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Documentation & Reporting:Maintain accurate procurement records and documentation for all transactions, audits, and performance reporting purposes.
  • Supplier & Contract Management:
  • Supplier Management & Sourcing:Identify, evaluate, select & Onboard suppliers for Polymers, molded plastic components, mechanical parts including Sheet Metal & Machined components, Raw fiber, protective jacketing materials, strength members & ensuring they meet quality, cost, and delivery benchmarks.
  • Negotiation & Contract Management:Manage the entire contract lifecycle, including drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and ensuring compliance with all contractual terms and legal requirements in collaboration with the legal department.
  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure continuous improvement and reliable supply.
  • Monitor and track supplier performance using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to quality, delivery, and cost, addressing any discrepancies proactively.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:Work closely with engineering, manufacturing, finance, and legal departments to align procurement activities with overall business objectives and production schedules.
  • Operational Procurement:
  • Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Production, to understand material needs and ensure alignment of procurement activities with manufacturing schedules.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience:
  • Proven experience as a Procurement Specialist or similar role within a manufacturing environment, preferably in the fiber optics or related industry.
  • Demonstrated expertise in procuring specific commodity types:polymers, molded plastic components, and mechanical components including Sheet Metal & Machined components, Raw fiber, protective jacketing materials, strength members & ensuring they meet quality, cost, and delivery benchmarks
  • Experience in managingcontract manufacturing(CM) relationships and agreements.
  • Proven track record of successfully implementingcost reduction measuresand achieving measurable savings.
  • Skills:
  • Exceptional negotiation communication, and interpersonal skills to build strong vendor relationships.
  • Proficiency in procurement software, ERP systems (e.g., SAP preferred), and Microsoft Office Suite (advanced Excel skills preferred).
  • Expertise in Power BI:Proficiency in using Microsoft Power BI for data visualization, spend analysis, and creating interactive dashboards to track KPIs and cost-saving initiatives would be a significant advantage. This skill will be highly valued for driving data-informed decisions within the procurement function.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical skills for data analysis, cost modeling, and forecasting.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Education:
  • BE B.TECH – Mech/ Electrical/ Electronics/Instrumentation with Minimum of 10 years of experience in procurement, preferably in Telecom Industry.

Learn more about how we're on a quest to connect the future and build what's next.

job.title: Project Manager, ICT
job.description:
Role Overview

The Project Manager, ICT takes full end-to-end ownership of planning, executing, and delivering complex, strategic, and medium-to-large-scale ICT projects. Acting as the central bridge between business requirements, technical delivery, and operational teams, you will define comprehensive project management plans to track progress, optimize resource utilization, manage costs, and mitigate delivery risks.

The ideal candidate possesses a deep command of industry-standard project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) across the full project lifecycle—from initiation through to closure. Operating within established organizational PMO standards and governance frameworks, you will lead cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, high-value technical solutions on schedule and within budget.

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery & Execution Management

  • End-to-End Delivery: Drive the start-to-finish lifecycle management of high-value, strategic ICT initiatives, ensuring full alignment with business objectives and quality standards.
  • Baseline Tracking: Actively plan, track, and report on project scope, timelines, financials, milestones, and performance metrics/KPIs.
  • Concurrence & Velocity: Maintain a highly organized, proactive, and delivery-focused mindset with the capability to manage multiple concurrent projects under pressure.

2. Stakeholder Engagement & Client Management

  • Primary Point of Contact: Act as the face of the project team for clients and external partners, providing transparent status updates while championing high customer satisfaction.
  • Executive Communication: Distill project progress, complex technical issues, and risks into clear updates for senior management and diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Strategic Influence: Align expectations across cross-functional business, product, and support teams to drive collaboration and minimize overall failure risks.

3. Resource Planning & Matrix Coordination

  • Utilization Optimization: Plan, monitor, and analyze resource allocation and utilization metrics to optimize future scheduling and team capacity.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Orchestrate tasks and workflows among internal teams, third-party vendors, and external partners within matrixed environments.

4. Risk, Issue & Change Governance

  • Proactive Mitigation: Anticipate, assess, and manage project risks and technical issues, implementing swift preventative actions and mitigation strategies.
  • Escalation Control: Actively manage project escalations, schedule slippages, resource shortages, and resolve team or vendor conflicts effectively.
  • Scope Governance: Strictly control scope creep and evaluate changing user requirements through formal organizational Change Control processes.

5. PMO Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Process Adherence: Ensure all project activities and artifacts strictly comply with internal corporate PMO governance standards, processes, and methodologies.
  • Documentation Excellence: Maintain accurate, thorough, and timely project documentation and health reporting.
  • Corporate Value-Add: Contribute to ongoing PMO capability developments, support pre-sales activities, assist in corporate initiatives, and mentor junior project managers.

Qualifications & Experience

1. Background & Experience Requirements

  • Professional Experience: Minimum of 5 years of dedicated project management experience specifically within ICT delivery environments.
  • Track Record: Proven success delivering medium-to-large-scale ICT projects from inception to completion.
  • Organizational Exposure: Prior experience navigating large matrix organizations or multinational corporation (MNC) environments is highly preferred.
  • Target Industries: Proven experience delivering technology solutions across sectors such as Government, Healthcare, Education, Financial Services (FSI), Hospitality/MICE, or Commercial industries.

2. Education & Professional Certifications

  • Academic Degree: An accredited University Degree in Information Technology, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related technical/business discipline. (Equivalent practical, professional experience will be evaluated and considered in lieu of a degree).
  • Mandatory Certification: Must hold at least one recognized professional project management certification: PMP, CITPM, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum (e.g., CSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe).

Core Competencies & Soft Skills

  • Methodology Command: Deep understanding and practical application of Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid frameworks.
  • Analytical Problem-Solving: A highly logical and analytical mindset geared toward troubleshooting, critical decision-making, and crisis management in fast-paced environments.
  • Elite Soft Skills: Exceptional interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Proven ability to command a room, resolve conflict, and positively influence diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders up to the executive level.

Application Note: We appreciate your interest in this role; please note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified for an interview.

job.title: Manager, Cyber Engineering
job.description:
Job Description

Job Description

Role Mission:

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, the role plays a pivotal role in ensuring the organization's adherence to regulatory and internal policies, managing risk, and maintaining a robust governance framework.

Accountabilities

As a 1LoD Cyber Risk Specialist, you will be the dedicated technical partner for Business Unit Heads (Risk Owners) and Technical Leads (Control Owners). Your responsibility is to translate complex cyber threats into business impact, manage the system development lifecycle of security controls, and ensure full compliance with StarHub policies and Singaporean regulatory frameworks (IMDA TCS/BCS, CSA CCoP 2.0)

Responsibilities

Risk & Control Ownership Support

  • Advisory to Risk Owners: Assist Business Unit Heads in overseeing the security posture of critical assets. Translate technical vulnerabilities into "Business Impact" language to facilitate informed risk acceptance.
  • Control Lifecycle Management: Act on behalf of Control Owners to design, implement, and document the technologies required to mitigate risks.
  • Execution Oversight: Coordinate with Control Performers (Support Teams) to ensure daily security activities are executed according to defined standards.
  • Documentation: Maintain formalized standard operating procedures and plans that align with StarHub’s Information Security policies and national requirements.

Operational Cyber Risk Management

  • Threat Modelling: Lead threat modelling sessions during the design phase of new systems or infrastructure changes to identify attack vectors before they go live.
  • Risk Assessments: Execute cyber risk assessments on identified gaps and vulnerabilities — through security deviations, operational activities (including but not limited to vulnerability scans, penetration testing, and security events), external threats, or audit findings — to qualify the risk posed to IT and Operational environments.
  • Remediation Strategy: Propose risk mitigation/treatment strategies (in the context of cybersecurity- corrective action/remediation plans and proposed security controls – Directive, Deterrence, Preventive, Detective, Corrective, and Compensating) to remediate identified gaps and vulnerabilities and maintain compliance with the Starhub Information security policies, standards and Singapore's national/sectoral requirements (e.g., CSA/IMDA).
  • Transparency: Provide Risk Owners with operational impact assessments, ensuring they understand potential service disruptions before accepting the residual risks.
  • Continuous Monitoring: Track and report on the status of remediation plans to ensure they are completed within agreed-upon timelines.

Compliance (Audit & Assessment) Management

  • Collaborate with ISO to facilitate the end-to-end audit & assessment process (including but not limited to CII audits, Starhub control Self-assessment, or any ad-hoc assessment / testing). You will take the lead in ensuring Risk and Control Owners meet audit milestones and deadlines
  • Support the selection and appointment of auditors, providing consultation on fees and operational feasibility.
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive audit plan—including scope, resource allocation, and budgeting—to verify that Starhub’s systems, infrastructure, and operations are resilient and fully compliant with all internal policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Take responsibility for the collection and verification of technical evidence (Request for information such as logs, screenshots, configurations). Ensure all artefacts are accurate, reflect the current state of critical assets, and meet the ISO’s standards before submission.
  • Collaborate with Risk and Control Owners to develop technically sound and operationally viable remediation plans for draft audit & assessment findings. This involves providing the necessary technical context to justify management’s response and ensuring that the proposed remediation actions are both effective and achievable within the business environment.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity or related field.
  • 8–10 years' experience, preferably in Telecommunications sector with deep understanding of service risk and impact, SLAs, network, knowledge of balancing service delivery vs cyber risks and must be able to balance availability and cyber resilience.
  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certificate of Cloud Auditing Knowledge (CCAK) or equivalent, ISC2 or SSCP/CISSP.
  • ISO 20000, 22301 and/or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of compliance frameworks and regulatory requirements (NIST, ISO 27001, Cybersecurity Act, Personal Data Protection Act, Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard, IMDA Code of Practice for Broadcasting & Telecommunications, etc).
  • Experience in cloud and operational technology environments and / or critical information infrastructures will be an added advantage.
  • Highly disciplined and diligent in driving deliverables strictly within defined timelines.
  • A sharp, analytical mind and able to pro-actively anticipate problems and risks to mitigate ahead of time.
  • Logical and methodological, with good planning & organizational skills.
  • An excellent communicator, strong team player, promotes a collaborative working environment and relationship building.
  • Able to work independently and handle multiple projects at the same time.

About the Role

job.title: Senior Incident Responder
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:The Senior Analyst – Cyber Security Incident Response is responsible for monitoring, detecting, and analysing cybersecurity incidents through the Security Operations Centre (SOC) platform. The role supports the end-to-end incident lifecycle — including triage, investigation, containment, and closure — ensuring timely response to security events and maintaining StarHub’s cyber resilience. This role acts as the Level 2 (L2) Incident Responder, bridging SOC analysts and Incident Response management by performing deep technical analysis and coordinating with internal teams for resolution.

Accountabilities

  • Perform end-to-end incident triage and investigation of security alerts escalated from L1 SOC analysts.
  • Ensure timely incident analysis, containment, and escalation aligned with MTTD and MTTR goals.
  • Support the SIEM platform (Elastic Stack) by fine-tuning existing rules and suggesting new detections.
  • Conduct log analysis and correlation across multiple data sources (network, endpoint, and cloud).
  • Create and maintain incident documentation, reports, and lessons learned.
  • Support incident response playbook execution during containment and recovery phases.
  • Collaborate with IT, network, and application teams for incident remediation and root cause analysis.
  • Provide insights for use case improvements and participate in use case validation and testing.
  • Escalate confirmed incidents to CSIRT / Assistant Manager – Incident Response for further action.
  • Participate in post-incident reviews, contributing to process and detection improvements.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor alerts generated from the SOC/SIEM and perform initial to intermediate-level investigations.
  • Review and validate security events from multiple log sources and identify legitimate threats.
  • Perform deep-dive investigations for incidents involving malware, phishing, insider threats, and cloud breaches.
  • Assist in detection rule creation and tuning under the guidance of senior incident responders.
  • Use frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK for mapping and improving detection quality.
  • Conduct threat hunting using Elastic Stack and related tools.
  • Collaborate with MSSP, CSIRT, and IT infrastructure teams to ensure timely incident handling.
  • Support incident response reporting, evidence collection, and documentation for compliance and audit.
  • Contribute to automation opportunities in detection and response workflows.
  • Participate in training sessions, simulations, and tabletop exercises to enhance readiness.
  • Responsible for the log source onboarding and managing the continuous logs availability on the SIEM platform.

Qualifications

  • 2–3 years of experience in a SOC or Incident Response (L2) environment.
  • Intermediate hands-on experience with SIEM platforms (Elastic Stack preferred).
  • Exposure to incident triage, malware analysis, phishing response, and log correlation.
  • Strong understanding of use case creation and MITRE ATT&CK framework mapping.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex alerts and distinguish false positives from true incidents.
  • Familiarity with security tools such as EDR, NDR, Cyber security tools and threat intelligence platforms.
  • Good communication and documentation skills for stakeholder updates.
  • Certifications such as CEH, CompTIA Security+, GCIA, or Elastic Certified Analyst preferred.

job.title: Domain Solution Architect
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission: This role exists to define and govern the end-to-end solution architecture for the Enterprise Business Group (EBG) CRM and Order Management (OM) domains at a time of continued enterprise platform transformation and growing integration complexity. The role ensures that business priorities across customer lifecycle, order orchestration, fulfilment readiness, and downstream operational handoffs are translated into scalable, secure, and supportable solution designs. It brings architectural consistency across initiatives, reduces fragmentation between platforms, and accelerates delivery by providing clear architecture direction. The role also helps shape the target-state roadmap for CRM and OM modernization while safeguarding business continuity and delivery quality.

Accountabilities

  • Own target-state and transitional architecture for EBG CRM and OM.
  • Govern end-to-end solution design across lead-to-order, quote-to-cash, order capture, decomposition, orchestration, and fulfilment handoffs.
  • Ensure alignment to enterprise architecture principles, security standards, integration patterns, and domain roadmaps.
  • Drive architecture decisions, design quality, and solution integrity across projects, vendors, and delivery teams.
  • Identify and manage architecture risks, technical debt, dependencies, and modernization opportunities within the CRM and OM domain.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, engineers, and vendors to translate business requirements into architecture options and approved solution designs.
  • Produce and maintain architecture artifacts such as solution blueprints, capability maps, application interaction diagrams, data flows, interface specifications, and transition roadmaps.
  • Define integration and data patterns across CRM, CPQ, product catalog, OM, billing, provisioning, service assurance, and related enterprise platforms.
  • Review business, functional, and technical designs to ensure compliance with approved architecture and non-functional requirements including resilience, security, observability, and supportability.
  • Support delivery governance, impact assessments, platform evaluations, and architecture reviews across change initiatives in the EBG domain.

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • This is an individual contributor role with strong matrix influence across business, product, engineering, integration, vendor, and operations teams.
  • Key stakeholders include: EBG business owners, product managers, enterprise architects, CRM and OM delivery teams, integration teams, billing/provisioning teams, program managers, operations/support teams, cybersecurity, and external delivery partners/vendors.

Minimum Profile/ Track Record:

  • Ideal Profile desired background: Strong background in solution architecture, preferably in telecommunications, B2B services, or similarly complex industries with multi-system customer and order lifecycle processes.
  • Ideal Profile seniority, skills and certifications: 8+ years in solution/application architecture or large-scale systems delivery; strong experience in CRM and Order Management; deep understanding of domains integration, APIs, event-driven patterns, and domain data models; strong stakeholder management and documentation skills. Must-haves include hands-on architecture delivery across multiple integrated platforms. Preferred: telecom BSS/OSS experience, TM Forum knowledge, cloud-native architecture exposure, and TOGAF or equivalent architecture certification.
  • Ideal track record #1: Proven experience designing and governing end-to-end solutions across CRM, order management, fulfilment, and downstream operational systems for complex enterprise environments.
  • Ideal track record #2: Demonstrated success leading architecture decisions for cross-functional programs involving multiple applications, vendors, and business stakeholders, with clear ownership of non-functional quality and integration design.
  • Ideal track record #3: Strong history of shaping domain roadmaps, reducing architecture fragmentation/technical debt, and enabling delivery teams to execute strategic transformation initiatives with lower rework and improved design consistency.

job.title: Sales Support Specialist (ICT)
job.description:
Job Description

Job Purpose

The Sales Support Specialist is responsible for supporting the sales process from quotation generation through to sales order submission. This role works closely with customers, vendors, the Lead Sales Specialist, and internal post-sales teams to ensure timely coordination, accurate documentation, and smooth pipeline progression. The role also supports key account management activities and sales administration to help drive business growth and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Handle the sales cycle for assigned transactions, from quotation generation to sales order raising.
  • Liaise with customers and vendors to clarify quotation details, pricing, and product or service requirements.
  • Support the Lead Sales Specialist in managing key accounts and coordinating customer requirements.
  • Perform sales administrative duties, including preparing quotations, sourcing quotations from suppliers, and maintaining pipeline tracking.
  • Liaise with post-sales teams to obtain and submit supporting documents required for order processing and service fulfilment.
  • Maintain accurate records of quotations, orders, pipeline status, and customer communications.
  • Ensure timely follow-up on sales activities to support customer satisfaction and order conversion.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth handover and execution of customer orders.
  • Comply with internal processes, sales governance, and documentation standards.

Requirements

  • Diploma in any field with at least 3 years of experience in Inside Sales, Telemarketing, Sales Administration, or B2B Account Support.
  • Experience supporting enterprise or commercial customers is an advantage.
  • Prior exposure to telecommunications, IT, or technology services will be an added advantage.
  • Strong communication, coordination and follow-up skills.
  • Able to manage multiple priorities and work accurately under tight deadlines.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
  • Meticulous and good organisational skills.

job.title: SaaS Technical Lead
job.description:
Role Mission:

The SaaS Technical Lead will lead the operational ownership, governance, reliability, and continuous improvement of the company’s shared enterprise software platforms such as PDPA, Marketing Communication, Workload Management, Address Manager, Knowledge Management and Splunk products which are operated under Starhub’s telecommunication business.

This role ensures these mission-critical SaaS and enterprise platforms operate securely, reliably, and in compliance with regulatory requirements while enabling business and engineering teams to function efficiently.

The SaaS Technical Lead embeds operational excellence, automation, observability, security, compliance, and cost governance into all enterprise software platforms. The role also supports legacy system modernization initiatives, including migration from On-Premise environments to AWS Cloud.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead and mentor junior SaaS/platform engineers in supporting enterprise software platforms.
  • Own day-2 operations including availability, reliability, patching, upgrades, configuration management, and vendor escalations.
  • Establish and enforce governance standards across enterprise SaaS platforms (access control, security hardening, audit readiness, DR posture).
  • Drive automation, monitoring, and operational improvements to reduce manual effort and incident rates.
  • Lead and support legacy system migration initiatives from On-Premise infrastructure to AWS Cloud, ensuring secure, scalable, and resilient target-state architectures.
  • Collaborate with Shared Services Manager, Platform Architect, Security, Compliance, Procurement, and Business stakeholders to align platform roadmap and operational priorities.**

**

Responsibilities:

  • Own, operate, and maintain all shared enterprise software platforms under Shared Services governance,
  • Ensure high availability and reliability of platforms through proactive monitoring, capacity planning, performance tuning, and SLA management.
  • Support and execute migration of legacy enterprise systems from On-Premise infrastructure to AWS Cloud, including architecture review, migration planning, security hardening, data migration, performance validation, and post-migration stabilization.
  • Support observability platform administration and integrations with other applications and tools (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace).
  • Define and maintain RBAC models, audit trails, security controls, and compliance standards aligned with CSA best practices and MAS-TRM guidelines.
  • Manage vendor relationships including support contracts, license renewals, escalation handling, performance reviews, and roadmap alignment.
  • Lead major version upgrades, platform migrations, DR testing, patch cycles, and vulnerability remediation programs.
  • Support incident response, problem management, root cause analysis (RCA), CAB reviews and continuous service improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain comprehensive platform documentation including architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, DR procedures, support playbooks, and knowledge base articles.
  • Track license utilization, SaaS consumption trends, and cost optimization opportunities to improve financial governance and resource efficiency.

Team Scope / Stakeholders:

  • Leads a small team of SaaS/platform support engineers.
  • Key stakeholders include:
  • Shared Services Manager
  • Platform Engineers
  • Application & DevOps Teams
  • IT Operations & SRE
  • Security & Compliance
  • Marketing & Business Operations Teams
  • Procurement & Vendor Management

Minimum Profile / Track Record:

  • Desired Background
  • Experience in medium-to-large enterprises or financial services environments managing multiple mission-critical enterprise software platforms.
  • Exposure to regulated environments requiring strong governance, auditability, and compliance controls.
  • Experience supporting both SaaS and on-prem enterprise systems with hybrid or cloud migration initiatives.
  • Seniority, Skills, Certifications (must-haves)
  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise platform engineering, SaaS operations, or IT infrastructure engineering.
  • Strong experience managing enterprise SaaS platforms and/or on-prem enterprise applications.
  • Hands-on expertise in:

Access control and RBAC governance

  • ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Release)
  • Monitoring & observability tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, or equivalent)
  • Automation scripting (Any of Python, Bash, PowerShell)
  • Public Cloud fundamentals (EC2, RDS, IAM, VPC, backup & DR patterns)
  • Experience managing vendor escalations and enterprise software contracts.
  • Sound knowledge in security and compliance standards (MAS-TRM, CSA).
  • ITIL certification, AWS/Azure certifications, or vendor-specific certifications are a plus.
  • Ideal Track Record:

Successfully operated and stabilized multiple enterprise SaaS platforms with measurable improvements in uptime, MTTR, operational maturity, and service quality.

  • Led major platform upgrades, migrations, or modernization initiatives with minimal business disruption.
  • Led or mentored a team of 2–5 engineers and drove governance standardization across multiple enterprise software platforms.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Business Planning
job.description:
Job Description

1\. Strategy Execution & Insights

  • Roadmap Maintenance: Update and maintain the division’s strategic roadmap templates and timelines based on inputs from the leadership team.
  • Cross-Divisional Coordination: Work with cross-functional teams to gather data for budgeting, forecasting, and target-setting exercises.
  • Performance Reporting: Consolidate regular performance data and highlight key variance trends to ensure the business stays on track financially and strategically.
  • Insight Generation: Analyze operational datasets to help frame business issues and pain points into structured, actionable insights.
  • AI Tool Integration: Assist in deploying AI-driven analytics tools to accelerate reporting processes and improve data-driven decision support.

2\. Business Management, Communication & Budgeting

  • Content Preparation: Draft initial versions of board decks, quarterly announcement commentaries, and risk committee materials based on leadership inputs.
  • CTO Briefings: Collate background information and build briefing packages for the CTO prior to external or internal presentations.

  • Action Item Tracking: Meticulously track action items from high-level meetings through to completion.
  • Change Support: Support change management efforts for internal AI and automation adoption, helping team members adjust to new automated workflows.

3\. PMO & Operations

  • Project Tracking: Run the day-to-day project tracking mechanics to monitor divisional KPIs and milestone delivery.
  • Risk Identification: Review department project plans to flag potential timeline overlaps, delivery roadblocks, or resource constraints to leadership.
  • AI-Powered PMO: Use and maintain AI-powered project management tools and automated workflows to maintain real-time visibility of project statuses.
  • Operational Governance: Assist in routing and tracking governance documentation, including vendor/tender reviews, CAPEX approvals, and pricing committee submissions.
  • Process Automation: Identify repetitive tasks within operational workflows (e.g., approval routing, report generation) and build or implement basic automation solutions to reduce cycle times.

4\. AI and Automation Implementation

  • Roadmap Support: Support the implementation of the division’s AI and automation adoption roadmap.
  • Requirements Gathering: Partner with data and analytics teams to document business requirements for AI dashboards and forecasting models.
  • Pilot Execution: Assist in piloting and scaling Robotic Process Automation (RPA), workflow automations, and Generative AI use cases (e.g., meeting summaries, reporting templates).
  • ROI Tracking: Track and compile metrics regarding the effectiveness of implemented AI tools, including time saved and process efficiency gains.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Engineering, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Business Administration, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • 5 to 6 years of experience in Project Management, Business Planning, or Operations, ideally involving technology-related projects (e.g., tech stack tracking, cloud migration, or digital transformation support).
  • Certifications: PMP, CAPM, or Agile/Scrum certifications are advantageous, alongside practical experience applying structured project management methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience working within Agile, Scrum, or Design Thinking frameworks.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in using AI tools, workflow automation platforms (e.g., Power Automate, RPA), or Generative AI prompts in a business environment.
  • Strong proficiency in data analytics and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to build dashboards and interpret complex operational datasets.
  • Prior exposure to corporate tender, RFQ/RFP processes, or contract administration is preferred.
  • Excellent structured thinking, strong presentation-building skills (PowerPoint storyboarding), and the ability to communicate clearly with mid-to-senior stakeholders.

job.title: Principal Engineer, Cybersecurity GRC
job.description:
Job Description

Job DescriptionAs a Principal Engineer (GRC), you will execute and own day‑to‑day cybersecurity governance, risk and compliance activities across StarHub’s business units. You will ensure our digital assets and projects comply with internal security policies and Singapore telco regulatory obligations (e.g., IMDA, CSA, TCS, BCS, CCoPv2) while uplifting our detection and response capabilities. You will collaborate with internal teams, our MSSP, and external consultants to deliver security reviews, exercises, and remediation on time and to a high standard.

Key Responsibilities

1) Regulatory Compliance & Governance (Execution)Maintain Cybersecurity Management (CSM) documentation and contribute to 5G policy development to align with regulatory obligations and deadlines.Plan and execute—together with appointed consultants and internal stakeholders—the following annual/biennial activities, including drafting and socialising reports and tracking remediation to closure:Bi‑Annual Host Configuration Reviews for CII and CII‑supporting assetsAnnual Table‑Top Exercises (TTX) across major stakeholdersBiennial external audits with auditors and key business unitsMaintain audit‑ready artefacts and ensure submissions meet expected timelines and quality.

2) Security Engineering & OperationsPartner with the MSSP and platform owners to ensure comprehensive 24×7 log ingestion and monitoring coverage; onboard new log sources and use cases.Tune SIEM/SOAR detections and playbooks; develop runbooks to reduce mean time to detect/respond.Track and drive vulnerability remediation for assigned systems; ensure adherence to SLA (e.g., critical within 14 days) and report status to stakeholders.Support incident response (IR): triage, containment coordination, evidence preservation, and post‑incident reviews; facilitate lessons learned and control improvements.Develop or enhance automation (e.g., scripts/dashboards) for evidence collection, risk tracking, and compliance reporting.

3) Risk Management & AssurancePerform risk assessments and threat modelling for new/changed business solutions; define security requirements and validate they are tested before go‑live.Maintain accurate risk register entries for owned domains; ensure risks have clear owners, treatments, and review cadences.Evaluate new security solutions/approaches and contribute to policies, standards, and guidelines.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.5–8 years’ hands‑on experience in cybersecurity engineering and/or GRC within a telco or similarly regulated environment.

Familiarity with Singapore regulatory landscape (IMDA, CSA, CII requirements) and enterprise frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001).

Demonstrated experience in one or more of: identity & access management (RBAC, MFA, PAM), cryptographic controls, vulnerability management, firewall policy reviews, log analysis, packet/stream analysis, SIEM/SOAR tuning, and incident handling.

Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to prepare reports for technical and senior, non‑technical stakeholders.Able to participate in on‑call/after‑hours support during critical cybersecurity incidents.

Preferred Certifications (nice‑to‑have): GCIH, GCFA, CISA, CISSP (or equivalent).

job.title: Senior Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Senior Engineer - Media, AI & Broadband Platforms

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Engineer to design, develop and support digital platforms across Media (OTT/IPTV), AI and Broadband services. The role requires strong software engineering expertise, cloud-native development experience and the ability to build secure, scalable and resilient applications. Working closely with Product, Architecture, Network and Operations teams, you will deliver solutions that improve customer experience, operational efficiency and service reliability.

Key Responsibilities

Software Engineering

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable applications, microservices and RESTful APIs.
  • Develop secure cloud-native solutions using modern engineering practices.
  • Participate in solution design, code reviews and technical governance.
  • Implement automated testing, CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis.

Media Platforms (OTT/IPTV)

  • Develop and support OTT/IPTV applications and backend services.
  • Integrate with CMS, DRM, CDN and subscriber management platforms.
  • Improve video streaming performance and application responsiveness.
  • Support Smart TV, Mobile, Web and Set-Top Box platforms.
  • Monitor platform health and resolve service issues.

AI Engineering

  • Develop AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, AI assistants and automation workflows.
  • Integrate AI services through APIs and orchestration frameworks.
  • Implement AI solutions for customer support, network operations and service assurance.
  • Apply AI security, governance and responsible AI practices.

Broadband & Network Integration

  • Develop applications integrating with broadband platforms and network management systems.
  • Support TR-069/TR-369, CPE management and broadband telemetry.
  • Analyse network data to improve diagnostics, automation and customer experience.
  • Collaborate with network teams to enhance service assurance and operational performance.

Collaboration

  • Work with Product, Architecture, QA and Operations teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical designs.
  • Mentor junior engineers and promote engineering best practices.
  • Participate in Agile delivery, production support and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. A Master's Degree or relevant professional certifications is an advantage.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in software engineering, application development or platform engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Java, Python, Go, Node.js or similar programming languages.
  • Experience designing and developing cloud-native applications, microservices and RESTful APIs.
  • Good knowledge of AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with OTT/IPTV platforms, video streaming, CDN, DRM, CMS or digital media technologies is preferred.
  • Knowledge of AI technologies including LLMs, RAG, AI agents or AI orchestration frameworks is an advantage.
  • Understanding of broadband technologies, networking concepts, TR-069/TR-369 and CPE management is desirable.
  • Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively in Agile teams and mentor junior engineers.

job.title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Engineering
job.description:
Job Description

The EBG CRM/OM Domain Owner holds end-to-end accountability for the strategy, delivery, and sustained health of StarHub’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Order Management (OM) platforms. This includes stewardship of Salesforce CRM, CloudSense CPQ/Order Management, and other bespoke CRM/OM solutions, as well as responsibility for evolving StarHub’s broader CRM/OM landscape.

This role ensures that CRM/OM capabilities enable and empower sales and service channels for SME, Enterprise, Wholesale, and International segments. Acting as both a technology steward and business partner, the role balances operational reliability with innovation, ensuring seamless customer and employee experiences. This position is pivotal in driving automation, platform stability, compliance, and business continuity, while shaping the long-term CRM/OM roadmap to align with enterprise priorities and evolving market needs.

Key Responsibilities

Domain Ownership and Platform Stewardship

  • Own the performance scalability and sustainability of CRMOM systems including Salesforce CloudSense and bespoke solutions
  • Ensure platform reliability compliance and system stability while driving continuous improvements in UX data integrity and integrated workflows
  • Establish monitor and report against key operational KPIs availability performance adoption fulfilment outcomes
  • Lead automation DevSecOps and process optimization initiatives to streamline sales and service workflows

Strategic Stewardship and Leadership

  • Provide longterm leadership and oversight of the domains people systems and outcomes ensuring alignment with organizational strategy
  • Establish and maintain the right leadership structure within the domain to drive accountability ownership and performance
  • Define and manage prioritization of initiatives to ensure the most impactful work is delivered in line with business objectives
  • Take ownership for delivering measurable results across people process and technology dimensions of the domain

Strategic Planning and Roadmap

  • Define and deliver the multiyear CRMOM technology roadmap ensuring alignment with StarHubs enterprise strategy
  • Evaluate prioritize and secure investments that maximize business impact and competitive advantage
  • Drive the endtoend fulfilment journey enablement from order capture through provisioning and support
  • Anticipate emerging needs ensuring the CRMOM domain evolves cohesively with adjacent enterprise systems

Operational Excellence and DevOps Execution

  • Oversee daytoday domain operations to ensure services meet or exceed agreed servicelevel objectives SLOs
  • Run the domain in a DevOps model including oncall schedules incident management monitoring and proactive issue resolution
  • Manage development capacity across competing demandsfeature enhancements technical debt remediation regulatory compliance security obligations operational fixes and audit requirements
  • Champion a culture of accountability postmortems and continuous improvement to enhance resilience and operational maturity

CrossDomain Collaboration and CrossFunctional Leadership

  • Partner closely with other domain owners to ensure interoperability reduce duplication and enable seamless enterprise workflows
  • Proactively manage dependencies across domains eg Billing ERP Digital Channels Data to ensure integrated solutions
  • Collaborate with related leadership roles across the organization clarifying mandates and ensuring seamless alignment of responsibilities
  • Champion knowledge sharing organizational alignment and crossfunctional success

Team and Resource Management

  • Build lead and mentor CRMOMaligned teams ensuring succession coverage for critical roles
  • Develop and implement sourcing and capability strategies including vendor management and internally owned operations
  • Oversee domain budget capacity planning and effective allocation of people and resources to balance delivery and sustainability
  • Foster a healthy highperforming team culture grounded in accountability transparency and continuous learning

Stakeholder Engagement and Senior Management Communication

  • Serve as the senior liaison for CRMOM initiatives across EBG SME Wholesale and International business units
  • Engage with executive stakeholders providing clear and timely communication of roadmaps risks progress and achievements
  • Build consensus on longterm CRMOM platform evolution balancing business demands with technical sustainability
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior management shaping strategic decisionmaking on customer platforms and fulfilment processes

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in CRM/OM platforms, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated ownership of mission-critical domains with responsibility for budgets, teams, and long-term strategy.
  • Deep knowledge of CRM and OM platforms, including Salesforce CRM and CloudSense CPQ/Order Management.
  • Proven experience supporting sales and service workflows across SME, Enterprise, and Wholesale customer segments.
  • Strong understanding of CRM UX optimization, workflow integration, and end-to-end fulfilment processes.
  • Familiarity with enterprise IT ecosystems (e.g., SAP, billing, middleware, DevSecOps practices).
  • Experience running teams in a DevOps operating model, including on-call support, incident management, and continuous delivery.
  • Strong knowledge of balancing development capacity across feature delivery, tech debt, compliance, and operational demands.
  • Proven ability to define and execute domain strategies aligned to enterprise business goals.
  • Strong financial and resource management skills, with track record of managing vendor and internal teams.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership.
  • Collaborative leader skilled at cross-domain coordination, consensus-building, and organizational change leadership.
  • Resilient, forward-looking leader with ability to balance delivery velocity and technical sustainability.

job.title: AI Transformation Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Role Overview

As a AI Transformation Engineer, you will help translate AI and automation ideas into working solutions that improve how StarHub's network and operations teams run day to day. You will work alongside senior engineers to build, test, and deploy practical AI use cases — from automating manual workflows to surfacing insights from network and operational data.

This is a hands-on, learning-focused role for an early-career engineer. You will get broad exposure across the technology transformation — data pipelines, machine learning, LLM-based tooling, and process automation — while building the judgement to deliver solutions that are reliable, compliant, and genuinely useful.

Key Responsibilities

1. Building & Delivering AI Solutions

  • Support the design, development, and testing of AI and automation use cases under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and scripts that prepare, clean, and transform network and operational data for AI models.
  • Develop and refine prompts, retrieval (RAG) workflows, and lightweight integrations for LLM-based internal tools.

2. Automation & Process Improvement

  • Identify repetitive manual tasks across engineering and operations that are good candidates for automation.
  • Implement workflow automations and monitor them in production, escalating issues and iterating on improvements.

3. Data, Testing & Documentation

  • Run experiments, evaluate model outputs, and help measure accuracy, latency, and reliability against clear success criteria.
  • Document solutions, data sources, and design decisions so work is reproducible and auditable.

4. Collaboration & Compliance

  • Work closely with data, network, and platform engineers, and take part in code reviews and knowledge-sharing.
  • Follow PDPA and internal data-governance practices when handling customer and network data.

Qualifications

  • Degree (or final-year / recent graduate) in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 0–2 years; internships, academic projects, or personal projects in AI, data, or automation are welcomed.
  • Working knowledge of Python, ML and AI; basic understanding of how LLMs and SLMs are used in applications.
  • Exposure to telecom or network data, cloud platforms, or LLM tooling (e.g. RAG, prompting) through study or projects.
  • Foundational familiarity in: Python/AI Agents/Git/Version Control/Rest APIs/ML Fundamentals/LLMs/SLMs/Prompting/RAG Basics/Pandas/NumPy/Data pipelines/Cloud Basics/Automation Scripting/Data Visualization

job.title: Data Centre Critical Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

The primary responsibility for this role is to:

•Perform day to day operation and maintenance of all the various facilities systems at StarHub Data Centres and Offices, such as Generators, Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS), DC Rectifier System, Static Transfer Switch (STS), Fire Protection System, Building Management System, HT/LT electrical system, all ACMV systems, etc.

•Ensure the routine maintenance of the facilities systems are carried out according to planned schedule and contracted scope of work

•Plan, call and evaluate tenders, and project-manage any expansion projects to cater for users’ requirements

•Ensure strict security system is enforced at the StarHub Data Centres and Offices by managing the physical and electronic security systems eg card access, CCTV surveillance, Visitors Tracking.

•Carry out customer related work orders within the customer’s requested Ready for Service (RFS) Date

•Maintain records and update all M&E, building & schematic drawings of the facilities in and security of the estates under our care

•Conduct regular checks of the premises for potential safety hazards and unsafe conditions, initiate corrective measures to maintain a safe and healthy work environment, in compliance with prevailing legislative and regulatory requirements

•Manage new leases and timely renewal of existing ones, covering offices, shops and technical sites:

o Negotiate with building owners, manage LOIs and agreements, follow-up with all related administration matters

o Conduct regular meetings with respective business units

o Monitor current industry rental rates

o Liaise with relevant authorities to ensure the leases comply with authorities’ requirements, if any

o Liaise with internal business units eg Legal, Finance, Business Units, for any changes of lease terms, rental and service fees, property tax, etc

o Liaise with external tenants in StarHub’s owned-premises, including the generation of billing invoices to tenants

o Ensure timely handover/ takeover of premises to/from building owners

•Carry out risk assessments and management

•Perform 24 x 7 standby duties, respond to and rectify all situations

•Carry out any other assignments from the management

Qualifications

  • Job Requirement

•Appropriate qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Telecommunications or Facilities Management with at least 2 yrs of work experience in facilities area, in particular Data Centre environment.

•Candidates with 2 to 3 years of working experience in supporting facilities operations & maintenance in Data Centre environment are preferred.

•Fresh Diploma graduates with positive attitude and willingness to work in a start-up environment are welcome to apply

•Good understanding and hands-on servicing experience in all facilities systems and building maintenance

•Possesses Class 3 Driving Lesson (Manual Gear)

•Basic networking, broadband access and structure cabling is a plus;

•Computer literate with knowledge of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, AutoCAD Able to manage and supervise contractors;

•Hands on experience in provisioning and configuration of network elements switches, CPE and services will be added advantage;

•Self motivated with strong drive and the willingness to take on challenges

•Good written and oral communications skills, with ability to interact will people of all levels, especially with end customers;

•Good working attitude with minimum supervision and ability to perform under pressure

•Possess initiative and professionalism with the ability to multi task.

•Service oriented manner is essential. Must be a team player coupled with strong communication and problem solving skills and shall demonstrate the ability to work independently

job.title: Salesforce/CloudSense Lead

job.title: Service Delivery Manager

Constantly review and ensure that current methodology conforms and meets industry standards.

job.title: Senior Systems Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:The mission of the Senior Systems Analyst is to support the design of scalable and effective systems that meet business needs and technical requirements. The role focuses on translating business requirements into clear solution specifications, supporting end-to-end solution design, and ensuring proposed solutions are feasible, well-integrated, and aligned to business objectives. The role also contributes to business growth and stronger solution outcomes through sound analysis, collaboration, and delivery discipline.

Accountabilities

  • Support the delivery of fit-for-purpose end-to-end solution designs aligned to business and technical objectives.
  • Translate business requirements into clear solution specifications and design inputs.
  • Ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible and integrated across relevant systems and platforms.
  • Provide technical and functional advice to stakeholders on solution options, design impacts, and implementation considerations.
  • Contribute to partner engagements, new business initiatives, and RFP/RFT submissions as needed.
  • Apply digital and customer-centric thinking, including user journey analysis and human-centric design principles, in solution assessment.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the end-to-end solution design process, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical requirements.
  • Liaise with business users and stakeholders to gather, clarify, and document requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate requirements into effective system designs.
  • Support analysis of solution feasibility, application design, integration points, and downstream impacts.
  • Understand business models and drivers and translate them into platform configuration or specifications for enhancements or new implementations.
  • Work with partners and internal stakeholders to support technical strategies that improve business effectiveness and service offerings.

job.title: Principal Systems Analyst

Job Description

  • Collaborate with business, architecture, delivery, operations, and partner teams to shape solution strategies and implementation approaches.

job.title: Middleware Architect
job.description:
Role Mission:

This role exists to define, standardize, and evolve the enterprise middleware and integration architecture to support growing digital, partner, and internal platform demands. As systems scale in volume and complexity, the organization requires a cohesive architecture that ensures reliability, security, and reuse across services and integrations. The role provides technical leadership to align business requirements with cloud-native, API-driven solutions while reducing operational risk and complexity.

Accountabilities:

  • Enterprise middleware and integration architecture strategy.
  • API and microservices architecture governance.
  • Platform scalability, resilience, and non-functional standards.
  • Security, compliance, and architectural best practices.
  • Technical leadership and cross-team alignment.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and maintain reference architectures, design standards, and patterns for middleware, APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Architect cloud-native, containerized services and integration solutions that are scalable, secure, and highly available.
  • Govern API lifecycle management, including design guidelines, versioning strategies, traffic management, and consumption models.
  • Collaborate with DevOps, security, and operations teams to ensure observability, automation, and platform readiness for production workloads.
  • Provide architectural guidance, conduct design reviews, and mentor engineering teams while engaging stakeholders and vendors as required.

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • Engineering & Platform Teams

Works closely with middleware, integration, and application development teams to define architecture standards, review designs, and guide implementation of cloud-native and API-based solutions.

  • DevOps & Operations

Partners with DevOps, SRE, and operations teams to ensure platforms meet non-functional requirements such as availability, performance, scalability, observability, and disaster recovery.

  • Security & Risk Management

Collaborates with security, risk, and compliance teams to embed security-by-design principles, ensure secure integrations, and meet enterprise governance and audit requirements.

  • Business & Product Stakeholders

Engages with business, product owners, and delivery leads to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and align architecture with strategic priorities.

  • Enterprise Architecture & Governance

Aligns with enterprise architecture, architecture review boards, and governance forums to ensure consistency with enterprise standards, roadmaps, and technology direction.

  • External Partners & Vendors

Coordinates with external vendors, system integrators, and partners for solution alignment, technical evaluations, and integration readiness.

Minimum Profile/ Track Record:

  • 8–12+ years of overall IT experience with a proven track record in middleware, integration, or platform engineering roles.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, cloud-native architectures supporting high-volume, mission-critical systems.
  • Proven ability to define and govern API-led and microservices architectures, including lifecycle management, security, and non-functional requirements.
  • Hands-on background in modern backend development with at least one widely adopted programming language and experience guiding multiple teams.
  • Track record of leading architecture decisions, conducting design reviews, and influencing technical direction across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience operating in complex, regulated, or large-scale enterprise environments, balancing delivery speed with stability, security, and governance.

job.title: Lead, Cyber Engineering
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission

Reporting to the Manager, Cyber Engineering, this role is central to ensuring the organization’s adherence to regulatory and internal policies, managing cyber risk, and maintaining a robust governance framework. The ideal candidate brings proven first-line GRC operations experience across critical telecom and enterprise environments, a track record of translating complex threats into business-impact language, and the ability to lead full-cycle audit delivery with minimal supervision.

Accountabilities

As a 1.5LoD Cyber Risk Specialist, you will be the dedicated technical partner for Business Unit Heads (Risk Owners) and Technical Leads (Control Owners). Your responsibility is to understand and identify cyber threats impacting the business, manage the system development lifecycle of security controls, and ensure full compliance with StarHub policies and Singapore’s regulatory frameworks (IMDA TCS/BCS, CSA CCoP 2.0). You will also provide specialist guidance on AI/LLM security risks as the organization expands its use of generative AI technologies.

Short Description

Responsibilities

Risk & Control Ownership Support

  • Advisory to Risk Owners: Assist Business Unit Heads in overseeing the security posture of critical assets. Translate technical vulnerabilities (CVSS, pen-test findings) into Business Impact narratives that enable informed risk acceptance and capex sign-off.
  • Control Lifecycle Management: Act on behalf of Control Owners to design, implement, and document technologies and safeguards (Directive, Deterrent, Preventive, Detective, Corrective, Compensating) required to mitigate identified risks.
  • Execution Oversight: Coordinate with Control Performers (Support Teams) to ensure daily security activities are executed according to defined standards and documented SOPs.
  • Documentation: Maintain formalized standard operating procedures, runbooks, and plans aligned with StarHub’s Information Security policies, ISO/IEC 27001/20000/22301, and national/sectoral requirements.

Operational Cyber Risk Management

  • Threat Modelling: Lead threat modelling sessions (jointly with your Manager) during the design phase of new systems, AI deployments, and infrastructure changes to identify attack vectors, abuse cases, and control gaps before production go-live; maintain reusable threat libraries mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Risk Assessments: Execute cyber risk assessments on gaps surfaced through policy deviations, vulnerability scans (Tenable Nessus), penetration tests, security events, external threat intelligence, and audit findings across IT, OT, 5G, and ISP environments.
  • Remediation Strategy: Propose risk mitigation and treatment strategies using the full safeguard taxonomy. Ensure remediation plans are technically sound, operationally viable, and aligned to StarHub’s Information Security policies and Singapore regulatory obligations (IMDA TCS/BCS, CSA CCoP 2.0, Cybersecurity Act, PDPA).
  • Transparency: Provide Risk Owners with operational impact assessments, ensuring service disruption implications are clearly understood before residual risk is accepted.
  • Continuous Monitoring: Track and report on remediation plan status, ensuring closure within agreed timelines; maintain a consolidated cyber risk inventory with credible impact ratings, justifications, treatment plans, and named accountable parties.

Compliance (Audit & Assessment) Management

  • Collaborate with the Information Security Office (ISO) to facilitate end-to-end audit and assessment processes, including CII audits, CSA Cyber Trust Mark reviews, StarHub control self-assessments, and ad-hoc assessments. Lead milestone stewardship with zero missed deliverables.
  • Support the selection and appointment of auditors, providing consultation on scope, fees, and operational feasibility.
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive audit plan covering scope, resource allocation, and budgeting to verify that StarHub’s systems, infrastructure, and operations are resilient and fully compliant with all internal policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Take responsibility for the collection and verification of technical evidence (logs, screenshots, configurations). Ensure all artefacts accurately reflect the current state of critical assets and meet ISO standards before submission; conduct pre-submission rehearsal reviews to head off avoidable findings.
  • Collaborate with Risk and Control Owners to develop technically sound and operationally viable remediation plans for draft audit findings, including management action plans with justified timelines.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field (Masters preferred).
  • 6-8 years; experience in cybersecurity and GRC, with exposure to the Telecommunications sector and an understanding of service risk, SLAs, network environments, and the balance between service availability and cyber resilience.
  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA); certified or actively pursuing; or equivalent (CISSP, SSCP, or ISC2 certification).
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience supporting ISO 27001, ISO 20000, and/or ISO 22301 compliance cycles including evidence curation, control walkthroughs, and finding closure.

Good to Have

  • Solid knowledge of compliance frameworks and regulatory requirements: NIST CSF/SP 800-53, ISO 27001, CSA CCoP 2.0, Singapore Cybersecurity Act, PDPA, PCI DSS, and IMDA Code of Practice for Broadcasting & Telecommunications.
  • Host configuration review and hardening experience to CIS Level 1/2 benchmarks (Windows/Linux/network).
  • Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and operational technology (OT) or critical information infrastructure (CII), and trade-offs between public and private cloud environments.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Tenable Nessus or equivalent vulnerability management tooling; familiarity with SIEM/SOAR platforms (Sentinel, Chronicle, Splunk, QRadar) and EDR tools (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Carbon Black).
  • AI/LLM Security Governance: Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, and MITRE ATLAS; experience assessing generative AI solutions for risk, data-privacy exposure, and adversarial threats (prompt injection, data poisoning, model inversion).
  • Scripting or automation capability (Python, KQL, PowerShell) applied to GRC workflows, evidence capture, or risk reporting.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

The senior data scientist is responsible to work with massive amounts of data to develop ML/GenAI models with Telco and other sets of data to help enterprises realise key business value through the use of Telco Insights. The senior data scientist will work closely with key internal and external stakeholders to develop new Al products or new application areas for Al.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Architect scalable Agentic AI systems using multi-agent architectures that can autonomously plan, decide, and execute tasks, integrating with enterprise data, APIs, and business workflows to support internal and external
  • Design and develop next generation of scalable Telco Big Data Analytics Models to support commercial projects across various business verticals.

Constantly review and ensure that current methodology conforms and meets industry standards.
  • Propose and develop new analytics models and innovative techniques and algorithms to enhance SmartHub capabilities and value proposition of Telco Big Data.
  • Independently develop solutions that adopt and leverage on latest AI/ML models including GenAI and agentic solutions to deliver exceptional value to internal/external stakeholders.

  • Experience with GenAI/Agentic AI solutions development and deployment
  • Experience with Business Intelligence Visualization (e.g. Tableau, AWS QuickSight)
  • Experience in presentation to stakeholders to articulate business values for analytical/data science projects
  • Experience in the following Big Data technologies: PySpark, Kafka
