job.title: Manager, Business Performance
job.description:
Job Description

The Business Performance Manager drives impact by combining data, process improvement, and performance insights to help the company scale sustainably. By bringing together sales, delivery, financial, and people metrics into a clear, actionable story, the role gives leaders visibility into how growth, execution, and capacity connect to business goals. With insights tied to accountability, the role ensures decisions translate into results.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Growth Performance

  • Track sales pipeline health, conversion rates, win/loss trends, and revenue realization by Service Line.
  • Monitor sales productivity (e.g., revenue per head, quota attainment) for affordability assessment.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to highlight risks to targets and opportunities for growth by Service Line.

Delivery & Operational Performance

  • Define and track delivery KPIs (e.g., utilization, backlog, SLA adherence, project profitability etc) by Service Line.
  • Monitor order-to-cash SLA by Service Line and fulfilment accuracy, escalating bottlenecks and operational inefficiencies.
  • Ensure operational execution is aligned with financial and customer commitments.

Financial Performance

  • Integrate financial KPIs (e.g., revenue, GM, EBITDA) with operational and sales metrics.
  • Provide variance analysis and root-cause insights behind financial performance.
  • Partner with Finance to align forecasts with operational capacity and pipeline reality.

People & Capacity Performance

  • Track headcount, attrition, productivity for affordability analysis.
  • Highlight alignment (or gaps) between workforce capacity and business demand.

Process and Performance Improvement

  • Identify and recommend high-impact opportunities for comprehensive process and performance improvements, driving initiatives for expense reduction, revenue enhancement, and efficiency maximization.

Governance & Insights

  • Develop dashboards and performance scorecards integrating all four dimensions.
  • Establish a regular performance review cadence across functions.
  • Ensure KPI owners are accountable for outcomes, and actions are tracked to closure.
  • Provide leadership with forward-looking insights, not just historical reporting.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or related field
  • At least 6 years’ experience in business performance, FP&A, sales operations, or strategy/ops roles.
  • Strong exposure to commercial, operational, financial, and HR data. Telecommunications and ICT products knowledge is a plus.
  • Proficiency with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) and source systems (CRM, SAP, Workday etc).
  • Advanced analytical skills with expertise in data visualization tools and financial modelling.
  • Experience influencing cross-functional leadership and driving performance outcomes.
  • Knowledge on ITIL, Six Sigma or Agile Methodology is a plus.

job.title: Associate Network Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

This role will be based at client site. Associate Network Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining mission-critical Wireless network infrastructure. The role involves troubleshooting, maintenance, incident response, preventive maintenance, implementation activities, vendor coordination, and support for large-scale wireless environments operating in a 24/7 environment.

Job Responsibilities

•Support day-to-day operations of wireless infrastructure including Cisco Wireless solutions, Aruba solutions, switches, firewalls, captive portals, and authentication systems.

•Perform troubleshooting for Wireless connectivity issues, DNS, DHCP, captive portal access, OTP login issues, VLAN routing, authentication failures, and internet access problems.

•Manage service technical escalations and support major incident troubleshooting during service disruptions.

•Support preventive maintenance, firmware upgrades, patching, and technology refresh activities for wireless and network infrastructure.

•Support WLC upgrade activities including Access Point image updates, failover testing, rollback planning, and validation activities.

•Work closely with vendor TAC such as Cisco TAC and Aruba TAC for issue analysis and problem resolution.

•Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and prepare incident reports, technical findings, and preventive recommendations.

•Support implementation activities including Access Point deployment, switch replacement, firewall migration, SSL certificate updates, and network migrations.

•Coordinate with stakeholders, vendors, contractors, and facility management teams during maintenance and implementation activities.

•Support testing activities such as congestion testing, failover testing, WiFi roaming optimization, and POE/network validation.

•Monitor infrastructure health using tools such as Catalyst Center, AirWave, SevOne, LogicMonitor, NetAlly.

•Fluent in ITSM Incident, Change Management, Service Request platforms such as ServiceNow.

•Maintain technical documentation including install plans, diagrams, inventory records, validation evidence, and maintenance reports.

•Support after-office-hour maintenance windows, standby support, and emergency troubleshooting activities.

•Ensure compliance with operational governance, safety requirements, and change management procedures.

Qualifications

Diploma, Higher NITEC, or equivalent qualification in IT or related discipline.

Basic knowledge of networking, WiFi, internet connectivity, and endpoint devices.

Experience in Service Desk, Helpdesk, NOC, or customer support environments preferred.

Good communication, coordination, and customer service skills.

Familiarity with ServiceNow or ITSM ticketing systems is advantageous.

Work Arrangement

Onsite support role

May require standby support, shift work, and after-office-hour maintenance activities depending on operational requirements.

job.title: Senior Matrixx SME DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Design and Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and resilient microservices using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks. Hands-on experience with Apache Camel and its core Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIPs). Implement RESTful APIs and ensure services meet performance, security, and stability requirements. Write clean, well-tested, and efficient code following best practices and design patterns. Containerization and Deployment: Develop and manage services deployed on OpenShift/Kubernetes, including defining Dockerfiles and Kubernetes resource configurations (Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, etc.). Work with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) for automated build, test, and deployment. Monitor and troubleshoot services running in the OpenShift environment. Architecture and Data: Contribute to the architectural design of microservices, focusing on principles like loose coupling, high cohesion, and fault tolerance. Implement various data persistence technologies, including relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis). Integrate services using messaging systems (e.g., Red Hat AMQ) where required. Collaboration and Quality: Perform code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge within the team. Ensure compliance with security standards and industry regulations by performing security vulnerability scans (SAST, DAST, SCA) and disaster recovery exercise. Support on-call duty on shift rotation and handle production incident and root cause analysis with minimal supervision. Knowledge Management: Build technical documentation from scratch, maintaining working documents on architecture overviews, API specifications and system integrations. Create and maintain operational runbooks to support the team and internal stakeholders.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. • Java Expertise: Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in developing enterprise applications using Java and the Spring Boot framework. • Microservices and API: Strong understanding of microservices architecture, principles, and best practices. Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs. • Containerization: Proficient with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift for deployment and orchestration. Experience with OpenShift-specific features is a significant advantage. • Database: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases. • Tools: Familiarity with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD tools. • Combined experience in DevOps, SRE, or Software Engineering. • Familiar with containerized environments, Kubernetes internals, and Helm. • Hands-on production experience with Jenkins and CI/CD best practices. • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript). • Solid understanding of AWS core services, IAM security, and cost-optimization practices. • Comfortable with Linux internals, networking fundamentals, and shell scripting. • Agile mindset with experience working in Scrum teams. • Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.

job.title: Sales Advisor
job.description:
Job Description

The Sales Associate/Brand Associate is responsible for achieving sales, delivering service and operations excellence. He/she also engages in innovation and productivity initiatives for the store. In order to drive seamless customer experience across channels, he handles order fulfilment processes for customers in store.

He operates in a fast-paced, diverse and customer-centric store environment. As the first point-of-contact in store, he serves as the ambassador of the organisation.

He is a highly motivated and service-oriented individual. He communicates well and thrives in a team environment.

Qualifications

  • GCE ‘A’ / ‘O’ / 'N' level with minimum 1 year related working experience
  • IT savvy, to navigate sales & service systems
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
  • Able to work retail shift hours including weekends and public holidays
  • Able to commit to a 5-day workweek based on roster

job.title: Senior Engineer, Cyber GRC
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:The role ofCyber GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance)is to ensure that an organization's cybersecurity strategy aligns with its business goals, manages policies/standards/frameworks, manages cyber risks effectively, provides oversight and independent 2nd line control review/testing, and adheres to external regulations.

Accountabilities

  • Drive and lead the end-to-end lifecycle of information security governance & policy management.
  • Drive and lead the cyber risk management and reporting.
  • Drive and lead the 2nd line assurance & compliance monitoring.
  • Drive 2nd line oversight and support for audit engagement with 1st line stakeholders.
  • Drive security culture, advisory & stakeholder engagement

Responsibilities

  • Manage the development of Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies for adoption
  • Manage the Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies compliance risk
  • Manage the cyber risk oversight by evaluating the adequacy and effectiveness of risk management practices and controls implemented by 1st line (i.e. risk owner, control owner, control supervisor, control performers) of Starhub to ensure proper adherence to risk assessment processes.
  • Manage the Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies security/risk deviation process
  • Manage the Starhub risk profile and maintain the Starhub risk register for IT Security / Cybersecurity risks relating to CII & Non-CII
  • Develop and drive regular monitoring and reporting of Starhub key risk indicators for Cybersecurity
  • Manage regular risk reporting and risk escalation to Senior Management or other relevant risk forums
  • Manage Control & Compliance Framework through timely updates of industry standards and regulatory compliance requirements
  • Perform 2nd line assurance review (e.g. control review/testing) on 1st line stakeholders to ensure adherence with Starhub policies and Sub-policies / Regulatory compliance requirements, provide actionable, recommendations, and engage stakeholders for implementation
  • Provide timely communication / awareness to stakeholders on Starhub policies and sub-policies for implementation
  • Provide advisory to stakeholders on Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies requirement
  • Conduct briefings and trainings on Cyber risk / Policy awareness (i.e. Cyber risk management process, Policy compliance, Emerging cyber risk/trend, Issues and Observations from 2nd line control review/testing, and audit related findings) to relevant stakeholders and to support the Starhub Cybersecurity Awareness Programme.
  • Provide 2nd Line oversight and support throughout the audit engagement with 1st line stakeholders: ensuring readiness before the audit begins, facilitating fieldwork execution, and monitoring remediation of findings post-audit.
  • Maintaining a tracker for audit findings (or audit issues registers) to monitor remediation progress, to ensure audit closure issues, to support the scoping for 2nd line assurance review.

Qualifications

1.More than 3 years of experience in information/cybersecurity and risk management Experience in leading cybersecurity risk assessment and risk reduction initiatives

2.Experience in IT/IT-Security policy development and implementation

3.Experience in driving IT-security thematic assessment and IT audits

4.Good knowledge and experience with handling IT-security and cybersecurity audits

5.Good knowledge of experience in driving compliance to meet cybersecurity regulatory requirements

6.Good problem analysis and resolution skills

7.Good and experience stakeholder management skills

job.title: Business Analyst, FRCS
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission

Support the delivery and optimisation of StarHub’s Finance, Risk & Compliance Systems (FRCS) by providing business analysis and delivery support for both StarHub core operations and acquired entities (e.g. MRBB).

This role focuses on supporting acquired entities during integration and steady-state operations, while also managing day-to-day partnering with StarHub Finance and FRCS teams to ensure requirements, processes, and system changes are clearly understood and documented.

Accountabilities

  • Support business analysis activities for FRCS initiatives covering both StarHub and acquired entities (e.g. MRBB).
  • Act as a day-to-day analysis support contact for acquired entities, helping them articulate finance, risk, and compliance needs in alignment with StarHub standards.
  • Assist in documenting business and functional requirements for BAU, post-acquisition, and stabilisation activities.
  • Support process understanding and alignment between acquired entities and StarHub FRCS processes.
  • Enable effective communication and partnering between acquired entities, StarHub Finance teams, IS delivery teams, and vendors through clear documentation.

Responsibilities

  • Support acquired entities (e.g. MRBB) by gathering and documenting requirements, issues, and process gaps related to FRCS systems.
  • Assist in documenting current-state processes for acquired entities and comparing them against StarHub target processes, under guidance from Functional Leads.
  • Support StarHub Finance and FRCS teams by documenting change requests, enhancements, and BAU requirements.
  • Translate inputs from Finance users and Functional Leads into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for both StarHub and acquired entities, including test preparation, coordination, and defect tracking.
  • Assist with documenting process and system impacts for acquired entities during post-acquisition changes.
  • Work closely with IS delivery teams and vendors to clarify documented requirements and support issue resolution.
  • Maintain analysis artefacts and documentation in line with FRCS governance standards.

Areas of Impact

  • Smooth day-to-day FRCS support for acquired entities through clearer requirements and process understanding.
  • Improved alignment between acquired entities’ finance processes and StarHub FRCS standards.
  • Reduced misunderstandings and rework during post-acquisition system changes.
  • Effective partnering support for StarHub Finance teams through timely and accurate analysis.
  • Improved readiness of users across StarHub and acquired entities for FRCS system changes.

Ideal Track Record

  • 8–12 years of experience in People Systems functional roles.
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into system-enabled process design.
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms (e.g. SAP SuccessFactors) from a functional / business perspective.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with various departments and vendors in complex organisations.
  • Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments preferred

job.title: Head, IAM
job.description:
##

Role Mission

Drive the implementation, optimisation, and adoption of identity and access management (IAM) capabilities across StarHub, ensuring secure, compliant, and seamless user access to enterprise platforms, with an initial focus on Google Workspace (GWS) enablement and identity uplift. This role owns the identity product lifecycle, including licensing, configuration, process optimisation, and user experience, while ensuring alignment with security, compliance, and business needs.

Accountabilities Own the Identity product roadmap covering IAM, SSO, and DLP capabilities. Drive successful implementation and adoption of identity services, with GWS as a priority platform. Optimise licensing, access models, and identity-related processes to improve efficiency and control. Ensure identity solutions meet security, compliance, and governance requirements. Partner with Security, IS, and business stakeholders to uplift identity maturity across the organisation.

Responsibilities Lead product ownership for IAM, SSO, and DLP solutions, from requirements through delivery and optimisation. Drive GWS identity integration, including user lifecycle management, access controls, and SSO enablement. Define and manage identity-related licensing models, ensuring cost efficiency and correct entitlement usage. Optimise joiner–mover–leaver (JML) and access provisioning processes through automation and standardisation. Partner with Cybersecurity and Risk teams to embed security, privacy, and compliance controls into identity design. Collaborate with IS delivery teams, vendors, and integrators to ensure quality and timely implementation. Establish identity governance, including access standards, role models, and approval workflows. Monitor product performance, adoption, and risk indicators to drive continuous improvement. Provide clear product guidance and prioritisation to stakeholders and delivery teams.

Areas of Impact Enterprise identity security and access control effectiveness. Successful GWS rollout enabled by robust identity foundations. Reduced access risk through standardised IAM and SSO processes. Improved user experience through seamless and secure access. Cost optimisation and transparency of identity-related licensing

Ideal Track Record 8–12 years of experience in identity management, security platforms, or enterprise product management. Proven experience delivering IAM, SSO, or access-related platforms in large organisations. Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, access governance, and security controls. Experience supporting collaboration platforms (e.g. GWS, M365) from an identity perspective preferred. Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with Security, IS, and business teams.

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

We are seeking an IT Logistics & Network Support Engineer to support IT and network warehouse operations, asset management, equipment staging, deployment, dispatch, collection, RMA coordination, and Level 1 network support.

The role combines hands-on logistics and inventory responsibilities with basic network troubleshooting and deployment support across enterprise networking and security equipment. The successful candidate will ensure IT assets are accurately tracked, properly prepared for deployment, and supported throughout their lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

1. IT Logistics & Asset Management

  • Receive, inspect, asset-tag, label, store, issue, dispatch, and track network hardware and IT accessories.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records covering:
  • Equipment models and serial numbers
  • Asset tags
  • Warranty and support status
  • Site/location
  • Stock movement
  • Project assignment
  • Manage spare units, replacement devices, SFPs, cables, modules, power supplies, and other network accessories.
  • Coordinate equipment delivery, collection, and movement between warehouses, offices, vendors, and customer sites.
  • Prepare equipment for deployment, including packing, labeling, staging, documentation, and handover records.
  • Maintain delivery notes, collection forms, stock reports, inventory trackers, and audit-ready warehouse documentation.

2. RMA & Vendor Coordination

  • Coordinate faulty equipment replacement, RMA processes, warranty claims, repairs, and return-to-vendor activities.
  • Track RMA status and follow up with vendors, suppliers, and relevant internal teams.
  • Maintain records of faulty units, replacement equipment, repair status, and returned assets.
  • Ensure replacement equipment is properly received, recorded, tagged, and assigned.

3. Level 1 Network Support

  • Perform basic checks for:
  • Power and hardware status
  • Cabling and physical connectivity
  • LED indicators
  • Link and port status
  • SFP/module status
  • Interface connectivity
  • Assist with device staging, rack-and-stack activities, patching, labeling, hardware replacement, and site deployment.
  • Provide basic troubleshooting support for LAN, WAN, WLAN, firewall, and general connectivity incidents or service requests.
  • Perform basic network diagnostic activities, including ping, traceroute, cable checks, link verification, and post-replacement connectivity testing.
  • Collect and document relevant technical information such as hostnames, IP addresses, serial numbers, device models, firmware versions, interface status, screenshots, and basic logs.
  • Escalate complex routing, switching, firewall, wireless, security, or configuration issues to Level 2/Level 3 engineers with clear diagnostic information.

4. Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate network and asset documentation.
  • Update port maps, rack layouts, deployment trackers, inventory records, and equipment movement records.
  • Prepare regular stock, asset, deployment, and RMA reports.
  • Ensure all warehouse and IT asset records remain accurate, complete, and audit-ready.
  • Maintain clear handover documentation for equipment issued to engineers, projects, vendors, and customer sites.

Qualifications

  • Experience in IT logistics, warehouse operations, inventory control, IT asset management, or network equipment handling.
  • Ability to identify and handle enterprise network and infrastructure equipment, including:
  • Switches
  • Routers
  • Firewalls
  • Wireless access points
  • SFPs and transceiver modules
  • Network modules
  • Ethernet/fiber cables
  • Power supplies
  • Rack and patching components
  • Basic knowledge of LAN, WAN, WLAN, IP addressing, VLANs, network cabling, rack layouts, and first-level connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Basic understanding of physical network connectivity, port/link status, SFP status, power indicators, and equipment health checks.
  • Strong coordination skills with vendors, couriers, suppliers, field engineers, project managers, network engineers, and technical teams.
  • Good documentation and record-keeping skills using spreadsheets, ticketing systems, inventory management tools, asset trackers, deployment trackers, and equipment handover records.
  • Able to maintain accurate records of equipment models, serial numbers, asset tags, locations, stock movements, project assignments, warranty status, and RMA status.
  • Willing to support site rollouts, hardware refreshes, equipment replacements, maintenance windows, and deployment activities when required.
  • Comfortable performing hands-on activities such as equipment staging, packing, labeling, rack-and-stack, patching, hardware replacement, dispatch, collection, and site support.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate inventory and audit-ready documentation.
  • Good communication, coordination, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Minimum Higher NITEC, NITEC, Diploma, or equivalent qualification in:
  • Information Technology
  • Networking
  • Electronics
  • Telecommunications
  • Logistics
  • Supply Chain
  • Warehouse Management
  • Or a related discipline
  • Relevant hands-on experience in IT logistics, network equipment handling, infrastructure deployment, or Level 1 network support may be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.
  • The following certifications are preferred but not mandatory:
  • Cisco CCNA
  • CompTIA Network+
  • ITIL Foundation
  • Huawei HCIA
  • Aruba entry-level certification
  • Palo Alto PCNSA
  • Fortinet entry-level certification
  • Equivalent networking, infrastructure, or IT service management certifications

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

The role is responsible to work with massive amounts of data to develop Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence (Al) models with Telco and other sets of data to help enterprises realise key business value through the use of Telco Insights. The senior data scientist works closely with key internal and external stakeholders to develop new Al products or new application areas for Al.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop next generation of scalable Telco Big Data Analytics Models to support commercial projects across various business verticals.
  • Propose and design effective analytical approaches taking into consideration performance and scalability to large datasets, adhering to best practices for model development, and perform unit and system testing to validate the results of the analytics models. Constantly review and ensure that current methodology conforms and meets industry standards.
  • Propose and develop new analytics models and innovative techniques and algorithms to enhance SmartHub capabilities and value proposition of Telco Big Data.
  • Independently develop solutions that adopt and leverage on latest AI/ML models including GenAI and LLM to deliver exceptional value to internal/external stakeholders.
  • Participate and contribute to stakeholders' requirement gatherings sessions, co-creation workshops to size up stakeholders' problem statements and formulate and review best approaches to analytic solutions and models.
  • Lead the technical collaboration with industry or research institutes to propose new potential areas for collaboration.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Analytics or related disciplines, along with at least 4 years of relevant experience in Big Data analytics application development
  • Experience with Business Intelligence Visualization (e.g. Tableau, AWS QuickSight)
  • Experience in presentation to stakeholders to articulate business values for analytical/data science projects
  • Experience in the following Big Data technologies: PySpark, Kafka
  • Programming experience in one or preferably more of the following languages: Python, Scala
  • Experience with Cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud)
  • Exposure to real-time streaming technologies (e.g. Spark Streaming, Apache Flink)
  • Good understanding of software agile development,continues integration and deployment
  • Attention to details, a self-starter and self-learner continuously keeping up to date with industry developments
  • Creative problem solver and ability to think out of the box
  • Experience in Telco industry will be an advantage

job.title: SM, SMO (Test & Quality Engineering)
job.description:
##

Role Mission

Lead and institutionalise enterprise-wide testing strategy, governance, and quality engineering practices to ensure StarHub’s corporate systems are resilient, secure, scalable, and consistently production-ready. Drive a culture of quality-by-design and continuous testing across the BTS ecosystem.

Accountabilities Own and evolve the enterprise testing and quality engineering strategy, aligned with BTS transformation goals. Provide leadership oversight for end-to-end testing governance across all corporate enterprise systems and platforms. Drive adoption of automation-first, continuous testing, and quality engineering practices across delivery teams. Ensure integration quality, release readiness, and production stability across complex, interdependent systems. Establish and govern vendor ecosystem, tooling strategy, and performance outcomes for testing services. Build and scale a Business Applications Testing Centre of Excellence (TCoE) to uplift organisational testing maturity and standardisation.

Responsibilities Define, implement, and continuously enhance the enterprise-wide testing strategy, governance model, and quality standards. Lead centralised test governance and operating model, ensuring consistency across programmes, platforms, and vendors. Establish and track enterprise quality KPIs (e.g., defect leakage, automation coverage, release readiness, system reliability). Provide executive-level visibility on quality health, risks, and release readiness across BTS initiatives. Oversee end-to-end testing lifecycle including planning, design, execution, and production validation across multiple programmes. Ensure comprehensive functional and non-functional testing coverage (performance, resilience, security, usability, scalability). Enforce quality gates and release governance to ensure all deployments meet enterprise standards. Drive large-scale adoption of test automation and continuous testing integrated into CI/CD pipelines. Lead strategy and standardisation of testing tools, frameworks, and platforms across BTS. Champion shift-left and shift-right testing practices, embedding quality early and continuously across the lifecycle. Partner with senior stakeholders (delivery leads, architects, product owners, service managers) to align on quality outcomes and delivery priorities. Provide leadership oversight of QA vendors, ensuring strategic alignment, SLA/KPI adherence, and value realisation. Integrate testing with Service Management processes to ensure seamless transition from delivery to operations. Lead enterprise-level defect management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. Develop and grow internal testing capabilities, including talent development and capability uplift within the TCoE.

Areas of Impact Enterprise-wide quality, testing maturity, and release reliability across corporate systems. System integration integrity, UAT effectiveness, and production stability. Automation adoption and CI/CD pipeline efficiency at scale. Vendor performance optimisation and cost-effectiveness of testing services. Reduction in defects, incidents, and operational risks.

##

Ideal Track Record

12–18 years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, or service management, with significant leadership responsibility. Proven track record of defining and leading enterprise testing strategies in complex, large-scale environments. Strong experience driving test automation, continuous testing, and DevOps quality practices. Deep understanding of Agile, DevOps, and ITIL frameworks in enterprise settings. Demonstrated success in managing multi-vendor ecosystems and cross-functional delivery at scale. Experience building or leading Testing Centres of Excellence or similar capability uplift initiatives.

job.title: Web Operations (AEM), Assistant Manager - Digital Business
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on, performance-driven Assistant Manager to own the technical build and performance of our website on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Sitting within the Web Operations digital business team, this role focuses primarily on AEM development, authoring, and page performance, working closely with the wider team on the campaign scheduling and day-to-day operations of StarHub's website (Discovery Pages) — a critical part of our digital experience that drives product awareness, campaign visibility, sales, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Website Strategy, Performance & Commercial

  • Co-own, together with the Web Ops Manager, the evolution of the StarHub.com experience to support digital sales, product awareness, and overall brand experience.
  • Work with Digital Business Lead to build best-in-class templates, page structures, and user journeys that align with strategic objectives.
  • Analyse page-level data (traffic, bounce rate, conversion) to identify what's working and what isn't.
  • Translate business goals into page structure and CTAs that support conversion.
  • Support A/B testing and personalisation initiatives and help implement winning variants.
  • Audit underperforming pages and recommend improvements.
  • Work with the Web Operations team and Digital Business Lead to recommend the best-performing, sales-driving page layouts within  the available component library.
  • Review every campaign or page post-launch and make recommendations to optimise the page based on performance insights for the next campaign.

AEM Page Build

  • Build, configure, and publish pages, components, and templates in AEM (Author/Publish).
  • Manage and execute the authoring workflow: content entry, versioning, approvals, and publishing.
  • Manage and execute AEM DAM, including organizing and tagging digital assets.
  • Partner with the AEM Product Owner and AEM developers to scope custom components, raise bugs, and run UAT.
  • Ensure all pages meet accessibility, SEO, tracking, and regulatory compliance standards prior to go-live.
  • Troubleshoot page-level issues and coordinate fixes with IT/development partners.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration.
  • Work closely with Digital POs, Product, Marcom, Brand, SEO, UX/UI, and Tech teams to plan, prepare, and execute timely Discovery Page updates, ensuring requirements and technical feasibility are aligned.
  • Coordinate with the Web Operations team on campaign timelines and pricing/product change go-live dates, ensuring the technical build is ready in time.
  • Flag technical risks, dependencies, or conflicts on planned launches.
  • Support lead-generation initiatives by integrating forms and dynamic content where appropriate.

Qualifications

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager, in an authoring and development capacity.
  • Prior experience in the telecommunications industry, with an understanding of plan/device pricing, promotions, and regulatory disclosures, is preferred.
  • Strong technical grounding in AEM: components, templates, content fragments, DAM, and workflows.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript to troubleshoot or brief developers.
  • Understanding of web UX principles and the digital content lifecycle.
  • Proficiency with web analytics tools (Adobe Analytics preferred) to interpret page-level data.
  • Experience with A/B testing and personalisation is an advantage.
  • General understanding of web operations processes, including campaign launches and content change workflows.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage competing priorities under deadline pressure.

Leadership & Mindset

  • A proactive self-starter, capable of managing cross-functional requests and competing priorities, and comfortable engaging senior stakeholders.
  • Performance-driven, with a strong sense of ownership over website experience and outcomes.
  • Able to balance technical execution with commercial requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to content quality and consistency.
  • Team management experience, with the ability to guide and coach operational or functional leads, is preferred.
  • Able to anticipate challenges, manage change, and keep teams aligned through uncertainty.
  • Positive, adaptable, and resilient — comfortable in dynamic, fast-moving environments.
  • Comfortable working under pressure to meet business deadlines.
  • High ethical standards a must

To APPLY NOW, click on Skye!

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

  • Provide Level 2 onsite support for Palo Alto NGFW and Datacom network infrastructure.
  • Ensure timely incident resolution and service restoration within agreed SLAs.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of configurations, policies, network diagrams, and operational records.
  • Collaborate with Day #1, Cybersecurity, Service Management, and Vendor TAC teams to ensure seamless service delivery and knowledge transfer.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve security and network incidents involving Palo Alto firewalls (policy issues, NAT, VPN, IPSec, SSL VPN, Threat Prevention, URL Filtering, etc.).
  • Manage firewall rule reviews, policy optimization, log analysis, and security posture improvements.
  • Perform configuration updates, firmware upgrades, patching, and change implementations following ITIL processes.
  • Troubleshoot Datacom switching and routing issues including VLAN, STP, OSPF/BGP (where applicable), and campus network connectivity issues.
  • Conduct periodic health checks, capacity reviews, performance monitoring, and vulnerability assessments to prevent service disruption.
  • Support integration with authentication systems (e.g., AD/LDAP), endpoint security solutions, and other enterprise platforms where required.
  • Liaise with vendor TAC (Palo Alto, Datacom, and Huawei where applicable) for escalations and major incident handling.
  • Provide technical reports, update service tickets, and participate in operational review meetings.

Qualifications

  • Background in network security operations, managed services, or enterprise campus environments.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing Palo Alto firewalls (must have).
  • Strong knowledge of Datacom switching and routing technologies (must have).
  • Experience in firewall policy management, VPN configuration, log analysis, and security incident troubleshooting.
  • Huawei switching or campus network experience is advantageous but not mandatory (training and knowledge transfer can be provided).
  • Certifications preferred: Palo Alto PCNSE / PCNSA, CCNA / CCNP, Huawei HCIA / HCIP or equivalent.
  • Experience working within SLA-driven environments with strong incident management discipline.
  • Proven ability to resolve complex network/security incidents independently onsite.
  • Strong documentation, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.

job.title: Data Centre Critical Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

The primary responsibility for this role is to:

  • Perform day to day operation and maintenance of all the various facilities systems at StarHub Data Centres and Offices, such as Generators, Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS), DC Rectifier System, Static Transfer Switch (STS), Fire Protection System, Building Management System, HT/LT electrical system, all ACMV systems, etc.
  • Ensure the routine maintenance of the facilities systems are carried out according to planned schedule and contracted scope of work
  • Plan, call and evaluate tenders, and project-manage any expansion projects to cater for users’ requirements
  • Ensure strict security system is enforced at the StarHub Data Centres and Offices by managing the physical and electronic security systems eg card access, CCTV surveillance, Visitors Tracking.
  • Carry out customer related work orders within the customer’s requested Ready for Service (RFS) Date
  • Maintain records and update all M&E, building & schematic drawings of the facilities in and security of the estates under our care
  • Conduct regular checks of the premises for potential safety hazards and unsafe conditions, initiate corrective measures to maintain a safe and healthy work environment, in compliance with prevailing legislative and regulatory requirements
  • Manage new leases and timely renewal of existing ones, covering offices, shops and technical sites:

o    Negotiate with building owners, manage LOIs and agreements, follow-up with all related administration matters

o    Conduct regular meetings with respective business units

o    Monitor current industry rental rates

o    Liaise with relevant authorities to ensure the leases comply with authorities’ requirements, if any

o    Liaise with internal business units eg Legal, Finance, Business Units, for any changes of lease terms, rental and service fees, property tax, etc

o    Liaise with external tenants in StarHub’s owned-premises, including the generation of billing invoices to tenants

o    Ensure timely handover/ takeover of premises to/from building owners

  • Carry out risk assessments and management
  • Perform 24 x 7 standby duties, respond to and rectify all situations
  • Carry out any other assignments from the management

Qualifications

  • Job Requirement
  • Appropriate qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Telecommunications or Facilities Management with at least 2 yrs of work experience in facilities area, in particular Data Centre environment.
  • Candidates with 2 to 3 years of working experience in supporting facilities operations & maintenance in Data Centre environment are preferred.
  • Fresh Diploma graduates with positive attitude and willingness to work in a start-up environment are welcome to apply
  • Good understanding and hands-on servicing experience in all facilities systems and building maintenance
  • Possesses Class 3 Driving Lesson (Manual Gear)
  • Basic networking, broadband access and structure cabling is a plus;
  • Computer literate with knowledge of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, AutoCAD Able to manage and supervise contractors;
  • Hands on experience in provisioning and configuration of network elements switches, CPE and services will be added advantage;
  • Self motivated with strong drive and the willingness to take on challenges

job.title: AVP, Technical Program Management (TPM) Lead
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Project Management Leadto head the TPM function within IS - DBE. This role will define and uphold the delivery standards, metrics, and practices that underpin StarHub’s digital engineering model.

As TPM Lead, you will:

  • Manage a team of Technical Project Managers distributed across DXP domains.
  • Partner closely with IS Senior leadership, Domain & System Owners (DOs & SOs), Journey Solution Designers (SDs), Release Program Managers (RPMs), and Solution Architects (SAs).
  • Drive predictable delivery, visibility, and quality across teams aligned to StarHub’s consumer, enterprise, and operational journeys.

This role reports into the Information Systems – VP of Delivery & Business Enablement (DBE) and is responsible for orchestrating StarHub’s digital delivery model and enabling DevOps-based execution across domains for our Digital Experience Platform (DXP) team.

TheTPM Leadis responsible for managing and developing a team of Technical Project Managers (TPMs) across multiple DXP domains and journeys. This role ensures that delivery practices (both agile and waterfall), engineering alignment, and cross-domain coordination are consistent, predictable, and outcome-driven.

You will play a pivotal role in establishing delivery governance, continuous improvement frameworks, and cross-functional synchronization between business journeys, engineering domains, and architecture.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery Leadership

  • Lead and mentor a team of TPMs across multiple domains to drive either (a) agile, DevOps-based or (b) waterfall-based delivery excellence
  • Define and maintain a standardized delivery governance framework — covering sprint cadence, backlog hygiene, dependency tracking, and reporting.
  • Oversee delivery execution across DXP domains, ensuring commitments are met with predictable outcomes.
  • Lead monthly delivery health reviews, highlighting key risks, capacity challenges, and improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with Domain Owners (DXP) and Journey SDs (DBE) to balance Product, Tech Debt, and Technical Campaign backlogs across teams.

Cross-Domain Coordination & Governance

  • Act as the central delivery integrator across DBE, ensuring synchronization between journeys, domains, and releases.
  • Collaborate with Release Program Managers (RPMs)to ensure alignment of delivery and release plans.
  • Establish and maintain a cross-domain dependency management framework with clear escalation paths.
  • Monitor delivery performance metrics (velocity, predictability, throughput) and drive corrective actions where needed.
  • Drive adoption of continuous improvement practices across all DXP squads.

People Management & Capability Development

  • Coach and mentor TPMs, supporting their career development, skills growth, and performance reviews.
  • Foster a culture of proactive communication, accountability, and continuous learning across the TPM community.
  • Lead training sessions or playbook initiatives to strengthen agile delivery maturity, tooling proficiency, and reporting discipline.
  • Identify and recruit high-performing TPM talent aligned to StarHub’s transformation roadmap.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Serve as a trusted partner to senior engineering, business, and architecture leaders — ensuring transparency on delivery health and execution status.
  • Communicate program-level risks, trade-offs, and delivery decisions clearly to executive stakeholders.
  • Represent the TPM function in enterprise forums, transformation reviews, and cross-functional working groups.

Requirements & Qualifications

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or Information Systems.
  • Advanced certifications in Agile, DevOps, or Program Management (e.g., SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, CSM) preferred

Experience

  • 12+ years of total experience in technology delivery, with at least 5 years in managing project/program teams or TPM functions.
  • Proven track record in delivering large-scale, cross-functional software or platform programs using agile and DevOps practices.
  • Experience in telecommunications, cloud platforms, or enterprise-scale digital transformation preferred.
  • Strong background in stakeholder management, dependency resolution, and performance reporting.

Skills & Attributes

  • Deep understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD delivery frameworks and SDLC practices.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret delivery metrics and drive data-informed decisions.
  • Excellent leadership, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to align cross-functional teams toward shared goals under time and complexity constraints.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and resilient in a fast-paced environment.

Success Profile

A successful TPM Lead at StarHub is:

  • Delivery-Driven:Ensures every initiative lands predictably, with measurable business impact.
  • Hands-on:Operates across strategy and execution — from stakeholder alignment to sprint-level delivery — can take over a TPM role as exigencies dictate
  • Systematically Agile:Brings structure and consistency to delivery across diverse teams and domains.
  • People-Centric:Builds high-performing, motivated TPM teams through coaching and empowerment.
  • Collaborative:Bridges engineering, product, and business stakeholders to drive alignment.
  • Outcome-Focused:Balances speed, quality, and cost without losing sight of the end goal — customer experience excellence.

job.title: Principal CRM Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

The Principal CRM Engineer defines and evolves the architecture of StarHub’s core Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Order Management (OM) platforms that power customer onboarding, sales journeys, and fulfilment for the Consumer Business.

The role focuses on building a scalable, resilient, and future-ready CRM/OM platform, ensuring seamless end-to-end customer experiences and enabling rapid product innovation. Operating within a DevOps model, the Principal CRM Engineer drives platform modernization, architectural standardization, and system-wide reliability, while guiding engineering teams to eliminate systemic issues and scale the platform sustainably.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and own the end-to-end architecture of CRM/OM platforms across Customer Management, Product Catalogue, Campaigns, Order Management, and Revenue/Billing integration
  • Establish architectural principles and standards for microservices, API design, workflow orchestration, and data management across CRM/OM domains
  • Design and optimize workflow orchestration strategies for order lifecycle processes, ensuring scalability and fault tolerance
  • Drive platform scalability and performance improvements by identifying system bottlenecks across APIs, databases, and workflows
  • Define and govern data architecture, ensuring consistency, integrity, and efficient data flow across CRM, provisioning, and billing systems
  • Establish API and integration standards, including versioning, idempotency, and reliability patterns for internal and external system integrations
  • Lead platform modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy CRM systems to cloud-native CRM-based architecture
  • Reduce technical debt and system complexity by driving modularization, decoupling, and standardization across services
  • Define and implement observability and reliability strategies across the platform, ensuring proactive monitoring, alerting, and performance optimization
  • Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to design scalable cloud-native solutions using Kubernetes (EKS), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code
  • Act as the technical authority for design decisions, conducting architecture reviews and ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and business objectives
  • Mentor CRM Engineers on system design, architectural thinking, and advanced debugging techniques
  • Influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders to adopt consistent engineering standards and best practices
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, QA, DevOps, and vendors to ensure seamless integration and delivery of end-to-end customer journeys

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong emphasis on system architecture and large‑scale distributed systems
  • Demonstrated ability to design, evolve, and operate enterprise‑critical platforms, particularly within CRM, OM, BSS, or comparable domains
  • Deep architectural expertise across:
  • Microservices and distributed system design
  • API design, integration patterns, and service contracts
  • Workflow driven and orchestration-based systems
  • Data architecture, modelling, and database performance optimization
  • Strong hands-on technical experience with:
  • Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful API design/development
  • PostgreSQL and/or Oracle, including query optimization and performance tuning
  • Kubernetes based platforms and cloud environments (AWS preferred)
  • Proven experience working in telecom BSS/OSS environments, including CRM, billing, and order management systems
  • Established track record of leading platform modernization, large scale refactoring, and transformation initiatives in complex enterprise environments

Preferred Certifications

  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional)

To support this journey, Singtel is seeking an experienced Senior Solution Designer to join the Group IT – Corporate HR Systems team, with a focus on payroll systems.

This role will act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for payroll technology, responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise payroll solutions across cloud-based HR platforms. The incumbent will drive solution architecture, ensure compliance with statutory requirements, and lead system enhancements while maintaining high standards of system performance, accuracy, and reliability.

The role requires close collaboration with HR, Finance, and IT stakeholders, as well as external vendors, to deliver scalable, secure, and efficient payroll solutions aligned with business objectives.

Make An Impact By

Delivery & Maintenance of HR Payroll Systems (approximately 90% of time focused)

  • Design and deliver payroll solutions aligned to business requirements across SaaS platforms
  • Drive standardization and adoption of best practices across payroll processes and system implementations
  • Provide primary support for payroll systems including payroll processing cycles, integrations, data validation, and statutory configurations (e.g., taxes, compliance requirements)
  • Manage technical payroll configurations, including schemas, rules, and, ensuring system stability, data accuracy, and compliance with local regulations and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Drive system enhancements and changes, including SIT/UAT coordination, functional documentation, and release management within packaged solution environments.
  • Drive system enhancements and changes, including SIT/UAT coordination, functional documentation, and release management within packaged solution environments.
  • Perform root cause analysis to resolve complex system issues and lead continuous improvement efforts to enhance payroll and HR system performance
  • Act as the key liaison between HR, Finance, and IT stakeholders, collaborating with vendors and partners to facilitate meetings and ensure successful solution adoption.
  • Participate in bi-annual HRSP upgrades and system maintenance activities for the payroll system, ensuring smooth transitions and minimal business disruption.
  • Support penetration testing activities and audits for HR systems, ensuring compliance with security standards and addressing identified vulnerabilities.
  • Contribute to application strategy, roadmap planning, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies or enhancements to improve existing solutions

Payroll Technology Advancement & Capability Development (approximately 10% of time focused)

  • Stay updated with industry trends, payroll technologies, and SaaS platforms, or similar, and apply this knowledge to enhance existing payroll solutions
  • Continuously build and strengthen technical and functional expertise to support system upgrades, enhancements, and payroll platform improvements
  • Develop skills in cloud-based payroll platforms, integrations, and application runtime environments to support modern payroll architecture
  • Upskill on emerging technologies and tools to improve payroll system performance, scalability, and reliability.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • More than 8 years’ experience in IT consulting or project delivery with HRMS, with at least 5 years of hands-on experience (both functional and configuration), 2 of those supporting Singapore Payroll.
  • Proven track record of end-to-end implementation of at least 2 full cycle of payroll system.
  • Working experience with the following: Payroll Parallel Runs, Regular / Off-cycle Payroll Runs, Configuration of Payroll / Time Schemas, Tax Calculation, Payroll replications.
  • Proficiency in HR Cloud Technologies, Statutory Compliance & Payroll Regulations and Payroll Integration & Data Management

job.title: Director, Cyber Security Governance, Risk and Assurance
job.description:
Date: 29 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

Reporting to the Group Chief Information Security Officer (GCISO), the Group Cyber Governance, Risk & Assurance Director is a senior Group-level leadership role accountable for setting, maintaining, and enforcing Singtel Group’s cyber security policies, standards, and compliance posture. The role owns the Group cyber policy framework, control standards, and assurance mechanisms that ensure cybersecurity risks are consistently identified, assessed, managed, and reported across all Operating Companies and Associates.

Working closely with OpCo risk and security leaders, the role defines Group-wide cyber governance requirements, including policies, minimum control standards, and risk acceptance principles. These policy guardrails establish clear expectations for due care, regulatory compliance, and “secure-by-default” outcomes, while allowing measured flexibility for local operating contexts.

As a policy authority and trusted governance advisor, the Group GRC Director provides independent oversight and challenge on major initiatives and material risk decisions. The role ensures that cybersecurity risks are formally assessed against Group policies and standards, that policy exceptions are governed through defined approval processes, and that residual risks are transparently escalated and accepted at the appropriate level.

This position requires strong risk judgement, regulatory insight, and executive influence, with the ability to translate complex technical and cyber risks into clear policy positions, compliance outcomes, and Board-level risk narratives. The role bridges business, technology, and security by embedding disciplined policy governance, compliance assurance, and accountability into the Group’s operating model.

Make an Impact by

Governance, Policy & Standards

  • Act as the Group owner and governing authority for Singtel Group Cyber Security Policies, Standards, and Control Libraries, ensuring consistent application, resilience, and enforceability across all OpCos and Associates.
  • Establish, maintain, and evolve Group-wide minimum cybersecurity requirements, including approval of material policy updates, standards enhancements, and control baselines.
  • Continuously assess Singtel Group Cyber Security Policies and Standards against industry best practices and regulatory expectations (e.g. ISO/IEC, NIST, CIS Controls, GSMA), ensuring safeguards remain effective against the evolving threat landscape.
  • Own and govern the policy exception and risk acceptance process, including escalation thresholds, decision authorities, and documentation of residual risk.
  • Drive security culture and controls adoption through structured stakeholder engagement, training, and enablement across the Group.

Controls Risk Framework & Risk Visibility

  • Define and own the Group Cybersecurity Controls and Risk Framework, including methodologies to assess inherent risk, control effectiveness, control maturity, and residual risk across cyber domains.
  • Develop and maintain controls risk metrics, KRIs, and gap indicators to provide consistent, risk-based visibility of cybersecurity posture across Singtel Group.
  • Translate controls and compliance outcomes into executive- and Board-level insights, supporting prioritisation, remediation planning, and informed risk decisions.

**

Compliance Assurance, Automation & Continuous Monitoring

**

  • Own the Group Compliance Assurance Framework, defining how compliance with Group Cyber Security Policies and Standards is assessed, validated, and reported across OpCos and Associates.
  • Lead the transition from point-in-time assessments to continuous controls assurance, leveraging technology to provide near-real-time visibility of controls effectiveness and cyber resilience.
  • Establish and execute a Group-wide digital GRC platform strategy as the single source of truth for governance, risk management, compliance, exceptions, and audit evidence.
  • Drive the adoption of automation and agentic AI to scale compliance assessments, evidence collection, and controls monitoring, while maintaining auditability, traceability, and regulator confidence.

**

Business, Regulatory & Cyber Leadership

**

  • Serve as the Group authority on cyber governance and risk, providing trusted advisory and challenge to senior management and Boards on cybersecurity risk posture and material exposures.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging cyber threats, technologies (e.g. AI, quantum), and regulatory developments, translating these into risk-aligned governance and control enhancements.
  • Act as a key interface with auditors, and external assessors on matters related to cyber governance, compliance, and assurance.
  • Provide thought leadership and effective stakeholder engagement, balancing business enablement with risk discipline and regulatory expectations across the Group.

Budget & Resource Stewardship

  • Assist in planning and managing budgets for GRC programs.
  • Recommend resource allocation strategies to optimize cost, scale, and talent effectiveness.

**

Stakeholder Engagement & Influence

  • Lead and contribute to cross-functional governance
  • Collaborate with GRC leads across OpCos to align on Group cyber governance requirements, policy interpretation, risk assessment approaches, and compliance expectations, including the treatment of emerging technologies and new risk paradigms.
  • Engage internal stakeholders across business, technology, and risk functions to ensure cybersecurity governance, risk posture, and compliance priorities are aligned with enterprise objectives and risk appetite.
  • Drive Group-wide alignment and awareness of cyber risk and compliance priorities, promoting consistent understanding of policies, standards, and risk responsibilities across all Operating Companies and Associates.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • At least 10 years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, or GRC roles, with demonstrated experience operating in Group-level, regional, or multi-entity environments, overseeing policy, risk, and compliance across complex organisations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and governing large-scale cybersecurity or technology risk initiatives, including setting Group standards, driving compliance programmes, managing material risk issues, and engaging senior executives and Boards.
  • Deep expertise in cybersecurity governance, risk management, and control frameworks, including NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/27002, CIS Controls, and risk-based control models, with the ability to set, interpret, and enforce Group-wide policy and control standards.
  • Strong understanding of telco, cloud, and enterprise IT operating environments, including cloud platforms, identity and access management, data protection, and network security, to enable informed risk-based policy decisions and governance oversight of emerging technologies (e.g. AI and quantum).
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical and cyber risks into clear governance positions, executive briefings, and Board-level risk narratives that support informed decision-making and risk acceptance.
  • Professional certifications preferred: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CCSP, or equivalent credentials supporting senior leadership in governance, risk, and compliance.
  • Demonstrated awareness of emerging cyber threats, regulatory developments, and evolving risk paradigms, with the ability to anticipate impacts to Group policy, controls, and assurance approaches.

Leadership and Collaboration:

  • Exceptional leadership, collaboration, and team management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders, including subsidiaries in a conglomerate or multi-subsidiary environment.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, especially in dynamic and high-pressure situations.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

**

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

We are committed to a safe and healthy environment for our employees & customers and will require all prospective employees to be fully vaccinated.

job.title: Director, Strategy & Transformation
job.description:
Date: 24 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Be a Part of Something BIG!

This role is responsible for leading Singtel Singapore’s overall strategy and corporate transformation (including AI push), while managing the end-to-end business planning and performance management for Singtel Singapore’s business units. It is part of a high priority talent pipeline for Singtel.

The Director, Strategy & Transformation, acts as 2IC to the Head, Strategy & Transformation and plays a critical role in shaping strategic priorities, driving organisation-wide change, and ensuring alignment of business outcomes with Singtel Singapore’s long-term strategic objectives. They leverage data to diagnose, conceptualise and act as a thought partner to business units and the leadership team.

Leading a fast-paced, high performing team in the CEOs office, the Director is a strong leader, coach and mentor who develops teams to grow their skills and be examples of excellence in this highly visible team. A versatile problem solver, they shift seamlessly between strategy, consulting, engagement, and change management, collaborating across functions and facilitating decision-making at all levels.

The role also drives the business planning process for Singtel Singapore, including the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), performance management frameworks, and leadership communications to support execution and accountability.

Make An Impact By

Strategy Development and Execution

  • Support the Head S&T in leading the definition and refinement of Singtel Singapore’s strategic direction, in collaboration with the Singapore Leadership Team.
  • Conduct data-driven analytics to inform recommendations on strategy and organisational priorities.
  • Be a thought partner to the leadership team to provide objective, business critical analysis and insights to advocate, challenge, and enable business decisions.
  • Oversee the execution of priority strategic initiatives across Singapore business units, ensuring overall alignment and realising business impact.
  • Develop content for strategic CEO communications including SMW, AOP, Board papers, CEO Forums, Investor Releases, and the Annual Report.

Advance Business Performance

  • Set annual objectives, quarterly milestones, and drive strategy and operational excellence across the organization.
  • Define success metrics and KPIs to track effectiveness of transformation initiatives.
  • Align top-level priorities with operational execution and identify areas for improvement.
  • Seek and bring in external best practices, including conducting research, testing emerging ideas and technologies, to identify effective strategies and solutions to achieve transformation objectives.

Transformation governance and delivery

  • Lead enterprise-wide transformation efforts, and other cross-functional programs aimed at improving customer outcomes, productivity, and employee engagement.
  • Champion change management and cultural transformation across business units.
  • Lead governance and oversight of strategic initiatives with cross-functional ownership, ensuring clarity of roles, accountability, and delivery of outcomes.
  • Act as a senior transformation partner, challenging norms and driving improvement.

Internal Communications and Employee Engagement

  • Develop internal communication strategies to align employees with strategic and cultural priorities.
  • Plan and implement leadership workshops, executive offsites, and townhalls, from storyboarding to logistics.

  • Annual Innovation Programs

  • Maintain communication platforms.
  • Promote initiatives that reinforce culture, recognize behaviors, and build change momentum.

Business Planning for Consumer BUs

  • Manage business performance, ensuring delivery of strategic initiatives and responsiveness to market shifts, risks, and opportunities.
  • Lead the annual business planning process, including ensuring alignment in the development of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), performance scorecards, and KPI tracking for these BUs.
  • Drive leadership engagement through executive workshops, board sessions, and townhalls.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources and prioritisation for key initiatives.
  • Execute strategic projects as assigned.

**

Skills To Succeed

**

  • Relevant degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience. An Executive MBA or other advanced business qualification is preferred.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in management consulting, strategy, transformation, or a comparable role, with experience navigating change in large and complex organisations.
  • Strong track record in leading large-scale business, operating model, or organisational transformation programmes from strategy through implementation.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure, manage, and deliver complex, cross-functional programmes with ambitious business outcomes.
  • Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to translate insights into practical actions.
  • Proven ability to engage, influence, and build credibility with senior stakeholders, including senior management, Board-level stakeholders, government agencies, and C-suite executives.
  • Ability to facilitate timely strategic decisions at senior leadership level and drive initiatives through to implementation.
  • Strong understanding of cross-functional and cross-business-unit operating environments, with the ability to work effectively across functions, business units, and operating companies.
  • Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills, including the ability to align diverse perspectives and secure commitment to shared outcomes.
  • Demonstrated people leadership skills, with the ability to motivate, coach, and inspire teams to perform effectively.
  • Strong project and programme management capabilities, including prioritisation, governance, risk management, and execution discipline.
  • Strong analytical capability, including experience using data to support business decisions and communicate insights.
  • Proficiency in data analytics and visualisation tools such as Power BI or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience in market research and qualitative and quantitative research methodologies.
  • Exposure to business operations and operational improvement initiatives is advantageous.

job.title: Information Security Specialist
job.description:
Summary

The purpose of this role is to provide security architecture risk and cloud compliance assurance across technology initiatives, ensuring that security risks are identified early, assessed consistently, and managed effectively throughout the system lifecycle. The role supports secure delivery of business initiatives by ensuring technology solutions, infrastructure services, and cloud services are designed and implemented in compliance with regulatory requirements, enterprise security standards, and the organisation’s risk appetite.

The role acts as a security risk and cloud security advisor to Singtel IT, Telco Networks and Enterprise stakeholders, applying recognized security frameworks and principles to evaluate design decisions, identify control gaps, insecure configurations and recommend risk-based mitigations.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Support comprehensive information security risk assessments for new and existing systems, applications, infrastructure changes, and cloud engagements
  • Assess design documents, architecture diagrams, and technical controls to confirm that technology risks are mitigated prior to go-live.
  • Ensure technology initiatives and controls comply with internal security policies, standards, and governance requirements; proactively highlight gaps and recommend remediation.
  • Review secure related configurations in cloud environments leveraging industry tools and work with application teams to remediate insecure configurations.
  • Collaborate with IT, application teams, and business stakeholders to provide risk advisory for projects and ad hoc reviews.
  • Drive governance oversight and processes for cloud security compliance, best practices and risk management.
  • Support management reporting of cloud security risks, remediation plans and security metrics.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree/Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or related fields
  • At least 4 years or more working experience in security assessment, cybersecurity, or related IT roles.
  • Experience working within system integrator or consulting environments, including exposure to multi-client or complex delivery engagements, is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience in system and security administration, implementation, and solution design.
  • Experience in application, infrastructure, telco networks, cloud and cybersecurity technologies including CNAPP, DevSecOps, containers.
  • Ability to apply Zero Trust security architecture principles to complex enterprise environments.
  • Cybersecurity risk assessment and risk reduction initiatives.
  • Regulatory requirements, security standards and best practices pertaining to cybersecurity and cloud risk management.
  • Professional security management certifications such as a Certified Information Systems Security professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) or other similar credentials, will be preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective time management and prioritisation skills.
  • Sound conflict management and negotiation skills.
  • High level of professionalism, commitment, and accountability.
  • Resilience and adaptability in fast-paced or changing environments.
  • Change-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, with remote stakeholders, exercising sound judgement and initiative.
