About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our Enterprise Platforms Engineering team. The role is responsible for designing, building and delivering software development infrastructure that supports internal tools and platform development. Working closely with engineering and technology teams, the Senior DevOps Engineer will enable reliable and automated application and infrastructure deployment while ensuring alignment with organisational IT, security, architecture and engineering standards.

The successful candidate will bring strong technical expertise, effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with teams with different levels of technical experience. They will contribute to the adoption of DevOps best practices, cloud architecture strategies and engineering standards while supporting the continued evolution of cloud and automation capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, implement and automate CI/CD pipelines across development, staging and production environments.
  • Develop and maintain DevOps engineering standards and best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve deployment consistency, reliability and automation.
  • Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions and automated application deployments.
  • Develop tools and scripts to automate deployment and operational processes.
  • Guide project teams toward solutions aligned with agreed architecture, security, engineering principles and standards.
  • Provide technical guidance to teams on application and infrastructure automation.
  • Mentor engineers and facilitate knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Integrate appropriate security controls and testing into DevOps processes.
  • Drive continuous improvements in application design, development and delivery.
  • Improve system reliability and recovery through monitoring, alerting, automation and self-healing capabilities.
  • Promote an automation-first engineering approach.
  • Apply agile practices to support consistent and transparent delivery.
  • Manage and maintain DevOps pipelines and collaborate with development teams on integrated delivery pipelines.
  • Lead technology evaluations and implementations to address gaps in software build, testing, deployment and scalability capabilities.
  • Develop and implement governance processes and tools to support compliance with applicable technology standards and policies.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience in Information Technology, including significant hands-on experience with DevOps engineering for complex systems.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing and operating CI/CD and infrastructure automation solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Linux operating systems such as Ubuntu.
  • Strong practical experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments.
  • Experience with at least one major public cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, VPNs, DNS, load balancing and network protocols.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes and Helm.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD solutions using technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins or comparable tools.
  • Experience with configuration-management technologies such as Ansible, Chef, Puppet or comparable tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills in complex distributed computing environments.
  • Proficiency with Git and experience using collaboration and work-management platforms such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience working with APIs, command-line interfaces and SDKs.
  • Experience with API gateway technologies such as NGINX, Apigee or comparable platforms.
  • Strong scripting capability using technologies such as Shell and Python.
  • Experience with logging, monitoring and tracing platforms such as Azure Monitor, Amazon CloudWatch, Zabbix, Elasticsearch/Kibana, Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Datadog or Dynatrace.
  • Understanding of SQL and NoSQL database technologies, such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, MySQL and PostgreSQL.

Preferred Skills

Experience with one or more of the following would be advantageous:

  • Event-streaming technologies such as Kafka.
  • Service-mesh technologies such as Istio or Envoy.
  • REST APIs and GraphQL.
  • Microservices architecture.
  • Secrets-management technologies such as Vault.
  • Service-discovery and distributed-coordination technologies such as Consul, ZooKeeper or etcd.
  • Relevant professional certifications, such as RHCE/RHCSA or Kubernetes certifications.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Sales Manager, Healthcare
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

NCS is a leading technology services firm that operates across the Asia Pacific region in over 20 cities, providing consulting, digital services, technology solutions, and more. We believe in harnessing the power of technology to achieve extraordinary things, creating lasting value and impact for our communities, partners, and people. Our diverse workforce of 13,000 has delivered large-scale, mission-critical, and multi-platform projects for governments and enterprises in Singapore and the APAC region.

As a Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving NCS sales, including account penetration, prospect qualification, supervision of sales activity, sales process planning, and closing all sales opportunities in the industry and/or sector that you are in. You are expected to build deep and trusted business relationships with the client to seed and grow future opportunities and will be focused on developing and closing application centric opportunities.

Beyond managing your own sales, sold margin and Business Centre’s revenue achievements, you also act as trusted client advisors, bringing together the right NCS team with the relevant expertise and thought leadership to coordinate pre-sales, professional services, and support resources to drive successful solutions for clients.

Reporting to the Sales Lead, you will work closely with different teams across NCS such as the Client Service Units, Lines of Businesses (LOBs) and NEXT Services. You will work with the teams to define the solution offerings & value propositions to maximise NCS’ win probability in each and every opportunity. This is achieved by him/her having a deep understanding of the business needs of the clients and working within the CSU and across the LOBs to strategise new growth plans.

What will you do?

  • Lead and grow his/her portfolio of accounts space through strong engagement with key decision makers by selling NCS Application solutions to the target customer base;
  • Have a strong understanding of the latest technology trends and the business needs of the clients, thus being able to coordinate across functional teams within NCS to bring the right winning team to drive successful solutions and contract closure;
  • Meet sales quota through identifying and gaining business from new and existing clients and ensuring customer’s satisfaction through the products and services provided by NCS
  • Manage and coordinate contract terms and conditions internally and externally;
  • Manage and build relationships at all levels with the designated clients that he/she is in charge of;
  • Develop value prepositions and negotiate successfully to close deals;
  • Develop a good understanding of the organisation’s products and services to coordinate pre-sales requirements;
  • Drive profitable wins focused on NCS’ core capabilities and growth strategy;
  • Coordinate and partner across functional teams and Lines of Businesses (LOBs) within NCS to strike innovative deals, get orders provisioned and meet the customers' service expectations;
  • Provide one-stop experience to customers regarding all NCS services.

The Ideal Candidate should possess:

  • 6+ years of sales experience, preferably in IT services.
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales quotas.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value propositions.
  • Knowledge of Commercial arrangements.
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Exceptional negotiation, presentation and deal maker skills.
  • Experience in managing multiple stakeholders preferred.
  • Dynamic and able to adjust in a fast-paced environment.
  • Able to deal with ambiguity.
  • University Degree/ Polytechnic Diploma. Background in Business, Computer Science or Computer Engineering or a related field.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we _make the extraordinary happen_ _._

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

job.title: Senior Cyber Security Consultant
job.description:
At Singtel, we believe in the strength of a vibrant, diverse and inclusive workforce where backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people help us innovate and create strong connections with our customers. We strive to ensure all our people practices are non-discriminatory and provide a fair, performance-based work culture that is diverse, inclusive and collaborative.

Join us and experience what it’s like to be with an Employer of Choice. Together, let’s create a brighter digital future for all. Awarded at the HR Fest Awards 2020.

Make an impact by:

  • Act as the Enterprise Cyber Security technical focal point during cyber incidents, working closely with SOC, CISO, infrastructure, network, cloud, application, and vendor teams.
  • Support cyber incident response activities including triage, investigation, containment coordination, evidence gathering, remediation tracking, and post incident review.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting across Enterprise infrastructure using available telemetry from SIEM, EDR, NDR, vulnerability management, asset discovery, and other security tools.
  • Identify suspicious behaviours, attack patterns, lateral movement indicators, privilege misuse, exposed services, anomalous access, and other signs of compromise.
  • Develop and enhance threat hunting hypotheses, detection use cases, investigation playbooks, response procedures, and escalation workflows.
  • Support improvement of security monitoring by identifying gaps in logs, telemetry, asset visibility, EDR/NDR/SIEM coverage, and detection rules.
  • Work with SOC and central security teams to improve alert quality, detection coverage, investigation context, and incident response readiness.
  • Support vulnerability management and risk-based remediation by correlating vulnerabilities with asset criticality, exposure, threat intelligence, and compensating controls.
  • Support Enterprise cybersecurity initiatives including NDR deployment, asset discovery, micro-segmentation, Zero Trust controls, PIAM/IAM adoption, and security tool integration.
  • Participate in security assessments, threat reviews, tabletop exercises, incident simulations, and lessons-learned activities.
  • Support root cause analysis and ensure remediation actions from cyber incidents, audit findings, vulnerability reviews, and threat hunting activities are tracked to closure.
  • Prepare management reports, investigation summaries, threat hunting findings, risk updates, incident dashboards, and security posture metrics.
  • Support cybersecurity audits, regulatory requests, internal governance activities, and evidence collection where related to incident response, monitoring, and security controls.
  • Maintain and improve technical documentation including incident response runbooks, threat hunting procedures, SOPs, escalation guides, and operational checklists.
  • Provide guidance to internal teams on security best practices, incident handling, evidence preservation, secure configuration, and remediation actions.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree or diploma with relevant experience in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, threat hunting, SOC operations, detection engineering, infrastructure security, or related roles.
  • Strong understanding of cyber incident response lifecycle, including detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Hands-on experience with security technologies such as SIEM, EDR, NDR, vulnerability management, threat intelligence platforms, asset discovery tools, firewalls, and endpoint/network security controls.
  • Good understanding of network security, TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, authentication, Windows/Linux systems, Active Directory, and cloud security fundamentals.
  • Experience analysing logs, alerts, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, user activity, and security events to identify threats or suspicious behaviours.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, threat hunting methodologies, and common attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures.
  • Ability to work across multiple teams during incidents and security projects, including SOC, CISO, infrastructure, network, application, cloud, GRC, and vendor teams.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

Preferred Certifications and Skills

  • Relevant incident response or threat hunting certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GNFA, GCFE, CySA+, or equivalent.
  • Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Security+, or equivalent are advantageous.
  • SIEM, EDR, NDR, or cloud security certifications from platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, CrowdStrike, Palo Alto, AWS, or Azure are preferred.
  • Experience with scripting, automation, and data analysis using PowerShell, Python, KQL, SPL, APIs, or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to tools and technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, CrowdStrike, Tenable, Qualys, Darktrace, Palo Alto, Illumio, CyberArk, Delinea, Device42, or similar platforms.
  • Experience working in complex, regulated, telecom, infrastructure-heavy, or enterprise-scale environments.

job.title: Lead Security Architect & Risk Assessment
job.description:
Summary

Lead Security Architect is a senior cybersecurity leader responsible for driving the organization’s enterprise-wide Security Architecture strategy. This role oversees implementation of Zero Trust secure architecture principles, deliver threat models, security reference architectures and design patterns.

This role will partner closely with enterprise architects, solution designers, application teams, technology infrastructure, devsecops, project management and executive leadership to deliver secure and resilient solutions.

Singtel has diverse technology ecosystems and lead security architect needs to be able to cope with varying complexities in terms of business requirements, system, network and application architecture. Additionally, while there are differing business and technical considerations, Architect needs to able to align the stakeholders from Singtel IT and Enterprise to adopt common Zero Trust technology components.

This role will report into the Head of Information Security Architecture and Risk Assessment.

How You will Make An Impact:

Strategic Leadership:

  • Establish Zero Trust security architecture strategy and execution across Singtel IT and Enterprise.
  • Plan, prioritize and develop roadmap to enhance Cyber capabilities and incorporate into Annual Operating Plan.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and new trends in Cybersecurity.
  • Keep abreast of emerging risks, industry wide attacks and mitigations.

Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Present thematic architecture gaps and risk posture to executive leadership and governance committees.
  • Translate technical cyber risks into business impact language.

Initiatives and Programs Oversight:

  • Lead execution of Zero trust security initiatives across Singtel IT and Enterprise Business.
  • Perform Threat Modelling and Risk Assessments across various Singtel IT and Enterprise projects.
  • Develop reusable Security reference architectures and design patterns.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or its equivalent.
  • 8 Years or more relevant experience
  • Network Security such as macro/micro segmentation, ZTNA, SASE, SDWAN, Perimeter security.
  • Infrastructure and Systems Security.
  • Threat Modelling.
  • Zero Trust Security Architecture.
  • Experience in Security by Design principles.
  • One or more Industry security Certifications such as CCIE, CISSP, CISM, CCSP or other equivalent industry certifications.
  • Orchestrate across cross-functional teams, make sound decisions under pressure, and manage expectations.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management decision-making, communication, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Manager, Electrical Engineering (Data Centre)
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

Passionate about making a real impact? Join our team at Nxera to unfold the new era! Be at the forefront of the data centre (DC) industry with a unique focus on sustainability, connectivity and AI which sets us apart as the next generation DC operator. You will also get to gain invaluable experience in a fast-growing industry that is powering the digitalisation wave. Be empowered to co-create the future ~~~~ with our dynamic teams!

We are seeking candidate who has experienced in M&E Data Centre subject matter expert to join our team. He/she will be part of the Electrical and Mechanical (M&E) engineering team for the Data Centre Business.

Make an impact by:

Design and Development

  • Develop next generation Mission Critical System to meet company long term strategies.
  • Develop concept Critical Data Centre equipment design with focus on Electrical Power System. i.e. EHT Transformer, Switch Bay, Ring Main Unit, Transformers.
  • Develop concept designs which meet or exceed quality requirements and fall within our budgetary and meet energy efficiency requirements.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, regional vendors and manufacturers to specify the appropriate Electrical system both upstream and downstream infrastructure.
  • Data Centre Electrical designs and collaboration with other disciplines to create construction document set.
  • Proposes some Electrical engineering knowledge that enabling to read and understand SLD, Electrical distribution layout and basic equipment electrical specification requirement to liaise with Electrical and commissioning counterpart for work deliveries.
  • Resourceful in continuously exploring for new engineering system and/or technology for Data Centre application with an aim to enhance or improve overall performance, lower energy, and water consumption, increase operation productivity and reduce total cost of ownership.
  • Liaise with Energy and Sustainability manager to examine and assess systems design and equipment selection are good in operating efficiency with low energy and water consumption to drive low PUE and WUE for all our DCs.

Review

  • Review RFIs documentation submittal from Consultants, Vendor and Manufacturers.
  • Review Data Centre commissioning scripts and ensure that systems are accurately tested to the required modes of operations.
  • Review design and construction drawings and engineering specification for Data Centre

Evaluation

  • Evaluate industry new technology to improve power consumption, quality, and efficiencies.
  • Evaluate the design, construction and operation of mission-critical facilities and associated M&E components.

Skills for Success :

  • Ability to perform complex business case analysis to justify technical decisions and present the justification to Management.
  • Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
  • Ability to travel oversea to support Data Centre construction and implementation.
  • Ability to incorporate Renewable Energy System to the Distribution Network.
  • Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and start-up as needed.
  • Manage Electrical Power System issues during concept design, detailed design, procurement, bidding, manufacturing, delivery, and installation on site.
  • Update and maintain the internal design specifications, drawings, and standards in accordance with the latest configurations and including all 'lessons learned' in relation to all equipment.
  • Provide and prepare documentation such as statement of work, engineering reports, design documents, total cost of ownership analysis, drawing markup, budget, schedule, commissioning, design specification etc.
  • Electrical power fundamental knowledge in load flow, fault analysis and protection
  • Knowledge of local Code of Practice and regulations.
  • Knowledge of large-scale mission critical facility’s M&E infrastructure systems. Ability to think outside of the box to find creative and innovative solutions to reduce costs with no compromise on quality and system reliability.

Qualification and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or relevant discipline.
  • 5+ years of M&E design experience in Mission Critical Data Centre environment.
  • Good communication skills, written and verbal, to all levels of Management.
  • Strong organization skills and ability to prioritize workload to meet tight deadline in a fast paced and dynamic work environment.
  • Experience with fast-track design/build project.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

job.title: Senior Software Engineer (MCP)
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”._

Be a Part of Something BIG!

Singtel is transforming into an AI-driven digital technology enterprise, delivering scalable, secure, and intelligent solutions across customer, network, and enterprise domains. As part of this transformation, Singtel is strengthening its internal engineering leadership to design and govern enterprise-grade AI platforms and automation capabilities.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to provide technical leadership across for new initatives. This role plays a critical part in shaping solution architecture, guiding delivery standards, and managing vendor and offshore engineering teams to ensure consistent, high-quality outcomes.

Make an Impact by:

AI and MCP agents

  • Design and Develop the MCP agents, tools and architect the MCP governance to be consumed by business flows
  • Design and govern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, including data ingestion, indexing, retrieval pipelines, and response orchestration.
  • Provide technical direction for development of MCP tools and AI-enabled services delivered by internal, vendor, and offshore teams.
  • Ensure AI solutions are production-ready, scalable, observable, and aligned with Singtel’s enterprise architecture standards.

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Own end-to-end technical solution design and architecture decisions for AI and automation initiatives.
  • Establish engineering standards, design principles, and best practices across AI platforms and backend systems.
  • Review and approve detailed technical designs, code structure, and deployment approaches produced by vendors or offshore teams.
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools, platforms, and technologies, recommending adoption where there is clear business value and operational readiness.
  • Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies, and architectural trade-offs. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, providing technical guidance and reviewing critical designs.

Vendor & Offshore Resource Management

  • Provide technical governance and oversight for vendors and offshore delivery teams, ensuring adherence to Singtel’s architecture, security, and quality standards.
  • Review vendor deliverables, validate designs, and ensure compliance with functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Guide task decomposition, estimation, and prioritisation to support effective offshore delivery.
  • Act as the technical escalation point for delivery issues, architectural deviations, or quality concerns involving external partners.
  • Support capability uplift of vendor and offshore teams through technical guidance, standards, and knowledge transfer.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with product owners, enterprise architects, cybersecurity, data, and operations teams to align AI solutions with business objectives.
  • Communicate technical decisions, risks, and progress clearly to internal stakeholders and leadership.
  • Facilitate alignment across multiple delivery teams operating across time zones.

Operations, Security & Governance

  • Ensure AI systems comply with Singtel’s cybersecurity, data governance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Guide operational readiness, monitoring, and support models for AI-enabled platforms.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and remediation for complex production issues affecting AI services.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
  • At least 6 years of experience as software developer.
  • 2-4 years AI/ML development; Experience leading complex system design and architecture
  • Experience managing vendors or offshore teams
  • Experience designing and integrating AI/ML solutions into production systems;
  • Ability to evaluate feasibility, risk, and operational impact of AI solutions
  • Significant experience in prompt engineering and prompt design for LLMs and GenAI applications.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python/Node.js/Go/Java;
  • Strong system design, API architecture, and distributed systems expertise;
  • Ability to conduct technical design and code reviewsStrong experience with AWS/GCP/Azure;
  • Proficiency with container platforms and deployment pipelines;
  • Operational readiness and observability experienceStrong understanding of secure coding, API security, identity/access management, and data governance
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Ability to influence vendors and offshore teams;
  • Strong decision-making and problem-solving

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: Bid Manager
job.description:
Company:Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Lead and manage end-to-end bidding pursuit process. Be the overall-in-charge of RFP document development, preparation and to ensure high quality proposals are submitted on time.
  • Direct the pursuit strategy to properly position the firm’s market leadership, capabilities, resources, and overall credentials to win the new business opportunity.
  • To perform effective engagement with bid stakeholders, customers, overseas offices and partners for bid submission.
  • Work closely with Sales to understand customers’ requirements and business environment in order to formulate bid win strategies and value proposition for proposals.
  • Manage and negotiate with partners and vendors' on commitments and commercial terms.
  • Ensure bid proposals adhere to finance and legal guidelines; Manage risk log and mitigation plan.
  • Drive commercial strategy and manage customer contract and commercial deliverables.
  • Work with Pricing and Finance stakeholders to ensure proposed pricing is in line with overall bid strategy, establish pricing structure that meets business/corporate target margins and have gained internal approvals for customer submission.
  • Facilitate deal presentation and contract negotiation with customers.
  • Assess and address commercial and contractual risks relating to the bid being worked on, manage risk register for strategic and complex bids and work with stakeholders on mitigation strategies.
  • Monitor bid trends, maintain reporting on current bid activities, business drivers and future market trends.
  • Support in driving bid related digitalisation initiatives.
  • Gather and analyze feedback from completed bids to identify areas for improvement. Track win/loss outcomes and integrate learnings into future bids to enhance success rates.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Business Studies, IT Engineering or Economics.
  • 8 years of related bid management experience.
  • Project Management Skill and Contract Negotiation Skill
  • Financial Analysis and Modelling
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to understand and interpret data as well as being able to present data in a compelling manner.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Brisbane Inner City
job.description:
Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital experiences that help people feel more connected.

We’re searching for positive, customer focused Retail Service Consultant to join one of our our Brisbane Innter City teams in aFull-Timecapacity. If you love helping people, thrive in a supportive team environment, and bring energy to every conversation, we’d love to have you on board.

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships, with our customers and with each other.

Your day to day:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Build strong product knowledge and become an expert across the full range of tech solutions, explaining everything in a friendly, simple and accessible way.
  • Use your personality, listening skills and service centric approach to understand customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Support customers through all enquiries, anything from general questions to complex issues, using empathy, clear communication and calm de‑escalation.
  • Contribute to a welcoming, customer first environment by working closely with your team and helping create memorable moments for every visitor.
  • Stay adaptable and proactive, stepping up in periods of high activity and jumping in where needed to keep the store running smoothly.

It starts with you!

  • Service Superpower: You naturally focus on customer needs, offer genuine support, and let great service lead to phenomenal outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers understand technology, breaking it down simply and guiding them to the right solution.
  • Problem Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with genuine curiosity and integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You stay steady during tricky situations, easing tension with care and working toward the best result for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support and educate one another, stay accountable and create a space where everyone succeeds together.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and access to exclusive discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Embrace what matters most with a paid Connected Day each year to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • Build meaningful connections through people-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • We support growing families, with inclusive paid parental leave (up to 14 weeks for primary caregiver).

We encourage you to apply, even if this is something new to you!None of us fits every requirement, and we all learn, grow and develop together. This could be the excellent next step in your retail or customer service journey.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

job.title: Technical Specialist - NaaS Exposure
job.description:
It starts with YES!

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

About the role

As a Technical Specialist, NaaS Exposure (API Gateway Platform Owner), you will lead the strategy, governance and ongoing evolution of Optus' API Gateway platform within the Network as a Service (NaaS) domain. Partnering across Network, Security, Operations and Product teams, you will ensure the platform remains secure, scalable and operationally resilient while driving adoption, governing integrations and enabling network modernisation through a seamless API ecosystem.

Your day to day

  • Own and evolve the API Gateway platform strategy, roadmap, governance framework, and service portfolio, ensuring alignment with NaaS objectives, network transformation initiatives, and business requirements.
  • Lead platform operations and lifecycle management, including capacity planning, licensing, observability, security governance, compliance, patching, upgrades, resiliency, and end-of-life risk mitigation.
  • Establish and maintain platform standards, documentation, integration patterns, and service governance processes, including API design, interface contracts, access management, onboarding/offboarding, and connectivity requirements.
  • Drive stakeholder, vendor, and operational engagement by managing change activities, support contracts, procurement assessments, migration planning, incident support, and collaboration across the broader NaaS Exposure portfolio.

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Demonstrated experience in platform or product ownership within telecommunications, networking, cloud, or infrastructure environments, supported by a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline, with strong knowledge of API gateway technologies, API lifecycle management, integration patterns, and enterprise service delivery.
  • Strong technical expertise in platform security, compliance, and risk management, including identity and access controls, vulnerability management, certificate lifecycle administration, cyber governance, and patching frameworks.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute platform roadmaps, lifecycle strategies, observability models, and change management processes to support secure, resilient, and scalable services in complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong stakeholder, vendor, and commercial management skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams, managing procurement and contracts, and leveraging automation and enterprise platforms such as Ansible, RHEL, VMware, Kubernetes, OpenShift, and related technologies.

The good stuff…

  • Competitive remuneration and colleague discounts. Make life easier—and more affordable—with $80 monthly credit, 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.

job.title: Director, Application Delivery
job.description:
Summary

The Director, Application Delivery is accountable for the strategy, architecture, roadmap, delivery,modernization, and operational performance of technology platforms that enable customer care operations in Singtel.

The role leads the evolution of customer service systems spanning assisted and digital channels, including contact centre platforms, case management, knowledge management, workforce enablement,conversational AI and integration with billing, order management, network, and digital platforms.

The Director will work closely with Customer Experience, Service Delivery & Ops, Product Development,Technology, Data & AI and business unit leaders to modernize and simplify the customer care ecosystems,technology landscape, improve service outcomes, increase automation and agent productivity and reduce

cost-to-serve.

The Director will oversee solution performance and service continuity across multiple call centre sites.Ensure systems are stable, responsive and aligned with business needs.

There are 4 key portfolio for this role:

a) Contact Center Platform

b) Fulfilment Systems

c) Order Assurance (Fallout Orders Management)

d) L1 support for Consumer IT

The Director, Application Delivery displays a forward-looking perspective, inspirational and decisive in envisioning the future of Care Platforms powered by Digital and AI in Singtel. He/She is an influential leader who is able to communicate his ideas persuasively and engage with team members and other stakeholders.

How You will Make An Impact:

Care and Fulfilment Platform - Technology Strategy & Transformation

  • Define and own the multi-year Care Systems strategy and roadmap, aligned with customer experience, digital transformation, and technology objectives.
  • Modernize legacy care platforms toward scalable, cloud-based, API-driven and AI-enabled architectures.
  • Establish the target architecture for omnichannel customer care across voice, messaging, chat,social, retail and digital channels.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the application landscape, retire legacy systems, and reduce technology complexity and operating cost.
  • Translate emerging technologies—including generative AI, conversational AI and intelligent automation—into practical customer care capabilities

AI, Automation & Digital Care

  • Lead adoption of AI-enabled customer care, including agent assist, automated summarization, intelligent routing, next-best-action, knowledge retrieval and autonomous service journeys.
  • Expand customer self-service and straight-through processing while maintaining appropriate controls and escalation paths.
  • Partner with Data & AI teams to develop reusable customer intelligence and decisioning capabilities.
  • Establish gatekeeper for responsible and secure use of AI in customer interactions.

Architecture & Engineering Leadership

  • Establish architecture, engineering and platform standards for Care and Fulfilment systems.
  • Ensure systems are resilient, scalable, secure, observable and designed for high-volume telecommunications environments.
  • Drive API-first integration and reusable service capabilities across customer-facing platforms.
  • Balance modernization with the stability and availability requirements of mission-critical customer care services.
  • Ensure appropriate disaster recovery, business continuity and operational resilience.

Delivery & Portfolio Management

  • Own the Care and Fulfilment System; technology portfolio, investment roadmap and delivery priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to expand service capabilities and drive account growth through strategic planning and continuous improvement.
  • Lead large-scale transformation programs involving multiple business units, technology teams, systems integrators and software vendors.
  • Own end-to-end service delivery, ensuring all contractual commitments and project deliverables are achieved in alignment with business objectives.
  • Champion customer experience by adopting industry best practices and delivering high-quality, reliable services.
  • Ensure programs deliver against agreed scope, schedule, quality and financial objectives.
  • Oversee vendor solution delivery, ensuring proposed solutions align with business needs and service expectations.
  • Continuously enhance service offerings to maximize customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and business value.
  • Establish measurable business cases and track benefits realization.

Operational Excellence

  • Accountable for the availability, performance and service quality of critical care platforms.
  • Establish and monitor service-level objectives and operational KPIs.
  • Drive reduction in incidents, technical debt and recurring operational issues.
  • Manage service recovery activities and escalations, driving timely resolution and implementing preventive improvements.
  • Analyse service trends and operational metrics to proactively identify improvement opportunities and strengthen platform reliability.
  • Ensure compliance with ITIL service management processes, governance standards, and operational controls
  • Improve release management, automation, observability and DevSecOps practices.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for major incidents, ensuring rapid recovery within agreed SLAs while minimizing business impact.
  • Partner with Customer Operations to rapidly identify and resolve technology-related drivers of customer contacts.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Build trusted relationships with Business, Product, Operations, Architecture, Infrastructure, and executive stakeholders.
  • Provide concise executive updates on programme status, service health, major incidents, risks, and mitigation plans to senior leadership, including VP and CIO levels.
  • Lead governance forums, steering committees, and service review meetings to ensure alignment across all stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor performance, commercial engagements, and third-party partnerships to deliver agreed service levels and continuous value
  • Manage strategic relationships with major technology vendors, cloud providers and systems integrators.
  • Lead technology evaluation, vendor selection and commercial negotiations in partnership with Procurement.
  • Ensure vendor roadmaps and contractual commitments support the company's target architecture and strategic priorities.
  • Drive vendor performance, cost optimization and accountability for delivery outcomes.

Leadership, People Development and Management

  • Hire, lead, mentor and grow a team of architecture, solution design, engineering and operations
  • expertise that possesses business relevancy across Singtel & vendors, both offshore & onshore.
  • Build strong technical leadership and succession pipelines.
  • Foster a culture of customer obsession, engineering excellence, ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Influence senior executives and align stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
  • Promote continuous learning, engineering excellence, and customer-first delivery across the organisation.

Financial Management

  • Budgeting, tracking and forecasting capital & operational expenditure

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline (preferred).
  • Minimum 15 years experience in the ICT industry, with at least 10 years managing systems; call center platforms (_must have_), CRM, BSS or OSS (_good to have_).
  • People Leadership: Minimum 10 years experience in leading a large scale team responsible for Call Center Platform.
  • Technology leadership: Understands modern architecture, engineering, cloud and AI sufficiently deeply to challenge and guide technical teams.
  • Talent leadership: Builds high-performing teams and develops future technology leaders.
  • Strategic Vision: Ability to align technology initiatives with business goals, ensuring long-term sustainability and relevance in a rapidly evolving market.
  • Customer orientation: Connects technology decisions directly to customer experience and
  • operational outcomes.
  • Complex Project Delivery: Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale, end-to-end implementation projects involving both legacy and modern platfom.
  • Execution discipline: Converts strategy into measurable delivery outcomes and operations resiliency and stability.
  • IT Services Contract Expertise: Deep understanding of IT services contracts and complex implementation projects in both legacy and cloud-managed service environments.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong track record of engaging with internal and external stakeholders, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
  • Continuous Improvement: Commitment to adopting industry best practices and driving excellence through innovation and process optimization.
  • Strategic thinker who is creative in the design of technology strategy and who has a track record of building scalable and operationally sound Core Telco systems and growing operations teams
  • Deep understanding of Core Telco space with demonstrated success in defining and leading end to end digital telco implementations starting from concept, ideation, design, implementation, delivery to value realization for the business.
  • Expert commercial understanding, analytical, judgment and decision-making skills, along with problem-solving/conflict management skills and ability to filter and prioritize information.
  • Precise, clear and assertive communicator with strong negotiation skills with ability to liaise with stakeholders across the business and partners to facilitate delivery in an agile methodology.
  • Ability to explain technical information in business terms
  • Exceptional leadership skills. Ability to collaborate effectively and work closely with various functions internally and externally.
  • Ability to manage both direct reports and virtual teams to deliver the end results.
  • Highly organized, self-motivated, pro-active, and ability to manage time and projects
  • Result oriented mindset. Possesses passion to innovate, Able to plan and manage program budgets. Strong stakeholder, team and vendor management skills
  • Courageously drives change to achieve entrepreneurial goals

  • Knowledge with AD integration.
  • Diagnosis knowledge based on alert, cluster listener logs to check for the db core issues.

  • Good experience in managing oracle data guard and ensure DG/DR in synch all times and manage DR activities with Switchover/failover.Monitor and maintain database backups.

  • Prompt 24x7 support.

Skills for Success:

  • Minimum Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
  • Oracle Professional Certification
  • Added advantage if have additional certification like MS SQL /MYSQL/EDB /POSTGRES/MONGO Professional Certification
  • Minimum 3 year of experience in Oracle(Standalone +RAC/Cluster)
  • Plus work experience on MS SQL /MYSQL/EDB/Postgres/MongoDB
  • Extensive experience in managing common Database platform like Oracle, and to have another db flavour PostgreSQL/MSSQL/MYSQL/MONGO/POSTGRES Including Cluster architecture
  • Experience in performing database Patching, backup & recovery as well as excellent troubleshooting and performance tuning skill is a must.(Including cluster architecture)
  • Implement Database hardening as per CIS Benchmarks.
  • Implement and manage DR,Audit, Backup & Monitoring of DBs.
  • Strong analytical skills for problem-solving database-related issues.
  • Big picture thinking - the ability to see how parts interact with the whole
  • Good knowledge of IT governance and operations
  • Ability to influence an outcome without creating conflict
  • Customer service orientation

job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Summary

As an experienced Full-Stack AI Engineer, you will design, build, and deploy end-to-end, AI-native applications. You will own the entire feature lifecycle—from designing intuitive frontend user interfaces that handle streaming AI data, to building robust backend architectures, orchestrating complex LLM or agentic workflows, and managing vector databases and cloud infrastructure. You are a generalist with architectural breadth and deep specialization in applying AI to practical software challenges.

How You will Make An Impact:

1. Applied AI & Intelligent Orchestration

  • Orchestration & Workflow Design: Build complex multi-agent frameworks, task routing systems, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows using orchestration engines like LangChain or LangGraph.
  • RAG & Vector Management: Architect high-performance Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. Design indexing strategies, chunking mechanisms, and hybrid search (semantic + keyword) utilizing vector databases.
  • Model Integration & Optimization: Integrate state-of-the-art LLMs and foundational models via commercial APIs or self-hosted inference setups. Implement strategies to manage model latency, token constraints, context windows, and fallback mechanisms.
  • Evaluation & Guardrails: Establish AI evaluation frameworks to test for hallucinations, drift, and accuracy. Implement prompt safety, structural validation, and robust guardrails to handle non-deterministic outputs safely.

2. Full-Stack Application Architecture

  • Backend & API Engineering: Design high-concurrency, asynchronous backend services using Python (FastAPI) or Node.js/TypeScript. Develop robust RESTful APIs and optimize interactions using Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems where applicable.
  • AI-Native Frontend Experiences: Build responsive, stateful UIs using React or Next.js. Implement streaming response interfaces (HTTP Stream), chat architectures, agentic UI interaction models, and intuitive data visualizations for complex model outputs.
  • Data Management: Design relational schemas and manage transactional data workflows using databases like PostgreSQL, while pairing them seamlessly with unstructured data pipelines.

3. Infrastructure

  • Containerization & Deployment: Package application layers using Docker
  • Cloud Architecture: Architect scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions across cloud ecosystems like AWS or Azure
  • CI/CD & Observability: Build automated deployment and test pipelines (e.g., Bitbucket & Bamboo). Implement advanced logging, error tracing, and observability tooling to monitor both typical software failures and LLM costs/latencies.

Skills for Success:

  • Minimum Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
  • AI / LLM Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini APIs
  • Vector Databases: pgvector (PostgreSQL), Azure AI Search
  • Backend Engineering: Python (FastAPI), Node.js, Java, TypeScript, API Gateway
  • Frontend Engineering: React, Next.js, State Management (Zustand/Redux), SSE/WebSockets
  • Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS S3 / Cloud Storage
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Azure, Docker, CI/CD Monitoring ( OpenTelemetry)

job.title: Senior Data Scientist, Enterprise AI #AIDA
job.description:
Powering the Future with AIDA

To lead the next phase of our AI evolution, we’ve launched a new business unit AIDA – Artificial Intelligence & Data Analytics – a strategic engine driving our transformation designed to scale our AI ambitions with precision and purpose. This marks a pivotal shift in how we operate, innovate, and serve to embed intelligence into every layer of our business.

At Singtel, this is more than a technology upgrade. It’s a strategic transformation that redefines how value is created across the enterprise core—augmenting human capabilities and unlocking entirely new potential. It is a transformation journey by aligning people, platforms, and processes under one cohesive strategy. Our mission is to build AI literacy and foster a culture where intelligence empowers people.

We welcome you to join us on a transformational journey that’s reshaping the telecommunications industry — and redefining what’s possible with AI at its core. Grow with us in a workplace that champions innovation, embraces agility, and puts human potential at the heart of everything we do.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As a Senior Data Scientist within the AI & Data Analytics (AIDA) business unit, you will play a critical role in designing and deploying enterprise-scale AI solutions that drive intelligent decision-making across Singtel’s business domains.

This role goes beyond traditional analytics to focus on high-impact AI use cases, including pricing optimization, anomaly detection, and predictive intelligence across network, customer, and operational environments.

You will develop and operationalize advanced AI/ML models and simulation frameworks to:

  • Optimize pricing strategies and revenue outcomes
  • Detect anomalies and risks in real time across large-scale data systems
  • Enable proactive, automated decisioning across enterprise workflows

You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g. Network, Finance, Enterprise Business, Product, and Operations) to translate complex business challenges into scalable AI solutions, leveraging advanced machine learning, optimization techniques, and Generative AI where applicable.

Make an impact by:

  • Lead Data Science Initiatives:Drive end-to-end AI programs focused on enterprise use cases, including pricing optimization, anomaly detection, and forecasting. Partner with business and technical stakeholders to define problem statements and architect scalable AI-driven solutions aligned with strategic priorities.
  • AI Solution Development & Integration: Build and productionize scalable AI pipelines and decision systems, integrating models into enterprise platforms and workflows. Ensure robustness in model governance, explainability, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Cross-Domain Data & Insight Generation: Leverage diverse datasets (network, customer, financial, operational) to uncover insights and enable:
  • Root cause analysis via anomaly detection
  • Scenario testing via digital twins
  • Optimization of business levers such as pricing, capacity, and resource allocation
  • Data Exploration & Experimentation: Enable robust data exploration, insight discovery, and experimentation for lifecycle marketing campaigns. Devise and execute rigorous A/B tests, segmentations, and optimization strategies to continuously improve business outcomes.
  • Technical Mentorship & Code Quality: Provide guidance to junior data scientists and collaborate on code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices, maintain high code quality, and promote knowledge sharing within the team.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor or Postgraduate degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a related field, with at least 3 years of relevant working experience.
  • Telecom or Insurance industries Sales / Marketing analytics experience will be an advantage.
  • Deep technical and data science expertise, demonstrating proficiency in:

a) Machine Learning & Statistical Modelling: Including linear regression, GLMs, time series forecasting, supervised learning (e.g., gradient boosted trees, neural networks), segmentation, clustering, design of experiments, and causal inference.

b) LLMs & Generative AI: Fine-tuning and evaluation of large language models (e.g., GPT, LLaMA), prompt engineering, red-teaming, and performance monitoring

c) Efficient data manipulation (with skills in SQL, Python, Spark, Hadoop/Hive, and Databricks) and data visualization (using tools like Power BI).

d) Familiar with software engineering best practices, including modular code design, reproducibility, and testing. Proficient with version control tools such as GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AWS, GCP) and ML lifecycle tools (e.g., MLflow, Airflow)
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and solve complex business problems through data analysis.
  • A team player with a customer-focused mindset, able to work well in a team and passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Excellent data visualization and communication skills, with the ability to present insights and findings in a clear, concise, and compelling manner, both in written and verbal form.
  • Experience in mentoring junior team members through collaborative problem solving, pair programming, and constructive code reviews.

job.title: Assistant Store Manager, Port Macquarie
job.description:
As one of Australia’s top telecommunications providers, Optus connects more than 11 million customers daily across mobile, broadband and digital products.

We’re looking to bring on board a supportive, driven and people focused Assistant Store Manager / 2IC to join our Port Macquarieteam. If you love developing others, energising a team, delivering outstanding customer experiences and stepping into a challenge of leadership with confidence, then take the next step in your career with us.

At Optus, we collaborate with purpose, support one another, take accountability, act with integrity and celebrate our wins as one team. Together, we learn, grow, overcome challenges and build genuine connections, both with our customers and with each other. As a Second in Charge, you’ll play a key role in helping to develop the store’s culture, driving performance outcomes and contributing to its overall success.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead by example, supporting your Store Manager to create a positive, high-performance culture where your team feels motivated, included and confident to shine.
  • Support the store manager to coach, mentor and develop team members through clear guidance, meaningful feedback and day to day support, helping them deliver exceptional customer experiences.
  • Help to maintain an energised, customer first environment that feels warm, welcoming and inspiring for both customers and your team.
  • Support smooth daily operations, from team coordination to service delivery, while finding opportunities to uplift performance, efficiency and customer experience.
  • Handle escalated customer enquiries with calm professionalism, modelling effective de‑escalation techniques and guiding the team through various situations.
  • Help to drive team engagement by celebrating wins, supporting goal setting, encouraging continuous learning and strengthening collaboration.

What you bring:

  • Supportive Leadership: You empower others through your actions, integrity and encouragement, helping people to perform at their best.
  • Customer First Coaching: You lead by example, coaching and supporting the team to deliver memorable experiences and always keep customers at the heart of their actions.
  • Calm Under Pressure: You stay composed during reactive or complex situations, modelling effective de‑escalation and helping your peers to manage challenges with care.
  • Operational & Business Awareness: You have a strong grasp of retail operations, know what drives performance, and showcase balanced step up to leadership with store efficiencies.
  • Team Culture & Adaptability: You support to build an inclusive team environment and stay flexible and solutions focused when priorities shift or customer needs change.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and exclusive access to unique discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and special shopping discounts with our retail and corporate partners.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ day to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 14 weeks.
  • Build future ready skills through Optus U, with industry micro credentials created alongside La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, available 24/7 across multiple channels.

Not sure you meet every requirement? Don’t let that hold you back. We value potential just as much as experience, and this role might be exactly where your next chapter begins.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

job.title: Retail Consultant, Burleigh
job.description:
Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital experiences that help people feel more connected.

We’re searching for positive, customer focused Retail Service Consultant to join ourBurleigh Headsteam in a Part-Timecapacity. If you love helping people, thrive in a supportive team environment, and bring energy to every conversation, we’d love to have you on board.

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships, with our customers and with each other.

Your day to day:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Build strong product knowledge and become an expert across the full range of tech solutions, explaining everything in a friendly, simple and accessible way.
  • Use your personality, listening skills and service centric approach to understand customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Support customers through all enquiries, anything from general questions to complex issues, using empathy, clear communication and calm de‑escalation.
  • Contribute to a welcoming, customer first environment by working closely with your team and helping create memorable moments for every visitor.
  • Stay adaptable and proactive, stepping up in periods of high activity and jumping in where needed to keep the store running smoothly.

It starts with you!

  • Service Superpower: You naturally focus on customer needs, offer genuine support, and let great service lead to phenomenal outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers understand technology, breaking it down simply and guiding them to the right solution.
  • Problem Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with genuine curiosity and integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You stay steady during tricky situations, easing tension with care and working toward the best result for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support and educate one another, stay accountable and create a space where everyone succeeds together.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and access to exclusive discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Embrace what matters most with a paid Connected Day each year to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • Build meaningful connections through people-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • We support growing families, with inclusive paid parental leave (up to 14 weeks for primary caregiver).

We encourage you to apply, even if this is something new to you!None of us fits every requirement, and we all learn, grow and develop together. This could be the excellent next step in your retail or customer service journey.

job.title: #EG Project Management Roles
job.description:
Overview

As anInfrastructure Project Manageryou will be responsible for the managing and implementing of Infrastructure-based projects with quality, within scope and to ensure deliverables are on time and conform to processes and standards meeting customer’s requirements.The Infrastructure Project Manager is also responsible for the following scope in addition to project administration, resource scheduling, project financial health monitoring, risk/issue management and quality assurance.

The broad area of your job responsibilities should cover the following:

What will you do?

Project & Service Management

  • Lead, deliver and maintain projects within time, scope, and cost
  • Ensure project delivery quality
  • Plan & establish project schedules, quality plans, budgets, and communication and risk management plans
  • Manage issues arising out of scope definition and disputes that impacted scope, schedule, and cost
  • Manage issues arising from integration of various components of the project, e.g. hardware, software installation, testing, business process review, redesign, application development, migration and data conversion etc
  • Manage project financials, ensuring project cost/ revenue forecast is done accurately
  • Oversee the implementation of the project with regards to schedules, budget, manpower and quality
  • Resolve project overrun issues
  • Track project progress and report to Senior Management and Customer
  • Manage resources in terms of mobilising resources during different periods of time from team to team to maximise productivity or minimise wastage
  • Lead the project and service team on smooth project transition to operation in accordance to customer requirement and processes.
  • Manage project operation and ensure service level is maintained without financial penalty and security incident due to negligent or lack of awareness

Customer/Vendor/ Stakeholder Management

  • Manage contracts and subcontractors
  • Effectively engaged stakeholders in project decisions and execution
  • Build long-term customer relationships by anticipating and exceeding customer’s expectation
  • Negotiate with customers on change control mechanism to meet schedules and prioritize changes based on business needs
  • Strong customer-service orientation
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (IT operations, engineers, vendors) to ensure project success.
  • Scope and Risk Management: Oversee project scope, budget, and risk, ensuring alignment with network objectives.
  • Experience in managing government-approved vendors and contractors.
  • Understanding of procurement processes and contract management within the public sector.

Team Management

  • Work cohesively, lead, guide, manage and motivate the projects’ team members in delivering quality project works, eliminating project exceptions, and delighting the customers
  • Plan for optimal use of resources across teams comprising of Project and Technical competencies
  • Manage performance review of team and maintain open communication with team for feedback on continuous improvement
  • Ensure high individual and staff billability

Technical Skillsets:

  • Network and Server Infrastructure:Proficiency in designing, implementing, and managing network infrastructure components such as routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, servers, storage, middleware and VPNs.
  • Cloud Technologies:Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and their infrastructure services.
  • Virtualization:Knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM) for server consolidation and resource optimization.
  • Storage Solutions:Understanding of storage technologies (SAN, NAS, DAS) and data management.
  • Security:Awareness of security best practices, including access controls, encryption, and vulnerability management.
  • Project Management Tools:Proficiency in using project management software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Jira) for planning, tracking, and reporting.
  • Change Management:Knowledge of change control processes and tools to manage modifications to infrastructure.
  • ITIL Framework:Familiarity with ITIL principles for service management.
  • Scripting and Automation:Basic scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to automate repetitive tasks.
  • Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity:Understanding of DR/BC planning and implementation.

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Project Management Experience:The candidate should have experience managing public sector projects in Singapore and possess a valid active project management certificate (e.g. PMP, CITPM).
  • Understanding of IT Infrastructure:Familiarity with IT infrastructure components such as WAN, LAN, Internet, Voice, Video services, and structured cabling.
  • Teamwork and Leadership:Strong teamwork, leadership, issue resolution, and negotiation skills.
  • Communication Skills:Excellent communication skills, especially when working across remote teams.
  • Adaptability:Ability to thrive under pressure, handle multiple projects, and adapt to a dynamic environment.
  • Quick Learner:Proven ability to think critically and quickly learn new technologies.
  • Familiar with government regulations, security standards, and compliance requirements specific to Singapore.
  • Knowledge of data protection laws (such as the Personal Data Protection Act) and cybersecurity guidelines.

We are driven by ourAEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We arecommitted to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we_make the extraordinary happen__._

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

job.title: Senior AI Solution Architect #AIDA
job.description:
Summary

As a Senior AI Solution Architect, you will serve as the technical expert in architecting enterprise-grade and end-to-end AI solutions across Singtel. Working within the AI & Data Analytics (AIDA) business unit, you will drive the design, integration, and deployment of scalable AI workflows that are secure, interoperable, and business-aligned.

This role sits at the intersection of data, platforms and business systems that plays a critical role in translating AI vision into actionable architecture and technical designs. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams across Networks, IT, and external partners to ensure that AI solutions are integrated seamlessly into existing infrastructures and future-ready ecosystems.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Design end-to-end AI solutions that are robust, scalable, and span data ingestion, model deployment, API orchestration, and business system integration across hybrid cloud and on-prem environments
  • Architect and deliver solutions for the Central AI platform, encompassing Agentic AI, AI Workbench and Tooling, Model Management, shared RAG service, MCP, AI Runtime environments, etc
  • Develop solution blueprinting by translating business needs into technical architecture, including selecting appropriate tools, frameworks, and infrastructure for AI model development and operations
  • Integrate AI capabilities with internal APIs, enterprise platforms and user-facing applications in IT and Networks including LLM-based and agentic workflows
  • Ensure secure and compliant architecture in collaboration with cybersecurity and governance teams, embedding PDPA and enterprise policy requirements into designs
  • Evaluate and recommend AI platforms and tools (e.g. Portkey, Databricks, open-source toolkits) based on enterprise goals and technical fit
  • Collaborate with AI engineering and data teams to operationalize AI models, ensuring architectural alignment, scalability, and lifecycle support
  • Contribute to proof-of-concepts (PoCs), technical evaluations, and prototyping efforts under supervision
  • Stay current with AI technologies and best practices in integration, model lifecycle management, and platform operations
  • Participate in architecture reviews, technical discussions, and sprint planning with cross-functional teams.
  • Define and enforce architectural standards, reusable design patterns, open-standard, and reference implementations to streamline AI deployment across business units
  • Provide technical leadership in prototyping, experimentation, vendor technology evaluations, and innovation pilots
  • Stay updated on emerging AI technologies such as vector databases, context-aware agents, orchestration protocols (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, A2A, etc) and assess their applicability within the enterprise
  • Responsible for leading solutioning activities and managing a small development team consists of AI engineer and application developer for selected use cases

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data, AI/ML, or related field.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in solution architecture in AI/ML platform integration, data pipeline design and API-driven systems
  • Proven expertise in designing and integrating end-to-end AI workflows, including data pipelines, model orchestration, and serving APIs across hybrid cloud environments

Good to have:

  • Certification on Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP or Databricks.
  • More than 5 years of experience in enterprise architecture.
  • Proven experience working in a telco environment or implementing AI platforms on-premise or in the cloud (e.g., Microsoft Azure, AWS, etc.).
  • Experience with on-premise data lake platforms such as Cloudera and HPE Ezmeral.

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.
