job.title: Head of Industry Marketing
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

17 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Head of Industry Marketing

Job Summary

Job Description

Who We Are

At Telstra, we're building a connected future where everyone can thrive. As Australia's leading telecommunications and technology company, we help businesses connect, transform and grow through innovative technology solutions, customer-centric experiences and trusted partnerships. Within Telstra Enterprise, we work with some of Australia's largest organisations to solve complex challenges and unlock new opportunities for growth.

Focus of the Role

As the Head of Industry Marketing, you will play a pivotal leadership role within Telstra Enterprise, shaping how we engage and grow across key industries in Australia.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, Telstra Enterprise, you will lead the development and execution of industry-led marketing strategies that drive customer engagement, influence pipeline growth and deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

This is a highly visible leadership role operating at the intersection of Marketing and Sales, requiring strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking and exceptional stakeholder influence. You will lead a team of experienced marketers and partner closely with senior Sales leaders and executive stakeholders to ensure marketing investment is aligned to growth priorities, customer needs and revenue outcomes.

Your ability to connect strategy with execution, inspire high performance and foster a strong team culture will be critical to success.

What We Offer

Performance-related pay Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up Global presence across 22 countries; opportunities to work where we do business.

Purchased annual leave scheme

Additional Telstra day off

Additional 30% off Telstra products and services

Toolkit provided (laptop + mobile phone + plan paid for)

What You'll Do

As the Head of Industry Marketing, you will:

  • Lead the industry marketing strategy for Telstra Enterprise, aligning priorities to growth ambitions and sales objectives.
  • Drive measurable commercial outcomes through integrated, full-funnel marketing programs, with accountability for influenced pipeline and performance targets.
  • Develop marketing strategies grounded in a deep understanding of Enterprise customers, industry segments, buying journeys and market needs.
  • Partner closely with senior Sales leaders and executive stakeholders to ensure strong alignment between marketing and commercial priorities.
  • Lead, coach and inspire a team of senior marketers, creating an environment that enables high performance, growth and accountability.
  • Build and maintain strong planning, prioritisation and execution disciplines to ensure the team delivers impact at pace.
  • Leverage data, insights and performance metrics to optimise investment decisions, campaign effectiveness and business outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance customer engagement, strengthen market positioning and accelerate growth across priority industries.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation and collaboration across the broader Enterprise Marketing function.
  • Champion best-practice marketing approaches that enhance customer experiences and support long-term business success.

About You

You are an experienced and commercially focused marketing leader with a strong track record of driving business growth through strategic industry-led marketing. You understand how to translate customer and market insights into impactful marketing programs that deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

You are comfortable operating in complex stakeholder environments, influencing executive leaders and aligning diverse teams around a shared vision. Equally strategic and execution-focused, you thrive in fast-paced environments where accountability, collaboration and results matter.

To be successful in this role, you'll bring:

  • Extensive experience (15+ years) in B2B and/or B2E marketing leadership roles, with a strong understanding of Enterprise customers, industries and market dynamics.
  • Proven success delivering commercial outcomes through marketing, including ownership of pipeline contribution, demand generation and marketing performance metrics.
  • Deep understanding of Enterprise customer buying journeys and how marketing influences demand, engagement and growth.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience partnering with senior executives and commercial leaders.
  • Strong leadership experience building, developing and leading high-performing teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritise effectively, work at pace and deliver outcomes in dynamic environments.
  • Strong analytical and commercial capability, using data and insights to inform decisions and continuously optimise performance.
  • A collaborative leadership style that fosters trust, accountability, innovation and engagement.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience within technology, telecommunications or enterprise solutions environments.
  • Experience operating within large, complex matrix organisations.
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales teams to drive commercial outcomes.
  • Experience leading industry, portfolio or segment marketing functions.
  • Strong understanding of modern demand generation, account-based marketing and customer lifecycle marketing approaches.

Culture & Leadership

This role is as much about how you lead as what you deliver.

You are a leader who:

  • Builds engaged, high-performing teams grounded in trust, clarity and accountability.
  • Creates an environment where people feel supported, challenged and motivated to do their best work.
  • Brings a growth mindset, continually lifting standards, encouraging new thinking and improving the way teams operate.
  • Leads with energy, transparency and ownership, setting a strong example for performance and culture.
  • Champions collaboration and encourages diverse perspectives to achieve the best outcomes for customers and the business.

Why Join Us?

This role sits at the heart of Telstra Enterprise Marketing, connecting strategy to execution and marketing to commercial outcomes.

You will have the opportunity to shape how Telstra shows up across key industries, elevate our customer impact and lead a talented team that delivers exceptional results. If you're a strategic B2B marketing leader who thrives on pace, accountability and building high-performing teams, we'd love to hear from you.

If you enjoy collaborating with different people and delivering amazing experiences for customers, we want to hear from you.

*As part of your application with Telstra, you may receive communications from us on +61 440 135 548 (for job applications in Australia) and +1 (623) 400-7726 (for job applications in the Philippines and India).

When you join our team, you become part of a welcoming and inclusive community where everyone is respected, valued and celebrated. We actively seek individuals from various backgrounds, ethnicities, genders and disabilities because we know that diversity not only strengthens our team but also enriches our work. We have zero tolerance for harassment of any kind, and we prioritise creating a workplace culture where everyone is safe and can thrive.

As part of the hiring process, all identified candidates will undergo a background check, and the results will play a role in the final decision regarding your application.

We work flexibly at Telstra. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you. When you apply, you can share your pronouns and / or any reasonable adjustments needed to take part equitably during the recruitment process.

We are aware of current limitations with our website accessibility and are working towards improving this. Should you experience any issues accessing information or the application form, and require this in an alternate format, please contact our Talent Acquisition team on DisabilityandAccessibility@team.telstra.com or via the additional contact options found at www.telstra.com.au/careers/diversity-equity-and-inclusion/disability-employment*

job.title: Project Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Engineering Manager ###

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by applying basic design thinking/design for excellence concepts in projects.

The work model for the role is # LI - Hybrid.

This role is contributing to the to the Process Automation business in Energy Industries division based in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • As a Project Engineer – Automation, you will be responsible for the end‑to‑end engineering and execution of automation projects in Oil & Gas, Refinery, Chemicals, Specialty Chemicals, and emerging process industries.
  • You will independently execute projects from FEED stage through commissioning and handover, acting as a technical interface to end customers, while ensuring compliance with ABB quality, safety, and cybersecurity standards.
  • Execute automation projects from FEED / Concept Engineering through Detailed Engineering, FAT, SAT, Commissioning, and Project Closure
  • Deliver engineering scope in line with contract requirements, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and cybersecurity policies
  • Act as technical focal point for customers, EPCs, and internal stakeholders and identify technical risks early and propose mitigation strategies
  • Automation System Design & Engineering and Industrial Networking & Cybersecurity and Design and implement solutions using industrial communication protocols:

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Proven Project Engineer experience in automation projects and DCS, PLC.
  • Looking for 5–10 years of relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated execution of end‑to‑end projects (FEED → Commissioning)
  • Experience in Oil & Gas, Refinery, Chemicals, Specialty Chemicals
  • Willing to travel to abroad as per project requirements
  • BE / BTech in Control Engineering, Electrical, Electronics, or equivalent.

More about us

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reducing risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Perform month-end general accounting close for multiple legal entities across ASEAN countries. Prepare journal entries and account reconciliations for relevant balance sheet accounts to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Reconcile and document all general ledger accounts in accordance with established accounting procedures. Review and verify the accuracy of journal entries and ensure appropriate accounting classifications are applied.
  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls for the respective legal entities to ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage treasury and payroll functions for each country, including payment processing and cash flow management.
  • Oversee in-country compliance activities, including coordination of external audits and preparation of corporate and indirect tax filings. Ensure full compliance with all applicable government regulations.
  • Support the review and enhancement of corporate financial accounting policies and procedures. Recommend and implement improvements to accounting processes, financial reporting, and systems.
  • Lead and participate in special projects as required, such as general ledger enhancements and changes in accounting procedures or systems.

Skills Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline.
  • CPA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
  • Minimum of 4 years of relevant accounting or finance experience.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, practices, and standards, including Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Familiar with SEC, IRS, and FASB regulations and guidelines.
  • Proven ability to analyze business conditions and assess financial impacts.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to define problems, collect and interpret data, and provide practical solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal abilities.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and Power Platform tools (PowerApps, Power BI, Power Automate), with experience in ERP systems and other accounting software.

#LI-VF1

Why CommScope:

CommScope is on a quest to deliver connectivity that empowers how we live, work, and learn. Our employees push the boundaries of communications technology that enables game-changing discoveries like 5G, the Internet of Things, and gigabit speeds for everyone, everywhere. With our unmatched expertise in copper, fiber, and wireless infrastructure, our global clients rely on us to outperform today and be ready for the needs of tomorrow.

If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at CommScope.

CommScope is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans. If you are seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process, please contact us to submit your request at talentacquisition@commscope.com. You can also learn more about CommScope’s accommodation process and EEO policy at [https://jobs.commscope.com/eeo](https://jobs.commscope.com/eeo)

job.description:
Role: Service Technician-VRV/VRF

Location: Mumbai,Maharastra,India

Full/ Part-time: Full time

About Carrier:

job.title: Supervisor Data Analytics
job.description:
Job Description

Who are we?

At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected.  With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people.

We are currently seeking a Supervisor Data Analytics to join our dynamic team in Piove di Sacco (PD), Italy!

The Data Analyst Supervisor leads a team of data analysts (on-site and globally distributed) within the Customer Insight function, reporting to the Senior Manager Marketing Data Science. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines people management, project ownership, and deep technical contribution.

The supervisor owns the full BI delivery chain, from designing and optimizing ETL pipelines in Snowflake (in partnership with IT) through building robust Power BI data models and semantic layers, to delivering polished reports and apps to the right audiences. A critical part of the role is ensuring proper data governance: every stakeholder sees only the information they are authorized to access, based on business policies, organizational structure, and regional scope.

Beyond technical delivery, the role carries strong project management accountability: scoping, planning, and driving multiple concurrent BI initiatives from concept to production. The supervisor acts as the key bridge between the data team and the wider business, translating requirements Marketing and other functions into scalable, well-architected analytics solutions.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable mentoring junior analysts, challenging a data model design, presenting insights to senior leadership, and building long-term strategic relationships across regions and functions to keep data solutions aligned with where the business is heading.

What kind of work will you be doing?

Team Leadership & Project Management (40%):

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data analysts across multiple locations and time zones.
  • Plan and prioritize team workload, balancing recurring reporting activities with strategic BI projects.
  • Manage BI projects end-to-end: scoping, planning, execution, delivery, and post-launch optimization.
  • Conduct performance reviews, set development goals, and support career growth of team members.
  • Establish and maintain consistent methodologies, standards, and documentation across the team.
  • Gather requirements and align priorities with stakeholders across IT, Sales, Finance, and Operations.
  • Build and nurture strategic relationships with cross-regional and cross-functional partners to drive long-term alignment and unlock collaboration opportunities.

BI Architecture & Hands-On Delivery (30%):

  • Own the BI architecture and semantic layer design, partnering with IT on platform-level decisions and infrastructure while retaining ownership of the analytics and reporting layer.
  • Design and optimize the data flow from source to consumption: ETL pipelines in Snowflake, Power BI datasets, report delivery to end users.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports: advanced DAX, data modeling, calculated tables, and performance optimization.
  • Define and manage data access and visibility rules across all reports and apps, ensuring that each stakeholder and audience sees only the information they are authorized to access, based on business policies, organizational roles, and regional scope.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across all BI outputs.
  • Identify and implement improvements to reporting processes, automation, and self-service capabilities.

Surveys & Voice of Customer (20%):

  • Coordinate the team's VoC activities, overseeing survey design, execution, and analysis using Qualtrics across regions.
  • Ensure VoC results are translated into actionable insights that inform product, sales, and marketing decisions.
  • Guide the integration of survey data into the broader BI ecosystem to enrich reporting and segmentation.

AI/ML Support (10%):

  • Provide support to AI/ML initiatives when needed, contributing expertise on data readiness, quality, and pipeline integration.
  • Help the team explore opportunities to apply advanced analytics and automation to existing processes.

What will make you successful?

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field (Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, or related).
  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis, BI development, or analytics roles.
  • Proven experience leading or coordinating a team (even informally).
  • Advanced proficiency in Power BI: complex data models, DAX, workspace governance, app deployment, and audience-based access management.
  • Solid SQL skills: writing, optimizing, and troubleshooting queries in Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses.
  • Experience designing or managing ETL/ELT pipelines and understanding of data architecture principles.
  • Experience with data governance, access control, and compliance in BI environments.
  • Strong project management skills: ability to run multiple concurrent projects with clear timelines and deliverables.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication: ability to influence without authority across functions and regions.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).

Nice-to-Have

  • Python for data manipulation, automation, or analytics.
  • Experience with Qualtrics or similar survey platforms.
  • Exposure to AI/ML concepts and tools.
  • Experience in a global, matrix organization.
  • Knowledge of marketing analytics, customer segmentation, or pricing analysis.

What we are looking for

  • A hands-on leader who can switch between strategic thinking and getting into the detail.
  • Strong ownership mentality: takes accountability for delivery quality and team performance.
  • Ability to build trust and develop strategic relationships across regions and functions.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-changing, global environment.
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues and drives continuous improvement.
  • Availability for international travel.

If YOU are the person we are looking for, feel free to apply and let's start drafting your future career in a healthy and growing environment!

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPALS: Safety.  Integrity. Respect.  Teamwork.  Diversity & Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • High-Performance Culture
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

OUR BEHAVIORS

  • Own It
  • Act With Urgency
  • Foster a Customer-First Mindset
  • Think Big and Execute
  • Lead by Example
  • Drive Continuous Improvement
  • Learn and Seek Out Development

The anticipated salary range for this role in the Piove di Sacco, Italy locality is between  €43,921 to €55,000 gross per year, based on a 40-hour work week. Salary ranges for other geographic localities may vary. Certain roles may be eligible for additional benefits. Where applicable, a comprehensive overview of the full benefits package and any additional compensation will be provided during the initial interview. Compensation ranges are determined based on objective, gender-neutral criteria including skills, experience, and job responsibilities.

Job Description

Job Summary

The _Electrical Design Engineer_ will develop electrical design HDLC units such as In row CDU and In rack CDU as well as 2 phase products. He/she will closely follow objectives of quality, environment and costs working in cooperation with manufacturing engineering, controls engineering, procurement, suppliers, mechanical engineering, and product marketing. The Electrical Engineer will contribute to the release of new products; will work in a cross-functional development group; manage a variety of tasks and activities in a dynamic environment; and solve complex problems where no precedence exists.

This position will be based onsite at Vertiv's Ironton, OH location (3040 S 9th St., Ironton, OH 45638).

Responsibilities

  • Design new and low voltage electrical enclosures (>240 volts AC).
  • Harness Design, schematic creation and 3D modeling of wiring and cabling inside equipment.
  • Experience with CREO Cabling module is preferred.
  • Capable and proficient at understanding and applying various standards of NEC (NFPA70), CSA/UL, and IEEE to do a proper selection of electrical components that meet agencies requirements.
  • Collaboration and guideline across the disciplines of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, process engineering, as well as production and offering teams. Work with these teams for design reviews, meeting cost metrics, and brainstorming around customer pain points.
  • Performs a variety of engineering calculations using traditional engineering methods to verify design requirements
  • Extended Responsibilities:
  • Create, revise and audit unit wiring schematics and network connection drawings
  • Create, review and audit electric panel layouts following relevant codes and standards

job.title: Sr. Engineer Reliability Engineering XI
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Sr. Engineer – Reliability Engineering will be responsible for managing and executing product reliability testing and validation activities within the Reliability Lab. The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement.

The role will work closely with Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab.
  • Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements.
  • Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data-acquisition systems.
  • Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions.
  • Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures.
  • Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions.
  • Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability.
  • Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions.
  • Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams.
  • Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities.
  • Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers.
  • Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure.
  • Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation.
  • Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required.
  • Analyze reliability data and identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support development and improvement of reliability test methodologies and laboratory capabilities.

job.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the Solutions Engineer reporting to the Solutions Engineering Manager, you will work closely with the rest of the Technology – Technical Solutions team, as well as the Head of Customer Success, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Support the team by learning and understanding the customer and market requirements, ensuring business alignment
  • Help to drive the delivery of the customer solution and product through the complete data centre cycle
  • Support translating customer requirements into key design projects of our data centres in the India region and in preparing presentations to customers and executives.

Your Day to Day

  • Provide support to the Solutions Team in the RFP proposal and deliver key technical / engineering documents
  • Provide support in production of key technical and sales collateral – High Level M&E Schematic and Technical presentation materials
  • Assist in high-level space planning and engineering solutions for our customers
  • Involved in pioneering various engineering solutions relating to design, calculations and other engineering aspects
  • Assist in the development of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
  • Support in preparing pitch decks, presentation packs and collateral for customers and executives
  • Support the connectivity team working with carriers in the region

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree/Diploma in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE)
  • 5–8 years’ relevant experience, ideally within data centres, critical infrastructure, engineering consulting or technical solutions.
  • Fluent in MS Office (Power Point, Word, Excel) and good knowledge of BlueBeam and Basic AutoCad
  • Basic knowledge of CFD is an advantage but not required – this only applies if you’re mechanical trade
  • Analytical mindset
  • Good technical writing, documentation, and communication skills
  • Willing to learn, good attitude and proactive

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Head of Site Acquisition
job.description:
• Lead the development and execution of CDC's site acquisition strategy, ensuring a sustainable pipeline of development opportunities, enabling our future growth!
  • Make your mark in a newly created role, reporting into our Chief Development Officer
  • Role open to both Sydney and Melbourne-based candidates

About Us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand’s leading operator of secure, world-class data centre facilities. CDC plays a unique role in the fabric of the nations in which we operate, and we take this responsibility very seriously.

With multiple facilities across Australia and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide large-scale secure data centre campuses that support co-location, dedicated and hyperscale compute environments, with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

Reporting into our Chief Development Officer, the Head of Site Acquisition will play a critical role in shaping CDC's future growth strategy through the identification, assessment and acquisition of strategically important sites across Australia and New Zealand. This role will provide leadership across CDC's site acquisition function, helping build a long-term development pipeline that supports future customer demand and campus expansion. Working at the intersection of property, infrastructure, and development, you'll lead site acquisition initiatives from early-stage opportunity identification and feasibility through to transaction execution and handover into development. This is a highly visible role that partners across, landowners, utilities, government agencies and industry advisors, driving favourable outcomes for the business.

  • Lead the development and execution of CDC's site acquisition strategy, ensuring a sustainable pipeline of development opportunities aligned to long-term business objectives.
  • Manage site selection activities, including feasibility assessments, due diligence and development viability reviews.
  • Drive negotiations with landowners, agents, advisors and other key stakeholders to secure land and property interests.
  • Collaborate with utilities, network providers and government authorities to assess power, infrastructure and service requirements.
  • Prepare and present business cases, commercial recommendations and acquisition strategies to support investment decisions - ensuring recommendations are commercially sound, technically viable, and aligned to business priorities.
  • Partner closely with development, construction and operational teams to ensure a seamless transition of acquired sites into delivery.

What’s in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy - Make your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About You

Combining significant experience in site acquisition, land strategy, infrastructure development or major projects, you are a commercially savvy leader who knows how to identify opportunities, navigate complexity and influence diverse stakeholder groups to achieve successful outcomes. With strong commercial judgement and a relationship-driven approach, you're comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on delivery to secure favourable outcomes for the business.

  • Experience in site acquisition, infrastructure development, property development, energy, utilities, renewables or other large-scale critical infrastructure environments.
  • Strong commercial acumen - leading negotiations, supporting investments decisions, property transactions, and due diligence capability.
  • Understanding of site selection, feasibility and infrastructure, electricity, and utility constraints.
  • Proven ability to negotiate and influence a diverse range of stakeholders through a collaborative and relationship-driven approach.
  • Ability to work through ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and seek continuous improvement in process and tools.

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and encourages everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

Vertiv is hiring a Director, Materials and Manufacturing Planning in Westerville, OH to lead delivery strategy, daily monitoring, and risk identification, with primary responsibility for delivery and inventory. This role drives operations within SIOP(Sales, Inventory, Operations & Planning), master scheduling, NPDI (New Product Development Introduction), and overall materials management strategy, governance, and continuous improvement. They will improve On-Time Delivery through planning and purchasing enhancements and lead inventory optimization programs. Alongside leadership, they will review, propose, and implement processes from Order to Delivery, including production planning, inventory parameters, and master data. They are responsible for formulating and executing the strategic plan to achieve operational goals.

Responsibilities

  • Be fully responsible for SIOP , Master Scheduling, NPDI and drive overall materials management strategy and tactics, governance and continuous improvement, Materials Planning and Inventory Control strategy, develop and improve processes and system requirements to improve efficiencies in the overall Materials Management area.

  • Act as an expert and give directions to improve the overall SIOP, Planning and Purchasing processes with responsibilities between different functions.
  • Responsible for Business Unit Supply & Inventory planning (SIOP); facilitates interactions with Plants, Procurement and LOB during SIOP Process.

job.title: IT Data Analitics Specialist - Reporting
job.description:
Job Description

Who are we?

At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people.

We are currently seeking a IT Data Analitics Specialist - Reporting to join our dynamic team in Piove di Sacco (PD), Italy!

This role is intended for a highly skilled Senior Analytics & Report Developer with deep experience in Power BI, AWS QuickSight, Streamlit, strong mandatory SQL expertise, and modern data visualization practices.

The ideal candidate will play a critical role in designing, developing, and optimizing analytical dashboards, interactive applications, and data products that support business decision-making across the organization.

This role is central to our strategic journey from Power BI to AI-driven analytics, enabling broader Analytics capabilities alongside Power BI expertise for our relevant business use cases. This position requires a strong blend of technical expertise, analytical thinking, data storytelling, and stakeholder management.

What kind of work will you be doing?

_Reporting & Dashboard Development_

  • Design, develop, and maintain advanced Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets.
  • Design, develop, and maintain AWS QuickSight dashboards, analyses, and datasets, leveraging the SPICE engine for high-performance analytics.
  • Build interactive Streamlit applications to support advanced analytics and data-driven workflows.
  • Translate business requirements into intuitive, visually compelling, and accurate reporting solutions.
  • Optimize report performance, data models, measures, and queries for scalability and speed.

_Data Modeling & Integration_

  • Develop efficient data models using best practices for semantic layers.
  • Leverage mandatory strong SQL expertise to write complex queries, optimize performance, and ensure data accuracy across all integration layers.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources (databases, APIs, Snowflake, AWS data services, etc.).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to define and refine data structures enabling analytical consumption across both platforms.

_Business Partnership_

  • Partner with business users to understand needs, gather requirements, and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Provide training, guidance, and best practices for self-service reporting.
  • Present insights and analytical findings in clear, actionable terms to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Support the organization's transition from traditional BI to AI-augmented analytics, identifying use cases where AI can enhance decision-making.

_Governance, Quality & Standards_

  • Ensure adherence to data visualization standards, governance policies, and security protocols across environments.
  • Implement version control, documentation, and lifecycle management for analytical assets.
  • Proactively identify data issues and drive remediation initiatives with cross-functional teams.

_Innovation & Continuous Improvement_

  • Evaluate and introduce new features in Power BI (Fabric, DAX advancements, etc.) and AWS QuickSight (ML Insights, QuickSight Q, Generative BI capabilities).
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting processes and leverage AI/ML for predictive and prescriptive analytics.
  • Drive adoption of modern, scalable analytics patterns, supporting the company's PowerBI-to-AI transformation journey.
  • Explore and implement generative AI capabilities within AWS QuickSight to enable natural language querying and automated insight generation for business users.

What will make you successful?

  • 5+ years of experience in BI/report development, with proven expertise in Power BI.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS QuickSight, including dashboard creation, dataset management, SPICE optimization, and analyses.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Streamlit for building interactive Python-based applications.
  • Expert-level knowledge of DAX, Power Query, data modeling, and visualization best practices.
  • Strong SQL knowledge is mandatory — the candidate must demonstrate expert-level proficiency in writing complex queries, performance tuning, and working with enterprise data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake).
  • Solid understanding of data governance, security, and report lifecycle management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets.
  • Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based BI and AI/ML analytics platforms.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Python for data manipulation and integration with Streamlit.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric ecosystems.
  • AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner).
  • Experience with AWS QuickSight Q (natural language querying) and ML Insights for automated anomaly detection and forecasting.
  • Experience with generative AI tools and their application in business analytics.
  • Experience working in agile environments and using CI/CD tools for BI assets.
  • Background in enterprise reporting for Finance, Supply Chain, Commercial, or Operations.

We are looking for someone who has:

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to translate technical topics into business language.
  • Attention to detail and passion for clean, intuitive design.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality output under tight timelines.
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI-driven innovation in analytics.

If YOU are the person we are looking for, feel free to apply and let's start drafting your future career in a healthy and growing environment.

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPALS: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Diversity & Inclusion.

  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • High-Performance Culture
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

OUR BEHAVIORS

  • Own It
  • Act With Urgency
  • Foster a Customer-First Mindset
  • Think Big and Execute
  • Lead by Example
  • Drive Continuous Improvement
  • Learn and Seek Out Development

The anticipated salary range for this role in Piove di Sacco (PD), Italy is between 43.000€ to 55.000€ gross per year (based on a full-time working week). Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation and benefits. Where applicable, a comprehensive overview of the full benefits package and any additional compensation will be provided during the recruitment process in accordance with local legal requirements. Compensation is determined based on objective, gender-neutral criteria, including skills, experience, and job responsibilities.

job.title: Project Manager Services Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Job Description

Experienced Project Management Professional for Data Center with Tier 04 I&C Exp.

Required a highly accomplished Project Manager, an Electrical Engineer with over 15 years of expertise in data center infrastructure and engineering, specialized in the execution and optimization of Tier 4 mission-critical facilities. Experienced in I&C of PAC, CAC, and DG, Chiller, Electrical Panels, Liquid Cooling with a strong focus on implementing strategic project management frameworks to ensure seamless execution, regulatory compliance, and optimal resource utilization. With a comprehensive grasp of the full project lifecycle, from strategic planning and execution to commissioning with L1, L2, L3, L4, L5, ISAT Testing Experience is must. Should be conversant with execution in cost efficiency, risk mitigation, and uncompromising quality control and safety measures.

Responsibilities: -

•Spearheading the end-to-end execution of Tier 4 data center infrastructure projects, ensuring seamless design, construction, commissioning, and operations.

•Managing critical facility components, including Advanced Modular Cooling (AMC), Precision Air Conditioning (PAC), Cold Aisle Containment, Comfort Air Conditioning (CAC), and Air-Cooled Water and Cold Chillers

•Implementing best-in-class mission-critical facility management protocols to ensure 24/7 uptime, reliability, and energy efficiency.

•Driving project risk management strategies, ensuring adherence to industry standards (TIA-942, Uptime Institute, ASHRAE guidelines, and ISO 9001/27001 compliance).

•Leading cross-functional teams, vendor negotiations, and stakeholder coordination, ensuring seamless execution within scope, schedule, and budget constraints.

•Enforcing rigorous health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards, optimizing operational efficiency, sustainability, and regulatory compliance.

Technical: -

  • In-Depth knowledge of Electrical Engineering
  • Provide On-the-Job training and on-site direction to associates for assigned projects
  • Conduct field customer training for assigned projects as required
  • Communicate with Technical Support on equipment issues
  • integrating cutting-edge HVAC, electrical, and structural engineering solutions

Safety (MUST): -

  • Operate in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines
  • Must wear appropriate PPE as per company guidelines and accordance with job duties
  • Report all work related accidents or injuries within 24 hours to the appropriate personnel
  • Must be a role model to fellow associates with regards to safety by setting a positive example
  • Point out potentially unsafe conditions to a customer or contractor, as necessary and based on extensive experience, with the authority to halt work on a project until conditions are corrected

Administration: -

  • Coordinate assigned project completion, customer training, and close-out
  • Provide all commissioning reports in a final package to the customer
  • Coordinate any additional training bought with the sales order
  • Provide Time and Material quotes for customers or contractors for assigned projects, as necessary
  • Coordinate subcontracted services and equipment rentals for assigned projects,
  • Provide accurate and timely reporting in accordance with published guidelines
  • Timecards, expense reports, ticket closure, forms etc.

Customer Satisfaction: -

  • Provide proper and adequate communication to internal and external customers
  • Provide estimated time of arrival to the customer or contractor where applicable
  • Coordinate and attend customer or contractor meetings as required
  • Maintain customer satisfaction rates according to company guidelines

Performance: -

  • Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to work accurately in a busy and demanding environment.
  • Complete all work in an efficient and timely manner
  • Capable of making strong decisions, technical and commercial, under pressure
  • Properly evaluate site and equipment for appropriate billing status
  • Adhere to company dress code and safety regulations
  • Understand and comply with company startup/escalation process and procedures
  • In all aspects of job requirements, must lead by example, and conduct themselves in a higher standard.  Must act and perform as a role model to all field associates
  • Maintain proper and adequate level of internal communications
  • Ability to communicate with all levels within the organization: Managers, co-workers, Service Delivery Team, Sales, Plants, Application Engineering, Technical Support, electronic communications, et al.
  • Conduct themselves in a high degree of professionalism, and of service delivery
  • Ability to handle stressful situations and provide a calming effect to customer
  • High level of diplomacy when interacting with internal and external customers

Qualifications: -

  • B.E./B. Tech Graduate of applicable University of Technology and fifteen years same and or similar work experience.
  • Data Center Construction management experience, critical infrastructure expertise with Power and Colling equipment.
  • Knowledge of construction, electrical and mechanical contracting.
  • Knowledge of engineering, manufacturing processes, data center infrastructure and commissioning processes.
  • Provide on-site customer consultation, must be able to present themselves as an expert in the field
  • Expert analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills (verbal and written) required.
  • Able to manage customer expectations during stressful situations
  • A high degree of communication, organizational and management skills are required
  • Valid driver’s license is required
  • Must be able to read and interpret electrical line diagrams, drawings and blueprints
  • Ability to summarize and report all work related tasks performed
  • Ability to give technical assistance via the telephone to customers on a regular basis
  • Independently evaluate, recognize, and recommend acceptable customer solutions based upon site evaluation.
  • Recommend and direct activities at a customer site by leading technical activities of other technicians at a customer site
  • Strong computer skills including editing, formatting and using templates in Microsoft Office, CAD,  use of Internet for standards/products/manufacturer research and operation of computer-controlled test equipment.
  • Foster a Customer-First Mindset

Time Travel Required: -

  • 30% travels in the Region as and when required
  • Project Based Location duty place is to be acceptable

job.title: Customer Relationship Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

The main function of this position is to ensure operational coverage and service coordination scheduling by reviewing, monitoring, and ensuring completion of all open work orders and service requests.  This includes assistance to the Manager, Customer Relationship Services and providing guidance and handling escalated scheduling / service issues.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for scheduling and dispatching all service events between Customer Engineers or Service Partners for an assigned territory.
  • Be willing to lead by example – be accountable and dependable, maintain a positive attitude, inspire others to go the extra mile to take care of Customers (internal/external) and achieve Operational Key Results (OKR).
  • Continuously monitor the scheduling efforts of the Regional scheduling team and report team statuses and action plans weekly to the Manager, Customer Relationship Services.
  • Act as a coach/mentor when communicating or addressing performance issues with the team.
  • Demonstrate the ability to remain calm and even-tempered during stressful situations.
  • Close coordination with the Manager, Customer Relationship Services of any behavioral or operational related issues. Present recovery plan(s) with multiple options that will allow the Manager, Customer Relationship Services to make informed decisions.
  • Actively seek and participate in continuous improvements initiatives that impact customer care and coordination of work.
  • Assist the Manager, Customer Relationship Services in the implementation of new processes/policies and systems.
  • Meet with scheduling team on a regular basis to review, coach and train on various Customer Service concerns and opportunities.
  • Handle escalated scheduling issues within the region, including but not limited to sales inquiries and assisting Customer Success Management and Coordinated Services scheduling.
  • Be available after hours to assist with escalations to meet customer/contract SLA (Service Level Agreement).
  • Generate standard and custom reports to monitor workload.
  • Proactively identify schedule risks and present options to resolve critical potential issues to the local team and Manager, Customer Relationship Services.
  • Ensure all billable work is being scheduled and executed and tickets are closed out in a timely basis.
  • Where practical, empower and direct the team to strategically schedule preventive maintenance visits to minimize/ cover costs for the company (take over Customer Engineer Scheduling or large account scheduling).
  • Ensure accurate documentation of all scheduling correspondence in tickets.
  • Maintain regional PTO schedule and ensure responsibilities are covered during absences.
  • Ensure performance results in BetterWorks monthly.
  • Provide content and assist Manager, Customer Relationship Services in quarterly BetterWorks one-on-one conversations related to job performance.
  • Promote recognition and submit positive feedback in BetterWorks and to the Manager, Customer Relationship Services.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee to perform this job.  Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Qualifications:(education, experience level, knowledge, skills, certifications).

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration OR High school education with 5 years minimum same or similar work experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years customer service and coordination of service activities.
  • Self-motivated and possess the ability to lead and direct a diverse team.
  • Must be attentive, patient and strongly skilled in written and verbal communication; clear, professional, positive, and informative communication style.
  • High-level competence in multitasking, time management, organization, critical and analytical thinking, problem solving, and the ability to influence others are required.
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment and be comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Adapt quickly to changing priorities and customer needs.
  • Ability to persuade others in order to change undesirable behaviors and/or achieve the goals of the business.
  • Must be proficient in the business tools used to perform the job and have extensive knowledge of the businesses processes, people, and products.
  • Intermediate/advanced proficiency using Microsoft Excel software, including data analysis, pivot tables, etc.

POSITIONS ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS(travel, location, etc.)

  • Willing to work flexible hours, including before shift/after shift and weekends to support the business.
  • Reports in office full-time Monday-Friday (Westerville, Ohio)

job.title: Regional Sales Manager, Channel
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The Regional Sales Manager, Channel is responsible for working with end users, partners, and local Vertiv offices in assigned territory to meet all goals and objectives.  Increase revenue via channel partners for edge solutions that include racks, rack power distribution, UPS systems, thermal solutions, Infrastructure Management Software, and Services. Work with our local Vertiv offices to engage and navigate all levels of an end user organization; with a focus on reaching executives, IT directors and decision makers for Data Center and Edge rollouts/deployments.  Develop go to market selling plans to include organizational structure, decision maker matrix, incumbent vendors, facility locations/potential, and partner ecosystem.  Identify and develop relationships with channel partners and end users to provide leadership towards the achievement of maximum profitability and growth in line with company vision and values. Establish plans and strategies to expand the customer base in the marketing area and contributes to the development of training and educational programs for clients and partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop, present, and execute on territory plan for market that ensures attainment of company goals and profitability.
  • Initiate and coordinate development of action plans to penetrate verticals and new accounts.
  • Develop and maintain sales by exploring and qualifying existing accounts.  (50% existing/50% new accounts)
  • Work with local Vertiv offices and partners to maintain and manage pipeline in CRM
  • Manage and lead Channel Account Managers at our local Vertiv offices.  (These CAMs are dotted lined to RSM)
  • Participate in trade shows within assigned geographic region.
  • Responsible for the performance and development of channel partners and local Vertiv offices.
  • Maintains accurate records of all pricings, sales and activity reports.
  • Controls expenses to meet budget guidelines.
  • Provide accurate feedback to management on wins/losses and trends.
  • Coordinate and lead activities with dedicated Inside Sales Rep to maximize our ability to close on new business opportunities.
  • Consult with management in formulating a sales and marketing strategy.
  • Interface with local, regional, and national distribution accounts management and sales.
  • Determine and oversee local tradeshow selections, scheduling, and coverage.
  • Customer Satisfaction:  Ensure a high caliber customer response and satisfaction
  • Train and mentor less experienced RSMs as needed.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of 8 years’ sales experience
  • Strong communication skills in written, verbal, and visual media.
  • Strong understanding of customer and market dynamics and requirements.
  • Willingness to travel and work in a global team of professionals.
  • Ability to learn and adapt to a rapidly changing market.
  • Proven leadership and ability to achieve sales goals.
  • Ability to manage multiple offices and personnel to achieve objectives.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Detail oriented with the ability to manage and prioritize leads through multiple channels.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and capable of resolving contract and product issues.
  • Understanding of Edge Solutions, UPS/Power Products, Racks, Thermal, critical space environments, and service offerings.
  • Team player with outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to handle multiple projects under a heavy travel schedule.
  • High degree of independent judgment.
  • Ability to work in a matrix management environment and with all levels within the organization.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Working knowledge and/or sales experience within the data center industry.
  • Understanding of Vertiv Representative selling structure.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Frequent driving.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • 50-75% within territory

job.title: Engineer I Electrical & Electronics Engineering IX
job.description:
Job Description

Job Description

Vertiv Infrastructure Solutions, Pune is looking for dynamic and experienced Controls Engineer in Design Engineering develops design of controls projects to satisfy all required inputs and requirements to produce sustainable and functional controls and building equipment monitoring design. Controls engineer models design in Revit and prepares standard controls documentation like plans, sections, elevation views, I/O lists, riser diagrams, sequence of operations, equipment technical specifications and material submittals. Controls engineer scope of work is:

  • Supportive role during design of the BMS documentation set for design of modular buildings (small/medium scale)
  • Specification of the control equipment and material
  • Setting up the BMS equipment (field equipment, network switches and PLC’s, servers and operator working station)
  • Making “As built documentation”
  • Support during FAT
  • Support during commissioning on site

Design of the BMS system of modular buildings (small/medium scale) according to the input data, specification of the material and equipment and development of construction documentation at office in Delaware NA. Support internal testing and FAT in factory In India/USA. Supporting commissioning team at site during commissioning process (India/USA region).

Job Specifications & Responsibilities:

  • Developing of project conceptual and detailed design
  • Based on input data (information, requirements, standards), development of electrical project documentation: riser and network diagrams, I/O lists, application and functional diagrams, instructions, material submittals, presentations and marketing materials etc.
  • During design follow and take into consideration international, national and company standards and good engineering practices
  • Participating in kick-off meetings, regular project team meetings, and on-site coordination meetings
  • Reporting project status to Project Lead Engineer
  • Proactive cooperation with all team members during project execution
  • Controlling and supporting controls integrators with support of lead Controls engineer
  • Initiating RFI („Request for Information “) in cases where additional clarification is needed
  • Development of defined documents according to Document list (DLIST)
  • Specifying Bill of Material and services required for project execution
  • Specification of necessary certificates for materials needed to be ordered
  • Supporting suppliers with additional information during bidding phase of sourcing (offer submitting)
  • Providing technical approval for received supplier offers
  • Providing technical support to subcontractors and installers during production/assembly
  • Cooperation with Manufacturing and Site deployment engineering team
  • Cooperation with Site Manager during assembly, providing technical solutions to raised issues
  • Cooperation with Quality Control during quality control of components/systems and assembly on Site
  • Cooperation with Commissioning engineer on testing documentation development
  • Supporting role on internal testing and FAT
  • Development of installation and maintenance documentation
  • In factory, on-site and/or remote commissioning and deployment of BMS

Authorities:

  • Review and approval of outsourced BMS design and commissioning with support of lead Controls engineer
  • Approve or reject technically received supplier offer with support of lead Controls engineer
  • Approve or reject suggested changes by subcontractor on approved workshop documentation with support of lead Controls engineer

Education & Certifications:

  • Education – Electrical Engineer (Automation) with 3-5 years’ experience
  • English language – fluent
  • Software – AutoCAD, EPLAN, Revit (preferred)
  • Technical skills – programming, SCADA, PLC, ethernet networks, DDC (preferred), Modbus (preferred)
  • Other skills – independent, attention to details, problem solving, organization, creativity, teamwork

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute
  • Lead by example
  • Drive continuous improvement
  • Learn and seek out development
  • Promote transparent & open communication

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. job.title: Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer, Data Center Operations
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Data Center Operations designs, installs & maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.

To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build & manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.

The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most advance data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.

A Data Centre Operations Tech at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).

There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:

Problem Solving: Maintain a high level of system reliability by prioritizing and resolving trouble tickets efficiently, these include:

  • Escalation point and technical troubleshooter for all Systems and Network hardware problems
  • Deep diving into Linux server issues
  • XEN service virtualization troubleshooting

Technical: Troubleshoot technical issues on various platforms ranging from Systems through Networking to Power/Mechanical

  • Remediation of physical layer outages, both Systems & Network
  • Remediation or recovery of physical power issues on racks
  • Participate in Data Center power & cooling events

Operations: Meet 24x7 On-Call requirements and response during shift rotations.

  • Install & configure racks of hosts in line with internal SLAs
  • Triage & resolve trouble tickets for all devices in your region
  • Data Center point of contact for all High Severity issues
  • Physical replacement of server and network device parts
  • Ensure correct rotation of parts & spares
  • Help define metrics to increase our customer uptime
  • Enforcing Security Best Practices at ADSIPL
  • Interact with third party vendors & contractors
  • Contribute ideas to improve operational efficiency
  • Project Management:
  • Participate in and deliver on a number of high impact small to mid-scale projects
  • Participate in internal team meetings at ADSIPL for metric analysis and project status updates
  • Help build the world’s largest Cloud infrastructure in India

Mentoring: Share knowledge and help educate less technical staff on the best practices related to all break fix issues Hiring: Contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the ADSIPL’s hiring process/candidate interviews

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
  • 2+ years of computer networking experience
  • 2+ years of Linux operating systems experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
  • Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
  • Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
  • Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)
