This position reports to:

Regional Sales Manager (Process Industries)__

Your role and responsibilities Responsible for the sales of ABB products, systems, and services for the Pulp, Paper and Fiber Business Line, Process Industries, based in Singapore and supporting customers across selected Southeast Asia markets. The role achieves both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenue, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. The role identifies and develops new sales opportunities, with a primary focus on Pulp & Paper, Fiber, and related process industries in the assigned regional markets.

The work model for the role is: hybrid, #LI-hybrid

This role is contributing to the Pulp, Paper and Fiber Business Line in South East Asia.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to drive sustainable sales growth and achieve order, revenue, margin, and customer satisfaction targets.
  • Build, manage, and continuously improve a healthy sales pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting and opportunity progression.
  • Establish and strengthen relationships with key customer stakeholders across management, operations, engineering, maintenance, and procurement functions.
  • Identify customer challenges, understand business drivers, and position ABB solutions to create measurable customer value.
  • Lead sales opportunities throughout the entire sales cycle, from opportunity qualification to negotiation and order closure.
  • Drive proposal development and commercial discussions, ensuring alignment on technical, pricing, contractual, risk, and delivery requirements.
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities, market segments, and growth initiatives within the assigned territory or industry.
  • Collaborate with local, regional, and cross-functional teams to leverage ABB's full portfolio, share market intelligence, and deliver a superior customer experience.

Qualifications for the role

  • Apply basic knowledge of industrial automation and electrical systems and demonstrate a strong willingness to learn ABB Pulp, Paper & Fiber solutions through training and field exposure.
  • Strong listening and consultative skills, with the ability to understand customer challenges, identify root causes, and position ABB as a trusted solution provider by recommending value-added solutions that address customer needs.

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. job.title: Project Engineer - Industrial Refrigeration (Gordon Brothers)
job.description:
Join the Global Leader in Sustainable Infrastructure and Industrial Refrigeration

At Johnson Controls (JCI), we're transforming the way the world manages energy, buildings, and critical industrial operations. As a global leader in smart buildings, thermal management, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, we help customers operate more efficiently, reduce carbon emissions, and build resilient, future-ready facilities across industries such as data centres, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, JCI has delivered innovative solutions where performance matters most. Backed by cutting-edge technology, lifecycle services, and a world-class field organisation, we help our customers achieve measurable results while creating more sustainable environments.

As part of the JCI family, Gordon Brothers Industries (GBI) brings more than 100 years of industrial refrigeration expertise and is recognised as Australia's largest Industrial Refrigeration company. With offices across every mainland state, GBI delivers end-to-end refrigeration solutions including design, engineering, construction, commissioning, servicing, and maintenance for leading customers within the food and beverage, cold storage, mining, chemical, and industrial processing sectors.

Due to continued growth and an expanding project portfolio, we are seeking an experienced Project Engineer to join our Melbourne team.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity to work on some of Australia's most complex industrial refrigeration and process cooling projects while being supported by the resources, technology, and global expertise of Johnson Controls.

About the Role

As a Project Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, delivery, commissioning, and ongoing support of industrial refrigeration systems and associated process equipment.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Deliver detailed engineering calculations and design solutions for industrial refrigeration and compression systems.
  • Develop estimates and proposals for both minor and major capital projects.
  • Prepare technical tender submissions in accordance with client specifications and deadlines.
  • Evaluate existing refrigeration plants and identify opportunities for optimisation, upgrades, and plant improvements.
  • Manage project delivery from concept through to commissioning, including procurement, supplier management, scheduling, and cost control.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary project resources to ensure successful project outcomes.
  • Undertake engineering audits, safety reviews, and refrigeration system assessments, preparing detailed client reports and recommendations.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant Australian and international industry standards.
  • Prepare risk assessments and promote a strong safety culture across projects and site activities.
  • Support plant commissioning, testing, and performance verification activities.
  • Conduct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
  • Produce technical drawings and documentation using AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and other engineering design tools.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across engineering and project delivery functions.
  • Mentor graduate engineers and provide technical guidance to internal teams and customers.
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with customers while acting as a key technical representative of GBI and Johnson Controls.

About You

We're looking for an engineer who combines strong technical capability with practical project delivery experience.

You will ideally have:

  • Degree qualifications in Mechanical, Process, Electrical, Chemical, or a related Engineering discipline.
  • Experience delivering engineering design and project execution within industrial refrigeration, compression, process engineering, or rotating equipment environments.
  • Strong knowledge of industrial refrigeration systems, ammonia refrigeration, process cooling, or related heavy industrial applications.
  • Proven experience managing engineering projects from concept through commissioning.
  • Exposure to industries such as food processing, cold storage, petrochemical, oil and gas, mining, manufacturing, or industrial processing.
  • Experience conducting FATs, SATs, and commissioning activities.
  • Ability to interpret technical specifications, engineering drawings, and design documentation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools.
  • AutoCAD and/or SolidWorks experience highly regarded.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • A team-focused mindset with a passion for delivering quality outcomes.
  • Commitment to safety, continuous learning, and technical excellence.

Ready to Take the Next Step?

If you're looking to advance your career with Australia's leading Industrial Refrigeration business while benefiting from the global strength and innovation of Johnson Controls, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn more about our industrial refrigeration capabilities, visit [www.gordonbrothers.com.au](http://www.gordonbrothers.com.au).

Applicants must have full working rights in Australia.

Please note that pre-employment checks, including reference checks, medical assessments, criminal history checks, and drug and alcohol screening, will form part of the selection process.

job.title: Senior PLC Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What you will do: The Senior PLC Engineer is responsible for the design, development, programming, commissioning, and support of industrial automation systems based on B&R Automation platforms. The role involves leading automation projects, developing machine control software, integrating motion control and Metasys CIM systems, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and providing technical leadership to engineers or SI.

How you will do it:

Automation System Development

  • Design and develop PLC software using B&R Automation Studio.
  • Develop machine control logic, sequences, and safety functions.
  • Configure and program B&R PLCs, HMIs, industrial PCs, and I/O systems.
  • Develop and maintain reusable software libraries and standards.
  • Create software architecture for complex automation systems..

HMI & SCADA Development

  • Design and develop operator interfaces using Metasys CIM/Pcvue.
  • Integrate PLC systems with SCADA, EMS, and Manufacturing Intelligence platforms.
  • Develop alarm management, diagnostics, and data logging functions.

System Integration

  • Integrate industrial communication protocols including:

Ethernet/IP

  • Modbus TCP
  • OPC UA

Interface with third-party equipment and field devices.

Project Execution

  • Participate in technical discussions with customers and stakeholders.
  • Review functional specifications and develop software design documents.
  • Conduct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
  • Support machine commissioning and startup activities globally.
  • Ensure project delivery within schedule and quality standards.

Technical Leadership

  • Mentor junior automation engineers.
  • Review software code and engineering deliverables.
  • Establish engineering best practices and coding standards.
  • Provide technical guidance during troubleshooting and project execution.

Troubleshooting & Support

  • Diagnose and resolve control system issues.
  • Support production plants and customer sites.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
  • Provide remote and onsite technical support

B&R Expertise

  • B&R Automation Studio
  • B&R PLC Programming
  • Structured Text (ST)
  • Ladder Diagram (LD)
  • Function Block Diagram (FBD)
  • Safety PLC Programming

Programming & IT

  • IEC 61131-3 Programming Standards
  • OPC UA
  • SQL Databases
  • C/C++ knowledge (preferred)
  • Version Control Systems (Git, SVN)

What we look for:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering / Mechatronics Engineering / Automation Engineering or Industrial Engineering
  • 7+ years of industrial automation experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with B&R or other PLC products.
  • Proven experience in machine automation and building management system applications.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Project leadership capability.
  • Customer-facing communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Cross-functional collaboration.
  • Analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
  • Willingness to travel internationally for commissioning and support.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What we look for

  • BE (Mechanical / Electrical)
  • Must have 8+ years of relevant experience in Fire Protection & Suppression Systems domains.

  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.

Preferred

What You Will Do

The Senior Compressor Engineer is a mechanical engineering position within the centrifugal compressor engineering team. This position offers a great opportunity for professional growth and advancement. Duties require applying mechanical engineering fundamentals to the design, development, analysis, and testing of rotating machinery and sub-components. A major focus of activities will be on cost reductions, performance improvements, and enhanced reliability of new and existing products. This position reports to the compressor engineering manager and will collaborate closely with a multi-functional technical team to support overall product development initiatives. In addition, the successful candidate will benefit from close professional collaboration with highly experienced senior engineers and staff within the department.

Role will primarily be focused on centrifugal compressors for chillers.

How You Will Do It

Take direction from manager and senior mechanical engineers.

Provide guidance to test operators and interface with compressor technicians.

Perform data collection and analysis.

Work collaboratively with other JCI engineering groups to develop new products.

Interface with product managers, project managers, product technical support associates, and multiple international manufacturing plants.

Be a subject matter expert for centrifugal compressors when communicating with customers, chiller and applications engineers, manufacturing, field service personnel.

Lead design improvement/enhancement efforts for performance, functionality, manufacturability, reliability, and cost reductions.

Assist in various assigned projects within the compressor engineering department as necessary.

Understand and follow all relative safety procedures and utilize appropriate personal protective equipment.

Adhere to the Company's Business Ethics and Safety standards.

Qualifications

  • External

What we look for

Required

Required BS in Mechanical Engineering or other relevant degree

High mechanical aptitude

The ability to obtain a passport for international travel

Proficiency in Microsoft Office

4+ years of experience in mechanical engineering

This is an onsite position at the Pune engineering facility

job.title: Technical Lead I (power electronics)
job.description:
Job Description

Technical Lead I (power electronics)

  • Our employees are the most important part of our business. Thank you for your interest in applying to new opportunities with us.

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Visit [johnsoncontrols.com](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/) for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.

What you will do

Johnson Controls is seeking a Principal Power Electronics Engineer to support our Chillers product group. You will be responsible for designing, testing and sustaining Variable Speed Drives (VSD) for chiller applications. This team conducts design, simulation, prototype testing, reliability testing and confirms that the product operates as expected with reference to specific documented hardware requirements. This position is located onsite in New Freedom, PA. Candidates must be commuting distance, or able to relocate.

How you will do it

  • Serve as technical expert within Power Electronics Department that is responsible to design, test, and maintain power electronics products and systems for Johnson Controls’ chiller applications.
  • Determine the best techniques, procedures and/or theories as they apply to the development of power electronics products and systems.
  • Create compliance procedures for the development of electrical/electronic circuitry designs.
  • Define and interpret design specifications; design electrical/electronic circuitry to meet specified requirements; and analyzes product design requirements and recommend solutions.
  • Prepare and coordinates the release of documentation to support component design and manufacturing.
  • Participate in all aspects of preliminary design and systems architecture, and conducts analysis of the cost impacts of proposed modifications, upgrades, and new implementations of application software.
  • Conduct feasibility studies and systems analysis for new applications or major modifications of existing systems.
  • Work with other engineers, designers, and technicians on specific work assignments.
  • Forecast and schedule work activities, and defines processes for repetitive tasks.
  • Act as the technical lead for troubleshooting field and factory issues on the range of power electronics products and systems on Johnson Controls’ chillers.

What we look for

Required

  • Master's degree on Electrical Engineering with specialization on Power Electronics
  • 4+ years of industry experience in the field of Power Electronics.

Preferred

  • Ph.D. OR Master's degree with focus in Power Electronics (Preferred not mandatory)
  • Strong experience on power electronics controls
  • Strong experience on IGBT based inverters
  • Strong experience on advanced tools such as Matlab/Simulink, OPAL-RT, Saber

job.title: Australia EHS and Quality Specialist
job.description:
Build a career with confidence!

We are a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

Role Overview

The EHS Specialist is a proactive, hands-on role responsible for driving the implementation, execution, and continuous maintenance of environmental, health, and safety programs across Carrier Australia. Reporting to the regional EHS director, this position partners directly with field teams, operations, and management to ensure strict compliance with Australian WHS/EHS regulations, Carrier Corporate EHS Policy, and ISO 14001/45001/9001 standards. This role requires a self-driven, action-oriented professional with a strong bias for execution, who takes full ownership of daily operational safety tasks, delivers pragmatic solutions, and actively supports evolving business needs across our Australian operations. This is a nation-wide role that requires regular travel to project and other sites across Australia.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and champion a strong EHS culture across all Australian offices, field operations and teams, promoting safety, environmental awareness and accountability.
  • Own and maintain the EHS Management System, ensuring compliance with corporate policies, Australian legislation and ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 9001 standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying EHS risks and gaps, implementing practical solutions and partnering with operations to improve safety performance.
  • Lead audits, inspections and incident investigations, ensuring non-conformances, corrective actions and statutory reporting requirements are effectively managed and closed out.
  • Develop and deliver EHS training and risk management programs, including inductions, JSAs, SWMS and procedures for high-risk activities and contractor management.
  • Provide expert, hands-on EHS guidance to operational teams, supporting regulatory compliance, workplace safety, environmental requirements and day-to-day problem solving.
  • Manage EHS reporting, workers’ compensation, licensing and compliance registers, providing accurate performance data and actionable insights to leadership.
  • Own ESG and sustainability reporting and regulatory relationships, while providing flexible, hands-on support across all EHS matters as required by the business.

Required Competencies & Qualifications

  • A tertiary qualification in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Certificate IV in Work Health and Safety (WHS) or equivalent Australian EHS qualification. NEBOSH or other international certifications are highly regarded.
  • 5-8 years of relevant EHS experience in a service, HVAC, construction, or industrial environment. Experience supporting field operations is essential.
  • Strong working knowledge of Australian WHS legislation (including harmonized WHS Act and Regulations), environmental protection legislation, and regulatory compliance requirements across multiple Australian states/territories.
  • Experience with ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and ISO 9001 standards, including participation in audits and implementation activities.
  • Practical experience in service operations, HVAC systems, construction sites, or mechanical projects is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively as a team player, building strong relationships at all organizational levels.
  • Experience communicating and liaising with Australian government agencies and regulators (e.g., SafeWork, WorkSafe, EPA).
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and training delivery skills with the ability to engage field teams effectively.
  • Strong capability to work both independently and as part of a team, with a service-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to travel within Australia to support operations as required.
  • Proficiency in English (written and verbal communication).

Key Attributes We're Looking For

  • High bias for action with a pragmatic, solutions-oriented, "can-do" attitude.
  • Strong execution focus and accountability for delivering agreed outcomes within tight deadlines.
  • Adaptability and resilience to respond quickly to changing business priorities and ad-hoc operational tasks.
  • Collaborative team player who builds trust, credibility, and open communication with field and leadership teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a practical approach to risk management.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary package + Full time opportunity
  • Excellent job stability + Ongoing training and development opportunities
  • Inclusive work environment + Supportive management team
  • Opportunity to work across diverse operations throughout Australia

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

Oracle is seeking a senior leader to serve as a OCI & AI Infrastructure Pursuits Lead within the Global AI Infrastructure & Strategic Pursuits organization.

This lead will operate at the intersection of sales, engineering, and executive leadership, owning end-to-end engagement for priority accounts. This includes owning revenue generation and customer acquisition for cloud infrastructure solutions, including compute, GPU/AI capacity, storage, and networking. This role requires leadership in end-to-end sales cycles for large-scale, complex deals with enterprises and hyperscale customers, driving long-term partnerships and multi-year contracts.

_ This role will have key coverage on China market and fluency in both English and Mandarin (Chinese) is required*_

_ This role can be hired out of Singapore or Hong Kong location*_

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Revenue Ownership & Pipeline Development
  • Build and manage a high-value pipeline across enterprise and strategic accounts
  • Identify and close large-scale infrastructure deals(e.g., AI clusters, GPU capacity, multi-region deployments)
  • Consistently meet/exceed quota targets (ARR, TCV, prepay structures)
  • Strategic Account Management
  • Own executive relationships across customer organizations (CIO, CTO, Head of Infrastructure, AI leaders)
  • Develop account strategies aligned to customer growth (AI/ML, data platforms, cloud migration)
  • Expand footprint through multi-product adoption(compute, storage, networking, AI services)
  • Complex Deal Execution
  • Lead end-to-end sales cycles: discovery, solutioning, pricing, negotiation, close
  • Structure commercial models(reserved capacity, consumption, prepay, hybrid deals)
  • Navigate procurement, legal, and finance stakeholders on both sides
  • Go-to-Market Strategy
  • Define and execute GTM plans for infrastructure offerings (compute, GPU, storage, networking)
  • Segment target markets (e.g., AI/ML, enterprise IT, SaaS, gaming, HPC)
  • Align pricing, packaging, and regional rollout strategies
  • Product Positioning & Messaging
  • Craft clear, differentiated messaging against competitors (AWS, Azure, GCP, specialized GPU clouds)
  • Translate technical capabilities into business value (cost/performance, scalability, latency, reliability)
  • Develop sales narratives for executive and technical buyers
  • Technical & Business Value Selling
  • Translate infrastructure capabilities into business outcomes(cost efficiency, performance, scalability)
  • Partner with solutions architects to design high-performance architectures(AI training, inference, HPC)
  • Build ROI/TCO models to justify large capital and operating commitments

job.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team can provide you the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive scale, integrated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment. OCI is committed to providing the best in cloud products that meet the needs of our customers who are tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges.

We offer unique opportunities for smart, hands-on engineers with the expertise and passion to solve difficult problems in distributed highly available services and virtualized infrastructure. At every level, our engineers have a significant technical and business impact designing and building innovative new systems to power our customer’s business critical applications. Oracle's Infrastructure Cloud Object Storage team is Hiring Software Engineers, level commensurate with demonstrated achievements in the past and experience.

The object store team is responsible for a performant, scalable, highly available, and durable object store built from the ground up. We believe this team and mission sits squarely at the center of Oracle's future and is an integral part of Oracle's public cloud efforts.

We have engineering work at every layer of the stack, from REST APIs to distributed systems to file systems, and we are looking for teammates who are interested in being part of a team that innovates from top to bottom. We believe that the only way to succeed is to own every part of the problem, and so we are creating a team that controls its own destiny. You will own development of new components and features, from initial concepts through design, implementation, test, and operation.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize Background Services (garbage collection, Object Lifecycle Management, Object Inventory, Scanner, Publisher, Snapshot Processing, etc.) to meet large-scale performance and scalability requirements.
  • Drive performance engineering initiatives, including profiling, benchmarking, capacity planning, and performance optimization of distributed background services.
  • Design and implement scalable processing pipelines capable of handling large-scale metadata, object lifecycle operations, and background workflows under metadata services umbrella.
  • Develop and enhance end to end tests for Background Services to improve end-to-end validation and production readiness, including scenarios that cannot be validated through traditional tests.
  • Build and execute performance, stress, endurance, and fault-injection tests to validate system reliability, scalability, and correctness.
  • Improve operational readiness by developing dashboards, telemetry, alerts, automation, runbooks, and operational tooling for production support.
  • Investigate and resolve complex production and performance issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term fixes.
  • Collaborate closely with Object Storage, Dataplane and infrastructure teams to optimize end-to-end system performance and ensure seamless integration across dependent services.
  • Participate in operational support rotations and contribute to continuous improvements in system reliability, availability, automation, and operational excellence.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution

  • Independently plan and execute assigned projects while meeting program milestones and delivery timelines.
  • Balance feature development, performance optimization, operational qualification, and production readiness activities based on project priorities.

Collaboration & Partnership

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Dataplane, Oak, Infrastructure, and SRE teams, to deliver scalable and reliable metadata service solutions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to define performance targets, operational readiness criteria, and feature delivery plans.

Problem Solving

  • Analyze complex distributed systems, identify performance bottlenecks and reliability issues, and implement scalable solutions.

Continuous Learning

  • Stay current with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and large-scale storage technologies, applying industry best practices to metadata services.

Continuous Improvement

job.title: Senior Security Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

We are looking for professionals with experience protecting critical infrastructure to help us defend Oracle cloud infrastructure. Our team is skilled in threat hunting, analyzing indicators of compromise (IOCs), investigating adverse security events, security incident management, and digital forensics across laaS, PaaS and SaaS environments. You will be part of a corporate security operations center responsible for defending infrastructure from adversaries and insider threats. This includes using tools to analyze and respond to threats, creating tools/scripts to aid in analysis, and responding in real time to adverse security events. Our team is the last line of defense if security controls are breached. We are expanding the team and working on ambitious new initiatives. The Senior SOC Analyst will leverage advance security tooling and automation to rapidly detect and respond to real-time security alerts and events and conduct detailed root cause investigations. The analyst will work closely with other SOC personnel, forensics, incident response, and engineering partners to mitigate a wide variety of threats and malicious activity.

Description

  • Support shifts and on call rotations
  • Detect and respond to security events and threats from alerting, escalations, and other sources
  • Lead complex investigations and conduct deep analysis of security events focused on rapid containment, remediation, and mitigation
  • Work closely with security engineering teams to improve monitoring, detection, and tooling
  • Understand the threat landscape, emerging trends, and incorporate this understanding into day-to-day security monitoring
  • Operate SOC technologies, including but not limited to a Security Information Event Management (SIEM) platform,Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), SOAR, Firewalls, Anti-Malware solutions, and insider threat tooling
  • Assist with security incident response activities
  • Prepare assigned reports for the SOC manager
  • Provide high quality written and verbal reports as required
  • Actively monitor and respond the SIEM alert queue and triage alerts
  • Investigate alerts using standard operating procedures
  • Monitor several screens, systems, and alerts simultaneously
  • This role is open to Singaporeans only
  • Must meet eligibility requirements for obtaining and maintaining a Singapore government security clearance.
  • This role will involve the successful applicant working on government projects which may require security clearance being obtained and maintained as a condition of employment. Candidates applying for this role must be willing to provide necessary personal details for the application and maintenance of necessary security clearance.

Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • 4+ years of Incident Response, Security Operations Center, and/or Forensic Analyst experience
  • Comfortable working in an ambiguous, fast-paced, unpredictable environment
  • Experience working in a highly collaborative, team centric, event driven operations team
  • Experience with querying across large data sets to understand complicated and difficult to solve problems
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Experience in one or more of the following fields of work: National security, military, intelligence, law enforcement, criminology, and/or foreign areas and language
  • Experience with variety of operating systems and threats that target them including Windows, UNIX/LINUX, and MacOS
  • Experience performing open source research on a variety of topics
  • Excellent verbal/non-verbal communication skills with proficient ability to deliver technical information to non-technical staff

job.title: Applied Scientist 3
job.description:
Job Description

  • Design and build data-centric GenAI methods for synthetic data generation, multimodal data curation, data augmentation, filtering, deduplication, and quality assessment.
  • Develop and evaluate synthetic data pipelines for text, speech, vision, and multimodal GenAI use cases, including controllable generation, provenance tracking, safety checks, and domain adaptation.
  • Build evaluation frameworks that connect data quality to downstream GenAI model performance, including benchmark design, ablation studies, error analysis, and model-feedback loops.
  • Research and implement modern generative AI techniques, including LLM/VLM-based data generation, fine-tuning, instruction tuning, preference optimization, and model-based data labeling.
  • Build scalable data and ML pipelines for acquisition, cleaning, transformation, metadata extraction, embedding generation, labeling, training, and evaluation.
  • Develop production-quality code for batch and real-time ML workflows, including model inference, feature processing, data validation, monitoring, and operational automation.
  • Translate research papers and emerging GenAI techniques into practical systems that improve data quality, model quality, and customer-facing AI outcomes.
  • Partner with modeling, product, infrastructure, and domain teams to define GenAI data requirements, quality bars, evaluation criteria, and delivery plans.
  • Operate across the full lifecycle: research, prototyping, experimentation, productionization, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, runbooks, and production support.

  • Ph.D. degree, Master's degree, or equivalent experience in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, operations research, statistics, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years with a Master's degree or 3+ years with a Ph.D. applying machine learning to real-world problems.
  • Strong Python programming skills and experience building production-quality ML, GenAI, or data systems.
  • Hands-on experience with PyTorch and modern deep learning stacks; experience with Hugging Face, LLMs, VLMs, diffusion models, or multimodal models is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with data-centric AI or GenAI methods such as synthetic data generation, data quality measurement, dataset curation, weak supervision, model-based labeling, active learning, deduplication, or data augmentation.
  • Experience designing experiments and interpreting results through statistical analysis, ablation studies, benchmark evaluation, and error analysis.

job.title: Network Developer 3
job.description:
Job Description

The AI2NE Org strives to be global leaders in the RDMA cluster networking domain and enable seamless, accelerated High-Performance Compute (HPC), Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning advancements. We envision a future where artificial intelligence and machine learning revolutionize industries, reshape societies, and unlock limitless possibilities. Our vision is to be a pioneering force, driving the development and design of state-of-the-art RDMA clusters tailored specifically for AI, ML, HPC workloads.

We strive to be the go-to experts in RDMA cluster architecture, leveraging our deep understanding of the unique demands of AI/ML and HPC applications. By staying at the forefront of technological advancements, we aim to redefine the boundaries of what is possible, pushing the envelope of computational capabilities and unlocking unprecedented performance.

Supports the design, deployment, and operations of a large-scale global Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Primarily focused on the development and support of network fabric and systems through a combination of a deep level understanding of networking at the protocol level coupled with programming skills. As OCI is a cloud-based network with a global footprint, this support will include hundreds of thousands of network devices supporting millions of servers, connected over a mix of dedicated backbone infrastructure, CLos Network, and the Internet.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with program/project managers to develop milestones and deliverables.
  • Will primarily use existing procedures and tools to develop and safely execute network change. However, may have to develop new procedures from time to time.
  • Develop solutions to enable front line support teams to act on network failure conditions.
  • Mentor junior engineers.
  • Participates in network solution and architecture design process and contribute to the roadmaps development.
  • Participate in operational rotations as either primary or secondary.
  • Provide break-fix support for events. Serve as the escalation point for event remediation. Lead post-event root cause analysis.
  • Frequently develops scripts to automate routine tasks for team and business units.
  • Coordinate with networking automation services for the development and integration of support tooling.
  • Coordinate with network monitoring to gather telemetry and create alerts rules using them.
  • Build dashboards to represent data at various network layers and device roles that help identify network issues, anomalies.
  • Serves as SME on software development projects for network automation and network monitoring.
  • Collaborate with network vendor technical account team and internal Quality Assurance team to drive bug resolution and assist in the qualification of new firmware and/or operating systems.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in CS or related engineering field with 5+ years of Network Engineering experience or master’s with 3+ years of Network Engineering experience.
  • Experience working in a large ISP or cloud provider environment. Experience in RDMA Networking is a plus.
  • Experience working in a network operations role.
  • Folks with strong knowledge of protocols such as MPLS, BGP/OSPF/IS-IS, TCP, IPv4, IPv6, DNS, and DHCP. Also, VxLAN and EVPN will be an added advantage.
  • Extensive experience with scripting or automation and data center design – Python preferred but must demonstrate expertise in scripting or compiled language.
  • Experience with networking protocols such as TCP/IP, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and SSL.
  • Experience with network monitoring and telemetry solutions.
  • Experience with network modeling and programming – YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF.
  • Ability to use professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways. Capable of working under limited supervision.
  • Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Excellent judgment in influencing product roadmap direction, features, and priorities.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.

Qualifications

Career Level - IC3

Required Skills

  • Automation
  • IP Networking
  • Networking Fundamentals
  • Python
  • Virtual Local Area Networks

job.title: Services Sales Representative IV
job.description:
About the Role

As an Account Manager in CSS you will be responsible for selling services that help customers realise and maximise the value of their Oracle investments. You will own a defined set of solution opportunities, working with Oracle account teams to identify, shape, position and close services engagements.

You will connect customer priorities to Oracle CSS advisory, modernisation services, cloud success, operational excellence, AI adoption and continuous innovation capabilities. You will demonstrate the credibility of Oracle's solutions at all levels with particular focus on C-suite executives and other key decision makers.

You will work closely with business leaders, IT executives, architects, partners, License Sales, Cloud, Support and Oracle specialists to develop strategic opportunities that deliver lasting customer success.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

  • Own sales from opportunity qualification through proposal, negotiation and close.
  • Understand customers' business priorities, operating models, industry challenges and strategic objectives, using AI-enabled insights and analysis to deepen discovery, identify patterns and align them to the most relevant Oracle CSS services.
  • Develop compelling value propositions, solution narratives and executive business cases, using AI to accelerate research, tailor customer-specific insights and strengthen the articulation of business outcomes and measurable value.
  • Build trusted relationships with board-level stakeholders, C-suite executives, senior business leaders, IT executives and technical decision makers.
  • Generate leads, progress qualified opportunities and submit customer proposals.
  • Provide credible solution presentations that position Oracle CSS capabilities aligned to customer needs.
  • Shape technical and cross-solution approaches in partnership with architects and specialists, ensuring customer needs are addressed with the right Oracle capabilities.
  • Drive the gathering and reuse of Oracle intellectual property, case studies, implementation examples and best practices to strengthen customer proposals.
  • Create and execute strategic account plans aligned with customer priorities, Oracle CSS growth strategies and initiatives, using AI to identify whitespace and expansion potential to uncover high-value growth opportunities.
  • Maintain a strong pipeline, manage complex opportunities and consistently contribute to sales targets.
  • Stay informed on market trends, including AI, cloud, cybersecurity, data, applications, digital transformation and future Oracle solution development.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who combines commercial thinking, advanced business and technical acumen, curiosity and a genuine passion for helping customers succeed.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 6+ years of relevant field sales experience, ideally in enterprise technology, consulting services, managed services, customer success, cloud services or enterprise software.
  • Proven success selling services-led solutions, including generating leads, developing proposals, nurturing opportunities and closing transactions.
  • Strong understanding of Oracle or comparable enterprise technology environments, including cloud, AI, enterprise applications, infrastructure, data and digital transformation.
  • Ability to connect customer needs and challenges to a set of Oracle CSS solutions, including cross-solution or technically complex services engagements.
  • Confidence engaging with CIOs, CTOs, CFOs, board members and senior business executives.
  • Strong consultative selling, discovery, storytelling, presentation and executive communication skills.
  • Experience developing and executing strategic account plans for major accounts, including competitive positioning, implementation references and future roadmap considerations.
  • Ability to develop strong internal relationships and collaborate effectively across Sales, Cloud, Support, Delivery and development teams and partner organisations.
  • Commercial negotiation, proposal development, opportunity management and pipeline discipline.
  • Ability to act as a leading individual contributor and team member, providing direction, coaching or mentoring to others where appropriate.
  • High levels of ownership, curiosity, resilience, self-motivation and comfort working on non-routine, complex opportunities.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.

Why Oracle Customer Success Services?

Oracle CSS sits at the centre of helping customers achieve long-term success with Oracle technology. In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Work with key strategic customers across South Australia.
  • Help customers adopt AI, cloud and enterprise technologies that transform their operations and overall business.
  • Sell outcome-focused services that deliver real business value.
  • Collaborate with world-class technical, product, sales and industry experts.
  • Access continuous professional development and sales enablement.
  • Build a rewarding career with one of the world's most respected technology companies.
  • Be part of an inclusive, supportive and high-performing team where your ideas and contributions matter.

What Success Looks Like

Our most successful team members are:

  • Naturally curious, customer-focused and outcomes-oriented.
  • Strategic thinkers who see opportunities others miss and can link customer business priorities to Oracle services.
  • Credible advisors who earn trust with senior executives and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong communicators who simplify complex concepts and present compelling business cases.
  • Collaborative team players who bring the right Oracle expertise together to win.
  • Disciplined opportunity managers who build pipeline, progress proposals and close services transactions.
  • Enthusiastic adopters of AI who use it responsibly to deepen customer insight, improve productivity and strengthen solution innovation, while building future-ready skills, accelerating their learning and increasing their impact.
  • Driven to deliver outstanding customer outcomes, not just close transactions.

If you're looking for an opportunity where you can make a genuine impact, grow your career and help customers unlock the full potential of Oracle technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Description

About Oracle NetSuite

At Oracle NetSuite, we believe businesses should be empowered by technology—not burdened by it. As the world's leading cloud ERP platform, NetSuite helps organizations streamline operations, improve visibility, and accelerate growth through a unified, AI-powered business management suite.

Oracle NetSuite Professional Services partners with customers to deliver successful ERP transformations through industry expertise, innovation, and leading practices.

Position Overview

Oracle NetSuite Professional Services is seeking a Senior Principal Consultant with expertise in the Consumer Goods and Retail industry and a proven track record delivering complex NetSuite ERP implementations.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to customer executives and business stakeholders, leading ERP transformation initiatives from strategy and solution design through implementation and adoption. You will leverage deep NetSuite expertise, industry knowledge, and AI-enabled business capabilities to help customers modernize operations, improve decision-making, and achieve measurable business outcomes.

As a senior member of the consulting organization, you will provide solution leadership, mentor project teams, influence executive decision-making, and contribute to practice growth and business development initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Advisory & Solution Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customer executives, business leaders, and project sponsors.
  • Lead discovery workshops, business process assessments, and solution design sessions.
  • Develop transformation roadmaps aligned with customer objectives and NetSuite leading practices.
  • Influence strategic business and technology decisions through industry expertise and solution recommendations.

NetSuite ERP Implementation

  • Lead end-to-end NetSuite ERP implementations from discovery through go-live and stabilization.
  • Define requirements for customizations, integrations, workflows, reporting, and automation initiatives.
  • Partner with technical teams to design, validate, and deploy scalable business solutions.
  • Ensure solution quality and adherence to NetSuite implementation methodologies.
  • Architect and deliver solutions across Finance, Supply Chain, Inventory, Procurement, Order Management, Warehouse Operations, Demand Planning and Manufacturing.
  • Advise customers on industry-leading practices across retail operations, merchandising, inventory management, demand planning, procurement, fulfillment, and direct-to-consumer business models.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, profitability, and scalability through process optimization and technology adoption.

AI-Enabled ERP Innovation

  • Identify and implement AI-driven use cases within ERP transformation programs.

  • Support AI adoption strategies, governance considerations, and business value realization initiatives.

  • Mentor consultants and provide functional leadership across engagements.

  • Contribute to reusable assets, implementation accelerators, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Maintain expertise in NetSuite products, industry trends, and emerging technologies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Business, Accounting, Information Systems, Supply Chain Management, Commerce, or a related discipline.
  • 6–10 years of ERP consulting, digital transformation, or enterprise applications experience.
  • Minimum 2+ years of hands-on Oracle NetSuite ERP consulting and implementation experience (mandatory).

  • Strong requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, business process documentation, and executive presentation capabilities.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple customer engagements and competing priorities simultaneously while maintaining high-quality delivery, customer satisfaction, and project timelines.
  • Strong project leadership skills with experience managing scope, risks, dependencies, stakeholder expectations, and implementation milestones across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Ability to synthesize business requirements, solution recommendations, and implementation roadmaps into clear and compelling customer communications.
  • Strong business process consulting and transformation experience.
  • Experience implementing or advising on AI-enabled ERP solutions leveraging Generative AI, Intelligent Automation, or Predictive Analytics.

  • Consumer Goods, Retail, Wholesale Distribution.
  • NetSuite ERP Consultant and/or SuiteFoundation Certification.
  • Experience with SuiteCommerce, Advanced Inventory, WMS, Demand Planning, Manufacturing, or Supply Chain solutions.
  • Experience integrating NetSuite with eCommerce platforms, POS systems, CRM applications, and other enterprise solutions.
  • Experience supporting executive presentations, solution architecture reviews, and pre-sales engagements.

Join a high-performing consulting organization that helps leading Consumer Goods and Retail companies transform their businesses using NetSuite and emerging AI technologies. This role offers the opportunity to work with senior business leaders, solve complex operational challenges, influence strategic decisions, and drive impactful ERP transformation initiatives on a global scale.

  • Drive operational execution for service patching, upgrades, staged rollouts, change controls, and readiness reviews using metrics-driven planning and governance.
  • Partner with global OCI teams to ensure India operations align with broader host management roadmaps, standards, escalation practices, and fleet reliability goals.

Operational Excellence, Metrics, and Governance

  • Define and mature operational KPIs and reporting for service health, incident performance, ticket aging, ticket resolution quality, queue backlog, change execution, and operational readiness.
  • Lead high-severity incidents and escalations: coordinate rapid triage, communicate status clearly, drive high-quality post-incident reviews, and follow through on corrective actions.
  • Improve operating mechanisms for risk management, audit/compliance alignment, change management, handoffs, escalation hygiene, and cross-team execution tracking.
  • Use data and trend analysis to identify repeat issues, operational bottlenecks, staffing gaps, process defects, and opportunities for reliability improvement.

Engineering Enablement, AIOps, and Automation

  • Drive adoption of AIOps and intelligent automation to reduce manual toil, improve alert quality, accelerate event correlation, standardize remediation, and improve triage accuracy.
  • Partner with engineering and platform teams to prioritize operational tooling, telemetry improvements, workflow enablement, runbook automation, and self-healing opportunities.
  • Establish measurable automation outcomes such as reduced manual handling, improved MTTR, increased auto-triage coverage, fewer repeat issues, and better operator/engineer effectiveness.
  • Manage focused software engineering work aligned to operations outcomes, including scripts, dashboards, workflow tooling, triage aids, monitoring enhancements, and reliability automation.

Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with senior leaders, peer managers, technical leads, and globally distributed teams to deliver predictable execution across AI/GPU host operations.
  • Translate complex technical and operational situations into accurate narratives, decisions, risks, and action plans for senior stakeholders.
  • Represent the team in operational reviews, readiness discussions, incident forums, and cross-functional planning sessions with clarity and ownership.

Qualifications / Experience

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure operations, cloud operations, site reliability, production operations, or related technical areas.
  • 5+ years of people management and/or technical leadership experience, including experience leading operators, engineers, senior technical contributors, or multiple operational workstreams.
  • Experience building and scaling teams, including recruiting, hiring, coaching, performance management, goal setting, and leadership development.
  • Strong operational background with incident management, service ownership, queue management, operational readiness, process improvement, and post-incident corrective actions.
  • Experience operating or supporting Linux-based infrastructure at scale, including hardware/software troubleshooting and service lifecycle execution.
  • Working familiarity with scripting and automation ecosystems such as Python, Bash, or similar tools sufficient to sponsor, review, and guide operational tooling direction.
  • Understanding of distributed systems fundamentals and the ability to reason across hardware, operating systems, networking, services, monitoring, automation, and customer impact.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols such as TCP/IP and HTTP and with standard cloud infrastructure architectures.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, including prioritization, scheduling, execution tracking, and operational governance.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, operational status, tradeoffs, and execution plans to senior stakeholders.

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience operating large-scale cloud infrastructure, AI/ML infrastructure, HPC environments, or GPU fleets.
  • Experience leading teams in a 24x7 production operations environment with globally distributed stakeholders.
  • Experience driving automation, AIOps, telemetry improvements, alert noise reduction, event correlation, runbook standardization, or toil reduction programs.
  • Experience managing operational tooling or focused engineering efforts for workflow enablement, triage automation, monitoring, reliability, or service readiness.

  • Demonstrated success using metrics such as MTTR, ticket aging, incident volume, repeat issue rate, automation coverage, SLO/SLA performance, and readiness indicators to improve operations at scale.

Leadership Profile

You are a distributed-systems-minded operations and engineering leader who values simplicity, scalability, ownership, and measurable execution. You combine people leadership with technical depth, enabling teams to operate reliable OCI services while continuously improving the operational and engineering foundations.

You are comfortable leading through ambiguity, driving accountability during escalations, and building mechanisms that help teams deliver consistently. You use data to set priorities, improve reliability, reduce toil, and strengthen execution across a rapidly growing AI/GPU infrastructure fleet.

job.title: Senior Optical DC Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

AI2CNE strives to be a global leader in the RDMA cluster networking domain and enable seamless, accelerated High-Performance Compute (HPC), Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning advancements. We envision a future where artificial intelligence and machine learning revolutionize industries, reshape societies, and unlock limitless possibilities. Our vision is to be a pioneering force, driving the development and design of state-of-the-art RDMA clusters tailored specifically for AI, ML, HPC workloads.

We strive to be the go-to experts in RDMA cluster network architecture, leveraging our deep understanding of the unique demands of AI/ML and HPC applications. By staying at the forefront of technological advancements, we aim to redefine the boundaries of what is possible, pushing the envelope of computational capabilities and unlocking unprecedented performance.

This role supports design, deployment, and operations of large-scale global Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Primarily focused on the development and support of high-speed fiber optic network fabric links and systems through a combination of a deep level understanding of optical cables of various types (patch cords, shuffle, bulk/trunk etc.) and high speed optical transceivers for interconnects for leaf-spine RDMA cluster networks at the L0/L1 physical layer1 and L2 protocol level coupled with troubleshooting and automation/programming skills. As OCI is a cloud-based network with a global footprint, this support will include millions of optical links for hundreds of thousands of network devices supporting millions of servers, connected over a mix of dedicated backbone infrastructure, CLOS Network, and the Internet.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with engineers from L1 optical engineering team, network design, delivery and AI Ops, DC Ops, and DC build teams and program/project managers to develop milestones and deliverables validating optical cabling and optical transceivers build quality and validation in the AI data center builds to the OCI standards for RDMA backend networks.

  • Will primarily use existing procedures and tools to develop and safely execute DC network builds and changes. However, may have to develop new procedures from time to time.
  • Provide break-fix support for optical links to meet RDMA cluster performance criteria (pre-FEC BER, Rx power, FEC bin, BOL and EOL margins etc.).
  • Serve as the escalation point for event remediation and lead post-event root cause analysis.
  • Frequently develops MPOs or scripts to automate routine tasks for team and business units to improve quality of builds.
  • Support dashboards build with requirements to represent data at L1 layers and device roles that help identify link level issues, anomalies such as link flaps and link downs.
  • Serves as SME on data center build standards for DC build environment, optical cabling and optics transceivers install and troubleshooting.
  • Participate in AI DC deployment rotations at DC build sites with up to 50% international/domestic travel for build sites quality control and optical link validation support for new clusters and provide recommendations to various teams for improvement and enforcement
  • Support Ops to stabilize RDMA networks after turn-up.

Qualifications

Career Level - IC4

Required Skills

  • Fiber Optic Connector
  • Fiber Route Design
  • Network Engineering
  • Networking Equipment
  • Structured Cabling Deployment
  • Structured Cabling Design

job.title: Lead Principal Security Software Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Lead Principal Security Software Engineer to lead Oracle’s next generation of AI-powered software assurance technologies. You will provide technical leadership for a strategic engineering initiative focused on AI systems that automatically discover, analyse, explain and remediate software vulnerabilities at scale. You will lead a small team of engineers and security researchers developing AI-driven platforms that combine large language models, agentic workflows, binary analysis, static and dynamic program analysis, and secure software engineering to improve vulnerability detection and automated vulnerability remediation across Oracle products. This role combines deep technical leadership with hands-on engineering. You will define technical strategy, drive AI architecture, mentor engineers, and translate cutting-edge AI and security research into production-quality systems that help developers identify and fix vulnerabilities earlier and more effectively. Success in this role requires strong software engineering skills, experience leading complex AI-based engineering projects, practical application security expertise, and the ability to build scalable AI systems that augment security engineers and software developers.

Who We Are

We are a world-class team of software security engineers, AI engineers and security researchers building the future of software assurance. We combine expertise in secure software engineering, binary analysis, reverse engineering, program analysis and modern AI to create intelligent systems that help engineers build more secure software.

Our mission is to transform software assurance through AI by developing platforms that automate vulnerability discovery, root-cause analysis and secure code remediation at cloud scale.

Join us to help define the future of AI-driven software security.

Responsibilities

Work You’ll Do

  • Lead the technical direction of AI-powered vulnerability detection and automated remediation initiatives across Oracle.
  • Design and build AI systems that discover, explain, prioritise and help remediate software vulnerabilities throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Lead development of agentic workflows that coordinate LLMs with static analysis techniques.
  • Drive architecture for scalable AI platforms supporting autonomous and human-in-the-loop security analysis.
  • Develop AI-assisted code repair capabilities that generate, validate and refine secure software fixes.
  • Build evaluation frameworks that measure AI effectiveness, accuracy, precision, recall and remediation quality.
  • Design orchestration, planning, validation, memory and recovery mechanisms for complex AI agents.
  • Collaborate with security researchers to translate novel vulnerability research into AI capabilities.
  • Build maintainable, production-quality software platforms used by engineering teams across Oracle.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design and code reviews while mentoring software engineers and AI researchers.
  • Partner with cloud engineering, product security and developer platform teams to integrate AI security capabilities into engineering workflows.
  • Communicate technical strategy, AI roadmap and architectural decisions to senior technical leadership.

What You’ll Bring

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 12 or more years of experience in software engineering, security engineering, application security, systems software or a related discipline.
  • Experience leading complex AI-enabled engineering projects from concept through production.
  • Strong software engineering background with experience building large-scale, maintainable software systems.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted or agentic systems using large language models.
  • Experience integrating AI into developer tools, security tooling or engineering workflows.
  • Strong understanding of software vulnerabilities, secure coding practices and application security principles.
  • Experience applying binary analysis, reverse engineering, static analysis or dynamic analysis to software security problems.
  • Experience designing evaluation methodologies for AI systems, including quality, safety and reliability metrics.
  • Experience building production AI systems including orchestration, planning, validation, observability and continuous improvement.
  • Experience working with Python and one or more systems programming languages such as C, C++, Rust or Java.
  • Experience integrating AI systems with development platforms, APIs and existing engineering tooling.
  • Strong architectural judgement and experience designing scalable engineering platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Legal authorisation to work in Australia without sponsorship.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a large cloud or enterprise software company.
  • Experience building or extending binary analysis, reverse engineering or program analysis tools.
  • Experience with compiler internals, LLVM, intermediate representations or static analysis frameworks.
  • Experience with coverage-guided fuzzing platforms such as AFL++, libFuzzer, Honggfuzz or comparable systems.
  • Experience analysing compiled binaries across architectures such as x86, x64 and ARM. Experience with architectures such as MIPS or RISC-V would also be valuable.
  • Experience with symbolic execution, concolic execution, taint analysis or dynamic instrumentation frameworks.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability classification and scoring frameworks such as CWE, CVSS, CAPEC or MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Experience building AI systems for automated code generation or code transformation.
  • Experience building AI systems for vulnerability detection, secure code review or automated remediation.
  • Experience evaluating LLMs for security tasks using benchmarks and automated evaluation pipelines.
  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, agent frameworks or multi-agent systems.
  • Experience fine-tuning or adapting foundation models for software engineering or cybersecurity tasks.
  • Experience developing AI safety, guardrails and validation mechanisms for autonomous engineering systems.
  • zExperience analysing operating systems, kernels, hypervisors, firmware, compilers or other low-level software.
  • Demonstrated contributions to the security community through published CVEs, open-source projects, technical publications, conference presentations or significant security research.

What We’ll Give You

  • The opportunity to work with a highly skilled and diverse global team.
  • A flexible, hybrid working environment.
  • Exposure to complex, large-scale and cutting-edge systems.
  • The resources of a global technology leader combined with the agility and close collaboration of a small engineering team.
  • Opportunities to work with advanced software assurance, AI and security technologies.
  • Extensive training and professional development opportunities.
  • Competitive benefits and company perks.
  • An organisation filled with smart, enthusiastic and motivated colleagues.
  • The opportunity to make a significant impact on the security of Oracle products and services.

Qualifications

Career Level - IC5

job.title: Software Developer 3, Oracle Health
job.description:
About the Role

At Oracle Health, we're transforming healthcare administration through Oracle Health Insurance (OHI), a cloud-native payer platform supporting enrollment, billing, benefits administration, provider payments, and claims adjudication.

As Oracle expands Oracle Health Insurance capabilities globally, including support for U.S. Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance programs, and AI-enabled claims processing, we're investing in engineers who are passionate about building the next generation of healthcare payer solutions.

As an IC3 Software Development Engineer, you will contribute to the design and development of scalable cloud services, healthcare business workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that improve operational efficiency for health plans and government programs.

Responsibilities

As a member of the software engineering division, you will assist in defining and developing software solutions associated with Oracle Health Insurance products. You will design, develop, test, and deploy software components while collaborating with cross-functional teams across product management, architecture, QA, and customer implementations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and enhance OHI modules supporting enrollment, benefits, claims, and payments.
  • Build scalable microservices and APIs supporting payer workflows.
  • Contribute to healthcare payer platform capabilities and country-specific configurations.
  • Participate in AI and automation initiatives leveraging LLMs and agent-based solutions.
  • Develop integrations using healthcare standards and EDI transactions.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-quality software.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or related field.
  • 3–7 years of software engineering experience.
  • Strong programming skills in Java and/or Python.
  • Experience with REST APIs and distributed systems.
  • Strong SQL and database fundamentals.
  • Experience with cloud technologies (OCI, AWS, or Azure).
  • Knowledge of software design patterns and object-oriented design.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted software development tools and modern developer productivity technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare payer domain knowledge.

job.description:
Job Description

Role Overview

Oracle is seeking a senior leader to serve as a OCI & AI Infrastructure Pursuits Lead within the Global AI Infrastructure & Strategic Pursuits organization.

This lead will operate at the intersection of sales, engineering, and executive leadership, owning end-to-end engagement for priority accounts. This includes owning revenue generation and customer acquisition for cloud infrastructure solutions, including compute, GPU/AI capacity, storage, and networking. This role requires leadership in end-to-end sales cycles for large-scale, complex deals with enterprises and hyperscale customers, driving long-term partnerships and multi-year contracts.

_\\\\\\* This role will have key coverage on China market and fluency in both English and Mandarin (Chinese) is required_

_\\\\\\* This role can be hired out of Singapore or Hong Kong location_

  • Build and manage a high-value pipeline across enterprise and strategic accounts
  • Identify and close large-scale infrastructure deals (e.g., AI clusters, GPU capacity, multi-region deployments)
  • Consistently meet/exceed quota targets (ARR, TCV, prepay structures)

  • Own executive relationships across customer organizations (CIO, CTO, Head of Infrastructure, AI leaders)

  • Product Positioning & Messaging

  • Translate technical capabilities into business value (cost/performance, scalability, latency, reliability)

  • Technical & Business Value Selling
  • Translate infrastructure capabilities into business outcomes (cost efficiency, performance, scalability)

  • Build ROI/TCO models to justify large capital and operating commitments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Work closely with inbound PMs, engineering, finance, and operations
  • Align product roadmap with market demand and commercialization strategy
  • Coordinate launches across marketing, PR, and partner ecosystems

Required Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure (compute, GPUs, storage, networking, data centers)
  • Experience working with large enterprise or hyperscale customers
  • Strong commercial acumen (pricing, deal structuring, revenue modeling)
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes
  • Executive presence with experience supporting C-level engagements
  • Structure and negotiate tailored commercial frameworks to support large-scale, strategic engagements
  • Align with global leadership priorities, including CEO-directed initiatives and high-visibility pursuits
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources to ensure successful execution across sales, product, and delivery teams
  • Provide market insights and feedback to inform global strategy and product direction
  • _This role will have key coverage on China market and fluency in both English and Mandarin (Chinese) is required \\\*_

Preferred Qualifications

  • Significant experience in enterprise technology sales, cloud infrastructure, or AI-related solutions
