job.title: Security Engineer - Architecture
job.description:
About us

We’re growing, not slowing, here at Macquarie Technology Group because we’re passionate about doing things differently. We want to challenge the industry and look for better ways of doing things. As a team, Macquarie Government are hardworking, results and success focused. We also take the time to celebrate our success and make sure our people are doing work that makes a difference.

We believe that collaboration & team connection is key for success. This role will be based in Sydney with a blended working arrangement of 3 days in our CBD offices & the remaining working from home. #LI-Hybrid

We require security clearance for this role, you must be an Australian citizen to be eligible to obtain a security clearance.

The Opportunity

Are you a Security Engineer who thrives on building and enhancing cyber security solutions that protect critical Australian Government environments?

As a Senior Security Engineer - Architecture, you'll play a key role in designing, implementing and optimising security services across Macquarie Government's Secure Internet Gateway (SIG) and managed cyber security environments. Working alongside a highly skilled cyber team, you'll leverage technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel and Splunk to strengthen detection and response capabilities, deliver security outcomes for customers and drive continuous improvement across our security platforms. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex government environments while influencing the future direction of our cyber security services.

Are you a Security Engineer who thrives on building and enhancing cyber security solutions that protect critical Australian Government environments?

As a Senior Security Engineer - Architecture, you'll play a key role in designing, implementing and optimising security services across Macquarie Government's Secure Internet Gateway (SIG) and managed cyber security environments. Working alongside a highly skilled cyber team, you'll leverage technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel and Splunk to strengthen detection and response capabilities, deliver security outcomes for customers and drive continuous improvement across our security platforms. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex government environments while influencing the future direction of our cyber security services.

Why Us?

  • We're Australia's Great Place to Work 2025 certified for 3 years in a row.
  • For the third year in a row, we have been named a Global Winner of the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award!
  • Over 42% of Australian government agencies use and trust us. They depend on us to protect them from private and state-sponsored cyber attackers.
  • We have the highest Net Promoter Score on the ASX, the [World's best customer experience](https://www.businessthink.unsw.edu.au/articles/macquarie-telecom-tudehope-customer-experience) & [crowned in 2020 at the World Communications Awards](https://www.scoop.co.nz/stories/BU2010/S00476/macquarie-telecom-group-wins-best-customer-experience-in-the-world.htm).
  • You’ll make an impact: Enjoy being part of a driven team with a collaborative culture that values decision-makers and action.
  • We Invest in you: Accelerate your career through our learning and development opportunities - think Gallup strengths-based training, defined career pathways and fantastic internal mobility opportunities across the group.
  • A dynamic and supportive team that values smart thinking.
  • A workplace where your business insights are celebrated.

What you'll be doing.

  • Design, implement and support cyber security solutions for Australian Government customers.
  • Lead customer onboarding and implementation activities, including solution design and technical documentation.
  • Build, configure and optimise Microsoft Sentinel and Splunk environments.
  • Develop and tune security detections, analytics rules, dashboards and reporting capabilities.
  • Investigate cyber threats, identify trends and implement preventative security controls.
  • Support and enhance Secure Internet Gateway (SIG) infrastructure and managed security services.
  • Collaborate with Security Operations, Infrastructure and Customer Success teams to deliver exceptional outcomes.

job.title: Cyber Security Architect
job.description:
About Us

At Macquarie Cloud Services, our people are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’re proud to be Australia’s #1 Great Place to Work in Technology for 2026, Australia’s #1 Great Place to Work for two consecutive years, and Great Place to Work Certified for three years running.

Macquarie Cloud Services are the Australian specialists in cloud services for business and government. Locally owned and operated, with an industry-leading customer service model, we’re trusted by our customers to provide the services that enable their business success.

We have made it our challenge to make our people feel good and love the work they do. Because of this, our people are energised and motivated in their work.

The Opportunity.

In this role, you will be responsible for defining and evolving the technology, platforms, use cases and processes that power Macquarie Cloud Services' Security Operations Centre (SOC). As the Cyber Security Architect, you will provide the technical vision and leadership that enables our SOC to detect, respond to and remediate cyber threats at scale across a diverse customer base.

You will act as the technical authority across our Managed Security Practice, guiding security analysts, engineers and stakeholders while continuously improving our managed security services. Working closely with Product, Operations and Engineering teams, you will help shape our security strategy, evaluate emerging threats, design new capabilities and ensure our customers remain protected in an ever-evolving threat landscape.

You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on technical leadership, contributing to architecture, detection engineering, threat management, security automation and service innovation. Whether developing new security use cases, evaluating Microsoft security technologies or mentoring the next generation of security professionals, you'll play a key role in strengthening Macquarie's position as a leader in managed security services.

The Opportunity.

In this role, you will be responsible for defining and evolving the technology, platforms, use cases and processes that power Macquarie Cloud Services' Security Operations Centre (SOC). As the Cyber Security Architect, you will provide the technical vision and leadership that enables our SOC to detect, respond to and remediate cyber threats at scale across a diverse customer base.

You will act as the technical authority across our Managed Security Practice, guiding security analysts, engineers and stakeholders while continuously improving our managed security services. Working closely with Product, Operations and Engineering teams, you will help shape our security strategy, evaluate emerging threats, design new capabilities and ensure our customers remain protected in an ever-evolving threat landscape.

You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on technical leadership, contributing to architecture, detection engineering, threat management, security automation and service innovation. Whether developing new security use cases, evaluating Microsoft security technologies or mentoring the next generation of security professionals, you'll play a key role in strengthening Macquarie's position as a leader in managed security services.

Why Us?

Australia's #1 [Great Place To Work](https://www.linkedin.com/company/great-place-to-work-us/) in Technology, 2026. We have been awarded Australia's #1 Great Place to Work 2025 for the second year running! We're Great Place to Work Certified 2023, 2024 and 2025. For the third year in a row, we have been named a Global Winner of the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award! We're the #1 Managed Services Cloud business in Australia. We have the highest Net Promoter Score on the ASX, the [World's best customer experience](https://www.businessthink.unsw.edu.au/articles/macquarie-telecom-tudehope-customer-experience) & [crowned in 2020 at the World Communications Awards](https://www.scoop.co.nz/stories/BU2010/S00476/macquarie-telecom-group-wins-best-customer-experience-in-the-world.htm). You’ll make an impact: Enjoy being part of a driven team with a collaborative culture that values decision-makers and action. We Invest in you: Accelerate your career through our learning and development opportunities - think Gallup strengths-based training, defined career pathways and fantastic internal mobility opportunities across the group.

What you’ll be doing.

  • Define the strategy, technology roadmap, platforms and operational processes that underpin Macquarie's Security Operations Centre (SOC).
  • Design and evolve managed security services including SIEM-as-a-Service, Extended Detection & Response (XDR), Global Secure Access and Microsoft Security solutions.
  • Act as the technical authority for the Microsoft Security stack, including Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, Entra ID and Zero Trust architectures.
  • Design, enhance and continuously improve security use cases, detections, dashboards, playbooks and response workflows to improve threat detection, response and operational effectiveness.
  • Provide guidance to customers on security strategy, cyber maturity and security framework alignment, including the ACSC Essential Eight, NIST, ISM and ISO27001.
  • Provide architectural leadership and technical guidance to SOC analysts, security engineers and other technical stakeholders.
  • Evaluate emerging threats, vulnerabilities and security advisories, assessing the impact on customer environments and recommending mitigation strategies.
  • Drive continuous improvement across security monitoring, threat detection, automation and incident response through innovation and operational excellence.
  • Support customer engagements, technical workshops, solution design discussions and strategic security conversations.
  • Collaborate with Product, Operations and Engineering teams to shape the future direction of Macquarie's Managed Security Practice.
  • Mentor and develop team members, fostering a culture of learning, innovation and technical excellence.

Required Skills and Experience.

  • Significant experience in Cyber Security Architecture, Security Engineering or a senior technical security leadership role.
  • Strong architecture and solution design experience across enterprise, MSP, consulting or vendor environments.
  • Deep expertise across the Microsoft Security stack, including Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, Entra ID, Global Secure Access and Zero Trust principles.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and optimising Microsoft Sentinel detections, analytics rules, workbooks, automation and SOC processes.
  • Strong understanding of Security Operations Centre (SOC) design, detection engineering, threat management and security operations processes.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise SIEM platforms and modern security operations practices.
  • Experience designing security use cases, response playbooks, automation opportunities and operational frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of cyber threats, adversary tactics and security frameworks including ACSC Essential Eight, NIST, ISO27001, ISM, SABSA or TOGAF.
  • In-depth networking knowledge across Layers 3-7, including protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS and SMTP.
  • Experience with scripting, automation and analytics technologies including KQL, Python, PowerShell or similar.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A passion for Cyber Security, innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Proven ability to mentor and uplift technical teams within a high-performing environment.
  • Australian Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain an NV1 Security Clearance.

If this excites you, apply now, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: HVAC Mechanic (Journeyperson)

job.title: SitecoreAI Content and Personalization Specialist
job.description:
SitecoreAI Content and Personalization Specialist

Position Overview

Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced SitecoreAI Content and Personalization Specialist to join our Global Marketing IT team. This role will be responsible for driving enterprise content operations, digital asset management, AI-powered content optimization, personalization, and experimentation across the global Sitecore ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Sitecore Content Hub, Sitecore AI, Sitecore XM Cloud, and Sitecore Personalize, with proven experience designing and executing content strategies that enable scalable omnichannel experiences. This individual will partner with business, marketing, analytics, and technology teams to ensure content is structured, governed, optimized, and activated effectively across customer journeys.

A key objective of this role is to leverage Sitecore AI and Content Hub capabilities to improve content discoverability, automate content operations, enhance personalization, accelerate content production, and drive measurable business outcomes through testing and optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Sitecore AI Enablement

  • Leverage Sitecore AI capabilities to improve content creation, optimization, classification, tagging, and asset enrichment.
  • Define and implement AI-assisted content workflows that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Utilize AI-driven insights to identify content gaps, optimization opportunities, and personalization strategies.
  • Support AI-powered content recommendations and customer experience optimization initiatives.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams to operationalize AI-enhanced content generation while ensuring governance and brand compliance.
  • Evaluate and implement emerging Sitecore AI capabilities and best practices across the enterprise.

Sitecore Content Hub Leadership

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Sitecore Content Hub DAM, CMP, and Content Operations capabilities.
  • Design and manage enterprise content taxonomies, metadata models, content schemas, and governance frameworks.
  • Establish and maintain content lifecycle processes including creation, review, approval, publication, archival, and compliance.
  • Drive adoption of Content Hub as the central source of truth for digital assets and marketing content.
  • Configure and optimize Content Hub workflows, governance policies, permissions, and content approval processes.
  • Lead metadata standardization, asset classification, tagging, and content discoverability initiatives.
  • Support Content Hub integrations with XM Cloud, personalization platforms, analytics solutions, and downstream marketing channels.
  • Drive content reuse and content modularization strategies to support omnichannel delivery and composable architecture.

Personalization & Customer Experience Optimization

  • Design, implement, and optimize content experiences using Sitecore Personalize.
  • Define personalization strategies based on audience segments, behavioral data, customer journeys, and engagement metrics.
  • Partner with analytics teams to create audience targeting rules and content decisioning frameworks.
  • Enable dynamic content delivery based on customer preferences, geography, product interests, lifecycle stage, and behavioral signals.
  • Develop and maintain personalization governance and measurement frameworks.
  • Monitor personalized experiences and continuously optimize outcomes based on data-driven insights.

A/B Testing & Experimentation

  • Lead digital experimentation strategies across web experiences and customer journeys.
  • Design and execute A/B tests, multivariate tests, content experiments, and personalization experiments using Sitecore capabilities.
  • Define hypotheses, success metrics, statistical requirements, and reporting methodologies.
  • Analyze experiment results and provide actionable recommendations to improve engagement, conversions, and customer experience.
  • Establish best practices for testing, optimization, and experimentation governance.
  • Collaborate with UX, Digital Marketing, Product, and Analytics teams to prioritize and execute testing roadmaps.

Content Strategy & Governance

  • Define enterprise content architecture and reusable content models supporting XM Cloud and composable DXP initiatives.
  • Establish best practices for content structure, SEO, accessibility, localization, and omnichannel publishing.
  • Drive content quality assessment and optimization initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment between content strategy, customer journeys, personalization objectives, and business goals.
  • Maintain governance standards for metadata, taxonomy, tagging, content ownership, and lifecycle management.

Required Qualifications

Must-Have Experience

  • 8+ years of hands-on Sitecore experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Sitecore Content Hub (DAM/CMP) administration, implementation, or content operations.
  • Strong experience with Sitecore AI capabilities and AI-driven content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with Sitecore Personalize.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and executing A/B testing and experimentation programs.
  • Strong understanding of customer journey mapping, audience segmentation, and content personalization.
  • Experience creating and managing enterprise taxonomies, metadata structures, and content governance frameworks.
  • Experience with content modeling and reusable content design in Sitecore XM Cloud.
  • Deep understanding of composable architecture and omnichannel content delivery.
  • Experience working closely with marketing, content authors, product teams, UX teams, and analytics teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline
  • Experience with Sitecore Search and content discovery capabilities.
  • Experience with CDP, customer data platforms, and audience activation use cases.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted content operations and content supply chain initiatives.
  • Knowledge of digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with SEO, accessibility, localization, and global content management practices.

Top Mandatory Skills (Screening Criteria)

  • Sitecore Content Hub (DAM + CMP)
  • Sitecore AI & Personalize
  • Content Personalization Strategy
  • A/B Testing & Experimentation
  • Content Taxonomy & Metadata Management
  • Content Governance
  • Omnichannel Content Operations
  • Analytics-Driven Content Optimization

Preferred Certifications

  • Sitecore Content Hub Certification
  • Sitecore XM Cloud Certification
  • Sitecore Personalize Certification
  • Sitecore Experience Platform Certification
  • AI or Generative AI related certifications

job.title: Account Manager (Building Solutions)
job.description:
Join a Global Leader in Smart Building Technologies, Fire Protection & Sustainable Solutions

At Johnson Controls, we're transforming the way buildings perform. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help customers enhance safety, optimise energy use, reduce carbon emissions, and maintain critical infrastructure across industries including healthcare, education, commercial facilities, manufacturing, and government sectors.

With more than 140 years of innovation and industry expertise, Johnson Controls combines leading technology with world-class service delivery to create smarter, safer, and more sustainable environments. Our people are at the centre of our success, and we're committed to providing opportunities for growth, development, and long-term career success.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

As part of a global organisation, you'll have the opportunity to work with some of the industry's most experienced professionals while managing a diverse portfolio of customers across Sydney and NSW. This role offers autonomy, strong earning potential, and genuine career progression within a market-leading business.

What we offer:

  • Permanent full-time opportunity
  • Competitive salary package + superannuation
  • Car allowance
  • Attractive incentive program
  • Supportive team culture and industry-leading training
  • Career development opportunities within a global organisation

About the Role

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of existing customers while identifying new business opportunities across our service offerings. You will partner closely with customers to understand their operational needs and deliver tailored solutions across Building Management Systems (BMS), HVAC, Fire, Security, and related building services.

Your focus will be on building trusted customer relationships, driving recurring service revenue, increasing account penetration, and delivering long-term value to both customers and the business.

Key Responsibilities

Account Management & Customer Success

  • Manage and develop strategic relationships across an assigned customer portfolio.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring a high level of service, engagement, and satisfaction.
  • Conduct regular account reviews to identify opportunities for improvement, renewal, and growth.
  • Develop a strong understanding of customer operations, objectives, and future requirements.

Business Development & Growth

  • Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities within existing and prospective accounts.
  • Drive growth in recurring service agreements and project-based opportunities.
  • Develop and implement account plans to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to deliver comprehensive solutions that meet customer needs.

Solution Selling

  • Engage customers through a consultative sales approach to identify challenges and recommend value-driven solutions.
  • Prepare proposals, quotations, and presentations aligned to customer requirements.
  • Support contract negotiations and successful commercial outcomes.

Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate closely with service technicians, operations teams, project managers, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of customer commitments.
  • Maintain regular communication with customers regarding service performance, project updates, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Market Engagement

  • Build and maintain a strong industry network across facilities management, property, healthcare, education, commercial, and industrial sectors.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify emerging opportunities.

About You

You are a customer-focused and commercially driven professional who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and driving business growth.

You will bring:

  • Proven experience in Account Management, Business Development, Sales, or Customer Relationship Management.
  • Strong knowledge of Building Management Systems (BMS), HVAC, Fire, Security, Building Services, or related technical industries is highly regarded.
  • A track record of achieving sales targets and growing customer accounts.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to identify growth opportunities.
  • A consultative and solutions-focused approach to customer engagement.
  • Ability to build credibility with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented.
  • An established network within the Sydney building services, facilities management, construction, property, or infrastructure sectors will be highly advantageous.

Compliance Requirements

To be considered for this position, applicants must have:

  • Full Australian working rights.

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction. Maintain project quality, on time delivery and manage escalations.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.

  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.

  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

3 to 8 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System.

job.title: Senior Manager – AMC Sales (CFS & IBMS))
job.description:
Who we are?

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Visit [johnsoncontrols.com](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/) for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.

Why JCI: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg)

Asia-Pacific LinkedIn: [https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feedView=all](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feedView=all)

Career: [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue: [This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What will you do?

Business Development

  • Identify and target potential clients for AMC sales across multiple industry verticals.
  • Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of prospects through networking, referrals, cold calling, and cross-selling activities.
  • Collaborate with inside sales teams to build a strong sales funnel and drive opportunity conversion.
  • Generate new business opportunities while expanding existing customer accounts.

Sales & Negotiation

  • Prepare customized proposals, quotations, and commercial agreements based on customer requirements.
  • Negotiate contract terms and close deals to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
  • Present and demonstrate IBMS AMC solutions and service offerings to prospective customers.
  • Ensure accurate sales forecasting and pipeline management.

###

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customer stakeholders.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for AMC customers throughout the sales and onboarding process.
  • Drive contract renewals and identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
  • Ensure high customer satisfaction through proactive engagement and support.

Market Intelligence & Strategy

  • Monitor industry trends, market developments, and competitor offerings.
  • Analyze customer requirements and tailor AMC proposals to meet operational and commercial needs.
  • Develop strategies to recover lost accounts and strengthen customer retention.
  • Provide market insights and feedback to support business growth initiatives.

Collaboration & Execution

  • Work closely with service delivery teams to ensure commitments made during the sales process are fulfilled.
  • Coordinate with technical and operations teams to align AMC solutions with service capabilities.
  • Support seamless customer onboarding and handover processes.
  • Foster cross-functional collaboration to enhance service quality and customer experience.

What we look for?

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  • 5-10 years of experience in B2B sales, AMC sales, facility management services, building management systems, or related service industries.
  • Proven track record in business development, customer acquisition, and contract negotiations.
  • Strong understanding of AMC business models, service contracts, and customer lifecycle management.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems and sales reporting tools.

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents.

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate.  Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

  • Mentor and guide junior team members in SAP MDG and DevOps methodologies.
  • Stay updated with the latest SAP technologies and industry trends.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Proficiency in DevOps tools and methodologies, including CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud services.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and leadership abilities.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Power Platform Developer with 3-5 years of experience in designing, building, deploying, and maintaining enterprise-grade Power Platform solutions that combine apps, automations, data, and conversational AI to solve real business problems.

job.title: IT Tech Analyst II
job.description:
What you will do:

· Assess entirety of Johnson Controls' internal and external attack surfaces, with special focus on assessing exposure of Johnson Controls' assets to vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and other findings.

· Maintain vulnerability management and external attack surface platforms for both Product and Corporate teams, including defining scan schedules, analyzing agent deployments and coverage gaps, building reports, and creating dashboards, etc.

· Partner with operational teams to identify, prioritize, and communicate vulnerability details.

· Support various audits by ensuring adherence to documented process and providing supporting data as needed

· Periodically assess security policies, standards, baselines, procedures, and metrics to drive improvements that help Johnson Controls adapt to evolving regulatory, customer, and threat environments.

How you will do it:

· Exhibit knowledge in various exposure and vulnerability management platforms and concepts

· Establish relationships with operational stakeholders by assisting teams with vulnerability data, prioritization rationale, guidance on remediation steps, etc.

· Prepare stakeholder prioritization reports and data ahead of scheduled touchpoints. Ensure all relevant data is posted for archival. Participate in stakeholder meetings with focus on note taking and recording action items for follow-up.

· Lead emerging threat review process, monitoring for newly announced vulnerabilities and assessing impact to JCI with immediacy.

· Support audits by providing supporting data as needed

· Periodically assess security policies, standards, baselines, procedures, and metrics to drive improvements that help Johnson Controls adapt to evolving regulatory, customer, and threat environments.

What we look for:

· 2+ years of professional experience; Cyber security or Vulnerability management experience a plus

· Ability to follow and manage previously built, well-documented processes

· Attention to detail, ensuring that all necessary documentation/ artifacts are preserved to support audits

· Effective communication skills; focusing on delivering potentially complex technical details to non-technical stakeholders

· Ability to learn new tools and concepts quickly

· Demonstrated problem-solving skills to analyze customer cyber issues and requirements (regulatory, policy, customer, industry standard) and link to appropriate security controls.

JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.

job.title: PLM Test Automation Engineer
job.description:
Our employees are the most important part of our business. Thank you for your interest in applying to new opportunities with us.

Job Title: PLM Windchill Test Automation Engineer

Location: Johnson Controls – Pune, India

Experience Required: 3+ Years

Department:IT Engineering Services

Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Overview:

Johnson Controls is seeking a highly experienced PLM Windchill Test Automation Engineer to join our IT Engineering Services team in Pune. This role is pivotal in ensuring the quality and reliability of our global PLM systems, with a focus on Windchill PDMLink and associated modules. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in test automation, leadership in QA strategy, and hands-on experience with Windchill implementations in a global enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • work on the test automation strategy for Windchill PLM applications across multiple business units.
  • Develop and maintain automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, TestNG, and REST Assured.
  • Collaborate with global teams in the US, EMEA, and APAC to align testing efforts with business goals.
  • Drive automated regression testing, integration testing, and performance validation for Windchill modules including PDMLink, MPMLink, and Change Management.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab, or Azure DevOps.
  • Work closely with PLM architects, developers, and business analysts to ensure test coverage and defect resolution.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to QA engineers in Pune and other global locations.
  • Participate in Windchill upgrade and migration projects, ensuring robust test coverage and minimal business disruption.
  • Maintain documentation for test plans, scripts, and execution results in tools like JIRA, Confluence, and ALM.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in QA and test automation, with at least 5 years focused on Windchill PLM.
  • Strong programming skills in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
  • Hands-on experience with Windchill APIs, Info*Engine, and customization testing.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and enterprise DevOps practices.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in a global engineering environment with distributed teams.
  • Exposure to SAFe Agile practices and tools.
  • Certifications in ISTQB, PTC Windchill, or relevant automation tools.
  • Experience with performance testing tools like JMeter or LoadRunner.

Why Join Us at JCI Pune?

  • Be part of a global innovation leader in building technologies and solutions.
  • Work on cutting-edge PLM transformation initiatives within the IT Engineering Services domain.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across continents.
  • Enjoy a flexible work culture, continuous learning, and career growth opportunities.

JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories

job.title: Bid Manager (Data Center Solutions)
job.description:
The Assistant Bid Manager plays a vital role in supporting the Bid Manager, Sales Director and Country/Division sales team with the project management and governance of the sales process across the full opportunity lifecycle — providing support from early opportunity identification and pipeline management through to the Request for Information (RFI) and Request for Proposal (RFP) stages.

It is a rewarding role and you will work across a broad range of interesting client accounts and internal CBRE stakeholders.The role is suited for someone who is passionate about quality, creativity, written word and seeing end results.You will have attention to detail and a flair for understanding and articulating solutions to client needs and challenges.

You will also have strong writing skills and are looking to develop your skills and build your bid management career. You will work closely with the Bid Manager, Business Development Managers (BDM) and Business Unit Sales Coordinators (BUSC) to ensure differentiated, innovative and client focused proposals are delivered on time and to an exceptional standard.

What you’ll do:

Attracting clients

‒Conduct client research to support cultivation

‒Assist with preparation of materials for prospective client meetings and presentations

‒Support the coordination of BU events by inputting into content, themes and materials

‒Support account planning by helping to capture client insights, relationship maps and whitespace opportunities that inform pursuit strategy

‒Support client engagement activities, helping to prepare for and follow up on prospective client meetings and capturing key actions and next steps

RFI and RFP process

‒The role provides bid support to your assigned BU, and you will coordinate and support the bid process with your BDM for new sales opportunities as required.

‒Ensure request for information (RFI) questionnaires are submitted to a high standard

‒Work closely with the sales team to manage proposals from initiation to submission, this will include:

o Ensure bid tracker/responsibility matrix is created for every opportunity and team remains organised

o Response planning and structuring

o Coordinate and manage supply chain partners to obtain quotations and pricing inputs in support of the BDM's commercial and pricing efforts

o Work with BDMs and Bid Manager to develop win themes aligned to client needs

o Write bespoke bid responses and work closely with the BDM to produce compelling executive summaries

o Check and challenge content, and contributions from others to ensure written responses clearly articulate differentiation and win themes

o Ensure final documents are of the highest quality through design, editing and proof reading

‒Ensure the team are on track for post proposal activities, helping plan and prepare site visit, presentation and workshop materials.

Knowledge and process

‒Support the Bid Manager to embed and improve process and knowledge across the Country/Division

‒Work closely with the team to develop and update the content library with professional profiles, account profiles and case studies. Share content with the wider business

‒Proactively stay up to date with CBRE, industry knowledge and innovations, sharing this information with the team and allowing this knowledge to filter in to bid responses

‒Gather and share market intelligence on clients, competitors and sector trends to strengthen pursuit strategy and win themes

‒Support sales enablement by helping to maintain and share reusable content, templates and tools that improve the quality and efficiency of sales and bid activity

Networking and collaboration

‒Support the Bid Manager by helping to build and foster a community and supporting on writing and proposal training within the BU,Build an internal network across the Business Unit to enhance knowledge, share best practice, and collectively benefit from shared insights

‒Build relationships with operational leaders and support functions.

What you’ll need:

Character You are passionate about quality, creativity, written word and seeing end results. You will have attention to detail and a flair for understanding and articulating solutions to client needs and challenges.

An ideal candidate for this role is energetic, proactive and able to prioritise demands and work to deadlines. With natural leadership skills and the ability to build robust working relationships, the ideal candidate has the ability to influence and motivate, and can work under pressure and to demanding and multiple deadlines

  • Strong writing skills, creativity and desire to win are crucial.
  • Education Higher educational qualifications to degree level would be beneficial.
  • Writing Skills Strong bid writing and editing skills are essential. Past bid writing and management experience in a sales environment is desirable.
  • Technology Skills Must possess excellent Microsoft 360 skills – primarily Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Administration Skills You are a strong communicator with solid planning skills. You like to stay organised, can delegate and manage multiple deadlines across multiple stakeholders.

Desirable Experience‒Experience working in a bid management and/or sales environment

‒Experience writing and managing proposals

‒Experience of meeting tight deadlines

‒Experience supporting and collaborating within teams

‒Experience of dealing with and co-operating with a wide range of people. Circumstances & Confidentiality Must be flexible to work outside core office hours from time to time to meet tight deadlines as set by customers.

This role may require travel on occasions to other work locations for team meetings, site visits or to attend confere nces or events.

All work opportunities are to be treated as highly confidential.

job.title: Senior Services & Commissioning Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the Senior Services and Commissioning Manager, Australia, based in Sydney, you will report directly to the Services and Commissioning Associate Director based in our HQ in Sydney. You will work closely with the Design, Development and Operations teams, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Act as the building services and commissioning lead, overseeing multiple projects in Sydney and manage them through to successful completion and handover to the operations team and customers.
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders including General Contractors, Suppliers, Commissioning Agents and Customers to meet all AirTrunk requirements within the testing and handover process.
  • Collaborate with the APME AirTrunk Development and Design team to drive the safety and quality standards and global best practices to meet AirTrunk requirements
  • Ensuring AirTrunk’s data centres are commissioned not just for completion, but for long‑term operability, performance and lifecycle sustainability.

This role is predominantly based in our data centres in Sydney, Australia, but may require you to travel to interstate and overseas occasionally

Your Day to Day

  • Provide leadership to the internal and external commissioning teams throughout the commissioning process for new data center developments in Sydney, Australia
  • Ensure governance throughout the commissioning process to maintain high standards of project delivery.
  • Conduct detailed design review and drive improvements of MEP (Mechanical, Electrical Plumbing) services to our new data centers to enable successful commissioning
  • Plan and execute the commissioning and handover process for AirTrunk new data centers in the region (Support in other regions may be required from time to time)
  • Oversee and manage multiple projects at different project stages at any one time
  • Ensure that all commissioning procedures follow the necessary safety and environmental policies and practices.
  • Drive consultant, General Contractor, Supplier and Commissioning Agent activities prior to and during commissioning to enable efficient and successful handover.
  • Coordinate and resolve technical issues leading up to and during commissioning.
  • Internal and external stakeholder engagement and report back to management on the status of commissioning activities
  • Drive and witness successful factory testing of MEP equipment.
  • Attend regular design and commissioning meetings to ensure AirTrunk standards and procedures are being maintained. Attend construction meetings on an as-need basis.
  • Establish and coordinate the commissioning schedule with general contractors, vendors, contractors, and commissioning agent to ensure completion prior to RFS dates.
  • Review the MEP, DCS, ICT, Security and other services designs for compliance with AirTrunks requirements and to enable efficient and successful completion and commissioning and Oversee stakeholders document control for these disciplines
  • Oversee contractor commissioning defect management process and Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
  • Coordinate commissioning activities with AirTrunk Operations teams and ensure submissions of MOPS, O&M Manuals and Training on-time and to AirTrunk’s requirements

Requirements

  • You have 8+ years of experience acting as a Commissioning Manager lead for a data center provider or Commissioning Agent role leading the successful handover of complex data center projects
  • Experience commissioning in live, operational data centres
  • You have a good understanding of multi-disciplinary building services design, construction and commissioning processes
  • You have experience interfacing with data center MEP Suppliers, Contractors, and Commissioning Agents within the APAC market
  • You are incredibly flexible and adaptable to a dynamic fast-paced, collaborative environment
  • You are willing to make decisions and be accountable for them
  • You excel at communication; you can deliver effective presentations on data centre design and commissioning strategies to customers, peers and management
  • You have good leadership acumen to lead multi-disciplinary teams across multiple geographies
  • You are willing to travel to other APAC regions

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Director, Water Infrastructure Strategy
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

At AirTrunk, we’ve all come together to deliver Data Centres that meet and grow with the needs of our large cloud, content and enterprise customers.

Water management is a key pillar of our sustainability commitments. We design and operate our Data Centers to source water responsibly, reduce reliance on potable water where appropriate, limit usage in water-stressed areas and improve water productivity to support energy, carbon and community outcomes. Through strong water stewardship, we seek to balance business growth with catchment-level resilience, responsible resource use and measurable sustainability impact.

In this leadership role, you will define and lead AirTrunk’s water strategy across the portfolio, managing a team of managers to deliver sustainable, commercially robust and operationally resilient water outcomes.

You will make your mark in a number of ways:

  • Set and own the regional water strategy for Data Center sites, ensuring scalable, sustainable and resilient water supply solutions across existing and future markets.
  • Lead, coach and develop a team of managers responsible for utility connections, upgrades, alternative supply options, water infrastructure delivery and site-level optimisation.
  • Oversee portfolio-wide assessment of water stress, supply risk and regulatory conditions, translating insights into long-term strategic plans and investment priorities.
  • Build executive-level partnerships with utilities, authorities, customers and solution providers to unlock recycled, industrial and alternative water sourcing opportunities.
  • Define the roadmap to water positivity, including on-site and off-site water solutions, reuse strategies, discharge optimisation and measurable sustainability outcomes.
  • Develop and implement a water stewardship framework that aligns site-level water decisions with regional sustainability objectives, local catchment conditions, stakeholder expectations and long-term operational resilience.
  • Establish governance, performance metrics and reporting cadence for water usage, metering, efficiency, risk management and delivery performance across the portfolio.
  • Influence design, site selection, development, commercial and operations decisions to ensure water strategy is embedded into major business and customer commitments.

Your Day to Day

  • Lead a team of managers, setting priorities, removing barriers, allocating resources and ensuring consistent delivery across markets and projects.
  • Represent AirTrunk with senior utility, government, customer and strategic partner stakeholders to shape water supply, infrastructure and sustainability outcomes.
  • Provide executive oversight of water projects, including supply connections and upgrades, infrastructure investments, commercial contracts, risk mitigation and delivery milestones.
  • Partner with customers at senior levels to understand water requirements, influence commitments and ensure AirTrunk’s water strategy supports customer growth and sustainability expectations.
  • Translate water sustainability strategy into practical implementation plans, including recycled water adoption, water reuse, efficiency initiatives, catchment partnerships, performance targets and transparent reporting.
  • Work with Design, Site Selection, Development, Commercial and Operations leaders to align water decisions with business strategy, technical requirements and long-term operating performance.
  • Prepare and present executive-level recommendations, investment papers, governance updates and performance reports for senior leadership forums.
  • Establish operating rhythms for the team, including portfolio reviews, cross-functional escalation, performance tracking and continuous improvement of water strategy delivery.

Requirements

  • Minimally 10 years of relevant experience e.g. water utilities, water project development and delivery, water sustainability water infrastructure services, water consulting, water treatment and recycled water, etc.
  • Strong understanding of the water supply landscape in several of our Asia-Pacific and Japan markets (including Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, Hong Kong and Japan)
  • Strong expertise in water supply design principles and various water technologies such as water treatment/recycling/recovery/capture
  • Relationships and networks in the water industry in the above markets
  • Strong analytical thinking and comfortable with data analysis and presentation (especially in PowerPoint and Excel)

  • Demonstrated experience leading multiple concurrent large-scale projects or programs.

job.title: Director, Software Engineering - Agentic AI - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

Equinix Incubation builds the agentic systems that run the software delivery lifecycle end to end: a fleet of specialized AI agents, with humans directing the work and owning every gate. Someone has to own the product, the roadmap, and the team behind it. That is this role.

You will lead the engineering pods that build the orchestration layer, the persona consoles, and the agents themselves, and carry the roadmap from first MVP to organization-wide scale. This is a player-coach role for a leader who can hold a product vision, an architecture, an executive audience, and a hiring plan in their head at the same time.

Responsibilities

Own the Product and the Roadmap

  • Define and drive the delivery-engine roadmap: orchestrator, agent fleet, consoles, dashboards, and enterprise integrations, sequenced for value
  • Make the build-measure-learn loop real: ship in sprints, pilot with live delivery teams, and let adoption and telemetry reshape the plan
  • Own trade-off decisions across scope, quality, cost, and speed, and defend them with data in front of senior leadership

Build and Lead the Pods

  • Hire, grow, and retain a small, exceptional team of agent engineers, platform engineers, and delivery talent across the UK and India
  • Run lean pods where agents do the routine work and people do the judgment work; model that way of working yourself
  • Set a high, kind bar: clear expectations, honest feedback, and career growth in the most modern engineering discipline there is

Prove the Value

  • Own the value story: cycle time, throughput, quality, adoption, and realized business value, instrumented and reported without drama
  • Keep the economics honest: agent cost, platform cost, and capacity unlocked, treated as first-class engineering metrics
  • Turn pilot wins into an expansion case that finance and function leaders believe

Set the Operating Standard

  • Establish how agent-first engineering is done: evals as release gates, human-in-the-loop approvals, and responsible AI governance with InfoSec and the AI council
  • Represent the platform in architecture and governance forums, and keep the roadmap aligned with enterprise platform and data strategy
  • Share patterns, standards, and playbooks so other teams can adopt what your team proves

What Success Looks Like

  • The delivery engine is in daily use by live delivery teams, with measurable cycle-time and quality gains that survive finance scrutiny
  • You have built a team people want to join, with a hiring record and retention that show it
  • Executives trust your roadmap because what you commit to ships, and what ships gets measured
  • The operating standards your team set are being adopted beyond your team

Qualifications

  • 12+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams or engineering-led products
  • A record of shipping and scaling platforms or products in an enterprise, from first release through adoption
  • Hands-on fluency with modern AI: LLM-powered applications, agentic systems, and what it takes to make them production-grade
  • Strong architectural judgment across APIs, event-driven systems, cloud platforms, and enterprise integration
  • Proven hiring and talent development record, including building distributed teams
  • Executive-grade communication: you can carry a room of senior stakeholders with a clear, honest narrative

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

"The Senior Electrical Engineer is an advanced subject matter expert, accountable for the overall integration of Standards, System Processes, Design and Construction, and Commissioning efforts.

This role is responsible for designing, installing, and maintaining the electrical systems that power and support the GDC data center operations.

This role coaches and develops less experienced electrical engineers within the team."

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Consults on creative solutions to complex electrical problems that arise in design and operation of mission critical systems.
  • Continuous improvement to come up with better ways to accomplish design intent, meet competitive landscape, and reduce cost.
  • Research new products, systems, and materials.
  • Accountable for the development of standard electrical equipment and specifications and developing redundancy schemes that meet the company’s strategic goals.
  • Networks with the Design Management team to ensure design deliverables meet company strategic goals. Conduct QA/QC of design and documentation, including but not limited to construction drawings and commissioning test scripts.
  • Represent the organisation with outsourced design consultants to ensure design concepts and product selection align with the organisations strategic goals for developing and operating cost effective, highly efficient, and reliable Data Centres.
  • Provide expertise to other organisation sectors internal to NTT GDC, including CFOps, Construction, Commissioning, Client Success, and Sales.
  • Represent General Construction as a Primary Electrical Project Specialist for selected Data Centre sites.
  • Networks with the Construction team to ensure design deliverables meet project schedules.
  • Accountable for participating in factory witness testing of new equipment.
  • Accountable for reviewing and approving of equipment submittals.
  • Participate in commissioning activities of new data centre phases.
  • SME for CFOps to troubleshoot problems and conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective Action (CA) for design related problems affecting efficient and resilient site operations.
  • SME for CFOps in review of operating procedures and maintenance initiatives.
  • Consult on electrical system modelling using AmpCalc, ETAP, and other electrical design software.
  • Networks with internal Sales Engineering team in analyzing RFPs, responding to RFP questions, conducting training on electrical systems in new buildings, and participating in client site visits.
  • Consults internal Deployment Services team in reviewing client fit out requirements and systems designs.
  • Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:
  • Expert Comprehensive knowledge of electrical system design and power distribution in Data Centres.
  • Expert Comprehensive knowledge of various mission critical topologies such as Distributed Redundant, Block Redundant etc.
  • Ability to work independently with minimum oversight and supervision and shall be self-motivated to complete the necessary due diligence and gather details as needed to come up with solutions.
  • Possess expert knowledge of controls and BMS/EPMS Systems.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of NFPA 72 (NEC), NFPA 70E, and other related codes and standards for electrical design of Data Centres.
  • Knowledge of Life Safety, IBC and OSHA codes and standards.
  • Strong Understanding of critical Data Centre electrical and mechanical equipment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, AutoCAD, Revit, electrical engineering software and Bluebeam PDF editing software.
  • Must be detail oriented with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment both virtual and in person.
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with individuals and groups both internally and externally.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills.

Organized and able to set priorities and meet deadlines and budgets

  • Academic Qualifications and Certifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering required.
  • Professional Engineering license achievement preferred.
  • Required Experience:
  • Advanced experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical Data Centres.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.description:

The Electrical Design Engineer will develop electrical design HDLC units such as In-row CDU and In rack CDU as well as 2 phase products. He/she will closely follow objectives of quality, environment and costs working in cooperation with manufacturing engineering, controls engineering, procurement, suppliers, mechanical engineering, and product marketing. The Electrical Engineer will contribute to the release of new products; will work in a cross-functional development group; manage a variety of tasks and activities in a dynamic environment; and solve complex problems where no precedence exists.

Job Summary

The _Electrical Design Engineer_ will develop electrical design HDLC units such as In-row CDU and In rack CDU as well as 2 phase products. He/she will closely follow objectives of quality, environment and costs working in cooperation with manufacturing engineering, controls engineering, procurement, suppliers, mechanical engineering, and product marketing. The Electrical Engineer will contribute to the release of new products; will work in a cross-functional development group; manage a variety of tasks and activities in a dynamic environment; and solve complex problems where no precedence exists.

Responsibilities

  • Design new and low voltage electrical enclosures (>240 volts AC).
  • Harness Design, schematic creation and 3D modeling of wiring and cabling inside equipment.
  • Experience with CREO Cabling module is preferred.
  • Capable and proficient at understanding and applying various standards of NEC (NFPA70), CSA/UL, and IEEE to do a proper selection of electrical components that meet agencies requirements.
  • Collaboration and guideline across the disciplines of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, process engineering, as well as production and offering teams. Work with these teams for design reviews, meeting cost metrics, and brainstorming around customer pain points.
  • Performs a variety of engineering calculations using traditional engineering methods to verify design requirements
  • Extended Responsibilities:
  • Create, revise and audit unit wiring schematics and network connection drawings
  • Create, review and audit electric panel layouts following relevant codes and standards
  • Create, revise and audit wire harnesses

Requirements

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) or related degree from an accredited college or university
  • 5+ years of experience in hardware development roles.
  • More than 5 years of expertise with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) or product documentation management systems.

Job Title: Supervisor Service Technical Support

Position Summary

The HVAC SME will provide advanced technical expertise in heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems, focusing on design, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimisation. This role supports critical environments such as data centers, industrial facilities, and commercial projects, ensuring compliance with safety standards and operational excellence.

  • Design & Commissioning: Lead installation and commissioning activities, ensuring proper integration and optimal performance.

job.title: Customer Product Quality Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

  • Drive customer satisfaction and product field quality improvements.  Interface with the customer to understand current issues, report performance metrics, and present 8D’s.  Organization cross functional teams to drive issue resolution utilizing discipline problem solving techniques.  Minimize customer operational risk when field issues, defects, recalls, or performance degradation events occur.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop 8D and Customer reports on reported issues.  Communicate internally and externally on outcomes of investigations. Work with internal teams, including Engineering, Service, Manufacturing/Operations, Sales, Offering Management, and Supplier Quality to resolve quality issues impacting customers.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to implement corrective actions through problem solving process. Evaluate completed corrective actions and ensure effectiveness of actions. Ensure root-cause analysis (RCA), corrective actions, and preventive actions (CAPA) are executed and tracked
  • Recommend appropriate remedial activities.  Leverage automation and AI to mistake proof processes.  Ensure rapid containment, clear communication, and structured resolution that maintains customer confidence and operational continuity.
  • Works with site team to incorporate management system and process changes to drive continuous improvement.
  • Escalate decisively when timelines, quality, or customer commitments are at risk.
  • Visit customers to proactively see installations and document improvement needs. Visit customers to understand the nature of the issue and get definite corrective action initiated in the organization.
  • Present reports to organization regarding Quality performance.  Present status updates on various quality initiatives to business management.
  • Create analytic reporting using Use Excel, SQL, and Power BI.  Identify top issues, trends, and correlation between factory performance and field issues.
  • Support Warranty administration as needed.
  • Capture lessons learned to improve future product launches and field readiness.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Job Qualifications

  • BA or BS in Engineering or Technical Field
  • At least 8 years of professional engineering quality related experience.
  • Direct and relative experience conducting Root Causes and Correct Actions using 8D problem solving or similar techniques.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Excellent organizational, analytical and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work and multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficient in data analysis; ability to develop performance metrics and goals based on product and process data.
  • Generate and present reports using Excel, PowerPoint and Vertiv system applications.
  • Knowledge of Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA)

Preferred Job Qualifications

  • Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt.  DMAIC experience.
  • Experience with CNC machines, copper brazing, waterjet cutting, and leak testing.
  • Process evaluation and capability analysis - Six Sigma (DAMIC) experience a plus
  • Knowledge in electrical, mechanical and firmware design and development, reliability and test validation
  • Experience in product development cycle processes including production release, supplier qualification requirements, production qualification / validation processes and production testing.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Occasional kneeling, bending, stooping.
  • Ability to work around elevated temperatures.

job.title: Logistics Coordinator I
job.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities-Export Logistics Coordination

  • Coordinate with Production, Planning, Sales, Warehouse, Finance and CHA/Freight Forwarder for export shipments.
  • Prepare and monitor the export shipment plan based on customer requirements, Ready Date (RD), commercial terms and shipping schedule.
  • Coordinate vehicle/container placement and factory/port stuffing.
  • Track material readiness against the confirmed RD.
  • Follow up with Production for delays, partial readiness and last-minute changes.
  • Coordinate with Freight Forwarders for pickup, booking, container availability and vessel connections.
  • Monitor shipment movement from plant to port and port to destination.
  • Coordinate with Third part Inspection agency for Inspection scheduling and certification.
  • DG declaration
  • Documentation and monitor Export Incentive.
  • Shipping bill checklist approval for filing.
  • Track vessel schedules, ETD/ETA and transshipment details.
  • Escalate shipment delays, port congestion, container shortages and other operational issues.
  • Monitor detention, demurrage, waiting charges and other logistics costs.
  • The candidate should be responsible for developing and maintaining Export Logistics MIS and Power BI dashboards
  • Support compliance with Customs, DGFT, FEMA, Foreign Trade Policy and applicable export regulations.
  • Ensure correct HS classification and export documentation.
  • Support preparation of documents for FTA/Preferential Certificate of Origin & coordination.
  • Maintain supporting documents for origin qualification and costing.
  • Monitor export incentive documentation and coordinate with relevant teams.
  • Support EDPMS closure/regularization and bank documentation.
  • Maintain proper records for audit and statutory requirements.
  • Ensure timely submission of required documents to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel is required.

job.title: Regional Sales Manager, Channel
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) is responsible for driving growth of Vertiv Rack Solutions - specifically Great Lakes Case & Cabinet offerings through direct engagement with end users, channel partners, and local Vertiv offices within the assigned territory. This role focuses on expanding rack share in data center, SLED, and enterprise environments while creating pull through for complementary Vertiv solutions including rPDU, UPS, thermal, and services. The RSM will lead regional go to market strategy, develop partner capability, and influence key decision makers across IT, facilities, engineering, and procurement.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop, present, and execute a territory business plan that aligns to Vertiv growth objectives for Great Lakes rack solutions.
  • Drive incremental revenue through channel partners, distributors, and direct engagement with end users.
  • Maintain balanced focus on both existing accounts and new logo acquisition (50/50 mix).
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline within CRM through collaboration with local Vertiv offices and partners.
  • Engage and navigate all levels of end user organizations including executives, IT leadership, facility managers, and project teams.
  • Conduct site walks aligned with edge and key accelerated compute initiatives, support solution scoping and design collaboration with SE resources.
  • Develop a decision maker matrix, account plans, and go to market strategy for key verticals.
  • Lead and support partner development activities including training, enablement, and joint selling motions.
  • Manage and influence Channel Account Managers (dotted line reporting) within local Vertiv offices to ensure alignment and effective execution.
  • Strengthen relationships with regional and national distribution partners supporting Great Lakes rack products.
  • Drive partner performance, competencies, and market engagement across the territory.
  • Maintain accurate pricing, forecasting, activity reporting, and funnel management.
  • Provide consistent feedback to leadership regarding competitive trends, wins/losses, and product needs.
  • Coordinate activities with Inside Sales Representatives to maximize visibility and closure of key rack opportunities.
  • Support regional trade show strategy, including event selection, logistics, and coverage.
  • Ensure timely, high quality customer engagement and post sales follow up to maintain strong customer satisfaction and long-term loyalty.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, sales, marketing, or related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
  • 5+ years of sales experience.
  • Strong communication skills (written, verbal, and visual media).
  • Ability to build strong relationships with IT, facilities, engineering, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Highly organized with strong pipeline discipline, forecasting accuracy, and follow-through.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and capable of resolving contract and product issues.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing market needs and internal processes.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across the assigned territory

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a territory with heavy partner and end user engagement.
  • Experience in data center, IT infrastructure, or related markets.
  • Working knowledge of the data center industry and channel ecosystem.
  • Able to lead multiple offices, partners, and projects simultaneously in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience selling into Fortune 500, enterprise, SLED, and colocation customers.
  • Understanding of rack systems, rPDUs, UPS, thermal, and edge infrastructure environments.
  • Familiarity with Vertiv’s representative model and product ecosystem.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • No special physical requirements.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • 50-75%
