job.title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

RESPONSIBILITIES

Process Development and Optimization

  • Assess compliance to workmanship standards and work instructions.  Analyze production workflows to identify inefficiencies, defects, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Design and implement process controls, inspection criteria, and statistical process control (SPC) methods to reduce variability and improve yield.
  • Develop, document, and maintain manufacturing workmanship standards, process procedures, work instructions, and quality plans.

Quality Assurance and Compliance

  • Develop and maintain process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) documentation.
  • Monitor key quality metrics (scrap rate, first pass yield, cost of poor quality) and drive improvement initiatives.

Root Cause Analysis and Corrective Action

  • Lead cross-functional root cause analysis investigations using structured methodologies (8D, 5-Why, Fishbone/Ishikawa).
  • Facilitate cross-functional process improvement workshops and Kaizen events.
  • Track and validate effectiveness of corrective actions through data-driven verification.

Stakeholder Coordination and Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Design Engineering, and Supply Chain teams to ensure process capability aligns with product specifications.
  • Share best practices with other facilities and drive best practices identified by other facilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Job Qualifications:

  • BA, BS Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Industrial and Systems Engineering, or other relevant degree.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in quality, or a related field.
  • Proven track record of driving metric improvements by utilizing paretos and utilizing quality management systems in a manufacturing or production environment.
  • Direct and relative experience conducting Root Cause and Corrective Actions using 8D problem solving or similar techniques.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex data, identify trends and patterns, and develop effective solutions.
  • Direct and relative experience developing FMEA’s and control plans.
  • Experience using measurement systems in receiving inspection or problem solving.
  • Possesses a strong work ethic and sets high standards for quality and quantity of work.  Ability to work in a fast paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of metal cutting, waterjets, and CNC machines.
  • High degree of knowledge with brazing and welding.
  • Expertise in metrology and measurement equipment.
  • Working knowledge of MES systems and traceability.
  • Knowledge of quality assurance principles, methodologies, and tools, including statistical analysis, root cause analysis, and risk management.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving continuous improvement initiatives (i.e. Kaizen events)
  • Certification in quality management (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean, ASQ) and Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and people skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively at all levels of the organization.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Frequent standing
  • Occasional kneeling, bending, stooping

ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to work around elevated temperatures.

TRAVEL TIME REQUIRED

  • Travel required, approximately 10-15%.

job.title: Field Service Representative - Thermal
job.description:
Job Description

Vertiv is hiring a Field Services HVAC Representative in Vancouver, who will be responsible for service, installation, commissioning, scheduled and emergency service on Liebert cooling products serviced by Vertiv commensurate with appropriate certification.  The Field Service Representative HVAC is required to establish, promote, and maintain excellent rapport with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives and others as appropriate.  The Field Service Representative HVAC is also required to maintain continuous communication with CRC, Area/District Offices, and direct manager.

RESPONSIBILITIES

ROLE

  • Rely on direction to accomplish goals.
  • Perform a number of work-related tasks.
  • Capable of working under direct supervision or independently based upon training.

TECHNICAL

  • Render on site and phone assistance to customers.
  • Communicate with appropriate Technical Support on equipment issues
  • Perform work related tasks according to company guidelines for scheduled maintenance
  • Implement Field Change Notices (FCN) according to published guidelines
  • Keep current on Safety Bulletins, Safety Field Change Notices, Field Change Notices, and Service Tips

SAFETY

  • Operate in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines
  • Must wear appropriate PPE as per company guidelines and accordance with job duties
  • Adhere to work hours policy guidelines – “14 hours rule”
  • Report all work related accidents or injuries within 24 hours to the appropriate personnel.

ADMINISTRATION

  • Provide accurate and timely reporting according to company guidelines.
  • Timecards, expense reports, mileage reports, ticket closure, forms, et al.
  • Maintain individual inventory in accordance with company policy
  • Provide estimated time of arrival to the Customer Response Center (CRC) where applicable
  • Maintain company property according to company policies.
  • Vehicle, credit cards, PPE, test equipment, laptop, pager, cell phone, et al.

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION

  • Provide proper and adequate communication to internal and external customers
  • Provide estimated time of arrival to the customer where applicable
  • Complete scheduled maintenance documentation properly and provide to the customer and local office upon completion of each designated assignment
  • Strive to provide all customers a “first time fix” for their equipment
  • Maintain customer satisfaction rates according to company guidelines
  • Attend Customer Meetings as required

PERFORMANCE

  • Maximize productivity by combining service opportunities
  • Complete all work in an efficient and timely manner
  • Capable of making technical and commercial decisions under pressure
  • Properly evaluate site and equipment for appropriate billing status
  • Maintain productive utilization rate according to company guidelines
  • Perform inventory cycle counts according to company guidelines
  • Adhere to company dress code and safety regulations
  • Understand and comply with company startup/escalation processes and procedure
  • Maintain proper and adequate level of internal communications to Managers, co-workers, Support Services, electronic communications, et al.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required education

  • Must have High School Diploma or HVAC Trade Credentials
  • 313A 4th Year Apprentice or 313A Journey Man

Required experience (One of the following)

  • 3-5 years relevant industry/commercial experience

Interpersonal Skills

  • Professional
  • Reliable
  • Team Player
  • Must be proficient with electrical / electronic test equipment and fundamentals
  • Must be proficient in reading and interpreting electrical line diagrams and blueprints

Technical skills

  • Ability to make in depth site evaluations.  Skills to include: environmental temperature and general operating conditions
  • Independently perform fix/repair techniques based on knowledge
  • Ability to demonstrate proper brazing techniques
  • Capable of completing tasks and return unit to full operating conditions
  • Ability to summarize and report all work related tasks performed

Strong skill sets:

  • Communication skills
  • Customer service skills
  • Troubleshooting skills
  • Safety procedures
  • Organizational and planning skills
  • Computer skills
  • Mechanical aptitude

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Travel is required
  • Flexible schedules (weekends, evenings, and holidays)
  • Valid driver’s license

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

While performing duties of the above jobs, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or other components; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear and smell.  The associate frequently is required to sit and climb or balance. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.  Must have ability to regularly lift at least 50 pounds.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • 10%

job.title: Field Service Representative - Thermal
job.description:
Job Description

Vertiv is hiring a Field Services HVAC Representative in Calgary, who will be responsible for service, installation, commissioning, scheduled and emergency service on Liebert cooling products serviced by Vertiv commensurate with appropriate certification.  The Field Service Representative HVAC is required to establish, promote, and maintain excellent rapport with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives and others as appropriate.  The Field Service Representative HVAC is also required to maintain continuous communication with CRC, Area/District Offices, and direct manager.

RESPONSIBILITIES

ROLE

  • Rely on direction to accomplish goals.
  • Perform a number of work-related tasks.
  • Capable of working under direct supervision or independently based upon training.

TECHNICAL

  • Render on site and phone assistance to customers.
  • Communicate with appropriate Technical Support on equipment issues
  • Perform work related tasks according to company guidelines for scheduled maintenance
  • Implement Field Change Notices (FCN) according to published guidelines
  • Keep current on Safety Bulletins, Safety Field Change Notices, Field Change Notices, and Service Tips

SAFETY

  • Operate in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines
  • Must wear appropriate PPE as per company guidelines and accordance with job duties
  • Adhere to work hours policy guidelines – “14 hours rule”
  • Report all work related accidents or injuries within 24 hours to the appropriate personnel.

ADMINISTRATION

  • Provide accurate and timely reporting according to company guidelines.
  • Timecards, expense reports, mileage reports, ticket closure, forms, et al.
  • Maintain individual inventory in accordance with company policy
  • Provide estimated time of arrival to the Customer Response Center (CRC) where applicable
  • Maintain company property according to company policies.
  • Vehicle, credit cards, PPE, test equipment, laptop, pager, cell phone, et al.

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION

  • Provide proper and adequate communication to internal and external customers
  • Provide estimated time of arrival to the customer where applicable
  • Complete scheduled maintenance documentation properly and provide to the customer and local office upon completion of each designated assignment
  • Strive to provide all customers a “first time fix” for their equipment
  • Maintain customer satisfaction rates according to company guidelines
  • Attend Customer Meetings as required

PERFORMANCE

  • Maximize productivity by combining service opportunities
  • Complete all work in an efficient and timely manner
  • Capable of making technical and commercial decisions under pressure
  • Properly evaluate site and equipment for appropriate billing status
  • Maintain productive utilization rate according to company guidelines
  • Perform inventory cycle counts according to company guidelines
  • Adhere to company dress code and safety regulations
  • Understand and comply with company startup/escalation processes and procedure
  • Maintain proper and adequate level of internal communications to Managers, co-workers, Support Services, electronic communications, et al.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required education

  • Must have High School Diploma or HVAC Trade Credentials
  • 313A 4th Year Apprentice or 313A Journey Man

Required experience (One of the following)

  • 3-5 years relevant industry/commercial experience

Interpersonal Skills

  • Professional
  • Reliable
  • Team Player
  • Must be proficient with electrical / electronic test equipment and fundamentals
  • Must be proficient in reading and interpreting electrical line diagrams and blueprints

Technical skills

  • Ability to make in depth site evaluations.  Skills to include: environmental temperature and general operating conditions
  • Independently perform fix/repair techniques based on knowledge
  • Ability to demonstrate proper brazing techniques
  • Capable of completing tasks and return unit to full operating conditions
  • Ability to summarize and report all work related tasks performed

Strong skill sets:

  • Communication skills
  • Customer service skills
  • Troubleshooting skills
  • Safety procedures
  • Organizational and planning skills
  • Computer skills
  • Mechanical aptitude

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Travel is required
  • Flexible schedules (weekends, evenings, and holidays)
  • Valid driver’s license

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

While performing duties of the above jobs, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or other components; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear and smell.  The associate frequently is required to sit and climb or balance. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.  Must have ability to regularly lift at least 50 pounds.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • 10%

job.title: Sales Operations Lead, Singapore
job.description:
Job Description

Brief Job Description: The Sales Operations Lead, Singapore is responsible for optimising the operational effectiveness of the Sales organisation in Singapore. Based in Singapore, this role leads the Sales Operations and Order Management functions to deliver an exceptional customer experience—from forecasting, order entry through to billing.

The position oversees sales reporting, forecasting, CRM and data governance, process standardisation, risk management, and cross-functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and other key stakeholders. The role ensures high productivity, consistent execution, and scalable support for the Asia Strategic Accounts business.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Sales Operations & Governance

  • Develop and lead a control-tower framework for the Sales organization in the Singapore Market Unit.
  • Capture, track, and drive key pipeline actions to support sales strategy execution.
  • Champion standardisation across all sales and operational workflows.
  • Support Account Planning and implementation activities.
  • Identify, assess, and manage operational and commercial risks throughout the sales cycle.
  • Maintain strong alignment with Finance and Operations to ensure seamless end-to-end processes.
  • Streamline and govern core Asia sales processes, including pipeline management, deal governance, and contract/order workflows.
  • Support regional sales planning, including quota allocation, territory alignment, and target deployment.
  • When necessary, support the commercial aspects and monitor the bids & tender process
  • Supervise the order management through billing process
  • Identify process gaps and drive continuous improvements to productivity and data quality.

Sales Reporting, Forecasting & CRM Excellence

  • Own the full regional reporting cadence (weekly, monthly, quarterly) across pipeline, performance metrics, funnel analytics, and business reviews.
  • Ensure strong forecasting governance through accurate pipeline data, disciplined forecast categories, and timely sales team updates.
  • Oversee CRM data quality, adoption, and compliance with process standards.
  • Develop documentation, SOPs, and training materials to strengthen operational consistency and CRM proficiency.
  • Support preparation of regional business reviews, leadership reporting packs, and analytical insights.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Business Operations, or similar roles.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in dashboards, reporting, KPIs, sales forecasting, and performance analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce, Dynamics, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Excel, reporting tools, and basic data analysis; experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) is an advantage.
  • Experience with Oracle – process improvement projects or transformational execution is an advantage
  • Strong process orientation, with the ability to define workflows, enforce standards, and maintain governance across multiple markets.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Skills & Competencies

  • Drive, proactiveness and agility with an attitude to “own-it”.,
  • Capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced regional environment.
  • Strong commercial acumen with a deep understanding of B2B sales cycles, negotiation, and contract management.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills with the ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate customer insights into actionable account plans.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to interpret market data, trends, and competitive intelligence.
  • Highly collaborative and able to work cross-functionally with internal teams to deliver value-driven solutions.

Physical & Environment Demands

  • This role is primarily based in Singapore. But may occasionally require travel across the Asia region for client meets or business events.
  • The position involves extensive computer and phone use for communication, reporting, and virtual meetings.
  • May occasionally require extended working hours across different time zones to coordinate with regional teams and clients.
  • Must be able to manage frequent changes in work environment, including corporate offices, customer sites, and industry events.

job.title: Commissioning Technician - Power, NSW
job.description:
Job Description

Position Summary/Objectives of Incumbent:

The Power Customer Engineer (Technician) – Commissioning is a critical technical role within the Global Service – APAC ANZ division, you will be responsible for the end-to-end commissioning of Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS) and Static Transfer Switch (STS) units. This role is at the forefront of delivering high-quality commissioning services across large-scale, mission-critical environments, including Tier 1 Data Centres.

Key Responsibilities

Planning & Reporting:

  • Time Sheets - Digital reporting tool to be used to accurately record hours worked each day.
  • Commissioning/Service Reports - to be completed within set timeframes
  • Proactively communicate project progress and any site issues to the Project Manager & Service Operations Manager.

Operational Delivery:

  • Own the commissioning process from start to finish - You'll lead the full commissioning cycle across Vertiv's complete range of UPS & STS units, delivering critical infrastructure that keeps the world's most important facilities running.
  • Work on landmark projects - Carry out L2, L3, and L4 commissioning tasks alongside experienced Vertiv Project & Commissioning Managers. If you've previously worked on Tier 1 Data Centre sites, you'll feel right at home here.
  • Broaden your expertise - This isn't a one-dimensional role. You'll also support the Service Team with maintenance and time & material works, giving you exposure across the full asset lifecycle.
  • Be the face of Vertiv - Build trusted relationships with our customers through professional, solutions-focused interactions. Your feedback helps shape how we deliver for our clients.
  • Never stop growing - Access ongoing training across multiple Vertiv technologies, keeping your skills sharp and your career moving forward.
  • Enjoy the perks - A fully maintained company vehicle and the support you need to represent Vertiv at the highest standard, every day.

Daily Work Duties and expectations:

  • Travel to various sites, including remote locations, requiring a valid Driver's Licence.
  • Undertake overnight or extended travel as project demands require.
  • Safely navigate and work within confined, tight, and restricted spaces.
  • Working on and around Energised Electrical equipment, adhering strictly to safety protocols.
  • Undertake manual handling tasks, including lifting, carrying, and relocating equipment and components in accordance with WHS guidelines.

WHS, Environment & Quality:

  • Comply with all Work, Health & Safety, Environment and Quality obligations
  • Actively champion a safety-first culture on all sites, leading by example and encouraging safe behaviours among colleagues and contractors.
  • Identify, report, and mitigate workplace hazards promptly and effectively.

job.description:
Job Description

Position Summary

The purpose of this position is to carry out all aspects of the startup, commissioning, testing and maintenance of large-scale industrial LV switchboards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Delivery of project site works on LV switchgear panels (3200-6200A 415Vac) - Commissioning, testing and handover to customers over multiple industrial projects with main focus on DATACENTERS
  • Investigation of site issues/breakdowns with view to carrying out repairs as necessary.
  • Completion of preventative maintenance tasks for all aspects of LV switchgear panels. (ACBs-MCCBs)
  • Preparation of all tools, test equipment and site documentation for project/maintenance activities.
  • Communication and interface with clients, sub-contractors and various internal Vertiv departments to ensure timely progress and meet project/contract milestones.
  • Liaise with department internal procurement for any additional material requirements/manufacturing needs to close out defect lists.
  • Management of site related paperwork, ensuring documentation is signed off by all relevant parties and uploaded to client portals in a timely manner.
  • Responsibility for safe working practices on-site and ensuring all relevant WHS procedures are adhered to.
  • Some remote travel may be required.

WHS, Environment & Quality:

  • Comply with all Work, Health & Safety, Environment and Quality obligations
  • Actively promote safety in the workplace
  • Proficient in LOTO procedures

Main contacts within Company

  • Service Operations
  • Sales

Main contacts outside the Company

  • White card

  • Working knowledge of Electrical Drawings/Control Systems
  • Experience in Troubleshooting

job.title: Customer Engineer - Thermal, VIC
job.description:
Job Description

Position Summary/Objectives of Incumbent:

The purpose of this position is to carry out the maintenance servicing of Vertiv equipment, after hours service work and commissioning as planned and directed by the Service Operations Manager and Thermal Supervisor.

Key Responsibilities

Planning & Reporting:

  • Plan your customer service maintenance visits in a structured and methodical manner.
  • Time Sheets – Digital reporting tool to be used (i.e., accurately record hours worked, and all call out and response times) each day.
  • Field Service Reports - to be completed for every maintenance & service call attended.

Operational Delivery:

  • Carry out commissioning, service maintenance and after-hours service commitments in a professional, efficient manner.
  • Maintain relationships between the VERTIV and our customers, by having professional interactions with customers & providing customer feedback to the Vertiv Team.
  • Keep up to date with your training requirements across multiple Vertiv technologies.
  • Maintain the supplied company vehicle & personal appearance to the appropriate company standard.
  • Spare Parts.  Keep personal onboard spares inventory, record & report inventory use.

WHS, Environment & Quality:

  • Comply with all Work, Health & Safety, Environment and Quality obligations.
  • Actively promote safety in the workplace

Daily Work Duties and expectations:

  • Drivers Licence is required (may involve visit to remote sites)
  • Overnight or longer trips may be required.
  • Unaccompanied (Lone worker) After-hours work and being on an On-Call Roster is needed.
  • Attending customer Service calls.

job.description:
Job Description

Senior Mechanical Design Engineer – Sustaining & Compliance

Location: Pune, India

Who are We?

At Vertiv, we're on a mission to empower the people who power the future. From life-saving healthcare systems to high-performance computing, we design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. With over $8 billion in annual sales and operations in more than 130 countries, Vertiv is uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people.

We are currently seeking a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer – Sustaining & Compliance to join our growing Pune-based engineering team. This role supports existing data center rack, enclosure, and infrastructure product lines throughout their lifecycle while serving as a key contributor to mechanical compliance, certification support, and regulatory engineering activities. The position will function as an extension of Vertiv's global sustaining and compliance engineering organizations and will work closely with teams located in North America, EMEA, and India.

Position Summary

As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer – Sustaining & Compliance at Vertiv, you will provide technical leadership in both sustaining engineering and product compliance activities for released rack, enclosure, and infrastructure products. Operating as part of the Pune engineering team, you will support ongoing production, quality, cost, reliability, and field issue resolution while also owning compliance assessments and certification support activities for assigned products and engineering changes.

This position requires a strong combination of mechanical design expertise, regulatory knowledge, engineering judgment, and collaborative problem-solving. You will work closely with manufacturing, quality, product development, certification agencies, and global engineering teams to ensure products remain compliant, manufacturable, reliable, and competitive throughout their lifecycle.

The successful candidate will report to the Pune Team Lead with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Global Sustaining Engineering Manager and will routinely collaborate with the Edinboro, Pennsylvania engineering team.

Responsibilities

Sustaining Engineering

  • Support released products through ongoing sustaining engineering activities, including issue resolution, product improvements, and lifecycle management across data center rack, enclosure, and infrastructure product lines.
  • Investigate and resolve manufacturing, supplier, quality, and field-reported issues using structured root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) methodologies.
  • Develop, review, and release updated 3D models, drawings, and technical documentation using Autodesk Inventor and PTC Creo.
  • Create, review, and execute Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) supporting product corrections, cost reductions, manufacturability improvements, reliability enhancements, and supplier changes.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on product quality, serviceability, cost optimization, and operational efficiency.
  • Coordinate with manufacturing engineering, supply chain, quality, and operations to successfully implement engineering changes.
  • Maintain BOMs, drawings, and product documentation within Oracle PD Cloud and PLM systems.
  • Apply lessons learned, field feedback, and operational data to improve product robustness and prevent recurrence of issues.

Compliance Engineering

  • Own compliance assessments and regulatory evaluations for assigned products, design changes, and sustaining engineering activities.
  • Support compliance with applicable UL, IEC, CB Scheme, seismic, structural, environmental, and regional certification requirements.
  • Evaluate engineering changes for compliance impact, risk, and certification implications.
  • Support third-party certification activities, including testing, documentation preparation, technical reviews, and agency submissions.
  • Work directly with certification organizations, laboratories, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to address compliance-related questions and findings.
  • Develop and maintain compliance documentation including test plans, technical justifications, risk assessments, deviation analyses, and certification records.
  • Assist with product qualification testing, compliance investigations, and corrective-action activities.
  • Support environmental and material compliance requirements including RoHS, REACH, and other applicable regulations.
  • Serve as a compliance resource and mentor for engineering teams regarding standards interpretation and best practices.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical experience.
  • 8–12+ years of mechanical engineering experience in sustaining engineering, product development, manufacturing engineering, compliance engineering, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting mechanical compliance activities and certification efforts for commercial or industrial products.
  • Proficiency in both Autodesk Inventor and PTC Creo.
  • Strong experience with engineering change management, root-cause analysis, and product lifecycle support.
  • Hands-on experience with PLM systems such as Autodesk Vault, Windchill, or Agile.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle PD Cloud or Microsoft Dynamics.
  • Working knowledge of UL, IEC, CB Scheme, and related mechanical compliance standards.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision while leading complex technical initiatives.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated success collaborating across global teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
  • Experience supporting data center racks, enclosures, power infrastructure, or telecommunications equipment.
  • Experience supporting seismic qualifications, structural certifications, and anchoring requirements.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing processes including sheet metal fabrication, welding, machining, coatings, and assembly operations.
  • Experience with environmental compliance requirements including RoHS, REACH, and material disclosure regulations.
  • Experience interfacing directly with certification agencies, test laboratories, suppliers, and customers.
  • Experience with automation and engineering productivity tools including iLogic, VB.NET, Python, C#, or C++.
  • Experience working within globally distributed engineering organizations.

What Will Make You Successful?

  • Strong ownership of both product performance and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to balance regulatory requirements with business, manufacturing, cost, and schedule objectives.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and engineering rigor.
  • Ability to work effectively across cultures, functions, and time zones.
  • Continuous improvement mindset focused on quality, reliability, and engineering excellence.
  • Strong collaboration skills while operating as an extension of a global engineering team.

Travel Requirements

Domestic and international travel may be required to support certification activities, product investigations, training, customer visits, supplier engagements, and collaboration with global engineering teams, including periodic travel to Vertiv locations such as Edinboro, Pennsylvania.

Vertiv Core Principles & Behaviors

Our Core Principles: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Diversity & Inclusion.

Our Strategic Priorities: Customer Focus. Operational Excellence. High-Performance Culture. Innovation. Financial Strength.

Our Behaviors: Own It. Act With Urgency. Foster a Customer-First Mindset. Think Big and Execute. Lead by Example. Drive Continuous Improvement. Learn and Seek Out Development.

Location: Pune, India

Who Are We?

At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people who power the future. From life-saving healthcare systems to high-performance computing, we design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. We are currently seeking a Senior Mechanical Design Engineering Manager – Pune Team Lead to establish, grow, and lead a Pune-based mechanical engineering team supporting data center rack, enclosure, and infrastructure product lines across both released-product sustaining work and new product development activities. This role will serve as a critical extension of the US-based engineering organization, partnering closely with stateside engineering leadership to build local capability, strengthen execution, and drive product quality, reliability, cost optimization, and continuous improvement.

Position Summary

As the Senior Mechanical Design Engineering Manager – Pune Team Lead at Vertiv, you will be a highly experienced people manager with a strong mechanical design background. You will lead a growing, multi-disciplinary engineering team in Pune while maintaining enough technical depth to guide design decisions, challenge assumptions, remove roadblocks, and ensure engineering output meets Vertiv standards.

This is both a challenge and an opportunity: the successful candidate will help build a new engineering capability in Pune, shape the operating model, recruit and develop talent, and create a high-performing team that can support both rapid response sustaining needs and disciplined new product development execution. You will be expected to translate priorities from US-based leadership into clear local direction while creating a team culture built on ownership, accountability, practical problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

Reporting to US-based engineering leadership, you will collaborate closely with stateside sustaining, NPDI, product, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and operations teams. You will operate as a strong local leader and trusted extension of the Edinboro, Pennsylvania engineering team, ensuring seamless coordination across time zones while progressively building Pune-based technical capability and capacity.

Responsibilities People Leadership & Team Building

  • Establish, grow, and lead a Pune-based engineering team supporting sustaining engineering, new product development, and engineering change management activities.
  • Recruit, interview, hire, onboard, mentor, and develop engineers and technical support roles needed to build a scalable Pune engineering capability.
  • Provide day-to-day people management, technical guidance, coaching, and career development for direct reports.
  • Create a strong team culture of ownership, urgency, accountability, customer focus, engineering discipline, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage workload, priorities, resource allocation, and execution commitments in coordination with stateside engineering leadership.
  • Drive performance management, skills development, succession planning, and team capability growth as the Pune organization expands.
  • Help define practical processes, communication rhythms, and handoff mechanisms that allow Pune and US-based teams to operate as one integrated engineering organization.

Technical Leadership & Mechanical Design Oversight

  • Provide experienced mechanical design leadership for data center rack, enclosure, and infrastructure product lines, including both released-product support and new design development.
  • Apply practical knowledge of sheet metal enclosure design, manufacturing processes, tolerancing, component selection, and configuration control.
  • Guide engineers through complex design decisions involving manufacturability, fit/function, structural integrity, serviceability, cost, quality, and compliance impact.
  • Review and approve technical work products including 3D models, drawings, BOM updates, engineering changes, and supporting documentation.
  • Support development and release of mechanical designs using Autodesk Inventor and PTC Creo, while ensuring consistent use of engineering standards, templates, and best practices.
  • Ensure lessons learned from manufacturing issues, quality feedback, field concerns, and customer requirements are captured and applied to future product improvements.

Sustaining Engineering, NPDI & Change Management Execution

  • Lead and coordinate sustaining engineering activities including issue resolution, design updates, product improvements, cost reductions, component substitutions, and lifecycle support for released products.
  • Support new product development execution by helping the Pune team contribute to design documentation, drawing release, design updates, prototype support, and transition-to-production readiness.
  • Oversee effective execution of engineering change orders, documentation updates, BOM maintenance, part-number/revision control, and product data accuracy within ERP and PLM systems.
  • Partner with engineering change analysts and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure changes are properly reviewed, approved, released, tracked, and implemented with minimal disruption.
  • Investigate and resolve manufacturing, quality, supplier, and field-reported issues using structured root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action methodologies.
  • Balance fast response to production and customer needs with disciplined engineering change control and long-term product robustness.

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  • Partner closely with US-based engineering leadership and technical leads, taking direction on priorities while providing clear local execution ownership in Pune.
  • Maintain a few hours of daily working overlap with US Eastern Time to support standups, design reviews, issue escalation, handoffs, and real-time collaboration.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, Product Management, Compliance, and other engineering teams to implement changes and product improvements effectively.
  • Support smooth transitions between new product development, production launch, and ongoing sustaining ownership.
  • Communicate clearly across geographies, functions, and levels of the organization, escalating risks and resource needs early with proposed solutions.

Qualifications Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical experience.
  • 12+ years of mechanical engineering experience with strong exposure to product development, sustaining engineering, lifecycle support, manufacturing support, or related design leadership responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated people-management experience, including hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance management, workload planning, and career development for engineering teams.
  • Strong mechanical design background with the ability to review, guide, and challenge detailed engineering work while also leading through others.
  • Experience leading engineering work across cross-functional teams and globally distributed organizations.
  • Proficiency in 3D CAD modeling and drawing release processes; Autodesk Inventor and PTC Creo experience strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with PLM/PDM systems such as Autodesk Vault, Windchill, or Agile.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle PD Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar business systems.
  • Strong understanding of engineering change management, BOM/documentation control, root-cause analysis, corrective action processes, and disciplined product data management.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively across geographies and time zones.
  • Ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions with limited supervision while keeping leadership informed of risks, tradeoffs, and resource constraints.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Management, or related field.
  • Experience building, scaling, or transforming engineering teams in a global or multi-site environment.
  • Experience designing and supporting sheet metal enclosures and assemblies for data center, ICT, or technology infrastructure applications.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing processes including laser cutting, punch press, press brake, welding, assembly, and powder coating.
  • Experience supporting high-volume, configurable, or engineered-to-order products in production.
  • Familiarity with mechanical compliance standards relevant to data center and infrastructure products, including UL, IEC, CB schemes, seismic qualification, and environmental standards such as RoHS and REACH.
  • Experience coordinating engineering change analysts, configuration management resources, or documentation-control activities.
  • Experience with automation or scripting tools such as iLogic, VB.NET, Python, C#, or C++.

What Will Make You Successful?

  • Proven ability to lead people while remaining grounded in practical mechanical engineering and design fundamentals.
  • Strong ownership and accountability for team performance, engineering output, product quality, and execution commitments.
  • Comfort building structure in a growing team environment where processes, responsibilities, and capabilities are still being established.

  • Bias toward action, with disciplined follow-through and the judgment to balance urgency with engineering rigor.
  • Collaborative mindset across time zones, cultures, functions, and levels of the organization.
  • Continuous improvement mindset focused on reliability, cost, manufacturability, documentation accuracy, and engineering excellence.
  • Ability to mentor engineers, develop future leaders, and build a team that earns trust through consistent execution.

The Purchasing manager is part of the Materials Management team, reporting solid line to the Materials and Manufacturing Planning Manager.

He/She oversees our day-to-day purchasing operations. Purchasing Manager will be responsible for managing a team of buyers, coordinating purchasing activities, resolving exceptions, and ensuring timely procurement of goods and services while focusing on Inventory optimization.

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)

  • Lead and manage the tactical purchasing team to ensure efficient and effective execution of purchasing activities.
  • Develop and implement tactical purchasing strategies to optimize procurement processes and achieve cost savings.
  • Coordinate the creation and management of purchase orders within the Oracle ERP/Cyberplan system, including monitoring PO status and resolving exceptions.
  • Analyze inventory turnover rates, carrying costs, and stock-out rates to identify opportunities for inventory optimization.
  • Implement inventory management strategies such as ABC analysis, cycle counting, and safety stock management to optimize inventory levels.
  • Evaluate alternative sourcing options and supplier lead times to optimize inventory replenishment processes.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, such as production, inventory management, and finance, to ensure alignment of purchasing activities with business objectives.
  • Analyze purchasing data and performance metrics to identify trends, opportunities for improvement, and areas of risk.
  • Monitor market trends, supplier performance, and regulatory requirements to inform procurement decisions and mitigate risks.
  • Develop and maintain purchasing policies, procedures, and best practices to ensure compliance with organizational standards and industry regulations.
  • Provide leadership, guidance, and coaching to the purchasing team to foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
  • Support talent management process (selection, development, and career path).
  • Prepare and present reports, dashboards, and analysis to senior management to communicate purchasing performance and recommendations for improvement.
  • Ensure communication of vision and strategy for his area of responsibility above and below within the organization.

Qualifications

Required/ Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • 15+ years’ experience in Purchasing

Additional / Preferred Qualifications:

  • Good knowledge of Oracle architecture and planning tools (Cyberplan)
  • Good knowledge of standard software tools (MS Excel, PowerPoint, Access).
  • English –fluent level – written and spoken
  • A high level of motivation combined with leadership abilities is required
  • Availability to travel and working time flexibility, in an international environment.
  • Competences: result-oriented, team player, careful to details, flexible.

job.description:

job.title: Head of APJC Tech Strategy and Operations, Global Sales Operations
job.description:
We are looking for a Leader of APJ Field Tech Operations to help drive the long-term growth of the APJ Tech business through a period of significant change. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, motivated self-starter who is passionate about using data, fluent enough in technology to operationally lead a technical field credibly, and has a track record of driving transformation, not just running operations. In this role, the leader will work out what the APJ Tech organization must prioritize from an operations perspective to help the business scale, and then drive that change through the field. This is not a role to run the operating cadence well and keep the reporting clean; it is to lead the organization through its transition as the AI business scales and the most fundamental roles, from how we sell to how we deliver, are reshaped. The mandate is to carry the org through that change rather than defend the current model, and it holds even if the team gets leaner, because the game is productivity and leverage, not size. Considered a close operational partner to APJ Tech leadership and a member of the APJ Tech leadership team, this leader will develop, implement, and manage the business processes, systems, insights, and strategies that optimize how the organization works to meet its goals along with geographically dispersed team reporting to them. They will own and drive the management of business cadences across cross-functional teams, and will have the capacity to absorb and lead change through their direct team as well as by earning trust and influencing others across the APJ and WW Tech business and worldwide stakeholders who do not report to the role. The role drives improvements to the reporting tools, mechanisms, and business insights the team relies on, increasing the availability and granularity of actionable, decision-ready data and building a single source of truth leaders can trust. Crucially, it reaches for automation and AI as the primary lever to redesign how operations work gets done, so the organization produces materially more without adding people. It also manages the proposal, administration, and execution of the region’s targets, goals, and headcount plans, and continuously proposes improvements that increase the organization’s effectiveness in driving desired results. The successful candidate must be able to roll up their sleeves and work directly with models and data, and thrive in ambiguity of various challenges encountered daily in a fast-moving Tech company. You will be passionate about your work, analytical, and a strong problem-solver, with the technical depth to earn the trust of a technical field and the judgment to know where technology creates the most leverage. You will have superb communication and relationship skills, hold a firm and well-reasoned line with senior leaders on what the data says even when it is unwelcome, and stay open to disconfirming input rather than anchoring on prior ways of working. You will drive toward simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have a track record of building high-performing teams and thinking big, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive org-wide transformation from an operations lens: Look across the APJ Tech org, decide what to prioritize to help it scale, and drive that change through the field - not just describe it. This is the heart of the role.
  • Bring technical depth to lead a technical field: Operate with enough technical fluency to lead a Tech organization credibly, earn the trust of a technical field, and make sound calls on where technology creates the most leverage.
  • Earn trust and influence across a matrixed org: Land change with Area GMs, Tech leaders across the Geo, and worldwide stakeholders who do not report to this role, and hold a firm line on what the data says even when it is unwelcome.
  • Use the FTO platform to drive change at scale: Know the Field Tech Operations function intimately and use it as a platform to lead transformation, with a demonstrated pattern of thinking big rather than optimizing the status quo.
  • Drive productivity through automation and AI: Redesign how operations work gets done so the org produces materially more without adding people, using AI and automation as the primary lever, and deliver results at a different scale.
  • Build systems and a single source of truth: Design mechanisms, standards, and trusted business insights that scale on their own; build the machine rather than personally running each cycle.
  • Run the operating cadence as the foundation: Keep firm command of the current state - business reviews, goals, and decision-ready reporting - as the stable base from which transformation is driven, since business as usual keeps running until the transitions land.
  • Build and develop the team: Attract, grow, and retain a high-performing operations and insights team, and raise the bar on talent as the function evolves.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of senior leadership work in sales operations, sales strategy, finance, business development, or other related fields experience
  • 7+ years of leading a divisional sales operations team or equivalent responsibilities supporting a mid-to-large-scale, multi-geographical, hi-tech, sales organization experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Experience in leading a divisional sales operations team or equivalent responsibilities supporting a mid-to-large-scale, multi-geographical, high-tech, sales organization
  • Experience hiring and leading a high-performance team

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing and implementing systems/tools utilized for CRM, variable compensation, revenue reporting, forecasting, Salesforce automation, etc.
  • Experience in business-process design
  • Experience rapidly growing an organization and attracting, hiring, and maintaining top talent
  • Experience working within a high-growth, technology company
  • Master's degree or equivalent

job.title: R&D Team Lead (Testing, Validation, Certification)
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Manager LBL India ###

What we believe in

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, leads a team of Research and Development (R&D) employees and support them in achieving the agreed R&D targets. Coaches and develops the team. Help manage technologies, platforms, and Intellectual Property (IP).

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification Smart Buildings Business to be based at Nelamangala, BANGALORE, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conduct testing, validation, and qualification of low-voltage switchgear products as per IS, IEC, and international standards, including prototype, design verification, and validation testing.
  • Develop test strategies, plans, qualification programs, and schedules, ensuring compliance with regulatory and certification requirements.
  • Coordinate BIS, CPRI, ERDA, DEKRA, UL, and other certification activities, while collaborating with Product Management, Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain teams.
  • Oversee root cause analysis, corrective actions, continuous improvement, and testing efficiency, supported by KPIs, dashboards, and certification tracking systems.
  • Lead and mentor the testing and certification engineering team, while supporting cost optimization, value engineering, product quality, and reliability improvements.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical, Electromechanical, or related Engineering discipline.
  • 12–15 years of relevant experience in testing, validation, qualification, and certification of electrical products.
  • Solid practical experience with LV switchgear products, including MCBs, RCCBs, RCBOs, MCCBs, and Distribution Boards.
  • Practical experience working with accredited testing laboratories and certification agencies such as BIS, CPRI, ERDA, DEKRA, and UL.
  • Extensive knowledge of IS/IEC standards, regulatory requirements, product compliance, testing methodologies, and certification processes.
  • Demonstrated experience in technical team leadership, project management, stakeholder management, and execution of multiple projects within challenging timelines.
  • Advanced abilities in analysis, problem solving, communication, and decision making, supported by a focus on quality, compliance, innovation, and process improvement.

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Solutions Analyst
job.description:
About Goodman

At Goodman, your career is more than just a job – it’s about growth, innovation, and making a lasting impact. Whether you’re building your career in property, data centres, finance, legal, or beyond, we value diverse perspectives and seek individuals who are passionate about driving our business forward.

As providers of essential infrastructure for the digital economy, Goodman has been developing its data centre capability since 2005. Since then, we have grown to become a large owner of powered sites globally. Our global power bank of 5.0GW includes completed facilities, secured power and potential data centre projects across 13 major international cities. This has been built up over time through our expertise in securing land, planning and power in highly sought after locations in major global cities.

Solutions Analyst

Join Goodman’s Australian Technology Centre of Excellence and play a key role in supporting and improving the systems that underpin our property, finance and operational platforms.

We are looking for a Solutions Analyst to support the delivery, enhancement and ongoing operation of our business applications environment, with a strong focus on Yardi. You will help translate business needs into practical system improvements, supporting reliable, integrated and easy-to-use technology across Goodman’s Australian business.

About the role

This is a hands-on solution delivery role where you will work closely with business stakeholders, Group IT and external vendors to design, test and implement system changes, support project and production environments, and help ensure our platforms are stable, integrated and aligned to best practice.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys being close to the business, solving practical system problems and building deep expertise in a core property technology platform.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, test and implement Yardi changes, enhancements and configuration updates.
  • Provide administration and support across test, project and production environments.
  • Troubleshoot application issues and coordinate resolution with vendors and internal IT teams.
  • Develop and test interfaces between applications and support IT and user acceptance testing.
  • Prepare deployment scripts, change submissions, rollback plans, backups and technical documentation.
  • Act as a Yardi subject matter expert, supporting best-practice use of the platform.
  • Provide guidance, training and mentoring to users to build capability and improve adoption.
  • Contribute to governance, risk management and continuous improvement across Goodman’s technology platforms.

About you

Strong hands-on Yardi experience is important for this role, ideally across configuration, administration, testing or application support. You will be comfortable working across technical and business teams, translating requirements into practical system outcomes and supporting users through change.

You will bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, good communication skills, close attention to detail and a practical, delivery-focused approach. Experience preparing technical documentation, user guides and deployment materials will be highly regarded. Knowledge of property management, general ledger systems, SQL, Power BI or TM1 would also be beneficial.

This role would suit someone who enjoys combining systems knowledge with business understanding. You will be practical, curious and comfortable working across both detail and bigger-picture outcomes — from troubleshooting an issue through to supporting project delivery, user adoption and continuous improvement.

The Benefits

At Goodman we know that our people are integral to our company success. That’s why we have implemented some fantastic benefits for all to experience, these include:

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.

job.title: Configuration Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Concepts, architects and integrates new products, components, or technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Researching and developing design parameters, performance characteristics, and technical specifications of new products and components.
  • Guiding the evolution of the technical design, technical project planning, performance analysis, and development testing. Participating in supplier selection and capabilities assessment.
  • Monitoring, exploring, and testing new technologies, materials, and components to understand product or process improvement opportunities.
  • Constructing and fabricating prototype equipment; overseeing materials selection, process optimization and process yield, as well as reliability testing and failure analysis.
  • Requires a degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, or Materials Science curriculum.

Degree Requirement

Degree required

Skill Descriptors

Business Process Improvement: Knowledge of business process improvement best practices and ability to use methods for identifying, evaluating, introducing and implementing more efficient approaches to performing business related activities.

Planning: Tactical, Strategic: Knowledge of effective planning techniques and ability to contribute to operational (short term), tactical (1-2 years) and strategic (3-5 years) planning in support of the overall business plan.

Quality Management: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques and ability to create and support an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Systems Thinking: Knowledge of the critical interdependencies among individual system elements that help and hinder performance; ability to plan and design solutions that synchronize resources to achieve business results.

This position requires working onsite five days a week. Posting Dates:

August 26, 2026 - October 2, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: EHS Coordinator
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

To serve as an individual contributor on Environmental, Health and/or Safety (EHS) projects and assignments that support and enhance Caterpillar facility performance and compliance.

Responsibilities

  • Performs inspections and tests planned to monitor specific EHS issues, regulations and company practices.
  • Assists in training employees on EHS guidelines, company policies and procedures, and regulations pertaining to EHS.
  • Making and maintaining necessary EHS records according to established guidelines.
  • Contributes to the development of EHS policies and procedures.

Degree required

Skill Descriptors

Process Management: Knowledge of business process improvement tools and techniques; ability to understand, monitor, update, control, or enhance existing business or work processes.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Influencing: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.

Initiative: Being proactive and committing to action on self-identified job responsibilities and challenges; ability to seek out work and the drive to accomplish goals.

Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Policy Compliance: Knowledge of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) policies; ability to implement EHS policies to ensure that provided products and services are safe for people and the environment and in compliance with legal requirements and standards.

This position requires working onsite five days a week. Posting Dates:

August 26, 2026 - September 25, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Chiller Team Leader - Perth
job.description:
Lead. Mentor. Stay Hands-On. Build the Future of HVAC Service in Perth.

$10,000 Sign-On Bonus Available for the Successful Candidate*

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the environments where people live, work, learn, and thrive. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help customers optimize energy use, reduce carbon emissions, and improve operational performance across critical industries including data centres, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered innovative solutions that make a real difference. Backed by world-class technology, industry-leading products, and one of the strongest service networks in the world, we're committed to helping our customers succeed while creating outstanding career opportunities for our people.

Why Join Us?

With continued growth across Western Australia, we're seeking an experienced Service Team Leader – Chillers to lead our talented team of Technicians in Perth.

To help you make your next career move, we're offering a $10,000 sign-on bonus for the successful candidate.*

This role is also ideal for a senior Chiller Technician or Service Supervisor looking to take the next step into leadership while remaining hands-on and technically involved. You'll have the opportunity to influence how the team operates, develop future talent, and play a key role in expanding our Perth service business.

Thinking About Relocating to Perth?

If you're currently based interstate, this could be the career move you've been waiting for.

Perth offers an enviable lifestyle with world-class beaches, a lower cost of living than many eastern states, shorter commutes, abundant outdoor recreation, and a thriving economy. Combined with the opportunity to join a global organisation investing heavily in growth, this role offers both professional and personal rewards.

What's In It For You?

  • $10,000 sign-on bonus available for the successful candidate*
  • Join a business that's growing and investing in Perth
  • Lead a highly skilled and supportive team of Chiller Technicians
  • Stay hands-on with complex technical work while developing your leadership career
  • Competitive salary package plus paid overtime
  • Company vehicle or vehicle allowance, fuel card, E-Tag and tools of trade
  • Flexible work arrangements that support genuine work-life balance
  • Autonomy to make decisions and lead your team your way
  • Access to industry-leading technical support, training, and development programs
  • Clear career progression pathways across leadership, projects, operations, and technical specialist streams
  • Work with market-leading YORK chiller technology
  • Strong safety culture and a supportive team environment
  • Relocation support may be considered for the right candidate

The Opportunity

As Service Team Leader, you'll be responsible for driving service excellence, supporting your team, and ensuring customers receive exceptional outcomes. You'll combine technical expertise, people leadership, and operational oversight to deliver safe, efficient, and profitable service operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Chiller Technicians, apprentices, and subcontractors
  • Drive operational excellence across maintenance, repair, retrofit, and service activities
  • Provide senior-level technical expertise on YORK Chillers and related HVAC systems
  • Perform and oversee commissioning, troubleshooting, diagnostics, and preventive maintenance
  • Build strong customer relationships and identify opportunities to enhance service delivery
  • Support service project planning, scheduling, estimating, and resource allocation
  • Manage customer accounts and contribute to business growth initiatives
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with company and industry standards
  • Partner with the Service Team Manager to support branch performance and operational goals

About You

You're a technically strong HVAC professional who enjoys leading from the front. You take pride in developing people, building customer relationships, and delivering high-quality outcomes.

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • Trade qualification in HVAC/Refrigeration or equivalent industry experience
  • Minimum 5 years' relevant industry experience (or 7 years without formal qualification)
  • Strong experience working on centrifugal, screw, or large commercial chillers
  • Demonstrated leadership or supervisory capability
  • Commercial awareness and sound business acumen
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
  • A commitment to safety, quality, and customer service excellence

Ready for the Next Step?

If you're a skilled Chiller Technician ready to step into leadership, or an experienced Service Team Leader looking for a new challenge with a global industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Join a company that invests in your development, values your expertise, and provides the support, technology, and opportunities to build a rewarding long-term career.

Apply Today

Click APPLY NOW to join Johnson Controls and help shape the future of sustainable building solutions.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Janis Sotelo at janis.sotelo@jci.com

Build your future with Johnson Controls and be part of something bigger.

*Sign-on bonus subject to terms and conditions and payable in accordance with company policy.

#LI-JS4

job.title: Technical Account Manager – Data Centres
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) – Data Centre Thermal Solutions. This role serves as the primary technical interface between Johnson Controls and key Data Centre customers across the Pacific region, with a specific focus on chilled water plants, precision cooling, and advanced thermal management solutions.

The TAM provides deep technical leadership across chiller systems, liquid cooling, and thermal plant architectures, while also taking ownership of technical pricing strategy and bid development for complex opportunities. Operating within a matrixed organisation, the TAM aligns technical, commercial, and delivery stakeholders to ensure chiller and cooling plant solutions are positioned, designed, priced, and delivered to win in a competitive market.

Key Responsibilities

Trusted Technical Advisor – Thermal Systems

  • Act as the trusted advisor for data centre cooling and thermal plant solutions, with a focus on chillers, CRAH/CRAC, and liquid cooling

​

​

Pipeline & Technical Governance

  • Ensure technical and commercial accuracy in CRM, pricing tools, and proposals
  • Maintain compliance with Johnson Controls governance standards

​

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (preferred) or related discipline
  • 10+ years’ experience in HVAC/chiller systems and thermal plant solutions, ideally within data centres
  • Demonstrated experience in technical sales, bid management, and pricing of complex engineered solutions
  • Strong expertise in:

Chilled water systems and central plant design

  • Chiller selection and optimisation
  • Cooling strategies for high-density environments

Proven ability to develop competitive, technically sound, and commercially viable bids

Experience in cost modelling, value engineering, and margin management

job.title: BMS Project Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What you will do

Acts as on-site project leader to plan, execute, and complete assigned projects. Delegates tasks to execute and fully complete assigned projects. Coordinates communication with customer during all phases of the project. Coordinates the work of subcontractors.

How you will do it:

  • Define scope, budget and schedule for projects.
  • Device project implementation methodology.
  • Plan and oversee work schedule for the multiple small to medium scale project under responsibility, in coordination with supervisor.
  • Identify potential project risks and recommend appropriate resolutions.
  • Establish effective communication with customer.
  • Track and update progress, task and project health to supervisors.
  • Ensure and monitor compliance to applicable codes, practices, QA/QC policies, performance standards and specifications.
  • Perform regular quality audit for all the suppliers and sub-contractors.
  • Identify and secure variation order.
  • Cost control - Track, monitor and ensure delivery of financial commitment as per KPI.
  • Managing reports and documents.
  • Work closely with Sales team for tender bidding.

  • Schedule purchase and deliveries of all materials for the project in a timely manner.

  • Assign task to, and supervise Assistant Project Engineer, Technician, if any.
  • System applications, drafting, data base generation and commissioning.
  • Follow-up on payment from customers and verify payment to our suppliers.
  • Train customer and provide first year maintenance warranty schedule visit.
  • Hand over project to customer and later to service team.
  • And other related works as assigned by your superior.

What we look for:

  • Degree with minimum 1 years relevant working experience in BMS project.
  • Excel, Word and Project essential.
  • Require interaction with clients, consultants and sub-contractors, etc.
  • Need to work odd hours as and when required, whenever the work need to be done on time.
  • Willingness to learn new things.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy
