job.title: Project Coordinator & Document Controller
job.description:
Shape the Future of Smart Buildings with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls (JCI), we're transforming the way buildings operate. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable building solutions, we empower organisations to reduce energy consumption, enhance occupant experiences, strengthen security, improve operational resilience, and accelerate their sustainability ambitions.

With over 140 years of innovation, Johnson Controls has partnered with customers across commercial buildings, healthcare, data centres, education, advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and critical infrastructure. Today, our leading technology, digital solutions, and service expertise are helping create the next generation of intelligent buildings.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

  • Permanent, full-time position based in Brisbane
  • Competitive salary package and employee benefits
  • Ongoing training, professional development, and career progression opportunities
  • Join a globally recognised industry leader with a strong project pipeline
  • Be part of a collaborative, high-performing team delivering impactful projects

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Document Controller / Project Coordinator to support the successful delivery of building technology and engineering projects. Working closely with Project Managers, engineers, customers, and vendors, you will play a critical role in maintaining accurate project documentation, ensuring compliance, and supporting project execution from start to completion.

This role is ideal for someone with previous experience in construction, engineering, building services, industrial, OEM, EPC, or project-based environments who thrives in a fast-paced setting and enjoys being at the centre of project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Document Control

  • Manage project documentation in accordance with JCI and client requirements.
  • Maintain document control processes, including document registration, distribution, revision control, tracking, and archiving.
  • Ensure accurate version control, document registers, transmittals, and compliance with project procedures.
  • Coordinate document submissions and information flow between project teams, clients, subcontractors, and suppliers.
  • Prepare project handover documentation, including O&M manuals and project dossiers.
  • Maintain and administer document management platforms such as SharePoint, Aconex, TeamBinder, or similar systems.

Project Coordination

  • Support Project Managers with tracking project deliverables, milestones, and documentation schedules.
  • Coordinate document reviews, approvals, and stakeholder feedback processes.
  • Manage vendor documentation requirements and proactively follow up outstanding submissions.
  • Assist with project reporting, KPI tracking, and maintaining accurate project records.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance project efficiency and compliance.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • Proven experience in Document Control, Project Administration, or Project Coordination within engineering, construction, building services, industrial, OEM, or EPC environments.
  • Strong knowledge of document control principles, revision management, and transmittal processes.
  • Experience using document management systems such as Aconex, SharePoint, TeamBinder, Procore, or equivalent platforms.
  • The ability to manage large volumes of technical documentation with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
  • Excellent organisational, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the ability to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

Build Your Future with Johnson Controls

If you're looking to join a global organisation where your expertise will directly contribute to the successful delivery of innovative building and infrastructure projects, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of a team that is shaping the future of smart, sustainable buildings across Australia.

job.title: Sr Developer - Enterprise integration
job.description:
Title: Lead Integration Developer

Exp: 9–12 Years

Role Summary

A strategic and hands-on Integration Leader responsible for driving end-to-end delivery of enterprise integration solutions. Ensures alignment with enterprise architecture, leads technical design (HLD/LLD), and builds high-performing teams while leveraging modern cloud, AI, and Copilot-enabled development capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Integration Architecture & Delivery

  • Own and lead end-to-end integration solution design and delivery across complex enterprise programs.
  • Define and implement integration architectures, API strategies, and reusable frameworks aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Create, review, and govern High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs) ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Drive architecture governance, technical design reviews, and best practices adoption.

Azure Integration Services Implementation

  • Lead development using Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, and broader Azure Integration Services.
  • Design highly resilient, secure, and scalable workflows and orchestrations.

job.title: Integrated Solutions Service Tech 1
job.description:
Job Description

Service Engineer – HVAC Chillers

Experience 3–8 years

###

Education

Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Engineering

Job Summary

The Service Engineer – HVAC Chillers is responsible for installation support, preventive maintenance, breakdown service, troubleshooting, and overhauling of HVAC chiller systems. The role ensures optimal performance, reliability, energy efficiency, and customer satisfaction across assigned customer sites.

###

Key Responsibilities

Installation & Commissioning

  • ### Support installation, commissioning, and start-up of air-cooled and water-cooled chillers
  • ### Verify system compliance with design specifications and safety standards
  • ### Coordinate with project teams, contractors, and customers during commissioning

Service & Maintenance

  • ### Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of HVAC chiller systems
  • ### Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control system faults
  • ### Carry out overhauls, compressor servicing, oil analysis, and refrigerant handling
  • ### Ensure timely closure of service calls and breakdowns

Technical Support

  • ### Interpret wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and control logic
  • ### Calibrate sensors, valves, and control devices
  • ### Ensure proper operation of pumps, cooling towers, and associated equipment
  • ### Maintain compliance with OEM guidelines and statutory safety norms

Customer Management

  • ### Interact with customers professionally and provide technical explanations
  • ### Prepare service reports, root cause analysis (RCA), and recommendations
  • ### Upsell AMC, spares, and service upgrades where applicable

Documentation & Compliance

  • ### Maintain detailed service records and job reports
  • ### Follow EHS guidelines, work permits, and safety procedures
  • ### Support audits and quality improvement initiatives

Key Skills & Competencies

  • ### Strong knowledge of HVAC chiller systems (screw, centrifugal, scroll, reciprocating)
  • ### Hands-on experience with refrigerants (R134a, R410A, R407C, etc.)
  • ### Electrical troubleshooting (motors, VFDs, starters, panels)
  • ### Familiarity with BMS, PLCs, and control systems
  • ### Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • ### Good communication and customer-handling skills
  • ### Willingness to travel and work on-site

Desired Certifications (Preferred)

  • ### HVAC / RAC Certification
  • ### OEM Chiller Training (Carrier, Trane, Daikin, York, etc.)
  • ### Electrical Safety / EHS Certification

Work Conditions

  • ### Field-based role requiring travel to customer sites
  • ### May require working in shifts, weekends, or during emergencies
  • ### Physically capable of working in plant rooms and industrial environments

Why Join Us?

  • ### Opportunity to work on advanced HVAC chiller technologies
  • ### Exposure to premium customers and complex installations
  • ### Career growth, technical training, and certification opportunities

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Visit [johnsoncontrols.com](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/) for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.

Why JCI: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg)

Asia-Pacific LinkedIn: [https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feedView=all](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feedView=all)

Career: [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue: [This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What will you do?

  • Design and implement C/C++ software for (bare-metal and RTOS) embedded devices to be used in safety related Public Address / General Alarm systems.
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded C / C++ firmware for STM32-based control and communication modules.
  • Implement low-level software for microcontroller peripherals, memory handling, interrupt management, watchdogs, boot behaviour, and hardware abstraction.
  • Support board bring-up, integration, debugging, and validation of new embedded platforms.
  • Development of engineering interpretations of product standards.
  • Create test plans and perform verification and validation activities.
  • Author documentation for software architecture, interface control, test plans.
  • Develop algorithms for digital audio streaming, routing and processing.
  • Implement communication protocols using Ethernet, LonTalk, RS232, RS485 and RS422.
  • Contribute to software quality MISRA C/C++, static analysis, configuration management, code reviews, development of unit and integration tests.
  • Collaborate with the estimation, production, commissioning and projects departments to derive requirements, and time scales for delivery of system solutions.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers.
  • Maintain older product: Defect rectification, bespoke solutions to meet customer requirements, solutions to hardware obsolescence.

What we look for?

  • Support the migration of legacy Echelon / CPM5000 communication and control functions to a new embedded architecture.
  • Analyse existing legacy behaviour and develop equivalent or improved implementations on STM32-based platforms.
  • Help define the migration path for LonTalk-related stack behaviour, node communications, and interoperability requirements.
  • Contribute to long-term removal of obsolete components and reduction of platform dependency risk.
  • Integrate firmware with higher-level software modules, communication stacks, diagnostics, and application functions used in PAGA / PAVA systems.
  • Support interaction between physical layer interfaces, node communications, and application-layer functions used for alarm, paging, routing, monitoring, and supervision.
  • Ensure effective transfer of amplifier and field-device fault information back to system nodes and controllers.
  • Audio & Life-Safety Functional Support
  • Support embedded functions related to 100V line audio systems, amplifier supervision, fault monitoring, and status reporting.
  • Develop software mechanisms for continuous system health checking, fault detection, and reporting.
  • Support deterministic and reliable behaviour required for critical alarm and public address functions.
  • Verification, Debug & Product Support
  • Investigate and resolve issues arising from development, manufacturing, commissioning, and field service.
  • Use structured testing, logging, and diagnostic methods to validate firmware performance and robustness.
  • Support regression testing and change control for product releases.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with hardware engineers, project engineers, manufacturing, test, and service teams.
  • Support design reviews, system architecture activities, and issue resolution across the product lifecycle.
  • Contribute to documentation required for product introduction, controlled change, validation, and support.

What we offer:

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate.  Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

job.title: EHS Engineer
job.description:
Who we are:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do:

As an EHS Engineer, you will support the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the company's Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) programs and management systems. You will work closely with project teams, subcontractors, clients, and internal stakeholders to ensure compliance with company EHS standards, legal requirements, and customer expectations, while promoting a safe and healthy working environment across all assigned sites.

How you will do it:

  • Implement and maintain the company's EHS Management System, including ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements, ensuring all EHS documentation, records, procedures, permits, and registers are accurately maintained and kept up to date.
  • Monitor compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, customer, and company EHS requirements by conducting workplace inspections, site assessments, and compliance reviews, and supporting regulatory inspections and customer audits.
  • Support project teams, subcontractors, and stakeholders in managing workplace risks through the development, review, and implementation of Risk Assessments (RA), Safe Work Procedures (SWP), Method Statements, and other risk control measures.
  • Investigate accidents, near misses, dangerous occurrences, occupational illnesses, and environmental incidents, prepare investigation reports, identify root causes, and follow up on corrective and preventive actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Coordinate and participate in EHS audits and assessments, including ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ConSASS, Global CAP, internal audits, customer audits, and other EHS evaluations, while ensuring timely closure of audit findings and non-conformities.
  • Plan, coordinate, and support EHS training and awareness programs, including employee orientation, toolbox meetings, safety briefings, contractor training, and safety campaigns to promote a strong safety culture and workforce competency.
  • Monitor EHS performance indicators and incident statistics, analyse trends, prepare reports, and provide recommendations to improve EHS performance, compliance, and operational effectiveness.
  • Support the implementation of emergency preparedness and response programs, including fire prevention activities, emergency response planning, evacuation exercises, and emergency drills to enhance readiness and effectiveness.
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders, including project teams, subcontractors, clients, suppliers, and regulatory authorities, to ensure alignment with EHS requirements and promote continuous improvement in workplace safety and environmental performance.
  • Provide day-to-day EHS support to assigned projects and workplaces, including identifying unsafe conditions and behaviours, recommending corrective measures, stopping work where there is imminent danger, supporting EHS committee activities, and performing other EHS-related duties as assigned by management.

What we look for:

  • Degree or Diploma in Environmental, Health & Safety, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Registered Workplace Safety and Health Officer (WSHO) and Environment Control Officer (ECO) certification.
  • Familiarity with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.
  • Experience in construction, engineering, HVAC, facility management, or related industries is an advantage.
  • Strong communication, investigation, problem-solving, audit and stakeholder management skills.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

job.title: Security Project Engineer
job.description:
Shape the Future of Smart, Secure Buildings with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls (JCI), we're transforming the way buildings perform. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help customers optimize energy use, enhance security, reduce carbon emissions, and improve operational resilience across mission-critical industries including data centres, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, education, and commercial infrastructure.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has been at the forefront of innovation, delivering technologies and solutions that make buildings safer, smarter, and more efficient. Backed by industry-leading expertise, advanced digital technologies, and a world-class service network, we're helping shape the future of the built environment.

Why Join Johnson Controls?​

  • Work on Industry-Leading Security Solutions

Design and deliver cutting-edge Security, Access Control, and CCTV systems across some of Australia's most complex and high-profile projects.

  • Build a Long-Term Career

Access world-class training, ongoing professional development, and clear career pathways within a truly global organisation.

  • Make a Real Impact

Help create safer, smarter, and more connected environments for customers and communities across Australia.

  • Be Part of a Global Innovator

Join a business with more than 140 years of engineering excellence and a strong commitment to technology, sustainability, and innovation.

  • About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Project Engineer - Security to join our VIC Projects team based in Scoresby.

This is an exciting opportunity for a technically capable engineer who thrives on delivering integrated security solutions and enjoys working across design, project delivery, commissioning, and customer engagement.

You will play a key role in the successful delivery of Security, Access Control, and CCTV projects, ensuring solutions meet customer requirements, industry regulations, and Johnson Controls' quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, engineer, configure, and commission Security, Access Control, and CCTV systems across a range of projects.
  • Develop technical solutions using both Johnson Controls and third-party security platforms.
  • Conduct software configuration, testing, and commissioning activities to ensure compliance with customer specifications and quality standards.
  • Provide expert technical support and troubleshooting for complex security systems and networked environments.
  • Collaborate closely with customers, project managers, sales teams, and technicians throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Support project execution by monitoring scope, schedules, budgets, and customer satisfaction.
  • Assist with system upgrades, enhancements, and future-proof security solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, technicians, and apprentices.
  • Support engineering and sales teams with technical recommendations, system layouts, and bid proposals.
  • Champion workplace safety and maintain full compliance with Johnson Controls' Safety, Health & Environment Management System (SHEMS).

About You

We're looking for a motivated and customer-focused Security Project Engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for delivering high-quality outcomes.

You Will Bring:

  • 3-5 years' experience in a Project Engineer, Security Engineer, or similar role.
  • Experience designing and delivering Security, Access Control, and CCTV solutions.
  • Strong BIM and CAD design capabilities.
  • Understanding of networked security systems, IT infrastructure, servers, and system integration.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • A proactive, safety-first mindset with a commitment to quality delivery.

Highly Regarded:

  • Victorian Security Licence.
  • Experience working on large-scale commercial, healthcare, industrial, education, or critical infrastructure projects.
  • Exposure to integrated building technologies and smart building solutions.

Ready to Secure the Future?

If you're looking to work on innovative security projects, develop your career with a global industry leader, and be part of a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and join Johnson Controls in creating smarter, safer, and more sustainable buildings.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and better outcomes for our customers and communities. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best. Regardless of your background, identity, or experience, you'll have the opportunity to grow, succeed, and make a meaningful impact.

Your voice matters. Your ideas matter. Your future starts here.

job.title: Senior Project Manager - Applied
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

Role Summary

The Senior Manager – Applied Projects will be responsible for managing a portfolio of HVAC and chiller projects in Gujarat, ensuring successful execution in line with project commitments related to cost, schedule, quality, revenue, and customer satisfaction. The role involves close coordination with project teams, customers, and internal stakeholders to drive project performance and timely closure.

Key Responsibilities

Project Portfolio Management

  • Manage and monitor a portfolio of 50–70 HVAC/chiller projects of varying sizes and execution stages.
  • Track project progress and ensure adherence to established project management processes and milestones.
  • Conduct regular project reviews and follow up on action plans to ensure timely execution.

Planning, Monitoring & Risk Management

  • Monitor project budgets, forecasts, and financial performance throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Identify, track, and report project risks, opportunities, and issues in a timely manner.
  • Maintain project risk registers and issue logs and work with stakeholders to drive resolution.
  • Escalate critical concerns and support implementation of mitigation plans.

Project Execution

  • Ensure project execution is aligned with key performance parameters:Cost
  • Schedule
  • Quality
  • Revenue
  • Customer Expectations

Support project teams in resolving execution challenges and achieving project objectives.Drive timely progression of projects through defined toll gates and closure processes.

Customer & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Maintain regular communication with customers, consultants, contractors, and internal teams.
  • Monitor customer commitments and ensure timely closure of pending actions.
  • Assist in resolving project-related issues to maintain customer satisfaction.

Team Management

  • Guide project managers and execution teams in meeting project deliverables.
  • Provide support in planning, monitoring, and resolving operational challenges.
  • Promote adherence to company processes, compliance requirements, and best practices.

Commercial & Operational Controls

Support project teams in ensuring:

  • Schedule baseline approvals from customers during HOTO.
  • Deliveries and project milestones are achieved as per agreed schedules.
  • Revenue realization is in line with approved forecasts.
  • Timely invoicing and collection of payments.
  • Unbilled Revenue (UBR) remains within acceptable limits.
  • Accurate project status reporting and forecasting.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 10–15 years of experience in HVAC, chiller, or related project execution roles.
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a customer-facing environment.
  • Good understanding of project management principles, including budgeting, planning, scheduling, and risk management.
  • Strong coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to analyze project performance and take corrective actions where required.
  • Proficiency in project planning and reporting tools.
  • Should have managed 5-10 engineers/ managers in his present/ past roles.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • On-time project completion.
  • Revenue achievement against forecast.
  • Gross margin performance.
  • Collection and receivables management.
  • UBR control.
  • Quality and customer satisfaction metrics.
  • Timely closure of project risks and issues.

job.title: Project Manager - Applied
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

Job Description –Project Manager – Applied (Chillers)

Grade: 169/170 Location: Mumbai Reporting To: Senior Project Manager – Applied Projects Experience: 5–8 Years

Role Summary

The incumbent will be responsible for managing the execution of multiple HVAC and chiller projects simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery in line with customer requirements, contractual commitments, and company objectives. The role will focus on project planning, coordination, schedule management, commercial follow-up, and driving projects through defined toll gates from HOTO to closure.

The incumbent will work closely with customers, vendors, site teams, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution & Coordination

  • Manage HVAC/chiller old, ongoing and new projects at different stages of execution.
  • Ensure projects are executed as per approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements.
  • Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, factories, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Track project milestones and drive closure of pending activities.

Schedule Management

  • Prepare and maintain project schedules in coordination with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Obtain customer approval for schedule baselines during HOTO.
  • Monitor progress against planned schedules and initiate corrective actions for delays.
  • Drive timely completion of project milestones and support toll gate movement.

Commercial & Financial Management

  • Monitor project costs, committed costs, and revenue realization.
  • Support achievement of forecasted revenue for assigned projects.
  • Ensure timely preparation and submission of invoices as per contractual milestones.
  • Follow up with customers for payment collections and resolution of commercial issues.
  • Maintain Unbilled Revenue (UBR) within prescribed limits.

Risk & Issue Management

  • Identify project risks and implementation challenges at an early stage.
  • Maintain project risk and issue logs.
  • Escalate critical risks, delays, and customer concerns to the Senior Project Manager in a timely manner.
  • Work with stakeholders to implement mitigation and recovery plans.

Customer Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for assigned projects.
  • Maintain regular communication with customers regarding project status, schedules, deliveries, and outstanding actions.
  • Address customer concerns promptly and coordinate internal support for resolution.
  • Ensure customer expectations are effectively managed throughout the project lifecycle.

Material & Resource Coordination

  • Coordinate with procurement, logistics, factory, and service teams to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Track material availability and installation readiness.
  • Monitor resource deployment requirements at project sites.

Reporting & Governance

  • Update project status, forecasts, and financial metrics regularly.
  • Participate in project review meetings and provide accurate project performance updates.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational project management processes and documentation requirements.
  • Support movement of projects through defined stage gates and successful project closure.

Desired Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of HVAC systems, chillers, and applied projects.
  • Knowledge of project management fundamentals including:Planning and Scheduling
  • Cost Monitoring
  • Risk Management
  • Quality Compliance
  • Customer Management

Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.Good communication and negotiation skills.Proficiency in MS Project, Excel, ERP, and project tracking tools.Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
  • PMP/Project Management certification would be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • On-time achievement of project milestones.
  • Successful movement of projects through toll gates.
  • Revenue realization against forecast.
  • Timely invoicing and collection performance.
  • UBR maintained within target limits.
  • Customer satisfaction.
  • Schedule adherence.
  • Quality and safety compliance.
  • Timely closure of project risks and issues.

job.title: Application Engineer
job.description:
What you will do:

The Application Engineer is responsible for technical support – primarily customer quotations and business development case studies for various composite applications. Key emphasis will be on the ability to understand customer requirements and rapidly demonstrate how composite based solutions can be utilized to provide solutions with costing, timing, and resources included in the proposals. This position will require travel with the business development team to customer facilities during visits to discuss these future opportunities in depth.

How you will do it:

  • Provides customer support by responding to requests for technical queries with detailed analysis of building management system, schedule of creation, tooling costing, and submittal of design and process improvements, when applicable, to meet all customer product needs.
  • Works with engineering, sales, and ops staff to understand standard component fabrication techniques, standard composite materials to use, and current demands of our customers to formulate design details for the sales staff and our customers.
  • ·Provides product technical engineering information by creating and giving presentations on customer proposals. This contains, but is not limited to, 3D representations of finished goods, 3D representations of tooling, etc.
  • ·Prepares cost estimates by studying blueprints, plans, and related customer documents; consulting with engineers, and other professional and technical personnel.
  • Conceptual design of composite components and assemblies to support proposals
  • Generate solid and surface component and assembly CAD models
  • Ability to compose detailed bill of materials for proposals
  • Work as part of a team of design and engineering and ops staff
  • Knowledge of ACMV and controls associate with Johnson Control Metasys will be an advantage

What we look for:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Process & Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical Engineering with minimum 1 year relevant working experience
  • Possess knowledge in PLC programming. Pcvue or ICONICS software
  • Transportation composite or other composite experience preferred
  • Willing to learn new things

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

The Senior Application Engineer will lead the application engineering team in providing technical support, primarily focusing on customer quotations and business development case studies across various composite applications.   • Conduct conceptual designs of composite components and assemblies to support proposals.
  • Generate accurate CAD models of components and assemblies.

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities

job.title: Commissioning Technician (Data centers)
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

About this opportunity

  • Permanent full-time opportunity
  • Attractive base + super + car allowance
  • Career and training opportunities

About Silent-Aire (A Johnson Controls Company)

Silent-Aire, a global leader in hyperscale data center cooling and mission‑critical infrastructure, is proudly part of Johnson Controls. Known for its innovative modular data center solutions and advanced cooling technologies—including custom HVAC and direct expansion (DX) systems—Silent-Aire supports some of the world’s largest cloud providers. As part of Johnson Controls, Silent-Aire combines deep engineering expertise with world‑class manufacturing, commissioning, and service capabilities, delivering reliable, scalable, and energy‑efficient solutions for high‑performance environments.

The Opportunity

Due to continued growth, we are seeking a skilled Commissioning Technician / Regional CCX Technician to join our Sydney team.

In this role, you will execute, coordinate, and support commissioning and construction activities related to Silent-Aire products. You’ll play a key part in ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction, operational performance, and compliance with safety and quality standards.

As an MCS Regional CCX Technician, your responsibilities span:

  • CCX Service Agreement Fulfilment
  • QA/QC
  • Preventative Maintenance, Operations Training & Technical Support
  • Technical Advisory

What You Will Do

  • Lead and coordinate day-to-day CCX services including inspections, installations, repairs, start-up, functional testing, and troubleshooting of Silent-Aire equipment.
  • Work closely with client project teams from installation through commissioning and handover.
  • Collaborate with SAE Engineering and QA/QC teams to understand design requirements and provide feedback on improvements.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, offering prompt technical support and issue resolution.
  • Develop and maintain deep technical expertise across the product and service portfolio.
  • Monitor and report on project progress, risks, milestones, and impacts to quality, cost, or schedule.
  • Support regional growth initiatives and contribute to developing the technical and customer infrastructure.
  • Work collaboratively with APAC technicians and management to improve regional performance and profitability.
  • Complete daily reporting and ensure all documentation is accurate and submitted on time.
  • Collect, analyse, and summarise operational data and trends.
  • Protect company information and comply with all business, safety, and quality procedures.
  • Perform additional duties or hands-on tasks as required.

What We’re Looking For

  • University or college degree in engineering or related technical discipline (preferred).
  • Trade school education/certification (an asset).
  • Minimum five years’ experience as a technician—ideally within the HVAC industry.
  • Strong analytical and computer skills; proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting, or financial reporting (advantageous).
  • Strong communication skills, professionalism, adaptability, and dependability.
  • Ability to build effective internal and external relationships.
  • Commitment to safety initiatives and quality standards.
  • Above‑average troubleshooting skills; self‑motivated and responsible.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaboratively support cross-functional teams.
  • Must meet site access requirements and pass all pre-employment checks (drug/alcohol testing, medical, background, references, driving record).
  • Willingness to travel as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

  • Global organisation offering strong career development pathways
  • Long-term progression into technical or leadership roles
  • Supportive team culture and access to market-leading technology
  • Strong commitment to safety and ongoing professional development

If you interested in this role, please click the apply button.

job.title: Service Technician
job.description:
TITLE- Service Technician

Location – Veraval

What you will do

  • Diagnose and rectify defects in Fire Detection and Alarm Systems (FDAS) and control panels onboard ships.
  • Execute retrofit and commissioning activities for AFDS and fire extinguishing systems (CO₂, FM200, Water Mist, Foam).
  • Perform annual maintenance contracts (AMC) for AFDS and fire extinguishing systems.
  • Troubleshoot software issues within control panels, including program upload/download.

How you will do it

  • Interpret manuals, P&ID diagrams, and electrical drawings for troubleshooting.
  • Apply control philosophy knowledge to implement retrofit solutions.

job.title: Technical Support Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Who we are

Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. It’s changing the way we design, operates and maintains indoor environments and driving to a new era of autonomous buildings.

We deliver the blueprint of the future for industries such as healthcare, schools, data centers, airports, stadiums, hotels, manufacturing and beyond through OpenBlue, our comprehensive suite of connected solutions.

Johnson Controls offers the world’s largest portfolio of building technology, software and services. Supported by a team of more than 100,000 dedicated employees working across 150 countries, we’re helping customers achieve their sustainability goals and power their mission.

Please visit and follow Johnson Controls linkedin for recent exciting activities.

APAC Linkedin [Johnson Controls APAC Linkedin ](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/)

Career [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://youtu.be/EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue [OpenBlue: This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://youtu.be/bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What you will do

Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced HVAC professional to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing top-quality service, maintenance, and repair of HVAC and industrial refrigeration systems at various client facilities. You will serve as the primary contact for all technical service issues, ensuring client satisfaction through effective troubleshooting and resolution of complex systems.

Required Capabilities

HVAC & Chiller Expertise

  • Practical work experience with HVAC system with various York chiller models, primarily YK, YVAA, YMC2, and YZ chillers.
  • Hands on Experience in commissioning of numerous chillers like Mag bearing, Centri, Screw, Scroll with different type of refrigerant R-22, R-134a, R407,R123, R1233ZD, R513A
  • Hands on Experience in conducting the chiller PM activity for various model chillers.
  • Good knowledge on AHUs, FCU, Cooling towers, water Pumps, EC fans used in the HVAC system.
  • Capable to handle the critical issues by taking quick appropriate decision with action plans to resolve the issues.

Electrical & Electronics Expertise

  • Ability to test and diagnose power electronic components such as Diode, SCRs, IGBTs, capacitors, and inductors.
  • Able to understand the Circuit Breaker settings and provide the cable sizing
  • Understand the root cause of the power electronic components failure and be able to prepare the root cause analysis for the failure.
  • Able to test and identify defective components at the PCB level in advanced multilayer electronic boards
  • Able to troubleshoot the various types of motor used in the chiller application and AHUs
  • Able to understand the various types of control logic used in chiller microcontrollers.
  • Capable of programming and debugging software for microprocessor-based controllers and PLC-based controllers

VSD starter & Troubleshooting

  • In-depth understanding of Variable Speed Drive (VSD) starter application, benefits in chiller, terminology and working principles.
  • Skilled in troubleshooting York starter models used in chillers, including D-Drive, Vyper, Hyper, and Python drives.
  • Knowing the importance of the Harmonic Filter in the VSD application and its function and troubleshooting.

Refrigeration System and Performance testing Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of refrigeration systems and capability to troubleshoot issues using operating data, History data or SD card data from chillers.
  • Able to interpret and analyze Pressure-Enthalpy (P–H) diagrams to evaluate refrigeration cycle performance, identify system inefficiencies, and assist in troubleshooting issues related to compressors, evaporators, and condensers
  • Chiller performance testing and field troubleshooting of performance related issues.
  • Understanding of psychrometry and its application in the HVAC industry

Join Johnson Controls and be part of a team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and provides a rewarding work environment.

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

job.title: HVAC Service Technician
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and customer-focused HVAC Service Technician to install, inspect, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration (HVAC/R) systems. The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to delivering excellent service while ensuring system efficiency and safety compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, and repairs on HVAC systems and equipment.
  • Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and control system issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Install, test, and commission HVAC equipment including air conditioners, chillers, heat pumps, furnaces, ventilation systems, and refrigeration units.
  • Monitor system performance and recommend upgrades or replacements when needed.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and company policies.
  • Maintain accurate service records, work orders, and maintenance reports.
  • Respond to emergency service requests and equipment breakdowns.
  • Communicate effectively with customers regarding service findings, recommendations, and repair costs.
  • Manage tools, equipment, and spare parts inventory responsibly.
  • Support energy efficiency initiatives and optimize HVAC system performance.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma, ITI, or Technical Certification in HVAC, Refrigeration, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in HVAC installation, maintenance, and repair.
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration cycles, electrical controls, and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Familiarity with building automation systems (BAS) and HVAC controls.
  • Ability to use diagnostic tools, gauges, meters, and testing equipment.
  • Valid driver's license (if field service role).
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and emergency call-outs when required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • HVAC/R certification or relevant trade license.
  • Experience with commercial and industrial HVAC equipment.
  • Knowledge of energy management systems and preventive maintenance practices.
  • Understanding of local safety and environmental regulations.

What you will do

The primary responsibility of this role is to lead global Data Center Building Management System (BMS) engineering projects, ensuring compliance with project specifications, customer requirements, and account-specific standards. The role requires independent ownership and execution of projects throughout the entire lifecycle, while serving as the first point of escalation for technical and project-related issues. Ensure adherence to data center-specific engineering and project execution processes, maintain high quality standards through a "First Time Right" approach, and deliver projects on schedule to achieve operational excellence and maximize customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs like MEP drawings and engineering submittal to generate following deliverables for systems covered into Datacenter Project
  • Configuration of software program for supervisory and DDC level controllers
  • Perform simulation of software and validation reports to prepare for software commissioning package delivery
  • Prepare FAT, FWT and SAT test script for validation of software
  • Provide demo sessions to end customer for functionality check of software
  • Optimize database with Trend, Alarm, Point COV management
  • Coordinate with all stakeholders for clarification on RFI’s & progress tracking
  • Perform FWT test at factory location
  • Provide remote / onsite support for site commissioning activities
  • Provide remote commissioning support to site team for troubleshooting issues, control loop tunning and guide site team with test script
  • Perform 3rd party controller integration with different communication protocols like BACnet IP, Modbus and troubleshoot issues with help of software like wireshark, ModScan etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance and defect free software package delivery
  • Adherence with all processes and guidelines to execute project within timeline
  • During pre-bid stage support sales team for providing/validating controls solution for systems into Datacenter project.

What we look for

  • BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical/ Electronics / Electronics & Communication
  • Hands on experience with Software Engineering scope for Datacenter Vertical
  • Good Understanding of Data Centre mechanical / electrical systems with expertise for instrumentation and control
  • Able to handle complex programming for systems like chilled water system, CDU, CRAH, CRAC, AHU with redundancy requirement at equipment or DDC level
  • Knowledge of HVAC systems from Datacenter vertical like Chilled Water System, Cooling Towers, Primary & Secondary pumping systems, Fluid Coolers, Heat Exchanger, CRAH, CRAC, CDU, Different types of AHUs, FCUs, VAV systems etc.
  • Strong knowledge of BMS architecture with different types of Operator workstations, Supervisory Controllers, DDC controllers, Sensors & Actuators etc.
  • Good understanding Network topology and architecture
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, LON, Modbus, OPC, and other protocols
  • Able to handle Modbus, BACnet IP/MSTP integration
  • Must be proficient in wiring of starters, field devices, safety interlocks & panels
  • Experience in engineering, installing and commissioning of HVAC & BMS systems for Datacenter projects or other infrastructure projects like pharmaceuticals, airports, commercial buildings, hospitals
  • Must be a quick learner & should have a keen eye for problem solving
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills

Preferred

4 to 8 years of relevant experience in Building Automation Industry Datacenter Vertical, BMS Design Engineering or Industrial Automation.

Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou).

job.title: Service and Commissioning Engineer, Specialist
job.description:
Who we are:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do:

As a Service and Commissioning Engineer, you will be responsible for troubleshooting technical issues on IREF-related products, testing systems for proper function, and managing service tickets for billing purposes for medium account(s)/ client(s) with moderate complexity system. It includes providing leadership to ensure 100% uptime and reliability of the Remote Operations Center’s infrastructure, working closely with management to meet operational requirements, and maintaining compliance with regulatory and company policies.

How you will do it:

  • Execute commissioning of new equipment / system, including installation verification, pre-commissioning, start up and commissioning, performance testing, optimization of Industrial refrigeration system
  • Experience on handling all type of compressor/chiller, ie: scroll, screw, reciprocating, centrifugal, Multi-stage centrifugal & absorption.
  • Carry out comprehensive plant audit for Industrial refrigeration systems and provide detailed report on plant condition, observations and recommendations
  • To provide site service & maintenance including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, inspection, troubleshooting, repair and upgrades works, major equipment overhauls and replacement
  • Ensure safe and reliable handling of ammonia, CO₂, hydrocarbon gases and other industrial refrigerant.
  • To produce commissioning reports, technical documentation, and training materials.
  • To conduct training to customer’s operation and maintenance team, in functional concept and practical works.
  • Travel within South East Asia with on shore and off shore as required by the business in order to service the customer base.
  • Carry our service work to the highest possible standard in line with JCI policy & procedures and industry recognised best practices.
  • Ensure service/commissioning work is completed efficiently with minimum call back and warranty expense.
  • Ensure service reports are completed in good standard and submitted on time.
  • Actively identify and promote potential opportunities on services, parts and products to customers.
  • Supervise subcontractors working on behalf of JCI
  • Ensure the continued and sustainable growth of our maintenance base through customer relationship building with new and existing customers
  • Ensure the highest standard of safety are maintained at any job site at all time including but not limited to JCI staff.
  • Perform any other duties from time to time, whether ad-hoc or otherwise, as assigned by your superior or management
  • Ability to work in harsh, chemical laden environment under the sun.
  • Ability to work on standby with 24 hours call out situation.
  • Ability to be on overseas assignment for more than 1 month.
  • Lead the communication with factory technical support team on issue raised during commissioning and warranty period, as well as liaise with local engineering/project team.
  • Strong communication skill and technical knowledge to explain root cause to customer and ability to handle customer with strong technical knowledge. To manage the situation in stress environment to complete the service related work within the given timeline.

What we look for:

  • University degree, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Minimum 3 years in HVAC&R industry or relevant professional experience preferred.
  • Valid driving license preferred
  • Demonstrated knowledge and skills gained through academic qualifications and/or practical work experience.
  • Ability to apply industry knowledge and expertise in a professional environment.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior HVAC Equipment Service Technician with 8+ years of hands-on experience in servicing, troubleshooting, maintenance, and commissioning of commercial and industrial HVAC systems. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in HVAC equipment, excellent diagnostic skills, and the ability to independently handle service operations, customer interactions, and critical breakdowns.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance of HVAC equipment.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot complex mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration system faults.
  • Service and maintain:Chillers (Air-Cooled & Water-Cooled)
  • VRF/VRV Systems
  • AHUs (Air Handling Units)
  • FCUs (Fan Coil Units)
  • Package Units
  • Precision Air Conditioning Units
  • DX Units
  • Split & Cassette ACs
  • Cooling Towers
  • HVAC Control Systems & BMS Interfaces

Conduct commissioning, testing, balancing, and performance optimization of HVAC systems.Lead and support installation, retrofit, and upgrade projects.Attend emergency breakdown calls and ensure minimal downtime.Analyze service issues and recommend long-term corrective actions.Maintain accurate service documentation, inspection reports, and maintenance records.Coordinate with clients, project teams, vendors, and OEM representatives.Ensure compliance with safety standards, environmental regulations, and company procedures.Guide and mentor junior technicians and service engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • ITI / Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or related discipline.
  • HVAC, Refrigeration, or Safety certifications are preferred.

  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, P&ID diagrams, and technical drawings.
  • Hands-on experience with commissioning and fault diagnostics.
  • Familiarity with Building Management Systems (BMS) and automation controls.
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC safety standards and best maintenance practices.

  • Team leadership and mentoring ability

job.description:
Who we are

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

  • Meeting with clients and establishing their requirements
  • Producing, reviewing and implementing appropriate documentation including: pre-construction information, schedules of work, specifications, schematics and drawings for tender for each project
  • Manage a portfolio of approved Mechanical and Electrical (M&E) contractors through the lifecycle of a project
  • Project cost procurement, analysis, appraisal and budgeting

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Who we are :

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

**Position: Quality Engineer – Project Company: Johnson Controls (or Johnson Controls–type projects) Location: Project Sites / Regional Reporting To: Project Quality Manager / Project Manager**

Job Description - The Quality Engineer – Project is responsible for planning, implementing, and monitoring quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) activities across Johnson Controls project execution. The role ensures compliance with company standards, project speciﬁcations, international codes, and customer requirements throughout the project lifecycle—from design review to commissioning and handover.

Key Responsibilities : Project Quality Planning  Develop and implement Project Quality Plans (PQP) in line with Johnson Controls Quality Management System.  Ensure quality requirements are integrated into project schedules, method statements, and execution plans.  Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and subcontractors to align quality objectives. Quality Assurance & Control  Conduct incoming material inspections, ensuring compliance with approved submittals and speciﬁcations.  Monitor installation, testing, and commissioning activities for HVAC, BMS, Fire Alarm, Security, or Energy Solutions systems.  Perform site inspections, audits, and surveillance to ensure workmanship quality.  Ensure compliance with applicable standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ASHRAE, NFPA, IEC, local authority requirements). Documentation & Reporting  Review and approve ITPs, method statements, and inspection checklists.  Maintain quality records including inspection reports, NCRs, CARs, MIRs, and test results.  Prepare quality dashboard reports and KPIs for project review meetings.  Support preparation of as-built documentation and handover dossiers. Non-Conformance & Corrective Actions  Identify, issue, and manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).  Conduct root cause analysis and ensure eective corrective and preventive actions.  Verify closure of quality issues and lessons learned implementation. Audits & Compliance  Support internal, customer, and third-party audits.  Ensure project compliance with Johnson Controls policies, HSE requirements, and client speciﬁcations.  Coordinate with certiﬁcation bodies and regulatory authorities when required. Stakeholder Coordination  Liaise with clients, consultants, authorities, and subcontractors on quality matters.  Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and ﬁnal inspections.  Provide quality awareness and guidance to project teams.

Key Skills & Competencies  Strong knowledge of QA/QC processes in building systems or industrial projects  Familiarity with HVAC, BMS, Fire & Security systems (Johnson Controls product experience preferred)  Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and speciﬁcations  Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills  Effective communication and stakeholder management  Problem-solving and continuous improvement mindset

Qualiﬁcations & Experience  Bachelor’s Degree/ Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, or related discipline)  3–8 years of experience as a Quality Engineer or QA/QC Engineer in project environments  Experience with ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems  Knowledge of relevant standards (ASHRAE, NFPA, IEC, ISO, local codes)  Professional certiﬁcations (CQE, IRCA Lead Auditor, PMI-related) are an advantage

Tools & Systems  Quality management systems and audit tools  MS Oice (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)  Project documentation and reporting tools  ERP/Project systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent – preferred)

Behavioral Expectations  Commitment to Zero Defect and Right-First-Time philosophy  Compliance with Safety, Ethics, and Integrity standards  Proactive approach to quality risk management  Collaboration across multi-disciplinary project teams

Role - Project Engineer - IBMS, Mumbai (1-Year Contract Role)

Johnson Controls delivers innovative building technologies that support smarter, healthier, and more sustainable environments. In this role, you will support project execution and project management activities for IBMS delivery in Mumbai, with hands-on involvement in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.

This is a one-year contractual opportunity, renewable annually based on performance. It is well suited to candidates with a strong background in project execution or project management and practical experience in IBMS site delivery.

Role Overview

As a Project Engineer, you will help drive the execution of IBMS projects from planning through site delivery, coordination, testing, and handover. You will work closely with internal teams, contractors, vendors, and stakeholders to help ensure work is delivered safely, on time, and to the expected technical and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end execution of IBMS projects, including CCTV and ACS systems.
  • Coordinate with project managers, site teams, contractors, vendors, and clients to support smooth project delivery.
  • Monitor site progress against project plans, timelines, and execution requirements.
  • Review technical drawings, specifications, and work instructions to support installation readiness and site execution.
  • Track material availability, site requirements, and execution dependencies to help avoid delays.
  • Support installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities for IBMS systems.
  • Raise and follow up on site issues, technical concerns, and coordination gaps in a timely manner.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, progress updates, and handover records.
  • Support quality checks and help ensure work is completed in line with project and safety expectations.

How You Will Do It

  • Stay close to the site execution work and understand what is needed to keep IBMS delivery moving forward.
  • Own tasks and follow-ups with accountability, integrity, and a clear focus on delivering the right outcome.
  • Use practical problem-solving and candid communication to remove obstacles and improve execution every day.
  • Work as one team with project management, engineering, vendors, and site stakeholders, building trust through collaboration and shared standards.
  • Keep documentation, progress tracking, and coordination updates accurate so that work remains visible and controllable.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Background in project execution or project management within IBMS projects.
  • Hands-on experience in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.
  • Experience supporting site-based project delivery, installation, testing, commissioning, or handover activities.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and site documentation.
  • Strong coordination, communication, and follow-up skills.
  • Good problem-solving mindset with attention to quality and execution detail.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to large-scale commercial, infrastructure, or facility-related projects.
  • Experience coordinating with multiple contractors and vendors on active project sites.
  • Additional exposure to integrated building systems or ELV project environments.

Why Join Us

This role gives you the opportunity to build strong IBMS project delivery experience with a global leader in smart and sustainable building solutions. You will gain hands-on exposure to project execution, strengthen your domain knowledge in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS, and contribute to meaningful work in a performance-based contractual role.

If you are ready to bring your project execution or project management experience to a hands-on IBMS role in Mumbai, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Application Engineer II
job.description:
Job Description

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer:

Competitive salary

  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA, Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc)
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Fire Alarm Panels, Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA, Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc)
  • Knowledge on Simplex & Zettler fire alarm product along with Xtralis, Securiton & Wagner product for Aspirating Smoke Detection system
  • Simplex & VESDA certifications will have added advantage
  • Expertise in Fire Alarm Code and Guidelines. Should be familiar with local code requirement for Singapore, Hong Kong & Malaysia region.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.), Blue Beam
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, Modbus, and other protocols.
  • Should have good experience for subcon/vendor engagement keeping close

co-ordination with procurement

  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

3-6 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System’s Desing and Estimation.

Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou).

job.title: Senior Solution Architect
job.description:
About us:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

###

What you will do: As Senior Solution Architect – OpenBlue (APAC), you will drive technical solutioning and customer engagement for the OpenBlue digital platform across the Asia Pacific region. You will partner closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering and Delivery teams to design digital building solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes in energy efficiency, sustainability, operational excellence and occupant experience.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in Smart Buildings and IoT with consultative selling, value engineering and solution architecture capabilities.

###

How you will do it:

  • Partner with Sales teams to qualify opportunities and develop winning technical strategies
  • Lead customer discovery workshops to understand business, operational and digital transformation requirements
  • Design scalable end-to-end OpenBlue solutions leveraging IoT, cloud, analytics, AI and enterprise integrations
  • Develop solution architectures, technical proposals, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts (POCs) and RFP responses
  • Build business cases, ROI models and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analyses that quantify customer value
  • Present solution and value propositions to technical and executive stakeholders
  • Act as the regional liaison between customers, Sales and Product Management by capturing market requirements, coordinating product feedback and supporting roadmap discussions
  • Collaborate with Delivery teams to ensure smooth transition from pre-sales to implementation
  • Develop reusable solution templates, reference architectures and sales enablement assets
  • Stay current on Smart Building, Energy Management, AI and Digital Building technologies while supporting strategic customer engagements across APAC

###

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline
  • 8+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales or Digital Building solutions
  • Experience with Smart Buildings, Building Management Systems (BMS/BAS), IoT, Cloud Platforms and Enterprise Integration
  • Strong understanding of energy management, sustainability and connected building technologies
  • Experience preparing technical proposals, conducting customer workshops and supporting complex solution sales
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong problem-solving skills with high attention to detail
  • Excellent presentation, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural regional environment

Preferred Skills

  • Technical
  • Smart Buildings, BMS/BAS, HVAC and Building Controls
  • IoT, Edge Computing and Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • APIs and enterprise integrations
  • Data analytics, AI and digital platforms
  • Cybersecurity fundamentals for OT/IT environments

Business & Commercial

  • Consultative selling and solution design
  • Value engineering, ROI and TCO analysis
  • Executive presentations and stakeholder management
  • Product coordination and Voice of Customer management
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Sales and Delivery teams

Key Competencies

  • Customer-focused mindset with strong business acumen
  • Strategic thinking with a focus on digital transformation and customer outcomes
  • Strong solution architecture and technical consulting capabilities
  • Passion for knowledge sharing and continuous learning
  • Strong collaboration skills with a proactive and solution-oriented approach
  • Ability to influence stakeholders across functions and levels
  • Adaptability and ability to manage multiple priorities across regional engagements

Success Measures

  • Technical win rate and solution quality
  • Customer satisfaction and executive engagement
  • Business value and ROI demonstrated during sales cycles
  • Product feedback adoption and reusable solution assets
  • Effective collaboration across Sales, Product and Delivery teams

Travel

  • Travel across the Asia Pacific region (approximately 25–40%) will be required to support customer engagements and strategic opportunities.

###

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to shape digital transformation initiatives across Asia Pacific
  • Exposure to leading Smart Building, IoT, AI and sustainability technologies
  • Hands-on experience with a wide range of customer environments and enterprise digital platforms
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

###
