Job Description – Project Engineer (Contractual Role)

Location: Mumbai Employment Type: Contractual (Contract to be renewed every year based on performance) Experience: 4–7 Years

Role Summary:

The Project Engineer will be responsible for end‑to‑end project execution of IBMS / ELV systems, ensuring timely installation, quality compliance, testing, and commissioning at project sites. The role demands strong hands‑on experience in IBMS, CCTV, and CFS systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute and manage IBMS / ELV projects at site.
  • Supervise installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of systems.
  • Handle project execution activities related to:

IBMS (Integrated Building Management Systems)

  • CCTV Systems
  • CFS (Critical / Fire & Life Safety Systems)

Coordinate with project managers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams.

Ensure adherence to project schedules, quality standards, and safety guidelines.

Review technical drawings, BOQs, and system specifications.

Conduct site inspections and quality checks for installed systems.

Prepare daily/weekly project progress reports and maintain documentation.

Resolve technical and operational issues at site in coordination with stakeholders.

Required Skills & Technical Expertise:

  • Strong hands‑on experience in IBMS project execution.
  • Practical exposure to installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Mandatory experience in CCTV and CFS systems.
  • Good understanding of ELV system integration and site execution practices.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and schematics.
  • Good communication, coordination, and problem‑solving skills.

Qualification & Experience:

  • Diploma / BE / BTech in Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / E&C or related discipline.
  • 4–7 years of relevant experience in IBMS / ELV projects.
  • Experience in commercial buildings, IT parks, data centers, or industrial projects preferred.

Reporting To:

Project Manager / Senior Project Engineer

job.title: Integrated Solutions Service Tech 3
job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Assistant Manager – Service (IBMS) to lead service operations for Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS). The incumbent will be responsible for managing service delivery, preventive and corrective maintenance activities, customer relationships, technical support, team management, and ensuring high system uptime across client sites.

Key Responsibilities

  • ### Manage end-to-end service operations for IBMS/BMS installations across multiple customer locations.
  • ### Lead a team of service engineers and technicians for maintenance and troubleshooting activities.
  • ### Ensure timely execution of preventive maintenance (PM), corrective maintenance (CM), and Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) obligations.
  • ### Support commissioning, upgrades, and system modifications as required.
  • ### Analyze system faults and provide effective solutions to minimize downtime.
  • ### Review service reports, maintenance schedules, and customer compliance documentation.
  • ### Coordinate with project, sales, and technical teams for smooth service delivery.
  • ### Monitor customer satisfaction and maintain strong client relationships.
  • ### Ensure adherence to SLAs, safety standards, and operational KPIs.
  • ### Identify opportunities for service revenue, AMC renewals, and modernization projects.
  • ### Conduct technical training and mentoring for service engineers.
  • ### Manage spare parts inventory and coordinate with vendors for replacements and repairs.

Key Skills & Requirements

  • ### Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • ### 6–10 years of experience in Building Automation, IBMS, BMS, or Building Technologies.
  • ### Hands-on experience with systems such as:

Honeywell

  • ### Siemens
  • ### Schneider Electric
  • ### Johnson Controls
  • ### Delta Controls
  • ### Tridium/Niagara

Strong knowledge of:

  • ### HVAC Controls
  • ### Fire Alarm Systems
  • ### Access Control Systems
  • ### CCTV Surveillance
  • ### Energy Monitoring Systems
  • ### DDC Controllers
  • ### PLCs and VFDs

Knowledge of communication protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, KNX, LonWorks, and TCP/IP.

Ability to interpret electrical schematics and control drawings.

Strong leadership, customer management, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ### Exposure to AMC management and service business operations.
  • ### Relevant certifications in BMS/IBMS, HVAC Controls, or Building Automation Systems.

job.title: Industrial Refrigeration Technician (Gordon Brothers)
job.description:
Join Australia's Leading Industrial Refrigeration Team

Johnson Controls is a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, helping customers optimize energy use, reduce carbon emissions, and maintain mission-critical operations across industries including food and beverage, cold storage, advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, and data centers.

With more than 140 years of innovation and expertise, Johnson Controls delivers world-class technology, service, and engineering solutions that help customers operate safely, efficiently, and sustainably.

Gordon Brothers Industries (GBI), now proudly part of Johnson Controls, is Australia's largest Industrial Refrigeration company. With offices across every mainland state, we design, install, service, and maintain industrial refrigeration systems for some of Australia's most recognised organisations in food processing, beverage production, cold storage, logistics, mining, and chemical processing.

As our business continues to grow, we're looking for an experienced Industrial Refrigeration Technician to join our Melbourne Service Team. This is an outstanding opportunity for a technician who enjoys working on technically challenging refrigeration systems while being supported by a market-leading industrial refrigeration specialist.

Why Join Us?

If you're looking to take your industrial refrigeration career to the next level, you'll have access to:

  • Industry-leading OEM training on Frick, Sabroe, and other leading industrial refrigeration equipment
  • Exposure to large-scale ammonia and industrial refrigeration systems
  • A fully maintained company vehicle and mobile phone
  • Competitive remuneration under our Enterprise Agreement
  • Ongoing technical development and career progression opportunities
  • The stability and resources of a global organisation combined with the expertise and reputation of Australia's leading industrial refrigeration business
  • A strong commitment to safety, innovation, and work-life balance

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Service Manager, you'll provide service, maintenance, troubleshooting, and technical support across a diverse range of industrial refrigeration systems. Working with a broad customer base, you'll play a key role in ensuring critical refrigeration assets operate reliably and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform planned and breakdown maintenance on industrial refrigeration systems
  • Diagnose faults and carry out repairs and commissioning activities
  • Complete service documentation accurately and efficiently
  • Build strong relationships with customers and provide exceptional service
  • Participate in ongoing training, technical development, and service team meetings
  • Maintain a strong commitment to safety and compliance standards

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Trade-qualified Refrigeration Mechanic
  • Current ARC Licence
  • Current Restricted Electrical Licence
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence
  • Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding capability

Highly Regarded

  • Previous industrial refrigeration experience
  • Experience working with ammonia refrigeration systems
  • Experience with screw compressors, pump recirculation systems, and industrial controls
  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • The ability to work independently and manage competing priorities
  • A proactive approach to safety and continuous improvement

Apply Today

If you're an experienced Refrigeration Mechanic looking to work on some of Australia's most technically challenging industrial refrigeration systems while developing your career with an industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Click APPLY to submit your application.

Applicants must have full working rights in Australia.

Please note that pre-employment checks, including reference checks, medical assessment, criminal history check, and drug and alcohol screening, will form part of the recruitment process.

To learn more about Gordon Brothers Industries and Johnson Controls, visit www.gordonbrothers.com.au.

job.title: HVAC Service Technician
job.description:
At Johnson Controls, we're helping shape the future of smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. As a global leader in thermal management, energy efficiency, and mission-critical building systems, we help customers reduce carbon emissions, optimize energy use, and operate with greater resilience across industries including healthcare, data centres, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and education.

For more than 140 years, we've delivered performance where it matters most. Backed by innovative technology, industry-leading expertise, and a world-class service network, we help our customers achieve real-world results while creating opportunities for our people to grow and succeed.

The Opportunity

We're seeking a skilled Service HVAC Technician to join our Sunshine Coast team.

This is an exciting opportunity to build your career while enjoying one of Australia's most desirable coastal lifestyles. Join a Global HVAC Leader Delivering Critical Infrastructure Solutions

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the future of smart, sustainable buildings. As a global leader in HVAC, building automation, energy efficiency, and decarbonization solutions, we help some of Australia's most important facilities operate at peak performance.

From data centres, healthcare facilities and pharmaceutical manufacturing plants to universities and commercial buildings, our technology and expertise keep mission-critical environments running safely, efficiently, and sustainably.

Apply today and discover why experienced HVAC professionals choose Johnson Controls to build their careers.

job.title: Engineering Intern, HVAC
job.description:
Who we are

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do

We are seeking an Engineering Intern to join the Project Delivery, SEA. Reporting to the HVAC team, the intern will drive customer proposals, project plans, as well as document engineering designs and schematics with guidance from the team. The successful individual will work closely with stakeholders to identify project requirements, and develop proposals including costing, durations and required resources.

How you will do it:

As an intern, you will work closely and support the team in the following activities:

  • Conceptualize composite components and models, develop drawings, designs and schematics (e.g. 3D modelling of finished goods, tooling)
  • Analyze blueprints, plans, relevant customer documents to identify and propose requirements
  • Generate cost estimation based on project requirements
  • Facilitate and support project findings, relevant operation trainings, closing and handover process
  • Act as a liaison between internal and external project stakeholders

What we look for:

  • Pursuing a relevant degree or diploma for built environment (e.g. electrical/mechanical/mechatronics engineering)
  • Prior experience and/or interest in building management systems/thermodynamics
  • Prior experience and/or interest in utilizing CAD will be beneficial
  • Able to commit to a full-time internship for 6 months
  • Possess good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Possess critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Motivated and passionate to challenge status quo and drive for continuous improvement

Job Description Summary

Performs direct field labor activities under the guidance of Team Leaders and Managers to support project delivery and service operations. Responsible for the installation, setup, configuration, and commissioning of HVAC equipment and control systems using established processes and standards. Provides operational support by applying troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve system issues, while assisting senior technicians in field service activities. Supports Operations & Maintenance (O&M) field activities as required to ensure customer satisfaction and system reliability.

What You Will Do

  • Execute field installation, startup, configuration, and commissioning activities for HVAC equipment and related control systems.
  • Support project delivery teams in implementing HVAC solutions in accordance with engineering specifications and project requirements.
  • Assist in troubleshooting and resolving equipment, controls, and system-related issues at customer sites.
  • Perform testing and verification of system performance to ensure proper functionality and compliance with project standards.
  • Support preventive and corrective maintenance activities under O&M contracts.
  • Work collaboratively with customers, contractors, and internal teams during project execution and service delivery.
  • Maintain accurate service records, commissioning reports, and project documentation.
  • Follow all Johnson Controls safety procedures, quality standards, and operational processes.

How You Will Do It

  • Utilize standard commissioning and configuration tools to install and start up HVAC systems.
  • Diagnose equipment and control system issues using established troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Assist senior technicians with system integration, testing, and customer demonstrations.
  • Coordinate field activities with project stakeholders to support timely project completion.
  • Escalate complex technical issues to Team Leaders or Managers when required.
  • Ensure customer concerns are addressed promptly and professionally.

What We Look For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related field with 1+ year of relevant experience; OR
  • Diploma/Associate Degree (2-year degree) in a related technical discipline with 6+ years of relevant experience; OR
  • Equivalent combination of education and industry experience.
  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of HVAC equipment, control systems, and field commissioning practices.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and project documentation.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and customer interaction skills.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS) or HVAC controls.
  • Knowledge of HVAC commissioning, maintenance, and service operations.
  • Familiarity with industry communication protocols and control system integration.
  • Experience working in a customer-facing field service environment.

Involved in employment issues, such as staffing, termination and employee relations issues.

  • must.

Job Title: Deputy Project Manager - IBMS Location: Kolkata Experience: 8-12 Years Industry: Building Automation / ELV / IBMS / Smart Buildings

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Deputy Project Manager - IBMS to support the planning, execution, and delivery of Integrated Building Management System (IBMS) projects. The incumbent will be responsible for end-to-end project execution, stakeholder coordination, resource management, and ensuring timely project completion while maintaining quality, safety, and commercial objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and execute IBMS projects from initiation to commissioning and handover.
  • Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, OEMs, and internal teams for seamless project delivery.
  • Oversee installation, integration, testing, and commissioning of IBMS and associated ELV systems.
  • Monitor project schedules, milestones, budgets, and resource utilization.
  • Ensure project execution adheres to approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
  • Track project progress and prepare periodic status reports, MIS, and project documentation.
  • Manage subcontractors and site teams to ensure timely completion of activities.
  • Handle project risks, change requests, and escalation management.
  • Support procurement and material planning activities to avoid project delays.
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards, statutory requirements, and company policies.
  • Coordinate with engineering and programming teams for system integration and troubleshooting.
  • Participate in client meetings and provide technical and execution-related support.

Technical Expertise Required

Strong experience in execution and project management of the following systems:

  • Integrated Building Management System (IBMS)
  • Building Management System (BMS)
  • Fire Alarm System (FAS)
  • Access Control System (ACS)
  • CCTV / Video Surveillance System
  • Public Address System (PA)
  • Intrusion Detection System
  • Networking and Structured Cabling
  • HVAC Integration
  • Energy Monitoring System (EMS)
  • SCADA Integration (preferred)

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical & Electronics, or related Engineering discipline.
  • Project Management certification will be an added advantage.

Desired Experience

  • 8-12 years of experience in IBMS/BMS/ELV project execution and project management.
  • Proven experience in handling commercial buildings, IT parks, hospitals, airports, metro, industrial, smart city, or large infrastructure projects.
  • Hands-on experience in project planning, scheduling, coordination, commissioning, and client management.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and contractors.

Required Skills

  • Strong project execution and management capabilities.
  • Knowledge of IBMS architecture, protocols, and system integration.
  • Good understanding of HVAC, electrical, and ELV systems.
  • Proficiency in MS Project, Primavera, AutoCAD, and MS Office.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Commercial awareness and contract management understanding.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight timelines.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • On-time project delivery.
  • Project profitability and cost control.
  • Successful commissioning and handover.
  • Customer satisfaction.
  • Quality and safety compliance.
  • Team productivity and resource optimization.

Location: Kolkata (with travel to project sites across Eastern Region as required).

job.title: Senior Project Engineer
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

##

Role - Project Engineer - IBMS, Mumbai (1-Year Contract Role)

Johnson Controls delivers innovative building technologies that support smarter, healthier, and more sustainable environments. In this role, you will support project execution and project management activities for IBMS delivery in Mumbai, with hands-on involvement in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.

This is a one-year contractual opportunity, renewable annually based on performance. It is well suited to candidates with a strong background in project execution or project management and practical experience in IBMS site delivery.

Role Overview

As a Project Engineer, you will help drive the execution of IBMS projects from planning through site delivery, coordination, testing, and handover. You will work closely with internal teams, contractors, vendors, and stakeholders to help ensure work is delivered safely, on time, and to the expected technical and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end execution of IBMS projects, including CCTV and ACS systems.
  • Coordinate with project managers, site teams, contractors, vendors, and clients to support smooth project delivery.
  • Monitor site progress against project plans, timelines, and execution requirements.
  • Review technical drawings, specifications, and work instructions to support installation readiness and site execution.
  • Track material availability, site requirements, and execution dependencies to help avoid delays.
  • Support installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities for IBMS systems.
  • Raise and follow up on site issues, technical concerns, and coordination gaps in a timely manner.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, progress updates, and handover records.
  • Support quality checks and help ensure work is completed in line with project and safety expectations.

How You Will Do It

  • Stay close to the site execution work and understand what is needed to keep IBMS delivery moving forward.
  • Own tasks and follow-ups with accountability, integrity, and a clear focus on delivering the right outcome.
  • Use practical problem-solving and candid communication to remove obstacles and improve execution every day.
  • Work as one team with project management, engineering, vendors, and site stakeholders, building trust through collaboration and shared standards.
  • Keep documentation, progress tracking, and coordination updates accurate so that work remains visible and controllable.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Background in project execution or project management within IBMS projects.
  • Hands-on experience in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.
  • Experience supporting site-based project delivery, installation, testing, commissioning, or handover activities.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and site documentation.
  • Strong coordination, communication, and follow-up skills.
  • Good problem-solving mindset with attention to quality and execution detail.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to large-scale commercial, infrastructure, or facility-related projects.
  • Experience coordinating with multiple contractors and vendors on active project sites.
  • Additional exposure to integrated building systems or ELV project environments.

Why Join Us

This role gives you the opportunity to build strong IBMS project delivery experience with a global leader in smart and sustainable building solutions. You will gain hands-on exposure to project execution, strengthen your domain knowledge in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS, and contribute to meaningful work in a performance-based contractual role.

If you are ready to bring your project execution or project management experience to a hands-on IBMS role in Mumbai, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Head Of Compliance, India
job.description:
Head Of Compliance, India

Johnson Controls is a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization. We help customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified compliance leader to head the India compliance agenda and support the continued development of our ethics and compliance program. Reporting to the Chief Ethics and Compliance Officer, this role is a key member of the Compliance Leadership Team and works closely with senior business management, Finance, Human Resources, the Law Department, Regional Compliance Counsels, and global compliance experts.

The role is responsible for strengthening compliance culture, supporting anti-corruption and fair competition efforts, and ensuring practical, effective controls across India.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain effective communication with senior management in India on compliance matters and support programs that strengthen tone at the top and the Speak Up culture.
  • Identify regional compliance risks and design focused training, communications, and program initiatives to address them.
  • Review and approve third-party due diligence, high-risk payment transactions, and employee-disclosed conflicts of interest relating to India.
  • Organize and facilitate India Compliance Committee meetings with senior business leaders and stakeholders from Finance, Legal, and HR.
  • Support internal investigations led by the Forensics team and oversee remediation and disciplinary processes, including escalation to the Disciplinary Sub-Committee where appropriate.
  • Direct internal investigations conducted under legal privilege, with focus on anti-corruption, anti-trust, and other regulatory risks.
  • Respond promptly to detected offenses and work with the Chief Ethics and Compliance Officer, Regional Compliance Counsels, local leadership, Human Resources, and local counsel to define corrective actions.
  • Support M&A due diligence and post-acquisition integration activities in India.
  • Lead or co-lead projects with senior management to strengthen program design and reduce compliance exposure across the country.
  • Support corruption-risk assessments, fair competition reviews, anti-corruption compliance audits, and targeted risk assessments of business units.
  • Develop and monitor plans to implement policies, procedures, and standards of conduct throughout the country.
  • Help maintain a data-driven, proactive monitoring program for customers, vendors, and employee transactions.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance and support to employees across India on a wide range of compliance issues.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the compliance program through updated policies, training, communications, data analytics, monitoring, and other initiatives.

How You Will Do It

  • Own the India compliance agenda with accountability, integrity, and a clear focus on doing the right thing.
  • Stay close to the business, remove obstacles quickly, and translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical solutions.
  • Use candid dialogue, data, and sound judgment to improve programs every day and respond effectively to emerging risks.
  • Work as one team with Finance, HR, Legal, Forensics, regional counsels, and business leaders to deliver consistent outcomes.
  • Apply disciplined follow-through on investigations, remediation, disciplinary actions, monitoring, and reporting so commitments become measurable action.

Qualifications

  • 15 or more years of related compliance experience, preferably within a multinational corporation.
  • Knowledge of the legal and regulatory framework in India.
  • Ability to work effectively within a team framework, in a matrixed organization, and across multiple cultures.
  • Proficiency with word processing and data processing programs, especially Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to relate comfortably at all levels of an organization.
  • Ability to lead, inspire, and manage effectively with unquestioned integrity.
  • Self-motivation and the ability to manage and prioritize a significant workload.
  • Ability to understand commercial objectives and solve complex problems in a practical way.
  • Ability to meet challenges confidently and react ethically, quickly, and helpfully in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Law degree.
  • Audit background.

Why Join Us

At Johnson Controls, your work helps protect trust, strengthen our culture, and support responsible growth in a business that serves critical industries around the world. You will have the opportunity to partner across functions, influence programs with real enterprise impact, and contribute to a global organization committed to performance, resilience, and decarbonization.

If you are ready to lead with integrity and help shape the future of compliance in India, we invite you to apply.

job.description:
Who we are?

##

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

## For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

##

What will you do?

We are looking for a hands‑on EC\&I Controls & Automation Engineer with a strong software bias, specifically in PLC programming, HMI development, and secure automation systems. This role strengthens our control and automation software capability within the India team, which is already strong in instrumentation and EC&I design. The objective of this role is to add depth in control and automation software, including PLC/HMI implementation, Cause & Effect logic, control philosophy development, and OT cybersecurity‑aware IEC 62443 system design requirements. This is a technical delivery role, not project management. The engineer will support oil & gas and process automation systems, including Hydraulic Power Units (HPU), CAFS, INERT / gas‑based fire suppression systems, and other safety‑critical control applications.

  • ## PLC, HMI & Automation Software (Primary Responsibility)
  • ## ➢ Develop, test, and maintain PLC programs using Siemens TIA Portal.
  • ## ➢ Design and implement HMI applications using WinCC / WinCC Unified.
  • ## ➢ Implement control sequences, interlocks, permissive, alarms, trips, and shutdown logic.
  • ## ➢ Develop, review, and execute Cause & Effect (C\&E) matrices and ensure correct implementation in PLC logic and HMI behavior. ➢ Support closed‑loop testing and simulation (e.g. PLCSIM Advanced).
  • ## ➢ Perform hands‑on troubleshooting of PLC logic, HMI screens, communication issues, and field I/O. 2. HPU, CAFS & INERT Fire Suppression Control Assessment
  • ## ➢ Support control system design and assessment for: • Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) • Compressed Air Foam Systems (CAFS) • INERT / gas‑based fire suppression systems
  • ## ➢ Develop and verify automation sequences, interlocks, and fail‑safe logic for hydraulic and fire suppression systems.
  • ## ➢ Review instrumentation inputs, valve actuation logic, feedback signals, alarms, and shutdown conditions.
  • ## ➢ Ensure fire suppression control logic aligns with Cause & Effect diagrams , safety requirements, and site operating philosophy.
  • ## ➢ Support FAT, SAT, and commissioning activities for safety‑critical systems. 3. Control Philosophy & Automation Documentation
  • ## ➢ Prepare and maintain: • Control Philosophy narratives • Functional Design Specifications (FDS) • Automation sequence descriptions • Cause & Effect diagrams
  • ## ➢ Translate process and safety requirements into clear PLC logic and HMI functionality .
  • ## ➢ Interface with EC\&I and process teams to ensure correct automation implementation. 4. OT Cybersecurity & Secure Automation Design
  • ## ➢ Apply OT cybersecurity principles in PLC and HMI system design.
  • ## ➢ Support secure control system network topology, including: • Network segmentation (zones & conduits concept) • Separation of control, safety, and enterprise networks • Secure remote access concepts
  • ## ➢ Ensure automation designs align with IEC 62443 awareness‑level requirements.
  • ## ➢ Participate in cybersecurity design reviews from an automation engineer perspective (not IT policy ownership).
  • ## ➢ Identify and mitigate basic cybersecurity risks related to PLCs, HMIs, and industrial networks.
  • ## Note: This is not an IT cybersecurity role, but OT cybersecurity awareness and correct engineering practices are required. 5. EC\&I Integration, Testing & Delivery
  • ## ➢ Work with EC\&I design documents (SLDs, I/O lists, cable schedules).
  • ## ➢ Support control panel design reviews, software loading, and configuration checks.
  • ## ➢ Execute and support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT).
  • ## ➢ Support commissioning, troubleshooting, and handover of automation systems. Required Skills & Experience Must‑Have
  • ## ➢ 5–10 years experience in EC\&I / Controls / Automation engineering .
  • ## ➢ Strong PLC programming experience (Siemens TIA Portal mandatory).
  • ## ➢ HMI development experience (WinCC / WinCC Unified preferred).
  • ## ➢ Hands‑on experience with Cause & Effect logic and control narratives .
  • ## ➢ Practical experience with industrial automation systems .
  • ## ➢ Experience supporting FAT, SAT, and commissioning .
  • ## ➢ OT cybersecurity awareness (secure control system networks, segmentation). Nice to Have
  • ## ➢ Oil & gas / process automation experience.
  • ## ➢ Experience with HPU, CAFS, INERT fire suppression systems . ➢ Basic functional safety exposure (SIL / IEC 61508 / IEC 61511). ➢ PLCSIM Advanced or similar simulation tools. ➢ AutoCAD / EPLAN (review level).

What we look for

  • ## 5–10 years experience in EC\&I / Controls / Automation engineering .
  • ## ➢ Strong PLC programming experience (Siemens TIA Portal mandatory).
  • ## ➢ HMI development experience (WinCC / WinCC Unified preferred).
  • ## ➢ Hands‑on experience with Cause & Effect logic and control narratives .
  • ## ➢ Practical experience with industrial automation systems .
  • ## ➢ Experience supporting FAT, SAT, and commissioning .
  • ## ➢ OT cybersecurity awareness (secure control system networks, segmentation). Nice to Have
  • ## ➢ Oil & gas / process automation experience.
  • ## ➢ Experience with HPU, CAFS, INERT fire suppression systems . ➢ Basic functional safety exposure (SIL / IEC 61508 / IEC 61511). ➢ PLCSIM Advanced or similar simulation tools.
  • ## ➢ AutoCAD / EPLAN (review level).

##

In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

job.title: Safety Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

What we offer:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What You Will Do

The Safety Engineer will be responsible for ensuring compliance with Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) standards across project sites. The role will support safe execution of IBMS, CCTV, CFS, ACS, and other building technology projects by implementing safety practices, conducting audits, and driving a strong safety culture aligned with organizational standards.

How You Will Do It

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS regulations, company policies, and client safety requirements.
  • Conduct regular site safety inspections, audits, hazard identification, and risk assessments.
  • Implement and monitor safety management systems and safe work practices across project sites.
  • Facilitate toolbox talks, safety inductions, and awareness programs for employees and contractors.
  • Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Monitor contractor safety performance and ensure compliance with approved safety procedures.
  • Maintain EHS records, reports, permits, and statutory documentation.
  • Work closely with project managers, site engineers, vendors, and customers to ensure safe project execution.
  • Support emergency preparedness planning and conduct mock drills as required.(Suggested enhancement based on standard safety practices.)

What We Look For

Required

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Industrial Safety, EHS, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Safety/EHS management within construction, IBMS, ELV, MEP, data center, or infrastructure projects.
  • Strong knowledge of safety regulations, risk assessment methodologies, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience conducting safety audits, inspections, and incident investigations.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred

  • Certification in Industrial Safety, NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent EHS qualification.
  • Experience supporting CCTV, CFS, ACS, IBMS, or building automation projects.
  • Familiarity with client-specific EHS requirements and contractor safety management.

Key Competencies

  • Safety Leadership
  • Risk Assessment & Hazard Identification
  • Incident Investigation
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Training & Awareness
  • Contractor Safety Management
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

job.description:

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

What You Will Do

This role involves managing the sales lifecycle for industrial refrigeration solutions, from lead generation to order closure, while ensuring client satisfaction and business growth. Key responsibilities include:

  • Ownership of customer requirements analysis, including studying tenders and email inquiries.
  • Preparation and presentation of technical offers and leading negotiation meetings.
  • Developing cost estimations and creating engaging product presentations tailored to client needs.
  • Engaging with consultants to ensure our products are specified in client projects.
  • Conducting market analysis to identify niche opportunities and expand the customer base for refrigeration packages.
  • Promoting and integrating York Process System (YPS) and F&B solutions in collaboration with industrial consultants.
  • Maintaining strong relationships with existing customers while actively acquiring new ones.
  • Coordinating with pre-sales teams for project-specific requirements and ensuring timely payment collections as per agreements.

How You Will Do It

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
  • Actively participating in review meetings to align strategies with business objectives.
  • Using a collaborative approach to foster teamwork with internal and external stakeholders, enhancing project outcomes.

What We Look For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Refrigeration, or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent).
  • 10+ years of experience in industrial refrigeration sales, with a strong focus on ammonia systems. Exposure to gas compression technologies is an advantage.
  • Proven expertise in tendering, technical proposal preparation, costing, negotiation, and sales closure.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build lasting relationships with clients and stakeholders.

Why Join Us

Be a part of a dynamic team where your contributions drive real-world solutions in industrial refrigeration. Enjoy a collaborative and forward-thinking work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development.

job.title: Sr. Service Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. It’s changing the way we design, operates and maintains indoor environments and driving to a new era of autonomous buildings.

We deliver the blueprint of the future for industries such as healthcare, schools, data centers, airports, stadiums, hotels, manufacturing and beyond through OpenBlue, our comprehensive suite of connected solutions.

Johnson Controls offers the world’s largest portfolio of building technology, software and services. Supported by a team of more than 100,000 dedicated employees working across 150 countries, we’re helping customers achieve their sustainability goals and power their mission.

###

Please visit and follow Johnson Controls linkedin for recent exciting activities.

APAC Linkedin [Johnson Controls APAC Linkedin ](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/)

Career [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://youtu.be/EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue [OpenBlue: This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://youtu.be/bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What you will do

HVAC Chiller Service Engineer - Troubleshooting

We are seeking an experienced HVAC Chiller Service Engineer to join our team. job.title: Assistant Manager - Service
job.description:
Job Summary

The Assistant Manager Service – Controls is responsible for leading the installation, commissioning, maintenance, and service support activities related to Building Management Systems (BMS) and HVAC Controls. The role involves managing a team of service engineers and technicians, ensuring successful project execution, system reliability, customer satisfaction, and adherence to quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead commissioning, troubleshooting, and servicing of BMS and HVAC control systems.
  • Manage installation and integration of controllers, sensors, actuators, VFDs, control panels, and field devices.
  • Oversee commissioning of HVAC equipment including Chillers, AHUs, FCUs, Cooling Towers, Pumps, and VAV systems.
  • Ensure successful integration through BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, and other communication protocols.
  • Support system testing, point-to-point checks, functional testing, and performance validation.
  • Manage service schedules, resource allocation, and field execution activities.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to service engineers and technicians.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues and customer concerns.
  • Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, and project teams to ensure timely project delivery.
  • Review service reports, commissioning documentation, and project handover records.
  • Drive customer satisfaction through effective service delivery and issue resolution.
  • Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and company operational standards.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • 6–10 years of experience in BMS, HVAC Controls, Installation, and Commissioning.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of team handling or supervisory experience preferred.

Key Skills

  • Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • HVAC Controls & Automation
  • DDC Controllers
  • BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks
  • Chiller & HVAC System Commissioning
  • VFDs and Control Panels
  • PLC/SCADA Knowledge
  • Team Management & Customer Handling
  • Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis
  • Project Execution & Service Operations

Industry Preference: Building Automation, HVAC, Data Centers, Commercial Buildings, Healthcare Facilities, Industrial Automation, Smart Buildings, and Critical Facilities.

job.title: Solutions Engineer
job.description:
Who we are:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do:

The Graduate Solutions Engineer Program is designed to develop the next generation of engineering leaders for smart buildings, data centers, and mission-critical infrastructure. Through a structured rotational program, participants will build deep technical expertise across multiple engineering disciplines while gaining practical experience in energy efficiency, digital technologies, controls, HVAC systems, and mission-critical environments.

During the 18-month rotational program, you will work alongside experienced engineers and subject matter experts, gaining hands-on experience across electrical, mechanical, controls, and digital domains. The program is designed to strengthen core engineering fundamentals, cultivate multidisciplinary problem-solving capabilities, and equip participants with the skills to design and deliver integrated solutions for increasingly complex customer challenges.

How you will do it:

  • Join the BMS Project/Service team to design and implement control programming for new or existing BMS sites, facilitating synergy between electrical control systems and mechanical operations
  • Engage with the HVAC Energy Solution/Service team to perform chiller performance reviews, audit reporting and maintenance, gaining insights that intertwine different components in energy management
  • Contribute as a member of the digital delivery and solution architect team, tasked with implementing and delivering JCI’s OpenBlue digital solutions.
  • Participate in Data Center and mission-critical infrastructure projects, gaining exposure to cooling systems, sustainability initiatives, operational resilience, and optimization strategies.
  • Participate in research projects with external organizations (e.g. Higher Learning Institution, startups) as a part of the JCI Innovation Center
  • Undertaking a full cycle project in the final year of the program
  • Engage in cross-functional collaboration to leverage collective expertise and drive innovative solutions in the design and implementation of comprehensive building systems & data center solutions.
  • Receive mentoring and coaching from experienced engineers and industry experts to accelerate technical and professional development.
  • Stay informed about industry trends and advancements in both electrical and mechanical fields to ensure solutions remain cutting-edge and relevant

What we look for:

  • Graduating student or recent graduate with a degree background in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, Infrastructure and Project Management, Urban Systems/Energy Management, or a related field, with up to 2 years of experience.
  • A strong interest in sustainability and a desire to learn and apply concepts related to smart building solutions that encompass multidisciplinary engagements
  • Robust analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, with a capability to approach challenges from both electrical and mechanical perspectives.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to facilitate teamwork across engineering disciplines.
  • Able to thrive in a collaborative and dynamic work environment, adapting to evolving project needs.
  • Shortlisted candidates will participate in a video interview and an assessment center to showcase their skills and fit for the role

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Associate Service Sales Engineer
job.description:
About us: Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do:

As Associate Service Sales Engineer, you will be supporting the sale of Labour & Materials (L&M) labour hours, travel, and materials for service tasks, and the sale/administration of Planned Service Agreements (PSA) for uptime.

Gain exposure to digitalization and retrofit opportunities while working under supervision to help generate quotes, manage opportunities, and engage customers.

How You Will Do It:

Primary Responsibilities (L&M & PSA Focus)

  • L&M sales:

Assist in pricing and selling Labour & Materials for field service tasks, including labour hours, labour rates, travel charges, and materials used. Ensure quotes reflect accurate scoping and margin targets, with engineering support as needed.

  • Quote preparation:

Prepare clear L&M quotations with defined labour, travel, and materials elements; use standard templates and guidance to ensure consistency.

  • PSA sales

Support the promotion and administration of PSA (Planned Service Agreements) for uptime, including quoting, basic proposal development, and coordination with operations and teams.

  • Attaching L&M/PSA:

Work with teams to identify opportunities to include L&M on service jobs or to offer PSA alongside existing services; support strategies to improve attach rates.

  • Customer data collection:

Gather site and equipment data, maintenance history, and usage information to tailor L&M quotes and PSA scopes; maintain accurate records in the CRM.

  • CRM & documentation:

Keep opportunities, quotes, and related documents up to date in the CRM; ensure accuracy and compliance of commercial paperwork.

Secondary Responsibilities (Digitalization & Retrofit)

  • Digitalization support: Assist in promoting digital service offerings (monitoring platforms, connectivity) by collecting customer data and supporting value-based proposals as directed.
  • Retrofit support: Aid in identifying retrofit/upgrade opportunities; coordinate with field/engineering teams for initial scoping and proposal preparation.

Operational & Support Responsibilities

  • Quotation support: Prepare quotes, pricing inquiries, and basic technical proposals under supervision; ensure timely, accurate documentation.
  • Customer engagement: Assist in proactive communication before, during, and after quotes; follow up on AR, PO, TOC, and other commercial documents.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Support regional offices and coordinate with Operations, Procurement, and Engineering to fulfill customer needs; assist with market surveys and competitive analysis as required.
  • Documentation & delivery: Ensure electronic documentation is complete and compliant; support timely parts delivery and service execution planning

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • L&M quotes won and L&M attach rate (percentage of opportunities converting to L&M quotes/sales).
  • PSA revenue, gross margin, and renewal activity (as applicable).
  • L&M/PSA pipeline growth and conversion rate.
  • On-time service delivery and adherence to project timelines.
  • Margin achievement on L&M and PSA engagements.
  • Customer satisfaction and retention metrics.

Relationships

  • Internal: Sales, Operations, Admin, Procurement, Engineering, Regional Offices.
  • External: Customers, Vendors, Contractors, Service Partners.

What We Look For:

  • Qualifications & Experience:

Diploma or Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related) or equivalent.

  • 1–3 years of relevant experience in service sales, maintenance, or related field; experience with L&M stand-alone quotes or service work is a plus.
  • Exposure to industrial sectors (manufacturing, oil & gas, heavy equipment) is beneficial.
  • Familiarity with digital service platforms is advantageous.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Foundational sales aptitude with ability to articulate value-based solutions.
  • Customer-centric, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and able to work independently as well as across functions.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills; proficient with CRM and MS Office.
  • Quick learner, willing to develop expertise in L&M (Labour & Materials) and PSA.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.description:
Job Title: Service Delivery – Application Support and IT Operations for ERPs

Experience: 12+ years in IT Operations and Support.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Solution Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in IT Operations & Application Support and a strong background in handling solution reliability in large IT Operations teams. SRE should drive IT operations process maturity by ensuring the reliability and stability of the IT Operations, proactively identifying and mitigating potential issues to maintain high security, uptime and performance in the IT systems that we are supporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Resiliency: Work with IT application support teams and other stakeholders to ensure the high availability and reliability of IT application portfolio.
  • Proactive Issue Identification: Develop and implement monitoring strategies and tools to identify potential problems before they impact users.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Collaborate with support teams to investigate and diagnose the root causes of failures and (major) incidents to prevent recurrence.
  • Performance Optimization: Analyze system performance and identify areas for improvement to enhance reliability and efficiency of support operations.
  • Solution Design and Implementation: Contribute to the continuous improvement of support solutions to make them more reliable and maintainable.
  • Monitoring: Collaborate with other IT support vendor teams to build proactive monitoring tools and techniques to identify risks.
  • Automation: Identify automation opportunities, collaborate with IT support teams for automation implementation and thus drive productivity and Support Cost efficiencies.
  • Risk Management: Identify and manage risks that can affect the reliability and availability of the solution – and work with support leaders for remediation.
  • Documentation: Collaborate with IT support team to build clear and

job.title: JDE EnterpriseOne CNC Consultant
job.description:
Job Title: JDE EnterpriseOne CNC Consultant Experience: 5+ Years Location: Hybrid/Onsite/Remote (as applicable) Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and motivated JDE EnterpriseOne CNC (Configurable Network Computing) Consultant with 5+ years of hands-on experience in administering, configuring, upgrading, and supporting JD Edwards EnterpriseOne environments. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in CNC architecture, system administration, performance tuning, security management, and deployment activities across development, testing, and production environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, administer, and maintain JD Edwards EnterpriseOne environments.
  • Manage CNC components including Enterprise Server, HTML Server, AIS Server, BSSV, Orchestrator, WebLogic, and Deployment Server.
  • Perform package builds, deployments, ESU installations, and application upgrades.
  • Support JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Tools Release upgrades and platform migrations.
  • Configure and manage user security, role-based security, and environment security.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues related to JDE applications, servers, and databases.
  • Maintain and support integrations involving AIS, Orchestrator, BSSV, and third-party applications.
  • Coordinate and execute backup, recovery, cloning, and disaster recovery activities.
  • Work with infrastructure teams on server management, operating systems, networking, and middleware support.
  • Create and maintain CNC documentation, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with functional consultants, developers, DBAs, and business stakeholders to resolve production issues.
  • Provide on-call support for critical business applications and production incidents.
  • Ensure system compliance with organizational security and audit requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience as a JD Edwards EnterpriseOne CNC Consultant.
  • Strong knowledge of JDE EnterpriseOne architecture and CNC administration.
  • Experience with:Enterprise Server
  • Deployment Server
  • HTML Server
  • AIS Server
  • BSSV Server
  • Orchestrator Studio
  • WebLogic Server

Expertise in package builds, OMW, ESU installation, and software deployments.Experience with Tools Release upgrades and EnterpriseOne application upgrades.Knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows Server administration.Experience with Oracle Database and SQL Server environments.Understanding of networking concepts, load balancing, SSL certificates, and security configurations.Experience with performance tuning, troubleshooting, and system monitoring.Familiarity with cloud-hosted JD Edwards environments (Oracle Cloud, AWS, Azure) is preferred.Functional Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Oracle JD Edwards EnterpriseOne certifications preferred.
  • Experience with DevOps practices, automation scripting (PowerShell, Shell Scripts, Python), and CI/CD processes is a plus.
  • Knowledge of JD Edwards Orchestrator and digital transformation initiatives.

Key Deliverables

  • Stable and high-performing JD Edwards environments.
  • Successful implementation of upgrades, patches, and deployments.
  • Timely incident resolution and root cause analysis.
  • Compliance with security, audit, and governance standards.
  • Accurate technical documentation and knowledge transfer activities.

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Proven experience supporting large-scale JD Edwards EnterpriseOne environments.
  • Strong understanding of CNC best practices and Oracle recommendations.
  • Ability to lead technical discussions and mentor junior CNC resources.
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong ownership and accountability.

Experience Required: 5+ Years Primary Technology: JD Edwards EnterpriseOne CNC Secondary Technologies: Oracle Database, WebLogic, Linux/Unix, Windows Server, AIS, BSSV, Orchestrator, Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure/OCI)

job.title: Baan Functional Consultant
job.description:
Baan Functional Consultant (Open) - Bangalore | 4 to 7 Years

Johnson Controls helps create smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, and this role supports the ERP platforms that keep business operations running smoothly. As a Baan Functional Consultant, you will help business users and support teams maintain stable ERP processes, resolve functional issues, and improve the day-to-day experience across Baan IV and ERP LN environments.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Baan Functional Consultant with hands-on experience in ERP functional support and user issue resolution. In this role, you will work closely with business users, functional teams, and technical teams to analyze issues, support production operations, validate process changes, and help ensure reliable ERP performance across the Baan landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional support for Baan IV, ERP LN FP3, and LN 10.4 ERP applications.
  • Analyze user incidents, identify functional gaps, and support timely resolution with the right teams.
  • Work with business users to clarify process issues, reproduce problems, and confirm expected outcomes.
  • Support production issues, change activities, and functional testing for ERP process updates.
  • Coordinate with technical teams on fixes, enhancements, and interface-related issues.
  • Validate data and process integrity across ERP transactions and support root-cause analysis for recurring issues.
  • Document resolutions, process notes, and functional changes clearly for continuity and knowledge sharing.

How You Will Do It

  • Take ownership of issues end to end, keeping user impact, accountability, safety, and integrity in focus until the process is restored or the right workaround is in place.
  • Stay close to the business process and the people using it so you can understand the real problem, not just the symptom.
  • Use structured analysis and candid root-cause discussion to prevent repeat issues and improve support quality over time.

job.title: HR Technology Analyst – HCM Core Workday
job.description:
What You Will Do

As an HR Technology Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting Workday organizational structure maintenance, HR data governance, and system operations across the organization. You will serve as a strategic partner to HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders by translating business requirements into effective Workday solutions that support operational efficiency and workforce management.

Demonstrating Workday expertise, the HR Technology team partners with HR stakeholders to answer system functionality questions, resolve issues, maintain organizational structures, and ensure data integrity. The Analyst will play a critical role in maintaining Workday organizational data, including supervisory organizations, cost centers, locations, and related business structures while supporting key HR processes and organizational changes.

How You Will Do It

  • Configure and maintain Workday organizational structures, including Supervisory Organizations, Cost Centers, Companies, Locations, Business Sites, and Custom Organizations.
  • Manage organizational changes resulting from restructures, acquisitions, divestitures, leadership transitions, and workforce planning initiatives.
  • Partner with HR, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders to ensure organizational data is accurate, compliant, and aligned with business requirements.
  • Maintain organizational hierarchies and support governance processes related to workforce structure and management.
  • Analyze and validate organizational data to ensure consistency and integrity across Workday.
  • Support HR business processes that rely on accurate organizational assignments and structure maintenance.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Workday organizational management functionality and related business processes.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues related to organizational structures, staffing models, and worker assignments.
  • Lead testing efforts for Workday releases and enhancements, validating organizational structures, security access, and business process functionality.
  • Support security administration to ensure appropriate access to organizational and workforce data.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, governance procedures, and end-user training materials.
  • Participate in Workday enhancement projects, including organizational redesign initiatives and process improvements.
  • Support audits, compliance activities, and data governance initiatives through accurate maintenance of organizational structures.

What We Look For

Required

  • Degree in Business, Human Resources, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working with Human Capital Management systems, preferably Workday.
  • Strong experience supporting and maintaining organizational structures within Workday.
  • Knowledge of workforce structures, organizational design, and HR operational processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into system solutions.
  • Experience partnering with HR, Finance, and business stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong customer service focus and commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Highly Desirable Workday Experience

Workday Organization Management

  • Supervisory Organizations
  • Cost Centers
  • Companies
  • Locations
  • Business Sites
  • Custom Organizations
  • Organizational Hierarchies
  • Reorganizations and Realignments
  • Staffing Model Maintenance
  • Position Management

job.title: HR Technology Analyst II - Workday Reporting
job.description:
What You Will Do

As an HR Technology Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting Workday reporting solutions, analytics initiatives, and data-driven decision-making across the organization. You will serve as a strategic partner to HR Centers of Excellence and business leaders, translating reporting requirements into scalable Workday reporting and dashboard solutions.

Demonstrating Workday expertise, the HR Technology team partners with HR stakeholders to answer reporting-related questions, develop meaningful analytics, ensure data integrity, and provide insights that support workforce planning and business outcomes. The Analyst will lead reporting enhancements, support Workday releases, and identify opportunities to improve data accessibility and reporting efficiency.

How You Will Do It

  • Partner with HR Centers of Excellence, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Payroll, and business leaders to translate reporting needs into actionable Workday reporting solutions.
  • Develop and optimize Advanced, Matrix, Composite, and Trending reports within Workday.
  • Create and maintain calculated fields, report prompts, and data sources to support business reporting requirements.
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across Workday reporting solutions.
  • Analyze workforce trends and HR metrics to identify opportunities, risks, and actionable business insights.
  • Support auditing, compliance, and regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Serve as a reporting subject matter expert during Workday implementations, enhancements, and biannual releases.
  • Lead testing efforts for Workday upgrades, ensuring reporting functionality, calculated fields, integrations, and dashboards perform as expected.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve data accessibility and streamline reporting processes.
  • Develop documentation, training materials, and reporting best practices for HR and business stakeholders.
  • Support security configuration and reporting access to ensure appropriate governance and compliance standards are maintained.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to automate reporting processes and improve operational efficiency.

What We Look For

Required

  • Degree in Business, Human Resources, Information Systems, Analytics, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working with Human Capital Management systems, preferably Workday.
  • Strong experience developing and supporting Workday reports and dashboards.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to transform data into meaningful business insights.
  • Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into reporting solutions.
  • Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to data quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Highly Desirable Workday Experience

  • Workday Reporting

Advanced Reports

  • Matrix Reports
  • Composite Reports
  • Trending Reports
  • Discovery Boards
  • Dashboards
  • Calculated Fields
  • Reporting Security

job.title: Deputy Project Manager
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Job Description: Deputy Project Manager - CFS (IBMS)

Position: Deputy Project Manager - CFS (IBMS) Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat Employment Type: On-Roll (Full-Time) Department: Projects - Controls & Fire Security (CFS) / IBMS Experience: 8-12 Years

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Deputy Project Manager - CFS (IBMS) to manage the execution and delivery of Integrated Building Management System (IBMS) projects. The role involves project planning, site execution, stakeholder coordination, team management, cost control, and ensuring successful project completion within budget, timelines, and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist the Project Manager in end-to-end execution of IBMS and CFS projects.
  • Manage project activities related to BMS, CCTV, Access Control, Fire Alarm, PA System, and other ELV systems.
  • Develop project schedules, resource plans, and execution strategies.
  • Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor project progress and ensure timely achievement of project milestones.
  • Drive installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities.
  • Ensure project profitability through effective cost monitoring and resource utilization.
  • Review technical drawings, BOQs, specifications, and project documentation.
  • Manage subcontractors and site teams to ensure quality project execution.
  • Ensure compliance with EHS guidelines, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
  • Support project billing, variation orders, claim management, and collections.

Role: Safety Engineer - IBMS (Contractual)

Position: Safety Engineer - IBMS (Contractual) Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra Department: Projects - IBMS / CFS (CCTV, Access Control Systems) Experience: 3-8 Years Employment Type: Contractual

Role Summary

We are seeking a dedicated and proactive Safety Engineer to oversee EHS compliance and safety management for IBMS projects involving CCTV, Access Control Systems (ACS), BMS, and ELV installations. The incumbent will be responsible for implementing safety procedures, conducting audits, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering a strong safety culture across project sites.

  • Ensure compliance with company EHS policies, client safety requirements, and statutory regulations.

  • Maintain safety records, reports, compliance documentation, and audit findings.
  • Coordinate with project managers, customers, and contractors on EHS matters.
  • Support emergency preparedness and response activities at project locations.

Educational Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Engineering.
  • Diploma/Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety, Fire & Safety, or equivalent certification.
  • NEBOSH, IOSH, or other recognized safety certifications will be preferred.

Experience Requirements

  • 3-8 years of experience in safety management for construction, MEP, ELV, IBMS, or electrical projects.
  • Experience in handling safety requirements for CCTV, Access Control, Fire Alarm, BMS, and related ELV installations.
  • Familiarity with client safety standards and statutory compliance requirements.

Technical Skills

  • EHS Management Systems

  • Electrical Safety
  • Work-at-Height Safety

  • Safety Audits & Inspections
  • Contractor Safety Management
  • Documentation & Compliance Reporting

  • Strong observation and analytical skills.
  • Good report-writing and documentation abilities.
  • Ability to work independently at project sites.
