job.title: Compliance Data Analytics, Monitoring, and AI Co-ordinator
job.description:
What you will do

#

Johnson Controls (the "Company") is seeking an experienced data analytics, AI, and digital professional to serve as Coordinator, Compliance Data Analytics, Monitoring and AI. This role will support the execution and delivery of the Ethics and Compliance (E&C) function's data analytics, monitoring, AI, and digital strategy.

The primary objective of the role is to strengthen the Company's ability to prevent and detect compliance risks by turning data into insight. The role will help the E&C function identify emerging risks earlier, respond to them faster, and reduce the likelihood and severity of issues that could negatively impact the Company. Collectively, this role supports a more proactive, resilient, and data-driven compliance program.

This person will work closely with the compliance team and other stakeholders, and will report to the Associate Director, Integrity Helpline and Compliance Digital Projects and have a dotted line reporting to the Compliance Director, India.

What you will do

  • Supporting the development and operation of the Ethics and Compliance (E&C) data analytics and monitoring program, including identifying and collecting relevant data, developing customer and supplier transaction analytics, and developing automated anomaly detection to identify fraud, waste, and abuse
  • Developing analytics and tools that consolidate and analyze E&C data to identify emerging risks and provide insights and context to the E&C team and other stakeholders
  • Designing, building, deploying, maintaining, and continuously improving Copilot Studio AI agents that support employees with compliance topics, and inform and strengthen the E&C program
  • Developing and implementing agentic AI solutions to automate recurring E&C tasks and processes
  • Building and analyzing Power BI dashboards and reports to surface risk trends, insights, and program performance for the E&C team and business leaders
  • Maintaining the E&C program's key performance indicators and Bowler charts, and supporting the consolidation and automation of E&C reporting
  • Collaborating with E&C, IT, and other stakeholders to understand needs, obtain the data and tools required to deliver initiatives, and stay current with the latest technological developments

What we look for:

Candidates for this role must possess the following:

  • 10 years or more of related experience in data analytics and monitoring, AI/automation, and digital solution delivery, preferably in a multi-national corporation.
  • Proficiency with the Microsoft Power Platform (including Copilot Studio).
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required.
  • Proficiency in data visualization, data governance and experience working with enterprise data sources (such as SAP, Oracle, or Snowflake) is preferred.
  • Knowledge or experience working with Ethics and Compliance is an advantage.

The candidate must also demonstrate the following personal qualities:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, translating business and compliance needs into practical, scalable solutions.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • The ability to lead and deliver solutions end-to-end, and to independently manage projects and initiatives from concept through delivery.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to work in a matrixed, multicultural, and international environment.

Johnson Controls is a global diversified technology and multi industrial leader, serving a wide range of customers in more than 150 countries. Among our core values we rank Integrity First, and our commitment to sustainability dates back to our roots in 1885 with the invention of the first electric room thermostat. We are committed to helping our customers win and creating greater value for all of our stakeholders through strategic focus on our buildings and energy growth platforms.

job.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Digital Solutions Development
job.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a modern, hands-on Engineering Manager who can lead high-performing software engineering teams in an increasingly AI-enabled development environment. This role extends beyond traditional people management and requires a strong blend of technical leadership, customer engagement, architectural guidance, and engineering execution.

The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise, remain closely connected to hands-on development, and leverage AI-assisted development practices to accelerate innovation, improve productivity, and deliver customer-centric solutions at speed.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical direction and architectural guidance for enterprise software products and platforms.
  • Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to engineering best practices, security standards, and design principles.
  • Guide teams on application architecture, design patterns, and technology selection.
  • Troubleshoot and support resolution of complex technical issues when required.
  • Drive adoption of modern software engineering methodologies and AI-assisted development practices.

Engineering Delivery

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of software features and enhancements.
  • Accelerate product delivery through automation, developer productivity tools, and AI-enabled engineering workflows.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Engage directly with customers, business stakeholders, and product management teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Develop rapid prototypes and proof-of-concepts to validate ideas and demonstrate product capabilities.
  • Present technical solutions, product demonstrations, and roadmap updates to internal and external stakeholders

Team Leadership

  • Build, mentor, and develop engineering talent.
  • Establish a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration, and innovation.
  • Coach engineers on technical growth, modern development practices, and problem-solving approaches.
  • Support performance management, succession planning, and team development initiatives

AI-First Engineering Culture

  • Champion the adoption of AI-assisted software development tools and practices.
  • Identify opportunities to automate routine engineering tasks and improve delivery efficiency.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and incorporate them into engineering strategies where appropriate.

TECH STACK

Angular 17+ | .NET 8 / C# | Azure | SQL Server / PostgreSQL

REST / GraphQL APIs | GitHub Actions / CI-CD | AI Dev Tools | Docker / Kubernetes

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with progressive leadership responsibilities.
  • Proven experience leading software development teams in enterprise environments.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in modern web application development.
  • Experience managing full software development lifecycle activities
  • Strong expertise in Angular for front-end application development.
  • Strong understanding of modern web architecture and design patterns.
  • Experience conducting code reviews and mentoring development teams.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with cloud-native and scalable application architectures.
  • Experience with .NET / ASP.NET Core application development.
  • Experience building enterprise SaaS products and digital platforms.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering productivity platforms.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and deployment pipelines.
  • Knowledge of containerization and cloud platforms (Azure preferred).

Desired Leadership Competencies

  • Technical credibility with engineering teams.
  • Customer-focused mindset.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with execution.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Innovation mindset with a passion for continuous learning.
  • Ability to drive change and adopt emerging technologies.

Additional Evaluation Criteria

Candidates demonstrating the following will be strongly preferred:

  • Active GitHub profile showcasing personal projects or technical contributions.
  • Open-source community participation.
  • Stack Overflow contributions or technical thought leadership.
  • Technical blogs, conference speaking engagements, or community involvement.
  • Evidence of continuous learning and experimentation with emerging AI technologies.

job.title: Technician - Chiller
job.description:
Shape the Future of Smart Buildings with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls (JCI), we're transforming the way the world uses energy. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help customers improve efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, and create resilient environments across industries including healthcare, data centres, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and education.

With more than 140 years of innovation and industry expertise, Johnson Controls continues to deliver market-leading solutions backed by cutting-edge technology, world-class service, and a strong commitment to our people.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

If you're looking for more than just a job, this is an opportunity to build a long-term career with an industry leader.

You'll enjoy:

  • Competitive salary package with overtime and RDO opportunities
  • Work-life balance and flexible working arrangements
  • Ongoing technical and professional development training
  • Exposure to leading HVAC and chiller technologies
  • Career progression opportunities across Service, Projects, BMS, Sales, and Leadership pathways
  • Supportive team environment backed by a national service network
  • Employee referral rewards program
  • Access to world-class products, tools, and technical support

About the Opportunity

Due to continued growth across Queensland, we're looking for an experienced Chiller Technician to join our Brisbane Service Team.

This role offers the chance to work on a diverse range of commercial and industrial sites, providing technical expertise across some of Australia's most advanced HVAC and chiller systems. You'll enjoy a high level of autonomy while being supported by an experienced team committed to your success.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Responding to emergency breakdowns and performing planned preventative maintenance
  • Commissioning chillers and HVAC equipment across customer sites
  • Diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex system issues
  • Conducting overhauls and fault-finding on reciprocating, screw, and centrifugal chillers
  • Completing service documentation and technical reports accurately
  • Building strong relationships with customers and providing expert technical advice
  • Supporting customers with operational guidance and system optimisation

About You

We're looking for a skilled technician who enjoys problem-solving, takes pride in delivering excellent customer service, and wants to continue growing their career.

You will have:

  • 4+ years' experience servicing HVAC, chiller, or industrial cooling systems
  • Strong maintenance, repair, and fault-finding capabilities
  • Mechanical and/or electrical trade expertise within HVAC
  • Ability to read technical drawings and schematics
  • Strong communication and reporting skills
  • Current Australian driver's licence
  • Ability to successfully complete pre-employment medical and background checks

Our Culture

At Johnson Controls, we believe our people are our greatest strength. Across our Australian branch network, we foster an inclusive, collaborative, and supportive culture where employees are encouraged to develop their skills, share ideas, and build rewarding careers.

Whether you're looking to deepen your technical expertise or take the next step toward leadership, we'll provide the support and opportunities to help you achieve your goals.

Ready for Your Next Challenge?

Join a global organisation that invests in its people, values innovation, and is helping shape the future of smart and sustainable infrastructure.

Apply today and take your career to the next level with Johnson Controls.

Applicants must have the right to work in Australia. Pre-employment medical, criminal history, and drug and alcohol screening will apply.

job.title: Field Service engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a dedicated Safety Officer to oversee and implement Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) practices for service and maintenance activities related to Controls, Fire Alarm Systems, Security Systems, Access Control, CCTV, and Building Management Systems (BMS). The role involves ensuring compliance with safety regulations, conducting risk assessments, and promoting a strong safety culture across service operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure compliance with company HSE policies, client safety standards, and statutory regulations.
  • Conduct site safety inspections, audits, risk assessments, and hazard identification activities.
  • Monitor service and maintenance activities involving fire, security, controls, and automation systems.
  • Prepare Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Method Statements (MS), and Risk Assessment (RA) documentation.
  • Conduct safety inductions, toolbox talks, and awareness training for service engineers and subcontractors.
  • Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all project and service sites.
  • Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, and implement corrective actions.
  • Coordinate permit-to-work (PTW) activities, including hot work, work at height, electrical work, and confined space entries.
  • Maintain HSE records, reports, inspection checklists, and compliance documentation.
  • Monitor contractor and vendor safety performance during service activities.
  • Support emergency preparedness, evacuation drills, and fire safety programs.
  • Liaise with customers, site management, and regulatory authorities on safety-related matters.

job.title: EHS/Safety Officer
job.description:
ob Summary

We are looking for a dedicated Safety Officer to oversee and implement Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) practices for service and maintenance activities related to Controls, Fire Alarm Systems, Security Systems, Access Control, CCTV, and Building Management Systems (BMS). The role involves ensuring compliance with safety regulations, conducting risk assessments, and promoting a strong safety culture across service operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure compliance with company HSE policies, client safety standards, and statutory regulations.
  • Conduct site safety inspections, audits, risk assessments, and hazard identification activities.
  • Monitor service and maintenance activities involving fire, security, controls, and automation systems.
  • Prepare Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Method Statements (MS), and Risk Assessment (RA) documentation.
  • Conduct safety inductions, toolbox talks, and awareness training for service engineers and subcontractors.
  • Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at all project and service sites.
  • Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, and implement corrective actions.
  • Coordinate permit-to-work (PTW) activities, including hot work, work at height, electrical work, and confined space entries.
  • Maintain HSE records, reports, inspection checklists, and compliance documentation.
  • Monitor contractor and vendor safety performance during service activities.
  • Support emergency preparedness, evacuation drills, and fire safety programs.
  • Liaise with customers, site management, and regulatory authorities on safety-related matters.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Safety Management, Occupational Health & Safety, or related field.
  • Safety certifications such as:

NEBOSH IGC (Preferred)

  • IOSH Managing Safely
  • OSHA Certification
  • Industrial Safety Diploma

Experience & Skills

  • Minimum 4 to 6 years of experience in HSE management for Service, Maintenance, ELV, Fire & Security, Controls, or MEP environments.
  • Strong knowledge of:

Fire Alarm Systems (FAS)

  • CCTV & Access Control Systems
  • Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • Electrical Safety Standards
  • Permit-to-Work Systems
  • Work-at-Height and Hot Work Safety

Familiarity with local safety regulations and client-specific HSE requirements.

Excellent communication, training, and incident investigation skills.

Proficiency in MS Office and HSE reporting tools

job.title: Services Team Manager - BMS
job.description:
Johnson Controls is a global diversified technology and multi-industrial leader serving a wide range of customers in more than 150 countries. Our 135,000 employees create intelligent buildings, efficient energy solutions, integrated infrastructure and next generation transportation systems that work seamlessly together to deliver on the promise of smart cities and communities. Our commitment to sustainability dates back to our roots in 1885, with the invention of the first electric room thermostat. We are committed to helping our customers win and creating greater value for all of our stakeholders through strategic focus on our buildings and energy growth platforms.

Being a Global company, you will work with some of the best people in the industry. This role will offer you autonomy and flexibility to make it your own and provide a pathway for a long-term career JCI career.

  • Global company with strong systems and support
  • Permanent full-time opportunity
  • Base + super + car allowance + incentive

About the role

This role will develop and manage the Service business in both recurring (Preventative Service Agreement) and non-recurring (Labour & Material) revenue streams to achieve a designated financial plan and develop profitable business with new and existing customers.

You will look after:

  • Service: Lead, drive and cascade service objectives to our customers and team members in line with our values, approach and required methodologies. PSA and L&M contractual objectives & operational excellence is to be delivered at all times, with ownership and accountability for the service teams operational excellence outcomes.
  • Customers: Service existing and potential customers to ensure that the company’s products and services outcomes continue to meet the customer & business requirements, whilst gathering information regarding future opportunities. Proactively implement processes to ensure client relationships are maintained, managed and developed. Act professionally at all times and take complete ownership of client relationships, engagement and satisfaction.
  • Growth: Support the management team with the formulation and execution of Service growth strategies.
  • Mentoring/Guidance: Mentor, influence and co-ordinate the service team, including but not limited to sales, technicians, team leaders, coordinators and admin resources to ensure alignment and delivery of service to ensure growth and profitability.
  • Account Management: Implement, maintain and develop account management strategies, to target specific industries and markets, based on current and future business requirements. Review, negotiate and support business contract management activities.

About you

  • Preferred to have a strong knowledge of BAS/BMS with Engineering or Technical qualification
  • Performs all business activities with integrity and the highest ethical standards
  • Experience in developing successful relationships with customers and delivering results
  • Outstanding written, verbal communication and soft skills
  • Excellent networking skills, business minded, change orientated and is proactive
  • Has a strong established network in the local market
  • Focuses on customers, consultative approach and solution focused
  • Strong commercial acumen

Only applicants who have a current right to work in Australia will be considered.

job.title: AI Application Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: AI Application Engineer

Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking AI Application Modernization Engineer to join our Digital Transformation team. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer with deep expertise in legacy application modernization, AI-assisted software development, and Microsoft cloud technologies.

As AI Application Modernization Engineer, you will lead the transformation of mission-critical business applications built on VB6 front-end technologies and IBM i (AS400) platforms, including Synon, RPG, RPGLE, and CLP. You will leverage AI and Generative AI technologies to accelerate code conversion, application modernization, testing, documentation, and deployment to modern Microsoft platforms.

You will play a critical role in reducing technical debt, improving application maintainability, and accelerating JCI's digital transformation strategy through scalable, cloud-ready solutions.

How you will do it

AI-Powered Application Modernization

  • Hands on application development to modernization of legacy applications built using VB6, Synon, RPG, RPGLE, CLP, and IBM i (AS400) technologies.
  • Utilize Generative AI, GitHub Copilot, Azure OpenAI, and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate code analysis, conversion, testing, and documentation.
  • Design and execute migration strategies from legacy platforms to modern Microsoft technologies.
  • Develop reusable modernization frameworks, patterns, and best practices for enterprise-scale application transformation.

Microsoft Development & Cloud Engineering

  • Design and develop modern business applications using Microsoft technologies including C#, .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core, and .NET MAUI.
  • Modernize desktop applications into cloud-enabled and cross-platform solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem.
  • Design API-first architectures and service-based integrations using Azure services.
  • Collaborate with enterprise architects, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to deliver secure and scalable solutions.

AI Strategy & Engineering Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and Generative AI to improve software engineering productivity and modernization outcomes.
  • Lead proof-of-concepts and pilots demonstrating AI-driven modernization capabilities.
  • Establish engineering standards, governance, and best practices for AI-assisted application development.
  • Mentor development teams on modernization approaches, AI tools, and Microsoft development platforms.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of software development experience.
  • 5+ years of experience with VB6 application development and maintenance.
  • Proven experience modernizing legacy applications to Microsoft technologies.
  • Experience delivering large-scale application modernization or migration programs.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted software development tools and Generative AI technologies.
  • Experience working with enterprise business-critical applications and complex integrations.

Technical Expertise

Front-End Technologies - Visual Basic 6 (VB6), C#, .NET Framework, .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, WinUI, WPF, XAML, HTML5, JavaScript

Back-End Technologies

Synon (CA 2E), RPG, RPGLE, CLP, IBM i / AS400, DB2, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, API Development

AI & Modernization Technologies

Azure OpenAI, GitHub Copilot Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, AI-assisted code conversion tools, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Cloud & DevOps

Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Power Platform, CI/CD Pipelines

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience converting VB6 applications to .NET MAUI, WinUI, or modern Microsoft technologies.
  • Experience modernizing Synon, RPG, RPGLE, or AS400 applications.
  • Experience with Azure-based application modernization programs.
  • Knowledge of enterprise architecture, application rationalization, and technical debt reduction strategies.
  • Experience within manufacturing, industrial, or enterprise ERP environments.
  • Microsoft Azure certifications preferred.

Ideal Candidate: An engineer who has successfully delivered VB6 and AS400 modernization programs and has leveraged AI technologies to accelerate application conversion to modern Microsoft platforms such as .NET, MAUI, Azure, and Power Platform.

job.title: Baan Functional Consultant
job.description:
Job Title: Baan - Sales & Distribution Consultant

Experience: 5+ years in Order Management, Procurement and Inventory Management modules in Baan IV, ERP LN FP3 and LN 10.4 ERP versions.

Job Description: We are seeking a Baan Sales & Distribution Specialist to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have extensive functional experience in implementing and supporting Baan Order Management, Procurement and Inventory Management module. Candidate should have experience in Baan IV, ERP LN FP3 and LN 10.4 ERP versions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Application Support: Leading Production support for Baan Order Management, Procurement and Inventory Management module. Identifying and resolving complex issues while providing support to end users on Baan ERP applications. Provide support third-party interfaces and ensure data integrity.
  • Troubleshooting: Identifying and resolving issues related to Order Management, Procurement and Inventory Management modules. Identify root causes of problems and implement effective solutions.
  • User support: Providing technical support to end users on Baan ERP applications, addressing queries and resolving issues.
  • Training: Developing and delivering training materials and sessions for end-users on Order Management, Procurement and Inventory Management modules.
  • Knowledge Management: Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation of system configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures. Contribute to the development and maintenance of a knowledge base for easy access to information.
  • Collaboration: Collaborating with clients, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth application management.
  • Data Analysis: Develop simple to medium complexity SQL scripts to extract ERP data for analysis.
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities for improvement in application performance, processes, and user experience. Participate in the development and implementation of new enhancements.
  • Business Requirements Analysis: Understanding client's business processes and identifying areas for improvement using Order Management, Procurement and Inventory Management modules. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and document business requirements.
  • Data Migration: Develop Source to Target ERP mappings from or to Order Management, Procurement and Inventory Management modules.
  • Mentoring: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Information Technology, or a Master’s Degree in Business Administration.
  • 5+ years of experience working with Baan ERP (Baan IV, ERP LN FP3 and LN 10.4 ERP versions) Order Management, Procurement and Inventory Management modules.
  • Strong understanding of Order Management, Procurement and Inventory Management modules.
  • Knowledgeable in Business requirement analysis, Gap identification, Solution proposals and Design development.
  • Proficient in ERP data analysis using SQL tools.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with functional teams and business users.
  • Experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experienced with SDLC/Agile methodologies and project management tools.

job.description:
Job Description

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for BMS Controls & CPM System India projects as per vertical specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Controls System (HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, PHE, Fire, Plant room system, and Third-party device integrations etc.)
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable & Cable Tray Type and Length Calculations related to Controls & CPM System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidence.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Controls System (HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing system, PHE, Fire system, Plant room system, third party systems etc.)
  • Expertise in Controls system (BMS & CPM) Sequence of operation.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.).
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACnet, Modbus, OPC, and other protocols.
  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.
  • Certifications on renowned PLCs and DDCs.
  • Presales knowledge of the Security and Fire Alarm system will have added advantages

Preferred

5 + years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System’s Desing and Estimation.

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Security System APAC projects as per country specific standards. Depth knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Security System (Access, Video, Intrusion , Complete ELV system etc)
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Security System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Perform Peer level Quality checks.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Security Systems (Access, Video, Intrusion , Complete ELV system etc)
  • Expertise in Security Guidelines.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.), Blue Beam & GroundPlan
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like Wiegand, OSDP and other protocols.
  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.
  • Data Center Security solutions’ experience is highly preferred.

Preferred

8+ years of relevant experience in Enterprise Level Security System.

job.title: Post-Sales Controls Systems Eng Mgr 1
job.description:
Engineering Manager - Controls

What you will do

The Engineering Manager is accountable for leading Building Automation System (BAS) engineering delivery across global projects, ensuring adherence to country‑specific standards, quality benchmarks, and on‑time execution. The role oversees hardware, software, and graphics engineering streams, managing a team of 30–50 engineers in collaboration with delivery managers. The position requires strong leadership, operational discipline, and a continuous improvement mindset.

How you will do it

  • Own regional KPIs with delivery managers and ensure consistent achievement of business targets.
  • Analyze regional performance and refine organizational design to support evolving business needs.
  • Manage account receivables and uphold financial discipline across the region.
  • Strengthen stakeholder relationships with JC branches, customers, and GCE teams to enable smooth business operations.
  • Build customer trust to support business growth and repeat engagements.
  • Allocate engineering capacity across delivery teams to meet project priorities and regional demands.
  • Maintain team competence across hardware, software, and graphics engineering streams.
  • Lead operational reviews and ensure governance, quality checks, and compliance with all deliveries.
  • Drive project reviews to ensure defect‑free, on‑time, and high‑quality engineering output.
  • Implement continuous improvement using LEAN principles to enhance productivity, reduce waste, and streamline workflows.
  • Develop team capabilities through structured learning, coaching, and skill‑building.
  • Manage performance with clear goals, continuous feedback, and measurable outcomes.
  • Mentor team members to achieve competency targets and align with organizational expectations.
  • Drive innovation, automation, and best‑practice adoption across engineering workflows.
  • Enable proactive problem‑solving and encourage LEAN‑driven improvements across all engineering streams.

What we look for

  • BE/ME in Instrumentation, Electrical, Electronics, or E&C, with strong fundamentals in controls engineering.
  • Understanding of BAS/BMS architecture including operator workstations, supervisory controllers, DDCs, sensors, actuators, and system integration.
  • Strong HVAC knowledge across CHW plants, cooling towers, pumping systems, AHUs, FCUs, VAVs, and related control strategies.
  • Experience delivering HVAC/BMS/industrial automation projects for pharma, airports, commercial buildings, hospitals, or similar infrastructure.
  • Ability to drive KPIs and operational performance across regional engineering teams.
  • Capability in resource planning, workload balancing, and optimizing engineering capacity.
  • Experience in quality governance, project reviews, and ensuring defect‑free, on‑time engineering delivery.
  • LEAN mindset with demonstrated ability to reduce waste, streamline workflows, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Strong people leadership — mentoring, coaching, performance management, and competency development.
  • Ability to build high‑performance teams through accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Excellent communication skills for cross‑functional coordination and customer interactions.

Preferred

12–18 years of experience in Building Automation Systems / BMS Design Engineering, including multi‑disciplinary team management.

  • Ensure, maintain and enhance a good and healthy relationship with Clients and all stakeholders
  • In collaboration with the Engineering, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Logistics, Sales & Commercial, Global Products teams, drives the operational & functional excellence with capabilities building to achieve business goals & targets.

How you will do it:

  • Drive project financial performance and reviews including Revenue, GM, Backlog, UBR, AR and VOs
  • Develop and manage detailed project schedules and work plans and track project performance, deliverables and costs to meet project milestones and budgets.
  • Project Team leader to lead, coach, manage effectively with team members
  • Develop Cash flow planning & control
  • Develop and manage tiered processes from proposal through project turnover to optimize schedule, scope, and cost to maximize customer success and the company’s profitability
  • Direct projects Risk and Opportunity reviews / assess risk and opportunity management outcomes
  • Device activity and resource planning
  • Perform risk management to minimize project risk and report/escalate to Management as needed with appropriate contingence resolution
  • Ensure projects operation financial KPIs are monitored and tracked
  • Champion continuous improvement efforts on project operation process, e.g., project closing process, transition process, urgent purchase process
  • Responsible for overall contracting strategies and execution which includes tender & bid evaluations, site progress, budgeting, scheduling, and project completion according to the established timelines
  • Support in pre-sales scoping, deliverables and cost effectiveness with sales, procurement and control manager
  • Manage business and project risks, perform project controls including cost and schedule control, progress monitoring and evaluation
  • Knowledge of Fire code of practice, sprinkler & piping design, Fire alarm system
  • Knowledge of JC Tyco products
  • Review projects to determine the VO opportunities, set up annual VO plan to increase project revenue and earning
  • Provide resolution of escalated project management/ installation and service issues with customers and other stakeholders

What we look for:

  • University degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. Another advanced degree required, additional technical degree preferred
  • Strong knowledge of Project Management with minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Fire industry operations and maintenance
  • Proven track record in delivering the strong results with strong accountability and say/do
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both internally and dealing with external customers and stakeholders

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment

job.description:
Who we are

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What you will do:

Oversees activity to ensure that project is completed in accordance with scope, budget, codes, and schedule as bound by contract. Delegates tasks to execute and fully complete assigned projects. Coordinates communication with customer during all phases of the project. Coordinates the work of subcontractors

How you will do it:

  • Define scope, budget and schedule for projects
  • Device project implementation methodology
  • Plan and oversee work schedule for the multiple small to medium scale project under responsibility, in coordination with supervisor.
  • Identify potential project risks and recommend appropriate resolutions
  • Establish effective communication with customer
  • Track and update progress, task and project health to supervisors

  • Hand over project to customer and later to service team.

  • Competent in Chiller Plant and airside replacement.

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Qlty Analyst II
job.description:
Job Title : Quality Analyst II

Objective: Looking for a career in the Quality and production filed with a progressive organization that gives scope to apply knowledge and skill with continuous learning and to be a part of a team that Dynamically. work towards growth and to achieve goal of the organization.

Key Responsibilities:  Operational Activities:  Inspect all inward–in–process material and clear GRN on time.  To Handle Inspection activity with proper Execution method, Incoming inspection + In process & and inspection at supplier end.  Very strong knowledge of Fabrication activity and inspection at the supplier end as well In-house.  Perform NDT inspections and evaluate NDT technologies and systems to detect, measure, and monitor deterioration mechanisms.  Very strong conversant with NDT method Level II - (PT,RT,UT,MPT)  Identify and evaluate inspection and NDT technologies for supporting operating facilities and capital projects.  To provide technical expertise on all NDT matters as required on projects.  Assist and support the NDT Co-ordinator or the project teams on all NDT matters.  Prepare NDT procedures for the assigned project.  Review clients' specifications and scopes of work, examine pipe metallurgy and prepare detailed NDT procedures to achieve maximum productivity in accordance with specified quality.  Review subcontractors' tender documents and technical qualifications.  Assist QHSE Department on subcontractor assessments/audits.  Review and approve subcontractors' NDT submissions.  Ensure that records are maintained for all NDT activities to demonstrate achievement of client requirements.  Maintain departmental project NDT files so that information is readily available to other department members.  Manage the Inspection activity as per suitability & and connivance for smooth operation & and co-ordinate with production department to achieve production target.  Review and study customer specifications to verify inspection and testing requirements. And accordingly preparation of Quality Assurance plan for customer.  Study the drawings, Quality plan and accordingly carry out in-process as well as overall visual, dimensional inspection (including weld joints).  Prepare welding procedure specifications & carrying out procedure qualifications in accordance with ASME Sec-IX, ASME Sec-VIII Div.1, ASME Sec-II A,B,C and customer specifications for various welding process like; GTAW,MIG,etc for various grade of stainless steels, alloy steels & carbon steels for groove & overlay welding.  Prepare qualification of PQRs & mock ups (TTP) welding.  Carry out visual inspection of welding during fabrication and monitor the welding activities on shop to ensure correct welding procedure is followed as per Weld plan with qualified welder and information with welding machines are duly calibrated. (the right machine is being used).  Inward / Raw material/ Consumables inspection:- review of material test certificates with respect to standard / technical specification & Purchase order and discrepancies to be communicated to concerned departments for resolution.  Based on Engineer drawing, function of job & aesthetic condition takes decision of material (Accept / Reject or Rework)  Day to day production activity continuously follow up with Production dept.  Maintain records of testing, information, and various metrics such as number of defective products per day etc.  For Any rejection and rework of material co-ordinate with store, purchase and production department.  Any supplier material issue discussed with supplier and purchase department and store.  To insure Incoming, outgoing & in process Quality of product as per global norms.  Tracking of material BOQ with Planning Team with proper schedule, Inspect Incoming material MIR.  Check the Certificate as per drawing / material MOC & verification as per ASME code and standards.  Having documentation on capabilities and maintaining the same at office.  Prepare and maintained project documentation as per client specification.  Monthly Incoming rejection + In process rejection status reports submitted to internal team and find out root cause analysis.  Issue Nonconformance note to production department as well as supplier for Root cause analysis against poor workmanship.  Close co-ordination with shop floor team members, and Engineering departments.  Prepare and submit reports to the quality manager.  Actively Involved in Suggestion and Improvement project at shop floor.  In process Inspection checked as per P &ID and GA drawing.  Shop floor Surprise Audit needs to be conducted to check process integrity.  Conduct Inspection with TPI agency as well as customer.  Make project documentation and keep records as per system requirement.  Actively Participation on Vendor development for localization of component and SOA. Authorities:  Acceptance and Rejection against rework During Incoming Inspection  Passed or hold the job as per quality norms.  Maintain Quality culture at shop floor .  Education:  Graduate – B.E Mechanical ( 5 ~ 7 years of Experience)  Competence:  Awareness of ISO 9001: 2015 / EMS 14001:2015 & OHSMS 45001:2018  Strong Knowledge of NDT and ASME Section V fabrication code requirements.  Sound Knowledge of Fabrication Inspection and Welding activity  Previous experience as a QA engineer.  Managerial experience preferred.  High-level analytical skills.

job.title: Category Manager, Procurement
job.description:
Category Manager

Who we are?

Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we’ve been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since. Today, we offer the world’s largest portfolio of building products, technologies, software, and services; we put that portfolio to work to transform the environments where people live, work, learn and play.

This is where Johnson Controls comes in, helping drive the outcomes that matter most. Through a full range of systems and digital solutions, we make your buildings smarter. A smarter building is safer, more comfortable, more efficient, and, ultimately, more sustainable. Most important, smarter buildings let you focus more intensely on your unique mission. Better for your people. Better for your bottom line. Better for the planet. We’re helping to create a healthy planet with solutions that decrease energy use, reduce waste and make carbon neutrality a reality. Sustainability is a top priority for our company.

We committed to invest 75 percent of new product development R&D in climate-related innovation to develop sustainable products and services. We take sustainability seriously. Achieving net zero carbon emissions before 2040 is just one of our commitments to making the world a better place.

Please visit and follow Johnson Controls LinkedIn for recent exciting activities.

Why JCI: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg)

Asia-Pacific LinkedIn: [https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feedView=all](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feedView=all)

Career: [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue: [This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

As a part of the Johnson Controls, this Sr. Category Manager role is a member of the Global Category Management team. This team is responsible for partnering with key stakeholders across all JCI plants to develop global sourcing strategies for all key categories, establish a best-in-class global sourcing footprint, act as a Center of Excellence for their respective categories, actively support the business in new product development and help plants to meet their business objectives.

The Category Manager is an advanced purchasing role that reports directly to a Director of Category Management. This strategic role works on a team with a purpose to assure strategic commodities alignment across functions of the business. As a member of this team, you will work within a dynamic environment that provides a high-level of exposure and influence.

As a Category Manager you will manage the micro category portion of overall spend budget and associated savings. You will develop, communicate, and implement comprehensive category strategies.

As a Category Manager you handle ambiguity well, can make decisions without all the data, can shift gears comfortably and can effectively cope with change. You believe that the best work is done in teams – you’re seen as a cooperative peer, candid yet fair. You can manage multiple priorities simultaneously because of your excellent planning, organization, and time management skills. You are intellectually curious – driving continual learning for you and your team. You’re also interpersonally curious – understanding that internal and external collaboration fuels improvement and best practice.

How you will do it…

  • Responsible for developing detailed global category strategies. Categories will typically be high spend and will impact multiple product business units/regions and may also be highly technical in nature.
  • Ensure alignment of category strategies to business requirements and objectives
  • Lead KBS (Knowledge-based Sourcing) team for assigned categories driving best product, process and footprint. Optimize supply base composition globally.
  • Conduct supplier contract negotiation, supplier selection and contract lifecycle management
  • Act as a center of excellence for the respective categories through complete understanding of industry, competition, future technologies, and innovations etc.
  • Responsible for overall continuity of supply and active risk mitigation. Work with plants to resolve quality, delivery, capacity, and other issues as required.
  • Support make vs buy decisions
  • Meet or exceed profit plan goals related to categories: cost savings, raw material economics, quality, supplier rationalization, LCC % content and other agreed objectives
  • Lead monthly or quarterly category reviews with dotted line global category team across the plants and regions.

What you will need…

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree preferred.
  • Min. 5-8 years in HVAC, engineering, large manufacturing, or multi-industry global organization
  • Min. 2 years of experience in a strategic sourcing role
  • Very strong negotiation skills
  • Capability to interface with senior leadership across regions both internally & externally
  • In depth understanding of purchasing tools and practices
  • Strong MS Office skills
  • Strong costing and analytical skills
  • Working knowledge of SAP or other equivalent ERP systems
  • Fluent in English will be a plus.
  • Travel up to 30%, global and domestic

Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate.  Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

job.title: Oracle Fusion Technical Analyst
job.description:
Job Title: Oracle Fusion Technical Analyst

Location: Bangalore Experience: 5 + yrs

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Technical Consultant with a good understanding of Oracle Projects Portfolio Management functional process or Order to Cash flows to join our dynamic team as Technical Analyst. The ideal candidate will have a good technological understanding of Oracle Fusion Implementations covering Oracle Projects or Order to Cash. The candidate will have

  • Very good understanding of Oracle Fusion
  • Delivers technical solutions that adhere to business requirements
  • Drives continuous improvement in solution performance, reliability, compliance, and efficiency.
  • Proactively drives solution usage and simplification working with Solution Architects.
  • Consistently grows expertise in business processes and enabling technologies

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide development and support of Fusion extensions in the assigned value stream with special focus on Oracle Projects Portfolio Management or Order to Cash flows.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance system performance and reliability.
  • Designs and develops industry leading process improvements within technology environment ahead of any migration activity using their understanding of all end to end functional processes.
  • Coordinates and ensures data governance methodologies are adhered to within our regulated environment.
  • Follow Agile methodology to streamline development, testing, and deployment processes.
  • Monitor and optimize system performance, ensuring high availability and minimal downtime as part of Post go live Operational Support
  • Stay updated with the latest Fusion technologies and tools to drive continuous improvement.
  • Conduct troubleshooting and root cause analysis for application issues.
  • Manage project timelines and stakeholder expectations effectively.
  • Job Function:
  • Analyze Oracle Fusion Enhancements/ Change Requests and Support activities pipeline
  • Work planning and prioritization for approved backlogs within the Value stream.
  • Coordinate with other Value stream leads within Fusion, Delivery and Support leads for other Edge applications within
  • Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices
  • Optimize and effectively manage Enhancements and support ticket backlog within the Value stream reviewing with the team
  • Drive for Continuous improvements to reduce support tickets, automation eliminating manual activities wherever possible
  • Follow JCI Major Incident management process to address any critical issues (P1/P2) by engaging right teams

Required Skills

  • Bachelor ‘s degree in engineering or Information Systems or equivalent
  • 5+ years of overall experience within Oracle Fusion and Oracle EBS ERPs
  • Proven track record in delivery and support of technical configurations and extensions supporting Fusion ERP Order to Cash Functional scope
  • Knowledge of Oracle Fusion functional configuration and solutions for small- and large-scale initiatives.
  • Hands on experience with development of BIP, OTBI Reports.
  • Knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP data models
  • Knowledge of interface development by using Fusion REST & SOAP APIs.
  • Basic understanding of enterprise integration tools like MuleSoft, Oracle Integration Cloud
  • Ability to communicate with Fusion functions teams as well as Business audience.
  • Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking skills
  • Proven ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a reactive high-pressure environment

**

Preferred Skills

  • Oracle Cloud certifications.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies.

**

JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.

job.title: Oracle Fusion Senior Technical Analyst
job.description:
Senior Oracle Fusion Technical Analyst

Johnson Controls creates smart, healthy, and sustainable environments. In this role, you will help strengthen Oracle Fusion technical capabilities that support reliable reporting, efficient business processes, and effective delivery across critical enterprise flows.

Role Overview

As a Senior Oracle Fusion Technical Analyst, you will lead technical development and support for Oracle Fusion ERP solutions, with a strong focus on Project to Close flows. You will partner with functional, technical, and business teams to deliver stable integrations, extensions, and reporting solutions that improve performance, simplify processes, and support end-to-end delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead development and support of Fusion extensions across Project to Close and related ERP functional flows.
  • Design, build, and maintain BIP and OTBI reports that support business and operational needs.
  • Develop and support integrations using Oracle Fusion REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Work with Oracle Fusion ERP data models to enable technical solutions and data-driven process support.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve system performance, reliability, and user experience.
  • Support implementation activities, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Analyze enhancements, change requests, and support issues; help manage backlog and conduct code reviews.
  • Contribute to automation, simplification, and reduction of support tickets through practical process improvements.

How You Will Do It

  • Own outcomes with accountability and integrity by delivering well-tested solutions, protecting data quality, and following disciplined change control.
  • Stay close to the business process by partnering with functional teams and understanding how each change affects users and downstream flows.
  • Improve every day through automation, root-cause analysis, simplification, and candid problem-solving.
  • Work as one team with technical and business partners to unblock issues quickly and keep delivery moving.
  • Use clear documentation, traceability, and thoughtful handoffs so support teams can sustain what you build.
  • Balance speed and quality by validating changes carefully before release and staying focused on business impact.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, or an equivalent field.
  • 8+ years of overall experience with Oracle Fusion and Oracle EBS ERP environments.
  • Proven experience delivering and supporting technical configurations and extensions in Oracle Fusion ERP.
  • Hands-on experience with BIP and OTBI reports.
  • Strong knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP data models.
  • Experience developing interfaces with Oracle Fusion REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with functional teams and business stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting implementation, testing, and post-go-live operations in a complex ERP environment.

Nice to Have

  • Basic understanding of MuleSoft and Oracle Integration Cloud.
  • Exposure to Agile delivery practices.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Analytics Cloud, VBCS, or Oracle ATP.
  • Experience supporting process improvement initiatives in large-scale ERP programs.

job.title: Service Team Manager - HVAC & Chillers
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Why Johnson Controls?

Being a Global company, you will work with some of the best people in the industry. This role will offer you autonomy and flexibility to make it your own and provide a pathway for a long-term career.

  • Global company with strong systems and support
  • Permanent full-time opportunity
  • Base + super + car allowance + incentive

About this role:

This role will develop and manage the Commercial Service business in both recurring (Preventative Service Agreement) and non-recurring (Labour & Material) revenue streams to achieve a designated financial plan and develop profitable business with new and existing customers.

You will look after:

  • Service: Lead, drive and cascade service objectives to our customers and team members in line with our values, approach and required methodologies. About you
