job.title: Production Support Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Schedules, plans and oversees material procurement, production and delivery processes.

Responsibilities

  • Participates in scheduling production and delivery processes in accordance with current productivity and cost efficiency standards.
  • Develops and executes material planning for a product line to ensure that all material requirements for assigned programs are met within the allocated time frame.
  • Organizes the flow of materials within the manufacturing unit and the transferring of materials to and from the inventory or warehouse.
  • Generates forecasts and manages replenishment planning for parts and materials to ensure specified service levels are met.

Degree Requirement

Degree or equivalent experience desired

Skill Descriptors

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
  • Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP): Knowledge of the process, issues and considerations for systematically managing distribution of inventory for multiple plants or warehouses; ability to apply related knowledge and experience in real practice.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Works with real-time inventory software, moving supplies to where needed, when needed.
  • Interprets the impact of bottlenecks and delays on operating costs.
  • Follows processes and applies technologies for items and inventory management.
  • Assists in solving issues related to distribution to meet orders or inventory replenishment requirements.
  • Works with basic distribution requirements planning (DRP) processes and operations.

Internal Resource Coordination: Knowledge of the techniques, tools and applications associated with coordination of internal resources; ability to synchronize and integrate activities, responsibilities, and command and control structures to ensure that internal resources are used most efficiently in pursuit of business objectives.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies basic characteristics of good business relationships or partnerships.
  • Attends training to learn coordination skills with individuals and groups.
  • Lists major techniques, tools and approaches for resource coordination.
  • Describes the organization's culture and policies for coordinating with others.

Manufacturing Requirements Planning (MRP): Knowledge of the processes, practices and systems used in manufacturing requirements planning (MRP); ability to optimize planning for manufacturing cycles and ensure capacity and materials availability.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes basic concepts of materials and capacity management processes and procedures.
  • Describes product life cycle and associated MRP cycle.
  • Identifies parameters and considerations used in making decisions about production runs.
  • Describes the use of bills of materials and other documentation needed to provide supplies.

Materials Handling and Management: Knowledge of material handling and management in plants; ability to perform, monitor and improve processes related to storage, transportation and handling of raw and hazardous materials.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies key issues involved with different types of manufacturing materials.
  • Discusses considerations for physical management of major types of materials.
  • Identifies types of materials used in manufacturing flagship products or components.
  • Describes packaging regulations and locates those specific to the requirements of the situation.

Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Seeks help to modify priorities as new information surfaces or conditions change.
  • Demonstrates the ability to estimate the time and resources required to complete tasks.
  • Identifies own key assignments, schedules, and process steps.
  • Applies the concept of 'critical path' in order to complete work in a timely manner and keep larger tasks on track.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the value of a disciplined approach to problem solving.
  • Describes problem reporting and escalation practices.
  • Utilizes accepted procedures for problem analysis and resolution.
  • Identifies key aspects of problem-solving techniques used in own area.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Provides examples of the characteristics of effective business relationships.
  • Identifies key business relationships in own organization.
  • Describes the nature of a productive business relationship.
  • Explains the benefits of building business partnerships.

This position requires the candidate to work a 5-day-a-week schedule in the office.

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

八月 19, 2026 - 九月 1, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: MineStar® Site Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Caterpillar is seeking a MineStar® Site Manager to join our Underground Mining Technology team.

Based in Perth or Brisbane on an international FIFO roster, this role supports MineStar® Fleet and Command for Underground systems at Freeport Indonesia. As Caterpillar’s senior representative on site, you will work closely with customer leadership teams to develop, implement and manage product support strategies, equipment management processes and technology adoption initiatives that deliver measurable operational outcomes.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an experienced mining technology professional to lead customer engagement and drive the long-term success of autonomous and fleet management solutions at one of the world's largest underground mining operations.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Acting as Caterpillar's primary MineStar® representative and trusted advisor at site
  • Developing strategies to improve technology performance, fleet utilisation and customer outcomes
  • Monitoring key site performance metrics including availability, production, operating costs, utilisation and safety
  • Identifying customer needs and supporting the deployment of new products, technologies and services
  • Providing guidance on equipment management, technology adoption and operational improvement initiatives
  • Leading the resolution of complex operational and technical issues
  • Supporting system implementation, upgrades and continuous improvement activities
  • Analysing performance data to identify optimisation opportunities
  • Aligning Caterpillar support activities with customer objectives and recovery strategies
  • Coaching and developing site personnel to maximise capability and system utilisation

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in mining engineering, IT, Software Engineering or a related discipline, required to meet Indonesian work visa eligibility requirements
  • Significant experience in mining technology, MineStar®, fleet management systems, automation or operational technology (OT)
  • Strong knowledge of mining operations, equipment management and operational improvement
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across operational and leadership teams
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with a focus on customer success
  • Australian Citizenship or Permanent Residency, and the ability to obtain and maintain all visas, work permits and approvals required to work in Indonesia

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary based on qualifications and professional industry experience.

The Total Rewards package includes:

  • Competitive remuneration package
  • Site, Shift and FIFO Allowances
  • Attractive Bonus and Share options
  • Career development with global prospects
  • A strong commitment to safety and your wellbeing
  • An inclusive workplace culture focused on quality, customer service and the environment
  • A commitment to diversity and inclusion, equal opportunity and equal outcome
  • SMART spending APP
  • The opportunity to do truly meaningful work in a supportive, constructive culture that encourages you to make the most of your talents

Additional Information

  • FIFO roster
  • Candidates must be based in Australia and meet the requirements to obtain an Indonesian work visa

How to Apply

If you're ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role with a global industry leader, apply via:

www.caterpillar.com/careers

Your road to success begins with Caterpillar.

Join a global leader and build a career with real impact.

_Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer._

_Caterpillar of Australia is not currently hiring applicants who require sponsorship. As a global company, opportunities may be available in other locations via our careers website._

This position requires working onsite five days a week. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: IS Technical Solution Architect for SAP MDG
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

IS Service Owner ###

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to own software solution architecture across multiple architecture categories and ensures its alignment with enterprise and data architecture standards. Also, responsible for the design and build, integrity, and quality of an IS solution and associated IS services delivered to business. You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring continuous improvement and compliance.

The work model for the role is #Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Corporate Finance Function and is part of the Finance IS Domain and Corporate Finance.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Design and architect robust and scalable software solutions using front-end and back-end technologies including highly scalable, fault-tolerant and durable messaging queue systems
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Develop and maintain applications in SAP4HANA/MDG environment
  • Ensure code quality through best practices, including clean code principles, code reviews, and automated testing.
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve our development processes.
  • Demonstrate strong DevOps acumen
  • System Integration: Facilitate seamless integration of finance processes within the MDG system, as well as with other enterprise systems (ERP, SAP TC, etc.), ensuring smooth data flow and automation of processes across platforms.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelors or Masters Degree, preferably in Computer Sciences, Engineering, Math or similar
  • At least 10+ years of experience with a strong background in system configuration and implementation within SAP.
  • Proven understanding of SAP solutions.
  • Hands-on experience in SAP environment with proven understanding of complexity and intricacies of it – is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of compliance requirements is a strong plus.
  • Certifications required - ITIL V4 foundation
  • Certifications preferred- SAP/MDG technology specific certifications, IT architecture certification.

More about us

We value people from different backgrounds. Apply today for your next career step within ABB and visit www.abb.com to learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory Our mission in ABB IS (Information Systems) is to harness the power of information technology to deliver valuable, reliable, and competitive IS services for ABB. If you have a strong technical skills, analytical mind, and the drive to help us stay ahead of the competition, you are the one we are looking for.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Accounting and Reporting Analyst_P2P
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

TA Regional Lead - India, Malaysia, Indonesia & Oversight Countries ###

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support general accounting activities in line with defined strategies, policies, and procedures. Each day, you will be responsible for managing and analyzing record to report data. You will also exhibit your proficiency by ensuring accurate financial reporting and compliance with the relevant accounting standards.

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

This role is contributing to the Finance Operational Service based in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

Leadership & People Management

  • Conduct one-on-one meetings, provide feedback, and mentor team members for growth.
  • Lead hiring, training, and performance appraisals for the AP team.
  • Manage attendance, leave planning, and ensure adequate backup for all activities.
  • Organize daily huddles and regular reviews to monitor process health and address issues.

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure accurate processing of AP transactions and adherence to SLA/TAT timelines.
  • Oversee month-end close activities, including account reconciliations and journal entries.
  • Present dashboards with SLI & KPI reports to business users and drive improvements in Paid on Time (POT) metrics.

Process Improvement & Compliance

  • Drive process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support implementation of best practices and harmonization across AP processes.
  • Ensure compliance with ABB Group Accounting Standards, local GAAP, and internal controls.
  • Lead internal control testing and documentation for financial reporting compliance.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for country heads and clients, ensuring service satisfaction.
  • Manage customer queries and enhance customer experience through timely resolution.

Analysis & Reporting

  • Perform transaction analysis, identify discrepancies, and ensure corrective actions.
  • Deliver KPI/SLI reports and insights to stakeholders for decision-making.
  • Utilize ERP tools (SAP, Oracle) and reporting platforms (Power BI) for data analysis and visualization.
  • Handle escalations, perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement preventive measures.
  • Manage new projects and process transitions from other business units to ABB GBS.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Commerce.
  • 7–11 years of experience in Accounts Payable, with at least 3+ years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) and reporting tools (Power BI).
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.
  • Proven experience in process improvement, compliance, and project management.

More about us:

ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who deliver forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results whilst operating at the highest standards. ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who delivers forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results and operates with the highest standards.

job.title: CFIN M&A Solution Architect
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Head of Central Finance ###

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

We are looking for a M&A CFIN architect to support System of Record (SOR)–related activities within the Central Finance (CFIN) landscape. This role supports mergers, acquisitions, divestments, and new company code onboarding by assisting in the alignment and integration of acquired entities’ SOR finance data and processes into the target CFIN environment, in line with defined business requirements and standards.

This position requires close coordination with Deployment team, Functional architects and external vendors, to maintain and evolve the CFIN M&A Solution Architect, ensuring it meets business needs and complies with ABB's standards.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Finance Services business Finance Process Data Systems division in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Assist in configuring and deploying M&A-related finance solutions in CFIN for new company codes, mergers, acquisitions, and divestments.
  • Support SOR data migration from source systems, including initial load, AVL load, and data validation for new clients.
  • Work across O2C, P2P, R2R, Tax, and Treasury processes to ensure accurate integration and operational readiness.
  • Perform financial reconciliations, system testing, and support issue resolution during deployments.
  • Assist with real-time data replication and CPAY activation to enable seamless transactions and reporting in CFIN.
  • Collaborate with CFIN solution teams, IS architects, M&A leads, vendors, and business stakeholders to support integration and deployment activities.
  • Follow ABB standards, data governance, and regulatory requirements while building expertise in CFIN, SAP S/4HANA, and SOR processes for continuous improvement.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

Background & Experience:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications in SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN, or IT architecture.
  • 7-10+ years of experience as CFIN Finance Architect, or similar role, with strong hands-on experience in mergers, acquisitions, and divestments, including finance systems integration and separation activities.

job.description:

This role is contributing to the Electrification discipline of the Automation business within Process Industries for the India, Middle-East and Africa Region. Main stakeholders include end customers, EPC/LSTK contractors, engineering consultants, project managers, process engineering teams, electrical and automation engineering teams, vendors, system integrators, and internal sales and execution teams.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Acting as a role model in applying design thinking or design for excellence concepts in projects, including modelling, prototyping, simulation, and calculations.
  • Serving as a specialist in the application of advanced concepts and methods.
  • Leading, supervising, and coordinates teams (5-25 members) in all engineering disciplines (both in-house and outsourced) on projects of medium complexity.
  • Collaborating on project installation, commissioning, and site activities, to clarify potential issues or provide solutions to rectify the engineering errors.

Qualifications for the role

  • You are immersed in and highly skilled in Electrical Engineering for Process Plants, working with electrical systems ranging from 220 kV to 110 V AC and 220/110 V DC across the Cement, Metals, Mining, Material Handling, Pulp & Paper, and Minerals industries.
  • You have a First Class B.E./ B.Tech. in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering with 18–20 years of relevant experience in project engineering, with consulting companies or with engineering departments of EPC / LSTK companies / Mill Builders.
  • You have extensive hands-on experience in the electrical engineering of Cement Clinkerization Plants, Grinding Units, WHRS, CPPs, HSMs, CRMs, Processing Lines, Open-cast and Underground Mines, CHPs, and Long-Distance Conveyor Systems.
  • You possess advanced expertise in the engineering of Outdoor Switchyards, Indoor Substations and Electrical Rooms and specifications of HV/MV/LV Switchgear, MCCs, IMCCs, Batteries & Chargers, VVVF Drives, LRS, Transformers, Cables, Lighting Systems.
  • You are highly adept in System and Layout Engineering, including Substation Equipment Assignment Layouts, Earthing Layouts, Cable Layouts, Lightning Protection Layouts, and Illumination Layouts.
  • You have proven experience in delivering large-scale electrification projects for the Cement, Metals, Minerals, Material Handling, Mining, and Paper industries.
  • You are passionate about technical problem-solving, stakeholder management, multidisciplinary coordination, and engineering excellence, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient project execution.
  • You have extensive experience in managing and coordinating with leading engineering consultants such as HOLTEC, DCPL, PENTA, MECON, CET, DASTURCO, and TCE, while effectively communicating with clients, contractors, vendors, and project teams.

More about us The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

SEN. DIGITAL SOLUTION ENGINEER. SPECIAL. ###

Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by applying basic design thinking/design for excellence concepts in projects.

This role is contributing to the to the Process Automation business in Energy Industries division based in Bangalore, India You will be mainly accountable for:

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.

  • 5-8 years of experience of using the commercial APC software’s such as ABB Ability™ PnC, Honeywell Profit™ Suite, Aspen DMCplus / DMC3, Yokogawa SMOC etc.
  • Candidates have experience in plant operations and Expertise in APC, control systems, and Open Platform Communication OPC
  • Prior experience of handling a complete APC project cycle from any of the following sectors :

Chemicals and Specialty Chemicals

  • Energy and Utility
  • Refinery and Petrochemicals
  • Steam and Power Generation

Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills in the field of advanced process control.

Experience in estimating engineering efforts and Developing standards, tools for productivity improvement

Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or a related engineering degree. An advanced degree is preferred.

More about us

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

job.title: Gas Turbine Engineer (Automation)
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Engineering Manager ###

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by applying basic design thinking/design for excellence concepts in projects.

The work model for the role is # LI - Hybrid.

This role is contributing to the to the Process Automation business in Energy Industries division based in Bangalore, India You will be mainly accountable for:

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Control Architecture Design: Develop scalable, high-performance control architectures for gas turbine and combined-cycle plants. Validate system performance across various operating conditions, including start-up, load changes, and grid disturbances.
  • Migration & Upgrade Projects: Lead engineering activities for Mark V to ABB control system migrations, including detailed I/O mapping, logic conversion, and validation of functional equivalence.
  • Integration & Commissioning: Oversee integration with electrical systems, instrumentation, and plant DCS. Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and commissioning at international sites.
  • Compliance & Standards: Ensure all work adheres to IEC, IEEE, NFPA, and local grid codes. Implement cybersecurity measures for control systems.
  • Digital Enablement: Integrate predictive analytics, remote monitoring, and AI-driven diagnostics into control solutions.
  • Documentation & Training: Prepare comprehensive engineering documentation, test procedures, and training materials for plant operators.

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.

Qualifications for the role:

  • At least 8-12 years’ experience in power plant automation, specifically in gas turbine control (experience with GE Mark V and ABB Symphony Plus is highly desirable).
  • Proven track record of successful retrofit or upgrade projects for turbine control systems and Strong proficiency in control logic design, PLC/DCS programming, and HMI development.
  • Hands-on experience with ABB Symphony Plus and GE Mark V control systems, as well as relevant communication protocols (such as Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850) and excellent project management and effective stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to influence and drive change across global initiatives and analytical approach and strong problem-solving abilities for complex integration projects.
  • Certifications (Preferred)- ABB Control Systems Certification, Cybersecurity for Industrial Control Systems and PMP or equivalent project management certification.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical, Electronics, or Automation Engineering.

More about us

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. job.title: Project manager
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Project Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to execute medium-size projects. Each day, you will ensure that all related activities are executed in accordance with procedures, regulations, standards, specifications and targets. You will also showcase your project management skills by leading the project team members to fulfill project requirements, deliver contracted deliverables, and meet the expected project result.

The work model for the role is: #LI - Onsite

This role is contributing to the Automation – Process Industries business. Main stakeholders are Customers, Sales & Tendering, Engineering, Procurement & Supply Chain, Project Execution teams, Finance, QHSE, Suppliers, and Business Management.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading the project team, establishing the project execution approach, and overseeing planning, monitoring and control activities for internal and external resources to accomplish all project goals.
  • Monitoring and controlling project progress, efficient resource utilization, and project financials.
  • Identifying, qualifying, quantifying, managing project risk, and ensuring all opportunities are identified and pursued.
  • Managing the formal acceptance of the project, contract close-out, and acknowledgment by the customer, all in accordance with the contract.

Qualifications for the role

  • You are highly skilled in project management methodologies, EPC project execution, project planning & scheduling, risk management, contract management, cost control, and stakeholder management within the Electrification and Industrial Automation industry.
  • You have 12–15 years of demonstrated experience in managing and delivering medium to large EPC projects across Mining, Metals, Cement, Paper, Process Industries, or related industrial sectors, with experience in Electrification and Automation solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience in executing projects with individual project values up to INR 500 Million, managing the complete project lifecycle from engineering and procurement through commissioning and customer handover.
  • Possess good knowledge of SAP, Microsoft Project/Primavera P6, Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), project financial management, and project reporting tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional project teams, manage customer and stakeholder relationships, handle project execution, mitigate risks, and ensure timely project delivery while meeting quality, safety, and contractual requirements.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or an equivalent Engineering discipline. PMP®, PRINCE2®, or equivalent Project Management certification.
  • Practical experience in site execution, installation supervision, contractor management, testing, commissioning, start-up support, and customer acceptance for industrial EPC projects.
  • You are at ease communicating in English, with effective verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

More About us:

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain understanding coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

LPG Manager LVS IN ###

Each day, you will be accountable for the long-term profitable growth of an offer. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting business results by overseeing each step involved in the offer lifecycle including development, launch, go-to-market, maintenance, pricing, and profitability.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Smart Power division at Nashik, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading the market intelligence analysis and identifying potential gaps in the portfolio, with respect to the competition and new market opportunities.
  • Owning technical and market specification for the offer and determining an offering business plan that supports sustainable growth while leading customer need and value analysis, planning the roadmap to create maximum value, and following-up on portfolio performance.
  • Leading the offer lifecycle management process, analyzing current offers, defining, and tracking performance metrics, and making decisions on offer obsolescence and end-of life to ensure that current and future market requirements are met to maximize their profitability.
  • Setting targets, monitoring offering costs and giving inputs to operations functions (e.g., Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Production) to maximize competitiveness and profitability.

Our team dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

Qualifications for the role

  • 15+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Marketing, or Business Development in Low Voltage Switchgear industry.**
  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (Should be full time)
  • Hands-on experience in New Product Development (NPD) and Product Lifecycle Management.
  • Proven expertise in product positioning, pricing strategy, and profitability analysis.
  • Experience in product forecasting, inventory planning, and demand management.
  • Strong understanding of LV systems is must (MCC / PCC / PDP / ACB / MCB / MCCB/ RCCB/ Panels / Breakers)
  • Experience working with R&D and engineering teams during product development.
  • Exposure to sales enablement, technical support, and customer engagement
  • You are at ease communicating in English, with excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

job.title: Principal Software Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Lead Technology Product Manager ###

What we believe in

ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, we are looking for an experienced Principal Software Engineer – Full Stack to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. The role requires a strong technical leader with extensive experience in React or Angular, .NET, and modern software architecture to design and deliver scalable industrial software platforms.

You will lead the architecture and development of cloud-native, high-performance applications that integrate Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) systems while driving engineering excellence across the software development lifecycle. You will also champion AI-assisted software engineering practices by enabling development teams to leverage LLM-powered coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate software delivery, testing, and architectural decision-making.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • ### Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable full-stack applications using React/Angular, .NET, microservices, and cloud-native technologies while ensuring high performance, maintainability, and software quality.
  • ### Drive engineering excellence by defining software architecture standards, mentoring development teams, promoting best practices, and leading adoption of modern software development methodologies including AI-assisted engineering workflows.
  • ### Design and deliver secure, reliable, and highly available industrial software solutions by integrating enterprise applications with automation platforms, real-time communication protocols, REST APIs, WebSockets, and modern cloud technologies.
  • ### Collaborate with architects, product managers, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver complex software solutions, reduce technical debt, improve system performance, and ensure predictable delivery of high-quality releases.

Qualifications for the role:

  • ### 12+ years of experience in Full Stack Software Development with strong expertise in .NET (C#), ASP.NET Core, React or Angular, and enterprise-scale application development.
  • ### Proven experience designing scalable microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications using modern software engineering principles.
  • ### Strong knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL or NoSQL databases along with backend frameworks, ORM technologies, and frontend state management concepts.
  • ### Experience with Azure or AWS cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes/K3s), DevOps practices, and software security standards.
  • ### Good understanding of industrial automation technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, SCADA, MES, IoT platforms, and integration between Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) systems is preferred.
  • ### Demonstrated technical leadership with experience mentoring engineers, defining engineering standards, driving architectural decisions, and successfully delivering complex enterprise software solutions across cross-functional teams.
  • ### BE/BTech/ME/MTech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related engineering disciplines with excellent communication skills and passion for innovation, continuous learning, and AI-driven software engineering practices.

More about us

ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation (PA) business area automates, electrifies and digitalizes some of the world's most complex industrial infrastructures. Through its five divisions, it serves customers across energy, process, hybrid and maritime industries by delivering innovative automation, digitalization and industrial software solutions that enable safer, smarter and more sustainable operations.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Shift Leader ###

What we believe in

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

You will also showcase your expertise by optimizing the cost, quality, and on-time delivery of products.

Service Sales Manager

岗位职责：

  • 熟练掌握ABB机器人全系售后服务产品：原厂备件、年度维保、数字化产品、机器人调试、程序优化、整机及备件翻新、停产机型升级改造等；结合产品价值，向客户对比原厂服务与第三方服务差异，输出价值型销售方案，独立完成商务沟通、报价、谈判、签单，达成个人及团队销售业绩指标。
  • 客户装机信息摸排与台账搭建:

将客户机器人装机信息摸排列为日常客户拜访核心工作，精准统计区域内客户的ABB机器人现有装机总量、型号、投产年限、设备工况、在用数量、闲置数量等核心数据；同步更新客户装机台账，精准盘点区域存量设备资源，依托装机数据匹配对应维保、备件、改造升级等服务商机，为销售策略制定、客户分层运营、业绩增量挖掘提供精准数据支撑。

  • 市场分析：
  • 进行市场趋势分析，研究竞争对手，并结合技术背景提出有价值的销售策略建议。
  • 售后服务协调：
  • 处理客户的售后服务请求，跟进服务进度，以技术为导向确保客户问题得到及时和有效的解决，提升客户满意度。
  • 开展客户满意度调查，分析反馈，持续改进服务质量，以提升客户忠诚度。
  • 销售文档管理：
  • 管理和更新客户档案及销售相关文件，确保所有技术和销售信息准确无误。
  • 培训与发展：
  • 为客户及内部团队提供技术导向的产品及服务培训支持，确保他们能够充分理解和应用ABB的解决方案。

职位要求：

  • 本科或以上学历，机械工程、电气工程、自动化、控制工程或相关工科专业背景优先。

•3年及以上工业产品销售经验，有售后或服务相关销售经验优先

  • 优秀的中英文书面及口头沟通能力，能够将复杂的技术概念转化为客户易于理解的商业价值。
  • 快速学习新技术和产品的能力，尤其是在工业机器人领域，具备将技术优势转化为销售机会的能力。
  • 具有良好的团队合作精神，能够在跨职能团队中工作，协调技术和销售资源以达成目标。
  • 熟练使用Microsoft Office，特别是Excel和PowerPoint，能够处理复杂的技术数据和制作专业报告。
  • 强大的时间管理能力，能够在压力下有效工作，确保按时交付客户期望的解决方案。

job.title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Quality & Continuous Improvement Manager ###

What we believe in

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

Your role and responsibilities

You will be working as Quality Assurance Specialist reporting to the Continuous Improvement Manager for the Electrification Business Area for Smart Power Division based in Bangalore.

The work model for the role is #Li-Onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Responsible for in-process and final inspection of low voltage products such as ACB, MCCB, contactors, and relays, ensuring compliance with quality standards.
  • Develop and implement Quality Plans, Control Plans, inspection checklists, CTQs, and quality gates to improve process control.
  • Monitor process performance through First Pass Yield (FPY) and implement continuous improvement and Opex initiatives to enhance efficiency.
  • Handle customer complaints by performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Coordinate customer audits, FAT, and certification audits (UL, CSA, CCC, ISO), and conduct product testing as per IEC and catalogue specifications using advanced test equipment.

Qualifications for the role

  • Diploma/Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in a similar quality role.
  • Minimum 8 years of practical experience in quality assurance in the low voltage switchgear industry.
  • Proficient in quality tools and methodologies including FMEA, 7 QC tools, 5S, 5 Why, Kaizen, Poka-Yoke, SPC, DMAIC, and 8D root cause analysis.
  • Experience with handling low voltage products such as MCCB, ACB, contactors, and thermal overload relays.
  • Good understanding of low voltage switchgear products with the ability to analyze and resolve complex quality issues.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
  • Demonstrated interpersonal, analytical, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Principal Engineer - Architect
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Lead ###

In this role, you will have the opportunity to initiate and drive technology, software, product, and/or solution development using in-depth technical expertise in a specific area. Each day, you will act as the first point of contact in Research and Development (R&D) for in-depth product or technology-related issues. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting strategic corporate technology management and future product/software/solution architecture.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid #LI Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Process Automation Business of Process Control Platform Division in Bangalore Location.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Design and develop scalable cloud-native and edge-enabled industrial software solutions using microservice architectures.
  • Drive end-to-end product development from requirements analysis and architecture design through implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Define and govern application, data, integration, and security architectures across cloud and edge environments.
  • Lead major technology initiatives, providing technical direction, mentorship, and architectural oversight to engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with product management, R&D teams, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Establish and promote software engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural governance.
  • Drive DevOps adoption, CI/CD strategies, automated testing, and release management practices.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, observability, and maintainability of distributed systems.
  • Champion cybersecurity principles, secure-by-design approaches, and compliance with industrial security standards.
  • Lead quality improvement initiatives, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement programs across the product portfolio.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies in cloud, edge computing, industrial connectivity, and AI-driven solutions.
  • Contribute to strategic technology roadmaps aligned with ABB’s industrial digitalization and automation objectives.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 15+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with C#/.NET/.NET Core and modern web technologies.
  • Strong expertise in microservices, distributed systems, software architecture patterns, SOLID principles, and system design.
  • Experience designing and implementing IoT solutions using REST APIs, WebSocket, MQTT, AMQP, or similar technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, MicroShift, K3s, or other container and edge orchestration platforms.
  • Strong cloud-native experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP, preferably for Industrial IoT workloads, including Azure IoT Hub or AWS IoT Core.
  • Deep understanding of security concepts including OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Zero Trust architecture, PKI, certificate management, and secure edge deployments.
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms, including automated testing and release strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of observability practices, including logging, monitoring, tracing, and tools such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases, time-series data management, historian integration, and industrial data modeling.
  • Familiarity with industrial communication technologies such as OPC UA and industrial standards such as ISA-95.
  • Awareness of industrial cybersecurity and compliance frameworks including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001, with experience applying them in enterprise or industrial environments.
  • Experience in working within agile teams, e.g., using SCRUM or SAFe

More about us:

ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Reporting to the Warehouse Supervisor, you'll take ownership of our warehousing operations at our Napier site. As part of our warehousing team, you'll be the backbone of our supply chain - ensuring goods flow efficiently from receiving through to dispatch. Your expertise and ability to work at pace will be critical in maintaining our warehouse standards and keeping our operation running smoothly.

  • Picking components from stock for our manufacturing division with precision and efficiency

  • Planning daily operations around expected deliveries, coordinating resources and equipment availability
  • Sorting and arranging material for storage according to established procedures, maximising space and accessibility
  • Preparing products for transport with care and accuracy

The Warehouse team work closely together to do what is required to get the job done. It's a physical role working primarily inside but also involves some outside work unloading and loading vehicles arriving on site.

  • An understanding of inwards and outwards goods and the world of logistics will be beneficial
  • Experience with a Warehouse Management System like SAP would be an advantage
  • A positive desire to learn with the ability to navigate computer systems confidently
  • A team player with a positive team attitude and a solution-focused approach
  • Strong written and spoken communication skills
  • Good with numbers

job.description:

This position reports to:

Service and Project Operation Manager

__

YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

In this internship role, you will support the implementation, delivery, and continuous improvement of products and services within the Measurement & Analytics Division. This is an excellent opportunity to acquire practical, hands-on experience that complements your academic studies while enhancing your professional skills and employment prospects. You will work closely with various teams across ABB's operations, gaining valuable insights into how we serve customers and drive innovation in smart instrumentation and analytics solutions.

You will be mainly accountable for:

• Supporting the implementation and delivery of products and services by collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure effective coordination and successful project completion within defined timelines

• Utilizing your understanding of customer needs and ABB's solutions to contribute to determining effective technical solutions that align with customer requirements and project outcomes

• Communicating with business teams to understand existing processes and actively contributing to continuous process improvement efforts across assigned projects

• Seeking regular feedback and guidance from your manager and team members to enhance your technical skills, performance, and professional development throughout the internship.

OUR TEAM DYNAMICS

You will join a collaborative and innovative team, where you will be able to thrive and grow. Our dynamic environment emphasizes knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning, providing you with the support and resources needed to succeed as an engineering professional while contributing meaningfully to real business projects.

QUALIFICATIONS FOR THE ROLE

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Engineering (Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical, Automation, or related discipline) or equivalent technical field with strong academic performance

• Demonstrated passion for automation, measurement technology, or industrial applications with a solid understanding of fundamental engineering principles and technical concepts

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, ask clarifying questions, and contribute constructively to team environments

• Practical experience or coursework in automation systems, PLC programming, instrumentation, or related areas; familiarity with engineering software tools is advantageous

• Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to think analytically, learn quickly, and apply knowledge to real-world technical challenges

• Proficiency in English (written and spoken); knowledge of Mandarin Chinese is beneficial

MORE ABOUT US

The Measurement & Analytics Division is among the world's leading manufacturers and suppliers of smart instrumentation and analyzers, working at the heart of industrial digital transformation. At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Regional Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will drive the service sales function in collaboration with the service sales and service team. You will generate service sales opportunities and secure profitable sales within the designated area(s). Focuses on Installed Base (IB) penetration and sells the entire Service portfolio for Drives, Motors and Electrification in collaboration with other ABB service units. Builds long-term customer relationships and ensures immediate response to specific customer needs and issues by promoting lifecycle management, modernization, preventive maintenance, digital solutions, and value-added services.

The work model for this role is: #LI-Hybrid

• Driving Installed Base (IB) penetration by promoting ABB's service portfolio for Drives, Motors, and Electrification, including preventive and predictive maintenance, lifecycle services, spare parts, repairs, upgrades, retrofits, modernization, digital solutions, and service agreements. • Identifying and develop new service sales opportunities by leveraging the Installed Base database, customer asset lifecycle, market trends, and operational needs. • Developing and execute strategic sales plans to achieve revenue, profitability, and growth targets across assigned customers and market segments. • Building trusted customer relationships by understanding operational challenges and delivering value-based service solutions that improve reliability, productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability, and asset performance. • Conducting regular customer visits, account reviews, presentations, seminars, and marketing activities to strengthen customer engagement and expand ABB's service footprint. • Supporting commercial and technical risk assessments, pricing strategies, contract negotiations, and successful project handover in accordance with ABB policies.

Qualifications for the role

• Diploma, Higher National Diploma, Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Power Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or equivalent. • Knowledge and/or experience in Drives, Electric Motors, Power Engineering, Industrial Automation, Electrification, or Asset Management are preferred. • 1 to 5 years of experience in service sales, technical sales, field service, or application engineering within industrial automation, electrical systems, drives, motors, or electrification. • Experience with products and products such as Low Voltage and Medium Voltage Drives, Electric Motors, Motor Control Centers (MCC), MV Switchgear, etc. • Proven experience in Installed Base (IB) penetration, lifecycle management, service agreements, modernization, upgrades, and aftermarket service sales. • Experience working with customers in industries such as pulp & paper, mining, metals, utilities, water, cement, oil & gas, or general manufacturing is preferred. • Willing to travel regularly across Southeast Asia market.

What's in it for you?

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

More about us

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: AI Lead , Autonomous
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Leader(Industrial Software)-AUEN BL

What we believe in

ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, we are looking for a highly experienced and hands-on AI Lead – Autonomous to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. The role will be responsible for driving the Autonomous Framework as a program and translating prioritized AI use cases into delivered, validated outcomes. The candidate will directly contribute to AI solution design, prototyping and delivery while providing technical leadership across Generative AI, Agentic AI and Classical Machine Learning for industrial applications.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, requiring strong execution discipline, stakeholder management and the ability to drive outcomes across product, platform, architecture, technology partners and pilot customers. The role will also contribute to AI-led margin acceleration initiatives and provide delivery and feasibility inputs into AI use-case prioritization. As the organization scales, the role will have an opportunity to build and lead a team of AI engineers.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for

• Drive AI-led margin acceleration and hands-on AI delivery by identifying high-impact AI opportunities and directly contributing to solution design, prototyping, development and implementation using Generative AI, Agentic AI and Classical Machine Learning for industrial applications. • Lead Autonomous Framework execution and program visibility by establishing the operating cadence, managing milestones, dependencies and releases, maintaining execution visibility, and providing concise, decision-ready updates on progress, risks, blockers and required actions. • Drive execution discipline, technical feasibility and stakeholder coordination by defining clear objectives, scope, success criteria and decision gates for AI initiatives, managing cross-functional dependencies, addressing risks and blockers, and providing input into prioritization and build-vs-buy decisions. • Build technical capability and partner alignment by acting as a senior AI SME, collaborating with architects, product teams, platform teams and partners such as Microsoft and Cognite, and progressively building and leading a small team of AI engineers as the function scales.

Qualifications for the role:

• 15+ years of experience in software engineering, data science or analytics, including 7+ years of hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI and/or Classical Machine Learning. • Strong hands-on expertise in LLMs, RAG, MCP, agentic orchestration, agentic harnesses and agentic architecture, with proven experience delivering AI solutions in industrial domains. • Proven experience developing Classical ML and Neural Network models, with strong knowledge of MLOps and cloud/edge deployment. • Demonstrated experience in driving execution across multiple teams and technology partners, influencing outcomes without direct authority and managing complex dependencies, risks and delivery milestones. • Strong understanding of AI solution architecture, experimentation, prototyping and production deployment, with the ability to translate business priorities into technically feasible and executable AI workstreams. • Strong communication, stakeholder-management and leadership skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for senior leadership and bring structure to ambiguous and rapidly evolving initiatives. • BE/BTech/ME/MTech in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field; advanced degree preferred. Experience in industrial software, process automation, energy, autonomous operations, asset performance, manufacturing execution or energy management, along with exposure to Microsoft/Cognite ecosystems and scaled Agile/program execution, is an added advantage.

More about us

ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation (PA) business area (>$6B revenue in 2021, 22,000 employees), automates, electrifies and digitalizes some of the most complex industrial infrastructures on this planet. Through its five divisions, it serves customers in the energy, process and hybrid industries – from hydrocarbons, chemicals, water, mining, minerals, pulp & paper to marine and ports, and many more. PA stands at the heart of some of the most important shifts in society, helping the energy-intense industries to safer, smarter and more sustainable operations to enable a prosperous, low-carbon society.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

That's our story. Make it your story.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, The Quality Specialist is responsible for ensuring product and process quality across the assembly line, meeting customer quality standards, and driving continuous improvement through structured problem-solving, process audits, inspections, and compliance with ISO 9001:2015 requirements. This role requires expertise in quality control systems, process validation, and technical knowledge of electrical and switchgear standards.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification Smart Buildings Business to be based at Nelamangala, BANGALORE, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensure product and process quality as per customer requirements, ISO 9001:2015 standards, drawings, PCPs, and defined quality procedures; monitor and improve key quality KPIs.
  • Inspection & Non-Conformance Management: Conduct visual, dimensional, functional, and pre-dispatch inspections; identify non-conformities, perform RCA, manage UD clearance, customer complaints, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions.
  • Process Quality & Validation: Maintain and update PFMEA, Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, and Work Instructions; conduct process validation, Cp/Cpk capability studies, LPA, poka-yoke audits, and support FPY improvement.
  • Calibration & Quality Documentation: Ensure timely calibration and upkeep of electrical/mechanical equipment and process instruments; maintain accurate daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual quality reports and records.
  • Continuous Improvement & Cost Reduction: Review FPY, Final Yield, Rework Yield, IFC, and Customer Complaint PPM; support Kaizen, OPEX/cost-saving initiatives, 5S, and structured problem-solving activities to raise quality and cut process losses.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Education & Experience: Diploma or bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering with 4+ years of relevant experience in Process Quality within a manufacturing environment.
  • Industry Exposure: Prior experience in Switchgear, Automobile, Electrical, or similar manufacturing industries, with practical experience in production quality processes.
  • Quality Management Systems: Good knowledge of ISO 9001:2015, PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flow Diagrams, Work Instructions, and quality documentation.
  • Statistical & Technical Skills: Proficiency in SPC, Cp/Cpk capability analysis, Minitab, calibration processes, and Poka-Yoke; basic knowledge of IEC 60898-1, IEC 60947-2, and IEC 61008-1 standards.
  • Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement: Practical skills in RCA, 8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa/Fishbone, and DMAIC, with the ability to analyze quality trends, investigate failures, and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Systems & Reporting: Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SAP for documentation, reporting, UD clearance, lot tracking, and inventory management; Windchill knowledge.
  • Communication & Ownership: effective communication and cross-functional collaboration with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, EHS, Maintenance, and R&D teams; prepared to support shift work, handle several priorities, and support quality improvement initiatives with accountability

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. job.description:

That's our story. Make it your story.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for Supports and Assists local unit in developing the necessary capabilities to effectively control products and systems, ensuring compliance with internal, customer, and industry requirements within a cost-effective and safe working environment. Participates in the development and implementation of standards and test methods to ensure only compliant products, software, and services are released to the customer.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification Smart Power Business to be based at NELAMANGALA, BANGALORE, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Quality, Safety & Compliance Assess operational risks and safety hazards, implement corrective measures, ensure compliance with all quality, production, and equipment safety requirements.
  • Process Control & Validation Ensure torque verification, equipment calibration, and validation of production test systems while implementing effective control plans to mitigate process risks.
  • Continuous Improvement & Project Execution Identify opportunities for improvement, oversee process enhancement projects, and advance operational excellence initiatives to boost quality and efficiency.
  • Customer Support & Issue Resolution Support customer issue resolution, participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), and act as an interface between the customer and internal teams during critical quality discussions.
  • Quality Systems & Capability Development Provide quality training to local teams, implement APQP methodologies for new product introductions, and establish effective process management systems to ensure processes remain controlled and continuously improved.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical or Electronics Engineering or a related engineering discipline, with a minimum of 5 years of quality experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated supervisory experience with the ability to lead teams, manage priorities, and implement quality and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Direct experience in electrical and mechanical testing, diagnosing and fixing problems, or assembly of electronic products and systems within a manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of quality management systems and standards, including ISO 9001:2015, IEEE standards, UL requirements, IEC 60947, EN 62040-3, along with proficiency in SAP systems.
  • Practical experience with calibration and test equipment, non-conforming material disposition, layout testing parameters, wire continuity testing, HiPot (HV) testing, CT ratio testing, and power quality analysis.
  • Prior experience working with Low Voltage (LV) Switchgear products and a good understanding of manufacturing processes and industrial applications.
  • Detail-oriented professional with a solid background in structured problem solving and ongoing improvement, contributing to better quality and more efficient operations.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.
