job.title: Commissioning Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Commissioning&Warranty Suport Specialist

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for leading and executing commissioning activities for marine and port projects, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality project delivery in accordance with contractual, technical, and cybersecurity requirements. You will work closely with project teams, site personnel, contractors, and customers to support installation, testing, commissioning, and final acceptance activities. Your expertise will contribute to successful project execution and customer satisfaction while upholding ABB's commitment to safety, integrity, and operational excellence.

The work model for the role is: Onsite (Most of the time at site - fabrication yard or site office)

This role is contributing to the Offshore solution under AUEN – eHouse solution, supporting ASEAN region, majority will be in Batam, Singapore) Main stakeholders. (Engineering, Planner, Construction, MC, QA/QC, Factory, warranty, warehouse, field service engineers)

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Planning, coordinating, and executing commissioning activities for marine and port automation, electrification, and control system projects, ensuring delivery in accordance with project specifications, quality standards, and schedules.
  • Supporting and coordinating installation and commissioning activities with Site Managers, Project Managers, contractors, and customers to ensure safe and efficient project execution.
  • Conducting testing, troubleshooting, commissioning design updates, and documentation mark-ups, ensuring accurate as-built documentation and technical completion of projects.
  • Ensuring compliance with ABB safety, quality, cybersecurity, and contractual requirements while supporting customer acceptance testing, project close-out activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications for the role

  • You hold a Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Marine Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • You have experience in commissioning, field service, installation, testing, or project execution within marine, port, industrial automation, power, or electrification environments.
  • You possess a solid understanding of electrical distribution, automation, control systems, drives, or marine electrical systems, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues on site.
  • You are experienced in coordinating site activities with project teams, contractors, and customers, ensuring projects are delivered safely and efficiently.
  • You have strong knowledge of HSE requirements and demonstrate commitment to safety, quality, compliance, and cybersecurity standards in project execution.
  • You are a proactive problem-solver with strong communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of working independently in a dynamic project environment.
  • You communicate effectively in English and are willing to travel domestically and internationally, including working onboard vessels and at customer sites when required.

More about us

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

job.title: HR Operations Team Lead - Compensation and Benefits
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

HR Delivery Manager ###

Key Responsibilities

1. Compensation & Benefits Operations - Cluster Countries

Lead and manage end-to-end C&B operations for assigned cluster countries, ensuring timely and accurate execution of all rewards transactions.

Oversee salary benchmarking, pay review cycles, merit increase processing, and market data analysis for cluster geographies.

Ensure country-specific compensation structures and benefit programmes are maintained and aligned with global ABB policy.

Manage benefits enrolment, renewals, vendor coordination, and employee queries related to health, wellness, retirement, and other benefit plans.

Partner with local HRBPs and country HR teams to address C&B escalations, exceptions, and complex cases.

Maintain data integrity in HR systems (Workday / SAP) for all compensation and benefits records across cluster countries.

2. Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) Process Management

Own and drive the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) process end-to-end for Global: from target setting, mid-year review, year-end calculation to payout processing.

Coordinate with P&R, HRBPs, and Business Leaders to ensure accurate AIP eligibility lists, payout calculations, and exception management.

Manage AIP communication and employee-facing documentation in coordination with HR Front Office and COE.

Ensure all AIP activities comply with ABB global guidelines, local labour laws, and audit requirements.Perform quality checks and reconciliation of AIP data before final payroll submission.

Track AIP timelines, identify risks, and proactively escalate issues to the Hub Delivery Manager.

3. Team Leadership & Performance Management

Lead a team of C&B specialists; manage work allocation, capacity planning, and business continuity. Conduct regular performance reviews, one-on-ones, and development conversations. Coach and mentor team members to build technical C&B capability and process expertise.

Foster a high-performance, customer-centric, and collaborative team culture.

Handle escalations with composure and resolve complex issues in a timely manner.

4. Compliance & Regulatory Adherence

Ensure all C&B operations comply with local labour laws, statutory regulations, GDPR, and ABB internal controls across cluster countries.

Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and evidence.

Monitor regulatory changes impacting compensation and benefits in cluster geographies and implement required updates.

5. Stakeholder Engagement & Customer Experience

Build strong partnerships with HRBPs, COEs, Finance, and Payroll teams across cluster countries.

Proactively manage stakeholder communication on C&B matters, process timelines, and issue resolution.

Analyse customer satisfaction feedback and drive continuous improvement in C&B service delivery.

Serve as the primary point of contact for all C&B-related escalations from cluster country stakeholders.

6. Operational Optimization & Innovation

Continuously review C&B processes to identify inefficiencies and implement improvements. Leverage HR technology (Workday, SAP, ServiceNow) to automate and streamline C&B workflows.

Support global HR initiatives such as total rewards redesign, policy harmonisation, and M&A activities. Explore AI-enabled tools and analytics to enhance C&B reporting, benchmarking, and decision support.

Qualification for the role

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Administration, or other relevant fields
  • Must have 7 to 10 years of experience in the Compensation and Performance function

Should possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong analytical abilities and strategic thinking.

  • Excellent user knowledge of Microsoft Office and Excel skills and other analytic tools and techniques is a must
  • Must have team handling and delegation skills and the ability to create a learning atmosphere among team members
  • Strong Customer service orientation and collaborative and conflict-resolving skills is an added advantage

ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.

Your role and responsibilities

The Lead (QE) for PA Core will serve as a dynamic techno-functional leader dedicated to enhancing the Quality Engineering framework across DataOps, Edge, Visualization, Packaging, and IAM within ABB Genix. The role is accountable for shaping automation-first practices, embedding QE in CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring governance and reusability across platform and customer project validations.

This position requires both technical depth and leadership capability – guiding teams, cross-functional stakeholders, and ensuring that PA Core QE becomes the foundation of trust for Genix APM and customer solutions.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Define and own the QE strategy across PA Core areas (DataOps, Edge, Visualization, Packaging, IAM) while establishing governance for functional, non-functional, and regression coverage.
  • Implement the adoption of automation-first and shift-left practices, embedding CI/CD-integrated testing and continuous quality validation.
  • Coordinate the development and recycling of Golden Test Packs and acceptance packs, working with Platform, APM, and Domain teams to align QE outcomes with business KPIs.
  • Mentor QE engineers to build a high-performance, specialist-driven culture while ensuring compliance, security, and performance baselines are validated and measurable.

Qualifications for the role:

  • 15+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, including 3–5 years in a lead or architect role.
  • Demonstrated experience in platform/IIoT or industrial software solutions, ABB, Honeywell, AspenTech, GE Digital.
  • Demonstrated knowledge in creating testing strategies, ensuring quality governance, developing automation frameworks, and establishing teams focused on quality engineering.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of CI/CD integration using tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and GitHub Actions.
  • Practical involvement with automation tools and validation frameworks (PyTest, Playwright, JMeter, SQL/KQL) along with comprehension of industrial data flows (DataOps, Edge, OT/IT adapters, IAM security).
  • Knowledge of security and compliance standards, combined with effective leadership and cross-functional collaboration skills to engage senior stakeholders.
  • Delivered measurable outcomes including >90% QE automation coverage, 100% governance adoption,

  • Leading a team of engineers responsible for delivering Digital Solutions for the below portfolios
  • Energy management solution
  • Historian
  • Asset Twin / APM
  • Cyber Security
  • Any other custom solutions not delivered by KM, EO and P&P MES team
  • The candidate is responsible for complete technical deliverables with for these projects.
  • Accountable for the KPIs for INOPC organization for the team Utilization, TNPS score, Productivity, Engagement.
  • Plan for the project team set-up based on the project scope. Right skill sets required for the project execution is ensured in the team
  • Will be responsible for getting projects executed as per scope agreed with the LBL’s. Will regularly review the progress & check on the quality process followed in execution.

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams like R2R, P2P, P2D, and O2C to ensure accurate and timely finance master data updates and resolve any data-related issues.

  • Master’s degree in accounting, Finance or Commerce.
  • 0 to 1 years of experience in Finance master data object in SAP S4/HANA.

job.description:

This Position reports to:

Technology Product Manager

What we believe in

ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.

Your role and responsibilities

At ABB, being engineered to outrun means enabling our customers to transform their operations, making them leaner, cleaner and more sustainable. With ABB Genix™, we bring together Industrial IoT, AI and deep domain expertise to enable industries to anticipate change, adapt swiftly and act with confidence in a rapidly evolving world.

The AU Digital organization accelerates digital capabilities through a horizontal, reusable and industry-rich Analytics and AI platform, combining Industrial IoT, system integration, Generative AI, predictive modelling and transformative analytics applications and solutions.

In this role, you will report to the Technology Principal Product Manager, AU Digital. As a Technology Product Manager – AU Digital, you will own the end-to-end product management and functionality of flagship AU Digital products and components.

You will work closely with global stakeholders, including Business Unit teams, Digital Business Unit Leads, Development, User Experience, Quality Engineering, Documentation teams and end customers. You will represent the voice of the customer by maintaining and prioritizing the product backlog, ensuring development teams focus on initiatives that maximize business value and deliver meaningful customer outcomes.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Define product vision and strategy: Develop, communicate and drive the product vision, strategy and roadmap for AU Digital products and components. Align business priorities, customer needs and technology capabilities to ensure stakeholders and development teams work toward common objectives.
  • Own product requirements and backlog: Collaborate with customers, business units, Digital Solution Engineering and other stakeholders to identify requirements and solution gaps. Translate business needs into functional specifications, value drivers, user stories and an appropriately prioritized product backlog.
  • Drive end-to-end product delivery: Work closely with development, UX and Quality Engineering teams to ensure a clear understanding of customer use cases and end-to-end functionality. Take ownership of committed releases, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery while maintaining agility to address evolving customer and market needs.
  • Drive product adoption and business value: Partner with marketing, documentation and key business stakeholders to strengthen the product value proposition, develop customer-facing and pre-sales collateral, support go-to-market activities and contribute to the successful adoption and commercial growth of ABB’s digital products and solutions.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in software or digital product management, with proven experience managing products across the end-to-end product lifecycle.
  • MBA from an accredited two-year university, preferably complemented by a technical or engineering background.
  • Strong experience in Industrial IoT, digitalization, enterprise software or analytics platforms, with exposure to technologies such as Azure IoT services, digital twins and IIoT-based analytics solutions.
  • Proven experience in software requirements management, including translating business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, product backlogs and integrated product roadmaps.
  • Demonstrated experience in product strategy, product conceptualization, roadmap development, go-to-market planning and successful release of digital or software products and services.
  • Strong stakeholder management, influencing, networking and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across customers, business units and cross-functional teams in a complex global environment.
  • Preferred experience in asset-intensive industries such as Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals, Power Generation, Metals & Mining, Paper & Pulp, Marine or Ports, along with excellent presentation skills, fluency in English and willingness to travel internationally as required.

More about us

ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.

The Process Automation business area automates, electrifies and digitalizes some of the world’s most complex industrial infrastructures. Through its broad portfolio of automation, software, analytics and digital solutions, ABB supports customers across energy, process, hybrid and maritime industries.

The PA Digital organization plays an important role in accelerating ABB’s digital transformation by developing scalable Industrial IoT, analytics, AI and software solutions. These technologies help customers improve operational efficiency, make informed decisions and operate safer, smarter and more sustainably.

You will own the network strategy and define how network technologies and products enable open, modular, interoperable and cyber-secure automation architectures while ensuring the reliability and continuity expected in mission-critical industrial operations.

The position combines strategic product management with a strong understanding of industrial automation, networking and cybersecurity. You will work across control system product lines and functions to turn technology trends, customer requirements and regulatory developments into a coherent roadmap, network portfolio and partner strategy.

The work model for the role is: hybrid.

This role is contributing to the Automation Process Control Platform (PCP).

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Define and manage the global strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for ABB’s OT network technology
  • Translate ABBs Automation Vision into secure, resilient, standards-based and interoperable network solutions
  • Lead customer, market, competitor and technology analysis, translating insights into requirements, business cases and differentiated value propositions
  • Develop strategic supplier and technology partnerships, including roadmap alignment, technical qualification and lifecycle commitments
  • Shape portfolio requirements for industrial Ethernet, Ethernet-APL, switching, routing, security-zone conduits, redundancy, network management and observability
  • Drive secure-by-design capabilities, including device identity, secure onboarding, access control, vulnerability management and lifecycle support
  • Collaborate with R&D, system architecture, cybersecurity, product-line management, service, sales and marketing to deliver and commercialize the portfolio

Qualifications for the role- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related field (Master's preferred)

  • 5+ years of product management experience in networking, automation, or industrial technology sectors
  • Strong understanding of networking technologies, protocols, and distributed control systems. Experience with ABB control systems System 800xA, Symphony Plus or Freelance is an advantage

  • Excellent strategic thinking and business acumen with ability to translate market insights into products
  • Fluent in English.

job.description:

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead and execute the sales support strategy for Process Industries, aligning local initiatives with ABB’s global business objectives and growth ambitions.

Each day, you will provide technical and commercial leadership to support both internal and external customers, ensuring the delivery of high-quality proposals and solutions. You will demonstrate your expertise by overseeing bid, estimation, and proposal activities, driving compliance with ABB standards, improving win rates and profitability, and coaching and developing a high-performing Sales Support team.

The work model for the role is: Onsite

This role contributes to ABB’s Process Industries Division across Australia and the Pacific Islands, driving excellence in sales support, customer engagement, and commercial performance.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading and developing the Spares, Bids and Proposals teams, fostering a high-performance culture focused on customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Defining key performance targets and ensuring their achievement by monitoring progress, driving corrective actions, and enhancing customer support and service delivery outcomes.
  • Establishing, maintaining, and continuously improving RFQ, pricing, governance, and bid management processes to ensure consistency, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  • Driving the development of competitive, commercially sound proposals by evaluating market conditions, customer requirements, and the most effective delivery models, including direct sales, partnerships, consortiums, and channel strategies.
  • Overseeing the review and validation of commercial, technical, legal, and pricing terms within customer offers, while supporting bid/no-bid assessments and strategic decision-making.
  • Participating in project risk reviews and providing technical and commercial guidance throughout the sales process, ensuring Sales teams are equipped to successfully engage customers through presentations, negotiations, and solution discussions.

Qualifications for the role

  • Proven leadership experience in sales operations, bids, proposals, or commercial teams within process industries such as mining, metals, minerals, energy, or heavy industry.
  • Strong background in sales, business development, or commercial management within automation, electrification, digitalisation, or process control environments.
  • Experience developing and optimising sales systems, governance processes, and performance metrics in high-volume, customer-focused organisations.
  • Sound technical knowledge of industrial automation and electrification solutions, including DCS, PLCs, drives, process control systems, and digital technologies.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify opportunities, negotiate contracts, manage profitability, and drive business growth.
  • Degree qualified in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline, with excellent communication, stakeholder management, and people leadership skills.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based incentives
  • Flexible working arrangements and international travel opportunities
  • Professional development, training, and career growth support
  • Employee assistance program and local-specific benefits in Australia

More about us

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems.

The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Lead ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to successful project results in technology, software, product, and/or solution development, as well as associated Intellectual Property (IP). Each day, you will act as the first point of contact in Research and Development for specific product-related issues and maintenance. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying, proposing, and implementing innovative solutions.

The work model for the role is:#Li-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Distribution Solution division at Nashik, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Maintaining recognized expertise in a specific area by integrating the latest developments in technologies, tools, and methodologies into your work.
  • Finding new ways of solving problems by following your ideas, creating hypotheses, and defining ways to validate them.
  • Documenting work results (like findings, designs, or software), allowing others to maintain and improve them.
  • Understanding and initiating IP generation in your area of specialization and participating in the project IP strategy development.

Qualifications for the role

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering (should be full-time)
  • Minimum 8 to 12 years of experience in Design and Development of Mechanical Parts and Assemblies (Sheet-Metal components, Casted & Machined Metal parts and Molded Plastic parts)
  • Hands-on experience in prototyping, type testing, and interpreting technical drawings.
  • Proficiency in SolidWorks or Creo 3D CAD software.
  • Strong technical knowledge of Medium Voltage Switchgear (CSS / RMU / Transformers)
  • Good verbal and written communication skills in English

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid.   • Lead system enhancement projects and process transformation initiatives.
  • Support implementation and optimization of lease accounting tools (CoStar, Trintech Cadency).
  • Develop and maintain process documentation and SOPs.

Governance & Controls

  • Ensure adherence to financial controls and company policies.
  • Monitor aging items, reconciliation exceptions, and control failures.

This role is contributing to the Critical Power division in Napier, New Zealand. Main stakeholders are manufacturing, engineering, quality assurance, customer quality representatives and supplier quality teams.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conducting quality assurance activities to ensure products, processes, systems, software and services meet specified requirements and customer expectations in incoming material, manufacturing, factory test labs, and final inspection including internal testing routine and Customer / Factory Acceptance Testing (F.A.T.) as applicable.
  • Supporting quality control/assurance needs and activities for production quality, customer quality, supplier quality, testing and validation, and engineering, as applicable in the local organization and sister factories globally.
  • Executing and assisting specific quality-related training, promoting a passion for quality and integrity in all actions, with a focus on result and customer orientation.
  • Collecting, recording, and evaluating data to be interpreted according to the internal ABB specifications, customer norms, material/supplier qualifications, and applicable national and/or global standards while maintaining a high level of integrity.

##

Qualifications for the role

  • You have established skills and experience in quality control/assurance, testing, validation, and inspection methodologies with a strong understanding of electrical and power systems manufacturing environments.
  • You have 8+ years of experience in quality assurance, testing, quality control, or a related function, preferably in a manufacturing or electronics environment.
  • You possess advanced knowledge of quality management systems, testing standards (ISO, IEC), and Factory Acceptance Testing (F.A.T.) procedures and are highly proficient in data recording, analysis and interpretation tools.
  • You are passionate about attention to detail, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement with a demonstrated ability to communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You demonstrate expertise in electrical systems, power electronics, or UPS/critical power applications or have a strong willingness to develop specialized knowledge in these areas.
  • You hold a qualification in electrical/electronic engineering, quality assurance or a related technical discipline, or have an equivalent combination of relevant experience and certifications (such as ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, Lean / Six Sigma Belts).
  • You are at ease communicating in English and have strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • You are flexible to work following extended production schedule, as necessary.

More about us

In ABB's Critical Power division, our customers require reliable and efficient power that supports their growing infrastructure, ensuring that data flows 24x7, while optimizing their footprint, energy costs and operations. They rely on us to provide the latest industry insights and technology to develop solutions needed to meet their evolving challenges. We are a customer-first provider of innovative critical power solutions that are designed for high reliability and performance. Our culture is one of quality and operational excellence which is fuelled and supported by our talented people, tools and processes, and our "know how."

ABB is a global leader in technology and engineering, dedicated to serving a wide range of industries through electrification, automation, and digitalization. Our commitment to innovation, sustainability, and excellence drives our mission to improve quality of life and support the energy transition globally.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: EHS Senior Associate
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an EHS Senior Associate to join our team in Burnie, Tasmania.

This role is ideal for an Environmental, Health & Safety professional who enjoys working closely with operational teams to promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with EHS regulations, policies, and best practices.

Working across our manufacturing and engineering environment, you will support the delivery of EHS programs, conduct inspections and risk assessments, maintain critical compliance records, and help drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety and environmental performance.

In This Role You'll

  • Conduct workplace inspections, audits, and assessments to monitor Environmental, Health & Safety performance
  • Support compliance with Caterpillar EHS policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements
  • Assist with the identification, assessment, and mitigation of workplace hazards and risks
  • Participate in incident investigations and support the implementation of corrective actions
  • Maintain EHS records, reports, and documentation to ensure compliance and data accuracy
  • Assist in the delivery of EHS training, awareness programs, and safety initiatives
  • Support emergency preparedness activities and workplace safety programs
  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of EHS policies and procedures
  • Collaborate with leaders and employees to promote a positive, proactive safety culture
  • Support environmental compliance and sustainability initiatives across the facility
  • Assist with EHS projects that improve operational performance, compliance, and employee wellbeing

What You'll Bring

We're looking for a motivated and detail-oriented EHS professional who can build strong relationships and influence positive safety outcomes across the business.

Ideally, you will have:

  • Qualifications in Workplace Health & Safety, Environmental Management, Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Science, or a related discipline
  • Experience in an Environmental, Health & Safety, manufacturing, industrial, or operational environment
  • Knowledge of workplace health, safety, and environmental regulations and compliance requirements
  • Experience conducting risk assessments, inspections, audits, or incident investigations
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • High attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records and documentation
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • A proactive approach to identifying opportunities for improvement

Highly Regarded

  • Experience within manufacturing, mining, heavy industry, engineering, or industrial operations
  • Knowledge of EHS management systems and compliance frameworks
  • Experience delivering safety training or facilitating toolbox talks
  • Familiarity with incident reporting and investigation processes
  • Experience supporting continuous improvement initiatives
  • Understanding of environmental management and sustainability principles

Why Join the Burnie Team

Burnie is home to Caterpillar's Underground Hard Rock Mining operations and supports the development and manufacture of equipment used by mining customers around the world.

You'll join a collaborative and values-driven team where:

  • Safety is our highest priority and a fundamental part of our culture
  • Employees are empowered to identify risks and drive improvements
  • You'll work closely with stakeholders across manufacturing, engineering, operations, and support functions
  • Your work will directly contribute to protecting people, improving workplace safety, and supporting operational excellence

Additional Information

  • This is a full-time position based in our Burnie office 5 days per week
  • Visa sponsorship is not available for this position

Employee Benefits

  • Competitive remuneration, including bonus and share options
  • Generous parental leave with flexible payment options
  • Strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity
  • Employee discounts across health, wellbeing, travel, and retail
  • Global career progression and development opportunities within Caterpillar

How to Apply

If you're passionate about workplace safety and environmental stewardship and want to build your career with a global industry leader, apply via:

Your road to success begins with Caterpillar.

Join a global leader and build a career with real impact.

_Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer._

_Caterpillar of Australia is not currently hiring applicants who require sponsorship. As a global company, opportunities may be available in other locations via our careers website._

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Business Process Analysttojoin Global Business Technology - Caterpillar Financial Services India Private Limited

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN

What you will do

Job Duties:

Evolving Regulatory and Compliance Landscape

  • India continues to experience frequent regulatory and compliance changes that require close collaboration between business, legal, compliance, and IT stakeholders. Recent initiatives have demonstrated the need for strong local knowledge and dedicated coordination to assess impacts, clarify requirements, and ensure timely and compliant implementation.

Business Partnership and Stakeholder Engagement

  • The RBA serves as a trusted partner to the business, supporting not only operational issues resolution, but also strategic initiatives and governance activities. The role actively participates in MD Governance forums and local IT committee meetings, providing business systems expertise and insights.

Country-Specific Expertise and Operational Continuity

  • India's operating model includes unique business practices, regulatory requirements, and system processes that require specialized knowledge. Maintaining dedicated in-country expertise helps preserve institutional knowledge, reduce delivery and operational risks, and ensure consistent support for both daily operations and future initiatives.

What you will have

Evolving Regulatory and Compliance Landscape

  • India continues to experience frequent regulatory and compliance changes that require close collaboration between business, legal, compliance, and IT stakeholders. Recent initiatives have demonstrated the need for strong local knowledge and dedicated coordination to assess impacts, clarify requirements, and ensure timely and compliant implementation.

Business Partnership and Stakeholder Engagement

  • The RBA serves as a trusted partner to the business, supporting not only operational issues resolution, but also strategic initiatives and governance activities. The role actively participates in MD Governance forums and local IT committee meetings, providing business systems expertise and insights.

Country-Specific Expertise and Operational Continuity

  • India's operating model includes unique business practices, regulatory requirements, and system processes that require specialized knowledge. Maintaining dedicated in-country expertise helps preserve institutional knowledge, reduce delivery and operational risks, and ensure consistent support for both daily operations and future initiatives.
  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.

Skills desired:

Core Application Systems:Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Helps create contingency plans to mitigate impact of disruption on core applications.
  • Identifies key players, criticalities, roles, and responsibilities.
  • Investigates application-related issues with both business and IT professionals.
  • Recommends enhancements for a major application system or related subsystems.
  • Works with core application systems for a major business unit or function.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Technology Advising:Knowledge of effective advisory methods and ability to provide valued information and advice to clients regarding products, technologies, services and solutions for a specific technology domain.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Assesses the current technology environment, expressed needs and initiatives of client organizations.
  • Uses an effective consulting method to present technology solutions that resolve stated client business issues.
  • Advises clients regarding a family of specific products, technologies or services in a technology domain.
  • Demonstrates basic competence and sound business knowledge regarding specific products,

technologies or services within a domain of technology expertise.

  • Achieves consulting relationship rating of 'professional' by delivering timely, meaningful advice meeting client needs in a narrow set of specific technologies.

Application Design, Architecture:Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Creates a basic architecture diagram, including component interactions and data flows.
  • Identifies and prioritizes application design and architecture tasks, such as refactoring and technical debt reduction.
  • Selects and presents design alternatives for applications of small to medium complexity.
  • Uses design tools and technologies to develop prototypes and proof of concepts.
  • Documents design decisions and rationale for future reference and review.

Implementation:Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
  • Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
  • Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
  • Provides instant support for end users of application software.
  • Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

Requirements Analysis:Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
  • Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
  • Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
  • Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
  • Trains others on requirements, walkthroughs and quality reviews.
  • Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

System and Technology Integration:Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Assists with current and planned integration initiatives.
  • Explores major issues and considerations for successful system integration.
  • Works with applications, data, technology bridges and a variety of platforms.
  • Works with existing interfaces as well as integration and migration plans within own area.Plays an active role in local integration efforts.

System Testing:Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Supports the project leader in developing and executing system test plans.
  • Evaluates system documentation and user manuals for usability, accuracy and completeness.
  • Executes test cases, analyzes test results and reports on findings regularly.
  • Tests system components for compliance with functional requirements.
  • Participates in the testing of a system's ability to recover from hardware or software failures.

What you will get:

  • Work Life Harmony
  • Earned and medical leave.
  • Relocation assistance

Holistic Development

  • Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
  • Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness

  • Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
  • Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness

  • Employee investment plan
  • Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Additional Information:

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers)

August 21, 2026 - August 30, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Site Leader - Thermal & Electric - El Paso Tx
job.description:
Job Description

The Site Leader will provide world class jobsite leadership for large, long-duration, high-profile projects for Vertiv power and/or thermal equipment. The Site Leader is the primary Vertiv Service on-site technical representative for large jobs, from construction start, through start-up, site acceptance testing, and project completion. The Site Leader is required to establish, grow and maintain excellent rapport with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives and others as appropriate. The Site Lead is required to work in tandem with the assigned Project Manager to drive cost controls, schedule adherence, resource management, and ultimately a positive customer experience.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

ROLE SUMMARY

  • Provide jobsite construction and technical leadership for large projects
  • Working knowledge of critical infrastructure equipment in data centers, including Vertiv-manufactured equipment
  • Leads a multi-disciplinary on-site team consisting of Project Leaders, Installers, Technicians, Customer Engineers, and subcontractors
  • Represents Vertiv at daily customer meetings and can speak to technical requirements for the day’s schedule to coordinate activity with other parties on-site
  • Leads and supports start-up and site testing activities for assigned projects
  • Ensure sufficient manpower on-site each day to perform start-up and site testing work
  • Assist during start-up and site testing as necessary, depending upon man-power availability and site location
  • Provide daily status reports to Service Management, Project Management and sales rep

TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Keeps current on Vertiv equipment start-up and commissioning processes, procedures, and tools-of-the-trade
  • Keeps current on Safety Bulletins, Safety Field Change Notices, Field Change Notices, and Service Tips

SAFETY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads daily Vertiv toolbox talk, pre-job safety walk and inspection, and drives any necessary corrective/preventative actions required in a timely fashion
  • Responsible for the adherence and administration of all site and Vertiv Safety policies on job sites
  • Operates in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines
  • Must wear appropriate PPE as per company guidelines and accordance with job duties
  • Adhere to work hours policy guidelines – “14 hours rule”
  • Report all work related accidents or injuries within 24 hours to the appropriate personnel
  • Must be a role model to fellow associates with regards to safety by setting a positive example
  • Lead by example with the use of STOP WORK Authority, Good Catch engagement, and timely closure of necessary corrective/preventative actions

ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure adherence to Vertiv Warranty process in partnership with Project Manager
  • Provide accurate and timely reporting in accordance with published guidelines
  • Timecards, expense reports, mileage reports, SR/task closure, forms, et al.
  • Supports Project Manager with obtaining any necessary technical data so Project Manager can maintain project systems
  • Maintain company property according to company policies
  • Credit cards, PPE, test equipment, laptop, smartphone, et al.

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide proper and adequate communication to internal and external customers
  • Ensure daily alignment of customer expectations and Vertiv activity, and drive clarification/re-alignment if there appears to be misalignment of expectations
  • Maintain customer satisfaction rates according to company guidelines

PERSONAL PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

  • Make decisions based on the Fundamental 5 in order of importance: Safety, Quality, Timeliness, Cost, Productivity
  • Capable of making timely decisions, technical and commercial, under pressure
  • Maintain productive utilization rate according to company guidelines
  • Adhere to company dress code and safety regulations
  • Understand and comply with company startup/escalation process and procedures
  • In all aspects of job requirements, must lead by example, and conduct themselves aligned to Vertiv Behaviors
  • Ability to communicate with all levels within the organization -Managers, co-workers, Support Services, sales, electronic communications, et al.
  • Ability to handle stressful situations and provide a calming effect to customer
  • High level of diplomacy when interacting with internal and external customers

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience (one or more of the following)
  • ASEET or ASMET preferred
  • Equivalent industry experience, specifically leading and actively participating in start-up and commissioning of power and/or hvac equipment preferred
  • Six years’ military experience in a related field
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Industrial construction management
  • Interpersonal Skills
  • Vertiv Behavior practitioner
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Independent operator
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Able to build and maintain trusting customer relationships
  • Collaborative and cooperative in high-stress environments
  • Able to communicate at all levels of an organization with a base level of executive presence
  • Able to quickly respond to changing customer priorities without disruption or resistance
  • Must be able to read and interpret electrical one-line diagrams and blueprints
  • In all aspects of the job, need to lead by example, and be held to a higher standard of conduct
  • Product certifications up to date
  • Meet all aspects of the job description
  • Performance evaluation rating of meets all aspects of job requirement or better
  • Consistent performance and customer relation skills
  • Technical skills
  • Ability to make an immediate site evaluation, skills to include environmental temperature, and general operating conditions without supervision
  • Ability to summarize and report all work related tasks performed
  • Independently evaluate, recognize and recommend acceptable customer solutions based upon site evaluation
  • Recommend and direct activities at a customer site by leading technical activities of other technicians
  • Provide on-site customer consultation with the assistance of Project Leader(s)
  • Capable of providing project leadership and on-site direction for assigned projects
  • Expert in COHE procedures
  • Expert in site acceptance testing procedures and equipment
  • Computer skills
  • Advanced word processing, report generation
  • Spreadsheet processing
  • Electronic mail
  • Testing equipment and data analysis programs
  • Familiarity with computer networks
  • Mechanical aptitude

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Job assignments will typically be long-term assignments ranging from 4 weeks to 12+ months duration based upon the scope and schedule of the project
  • If assigned a project not located in the vicinity of Site Leader residence, travel will consist of a field rotation that includes (3) consecutive weeks on the customer site followed by (1) week of a service break in their home office whereby the Site Leader is expected to work their minimum of 40 hours on billable tasks and any administrative duties (i.e. Safety training, cycle counts, etc.) as necessary
  • Jobsites consisting of industrial new construction (greens field) or retrofit construction (browns field)
  • Flexible schedules (weekends, evenings, and holidays)
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Deployable in the event of emergencies

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing duties of the above jobs, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or other components; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear and smell. The associate frequently is required to sit and climb or balance.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.  Must be able to consistently lift up to 50 pounds and occasionally up to 75 pounds.

Notes: Vertiv will make reasonable accommodations whenever necessary for all qualified employees or candidates with disabilities (as defined by applicable law), provided that (1) the individual is otherwise qualified to safely perform the essential functions of the job and (2) such accommodations due not impose an undue hardship.

_The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities._

_OUR CORE PRINCIPALS: Safety. Integrity.  Respect.  Teamwork. Diversity & Inclusion._

_OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES_

  • _Customer Focus_
  • _Operational Excellence_
  • _High-Performance Culture_
  • _Innovation_
  • _Financial Strength_

_OUR BEHAVIORS_

  • _Own It_
  • _Act With Urgency_
  • _Foster a Customer-First Mindset_
  • _Think Big and Execute_
  • _Lead by Example_
  • _Drive Continuous Improvement_
  • _Learn and Seek Out Development_

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

  • Own it
  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute
  • Lead by example
  • Drive continuous improvement
  • Learn and seek out development
  • Promote transparent & open communication

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Work Authorization

No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Vertiv is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability. If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, you can request help by sending an email to [help.join@vertiv.com](mailto:help.join@vertiv.com)

The Site Leader is the primary Vertiv Service on-site technical representative for large jobs, from construction start, through start-up, site acceptance testing, and project completion.   • Leads and supports start-up and site testing activities for assigned projects

job.title: Test Engineering Technician
job.description:
Job Description

Brief Job Description

This is a Test Engineering Technician role is in the Product Integrity department of the Power Management business unit.  The Product Integrity team setups and executes test cases to validation new AC Power products.  Products may have a regional scope or a global scope.

Job Summary

This is a _Test Engineering Technician_ role is in the Product Integrity department of the Power Management business unit.  The Product Integrity team setups and executes test cases to validation new AC Power products.  Products may have a regional scope or a global scope.

The Test Engineering Technician will setup the unit under test and the instrumentation as per the test plan.  They will operate the unit under test and collect data as per the individual test cases. While executing the test cases, the technician will make observations and keep notes regarding the unit under test’s performance.  All of the data collected and the technician’s notes are entered into the test results by the technician.  The technician participates in daily standup meetings, keeps their work areas clean and safe, and assists with keeping all the test labs clean and safe.

This position will be based onsite at our Delaware, OH location.

Responsibilities

  • Follow safety policies and lead by example with safe job execution.
  • Setup the unit under test and other equipment which entails connecting large cables (up to 50lbs).
  • Setup instrumentation (oscilloscopes, power meters, CTs, voltage probes, and other equipment).
  • Execute test cases, operate unit under test, operate the instrumentation, collect data, and document the results.
  • Troubleshoot and correct problems with test setups and with units under test.
  • Suggest continuous improvement opportunities.

Requirements

  • Associate of Science majoring in Electronics or Electrical Engineering or military certification achieved.
  • 1 to 3 years of relevant experience.
  • Broad knowledge of electrical and mechanical test techniques.
  • Experience with 208/230/480V/600V 3-phase 60/50 Hz wiring and equipment.
  • Experience with 120v 1-phase 60Hz wiring and equipment.
  • Experience with instrumentation and low volt wiring.
  • Experience with electrical safety tools and techniques.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Word and Excel
  • General mechanical skills assembling and disassembling electrical equipment including but not limited to, high power electronics, large magnetic components, circuit boards, high current wiring etc.
  • Must have good working knowledge and skills in testing of electrical equipment.
  • Must be able to read electronic and electrical schematics.
  • Good troubleshooting skills related to AC and DC power circuits.
  • Basic experience setting up and using oscilloscopes, power meters for 3 phase measurements.
  • Shift/Schedule flexibility for short periods/projects is a plus

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to lift 50lbs.
  • Ability to stand and/or walk while performing tasks 70% of the time.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • ~5%

job.title: Product Strategist - Emerging Technologies
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Product Strategist - Emerging Technologies is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and developing product and market strategies for next-generation technologies that will shape the future of data center infrastructure. This role serves as a key link between market intelligence, customer needs, technology innovation, product management, engineering, and business leadership. The Product Strategist assesses emerging market trends, competitive dynamics, customer requirements, and technology advancements to support Vertiv’s long-term growth strategy, product roadmap development, and investment decisions.

_This position will be based onsite at our Westerville, OH location._

Responsibilities

  • Commercial Assessment: Evaluate research programs for commercial potential — assessing market demand, technical feasibility, regulatory pathway, and time-to-market.
  • Customer Discovery & Competitive Analysis: Conduct customer discovery interviews, competitive landscape analysis, and market sizing to inform research priorities and investment decisions.
  • Research-to-Business Alignment: Work with research teams to align research roadmaps with business strategy, product portfolio needs, and market timing.
  • Go-to-Market Planning: Develop preliminary go-to-market strategies for promising research outcomes, including pricing frameworks, channel strategies, and launch sequencing.
  • Proof-of-Concept Guidance: Guide proof-of-concept development to ensure experiments address business-critical questions (not just technical curiosity).
  • Regulatory & IP Strategy: Identify regulatory requirements and intellectual property considerations that impact commercialization timelines and investment decisions.
  • Cross-BU Collaboration: Work across business units to ensure research initiatives align with broader market needs and avoid duplication of effort.
  • Financial Modeling: Build business cases and financial models to support investment decisions, including TAM/SAM analysis, ROI projections, and risk-adjusted returns.

Preferred Competencies:

  • Strategic Thinking with Commercial Pragmatism
  • Commercial Acumen and Business Case Development
  • Customer Empathy and Voice of Customer Discovery
  • Comfort with Ambiguity in Early-Stage Research
  • Energy Efficiency and Sustainability Solutions

Requirements

  • 8–10 years in product strategy, product management, or business development in technology-driven organizations.
  • Demonstrated success in evaluating and commercializing early-stage technology or research.
  • Strong market analysis, customer discovery, and competitive intelligence skills.
  • Ability to assess technical feasibility at a conceptual level (without needing to do the engineering).
  • Excellent stakeholder management — ability to influence without authority across research, engineering, and commercial teams.
  • Experience building business cases and financial models for technology investments.

Preferred:

  • Background in engineering, science, or technical field (degree or equivalent experience).
  • Industry experience in data center infrastructure, thermal management, power systems, or energy efficiency.
  • Understanding of regulatory environments relevant to infrastructure technology.
  • Experience working with or within R&D organizations.

job.title: FP&A Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Who are we?

_At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected.  With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people._

We are now looking for a FP&A Analyst in Cluj-Napoca, Romania!

As a FP&A Analyst – Trade Working Capital, you will take part in key activities of the team related to monthly / periodical reporting, monitoring, planning and analysis of working capital and cash flow for EMEA, working closely with various cross-functional & cross-regional teams including C2C, R2R, P2P, Corporate Treasury.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and support monthly actuals and forecasting activities for Trade Working Capital (TWC) across local entities and the EMEA region, including submissions in Hyperion Planning.
  • Play an active role in the budgeting and financial planning process, contributing to key business decisions and future growth initiatives.
  • Manage and continuously improve the weekly cash flow forecasting process, providing visibility and insights at both Entity and EMEA levels.
  • Perform financial and business performance analysis, comparing Actuals, Forecasts, and Prior Year results to identify trends, opportunities, and key business drivers.
  • Collaborate with finance and business stakeholders to investigate variances, solve complex challenges, and recommend actionable solutions.
  • Support management in decision-making through ad-hoc financial analysis and business insights.
  • Develop, enhance, and deliver management reports, dashboards, and presentations that provide clear and impactful performance updates.
  • Use modern analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI, Power Query, SQL, VBA, Oracle Hyperion and AI to automate processes, improve reporting, and turn data into meaningful insights.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, challenging existing ways of working and helping shape more efficient and data-driven finance processes.
  • Gain exposure to a dynamic EMEA business environment, working closely with experienced professionals and building strong expertise in financial planning, reporting, cash flow management, and data analytics

Key Capabilities:

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build effective working relationships across teams
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to present insights through reports, presentations, and discussions.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Continuous learning attitude, open to feedback and committed to personal development.
  • Process improvement focus, always looking for opportunities to simplify, automate, and optimize.
  • Ability to influence and support decision-making through data-driven recommendations.

  • University Degree in Economics/ Finance or equivalent
  • 2+ years work experience in a financial capacity, experience in analysis, reporting preferred
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel is a must)
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, accuracy, ability to work with figures and complex calculations; ability to transform a user’s reporting and/or analysis needs into insightful reporting
  • Problem solving attitude
  • Experience with software and other Reporting Tools such as HFM, Hyperion Planning, Microsoft Power BI / Tableau, Snowflake, SQL, VBA, AI and automation tools is a plus
  • Oracle ERP knowledge is a plus
  • Good communication skills and team working approach
  • Global and cultural awareness
  • Language Skills: Fluent in English – Minimum C1 level English requirement

Preferred Skills

  • Advanced Degrees: master’s degree in a related field or an MBA.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI,/ Tableau, Snowflake, SQL, VBA, AI and automation tools

job.title: Program Manager – Emerging Technology
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Program Manager – Emerging Technology coordinates and manages complex, multi-disciplinary research programs that span multiple business units, research domains, and external partnerships. The role’s primary purpose is to remove organizational and logistical friction so domain scientists can focus on research, and ensure dependencies, budgets, and timelines across teams stay visible and aligned.

This position will be based onsite at our Westerville, OH location.

Responsibilities

  • Program Coordination: Own end-to-end delivery of 2–3 large research programs; establish timelines, milestones, and cross-team dependencies; escalate blockers to leadership.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate planning meetings across Research Scientists, Research Engineers, Data Engineers, and external partners (universities, vendors, contract labs); ensure alignment on objectives and resource needs.
  • External Resource Management: Coordinate with external labs, academic partners, vendors, and contract researchers; manage SOWs, timelines, deliverables, and communication.
  • Budget & Resource Tracking: Monitor program spend, resource allocation across internal and external teams, and forecast variances.
  • Status & Reporting: Maintain program dashboards; provide leadership with visibility on health, risks, and upcoming milestones.
  • Cross-BU Coordination: Work with product/commercial teams to ensure research roadmaps align with business priorities; unblock resource conflicts between business units.
  • Risk Management: Identify dependencies, critical path risks, and resource constraints early; develop mitigation plans.

Preferred Areas of Technological Focus:

  • Thermal Management and Advanced Cooling Systems
  • Data Center Infrastructure and Architecture
  • Power Systems and Power Conversion
  • Energy Efficiency and Sustainability Solutions
  • High-Performance Computing (HPC) Environments
  • Advanced Materials and Manufacturing Processes

Requirements

  • Bachelor Degree in Engineering, Technology Management, or related technical discipline.
  • MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.
  • 5-7 years of program or project management experience in technology, critical infrastructure, data center, power systems, energy storage, thermal management, or related industries.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional technology development or product commercialization programs.
  • Strong understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including power, thermal, digital management, or energy systems.
  • Experience with NPDI methodologies.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Knowledge of DFSS, FMEA, requirements traceability, and technology readiness frameworks preferred.
  • PMP certification preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, and Power BI.

Preferred:

  • Background in engineering, science, or technical field (degree or 5+ years hands-on experience).
  • Experience managing research programs or innovation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with academic partnerships or contract research organizations.
  • Background in data center, thermal management, power systems, or related industries.
